Explanatory Remarks:

1. Structural elements are enclosed in <>.

Text:

<4.1>
śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca
oṃ namo yugarūpāya namastiṣyādimokṣiṇe |
bālayoginīnāthāya namaste bālayogine || 1 ||
namo’saṃkhyacaritrāya namaścānandavārdhaye |
namaste bālakṛṣṇāya bālāntarātmane namaḥ || 2 ||
cidacidvapuṣe’nādiśrīkṛṣṇāya namonamaḥ |
badrikāpataye naranārāyaṇātmane namaḥ || 3 ||
sarvasaukhyavidhātre te sarvadharmādhikāriṇe |
yāvallīlādivāsyāya namaste sādhurūpiṇe || 4 ||
sādhvīśaktisumiśrāya svarṇarekhājaṭādhṛge |
ekarasasvarūpāya sarojanījuṣe namaḥ || 5 ||
ekadhā daśadhā sahasradhā koṭyarbudābjadhā |
kāntākānto’nvitaścāste pṛthak cāpi ca te namaḥ || 6 ||
yo dadhāra tu rādhāyāḥ kṛte kṛṣṇaṃ nijaṃ vapuḥ |
yaśca śriyaḥ kṛte nārāyaṇo nārāyaṇeśvaraḥ || 7 ||
yaśca ramyaṃ vāsudevaṃ vyūhaṃ dadhāra sṛṣṭaye |
yaśca hiraṇmayaṃ rūpaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ dadhāra ca || 8 ||
tathā tiṣyārditānāṃ tūddhārāya tāpasāṃ vapuḥ |
dharmād dadhāra bhagavān naranārāyaṇātmakam || 9 ||
sarvathā karuṇāpūrṇaṃ sādhuśīlasamanvitam |
muktarṣisevitaṃ śāntaṃ taṃ namāmi pareśvaram || 4.1.1 0||
naranārāyaṇaṃ rūpaṃ vīkṣya kāntasya cakriṇaḥ |
yā māṇikyā cākṣaraśrīstāpasī śīlayoginī || 11 ||
yā divyā divyaśaktiśca brahmacaryaparāyaṇā |
manāk sparśaṃ na sahate yānyasya śrīhariṃ vinā || 1 2||
sā kāntaṃ tāpasaṃ saṃsevituṃ badarikābhavat |
badrīśvarī māṇikī suprajñā pārvatikātmikā ||13||
rādhāramādisaṃpūjyā rājate nandasaccitiḥ |
tryātmikāpyekarūpāsti chatrarūpā hareḥ sadā || 14||
yasyāḥ patreṣu devyaśca muktānikā vasantyapi |
yasyā muktā badareṣu vasanti madhurātmakāḥ || 12||
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ sākāraṃ badarīti tat |
tejomayaṃ dhāmarūpaṃ tat drumātmakamatra vai || 16||
sevākṣarakṛtā mūrtimatī yāvāhanaṃ hareḥ |
brahmacaryaṃ hareratra nararūpaṃ virājate || 17||
ṛṣayo bhagavatkeśāḥ sarve tapanti yatra ca |
anyāścātra badaryo vai hareḥ śaktaya eva tāḥ || 18||
gaṃgā cidbuddhirūpātra vartate nrāyaṇāṃganā |
ānandaiśvaryarūpāśca bhūmayo badarīvane || 19||
satsvarūpiṇya upalā dhavalā dāvanāśikāḥ |
parṇakuṭyo’tra dhāmāni sabhā brahmavratātmikā ||4.1.20||
samādhirdhāraṇā dhyānaṃ vitāneṣu vasanti hi |
rājate munibhāleṣu munibhāleṣu tūrdhvasrotastvamuttamam ||21 ||
jitendriyatvaṃ cihneṣu dhātusrāvaviyogiṣu |
jitātmatvaṃ hṛdayeṣu rājate badrikāśrame ||22||
yatra nāsti kalervāsaḥ satyaṃ vasati sarvadā |
satyadharmā satyasanto vidyante kṛtadharmiṇaḥ ||23||
yāvatsthāsyati bhūdevī yāvaddhimagiristathā |
tāvacchrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sthāsyati tāpasaḥ ||24||
naranārāyaṇanāmnā badrīśvaraparaprabhuḥ |
tāvat kṛtasya dharmā vai sthāsyanti badarīvane ||25||
dhanyo’yaṃ mānavo loko yadarthaṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikānātho naranārāyaṇātmanā ||26||
badarīnātha evāyaṃ bhūtvā śaśvadvirājate |
māṇikyāyāśvinī divyā vāhā ceyaṃ drurūpiṇī ||27||
badrī bhūtvā brāhmatanvī tena sākaṃ virājate |
nārāyaṇī hi sā lakṣmīrbālakṛṣṇaṃ niṣevate ||28||
yairjanaiḥ samanudhyātā vanditā viditā tathā |
yābhiśca kṛtasevā tāḥ kṛṣṇayogaṃ prayacchati ||29||
te narā yoṣitaḥ sarve māṇikyānugrahād bhuvi |
saguṇā api jāyante nirguṇā mokṣabhāginaḥ ||4.1.3 0||
aho bhāgyaṃ bhuvanānāṃ yanmadhye badarīvanam |
aho bhāgyaṃ mānavānāṃ ye vasanti vanābhitaḥ || 31 ||
badaryāḥ śītalā vātā yān spṛśanti janāspadān |
te deśāḥ pāvanāḥ puṇyā jāyante badarīsamāḥ ||32||
dhanyeyaṃ badarīdevī pārijātāvahāsinī |
pārijātastu vai varṣamuvāsa kṛṣṇamandire ||33||
iyaṃ tu badarīdevī hyākalpaṃ chatravaddhareḥ |
rājate nityayogena muktānī śīlayoginī ||34||
kalpadrumo’pi yasyāgre notkṛṣṭatvaṃ prasevate |
sakāmaḥ sa hi seyaṃ tu niṣkāmā śrīnarāyaṇī ||35||
tulasī bhāgyaśīlāpi vane vane vinā harim |
sākṣāt patimṛte tvāste tato na badarīsamā ||36||
badrikeyaṃ tu bhagavadgṛhiṇī gṛharūpiṇī |
yannāmnā śrīnārāyaṇālayaḥ prasiddhyati ||37||
vṛndāṃ tyaktvā yayau vṛndāvane kṛṣṇastu paścimām |
dvārikāṃ tena sā vṛndā vṛkṣarūpā viyoginī ||38||
naināṃ badarīṃ bhagavām̐styajatyeva kvacit prabhuḥ |
vṛndāyāṃ ca tulasyāṃ ca nirodho rājaso mataḥ ||39||
badaryāṃ brahmasattvaṃ vai sadā sāttvikatāṃ gatam |
ketakī ca tapaḥ kṛtvā yayāvambaramūrdhvagam ||4.1.40 ||
sā tu kāpaṭyadoṣeṇa prakṣiptādhojagāma ha |
mithyāsākṣyaṃ vedhasaśca kṛtvā hyapūjyatāṃ gatā ||41||
badarīyaṃ mahāmuktānikā cājñākarī hareḥ |
mahāmāṇikyavarṇā sā muktānikā ca dāsikā |||42|||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya virahāsahā |
naranārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ tāpasaṃ cānutāpasī ||43||
bhūtvā nārāyaṇīdevī bālakṛṣṇamanusṛtā |
sadā bālasvabhāvā vai badarī bālayoginī ||44||
sarvaśreṣṭhā vidyate’tra nityakṛṣṇasuyoginī |
kāmadughāḥ samastā vai gatvā śrībadarīvanam ||45||
natvā nārāyaṇīṃ badrīṃ chāyāyāṃ tāḥ samāsate |
nārāyaṇaṃ payaḥ pāyayitvā yāntyanu taddivam ||46||
tā manvate dhanyabhāgyaṃ badaryāḥ kṛṣṇayojitam |
kalpalatāḥ svargavallyaḥ śocante virahaṃ hareḥ ||47||
praśaṃsanti mahadbhāgyaṃ badaryā nityayojitam |
phalāmṛtaṃ kvacit prāpya devā gaṃgāplavārthinaḥ ||48||
pramodante phalarase tiraskurvanti cāmṛtam |
amṛtasya sadā pāne tṛptā devā bhavanti na ||49||
badarīphalamāsādya varṣaṃ tṛptā maharṣayaḥ |
bodhivṛkṣo vane tyakto nārāyaṇena sādhunā |4.1.50||
so’pi nābhyudayaṃ dhatte dhatte badrī tu yādṛśam |
yaṣṭikā śrīvāmanasya kṛtakārye layaṃ gatā ||51 ||
vinā sevāṃ vartate sā brahmaloke viyoginī |
badarīyaṃ bhāgyavatī mahatī yaṣṭikāditaḥ ||52||
yajñanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samidhārthaṃ drumān śubhān |
vyaracayattathā yajñe juhāva tān purā svayam ||53||
tathāpi te na badarīsamā bhāgyayujo yataḥ |
yajñānte te vane tyaktā nārāyaṇena yajñinā ||54||
badarīyaṃ sadā nārāyaṇena śirasi kṛtā |
dhanyā tvaṃ māṇikīdevi dhanyā tvaṃ badarīśvari ||55||
yā tvaṃ kṛṣṇena na tyaktā cānte satyādikā yathā |
dhanyā vai koṭiśo nāryaḥ kṛṣṇayogamupāgatāḥ ||56||
śaśvaddhanyā yathā tvaṃ vai tathā tā na kadācana |
sarvālayaṃ gatāḥ paścād rājase tvaṃ tu badrike ||57||
tvanmūlāt khalu tīrthāni nadyo bhavanti badrike |
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ ramā śrīśca kamalā tvaṃ haripriyā ||58||
tvaṃ nārāyaṇavāsena nārāyaṇī narāyaṇī |
rādhā virajā hariṇī sarasvatī tvadāśrayāḥ ||59||
sarvāstvāṃ vīkṣituṃ yānti nityaṃ nārāyaṇājñayā |
gaṃgā tvatpādamāplāvya tato yāti sthalāntaram ||4.1.60||
narmadā saptakalpā vai godā tu daśakalpikā |
sarvakalpā badarīti nārāyaṇena nirmitā ||61 ||
yāvaccheṣaḥ kṣīranidhau ramā śvetanivāsinī |
lakṣmīryāvacca vaikuṇṭhe tāvad badrī hi śāśvatī ||62||
yāvatīnāṃ drujātīnāṃ pādapānāṃ ca mūlinām |
pāvanī badarīdevī nārāyaṇī pareśvarī ||63||
plakṣadvīpe plakṣadevālaye plakṣamahotsave |
dvīpāntarebhyaścodbhijjā jātayaḥ samupāyayuḥ ||64||
kalpodbhijjāstu vai svargāt puṇyodbhijjāstu satyataḥ |
śrāddhodbhijjā janādibhyo bhūmestu daivipādapāḥ ||65||
caityavṛkṣāḥ samidvṛkṣā aṃkurā darbhajātayaḥ |
rasiṇaḥ śākinaścāpi phalinaḥ puṣpiṇastathā ||66||
dvīpanāmakarā jambuprabhṛtayaśca cāyayuḥ |
oṣadhayo viṣahantryo jīvadāścāyayustathā ||67||
garbhiṇyaḥ prasaviṇyaśca vaṃśinyaśca samāyayuḥ |
sandhinyo brahmacāriṇyo yugalāśca samāyayuḥ ||68||
plakṣapūjottaraṃ koṭyoṣadhīnāṃ maṇḍape tadā |
kalpadrumo jagādaitān pādapān daivasaṃjñakān ||69||
plakṣotsavo’yaṃ sampannaḥ puṇyakṛt sarvaśākhinām |
jijñāsaikā vartate me prakāśayāmi vaḥ puraḥ ||4.1.70||
vayaṃ tu pādapāḥ sarve karāgraphalaśālinaḥ |
bhuñjante’nye naḥ phalāni vayaṃ tu tāpasāḥ sadā ||71||
pṛthivīgarbhabhoktāro devārpaṇavivarjitāḥ |
pāpabhujastataḥ syāmo vṛtrahatyāghayoginaḥ ||72||
kledyakhādyaprabhoktāraḥ pūjādharmādivarjitāḥ |
tīrthakāryavidhurāśca tāmasā jñānavarjitāḥ ||73||
kathaṃ duritanāśo naḥ saṃbhaved baddhaśākhinām |
plakṣadrumo mahān vipra uddhāraṃ naḥ pravakṣyati ||74||
ityevaṃ tathyajijñāsāṃ śrutvā plakṣeśvaro drumaḥ |
vicārya bahudhā sarvapādapānāṃ viśuddhaye ||75||
sāmarthyaṃ paramaṃ yatra vartate śrīhareḥ samam |
avyāhataṃ śāśvataṃ ca manāk hrāsavivarjitam ||76||
taṃ śaraṇyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca pāpaghnaṃ śāntidaṃ tathā |
māyāśāntikaraṃ nārāyaṇamūrtyātmakaṃ drumam ||77||
satsabhāsaṃgataṃ nityaṃ badarīdrumamāha tān |
śṛṇvantu śākhinaḥ sarve sarvapāpavināśakam ||78||
kṛṣṇatulyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāśrame |
badarīvanamadhye vai tvāste yā bālayoginī ||79||
bālabadarīdevī yā māṇikyā pārameśvarī |
badrīśvarī śīlaguptā sadaiva brahmacāriṇī ||4.1.80||
mahāmuktānikā koṭimuktamaṇḍaladhāriṇī |
sā badrikā pādapānāṃ jātyuddhārakarī śubhā ||81||
darśanāt sparśanānnāmnā namaskārād vicintanāt |
āśrayādyogataścāpi vartate pāpanāśinī ||82||
yāni vai vṛkṣajātīnāṃ pāpāni sahajāni ca |
āgantukāni cānyāni sā badrī nāśayiṣyati ||83||
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād brahmacaryārthatāpasaḥ |
yadarthaṃ sā badrikāpi brahmaśīlā ca tāpasī ||84||
sarvapāpaharā divyā sarvakalmaṣanāśinī |
vartate sarvasāmarthyānvitordhvā pārameśvarī ||85||
tatra pāpavināśārthaṃ gantavyaṃ tu yathāyatham |
śākhibhiḥ pādapaiḥ sarvairyātrārthaṃ prativatsaram ||86||
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ ca yoginastathā |
phalapuṣparasādyaiśca sampūjya badarīṃ namet ||87||
spṛśed badarīṃ divyāṃ tāṃ vasettacchāyike sthale |
milecca vakṣasā badrīṃ makarandaṃ grasettathā ||88||
tadvāyuṃ cāpi gṛhṇīyāt pradakṣiṇaṃ carettathā |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ samarpayet kṣamāṃ stutim ||89||
prakuryāt parameśi tvaṃ pāpajālaṃ vināśaya |
vṛkṣayonermahākaṣṭānmocayāsmān pramokṣaya ||4.1.90||
evaṃ samprārthya tāṃ devīṃ natvā svaṃ svaṃ vanaṃ vrajet |
saṃsmared badarīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||91 ||
vṛkṣāṇāṃ mokṣadā devī badrikā tvekajanmani |
evaṃ yātrākṛto vṛkṣā yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim ||92||
tato vṛkṣairarthitā vai yātrārthaṃ calatā nijā |
śvetadvīpe hareragre haristānāha sarvadā ||93||
sthirā bhavanto vṛkṣā vai tathāpi mokṣalabdhaye |
sūkṣmadehena gantāro yātrārthino bhaviṣyatha ||94||
pādasyaikasya sūkṣmasya bhūgarbhe vastu lagnatā |
bhaviṣyati tu yāvadvai tāvajjīvanamastu vaḥ ||95||
sūkṣme dehe gate cāpi badaryāṃ yātrayā punaḥ |
svadehe sthūlasaṃjñe tvāgatya vāsaṃ vidhāsyatha ||96||
badarīyātrikāḥ sarve pādapā dhāmamokṣaṇam |
prayāsyatho vadāmyeṣaḥ śvetanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||97||
evaṃ prāpya hareranugrahaṃ te pādapāstataḥ |
badarīyātriṇo bhūtvā pūjayitvā narāyaṇīm ||98||
prajvālya nijapāpāni badrīpratāpato drumāḥ |
yayurvai mokṣaṇaṃ tvekajanmanā yānti vai tathā ||99||
yāsyantyeva padaṃ divyaṃ badarīśīprasevanāt |
badarīnāthayogena plakṣoktā mokṣadāyinī || 4.1.10 0||
sarvamokṣakarī divyā sākṣānnārāyaṇāśrayāt |
jayate badarīdevī māṇikyā bālayoginī || 101 ||
sā papraccha kathā divyāstiṣye’pi mokṣakāriṇīḥ |
naranārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ badaryāśrama uttame || 1 02||
yā yā badryāḥ kathāḥ pṛṣṭā naranārāyaṇaṃ prati |
uttaritā naranārāyaṇena svāminā ca yāḥ || 1 03||
tāstādivyāstiṣyakhaṇḍe vidyante mokṣadāyikāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhāśritāḥ || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīnaranārāyaṇasya śrīmāṇikyātmakabadaryāḥ svarūpavartanaṃ māhātmyakathanaṃ kathāprastāvaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā prathamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

<4.2>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīrame devi tava bhaktakathānakam |
yathā tvaṃ bradarībhāvaṃ prāptā bhaktivaśānugā || 1 ||
badaro nāma rājarṣirhimabhūmau purābhavat |
mahābhāgavato bhakto vaiṣṇavottama ūrdhvagaḥ || 2 ||
pṛthivyardhaṃ śaśāsāsau divyasāmarthyasādhanaiḥ |
vimānānyabhavan yasya pāre lakṣaṃ sukhāni ca || 3 ||
sauvarṇāni kalpavṛkṣodyānopaśobhitāni hi |
divyakanyānivāsāni smṛddhānyuccāvacāni ca || 4 ||
ekaikaṃ sūryavadbhāti candravattejasāṃ cayaiḥ |
yatprabhābhirniśā pṛthvyāṃ līneva vartate tadā || 5 ||
bhrāntirnakṣatratārāṇāṃ jāyate’lpe vimānake |
candrajyotsnā tu militā tadā dugdhāyate’mbare || 6 ||
indradhanuḥprakāśāścotprasaranti ghaneṣvapi |
vimānānāṃ kiraṇānāṃ badarasya mahātmanaḥ || 7 ||
ekaṃ satyābhidhaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ satyasaṃcaram |
brahmasabhāyāṃ nṛpatistena yāti hi yogirāṭ || 8 ||
dvitīyaṃ cāryamasaṃjñaṃ pitalokādisañcaram |
tṛtīyaṃ tridivaṃ nāma caindrapadaṃ caturthakam || 9 ||
pañcamaṃ bhāskaraṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaṃ kaumudakaṃ tathā |
saptamaṃ dhruvasaṃjñaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ kailāsanāmakam || 4.2.1 0||
dharmasaṃjñaṃ navamaṃ ca merusaṃjñaṃ tato’dhikam |
śvetavāhaṃ kṣīravāhaṃ talākhyānyaparāṇi ca || 11 ||
lokālokābhidhaṃ cāpi manojavāni tāni vai |
yathābhidhānaguṇakānyatidigantagāni ca || 12||
sarvabhogyarddhipūrṇāni yathā dhiṣṇyāni tāni ha |
teṣu sarveṣu ratnānāṃ suvarṇānāṃ ca mūrtayaḥ || 13 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pratimāḥ śubhāḥ |
śrīmāṇikyāmahālakṣmīyutā yugalavigrahāḥ || 14||
gajāsane sthāpitāḥ pūjitāḥ śrībadareṇa ha |
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyāḥ sarvagandharasārpitāḥ || 15||
devadūtāḥ pārṣadāśca bhūsurāḥ sādhavo’malāḥ |
vaimānikāḥ pravidyante teṣu bhāgavatottamāḥ || 16||
mahābhāgavatīsatyaḥ sādhvyaḥ śīlaparāyaṇāḥ |
candrānandāścandrakāntyānanāḥ svarṇaprabhānvitāḥ || 17||
mahābhaktānikāsteṣu vidyante badarasya ha |
kīrtanaṃ satataṃ teṣu jāyate badarīśvari || 18||
yatprasaṃgena devādyā yānti brahma sanātanam |
naitādṛśo’bhavad bhakto yena jagat prapūritam || 19||
harikīrtanabhaktyāḍhyamahāghoṣaiḥ samastakam |
sthale sthale’sya nṛpaterjayaghoṣaḥ pravartate ||4.2.20||
badarasya vimānāni yaddiśaṃ yanti taddiśi |
namanti devamunayo bhaktyā nṛtyanti tatstriyaḥ ||21||
pūjayanti vimāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇacchavim |
nīrājayanti muditā datvopadāḥ prayānti ca ||22||
badarasya mahārājye grāme kheṭe purādiṣu |
nagare pattane rājadhānyāṃ ghoṣe’pi sarvathā ||23||
sādhavo yatayaḥ sādhvyaḥ pūjyante’nnāmbarādibhiḥ |
viprā dakṣiṇayā cāpi nirāśrayāḥ śubhāśrayaiḥ ||24||
anāthādyā yathāpekṣairnāryaḥ sveṣṭasamarpaṇaiḥ |
grāme grāme brahmayajñā jāyante badarasya vai ||25||
annasatrāṇi bhūbhāge badarasya tu padmakam |
prapādānāni sarvatra cāsan kalpalatāstathā || 26||
yātrālavo latāmāpya bhuṃjate bhikṣayā phalam |
tṛptidaṃ ca rasaṃ miṣṭaṃ pibanti ca bhajanti mām ||27||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ maṇḍalāni hyāsan vai pratikharvaṭam |
prātarmadhyāhnake sāyaṃ kīrtayanti bhajanti mām ||28||
devakathākarā bhūmāvāgatya ca kathāṃ mama |
vācayitvā saṃhitāṃ ca bodhayanti bhajanti mām ||29||
utsavā uttamāḥ śreṣṭhā jāyante ca prajāsu vai |
ūrjāsitāṣṭamīprabhṛtyahassu dvādaśīṣvapi ||4.2.3 0||
jayantīṣu samastāsu satsaṃgāḥ saṃbhavanti ca |
vratotsavānāṃ sammānaṃ pālanaṃ pūjanādikam ||3 1 ||
udyāpanaṃ cādaraśca jāyante’sya prajāsvapi |
nityaṃ gavāṃ tu bahvīnāṃ dānaṃ nṛpasya jāyate ||32|||
śeṣo navaḥ kutaḥ svarṇamayo yena tu bhūbhujā |
pratiṣṭhāpya ca taṃ śeṣaṃ nāgaṃ nītvā vimānake ||33||
yayau pātālake prāha pūrvaśeṣaṃ nivartaya |
mama śeṣo baliṣṭho’yaṃ dhārayiṣyati ke bhuvam || 34||
mūlaśeṣaḥ parīkṣārthaṃ mumocādho hi golakam |
sahasā svarṇanāgastaṃ bhūgolaṃ ke nyadhād drutam ||35||
mūlaśeṣasya mānaṃ vai nirmūlaṃ saṃvyajāyata |
garvo naṣṭo’tha neme taṃ badaraṃ svarṇaśeṣiṇam ||36||
prārthayāmāsa mānārthaṃ dhāraṇaṃ nijamastake |
anyathā bhūbhṛtā cāvamānitasya yaśolayaḥ ||37|||
apratiṣṭhā bhavelloke yayāce golakaṃ punaḥ |
dhartuṃ nijaphaṇāyāṃ vai tadā tu badaro dadau ||38||
pūrvaśeṣāya pṛthivīṃ svarṇaśeṣaṃ nijālayam |
ānināya tataḥ svarṇaśeṣo vijñānavān yatiḥ ||39||
patañjalirmahāyogī vidyādharo vyajāyata |
sarvayogakalābhiśca jagaduddhāramācarat ||4.2.40||
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya badarasya gṛhe gṛhe |
kṛṣṇadhūnyo’bhavan badri bhaktiścāsīd gṛhe gṛhe ||41 ||
śrīmāṇikyā sevitasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai |
mama mūlasvarūpasyāśritaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddhyabhūt ||42||
śṛṇu badrīprabhe devi tadā rājyaṃ tu ṛddhimat |
svargottaraṃ bhūtalaṃ tu vīkṣyānyabhvardhapālakāḥ ||43 ||
paspardhurbadaraṃ bhaktaṃ rājānaṃ smṛddhilālasāḥ |
bahavo badaraṃ prāpyāyudhyan parājayaṃ hyaguḥ ||44||
bhakto bhaktyā hi jīyeta nānyayuddhaiḥ kadācana |
yadgṛhe bhagavān sākṣād vasati durjayaḥ kutaḥ ||45||
rājñaḥ śarairhi bahavo hatā bhūpā virodhinaḥ |
sarve te nihatā vārdhau himavārdhisamāhvaye ||46||
kiṃpuruṣapradeśānāṃ dakṣiṇe madhyasaṃsthite |
dvisāhasrayojanātmavistṛte miṣṭavāriṇi ||47||
mānasākhyaḥ samudro’yaṃ miṣṭodo hyabhavattadā |
sadā śītalajaladhiḥ sarvaratnasamanvitaḥ ||48||
yatrāste sāmprataṃ badri himālayo’drirāḍiha |
śṛṇu badrīprabhe devi jetuṃ tu badaraṃ nṛpam ||49||
āyayau tvekadā vyomnā hemānalo’suro mahān |
aparaṃ yat pṛthivyardhaṃ tasmādarbudasainyavān ||4.2.50||
vyomamārgeṇa sahasāyutairvimānakai saha |
khaṇḍe kiṃpuruṣe yuddhaṃ badareṇa samācarat ||51||
badarasya vimānāni sasainyāni tadāmbare |
abhipetuścāsurāṇāṃ sainyeṣu divyaśaktayaḥ ||52||
sahasraśo vimānāni naṣṭānyāsurakāṇi vai |
sainyāni miṣṭajaladhau bhūtvā yādāṃsi cāviśan ||53||
hemānalo’suravaryo yuyudhe badareṇa ha |
mithaḥ sainyāni yuyudhuḥ prāṇāntaniścayāni vai ||54||
divyāstravarṣaṇairdivyaśarairdivyaiśca hetibhiḥ |
vidyutpravāhaṇaiścāpi pāśairvāruṇajaistathā ||55||
vajraiśca vividhairdaṇḍaiḥ kālacakrairviśālakaiḥ |
mantraistantrairmahāyantrairmāyikairaindrajālikaiḥ ||56||
vāyvagnināgagavayairgarutmataiśca vṛścikaiḥ |
parvataiścāpi vṛkṣaiśca yuyudhire tu kṛtrimaiḥ |57|
himaśailaiśca vividhairgrahagolairanuttamaiḥ |
gadābhiścāṇḍabhettrībhirjaghnuranyonyamudruṣaḥ ||58||
āsurāṇāṃ hi sainyāni mārayitvā muhurmuhuḥ |
miṣṭābdhau te praviśanti svasthāstatra bhavanti ca ||59||
punarbalaṃ nīrugṇatvaṃ prāpya cāyānti saṃgare |
badareṇa hatāste ca punarviśanti sāgare ||4.2.60||
athāyaṃ badaro rājā bhaktarāḍ vīkṣya jīvitān |
samudrasthānāsurām̐śca cintayāmāsa cāntare ||61||
kathameṣāṃ samudre vai vināśaṃ pratipādaye |
punarnaiva yathā svasthā nirgaccheyurbahiryudhi ||62||
jalaṃ sarvaṃ tvabdhirūpaṃ himaśailātmakaṃ bhavet |
antaḥsthitā āsurāste syurmṛtāśca śilātmakāḥ ||63||
sañcintyaivaṃ badaro’yaṃ sasmāra candradevatām |
tūrṇaṃ copasthitā tatra devakāryasahāyinī ||64||
āsurāṇāṃ suraghnānāṃ vināśārthaṃ matiṃ dadhe |
āgatya sahasovāca badarāya mahātmane ||65||
vada rājan tava kāryaṃ surakāryaṃ tathā sukham |
tūrṇaṃ karomi sādhyaṃ te duḥsādhyamapi sarvathā ||66||
badaraḥ śaśinaḥ pūjāṃ svāgataṃ vandanaṃ stutim |
cakārāsanavaryaṃ ca dadau neme punaḥ punaḥ ||67||
kṛpālo śāntikṛt svargasudhākara mahāprabho |
bhaktānugrahadhātastvaṃ jayase cāmṛtaprada ||68||
jīvanaṃ sarvalokānāṃ kalāsu tava tiṣṭhati |
mādhuryaṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca tava yogātpravartate ||69||
vṛddhiḥ puṣṭistava yogājjāyate dāharodhanam |
tvadādhārāścauṣadhayastadādhārāśca dehinaḥ ||4.2.70||
candra kaumudikānātha niśeśa priyasaṃgakṛt |
śaśin nakṣatranātha tvaṃ jayase vai tamonuda ||71 ||
mṛgāṃka dugdhavarṇa tva himāṃśo jayase sadā |
śītalābdhe sudhāmūrte bhaktakāryaṃ dadhātviha ||72||
asurā muhurāgatya samardayanti mānavān |
devān pitṝnmunīn bhaktān kleśayanti muhurmuhuḥ ||73||
madbāṇairarditāścaite praviṣṭā himasāgare |
te yathā syurmarditā vai himapāṣāṇaparvataiḥ ||74||
punarna te bahistvatrāyayustathā vidhehi yat |
tvamoṣadhirhi lokānāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ nibarhaṇam ||75||
śītaṃ śastraṃ mato’syeva śīghraṃ tadoṣadhaṃ kuru |
ityevamarthito rātrināthaḥ śrībadarīprabhe ||76||
dadau kaṇṭhāt samuttārya candrakāntamaṇiṃ śubham |
badarāya svabhaktāya devakāryakarāya ca ||77||
prāha maṇiṃ nṛpa cātra śītābdhau sanniveśaya |
śītābdhiḥ sahasā śītaśilātmako mahān giriḥ ||78||
atraiva śītalabhūmirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
tvaṃ vimāne vasa rājannambare na tu bhūtale ||79||
śītenābhibhavaṃ naiva vrajethāstattathā kuru |
eṣo’haṃ saṃprayāmyeva śīghraṃ maṇiṃ jale kṣipa ||4.2.80||
evamuktastu badaro drutaṃ vimānamambare |
kṛtvā candramasaṃ natvā cikṣepa maṇimabdhiṣu ||81||
tāvajjalāni sarvāṇi śītāgnipīḍitāni vai |
piṇḍitānyabhavam̐statra śītābdhau śītalopalāḥ ||82||
śītābdhiḥ śītabhūbhāvaṃ himabhūtalatāṃ gataḥ |
jalānyūrdhvaṃ coṣmaṇā cotkṣipyante paritastadā ||83||
śikharāṇi śvetahaimaśilātmakāni tāni ca |
sañjātānyeva sahasā cāmbaraṃ śītatāṃ gatam ||84||
himānāṃ karakāvarṣāḥ sahasā peturambarāt |
tābhiśca vardhamānāni śṛṃgāṇi pārvatāni vai ||85||
mahaḥsparśāni jātāni vardhamānāni tāni vai |
evaṃ sa parvato jāto’yugasāhasrayojanaḥ ||86||
candrakāntena sampanno himavaddhimavarṣaṇaḥ |
himāṃśumaṇinā bhūmau himādrirbadarīprabhe ||87||
āsurā yuddhakartāro jalopalāsu tattale |
marditāśca niruddhāścopalābhāvaṃ gatā mṛtāḥ ||88||
upadravāḥ praśāntāśca mahataḥ parivartanāt |
atha lokāśca ṛṣayo munayo devatāstathā ||89||
śrutvā himālayaṃ bhūmiṃ vīkṣituṃ tvāyayurmudā |
rākṣasā asurā daityā dānavā mānavāḥ khagāḥ ||4.2.90||
pitaro lokapālāśca siddhāścāraṇanartakāḥ |
gāndharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtā māgadhā bandinastathā ||91||
vidyādharā apsarasaḥ sādhyaḥ śaṃkarayoginaḥ |
gaṇāśca gaṇadevyaśca mātaro vasavastathā ||92||
merusthāḥ paralokasthā divyadehāḥ samāyayuḥ |
mumudurbahudhā haimaṃ śītaṃ cāndraṃ vilokyate ||93||
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhūpatiṃ badaraṃ tathā |
praśaśaṃsuśca te sarve dikpālā mānamādadhuḥ ||94||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca prasannāstvabhavan bahu |
badarasyābhavad rājyaṃ sarvaṃ himālayātmakam ||55||
navaṃ tvaraṇyakaṃ tasya parito nābhavattadā |
devādyā vāsayogyaṃ taṃ merutulyaṃ tu bhūbhṛtam ||96||
vīkṣya spṛhāṃ pracakruścārthayāmāsurnṛpaṃ muhuḥ |
rājā vāsaṃ dadau devakoṭibhyastu himālaye ||97||
devajātayaḥ sarve ye te vāsān svakulocitān |
cakruḥ śṛṃgeṣu haimeṣu devālayo babhūva saḥ ||98||
svargaṃ vai cāparaṃ bhūmau himālayo babhūva ha |
kalpadrumāḥ kalpalatāstathā kalpatṛṇānyapi ||99||
himālaye’bhito devaiḥ ropitāni vanāni ca |
bhūsandhau paritaḥ śatayojanānāṃ tu vartule || 4.2.1 00||
divyauṣadhīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ vanāni ropitāni vai |
udyānāni vicitrāṇi phalapatrarasādibhiḥ || 1 01||
smṛddhāni svargalokād vai svasvalokāttathāparaiḥ |
āhṛtyāhṛtya parito nihitāni śubhāni ca || 1 02||
saptarṣayo nyavasam̐śca śaṃkaro’pyavasattataḥ |
brahmā viṣṇustathā devyo nyavasan cāpsarogaṇāḥ || 1 03||
gāndharvāścāraṇāḥ kiṃpumāṃsaśca kinnarāḥ surāḥ |
anye’pi bahavo devā nyavasan vai himālaye || 1 04||
evaṃ himagirirjāto bhūmau candragirirmahān |
bhūtalaṃ svargamiśraṃ ca jātaṃ divyāṃśaśobhitam || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne mahābhāgavatasya badarākhyarājarṣerākhyāna, hemānalāsurayuddhaṃ, badarabhayena bhūmadhyaśītavārdhau tvasurāṇāṃ praveśanaṃ, badarastutyā candrapradattacandrakāntamaṇeḥ śītavārdhau nikṣepeṇa śītopalātmakamahāhimādrirūpaparivartanaṃ, caturdaśalokavāsināṃ divyahimādrau nivāsākāṃkṣayā badarapradattavasatayaḥ svargīyauṣadhīnāṃ devādyairopitāni vanodyānāraṇyāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

<4.3>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīrame pārvatike yajjātamulbaṇam |
vidrāvakaṃ hi devānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā punaḥ || 1 ||
susthireṣu tu deveṣu viśvaste tu himācale |
yatra hemānalo haimaśilātale’rdito’bhavat || 2 ||
śikharaṃ tat sahasaivāmbare mūlāt parāpatat |
bhūkampaścāpi śṛṃgeṣu cānyeṣu saṃvyajāyata || 3 ||
śabdo bhayaṃkaraścāpi pralayāgnerivābhavat |
muhurbhūdhūnanaṃ jātaṃ śilāvarṣā bhuvo’bhavat || 4 ||
samutpatanti talataścopalā haimabhāsurāḥ |
hemānalena talato noditāḥ kṣepitāstathā || 5 ||
hime śilātalāddhemāsuro balāt punastadā |
uttasthau yogabalato mahāścaryamidaṃ hyabhūt || 6 ||
devā bhayaṃgatāścānye brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ |
surādyā dehinaḥ sarve vīkṣyopadravamulbaṇam || 7 ||
sasmaruḥ śrībhagavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ prabhum |
tathā badaraṃ rājānaṃ mahābhāgavataṃ tadā || 8 ||
hemānalo’pi gadayā yoddhuṃ tadāmbare’bhavat |
parvataprāyadehaḥ sa himopaleva bhāsuraḥ || 9 ||
yaṃ yaṃ devaṃ girau tatra vyalokayad vyapothayat |
hāhākāro mahān jātastāvad vimānakaḥ prabhuḥ || 4.3.1 0||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrībadarīśvaraḥ|
vimānenāgamattatra yatra hemānalo’suraḥ || 1 1||
vīkṣya divyavimānaṃ tad yoddhumupādravaddharim |
bhagavān gadayā tūrṇaṃ sannaddhaśca tadābhavat || 12||
śriyaṃ ramāmavasthāpya vimāne bahirāyayau |
badaro’pi mahārājastūrṇaṃ tatrāpyupāyayau || 13|||
vīkṣya hemānalaṃ mahāsuraṃ cojjīvitaṃ punaḥ |
mahāścaryaṃ prāpa rājā tenāyuddhyad gadākaraḥ || 14||
kṛṣṇena badareṇāpi tāḍito gadayāsuraḥ |
jātaklamo’bhavad bhagnakaṭiḥ papāta bhūtale || 15||
badarastaṃ samuttolya jīvantaṃ tatra gartake |
yatrābhavat sa tatraiva cikṣepa himagartake || 16||
himaśailaṃ punastatra sthāpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ |
badaraśca tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum || 17||
prārthayāmāsa bahudhā hyanutthāya vai punaḥ |
bhagavānāha vai rājan śṛṇu haimānalīkathām || 18||
tapastepe purākalpe prasādāya sa cakriṇaḥ |
haste kṛtvā harergṛti varṣasahasrakaṃ tadā || 19 ||
tato varṣasahasraṃ vai tvekapādena cotthitaḥ |
tato varṣasahasraṃ vai vaṭaśākhāvalambitaḥ ||4.3.20||
adhomukhastapastepe haste paśyan hariṃ hi mām |
tato varṣasahasraṃ sa prajvālyānalamūrdhani ||21||
lambamāno hi śākhāyāṃ tapastepe’tidāruṇam |
anāhārastato vāyvāhāro varṣasahasrakam ||22|
vaṭaśākhājaṭāmadhye protadeho’bhavaddhi saḥ |
śuṣkamāṃsāsthikuṇapaḥ śākhājaṭāntare’bhavat ||23||
jaṭārūpo’bhavattatra pipīlikādhirodhitaḥ |
mṛttikāvalmikairācchāditaśchannataro’bhavat ||24||
hastatale mama mūrti cātyajan valmiko’bhavat |
daśavarṣasahasrānte cāhaṃ prasannatāṃ gataḥ ||25 ||
tasya kare sthitaścāhaṃ caitanyarasamādadan |
vaṭadugdhaṃ dadam̐ścāpyāplāvayaṃ tasya varṣma tat ||26||
varṣāvegena ca dhūlīḥ sarvā dhūtābhavattataḥ |
adhomukhaḥ prāptaraso’suro hemānalo’bhavat ||27||
śanaiḥ samprāptacaitanyaśconnidra iva cakṣuṣā |
uddhāṭitena parito vyalokayattadā puraḥ || 28||
adarśayaṃ mama rūpaṃ caturbhujaṃ śriyānvitam |
asuraḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā neme māṃ sa jaṭāntare || 29||
prāptamadviṣayajñānaḥ prasannamānaso’bhavat |
jijñāsamāna iva tu vihvalo’bhūttu māṃ prati ||4.3.30||
mayā sambodhitaścāyaṃ varadānāya vai tathā |
tapaḥsamāpanārthaṃ ca tadā vavre sa vihvalaḥ || 3 1||
yadi tvaṃ varadānāya kṛṣṇa pravartase tviha |
yadi satyavratatvaṃ vai yadi yogyo’smi pātrakam || 32||
tadāhaṃ te śriyāḥ pādau vīkṣya mohaṃ gato’smyataḥ |
śriyāḥ pādau komalau bhāsurau sarvaśubhāśrayau || 33||
suspṛśyau darśanīyau ca dehi me cāvyayau yathā |
mama dehaṃ spṛśamānau bhavetāṃ caraṇau śriyāḥ ||34||
rājyaṃ tathā paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dehi vaibhavasaṃbhṛtam |
sāmarthyaṃ ca tathā dehi bhūtaiḥ parābhavo na me ||315||
śriyo’dhīno bhavāmyeva nānyasya kasyacit kvacit |
yadi dehi varaṃ taṃ vai tadā tyakṣyāmi vai tapaḥ ||36||
anyathā tvamasadvaktā viśvāsyo nāsi mādhava |
yathāgatastathā yāhi tapaścarāmi vai ciram ||37||
ityevamarthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ badri tathāstvevaṃ jagāda ha ||38||
prāpte karmavipāke te sarvaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastirobhavacchriyānvitaḥ ||39||
hemānalo’yaṃ sahasā tapastyaktvā gṛhaṃ yayau |
merau gatvā sa gadayā yuddhārthaṃ ca viniryayau ||4.3.40||
pṛthivyardhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena kalpe’tra prāktapobalāt |
samrāḍrājā vartate’yaṃ tadā viṣṇurivāparaḥ ||41 ||
sa cāyaṃ badarasyāpi rājyaṃ jetumupāyayau |
śrītareṇa na kenāpi bhūtena bhautikena vā ||42||
parābhavaṃ tvāsuraḥ sa samavāpsyati vai kvacit| |
evaṃ labdhavaraścāyaṃ himaśailaśilopamaḥ |||43|||
utkṣipyāpi bhuvo garbhāduttasthau prāktapobalāt |
so’yaṃ kṣipto badareṇa tvayā garte’tra vai punaḥ ||44||
kintu yāvacchriyā pādau taddehe na patiṣyataḥ |
tāvannaiva parābhāvyaścāsuro’yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||45||
śriyāḥ padbhyāṃ niścalo’yaṃ bhūgarbhe sannivatsyati |
avyayau caraṇau labdhvā niścalātmā bhaviṣyati ||46||
tasmād badara māṇikyāṃ śriyaṃ mama priyāṃ tviha |
ārādhaya nivāsārthaṃ devakāryārthamityapi ||47||
mayā dattavarasyāpi yāthārthyāya jayāya ca |
anyathā niṣphalaḥ sarvo yatnaste’tra bhaviṣyati ||48||
ityukto badaro rājā tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm |
māṇikyāṃ śrīṃ mahāmuktānikāṃ śrībālayoginīm ||49||
namaścarācarasthāyai camatkāramayīśriyai |
nārāyaṇyai hyabhedāyai bālakṛṣṇāṃgayoṣite ||4.3.50||
namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamyai hariṇyai brahmayoṣite |
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃganāyai te namaḥ ||51 ||
namo māṇikyavarṇāyai dhāriṇyai śrīharernamaḥ |
namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇakāntāyai pārabrāhmyai namonamaḥ ||52|||
bhaktakāryātisampādayitryai mātre namonamaḥ |
prasannā bhava deveśi hemānalapraśāntaye ||53||
mahāsuro’yaṃ śrīkāntāmṛte mṛdho na jāyate |
tvaṃ mātastanmardanaṃ vai kuru devārthasādhike ||54||
namastasyai sarvahantryai rakṣayitryai ca te namaḥ |
mahānārāyaṇapatnyai māṇikyāyai ca te namaḥ ||55||
evamabhyarthya tāṃ śaktiṃ hṛdā pūjāṃ cakāra saḥ |
arpayāmāsa puṣpāṇi māṇikyācaraṇe tadā ||56||
tāvat sā paramā lakṣmīścākṣarabrahmavāsinī |
puro babhūva sahasā prasannāsyā hi suprabhā ||57||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpānurūpiṇī |
yuvatī tejasā vyāptā cakrapadmādidhāriṇī ||58 ||
aṃkuśaṃ śūlamutkṛṣṭaṃ dadhānā karayostathā |
kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ priyaṃ prāṇaṃ vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ ||59||
ājñāṃ voḍhuṃ satvarā sā tatparā balaśālinī |
tanvī prapūrṇapuṣṭāsyā navayauvanaśālinī ||4.3.60||
svarṇavarṇā kanakābhā padmāyatasulocanā |
śukanāsā kundadantā bimbauṣṭhī śītalaspṛśā ||61 ||
vidyudbhāsvaravastrāḍhyā kaustubhena virājitā |
karṇanāsābhālabāhuprakoṣṭhapādabhūṣaṇā ||62||
kaṭyāṃ raśanayā yuktā śṛṃgārakajjalānvitā |
kabarīdhammilaśobhā sindūracandrakānvitā ||63||
sustanī sunitambā ca sumadhyā ca sugandhinī |
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptā candrābhanakhaśobhitā ||64||
alaktakātisaundaryā svarṇaromāvaliśritā |
premarasamahāpūrṇā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī priyā ||65||
sugandhipuṣpahārālivyāptavakṣaḥsthalottamā |
sthalapadmanibhasakthidvyaśobhāmanoharā ||66 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ tyaktuṃ necchāvatī sadā |
gṛhītaśrīkṛṣṇakarā nityayuktā mahāsatī ||67||
bhagavatpremapātraṃ sā śrīkṛṣṇāṃganivāsinī |
śītaśailasamā dehe tāpasīva pareśvarī ||68||
sarvaiśvaryādisampannā vātsalyaguṇasāgarā |
lāvaṇyānantyasaṃjuṣṭā naikasakhīpravanditā ||69||
bhagavanmukhalagnākṣī pūrṇānandātimodinī |
hasamānā badaraṃ sā jagād puruṣottamau ||4.3.70||
vada rājam̐stava śreyo vidhāsye sahasā tviha |
surakāryaṃ kṛṣṇakāryaṃ vidhāsye drutamatra ca ||71||
śrutvā rājāsuracūrṇanārthaṃ vyajijñapacchriyam |
nārāyaṇecchayā sāpi padbhyāṃ hantumupādravat ||72|||
tāvad daityavaro garte himopalātmako’bhavat |
nārāyaṇastadā lakṣmīṃ māṇikyāṃ prāha satvaram ||73||
nārāyaṇi drutaṃ tvatra padbhyāṃ tiṣṭhāsuropari |
tava padbhyāṃ hataḥ spṛṣṭo’suraḥ punarna vai bahiḥ ||74||
udgamiṣyati duṣṭātmā varadānabalāttathā |
kuru kāryaṃ badarasya devānāṃ ca hitāvaham ||75||
tadā tu khinnacittā śrīmāṇikyā tvavadat prabhum |
kathamekākinī kṛṣṇamṛte nvatra vasāmi vai ||76||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvaṃ me patiḥ sadā |
patnī cāhaṃ tava kṛṣṇa pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||77||
patiṃ vinā kṣaṇaṃ sthātuṃ notsahe vijane hime |
yatheṣṭaṃ kuru kṛṣṇa tvaṃ śādhi dharmyaṃ vrataṃ mama ||78||
śrūtvā vicāramakarod bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ |
māṇikye tvaṃ bhava badrī bahupādā drumātmikā ||79||
aṃkuśaṃ śūlamevāpi kaṇṭakau te mahāyudhe |
bhavatāṃ patrasahite sarvāsuravināśake ||4.3.80||
sadā tvaṃ tāpasī vārkṣī badarī bhava śobhanā |
pādairhemānalaṃ spṛṣṭvā bhūgarbhe taṃ prapeṣaya ||8 1||
niścalā śāśvatī devī badrīdevī sadā bhava |
badareṇa stutā rājñā vadareṇābhivāñcchitā ||82||
badareṇa tathākṛṣṭā tvāyātāsi yatastviha |
badarītisadānāmnā saphalā tvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||83||
badrikāśrama evāyaṃ divyāvāso bhaviṣyati |
ahaṃ nityaṃ badaryāste chāyāyāṃ tāpasottamaḥ ||84||
dharmaputro naranārāyaṇātmā saṃbhavāmi ca |
jaṭī śīlī brahmacārī tvanmūlāvāsaśobhanaḥ ||85||
bhavāmyatra jagatkalyāṇārthaṃ naranarāyaṇaḥ |
yāvaccandrastathāsūryo yāvat sthāsyati medinī ||86||
tāvattāpasaveṣo’haṃ tāpasī tvaṃ tu badrike |
nivatsyāmo’tra dhavale śītale himakāśrame ||87||
hemānalo’pi bhūgarbhe tava pādatale sadā |
saṃpiṣṭastava bhakto vai suṣuptaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||88||
śreyo jagatāṃ paramaṃ tathā syāttattathā kuru |
ityuktvā māṇikīdevī babhūva badrikā drutam ||89||
hemānalāsuramūrdhni kṛtvopalāpravarṣaṇam |
pādām̐statra nidhāyaiva māṇikyā sā sthirābhavat ||4.3.90||
badrīramā mahādivyā vārkṣī devī tu śāśvatī |
tāpasī tāpasenāpi nārāyaṇena saṃyutā ||91 ||
nyavasattatra sahasā dharmaputreṇa cakriṇā |
upadravāḥ praśāntāścāsurabhītirlayaṃ gatā ||92|||
devādyā niścalāstvāsan pupūjurbadarīśvarīm |
naranārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samarcayan ||93||
badrīnāthaṃ badrikāṃ ca badaraṃ ca nṛpaṃ tathā |
badrikāśramamevainaṃ sthalaṃ prāhuḥ surādayaḥ ||94||
divyaṃ ca pāvanaṃ badrīśvari tvadvāsaśobhanam |
tata ārabhya devā vai māsaṣaṭkaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||95||
tīrthaṃ kurvanti himavacchikhare badrikāśrame |
māsadvayaṃ tu pitaraścaturmāsām̐śca mānavāḥ ||96||
badrikāśramayātrāṃ te kṛtvā hemānalāsuram |
pāparūpaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ cārdayanti himālaye ||97||
bhūtvā te pāvanā badrīśvari te darśanāttathā |
mamāpi darśanāt pūtā muktā bhavanti dehinaḥ ||98||
yathākṣare pare dhāmni brahmaloke vasāmyaham |
māṇikyāsahitastadvaccātra badrikayā yutaḥ ||99||
vasāmi sarvathā badri lokānāṃ śreyasāṃ kṛte |
evaṃ tvaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhā sarvapādapapūjitā || 4.3.1 00||
tāpasī vartase tvatra himādrau matsadharmiṇī |
nārāyaṇī tvaṃ badarī māṇikyā vāhinī mama || 101 ||
nārāyaṇo’haṃ bhagavān narayuk puruṣottamaḥ |
naranārāyaṇanāmnā bhajanīyo bhavāmi ha || 1 02||
evaṃ te vai samākhyānaṃ proktaṃ śrībadarīśvari |
badarasya subhaktasya bhaktyā saṃbhṛtamuttam || 1 03||
badaro’pi sadā bhaktyā rasarūpo vyajāyata |
phalātmā te badaryā vai vartate te suto yathā || 1 04||
bījaṃ phale nararūpaṃ phalagarbhe vasāmyaham |
tena tvanyā badaryo’tra prajāyante hi badrike || 1 05||
etatsthānaṃ pratīkaṃ me mūlaṃ sthānaṃ tu me girau |
ito dūre divyarūpaṃ yasya yātrā na jāyate || 1 06||
paśya tvaṃ māṇiki taddhi mānavānāṃ na dṛṣṭigam |
na gatirmānavānāṃ tu muktānāṃ gatirasti yat| || 1 07||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmokṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
āsuropadravaśāntistathā brahmamayī gatiḥ || 1 08||
sarvaśreyaḥpradāśaktiḥ prajāyeta parā yathā |
sarvāḥ śriyo vaseyuśca badrīkathāśravāntike ||1 09||
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi na tiṣyasya parābhavaḥ |
naranārāyaṇaścāhaṃ śrotuścitte vasāmi hi ||4.3.1 10 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne punaheṃmānalotthānaṃ, śikharakṣepādyupadravāḥ, badareṇa hariṇā ca garte nikṣepaḥ, hemānalasyapūrvatapaḥkathā, varadānaṃ śrīpādākrāntatvavaraprāptiḥ, śrīmāṇikyāyāstanmardanārthaṃ badarīrūpatā, tatpādairmardanaṃ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya naranārāyaṇarūpatā, badarasya phalarūpatā, narasya bījarūpatā, badrikāśramatīrthaprākaṭyaṃ, mūlaṃ badrikāśramaṃ tu bhinnaṃ dūre cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tṛtīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

<4.4>
śrībadrīśvaryuvāca
naranārāyaṇaviṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho |
kṛṣṇakāntahare kṛṣṇaśrīmāṇikīramārttihan || 1 ||
kathaṃ sa badaro rājā badarīphalatāṃ gataḥ |
naraśca bījatāṃ prāptastanme brūhi narāyaṇa || 2 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīrame devi tatkathāṃ pāvanīṃ śubhām |
mokṣakarīṃ hi bhaktānāṃ pāpināṃ pāpanāśinīm || 3 ||
badaro vai mahābhakto rājyaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhādikam |
sampadaḥ strījanaṃ yānavāhanāni prajāstathā || 4 ||
kośaṃ ratnāni bhūmiśca dehadaihikamityapi |
sarvaṃ kṛtvā hi kṛṣṇārthaṃ vyavartata sa sādhuvat || 5 ||
nyayuṅakta dāsadāsīśca sādhusevāsu sarvadā |
saudheṣu sādhavastasya nivasanti harerjanāḥ || 6 ||
kīrtanāni sadā tasyālaye bhavanti badrike |
sarvasvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhaktayogārthaṃ tvakaroddhi saḥ || 7 ||
ātmaniveditāṃ prāptastvekadācintayannṛpaḥ |
niveditaṃ mayā sarvaṃ haraye paramātmane || 8 ||
māyikaṃ sarvamevāpi tathātmāpi niveditaḥ |
pārthivaṃ ca jalīyaṃ ca taijasaṃ prāṇa ityapi || 9 ||
sarvaṃ niveditaṃ śrīmannārāyaṇāya cakriṇe |
gehaṃ yānaṃ bhojanādi vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇam || 4.4.1 0||
gandhasugandhatailādi kṛṣṇārthaṃ caupayogikam |
sarvaṃ prajāyate yogyaṃ sevārhaṃ jaḍavastukam || 1 1||
kintu nikṛṣṭamatyarthaṃ varṣma durgandhisaṃbhṛtam |
samalaṃ vikṛtaṃ kledyaṃ nopayogāya cakriṇaḥ || 12||
bhavatyevāśuci nityaṃ malamūtrasamanvitam |
snāyyvasthimāṃsasaṃvyāptaṃ nyakkṛtaṃ kuṇapaṃ śavam || 13||
sarvathā nopayogārthaṃ svāmino me prajāyate |
jīvacchavaṃ mṛtaṃ bhasma viṣṭā mṛd vā prakīrtitam || 14||
kathaṃ kṛṣṇakṛte kārṣṇasatāṃ kṛte’sya yojanam |
upayogi kathaṃ syācca kathaṃ na syānnirarthakam || 19||
yanmayā poṣitaṃ lakṣavatsaraiḥ sevitaṃ śubhaiḥ |
tasya kathaṃ satāmarthe hyupayogo bhavediha || 16||
sārthakyaṃ ca bhavedasya mānavasya hi varṣmaṇaḥ |
karomi tapasā divyaṃ satāṃ bhogyaṃ harestathā || 17||
bhaktyā vā copayogasthaṃ kurve sevārhameva tat |
nṛpāya sādhavaḥ sevāṃ diśanti na kadācana || 18||
nṛpadeho dīnavacca karoti sevanaṃ na ca |
tasmānnṛpasya deho’yaṃ niṣphalo’dya pravartate || 19||
saphalaṃ taṃ karomyeva tapasārādhanena ca |
yaddhiṣṇyaṃ na tu devāya taddhiṣṇyaṃ dhikkṛtaṃ matam ||4.4.20||
yacchiro devanamane nopayuktaṃ tu dhikkṛtam |
ye netre na darśanārthe devānāṃ te’pi dhikkṛte ||21 ||
ye śrotre na śravaṇārthe devānāṃ te’pi dhikkṛte |
yallalāṭaṃ na devārhacandanādiprasādavat ||22||
tannirbhāgyaṃ sadā bodhyaṃ bhālaṃ bhallukabhālavat |
yā nāsā śrīharergandhagrāhiṇī naiva vartate ||23||
sā śuṣkatilapuṣpābhā gahvarāḍhyā na śobhanā |
yanmukhaṃ śrīharervācaṃ na gṛṇāti kadācana ||24||
na kīrtanaṃ na modaṃ ca tanmukhaṃ mūrkhakarkavat |
yā jihvā na rasaṃ vetti nārāyaṇaprasādajam ||25||
sā tu darvīva bodhyā vā dardurīva ca nirguṇā |
yanmukhaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ harerbhogyaṃ na cedyadi |||26|
rāhugrastaṃ sadā tattu bodhyaṃ suyoṣitāmapi|
narasya ca mukhaṃ tattu vānarāsyasamaṃ matam ||27||
yanmukhaṃ na harernārāyaṇāsyarasavedi tat |
tāmbūlarasaśūnyaṃ ca tadbilaṃ mūṣakasya vai ||28||
yaḥ kaṇṭho na hareḥ kīrtigītimagno’tisusvaraḥ |
sa bodhyaḥ kīcakavaddhi vṛthāsvananinādavān ||29||
yadvakṣo na hareryogyaṃ yannoraḥ śrīhareḥ śritam |
yatra nāsti harervāsastadvakṣo vṛkṣanīḍakam || 4.4.30||
yadvakṣasi svayaṃ kṛṣṇo na śete hāravattu tat |
śavavakṣo’śucibodhyaṃ vṛthāstanavilambitam || 31 ||
yau stanau śrīkṛṣṇakāntakarapadmatalāspṛśau |
tau piṇḍau cāmaṃgalau vai rasālīgranthisadṛśau ||32||
yau skandhau kṛṣṇahastābhyāṃ nāśliṣṭau stambinau tu tau |
yaḥ pṛṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇaśayane spṛṣṭo naiva sa kāṣṭhavat ||33||
udara yad ramākāntodaralagnaṃ na tad daram |
nābhiḥ kṛṣṇena dṛṣṭā na sā gartaḥ khanirūpavat || 34||
kaṭirjaghanaṃ guptaṃ ca spṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇena naiva yat |
tad yāmyaṃ cālayaṃ bodhyaṃ pāpāśrayaṃ samastakam ||35||
nitambau sakthinī jānū jaṃghe pādau ca pattale |
kṛṣṇasparśamanāpanne vṛkṣastambanibhe tu te ||36||
mano yat kṛṣṇavirahaṃ rauravaṃ tattu vai matam |
buddhiryā kṛṣṇaśūnyā sā kuṃbhipākātmikā khaniḥ ||37||
cittaṃ kṛṣṇavihīnaṃ yat tattu śṛgālasadṛśam |
ahantā kṛṣṇaśūnyā yā sā vṛkīva vināśinī ||38||
guṇatrayaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ tattu tridoṣarūpi yat |
avasthātritayaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ tvaghatrayaṃ hi tat ||39||
rūpaṃ kṛṣṇānapekṣaṃ yat tat śvitraṃ sarvadā matam |
rasaḥ kṛṣṇavihīno yaḥ sa vai vaitaraṇī nadī ||4.4.40 ||
gandhaḥ kṛṣṇavihīnastu malapātranibhaḥ sa vai |
śabdaḥ kṛṣṇena vidhuro ghūkaśabdo hi sarvathā ||41 ||
sparśaḥ kṛṣṇena hīnastu viṣānalasamaḥ sa hi |
ratiḥ prītiḥ sukhaṃ modaḥ kṛṣṇahīnāstathotsavāḥ ||42||
sarve te nārakā bodhyā ānandā nirayātmakāḥ |
kṛṣṇayuktaṃ samastaṃ vai svalpaṃ mahattu yad bhavet ||43||
tattu divyaṃ śāśvataṃ ca mokṣapradaṃ mahāmṛtam |
śrīkṛṣṇasya satāmarthe yad bhavedupakārakam ||44||
cennikṛṣṭaṃ bhavet tattu cotkṛṣṭaṃ suravanditam |
api majjāsthicarmādi kṛṣṇārthaṃ yojitaṃ bhavet ||456||
sarvaṃ divyaṃ muktidātṛ sārthakaṃ naravarṣma tat |
vṛkṣāḥ kṛṣṇakṛte yānarūpā bhavanti sārthakāḥ ||46||
hastidantāstṛṇavallyo bhavanti bhūṣaṇāsanam |
camarīpucchavālānāṃ cāmaraṃ jāyate śubham ||47||
kastūrikā mṛgasyāpi matā kṛṣṇopayoginī |
mṛgasiṃhādicarmāṇi bhavanti cāsanānyapi ||48||
śuktyādīni ca ratnāni bhūṣaṇāni bhavantyapi |
kandamūlaphalānāṃ ca naivedyaṃ jāyate hareḥ ||49||
kaṇānāṃ miṣṭabhojyāni jāyante paramātmanaḥ |
dugdhādīni gavotthāni peyāni saṃbhavantyapi ||4.4.50||
mākṣikaṃ ca madhuraṃ ca madhu bhakṣyaṃ prajāyate |
kauśeyaṃ kīṭajaṃ vastraṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ caupayogikam ||51 ||
dhātavaḥ khanijāścāpi hetirūpā bhavantyapi |
śaṃkhaḥ sāmudrajantūttho vādyarūpo bhavatyapi ||52||
maṇayo’pi śarīrotthā mauktikāni ca vai sraji |
dhāryante kṛṣṇakāntena sarvaṃ tathaupayogikam ||53||
api haṃsasya pṛṣṭhaṃ ca garuḍasya gajasya ca |
aśvasyāpi hareḥ śubhāsanayogyaṃ bhavatyapi ||54||
kintvayaṃ naradeho vai nāsti kṛṣṇaupayogikaḥ |
satāṃ vā nopayogārthastato nirarthakaḥ sadā ||55||
evaṃ vyacintayad rājā bahudhā nijavarṣmaṇaḥ |
api vai kajjalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanetrāsanaṃ bhavet ||56||
tattulyo’pi na vai deho narasyāto nirarthakaḥ |
nārīdeho harerarthe dāsyā iva kṛtārthakaḥ |57||
tattulyo na naradeho yaḥ kṛṣṇārtho na vartate |
tasmānmayā tu kṛṣṇārthaḥ sādhusādhvyartha ityapi ||58||
ṛṣimunyartha evāpi kartavyastāpasārthakaḥ |
bhuktaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||59||
viśālākhyo yuvā putro yogyo’sti rājyakovidaḥ |
tasmai samarpya rājyaṃ me kāryaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tanu ||4.4.60||
vicāryetthaṃ sa badaraḥ samāhūya prajājanān |
prakāśaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā prāpya prajāmatāni ca ||61||
mahotsavena putrāya viśālākhyāya vai dhuram |
dadau rājyasya dharmyāṃ ca mano mokṣe’karottataḥ ||62||
naranārāyaṇaśālāṃ samāsādya himālaye |
vyacintayannijaṃ dehaṃ satāṃ sevaupayogikam ||63||
nārāyaṇasya sevāyāṃ tathā yathaupayogikam |
tasthau samādhau sahasātmanyātmānaṃ nidhāya saḥ ||64||
snehātiśayamāsādya naranārāyaṇaprabhau |
tallīnaḥ sambabhūvaiva vismṛtya dehamātmanaḥ ||65||
brahmānalena sampūrṇo jñānāgninātibhāsuraḥ |
snehaśikhinā dravito videhaḥ sahasābhavat ||66||
sarveṣāṃ munivaryāṇāṃ paśyatāṃ dravatāṃ gataḥ |
romalohitamāṃsāni snāyvasthimajjikāstataḥ ||67||
vīryaṃ caitāni sarvāṇi rasātmakāni cābhavan |
badaryāḥ śrīmāṇikīśrīrūpāyāḥ pādabhūsthale ||68||
rasaḥ sarvaḥ khādyarūpo vyalīyata tadā drutam |
mahāścaryamidaṃ jātaṃ śrīpādayoḥ samarpitaḥ ||69||
yādṛśī bhāvanā cānte tathā bhavati dehyapi |
tūrṇaṃ badaro rājāsau rasabhāvamupāgataḥ ||4.4.70||
dravakhādyasvarūpo vai badrīmūleṣvalīyata |
badrīstambe cāviveśa rasarūpo’timiṣṭakṛt ||71 ||
śākhāsu sahasā vyāptaḥ puṣparūpo’bhavattathā |
phalarūpo’bhavaccāpi badarāṇi tato’bhavan ||72||
mahāścaryamidaṃ jātaṃ badareṇa nijaṃ vapuḥ |
kṛtvā rasaṃ dravitaṃ tat phalarūpaṃ prapāditam ||73||
badrīphalāni miṣṭāni tāni pakvāni sarvaśaḥ |
sugandhīni surūpāṇi mahānti tṛptidāni ca ||74||
māṇikyāśrīgarbhajāni pāvanāni tadābhavan |
prasādajāni sarvāṇi badarāṇi tadābhavan ||75||
naranārāyaṇo devo jagrāha kānicittadā |
naivedye’bhuṅkta bhagvān madhurāṇi phalāni vai ||76||
athānye ṛṣayo devā gandharvā mānavāḥ surāḥ |
ye ye tvāsan himādrau te cakhaduḥ satphalāni vai ||77||
ekaṃ phalaṃ varṣakālatṛptidaṃ tad vyajāyata |
madhugarbhaṃ samastaṃ vai tāpasānāṃ hi tṛptikṛt ||78||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu praśaṃsā saṃvyajāyata |
sudhāśreṣṭhāni himavadgirau badrīphalāni vai ||79||
nārāyaṇaprasādāni prāpyante tṛptidāni vai |
paramparayā tvākarṇya pitaraḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ||4.4.8 0||
ṛṣayo mānavā devāstathānye dehino girau |
āyayuḥ phalalābhārthaṃ nārāyaṇo’pi sandadau ||81 ||
prāpya phalāni sarve’pi sudhordhvasvādavanti vai |
attvā tṛptiṃ vārṣikīṃ cāvāpuḥ sarve sukhapradām ||82||
ye ye’danti phalānyasyāste te prayānti divyatām |
balaṃ puṣṭiṃ ca vīryaṃ ca sahasradhāpnuvanti te ||83 ||
śrutvā śrutvā samāyānti nītvā nītvā prayānti ca |
dṛṣṭvā himālayaṃ badrīṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam ||84||
badarāṇi vicitrāṇi modante tvaṇḍavāsinaḥ |
mahotsavaḥ samastānāṃ jāto badarabhojinām ||85||
abdhau tu parvataṃ vīkṣya māṇikyāṃ badarīṃ tathā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vīkṣya naranārāyaṇātmakam ||86||
tāpasaṃ jaṭinaṃ cāpi navāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ hi menire |
yātrārthaṃ tīrthavaryaṃ vai jātaṃ badārakāśramam ||87||
suvatārāḥ pārṣadāśca vyūhā īśvarakoṭayaḥ |
īśvarāṇyaḥ surā devyaścāyayuḥ phalavāñcchayā ||88||
yathā yathā badarāṇi nīyante tu tathā tathā |
drāgeva nūtanānyeva prodbhavanti drume’bhitaḥ ||89||
badaro’yaṃ mahārājaḥ snehabadarasadrasaḥ |
phalarūpo’tibhaktyābhūt sarvabhogyaśarīrakaḥ ||4.4.90||
avyayaścākṣayaścāpi tathā saṃkhyāvivarjitaḥ |
divyaraso brahmarasātmakaḥ śrīrasa uttamaḥ ||91||
vyajāyata kṛpayāpi naranārāyaṇasya vai |
lakṣmyāśca kṛpayā cāpi phalaputrātmakaḥ sadā ||92||
māṇikyāphalarūpaḥ sa sadā divyaphalo’bhavat |
badrīdevī saphalābhūd vṛkṣarūpāpi sarvadā ||93||
nārāyaṇo’pi bhagavān phalaputrānvito’bhavat |
brahmacaryavratastho’pi badarasya pitābhavat ||94||
māṇikyāśrīḥ sadā śīlavratā ca bālayoginī |
badarākhyaphalairvaṃśaputravatī sadābhavat ||95||
tānaumāni badarāṇi nārāyaṇātmakāni vai |
lakṣyātmakāni divyāni muktabhojyāni cābhavan ||96||
tasmādbadrīphalabhoktā kṛṣṇamūrtermahāsukham |
bhuṃkte mūrtyānandabhoktā sa eva badarīvane ||97||
amāyikāni sarvāṇi badarāṇi śubhāni vai |
caikatattvamayānyeva santi tadbadarīdrume ||98||
evaṃ vai badarīdevi badaraḥ phalatāṃ gataḥ |
atibhaktyā rasabhāvaṃ dravaṃ prāpya drume sthitaḥ ||99||
mahābhāgavatānāṃ hi sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ matam |
divyaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatyeva śrīkṛṣṇānugrahāttathā || 4.4.1 00||
māyāpyamāyā bhavati deho’pyadeha ityapi |
guṇāścāguṇatāṃ yānti jaḍaṃ divyaṃ sacetanam || 10 1||
kṛṣṇārpitaṃ samastaṃ vai kṛṣṇātmakaṃ prajāyate |
evaṃ śrīmāṇikīdevi tava bhaktakathānakam || 1 02||
divyaṃ śrībadarīdevi mokṣakṛt kīrtitaṃ mayā |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ gatiṃ labhet || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne vadarākhyanṛpasya svadehasyaupayogikatāsiddhyarthaṃ badarīmūle tapasā bhaktyā rasātmakatā badarātmakaphalarūpatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturtho’dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

<4.5>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīrame devi teto narakathāmapi |
nirbīje badare tatra naro vai bījatāṃ yayau || 1 ||
dṛṣṭvā bhuktvāmṛtasvādūnyuttamāni phalāni vai |
surā maharṣayo devā mānavā dehino’pare ||2||
naranārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca māṇikīm |
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ badrīṃ deśe ninīṣayā || 3 ||
naranārāyaṇaviṣṇo sarvopakārakaprabho |
badarīyaṃ kalpavṛkṣottamā pīyūṣasatphalā || 4 ||
sampannā kṛpayā te’trākṣaradhāmanivāsinī |
badaro’tra ca phalatāṃ prāptastṛptikaro rasaḥ || 5 ||
naitādṛśī sudhā svarge jane tapasi satyake |
na mānave na pātāle merau lokācale’pi na || 6 ||
imāmakṣayyaphaladāmakṣayyatṛptidāmapi |
dehi lokeṣu naḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadayānidhe || 7 ||
yathā devā vayaṃ bhaktāḥ ṛṣayaśca mahārṣayaḥ |
vanāraṇyanivāsā vai syāma caitatphalādanāḥ || 8 ||
bhavān lokasya sarvasya śreyo’rthaṃ tapati prabho |
badarīlābhadānena paraṃśreyaḥ karotvapi || 9 ||
pāpā jīvā api loke badarāśanakāriṇaḥ |
niṣpāpāste bhaviṣyanti yāsyanti paramaṃ padam || 4.5.1 0||
kṛpā kāryā hi lokeṣu phalaṃ naitādṛśaṃ param |
mokṣadaṃ pāvanaṃ puṇyapradaṃ yajñaphalapradam || 11 ||
tapasvināṃ tapovṛddhikaraṃ śāśvatatṛptidam |
devāmṛtātimiṣṭaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ param || 12||
vanāraṇyanivāsānāṃ sādhūnāṃ sattvavardhanam |
antaḥkaraṇanairmalyasampādakaṃ hareḥ priyam || 1 3||
brahmaphalaṃ hi badaraṃ divyāmṛtaphalaṃ tathā |
lakṣmīphalaṃ tathā bhaktiphalaṃ śrīmāṇikīphalam || 14||
ākṣaraṃ satphalaṃ tvetannānyatra labhyate prabho |
datvā nastvaṃ kṛtārthānnaḥ kuru kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa || 15||
badarākhyaphalaṃ tvetad badarākhyo nṛpastathā |
lakṣmīśrīmāṇikībadrīpārvīramā haripriyāḥ || 16||
naranārāyaṇastvaṃ ca sarve lokopakārakāḥ |
upakāraṃ prakurvantu badarārpaṇakarmaṇā || 17||
ityarthito hariḥ prāha sarvān badarabhikṣukān |
bhavatāṃ mama bhaktānāṃ manaḥpūrttyai dayāvaśaḥ || 18||
dātumicchāmi badarāṇyavicchinnāni syuryathā |
imāni divyarūpāṇi nirbījāni bhavanti vai || 1 9||
teṣāṃ dānena bhavatāṃ ciraprāptirna vai bhavet |
vṛkṣastveko badaryāstu vidyate’vicalastathā ||4.5.20||
hemāsuropamardārthaścotkhātuṃ sa na śakyate |
badarāṇāṃ yathā vaṃśaparamparā bhavettathā ||21 ||
mayā phalāni sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bījavanti ca |
vinā bījaṃ na tajjātiravicchinnā pravardhate ||22||
mūlātstambātphalātpatrātkāṇḍānnālācca cakṣuṣaḥ |
śākhāyāśca jaṭāyāśca granthervā vaṃśavardhanam || 23||
bījācchreṣṭhatarā vaṃśavṛddhiḥ sātra vibhāvyate |
vaṃśajaiḥ pūrvajānāṃ tu samuddhāro vitanyate || 24||
hrāse nūtanasampattau kṣayaścāpi bhavenna vai |
tataścātra badareṣu bījāni racayāmyaham ||25||
uktvaivaṃ badarīnātho nārāyaṇastu śīlavān |
svāṃśaṃ naraṃ prasannātmā lokayāmāsa tatkṣaṇe ||26||
naro namro vinītaśca kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata |
yadicchā te hare cāste kurve drutaṃ vadātra me || 27||
tvadicchayākṣare dhāmni śrīpuruṣottamāt purā |
yadā rādhārbabhūva tadāhaṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ ||28||
goloke rādhayā sākaṃ tvadājñayāvasaṃ sadā |
yadā punaśca te mūrteḥ ramādevī vyajāyata ||29||
tadā nārāyaṇatvaṃ samprāpya vaikuṇṭhago’bhavam |
yadā ramā tava mūrteḥ prāvirbabhūva vai tadā || 4.5.30||
vāsudevasvarūpo’haṃ vyūharūpo’bhavaṃ purā |
yadā jātā mahālakṣmīrlalitā te svarūpataḥ ||3 1||
tadāhaṃ tu mahāviṣṇuḥ śrīpure tvabhavaṃ purā |
lakṣmīryadā tava dehājjātā viṣṇustadābhavam ||3 2||
śrīśca jātā tava mūrtestadāhaṃ śeṣaśāyanaḥ |
kamalā ca tava mūrterjātā yadā tvadājñayā ||33||
śvetadvīpe śvetanārāyaṇo’haṃ tvabhavaṃ tadā |
yadā tvaṃ māṇikīṃ badrīṃ kṛtvā niṣevase hime ||34||
tadātrāhaṃ tava bhrātā naro bhavāmi te’nujaḥ |
dharmaputro mānaso’smi vada yattatkaromyaham ||35||
dharmaputrā hi catvāro nārāyaṇā bhavanti ye |
jyeṣṭho haristvakṣare’sti bhavān śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||36||
kṛṣṇo golokadhāmastho nārāyaṇo vikuṇṭhake |
sa tvaṃ śīlasvarūpaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||37||
māṇikyāsahitastvatra vartase parameśvaraḥ |
tavāṃśo’haṃ naraścāsmi karomyājñāṃ pradarśaya ||38||
ityuktvā praṇanāmainaṃ badrīnāthaṃ narāyaṇam |
tadā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha bhrātaḥ kalyāṇakṛdbhavān ||39||
lokopakārakartāsti matparākramarūpavān |
vartase tvaṃ mama vīryabalaśaktyādimūrtikaḥ ||4.5.40||
ime devādayo bhaktāḥ prārthayanti hi badrikām |
badarāṇi samicchanti nityabhojanasiddhaye ||41||
ekaiva badarī tvadya vartate mūladevikā |
badarāṇi hyasaṃkhyāni jātānyasyāḥ phalāni vai ||42||
nirbījāni bhavantyeva surādyairarthitāni ca |
tāni sarvāṇi dīyante bhakṣyante ca surādibhiḥ ||43||
ekavāraṃ tṛptidāni bhaviṣyanti na cādhikam |
kintu vaṃśakarāṇyeva tāni syuryadi sarvadā ||44||
akṣayyavaṃśadānyeva tadā lokasukhaṃ bhavet |
badaryā vaṃśavṛddhiśca tāpasānāṃ ca bhojanam ||45||
phalāhārātmakaṃ syācca bhūtale divi cāpare |
sarvalokeṣu badarīvaṃśo bhavet parārthakaḥ ||46||
badareṣu tataścātra bījānīṣṭāni santi me |
bhūtvā tvaṃ bījarūpo’tra phaleṣvāviśa cānuja ||47||
tvadātmakairbījamūlairbadaryaḥ koṭiśo’parāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti vanāraṇyodyākṣetrāṭavīṣvapi ||48||
sarvalokeṣu bījāḍhyabadarāṇyuttamānyapi |
bhaviṣyanti tavādeśād badare bījavadbhava ||49||
ityuktaḥ sahasā bhakto naro nārāyaṇājñayā |
bījarūpo’bhavad badrīmūle viveśa ca drume ||4.5.50||
vadareṣu samasteṣu bījātmā sa vyajāyata |
naro’yaṃ badarīgarbho vyajāyata suvaṃśakṛt ||5 1 ||
tāpasenāpi veṣeṇa pṛthak cāpi sthito’bhavat |
nārāyaṇaḥ prasanno’bhūd dṛṣṭvā bījātmakaṃ naram ||52||
badarīśrīḥ prasannābhūd vaṃśavatī hyajāyata |
atha nārāyaṇaḥ prāha devādibhyo’tigauravam ||53||
māhātmyaṃ badarāṇāṃ vai badaryāścāghanāśanam |
etanmūlā badaryo vai bhaviṣyanti kṣitau divi ||54||
candre merau satyaloke jane tapasi mānave |
lokāloke raivatādrau puṣkare dakṣiṇe kurau ||55||
brāhme parīpradeśeṣu prācīneṣvamarīśake |
gaurīloke cābrikteṣu tathoṣṭreṣu ca bhūmiṣu ||56||
pātālādau munīnāṃ ca nivāseṣu śubheṣvapi |
nadītīreṣvaraṇyeṣu siṃhāraṇyādikeṣvapi ||57||
dharmāraṇyeṣu sarvatra bhaviṣyanti hi badrikāḥ |
sarvartuphaladāḥ kāścit svargādau cākṣayā sadā ||58||
kāścid deśādiguṇakā yathartuphaladā api |
kāścid varṣāsu phaladāḥ kāścicchītaphalapradāḥ ||59||
kāściduṣṇartuphaladā bhaviṣyanti drumātmikāḥ |
kāścitpauṣyastathā mādhyaḥ phālgunyaścaitrya ityapi ||4.5.60||
bhūbhāgeṣu bhaviṣyanti badaryaścāpi putrikāḥ |
pakvamiṣṭāyatapuṣṭamahatphalapradāḥ śubhāḥ ||61 ||
māghe pūjāṃ badarīṇāṃ kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ |
teṣāṃ lakṣmīramāpūjāphalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||62||
vasantasya dine tvekādaśyāṃ vā pūrṇimātithau |
amāyāṃ vā badaryāstu gatvā mūlasya sannidhau ||63||
phālgunaikādaśikāyāṃ phākanapūrṇimātithau |
phālgunasyāmāvāsyāyāṃ gatvā śrībadarītale 1150||
pūjayedbadarīṃ devīṃ jalārpaṇena vai purā |
gūḍaṃ dadyāccharkarāṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ mūlake’rpayet ||61||

ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca pradakṣiṇaṃ namaḥkriyām |

tava chāyānādimāyāchāyānāśakarī matā |

badarīphalahārām̐ścārpayet pakvaphalakṛtān |

purā pitre suśīlākhyo vipro datvā śubhaṃ phalam |

badaraṃ badarīnāthaṃ badrikāṃ badrikāśramam |

smṛtvā badarīṃ badaraṃ vadrīśvaraṃ himāśramam |
antakāle tyajan dehaṃ yāsyatyūrdhvo parāṃ gatim ||99||
nārīṃ śrībadarīdevīṃ smṛtvā yāsyati cākṣaram |
bhaviṣyati hareḥ patnī māṇikyāyāḥ sakhīśvarī || 4.5.10 0||
naro yāsyati mokṣaṃ ca nārāyaṇapadāmbuje |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi kīṭāśca jalajā api || 10 1||
tṛṇādyā badarīṃ śritvā mṛtvā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam |
badarīyaṃ naranārāyaṇāṃ ganā pravartate || 102||
tasyā yogena bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ svargādisampadaḥ |
prāpsyanti kṛtapāpā vai bhaviṣyanti hi pāvanāḥ || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne devādīnāṃ satatabadarīphalāptivāñcchāyāṃ badaryāḥ sabījaphalavattvakaraṇaṃ, narasya bījarūpatā, badarīmāhātmyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

<4.6>
śrībadrīśvaryuvāca
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanārāyaṇaprabho |
naranārāyaṇaviṣṇo badrīnāthasutāpasa || 1 ||
suśīlākhyo bhūsuro vai kadā kutrābhavatpurā |
pitṛtṛptirbadareṇa kṛtā yena divampradā || 2 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīrame devi suśīlasya kathānakam |
vihārākhye śubhe deśe pulahāśramasannidhau || 3 ||
gaṇḍakyāḥ subhage tīre mauktikāhārapattane |
suśīlo’bhūdvipravaryaḥ kuṭumbibahulaḥ khalu || 4 ||
pitā tasyābhavannāmnā śrīśīlaḥ karmaṭhaḥ sadā |
vidvān lobhābhibhūtaśca vyayabhītiparāyaṇaḥ || 5 ||
kuṭumbārthe vyayahīno labdhadravyādisañcayaḥ |
utsavādivihīnaśca vratotsāhādivarjitaḥ || 6 ||
mahīmānādisammāne kadarya iva nirvyayaḥ |
veṣe yāne bhojane’pi rūkṣa iva vanecaraḥ || 7 ||
devapūjādikāryeṣu bhikṣopalabdhanirvahaḥ |
ātithyādivihīnaśca śuṣkayajñaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 ||
apatyānāṃ dugdhapāne piṣṭamaṇḍapradāyakaḥ |
śākādiśūnyamadhyāhnabhojano ghṛtavarjitam || 9 ||
kṛśarānnaṃ bhunaktyeva bhojayatyapi yoṣitam |
putrādīn śākamātraṃ ca bhojayatyapi tadvidham || 4.6.1 0||
dānādivarjito vipraḥ śrīśīlaḥ karmaṭhaḥ pitā |
nadītīre svayaṃ gatvā snātvā nītvā phalādikam || 1 1||
samidhaśca svayaṃ samāhṛtyāgnau prajuhoti vai |
tatrāpi bindumātraṃ vai ghṛtaṃ dadāti nādhikam || 1 2||
kaupīnaṃ cāñcalaṃ dhatte nādhikaṃ vastramityapi |
yajñapaṭṭena vai skandhe nirvahatyeva bhūsuraḥ || 1 3||
gṛhastho’pi lobhavaśāttāpaso hi muniryathā |
tathāyaṃ vartate gehe paryuṣitena vai kvacit || 14||
bhājīṃ labdhvāthavā kandān mūlāni vā dalāni vā |
vane’raṇye’pyaṭavyāṃ vānayatyayaṃ bhunakti tat || 15||
evaṃvidhasya viprasya putrā daśābhavan śanaiḥ |
putryaḥ saptābhavam̐ścāpi brāhmaṇadharmaśobhitāḥ || 16||
jyeṣṭhaḥ suśīlanāmāsya suto vedādividyayā |
khyātimāpa samasteṣu pārśvagrāmeṣu karmaṭhaḥ || 17||
udāro dānaśīlaśca dharmotsavaparāyaṇaḥ |
bhojane chādane bhogye kuṭumbaparipoṣakaḥ || 18||
rājamānādipātraṃ ca prajāsammānasatkṛtaḥ |
yajñakāryādiniṣṇāto vaiṣṇavo bhaktarāḍ yathā || 19||
satāṃ sevāvratavām̐śca sādhvīsevāparāyaṇaḥ |
ātithyadharmo gosevāgrāmasevāparāyaṇaḥ ||4.6.20 ||
pāṭhako bālakānāṃ ca kathākāraśca sarvadā |
evaṃvidhaṃ nijaṃ putraṃ lomadharmavivarjitam ||21||
vyayaśīlaṃ pitā vīkṣya gṛhāddūraṃ cakāra tam |
tenāyaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yayau tu pattanāntaram ||22||
dārābhāgyābhidhaṃ rājyaṃ tadrājñā tu kṛtādaraḥ |
uvāsa svasthacitto’yaṃ prajārājādimānitaḥ ||23||
dārābhāgyeśvaro rājā nāmnā dāreśvarābhidhaḥ |
saudhaṃ vāsāya viduṣe suśīlāyārpaṇaṃ dadau ||24||
bhūmiṃ kṣetraṃ vāṭikāṃ ca mahodyānaṃ ca vāhanam |
annaṃ nirvāhamātraṃ ca dadau dāne’rkaparvaṇi ||25||
vipro’yaṃ prāpya sanmānaṃ prasannaḥ śubhasampadā |
śāntacitto hariṃ bheje śrīpatiṃ nijavallabham ||26||
jīvikāṃ nijayātrāyā yogyāṃ labdhvā tutoṣa ha |
upādhiṃ sarvathopārjyagocaraṃ sa vihāya vai ||27||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tu pratyaham |
nagare vācayāmāsa prajāsaṃghasabhāsthale ||28||
nṛpo dāreśvaraścāpi pratyahaṃ tūpatiṣṭhati |
ākhyānāni vividhāni bhaktabhaktiparāṇi hi ||29||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākhyānāni yānyapi |
śrutvā śrutvā modate vai vaiṣṇavāsyodgatāni ca ||4.6.30||
kathānte kārayatyeva savādyotsavakīrtanam |
hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīpate puruṣottama ||3 1||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇaṇanārāyaṇa śrībadarīśvara |
evaṃ kṛtvā kīrtanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ vinivedya ca |||32||
prasādaṃ saṃvibhajyātha gṛhaṃ yānti sabhājanāḥ |
vipraḥ sāyaṃ harerbhaktiṃ prātarbhaktiṃ karoti ca ||33||
madhyāhnabhaktiṃ kṛtvātha bhojanaṃ sa karoti vai |
sāyaṃ prātarjanāstasya samāgamārthamutsukāḥ ||34||
āyānti śreyase nityaṃ mumukṣavaḥ sumānasāḥ |
tebhyo mantraṃ vipravaryo dadāti mokṣadāyakam ||35||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
bahavo vaiṣṇavāścaivaṃ sampannāstatra pattane ||36||
narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi bhaktisaṃghā sudhārmikāḥ |
abhavan bhaktikarmāṇo bhajanti śrīprabhāpatim ||37||
pattane tu yathā tadvad grāmeṣu cetareṣvapi |
bhaktasaṃghā abhavam̐śca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritāḥ ||38||
atha bhaktottamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vipraṃ bhāgavataṃ śubham |
yogyaṃ matvāsmai svaputrīṃ rājā kundanikāṃ dadau ||39||
suśīlo’yaṃ bhāgyavām̐śca labdhvā kundanikāṃ satīm |
patnīṃ nṛpasutāṃ divyāṃ mumude kṛpayā hareḥ ||4.6.40||
sāpi lakṣmīsamā dharmavatī bhaktimatī satī |
bheje’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum ||41||
udārā hi maharddhisaṃbhṛtā dāneśvarī priyā |
kṛṣṇapriyā sadā kṛṣṇabhaktiparā vyajāyata ||42||
jāmātā rājabhavane śobhate bhāgyavardhitaḥ |
kīrtiścāsyābhavad vyāptābhitaḥ śuśrāva tāṃ pitā ||43||
pitrā prahitāḥ putrāśca putryaścāpi sahodaram |
jyeṣṭhaṃ draṣṭuṃ cāyayuśca mahotsāhasamanvitāḥ ||44||
mātāpi gālavīdevī putraṃ draṣṭumupāyayau |
pitā tasthau gṛhe tvekastyāgadoṣātilajjitaḥ ||45||
dhanalobhaparaścāpi gṛhe dhanasya rakṣakaḥ |
daivayogena viprasya śrīśīlasyābhavajjvaraḥ ||46||
āyuḥkṣayena maraṇaṃ prāpto gṛhe’tinirjane |
jñātijanaiḥ śanairjñāte maraṇe tatkriyā kṛtā ||47||
pāpinaśca kadaryasya lubdhasya badarīśvari |
mṛtiḥ śūnyā jāyate vai bahuṣvapi kuṭumbiṣu ||48||
lobhadoṣeṇa vipro’sau vāsanādripravāsitaḥ |
pretatāṃ labdhavām̐statra gṛhe bhūtaśarīradhṛk ||49||
gṛhapṛdhvīgate dravye kṛtavāso hi tiṣṭhati |
nānyaḥ praveśaṃ labhate praviṣṭaṃ pīḍayatyayam ||4.6.50||
khyāto’bhavat sa bhūto’sau pretaceṣṭāparāyaṇaḥ |
adattadāno labhate naivānnaṃ bhojanaṃ jalam |||51||
kṣudhāyuktaḥ kvacid rauti rātryardhottarameva saḥ |
kvaciddhasati sasphoṭaṃ garjayannambaraṃ bahu ||52||
kvacid viprātmako bhūtvā grāmamadhye’rdharātrike |
samaye ca tadūrdhve ca viharatyatiduḥkhitaḥ ||53||
śrīśīlasya gatistvevaṃ jātā badrīprabheśvari |
dārabhāmye’pi putrāśca putryaśca patnikā tathā ||54||
rājasammānamāsādya sukhaṃ labdhvā mahattaram |
tatraiva jyeṣṭhabhrātuścājñayā nyūṣurnirantaram ||55||
devakanyāsamā rūpe yuvatyo viprakanyakāḥ |
rājakuṭumbe bhāgyena vivāhitāstato’bhavan ||56||
mātābhavat susukhinī sutā rājñyo’bhavannapi |
putrāścāpi khyātimanto nṛpakuṭumbayoginaḥ ||57||
nṛpakuṭumbikanyānāṃ patayaste tato’bhavan |
bhaktiḥ kṛtā hi phalati satāṃ sevā phalatyapi ||28||
dānaṃ puṇyaṃ copakāraścāśīrvādāḥ phalantyapi |
jyeṣṭhabhrātuḥ puṇyayogaiḥ sarve rājakuṭumbavat |||99||
jātaṃ yāne bhojane ca dāreṣu ṛddhivaibhave |
yatra lakṣmīḥ prasannāsti yatra nārāyaṇo’pi ca ||4.6.60||
yatra devāḥ pratuṣṭāśca tatra nyūnaṃ na vidyate |
kṛtaṃ kālena phalati nākṛtaṃ tvāpyate kvacit| ||61||
badrīprabhe suśīlo’yaṃ prajeśvara ivābhavat |
mama bhaktyā kathayā ca kīrtanairdānapūjanaiḥ ||62||
athaikadā pitā preto nijapatnyāmupāyayau |
āveśaṃ bahulaṃ prāpya ruroda bahudhā tataḥ ||63||
bhajanena kṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ sphuṭākṣaraśca ko bhavān |
jagādāhaṃ pitā nāmnā śrīśīlo’smi mṛto’smi ca |||64||
atha śokaṃ gatāḥ sarve ruruduścāpi laukikam |
kriyāṃ cakrustato rājña ājñāmāsādya te janāḥ ||65||
yayau laukikakāryārthaṃ śrāddhārthaṃ tanmṛtisthalam |
pattanaṃ mauktikahāraṃ cakruḥ śrāddhādi karma ca ||66||
uddhārārthaṃ pitustatra bahudānāni te daduḥ |
putrāścakrurhi bahudhoddhārapuṇyāni tatra ha ||67||
gaṇḍakyā cāsthivinyāsaṃ cakruste vārṣikaṃ vidhim |
yaddhanaṃ tvarjitaṃ pitrā nihitaṃ bhūtale’pi ca ||68||
sarvaṃ dāneṣu putrāste daduḥ kadaryadūṣitam |
tathāpi pretaviprasya sadgatirna vyajāyata ||69||
kṛte yajñe’pi badrīśi na muktirvāsanāvataḥ |
kiṃ punardānakarmādi mokṣadaṃ vāsanāvataḥ ||4.6.70||
na mokṣaṃ samavāpāsau punaḥ patnyāmupāyayau |
sakampaṃ ca mahākrośaṃ kṛtvovāca nijātmajān ||71||
na me muktiḥ prajātā vai vāsanā bādhate hi mām |
bhojanasya suveṣāderlobhasya ca dhanasya ca ||72||
vāsanāparihārārthaṃ yāntu badarikāśramam |
naranārāyaṇāvāsaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam ||73||
śrāddhaṃ madarthaṃ tatraiva kurvantu badarītale |
divyaṃ ca badaraṃ mahyaṃ bhojanārthaṃ dadatvapi ||74||
nārāyaṇārpitaṃ vāri phalaṃ ca badaraṃ mahat |
tathā ca valkalaṃ vastraṃ kambalaṃ vā yathocitam ||75||
badarīphalakṛddhāraṃ badarīrasamityapi |
śrāddhe mahyaṃ dadatveva tṛptirme śāśvatī tathā ||76||
bhaviṣyati kṣudhānāśastṛṣānāśo bhaviṣyati |
vāsanā badrīśanārāyaṇāgre me vinaṃkṣyati ||77||
patnyāmāviśya badarīnāthaṃ tvāyāmi vai saha |
kurvantu mama kāryāṇi divye badarikāśrame ||78||
ekasyapi badarasya dānena tarpaṇaṃ mama |
mokṣadaṃ śāśvatatṛptipradaṃ syānme na saṃśayaḥ ||79||
anyathā me na vai mokṣaḥ koṭidānairapīha vai |
kadaryāṇāṃ na vai mokṣastīrthāyute kṛte’pi hi ||4.6.80||
atha te prayayuḥ sarve padbhyāṃ badarikāśramam |
saṃsnustatrādigaṃgāyā nemurnaraṃ narāyaṇam ||81||
badrīprabhāṃ praṇemuśca sādhvarṣīnārcayam̐stathā |
sarvatīrthāni kṛtvaiva śrāddhaṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ ||82||
jyeṣṭhaputro dadau piṇḍān badarākhyaṃ phalaṃ tathā |
gāṃgeyaṃ salilaṃ nārāyaṇapādaprasādajam ||83||
dadau suvarṇadānaṃ ca viprāya valkalaṃ tathā |
godānaṃ ca tathā dānottamāni bhūmidānakam ||84||
gorasādipradānāni miṣṭānnāni ghṛtāni ca |
ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi dadurnṛpocitāni hi ||85||
jagrāha śrīśīlavipraḥ sākṣādāgatya vai kare |
badaraṃ ca jalaṃ ramyaṃ valkalaṃ śarkarāṃ tathā ||86||
anyat sarvaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca prāpya tṛptiṃ jagāma saḥ |
patnyāṃ praviśya tatraiva prāha tṛpto’smi sarvathā ||87||
idānīṃ śāśvatā lokā madarthaṃ samupasthitāḥ |
pretatā me gatā tvatra hyeṣa yāmi paraṃ padam ||88||
vāsanā me tadā naṣṭā māyā naṣṭā durantagā |
pāpāni mama naṣṭāni puṇyaṃ jātaṃ ca muktikṛt ||89||
vimānaṃ ca madarthaṃ vai samāgataṃ sutaijasam |
naranārāyaṇakṛṣṇapāṣadaiḥ śobhanaṃ param ||4.6.90||
sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ putrāḥ putryaśca me priyā |
ekena badareṇāhaṃ śāśvatīṃ tṛptimāptavān ||9 1 ||
eṣa yāmi svasti vo’stu tārito’haṃ vrajāmi vai |
ityuktvā divyasadane tvadhiruhya vimānake ||92||
pārṣadairviṣṇubhaktaiśca sanmānito hi paśyatām |
sarveṣāṃ nijaputrāṇāṃ putrīṇāṃ yoṣitastathā ||93||
maharṣīṇāṃ paśyatāṃ ca vimānenākṣaraṃ yayau |
mahāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve naranārāyaṇāśrame ||94||
pitṛmuktiṃ vidhāyaiva nyavartanta sutādayaḥ |
pūjayitvā badarīśīṃ badrīnāthaṃ narāyaṇam ||95||
naraṃ sampūjya badaraṃ sabījaṃ prāpya te tataḥ |
avatīrya himādrestu nijālayaṃ yayurdrutam ||96||
mauktikāhāramāsādya datvā dānaṃ gṛhasya ca |
sarveṣāmupakaraṇādīnāṃ dānaṃ pradāya ca ||97||
āyayuste sukhasthānaṃ dārābhāgyākhyapattanam |
śvaśuraṃ nṛpatiṃ dāreśvaraṃ tathā prajājanān ||98||
bhaktān bhaktānikāścāpi prāhurvṛttāntameva te |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā badarīśapratāpajam ||99||
evaṃ badaradānasya māhātmyaṃ mokṣadaṃ param |
kathitaṃ te badrike vai sarvāpadvinivārakam || 4.6.1 00||
tataḥ śrutvā janasaṃghā dārābhāgyābhidho nṛpaḥ |
prajāśca saṃghaśo bhūtvā kuṭumbasahitā yayuḥ || 101 ||
badaryāḥ khalu yātrārthaṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam |
sarvasāmagrikāyuktā bhaktilagnaikamānasāḥ || 1 02||
bhajantaḥ śrībadrikeśaṃ dhyāyanto badarīśvarīm |
prāpurhimālaye badrīprabhe badarikāśramam || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīśīlasya putrāṇāṃ dārābhāgyapattane rājasammānaṃ śrīśīlasya maraṇaṃ pretatā taduddhārāya badrikāśrame śrāddhe badarādidānaṃ pretamokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭho’dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||

<4.7>
śrībadarīśvaryuvāca
kāntanārāyaṇakṛṣṇa dārābhāgyo nṛpo hi me |
badrikālayamāsādya kiṃ cakāra vadasva me || 1 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
ṛṣīkeśātsamārabhya pratikrośaṃ sa bhūpatiḥ |
vyadhādvai daṇḍavad badrīnāthaṃ dānāni sandadau || 2 ||
padbhyāṃ yayau śanaiḥ sarvaprajābhiḥ sahito hi me |
bhojyavyayaḥ samasto vai sahasradehināṃ nijaḥ || 3 ||
vrataṃ madhyāhnabhojitvaṃ cakre rājā prajānvitaḥ |
sahasramālikāvarttanaṃ cakre pratyahaṃ nṛpaḥ || 4 ||
prajāścāpi tathā cakrurmālāvarttanakīrtanam |
hare kṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇabadrīnātheśamādhava || 5 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapadmāvatīdhava |
evaṃ saṃbhūya bhajanaṃ cakruste vācikaṃ pathi || 6 ||
tīrthavratāni te sarve pālayāmāsurutsukāḥ |
bhūśāyitvaṃ brahmacaryaṃ caikabhuktatvamityapi || 7 ||
nārīṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca mithaḥ sparśavihīnatām |
satyavacanaṃ cādrohaṃ cānyagāthāvivarjanam || 8 ||
asteyaṃ ceśvaravṛttiṃ svādhyāyaṃ phalabhojanam |
satāṃ sevāṃ hareḥ sevāṃ sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā || 9 ||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ sāyaṃ kīrtanaṃ vādyasaṃyutam |
vṛddhānāṃ vandanaṃ prātardevānāṃ pūjanaṃ prage || 4.7.1 0||
ahiṃsāṃ cāpi jīvānāṃ nocchedaṃ tṛṇaśākhinām |
snānaṃ dhyānaṃ japaṃ cāpi havanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || 1 1||
pitroḥ prasevanaṃ patyuḥ sevanaṃ sādhusevanam |
nityadānaṃ ca gosevāṃ viprasammānamarhaṇam || 12||
annavastrapradānaṃ ca dhūpadīpanivedanam |
vratānyevaṃvidhānyeva cakrurmārge hi yātrikāḥ || 13||
sahasramānavāḥ sarve dārābhāgyanṛpānvitāḥ |
badarīśa jaya viṣṇo naranārāyaṇa prabho || 14||
gaṃgā jayatu badrīśī himālayo jayatvapi |
evaṃ jayādiśabdaiste sotsāhā ruruhurgirim || 15||
śikharāṇi kajjalāni dhavalāni kramāt tataḥ |
vilokayanto bhaktau ca magnā yānti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 16||
atha nārāyaṇasvāmī sādhurbhūtvā naro’pi ca |
tathā śrībadarī sādhvī bhūtvā bhāgavatīprabhā || 17||
bhikṣukāṇāṃ veṣavanto yayuḥ saṃghena saṃyutāḥ |
rātrau trayo militvā ca miṣṭasvaraiḥ sukīrtanam || 18||
naranārāyaṇasyaiva kurvanti snehagarbhitam |
śṛṇvanti saṃghaśaḥ sarve namanti trīn gurūniva || 19||
bhojayanti pare cāpi sevante tvapare’pi tu |
arpayanti yatheṣṭaṃ vai tribhyo yātrālavo muhuḥ ||4.7.20||
trikaṃ cāpi divyarūpaṃ bhāgavataṃ sthale sthale |
āvedayati panthānaṃ pathyaṃ pātheyamityapi ||21||
vikretṛrūpamāsādya parvatīyaphalādikam |
āpaṇe tviva dhṛtvā ca mārge tiṣṭhati vai puraḥ ||22||
evaṃ śrībhagavān badri saṃghena saha vartate |
bhaktā yataḥ prasannāḥ syuḥ sevayā duḥkhavarjitāḥ ||23||
viyogaṃ nijabhaktānāṃ tatrāpi svaṃ prayāyinām |
sahate na harikṛṣṇo bhaktāḥ sahanta eva na ||24||
tathā badrīprabho nārāyaṇo’haṃ vai tvayā saha |
nareṇa sahitaḥ saṃghe yukte’bhavaṃ nijecchayā ||25||
muktido’haṃ hi bhaktānāṃ pārvatiko’ghanāśakaḥ |
dayayā preritaḥ saṃghe vyacaraṃ sādhuveṣabhāg ||26||
sādhūnāṃ sevayā kṛṣṇasevayā tīrthayātrikā |
saphalā jāyate badri darśanāt pādavāhanāt ||27||
atha rājñastu saṃghasya parīkṣārthaṃ mayā tadā |
rugṇaṃ rūpaṃ mama badri darśitaṃ jvaraveśitam ||28||
calituṃ tvasamartho’haṃ jvarāgninā tadābhavam |
mama bhrātāpi sahasā jvarāviṣṭo’bhavattataḥ ||29||
mama patnī satī nārī sādhvī rurodha vai bhṛśam |
jvarāviṣṭau pumāṃsau dvau sevanīyau kathaṃ pathi ||4.7.3 0||
ekayā yoṣitā sādhvyā rugṇau pālyau kathaṃ pathi |
śītāḍhye himamārge vai parādhīnau suduḥkhitau ||31||
bhikṣukyāḥ sannidhau tatra nāyānti dhanamāninaḥ |
bhikṣukī rauti vijane niṣadya sannidhau tayoḥ ||32||
saṃghasthā mānavāḥ sarve dayāyuktāstu tairthikāḥ |
ye ye tvāyānti tatpārśve tiṣṭhanti dayayānvitāḥ ||33||
sevante jvaranāśārthaṃ dehaṃ saṃvāhayantyapi |
dhairyaṃ vadanti nāryai ca yatheṣṭaṃ saṃdadatyapi ||34||
kramaśaste sahasraṃ vai mānavā rugṇasannidhau |
yātrāṃ nirudhya militāstyaktuṃ śaktā na cābhavan ||35||
rājāpi tvāyayau mārge nirgacchan tau vyalokayat |
rugṇau sādhūsattamau ca duḥkhinīṃ sādhvikāṃ priyām ||36||
atiṣṭhat sahasā tatra niṣasāda purastayoḥ |
papracchepsitamevāpi dhairyaṃ dadau dhanaṃ dadau ||39|||
vacanaṃ pradadau tābhyāṃ sādhubhyāṃ nṛpatiḥ śubham |
yāvad rogo na bhavatornivarteta tu tāvatā |38||
nāsmāt sthānāt prayāsyāmi tvagre badarikāśramam |
saha nītvaina yāsyāmi mā khedaṃ kurutaṃ yuvām ||39||
sarve vayaṃ nivatsyāmaścātraiva svasthatāvadhim |
yadvājñayā tu bhavatorvāṃ kṛtvā skandhavāhinau ||4.7.40||
yāsyāmo badarītīrthaṃ santo hi hṛdayaṃ hareḥ |
na tyaktavyā mokṣaṇārthaiḥ prāptāḥ santaḥ kadācana ||41||
sādhvīyaṃ mā śucaṃ yātu tiṣṭhāmastvatsahāyinaḥ |
badrīnātho drutaṃ cemau nīrugṇau vidadhātviha |||42||
evaṃ niścitya rājāpi prajāścāpi haripriyāḥ |
sarve yātrāṃ vihāyaiva sādhvarthaṃ tūṣitāḥ pathi |||43||
atha bhojanapānādi phalādanaṃ pracakrire |
sādhubhyāṃ dattavantaśca mudgapakvādimaṇḍakam ||44||
papatustau sukhaṃ sādhvī bhojanaṃ pracakāra ha |
sarve’pi bhuktavantaste rātryāgamo’bhavattataḥ ||45||
rātrau sarve kīrtanaṃ ca pracakruḥ kaṇṭharāgiṇaḥ |
savādyaṃ śrīnaranārāyaṇanāma pracakrire ||46||
athāpi himavarṣā vai niśārdhavigame’bhavat |
śītānalo’bhavad vyāptaḥ saṃghe sarvatra bhūtale ||47||
rugṇau prātarmṛtau tyaktvā prāṇān pretau babhūvatuḥ |
rurodha sādhvī sānāthā rurudurnṛpatatprajāḥ ||48||
himasya vigame jāte prātaḥprakāśanottaram |
rājā sarvān yātrikām̐śca sambodhayannuvāca ha ||49||
yāvanmṛtau na jīvetāṃ tāvadannaṃ tyajāmyaham |
maraṇaṃ sādhubhiḥ sākaṃ manye mokṣapradaṃ mama ||4.7.50||
śrutvaivaṃ yātrikāḥ sarve narā nāryo’pi bālakāḥ |
pratijñāṃ tādṛśīṃ cakrurgṛhṇāmo bhojanaṃ nahi ||51 ||
yāvannaitau hi jīvetāṃ mariṣyāmo’tra nirjalāḥ |
yāsyāmo brahmasadanaṃ sādhvarthe prāṇarodhinaḥ |||92||
kimatra yātrayā sādhūn tyaktvā svārthaparārthinām |
niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasya sādhūm̐styaktvā tu jīvati ||553||
api prāṇān pradāyaiva sādhūn saṃrakṣayet sadā |
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā sādhvarthe ca satīstriyai ||54||
prāṇapaṇaṃ vidhāyāpi rakṣāṃ karoti yo janaḥ |
tasya svargaṃ ca mokṣaśca śaraṇyasya dhruvau matau |||55|||
api pañcamahāpāpaprasakto’pi satāṃ kṛte |
prāṇān jahāti rakṣārthaṃ sarvapāpāt sa mucyate ||56||
sādhurakṣākṛtaḥ rakṣāṃ karoti bhagavān hariḥ |
sādhuṣveva hariścāste sādhureva svayaṃ hariḥ ||57||
yā prītirnijaputreṣu patnyāṃ pitrośca bandhuṣu |
tāṃ kṛtvā satsu dehyatra mucyate janmabandhanāt ||58||
yo yatnaḥ svakuṭumbasya bharaṇārthaṃ vitanyate |
sa cet kṛtaḥ satāmarthe yatnavān mucyate hyaghāt ||59||
yathā lokaiḥ pakṣapātaḥ kriyate svakuṭumbiṣu |
tathā kṛtaḥ satāmarthe tārayatyeva tatkṛtaḥ ||4.7.60||
yathā sneho nijadehe daihike vartate nṛṇām |
tathā cejjāyate satsu mucyate bhavasāgarāt ||61 ||
yathā svārthe kṛtayatnaḥ pumānna manute śramam |
tathā satāṃ kṛte yatne snehānna manute śramam ||62||
na pārakyaṃ ca manute manute mokṣakṛcchramam |
sa eva labhate dhāmni nārāyaṇapadāmbujam ||63||
rugṇaṃ sādhuṃ tu yastyaktvā yāti dehī madānvitaḥ |
sa yāti yāmyalokaṃ vai duḥkhaṃ yāmyanibhaṃ tviha ||64||
mātṛsevāphalaṃ pitṛsevāphalaṃ tathā satām |
sevayā labhate kāntasevāphalaṃ hi śāśvatam ||65||
sarvatīrthāni sādhūnāṃ mūrtau vasanti sarvadā |
sādhutīrthāvamantā na labhate tīrthajaṃ phalam ||66||
sādhvoretayormārge’tra gatāsvostyajanaṃ hyagham |
tadarthaṃ prāṇadānena puṇyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ||67||
iti niścitya rājā ca prajā yātrāṃ vihāya vai |
annaṃ jalaṃ vihāyāpi niṣeduḥ śavasannidhau ||68||
cakruste bhajanaṃ tatra satataṃ nāmakīrtanam |
atha sādhvī satī nārī prāṇān hātuṃ samicchati ||69||
kṛtvā kāṣṭhāni caikatra śavau nidhāya tatra ca |
yāvadagniṃ tatra kartuṃ yāti tāvannṛpaḥ svayam ||4.7.70||
utplutya kāṣṭhacayane nipapāta puraḥ striyāḥ |
tato rājñī tathā nāryaḥ prajāścāpi śucākulāḥ ||71 ||
nipetuḥ sahasā kāṣṭhacitāyāṃ maraṇāya vai |
nārī vahniṃ samutpādya śete tu yāvadeva ha ||72||
śerate bhūbhṛtādyāśca na nirgacchanti vahnitaḥ |
tādṛśīṃ paramāṃ bhaktiṃ vilokya bhagavān svayam ||73||
citāyāḥ śāntavahnestu sajīvaḥ sanaro hariḥ |
utthitaśca hasan divyavapuścaturbhujānvitaḥ ||74||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo nareṇa śobhitaḥ |
tathā lakṣmyā yutaḥ sādhvyā hasannāha nṛpādikān ||75||
bhavanto mama bhaktāḥ stha sarvasvārpaṇakāriṇaḥ |
sādhusnehayutāstīrthapāvanāścātmasadṛśāḥ ||76||
ātmanivedinaḥ sarve sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ |
vaikuṇṭhayogyā yūyaṃ stha mama prasannatānvitāḥ ||77||
parīkṣitā mayā sarve madarthakṛtayatnakāḥ |
madarthaprāṇadātāro madarthakṛtajīvanāḥ ||78||
tyaktasaṃsāraputrādisnehāḥ sādhuparāyaṇāḥ |
dhāmayogyā muktiyogyā bhavathātra himālaye ||79||
matprasādāddivyadehā bhavathātra sugandhinaḥ |
vyomagāḥ saṃbhavantyeva sarve duḥkhavivarjitāḥ ||4.7.80||
ito dūraṃ na me badrikāśramo vidyate’naghāḥ |
āyāntu vyomamārgeṇa sahasā tu mayā saha ||8 1 ||
ityuktvā bhagavānnārāyaṇo naraśca badrikā |
vyomamārgeṇa sarvāṃstānninyurbadarikāśramam ||82||
badaryāṃ abhitastatra tasthuste bhagavatparāḥ |
ūṣuḥ pakṣaṃ sevamānā badrīnāthaṃ naraṃ satīm ||83||
ṛṣīndevānpitṛgaṇāndivyāndivaḥ samāgatān |
vīkṣayāmāsurūrdhvajñā muktā ivābhavam̐śca te ||84||
athaikaṃ tatra vipraṃ ca tapantaṃ tāpasaṃ munim |
vyalokayan badaryagre nārāyaṇajapānvitam ||85||
nirāhāraṃ dhyānamagnaṃ divyamūrtiṃ jaṭānvitam |
vyapaśyam̐śca dvijasyāgre tvāyātāṃ kanyakāṃ śubhām ||86||
badarīmūlato divyāmudbhūtāmadbhutāṃ prabhām |
viprāya badaraṃ datvā vyalīyata drutaṃ tu sā ||87||
badaryāṃ sā līnabhāvamupayātā narāyaṇī |
dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ tu paramaṃ prāptāste nṛpamānavāḥ ||88||
tīrthavidhiṃ tataścakrurnārāyaṇasya pūjanam |
gaṃgāsnānaṃ badarasya phalāhāraṃ vyadhustadā ||89||
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakrurnārāyaṇagatāsavaḥ |
nīrājanaṃ hareścakruḥ prasādaṃ jagdhurutsukāḥ ||4.7.90||
ekāgramānasā jātāḥ kṛṣṇe snehadravānvitāḥ |
tāvatteṣāṃ śarīrāṇi divyāni taijasāni vai ||9 1 ||
vyajāyanta kṣaṇād badri vimānaṃ cāgataṃ tataḥ |
nirvikalpasamādhisthā divyendriyādivigrahāḥ ||92||
taireva vigrahairdivyairāruruhurvimānakam |
sarve caturbhujā divyā narā nāryaśca bālakāḥ ||93||
vaikuṇṭhamārgaṃ vimalaṃ tvavicchinnaṃ tathāmbare |
vyalokayan hariṃ natvā pārṣadaiḥ saha taijasaiḥ ||94||
yayurvaikuṇṭhadhāmātha jayaśabdāstadā divi |
devānāmabhavan badri maharṣīṇāṃ śubhā ravāḥ ||956||
nārāyaṇāḥ sarvanarā nārāyaṇyaḥ striyastadā |
divyā vaikuṣṭhayogyāste vaikuṇṭhaṃ viviśuḥ kṣaṇāt ||96||
sādhurūpasya kṛṣṇasya sevāphalaṃ hi mokṣaṇam |
dārābhāgyanṛpādyām̐stān svapne dadṛśire prajāḥ ||97||
muktiṃ gatān vimānena mahotsavān pracakrire |
evaṃ śrīmāṇikībadri badrikāśramayātrayā ||98||
muktiṃ yānti mānavā vai divyadehā vimānagāḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt saṃstavādapi ||99||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhante vai badrīprabhetivādinaḥ |
sākṣānnārāyaṇo yatra yatra tvaṃ badrikāprabhe || 4.7.100 ||
yatra maharṣayo divyā gaṃgā yatra ca pārvatī|
tatra vaikuṇṭhamevāste pañcamaṃ tapasānvitam || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne dārābhāgyanṛpasya sahasramānavayutasya badrikāśramayātrāyāṃ sādhusādhvīrūpabadarīnaranārāyaṇadarśanaṃ, parīkṣaṇaṃ, nārāyaṇārthaprāṇadānaṃ, prasannatā, vyomnā vadrikāśramaprāpaṇaṃ, divyadehavattvaṃ, mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptamo’dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

<4.8>
śrībadrīśvaryuvāca
ko’sau vipro’bhavat tatra tāpaso badarīsthale |
yasmai kanyā ca badaraṃ dadau brūhi hare kathām || 1 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
brahmadevo’bhavadvipro lūnīgrāmanivāsakṛt |
saurāṣṭre vedavedāṃgapravīṇo makhakarmaṭhaḥ || 2 ||
prātaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā kṛṣṇaṃ daivatapañcakam |
bhikṣārthaṃ sa prayātyeva grāmavasatisadgṛham || 3 ||
alaṃ prāpyodarapūrṇaṃ nivartate gṛhaṃ nijam |
aprāpya pūrṇaṃ vasatigṛhāṃgaṇāni yātyapi || 4 ||
alaṃ labdhvā gṛhaṃ yāti pācayitvā striyā saha |
nāmnā tu viśadākṣyā 3 bhuṃkte devārpaṇottaram |||5 ||
ityevaṃ vartamānasya gataṃ varṣasahasrakam |
vyajāyata na cāpatyaṃ patnī śokāturābhavat || 6 ||
anapatyasya lokā na bhavanti sukhadāyinaḥ |
uddhāro’pi bhavennaiva ṛṇānubandhinastathā || 7 ||
api mūrkho’pi vaṃśīyaḥ samuddharati pūrvajān |
aputrasya gatirnāsti vandhyāyā nahi mokṣaṇam || 8 ||
tasmāt prayatitavyaṃ vai putrārthaṃ tapaādibhiḥ |
vicāryetthaṃ patiṃ prāha viśadākṣī pratāpinī || 9 ||
gataṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai putro nāsti hi mānasaḥ |
na garbhajo nāṃkajaśca na datto na ca rakṣitaḥ || 4.8.1 0||
vinā putraṃ gatirnāsti caiṣitavyaḥ sutastataḥ |
sarvebhyaḥ khalu putrebhyo garīyān garbhajaḥ sutaḥ || 1 1||
auraso guṇasampannaḥ pitrośca pratibimbakaḥ |
utpādanīyaścāvābhyāṃ putro garbhaja uttamaḥ || 12||
dehi garbhaṃ hariṃ dhyātvā kṛtakṛtyā bhavāmi yat |
śrutvaivaṃ pramadāvākyaṃ vipraḥ prāha na me sutaḥ || 13||
lalāṭe likhitaścāsti na te putro bhaviṣyati |
stheyaṃ tasmādaputrābhyāmāvābhyāṃ bhavasāgare || 14||
śrutvaivaṃ pramadā prāha bhāgyaṃ tapasā vardhate |
putrecchayā tapaḥ kāryaṃ bhavatā vā mayā tviha || 15||
aputrayormaraṇaṃ vai narakāya bhavediti |
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mokṣe cittaṃ niveśayet || 16||
asādhyaṃ nāsti viprasya tapasvino viśeṣataḥ |
tasmāttapaḥ paraṃ kāryaṃ putrārthaṃ kānta sarvathā || 17||
ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ vipraścintāṃ cakāra ha |
patnyā vākyaṃ yathārthaṃ vai nānapatyasya sadgatiḥ || 18||
saṃkalpapūrakaṃ kṣetraṃ divyaṃ badarikāśramam |
gantavyaṃ tatra yātrārthaṃ putrārthaṃ tapase’pi ca || 19||
putraprāptirbhavedvā na mokṣasiddhirbhaviṣyati |
tasmādubhayasiddhyarthaṃ gantavyaṃ badarīvanam ||4.8.20||
nirṇīyetthaṃ striyā sākaṃ yayau badarikāśramam |
tīrthavidhiṃ vidhāyaiva kṛtvāsanaṃ prakāśake ||21 ||
tapastepe bhūsuro’sau patnyā sākamaharniśam |
māsaṃ cakre phalāhāraṃ badarasyaiva kevalam ||22||
māsaṃ tasthau nirāhāraṃ himānilakṛtāśanaḥ |
māsadvayānte badarīṃ smṛtvā stotraṃ cakāra ha ||23||
nārāyaṇī satī sādhvī māṇikī śrīḥ ramā ratiḥ |
hariṇī kamalā lakṣmīḥ sadā jayatu mādhavī ||24||
mūlinī pattriṇī devī śākhāvatī himālayā |
badarāḍhyā narabījā sadā jayatu mādhavī ||25||
śūlāṃkuśadharā sādhvī brāhmaṇī bālayoginī |
sarvarṣidevavāsā śrīḥ sadā jayatu mādhavī ||26||
kārṣṇī kṛṣṇapriyā śītā hemānalanivāriṇī |
haryaṃganā brahmaśīlā sadā jayatu mādhavī ||27||
sattvamayī bālakṛṣṇasvarūpā puruṣottamī |
prajñānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇī jayatu mādhavī ||28||
pārvatī brahmamuktādijaganmātāvatāriṇī |
śrīkṛṣṇe vallabhā goptrī sadā jayatu mādhavī ||29||
camatkārasthitā devī tāpasī parameśvarī |
bhaktecchāpūrikā cāndrī sadā jayatu mādhavī ||4.8.30||
evaṃ stutvā namaḥ kṛtvopārarāma sa bhūsuraḥ |
viśadākṣau tato gatvā pupūja badarīśvarīm ||3 1||
jalaṃ tathākṣatān puṣpāṇyuttamāni ca śarkarāḥ |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ ca tathāmbaram ||32||
samarpya badrikādevyai nīrājanaṃ samācarat| |
aparādhakṣamāṃ cāpi yayāce viśadākṣikā ||33||
tataścākāśavāk tatra badaryūrdhvaṃ manoharā |
aśrūyata viśadākṣi badarīvratamācara ||34||
nityaṃ prātarbadaryāstu mūle secaya vāri tu |
badaryadhaḥśayanaṃ ca badaryadho nijāsanam ||35||
badrīpatraprapūtaṃ ca badarīphalabhojanam |
badrīchāyāṃ samāsādya māsamekaṃ nivāsanam ||36||
badarīrasasammiśravārisnānaṃ tathottamam |
badarīphalamālāyāḥ kaṇṭhe nityaṃ pradhāraṇam ||37||
prakoṣṭhe badarīpatraphalamālāvadhāraṇam |
kaṭyāṃ badarīpatrāṇāṃ mekhalāyāḥ pradhāraṇam ||38||
badarīpuṣpagandhasya mañjaryā grahaṇaṃ tathā |
dhammile badarīpuṣpamañjaryā dhāraṇaṃ tathā || 39||
sāyamārādhanaṃ badrīpramāyāḥ stotrakīrtanam |
badrībhūmermārjanaṃ ca badrīgundrasya bhakṣaṇam ||4.8.40||
badrītvakcūrṇayuktasya jalasya pānamityapi |
māsānte badarībījāṃkuraropaṇamityapi ||41||
udyāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ ca badarāṇāṃ pradānakam |
yathāśaktisvarṇarūpyabhūṣāratnapradānakam ||4 2||
annavastrādidānaṃ ca smṛddhirājyapradānakam |
yathā vaibhavadānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ ca visarjanam ||43||
sādhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā |
kanyānāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi kumārāṇāṃ ca bhojanam ||44||
vadhūnāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi garbhiṇīnāṃ ca bhojanam |
śāṭikāṃ ghargharīṃ colīṃ kucalīṃ stanabandhinīm ||45||
dadyād dāne pramadābhyo mama prasādakāriṇīm |
dhanaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt parihāraṃ tataścaret ||46||
evaṃ māsavrataṃ kuryāttasyāḥ putro bhavediti |
putrī cāpi mayā tulyā bhavennāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||47||
śrutvaivaṃ vyomavāṇī sā māsaṃ śrībadarīvratam |
pracakāra yathāproktaṃ vipro’pi tapa ācarat ||48||
vratānte badarīdevī prasannā māṇikīramā |
kanyārūpā svayaṃ bhūtvā nirjagāma drumāntarāt ||49||
badaraṃ sā kare dhṛtvā dadau tad viprayoṣite |
viśadākṣī phalaṃ neme neme tāṃ badarīśvarīm ||4.8.50||
pataye phalalābhārthaṃ sā ceyeṣa hṛdantare |
badarī sahasā bhāvaṃ jñātvā viprāya tad dadau ||51||
prathamaṃ badaraṃ divyaṃ sabījaṃ putradāyakam |
dvitīyaṃ badaraṃ cāsyai brāhmaṇyai sā tato dadau ||52||
uvāca badarīdevī vipraṃ bhuṃkṣva sabījakam |
putravān tvaṃ yathākālaṃ patnīdvārā bhaviṣyasi ||53||
viśadākṣīṃ tataḥ prāha putraste’pi tataḥ param |
snuṣāsaṃkalpamātreṇa putrikāvān bhaviṣyati ||54||
putrikā sā mānasīti cākasmād bālayogini |
matsamā śrīharerbhaktā nārāyaṇī bhaviṣyati ||55||
dvitīyaṃ badaraṃ tasmād rakṣa snuṣārthamavyayam |
prasannāsmi bhava brāhmi vaṃśavistārayoginī |||56||
pautrīvaṃśo gānasaste bādarākhyo bhaviṣyati |
ityāśīrvādamevaitāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā ||57|||
datvā tiro’bhavad badrīnārāyaṇī nareśvarī |
kṛtakṛtyo’bhavad vipro viprāṇī pūrṇamānasā ||58||
nārāyaṇaṃ badarīśaṃ badrīṃ prapūjya bhāvataḥ |
udyāpanaṃ samastaṃ ca yathāśakti vidhāya ca ||59||
yātrāṃ pūrṇāṃ saṃvidhāya tapaḥpūrṇaṃ vidhāya ca |
ṛṣīndevānprapūjyāpi gaṃgāṃ vigāhya vai tataḥ ||4.8.60||
śanairnatvā hariṃ smṛtvā nyavartatāmubhāvapi |
ṛṣīkeśaṃ haridvāraṃ puṣkaraṃ siddhapattanam ||61||
kṛtvā tīrthāni tau māsacatuṣṭayottaraṃ mudā |
saurāṣṭre tvāyayatuśca kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||62||
tīrthavidhiṃ vidhāyāpi dṛṣṭvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapūjya tāvubhau ||63||
prāpatuḥ svagṛhaṃ lūnīgrāmaṃ prasannamānasau |
pūjābhiḥ pūjitau vāsaṃ cakruturgṛhadharmiṇau ||64||
viśadākṣī babhūvāpi patyurdaurhṛdalakṣaṇā |
suṣuve sā susamaye kumāraṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ||65||
dadau dānāni vipraśca jātakarmādi cācarat |
viśadākṣī putravatīgaṇanāṃ prajagāma ha ||66||
badrīpārvīramādevyāḥ kṛpayāpatyayoginī |
jātā saubhāgyasampannā saphalā gṛhadharmiṇī ||67||
atha kāle prayāte ca suto yadā yuvābhavat |
nāmnā nikāmadeveti khyātiṃ prāpa prajāsvapi ||68||
vivāhitaḥ sa pitrāpi dhūnīgrāme śubhālaye |
girīśvarasya viprasya sutāṃ sureśvarīṃ satīm ||69||
kanyāṃ vivāhavidhinā jagrāha sa tu maṇḍape |
sāpi mahendratulyaṃ vai badaryanugrahodbhavam |||4.8.70||
patiṃ tvāsādya mumude nikāmadevanāmakam |
nikāmadevamātāpi snuṣāyai badaraṃ phalam ||71||
rakṣitaṃ cirakālena sopākhyānaṃ dadau mudā |
sureśvarī snuṣā bhuktvā phalaṃ badarīdaivatam ||72|||
divyajñānavatī jātā satyasaṃkalpaśālinī |
