yattat sureśvarī patnī kalpayatyeva mānase ||73||
tattat sarvaṃ bhavatyeva yathā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī |
evaṃ te badrike proktaṃ sureśvarīkathānakam ||74||
athāgre’pi kathayāmi kathāṃ te bālayogini |
tvameva badarī jātā putrikā bālayoginī ||75||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne lūnīgrāmasya brahmadevaviprasyānapatyasya badrikāśrame tapasā prāptavaradānabadaraphalābhyāṃ putrapautrīprāptiprabhṛtinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||

<4.9>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīrame devi kathāṃ bhaktasya pāvanīm |
nāmnā nikāmadevasya saurāṣṭre dhūnivāsinaḥ || 1 ||
dhūnigrāme’vasad vipraḥ śvaśurasya gṛhe śubhe |
raivatādreraraṇyeṣu vasatīnāṃ gururhi saḥ || 2 ||
vaidikaḥ karmadharmasthaḥ kriyākāṇḍaparāyaṇaḥ 1
pañcadevārcanarato yajamānasukhāvahaḥ || 3 ||
babhūva sa kriyā yatra saṃskāramūlikāstathā |
vivāhādisvarūpiṇyo yatra saptāhavācanam || 4 ||
devotsavā vatsarasyotsavāstatra prajājanaiḥ |
ākāritaḥ prayātyeva bahumānyapuraḥsaram || 5 ||
niṣpādayati kāryāṇi samastāni yathāvidhi |
grāme grāme yajamānāḥ sahasraśo’sya cābhavan || 6 ||
yatra yatra prayātyeva tasmād draviṇamuttamam |
vipulaṃ samavāpnoti gṛhaṃ nayati cotsukaḥ || 7 ||
annaṃ vastrāṇi bahūni vibhūṣā vindate’pi ca |
yānavāhanapātrāṇi tathopakaraṇānyapi || 8 ||
gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ yāti lobhapradhāna eva ha |
nānyebhyaścāpi viprebhyo’nāthebhyaḥ pradadātyapi || 9 ||
sañcayaṃ kurute saudhe vastūnāṃ nityameva ha |
svajñātīnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ kāryārthaṃ na dadātyapi || 4.9.10 ||
gṛhamadhye bhavantyeva jīrṇāni śaradādibhiḥ |
varṣābhiścāpi naṣṭāni jāyante cātapādibhiḥ || 1 1||
kīṭāḥ khādanti vastrāṇi cānnānyapi bahūni ca |
tathāpi naiva lokebhyaḥ pradadāti hi lobhavān || 12||
nikāmadevaviprasya patnī nāmnā sureśvarī |
bhaktābhūddānakāryeṣu mahodāryavatī tathā || 1 3||
bhikṣukebhyaḥ pradadāti yathā jānāti naiva saḥ |
annaṃ vastraṃ ca pātraṃ ca dadātyanāthadehine || 14||
parameśaḥ prasanno’stu cāntarātmā hariḥ prabhuḥ |
evamuccārya viprāṇī dehibhyaḥ pradadāti vai || 15||
kṛṣṇārpaṇavidhānena dadāti bhaktiyoginī |
puṇyaṃ cāsyāstato nityaṃ jāyate śāśvataṃ bahu || 16||
antarātmā prabhuścāsyāḥ prasanno vartate hyati |
pūjākāle ca viprāṇī yadarpayati śārṅgiṇe || 17||
mūrtau hariḥ samastaṃ tad gṛhṇāti divyarūpavān |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīvallabhaḥ svayam || 18||
śvaśrvārpitaṃ badaraṃ sā bubhuje putrikārthinī |
putrīṃ tathehamānāyā viprāṇyāstu gṛhe kvacit || 1 9||
badrīrūpā navavarṣā kanyā kācit samāyayau |
na me rakṣākaraḥ kaścinmātāpitṛvihīnikā ||4.9.20||
na kuṭumbaṃ vartate me rakṣa māṃ brahmapatnike |
ityevamārthayat kanyā sureśvarī muhurmuhuḥ ||21 ||
sureśvarī tato badri snehaparā rarakṣa tām |
kuru kāryāṇi sarvāṇi gṛhasyeva sutā mama |||2||
pālayiṣye sadā tvāṃ vai mānasī tvaṃ sutā mama |
ityevaṃ svāśraye pṛṣṭvā patiṃ rarakṣa sā tu tām ||23||
kanyāpi sevate matvā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ ca tau |
atha kāle gate prāpte yauvane bālayoginī ||24||
balaṃ prāpyāpīndriyāṇāṃ vikṛtiṃ na jagāma sā |
pṛṣṭā vivāhaviṣaye netyevaṃ prāha bhūsurau ||25||
uvāca mātaraṃ tvādhyātmikaṃ prāgbhavayoginī |
mātarmanuṣyadeho’yaṃ mokṣārthaṃ mukhyato’rjitaḥ || 26||
na mātrārthaṃ prayoktavyo bhavārthaṃ vā mumukṣuṇā |
gatānyanekajanmāni tanmātrāṇi sukhāni ca ||27||
tatra bhuktāni sarvāṇi na tṛṣṇānto vilokitaḥ |
bhoge tu jāyate tṛṣṇādhikā yā na nivartate ||28||
akṣatāyā na me tṛṣṇā vidyate jāyate’pi ca |
abhuktāyāśca muktāyā mokṣo hastatale mama ||29||
brahma sampādyamevāsti vivāhyaśca narāyaṇaḥ |
gantavyaṃ tvātmanā tatra śrīmannārāyaṇagṛhe ||4.9.30||
hareḥ saṃgo hi satsaṃgastadanyastu kusaṃgakaḥ |
satsaṃgaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya labdhavyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||3 1||
jīvo’yaṃ mānave loke bahudhā strīrvyajāyata |
naro’pi saṃbabhūvaiṣaḥ kāmanāṃ tyaktavānnahi ||32||
yadā satsaṃgametyatra vijñānaṃ jñānamityapi |
vivekaṃ bhedavijñānaṃ labhate bhaktimeti ca ||33||
pratyakṣe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śaktinidhau prabhau |
tadā saṃsārapāraṃ vai yāti bhaktajano mudā ||34||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
vartate bhūtale mātargopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ||35||
divyo’nantabrahmapriyāpatiḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ |
taṃ bhajitvā bhayaṃ nāsti kālamāyākukarmaṇām ||36||
ye bhajante parātmānaṃ tyaktadaihikavāsanāḥ |
sādhavaste sadoktā vai sādhvyastā yoṣito’pi ca ||37||
kāmakrodhādayo yeṣāṃ santi naiva kadācana |
bhakteṣu cet kvacit kāmo dṛśyetāpi na bandhakṛt ||38||
bhagavatsaṃgamāptasya divyāḥ kāmādayaḥ sadā |
kṛṣṇamāhātmyayogena māyāpi caiti divyatām ||39||
ataḥ kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇabhakte durguṇo’pi guṇottamaḥ |
divya eva bhavatyeva mokṣadaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ ||4.9.40||
yatra yatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra ca tatpriyāḥ |
tadrajodhūsaraṃ dehaṃ vāñcchanti bhaktivedinaḥ ||41 ||
api vṛkṣāstṛṇagulmā vallikā paśupakṣiṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇasambandhamāpannāste sarve divyatāṃ gatāḥ ||42||
devapūjyā bhavantyeva teṣāṃ saṃgāt pramokṣaṇam |
kiṃ punarmānavā bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇasevāparāyaṇāḥ ||43||
sadā kṛṣṇadhyānapūjānāmasmṛtyādikārakāḥ |
mātastvaṃ bhajase kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ||44||
tato’haṃ divyatāṃ prāptā sevayā te nirantam |
nānyaṃ patiṃ samicchāmi śrīkṛṣṇakāntamantarā ||45||
sarvatra bhagavatprītihetustapa udīritam |
prasādito vedhasāpi hariḥ pūrvaṃ tapomayaiḥ ||46||
niṣkāmārpaṇabhāvaiśca sanakādyaiḥ prasāditaḥ |
anye vivekavanto’pi viṣṇostoṣaṇahetave ||47||
samācaranti bahudhā tapāṃsi saṃyamānapi |
saṃyamena ca vartante bhagavatprītikāmukāḥ ||48||
badaryāṃ śvetabhavane tapaḥ kurvanti sādhavaḥ |
bhagavatpremalabdhyarthaṃ sevāprāptyarthamityapi ||49||
anena vā paraiścāpi janmabhiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
yāvatprīto bhavettāvattapaḥ kuryāṃ hi śīlinī ||4.9.50||
harerdāsyapratāpena śivābrāhmīramāsamā |
bhaviṣyāmi harerbhaktyā mātaste kṛpayāpi ca ||51 ||
srakcandanāṃśukābhūṣānaivedyasevanādibhiḥ |
prasādya śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ prāpsyāmi svāminaṃ prabhum |||52||
ihāmutra ca sarvāsāṃ niḥśreyasakaraṃ hi tat |
dāsyaṃ tapaḥsvarūpaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ||53||
tatrodyuktasya vighnaughā bhavanti na kadācana |
nānāvidhāni bhogyāni svarṇālaṃkārasampadaḥ ||54||
khādyapeyarasādyāśca jāyante bandhanāya na |
mātarlokapravāho’yamandhānāmandhagāmivat ||55||
vahatyeva vinā jñānaṃ yatpāro naiva labhyate |
kāminyo vidhavāścāpi kāmatṛṣṇākulāstu yāḥ ||56||
mṛtaṃ kāntaṃ praśocanti cāśrayanti narāntaram |
kṛṣṇaikabhaktimatyastu taruṇyaḥ sadhavā api ||57||
kāmasukhaṃ tvavamapya bhajanti śrīhariṃ patim |
eṣaṇā vāsanā cāpyavivekastatra bandhanam ||58||
divyatā bhāvanā cātmajñānaṃ niḥśreyasāṃ pradam |
tasmāt prītaye kṛṣṇasya premabhaktiyutaṃ tapaḥ ||59 ||
kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ mātarmayā tvatsannidhāviha |
kṛṣṇe prītiḥ prakartavyā mātaḥ preṣṭhatame mayā ||4.9.60||
yadyat priyaṃ bhavatyasya kāryaṃ tattanmayā sadā |
tasya rucyanusāreṇa vṛttyaṃ nityaṃ mayā tathā ||6 1 ||
viprakṛṣṭe’ntike vāpi stheyaṃ tadājñayā sadā |
nāpriyaṃ nijabhaktasya kvāpi kṛṣṇaḥ karoti hi ||62||
bhaktimatī yatra yatra vartate ca tadājñayā |
tatra tatra hariryāti bhaktāyāḥ premasaṃvaśaḥ ||63||
ato naiva hi bhaktāyā viraho’sya bhavet kvacit |
kṛṣṇo bhaktasya virahaṃ soḍhuṃ śakto na vai kvacit ||64||
mātaḥ śarīrametattu māyikaṃ jīvabandhakṛt |
janmanaḥ kāraṇaṃ māyā tamo’jñānaṃ ca mohanam ||65||
satsaṃgaṃ samvidhāyaiva māyāmohādi nāśayet |
premṇā dhyāyet parabrahma sākṣāddhariṃ ramāpatim ||66||
kṣetrajñeśaṃ parameśaṃ hṛtsthaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam |
divyānandapradaṃ dhyāyed bālakṛṣṇaṃ jagatpatim ||67||
karṇābhyāṃ śṛṇuyāttasya līlācaritramutsavāt |
harelīṃlā garīyasyastapodānebhya uttamāḥ ||68||
hareryogena mātarvai niṣkāmatvaṃ sadā bhavet |
pūrṇakāmasya yogena sadā syāt pūrṇakāmatā ||69||
dṛṣṭvā naraṃ bālakaṃ vā yuvānaṃ vṛddhamityapi |
vikriyāṃ prāpnuyānnārī māyāyuktā hi sā matā ||4.9.70||
narasya trividhasyāpi tvaṃgānāṃ darśane sati |
vikriyāṃ tu manāk prāptā bhavet sāpi tu māyikī ||71 ||
paśuṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā tadvannaraṃ dṛṣṭvā na vikriyām |
prāpnuyāt sā bhavejjitendriyā nārī virāgiṇī ||72||
raho vikāramāpannā madhyarāgā hi socyate |
puṃso yoge’pi yasyā na vikṛtiḥ sā tu ceśvarī ||73||
brāhmī muktānikā bodhyā brahmapriyā haripriyā |
mahāvairāgyasampannā divyanārāṇapriyā ||74||
etādṛśī tu yā nārī nārāyaṇapareśvare |
vīkṣya kāmaṃ madaṃ krodhaṃ divyaṃ taṃ manute sadā ||75||
tasyā jñeyopāsanā tu merutulyā hi niścalā |
tayāpnuyānmahāsiddhimuttamāmiha janmani ||76||
māyādoṣaiḥ kāmamānasvādairdagdhāśayastriyāḥ |
kṛtārthatā na vai syāddhi prāptau satyāmapi prabhoḥ ||77||
māyādoṣā nāśanīyā amāyikaprasevanaiḥ |
amāyiko hariḥ sākṣāttatsantaścāpyamāyikāḥ |||78|||
teṣāṃ samāgamāt tyājyā māyā ca māyikārayaḥ |
brahmabhūtayā vṛttyaṃ vai dāsyā kṛṣṇasya yoṣitā ||79||
na sthātavyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ cāpi vinā kārṣṇīṃ hi saṃgatim |
narākāre harau stheyaṃ sarvānandaprade prabhau ||4.9.80||
sādhuvākyāni saṃgṛhya vṛttyaṃ śrīparameśvare |
ahaṃmamate santyajya vartitavyaṃ mayā harau ||81 ||
kaṭhināni sadvacāṃsi hyapi grāhyāṇi sarvathā |
aguṇāḥ saṃvinaśyanti prasādāt paramātmanaḥ ||82||
durguṇāśca vinaśyanti satāṃ prasādanāttataḥ |
vṛttyaṃ tadagre niśchadmamanodehendriyādibhiḥ ||83||
sarvathā tatpriyaṃ kāryaṃ kāryaṃ naivāparādhanam |
aparāghe kvacijjāte prasādanīyāḥ sevanaiḥ ||84||
santo yasyāḥ prasannāḥ syustasyāḥ kālabhayaṃ nahi |
śreyaḥ paraṃ niścitaṃ ca tasyāḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||85||
jñānavatī brahmarūpā na bibheti kutaścana |
kṛtārthā kṛṣṇayogena mātarbhavati bhāminī ||86||
viśvastā śrīharau satsu na bibheti kutaścana |
anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsmītiniścitā ||87||
snigdhaprītimatī kṛṣṇe na bibheti kutaścana |
kṛṣṇa eva varastasyāḥ pātivratyaṃ harau sadā ||88||
hṛdaye’syā bhayaṃ nāsti kṛtārthāyā hareḥ śriyāḥ |
kṛṣṇasya vā satāṃ prītyai sarvaṃ jahyāddhi māyikam ||89||
rājyaṃ patiṃ ca bhogām̐śca gṛhaṃ kuṭumbinaḥ striyam |
na tasyāḥ kvāpi kimapi bhayaṃ tvanyat prajāyate ||4.9.90||
dikkariṇī madonmattā yathā tathaiva sā bhavet |
kṛṣṇagrahagṛhītātmā nānyadicchet kadācana ||9 1 ||
anenaiva hi dehena yāyāt sā paramāṃ gatim |
saṃskṛtā cāsaṃskṛtā vā bhagavaddhāma yāti sā ||92||
brahmadhāmādhipaḥ kṛṣṇo virahākṣamiṇāmiha |
sukhāyāyāti ca sukhayitvā nayati cākṣaram |||93|||
evaṃ sarveṣu cāṇḍeṣu bhaktasukhāya jāyate |
sukhayitvā sakhīn sakhīrnayatyakṣaradhāma saḥ ||94||
deveṣu jāyate kṛṣṇaḥ kvacidṛṣiṣu pitṛṣu |
kyacinnareṣu nārīṣu yādassu paśupakṣiṣu ||95||
yāvadarthaṃ vinirvartya mūlarūpaṃ vrajatyayam |
dvibhujaṃ tu nijaṃ rūpaṃ nrākṛti muktasevitam ||96||
bhaktecchayā kvacinnijecchayāpi bahubāhumān |
gṛhastho vā virakto vā jāyate puruṣottamaḥ ||97||
śreyomūrtiḥ sarvathaiva mātaḥ so’sti pareśvaraḥ |
bahurūpaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ mātastasya kṛpānidheḥ ||98||
dāsyo jānanti nānyāstu kṛṣṇasya cāntarātmanaḥ |
so’ntaryāmisvarūpeṇa sarvatrāste varaḥ prabhuḥ ||99||
tasmai samarpitā cāsmi mātaḥ kṛṣṇāya sarvathā |
kṛṣṇāśrayabalā cāhaṃ nānyaṃ patiṃ vṛṇomi vai || 4.9.1 00||
hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīkānta puruṣottama |
tvameva me patirnityastavāsmi śaraṇaṃ gatā || 10 1||
ityuktvā sā virarāma badrike bālayoginī |
sureśvarī ca mātāpi mahāścaryaparābhavat || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ sureśvarīviprāṇyai putrīrūpāyā badaryā bālayoginyā muktāyā brahmabhāvopadeśādiritinirūpaṇanāmā navamo’dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||

<4.10>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
tataḥ sureśvarī mātā punaḥ papraccha kanyakām |
kathaṃ prāpyeta bhagavān punarme vada vistarāt || 1 ||
ityuktā sā punaḥ prāha prasannā bālayoginī |
tatsarvaṃ te kathayāmi śṛṇu badrīrame hitam || 2 ||
mātaḥ prāpyo bhavet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tisevayā |
dāsyena snehapūreṇa tadarthārpaṇakarmabhiḥ || 3 ||
dehastasya kṛte kāryastadarthānīndriyāṇyapi |
tadarthaṃ mānasaṃ cāhaṃ cittaṃ buddhistadarthikā || 4 ||
kāmo modaḥ pramodaścotsavo mahastadarthakāḥ |
ramaṇaṃ svapanaṃ keliḥ sparśaḥ śayyā tadarthikāḥ || 5 ||
antaraṃ vā bahiścāpi rahasyaṃ ca tadarthakam |
guptaṃ prakāśaṃ sarvaṃ vā tadarthaṃ kāryamañjasā || 6 ||
tena labhyeta kamalākāntaḥ kāntatayā prabhuḥ |
mayā tadarthaṃ sarvaṃ vai kṛtaṃ cāharniśaṃ mama || 7 ||
miliṣyatīti bhagavān bhaktāyāḥ snehapāśavān |
bhagavantaṃ hṛdaye me paśyāmi saṃsmarāmi ca || 8 ||
śayane bhojane yāne mātaḥ paśyāmi taṃ manāk |
hasamānaṃ kvacit kāntaṃ cāhvayantaṃ nijāntike || 9 ||
ramamāṇaṃ rāmaye taṃ ramamāṇā hi tanmayī |
sa evaṃ me vyavasthāsu sahayukto vibhāvyate ||4.10.1 0||
nainaṃ tyaktvā paraṃ kaṃcit smarāmi mātaranvaham |
khānapānagatisthānaśayanaśravaṇādiṣu || 1 1||
tameva śrīprabhākāntaṃ praseve sahayoginī |
ramābhartuśca sādhūnāṃ kṛpayāhaṃ tathāvidhā ||12||
āhāraniyamaṃ prāptā nārāyaṇe parātmani |
ātmanaḥ saṃyamaṃ prāptā mālatīśe parātmani || 1 3||
etādṛśī sadā sādhyā kṛṣṇekāntikatā sthirā |
sarvābhiścāpi nārībhistadā mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ || 14||
brahmacaryavrataṃ tadvai yadvai brahmaṇi kāmanā |
brahmacaryavratenaiva dharmāḥ siddhyanti sarvaśaḥ || 15||
mukhyaṃ kāryaṃ kṛṣṇayogo nārīṇāṃ sarvadottamaḥ |
divyatāpādako mātarmokṣastena prajāyate || 16||
śrīkṛṣṇe kāntavṛttiryā parāvarttyā na sā kvacit |
poṣaṇīyā sādhusaṃgāt prayatnena hi yoṣitā ||17||
kṛṣṇasyārucikṛd yattat parāvṛttyaṃ drutaṃ khalu |
aprasādakaro bhāvastyājyo nisargajo’pi vai ||18||
nityaṃ sadanurodhena vartitavyaṃ suyoṣitā |
sā jāyate saṃgayogyā divyamuktipradāyinī ||19||
dehābhimānaṃ mānaṃ vā tyājyaṃ kṛṣṇāntike sadā |
evaṃvidhāyā bhaktāyā śreyaḥsiddhirbhavediha ||4.10.20||
satsaṃgastādṛśīnāryāḥ kartavyaḥ śreyasāmpradaḥ |
yā kṛṣṇe yojayet snigdhā saiva mātā pitā prabhuḥ ||21||
yā kṛṣṇaṃ smārayennaiva yojayenna pareśvare |
śreyohetuṃ bodhayenna śaithilyaṃ darśayeddharau ||22||
doṣān pradarśayet satsu śrīkṛṣṇe durguṇām̐stathā |
pātayed bhagavadyogāt sā saṃgārhā na sarvathā ||23||
tasyā vacanaṃ mānyaṃ na stheyaṃ sākaṃ tayā na ca |
nirayāṇāṃ pradātrī yā sā na mātā śubhāvahā ||24||
kṛṣṇaścyaveta yadvākyānmānyaṃ tasyā vaco nahi |
kutarkāścet hṛdaye’pi bhaveyuḥ kṛṣṇabādhakāḥ ||25||
tadā kṛṣṇasya satataṃ kartavyaṃ kīrtanaṃ śubham |
prārthanīyo’pi bhagavān dīnabandhurdayārṇavaḥ ||26||
hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa tavāsmi pāhi māmiha |
satāṃ nāmāni divyāni kīrtanīyāni vai tathā ||27||
ātmaniṣṭhā tathā kṛṣṇaniṣṭhā kāryā dṛḍhā sadā |
divyatā ca bhavecchreṣṭhā kutarkāṇāṃ vināśinī ||28||
kṛṣṇasyākārasaṃsphūrtiryathā syāt kāryameva tat |
yatra rūpe na vai kṛṣṇo draṣṭavyaṃ rūpameva na ||29||
yatra gandhe na vai kṛṣṇo ghrātavyo gandha eva na |
yatra sparśe na vai kṛṣṇaḥ spraṣṭavyaḥ sparśa eva na ||4.10.30||
yatrānande na vai kṛṣṇa ānandayitavya eva na |
yatra svāde na vai kṛṣṇa āsvādanīya eva na ||3 1||
yatra svāpe na vai kṛṣṇaḥ svapitavyaṃ na tatra ha |
yatra sthāne na vai kṛṣṇaḥ sthātavyaṃ tatra naiva ca ||32||
yatra veṣe harirnāsti veṣo viṣāyate mama |
yatra tattve na vai kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaṃ duḥkhāyate mama ||33||
īdṛgbhāvādisaṃsiddhyā kṛṣṇaḥ siddhyati kāntavat |
īdṛk śrīkṛṣṇayogena mātarmuktā bhavāmyaham ||34||
muktayā ca mayā nityaṃ sevyate parameśvaraḥ |
evaṃvidhā brahmavettrī paramāpnoti māpatim ||35||
bhaktyāśrayaṃ parabrahma pratyakṣaṃ puruṣottamam |
bhaktyā tvananyayā mātaścāpnoti kṛṣṇakāminī ||36||
pṛthivī strī sadā bodhyā bījapradaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ pārthivyo mādhavāṃganāḥ ||37||
akṣaraṃ cāvatārāśca muktā muktānikāstathā |
īśvarāśca surā māyā tattvāni cetanāstathā ||38||
śarīraṃ yasya kṛṣṇasya śarīraṃ tvaṃganātmakam |
sa kṛṣṇaḥ sarvatattvātmā sarvarūpapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||39||
puruṣottamarūpaḥ sa brahmapureśvaro naraḥ |
anantaiśvaryasampannaḥ sākṣāt sevyo’sti naḥ patiḥ ||4.10.40||
evaṃ jñānaṃ parajñānaṃ muktisādhanamuttamam |
pūrṇajñānavatī sā syāt kṛṣṇasyaiva hi kāminī ||41||
cāñcalyavarjitā syāt sā kṛṣṇetarasmin sarvathā |
kṛṣṇe netraṃ yojanīyaṃ tvak kṛṣṇe śrīrameśvare ||42||
hastapādāstathā kṛṣṇe yoktavyāḥ mādhavīśvare |
indriyāṇi samastāni yoktavyāni rameśvare ||43||
cāñcalyaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇe lagnaṃ sthirataraṃ bhavet |
śraddhāyāstāratamyena yatnaśaithilyayogataḥ ||44||
tāratamyaṃ sthiratve’pi harau bhaktasya saṃbhavet |
satsevāyāṃ parā śraddhā yasyāstasyā harāvapi ||45||
bhavatyeva na sandehaḥ sā divyā jāyate drutam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāstu satkathā muhuḥ ||46||
śrotavyāstābhirudayo bhakteḥ snehasya jāyate |
harau snigdhā hariṇyeva nārāyaṇī prajāyate ||47||
gāḍhaḥ sneho harau nityaviyogāsahanātmakaḥ |
jāyate yoṣito yasyāḥ sā svābhīṣṭaviyojane ||48||
prāṇān jahyād vinā kṛṣṇaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā viṣāyate |
vikalā jāyate kṛṣṇaṃ vinā saukhyaṃ labheta na |||45||
raktāsthimalamāṃsādibhṛteṣu sarvadehiṣu |
virāgabhāvamāpannā sthairyaṃ naiti hi kutracit ||4.10.50||
puruṣā durlabhā naiva śreyo’dhvaparipanthinaḥ |
saṃsārabhramadātāraḥ paratrātra ca duḥkhadāḥ ||51||
duṣpūrakāmāḥ sarvasvahartāro na hitāḥ pare |
bahujanmasu bhuktāste muhurjanmapradā narāḥ ||52||
eka eva hi satsaṃgaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo mokṣado mama |
taṃ vinā puttalaṃ sarvaṃ kathaṃ puttalamāśraye ||53||
ātmaniṣṭhāvatī nārī narekṣaṇānna muhyati |
nāpi kṣubhyati yuktātmā divyā kṛṣṇapriyā kvacit ||54||
ātmātmā nityasukhavān sa prāpyo mādhavīśvaraḥ |
ātmāhaṃ brahmarūpāsmi dāsyasmi vai prabhāpateḥ ||55||
brahmātmāsaṃkhyasakhībhiḥ sevitasya priyāsmyaham |
sa kṛṣṇo’sti narākāraḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||56||
evaṃvidhāyā bhaktāyā divyā dṛṣṭirvivardhate |
ato na svargabhogānāmicchāstasyāḥ pravartate ||57||
tadā laukikadehānāṃ bhogatṛṣṇā kutastarām |
etādṛśyā nityasādhvyā yoginyāḥ paramaṃ sukham ||58||
māyā tu duḥkharūpāsti hyabhaktāyāḥ kṛte sadā |
bhaktāyāstu kṛte kṛṣṇe sevāyāṃ puṣṭidā hi sā |||59||
bhaktāyāḥ sukhadā kṛṣṇayogadā divyatāpradā |
mokṣadāpi bhavatyeva kṛṣṇaprasādadāyinī ||4.10.60||
māyā bandhakarī yā vai hyabhaktānāṃ kṛte matā |
bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ sā tu bhaktipuṣṭikarī matā ||61||
dehena manasā vācārpaṇena kāmanādibhiḥ |
sevante yoṣitaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dehādyāstatra mokṣadāḥ ||62||
kṛṣṇaprasannatāprāptisādhanaṃ strīvapustataḥ |
prasādito gopikābhirmokṣado mādhavīśvaraḥ ||63||
tathā mayā prasādyo’yaṃ ramākṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ |
sarvātmākṣaranāthaśca kālakāleśvareśvaraḥ ||64||
yatra kṛṣṇācāryakānte vikalpo’nyo na jāyate |
nirvikalpā sthitiḥ sā vai sādhanīyā hi yoṣitā ||65||
naravat kāmabhāveṣu pravarteta prabhuryadi |
adhiko’pi pravarteta pravarteta tato’dhikaḥ ||66||
sarvaviṣayabhogeṣu pravarteta tato’tigaḥ |
sarvalokavigarhyeṣu tathāpi mādhavīśvare ||67||
śaṃkā yasyā na jāyeta divyatā utajāyate |
sarvakartari kṛṣṇe vai ghaṭate sarvakāraṇe ||68||
sarvameveti jānāti sevate sā haripriyā |
haristu vahnivad vyomavattathā lepavarjitaḥ ||69||
koṭiśvarāṇībhoktāpi koṭimuktānikāpatiḥ |
boddhavyaḥ sarvadā dhāmni rādhāprajñāramāpatiḥ ||4.10.70||
yaddivyaṃ bhagavaddhāma brahma cāmṛtamakṣaram |
tatra mayā prāpaṇīyaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāntaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ ||71 ||
evaṃvidhā mama prajñā pramā vikalpavarjitā |
śrīkṛṣṇe sarvadā cāstu svāmiśrīmativallabhe ||72||
evaṃ śiṣyā nirvikalpaniścayāḍhyā hariprayā |
kṛtakṛtyā nirbhayā ca kārṣṇī nārāyaṇī matā ||73||
kṛṣṇasampattiyuktādvai gurornijeṣṭasiddhayaḥ |
prajāyante tataḥ sevyo gururnārāyaṇasthitiḥ ||74||
gurorbalena śiṣyāpi kaniṣṭhotkṛṣṭatāṃ vrajet |
nirvikalpasthitiryasyāḥ sākṣātkṛṣṇapadāmbuje ||75 ||
sā naivākṛṣyate tvanyaiḥ kṛṣṇaśūnyaistaraṃgakaiḥ |
bhagavantaṃ prapannā yā na tvanyamānasā kvacit ||76||
sā māyāpāramāpannā brahmapriyā na saṃśayaḥ |
kṛṣṇe kṛṣṭaśarīrā sā jāyate puruṣottamī ||77||
kṛṣṇānande kṛṣṇapatnī bhūtvāśnute’tikāmanāḥ |
kṛṣṇasevāṃ tu samprāptā modate kṛṣṇakāntake ||78||
evaṃ mātarmahānārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ bhajāmyaham |
dāsī bhūtvāṅganārūpā seve śrīvallabham prabhum ||79||
arucirbhūyasī me’sti kṛṣṇahīne tu vastuni |
atastu māyike tyāge sadāsti vai rucirmama ||4.10.80||
satsu prītirharau prītirnaisargikī mamāsti ca |
śrīkṛṣṇe vallabhe sarvasvāmini rucirasti me ||81||
nityaṃ maṃgalamūrtirvai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhu |
avatārī samastāvirbhāvānāṃ parameśvaraḥ ||82||
paritaścāntare bāhye so’yaṃ kānto mayekṣyate |
divyo divyaguṇāgāraḥ sākāro divyabhūṣaṇaḥ ||83||
koṭimuktānikākāntaścātitejaḥprapūritaḥ |
divyalāvaṇyamādhuryaujjvalyaśītalatānvitaḥ ||84||
divyacandanapuṣpādyairarcito brahmaśaktibhiḥ |
atiprītyā vīkṣamāṇo māṃ kaṭākṣeṇa harṣakṛt ||85||
pratikṣaṇaṃ cekṣyate’yaṃ navo navo hariḥ patiḥ |
tatra bhaktirmama mātarniṣkāmā niścalā sadā ||86||
putre dhane striyāṃ kānte iva sneho harau mama |
evaṃ satsu hareścāpi prema sāhajikaṃ mam ||87||
teṣāṃ kīrtanavelāyāṃ mano me tatra dhāvati |
śrīkṛṣṇe vallabhācārye gopīnāṃ vallabhe prabhau ||88||
tārābhe tvātmahṛdaye vidyudābhe’nalaprabhe |
vāḍavābhe mahātejonibhe cātmani me dhavaḥ ||89||
mamānandapradaścāste brahmānandapravarṣakaḥ |
sarvānandapradaścāste tādātmyena sadā mayi ||4.10.90||
nirāvaraṇarūpāhaṃ paśyāmi svāminaṃ mayi |
mahāmodapradaṃ śuddhaṃ pūrṇaṃ paśyāmi matparam ||9 1||
etādṛśyā mama mātarmāyārāgo na vidyate |
nairguṇye vartamānāyāḥ kuto vai guṇalepanā ||92||
kuto’tra vāsanāścāpi kutaḥ karmāśayāstathā |
kutaḥ kośā bhautikāśca kuta saṃgo vināśinām ||93||
kuto drohaśca bhaktānāṃ kuto doṣekṣaṇaṃ satām |
kuto’haṃmamatāsparśaḥ kuto bhedādi kalmaṣam ||94||
kuto mānaṃ sarvadoṣanikaraṃ satsu māpatau |
rādhāramaṇayogena mātardivyaṃ samastakam ||95||
vidyate me śarīraṃ ca śārīro’pi susevakaḥ |
etādṛśīnāṃ muktānāmanyāsāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām ||96||
mātarbhavāmi pattrāṇā rajodhūlyādidhūsarā |
bhṛtyā dāsī preṣyadharmā dīnā ca sevikāpi ca ||97||
evaṃ māhātmyapānā ca matiḥ kṛṣṇāccalennahi |
nāsyā duṣyati dāsītvaṃ kṛpāvedī tu sā hareḥ ||98||
nāsyāḥ patanaṃ dāsītvāt kṛṣṇakāntātvataḥ kvacit |
sā śaktiḥ syāt parābrāhmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī priyā ||99||
tasyā bhayād vāti vātastapatyarko’pi tadbhayāt |
meghāḥ ṛtūnāśrayanti tasyā bhayāt sadāmbare || 4.10.1 00||
abdhistiṣṭhati velāyāṃ bhayāttasya dhruvaḥ sthiraḥ |
lokapālāstathā mṛtyuḥ kālo māyā ca tadbhayāt || 101 ||
vartante nijakāryeṣu yathāyuktā yathāyatham |
etādṛśī mahāśaktirjāyate sā hariśritā || 1 02||
tamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālanandanam |
prāptāsmyanādikāntaṃ śrīpatiṃ śrīkāntavallabham || 1 03||
tathā varteta yā nārī prāpnuyāttaṃ patiṃ prabhum |
tvaṃ mātastaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ prāpnuhi śrīprasevitam ||1 04||
ityuktvā virarāmāpi sā kanyā bālayoginī |
sureśvarī dadhārāpi hṛdaye badarīśvari ||1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ sureśvaryai bhagavatprāptisthitiprabhṛtibālayoginyuktamityādinirūpaṇanāmā daśamo’dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

<4.11>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
badrīpriye śṛṇu tvaṃ ca tato devī sureśvarī |
papraccha dāsyaṃ kanyāyai kiṃvidhaṃ tad vadāmi te || 1 ||
dāsyaṃ dānamayaṃ sarvamātmadānaṃ mahattaram |
sukhadānaṃ manodānaṃ buddhidānaṃ tu śārṅgiṇe || 2 ||
cittadānaṃ mānadānaṃ sarvendriyapradānakam |
prāṇadānaṃ dehadānaṃ dāsyaṃ sarvapradānakam || 3 ||
mātastvevaṃ dāsikā yā brahmapriyā tu sā matā |
etādṛśīṃ parāṃ dāsīṃ mānavaścāmaro’pi vā || 4 ||
cālayituṃ samartho na kṛṣṇakāntāt pathāntare |
dāsyāścaivaṃvidhāyāstu bhayaṃ manāṅ na vidyate || 5 ||
dāsī sā devadevasya śrīpateḥ padminīpateḥ |
yathā tathā satāṃ dāsī prajñāvad bālayoginī || 6 ||
dhanyeyaṃ yā satāṃ yogaṃ hareryogaṃ ca vindate |
naraṃ kāntaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sevate bālayoginī || 7 ||
siddhaṃ kārya bhavet| tasyā mātardāsyaṃ cidambare |
yadatrānubhūyamānaṃ vikāsate’kṣare pade || 8 ||
tadrūpaṃ caitadevāpi svasiddhaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
śreyase cobhayaṃ rūpaṃ tathānantāni yānyapi || 9 ||
saccidānandarūpāṇi lāvaṇyasaṃbhṛtānyapi |
divyaiśvaryapūritāni sarvālaṃkāravanti ca || 4.11.1 0||
koṭikāmasurūpāṇi cānantataijasāni hi |
naikaśaktikalāvanti sarvāntaryamanāni ca || 1 1||
anantakoṭirādhāśrīlakṣmīkṣāsukhamuttamam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanesti ve || 12||
sa kāryārthaṃ bahūnyeva dhatte rūpāṇi mādhavaḥ |
yathopayogaṃ yojayitvā tirodhāpayati prabhuḥ || 13||
indriyātmā ca devātmā viṣayātmā samīkṣyate |
māyikairna tu divyairvai dāsyaṃ prāptairhi dehibhiḥ || 14||
māyāmayīcchayā līlā nārāyaṇasya sāsti hi |
sarvā kalyāṇarūpā sā divyadhāmapradā hi sā || 15||
narākāre bhāvanā sā divyā dāsītvabodhinī |
narākāreṣu yā satsu divyā sā bhāvanottamā || 16||
kṛṣṇavat sarvathā kāryā kṛṣṇadāsitvabodhikā |
nārīṣvapi ca sādhvīṣu divyā sā bhāvanottamā || 17||
kartavyā sarvadā mātardāsitvabodhikā tathā |
brahmapriyātvaṃ cāpyeta tayā sarvordhvayā tataḥ || 18||
evaṃ bhāvanayā yuktaṃ dāsyaṃ pūrṇaṃ prakāśate |
saṃsādhyaivaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ labhate nānyathā || 19||
dāsyāḥ kṛṣṇa indriyāṇi divyāni vidadhāti vai |
kṛṣṇayogena saugandhyaṃ divyaṃ dehe prajāyate ||4.11.20||
kṛṣṇayogena ca nityaṃ nirāvaraṇatā bhavet |
kṛṣṇayogena cānandapūrṇatāharniśaṃ bhavet ||21||
uttamāḥ sarvaviṣayāḥ kṛṣṇayogena kṛṣṇavat |
jāyante śāntaye mātarniratyayāstathāvyayāḥ ||22||
asaṃkhyasṛṣṭināthasya sukhordhvaṃ tvākṣaraṃ sukham |
tato’nantaguṇaṃ kṛṣṇakāntasya sukhamuttamam ||23||
brahmādyā īśvarāstasyāntike raṃkajanā iva |
bhavanti sarvathā mātastaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi dhārayet ||24||
pūrṇānandanidhestveke sukhaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyate |
na dūre tādṛśaṃ cāste tasmāt kṛṣṇe’rpitā bhavet ||25||
evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇamūrtibhūryānandapariplutā |
jātāsmi te kṛpayātra mātardāsyaṃ bhajāmi ca ||26||
tādātmyānubhavenaiva kṛṣṇakānto’dhibhujyate |
nairguṇyabhāvamāpannā sevate yā tu dāsikā ||27||
sevinaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ taṃ labhate sā nijānvitam |
mahānandapradaṃ sarvabhogatṛptipradaṃ prabhum ||28||
alpāpi kṛṣṇakāntārthā yasyā buddhiḥ kriyāpi ca |
sā divyā brahmaśaktyākhyā sarvasiddhipravarṣiṇī ||29||
nirguṇā kṛṣṇasambandhād divyākṣayākṣarābhidhā |
darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ śravaṇādi ca ||4.11.30 ||
svapanaṃ ramaṇaṃ dāsyamāśleṣaṇaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ |
kṛṣṇasyaiva sadā mātaḥ kāryaṃ dāsyā na cetarat ||31||
nānyatra preraṇīyāni dehendriyāṇi sarvathā |
viśvastāni kṛṣṇayogāt pātayanti hi yoginīm ||32||
hare kṛṣṇa priyākṛṣṇa mādhavīkṛṣṇa sevikām |
dāsīṃ māṃ rakṣaya cānyāt prārthayet parameśvaram ||33||
evaṃ samprārthitaḥ kṛṣṇakānto rakṣati dāsikām |
brahmāṇḍe tādṛśo nāsti yādṛśaḥ kṛṣṇasadvaraḥ ||34||
akṣare brahmaṇi svīye rājate yo’tra vidyate |
divyābhiḥ śaktibhirdivyapārṣadaiḥ sevitaḥ prabhuḥ ||35||
rādhāramādibhirbhaktyā sevyate puruṣottamaḥ |
brahmāṇḍādhisvāmibhiśca prārthyate’ṇḍāgamāya saḥ ||36||
kṛpayā sa bālakṛṣṇastvāvirbhavati tatra tu |
devamānavapaśvādau karoti tanmayīṃ kriyām ||37||
yugānurūpaṃ svāyuṣyaṃ dadhāti parameśvaraḥ |
balaṃ sāmarthyamevāpi dehaṃ cāpi yathāyugam ||38||
guṇā doṣāśca dṛśyante divyā eva harau tu te |
hitaṃ bhavennṛṇāṃ yadvad vartate sa tathā bhuvi ||39||
sajātīyaprasaṃgaṃ sa dadātyeva tathābhavan |
tejaḥ saṃkocayitvaiva mānavaḥ san pravartate ||4.11.40||
divye tatra nātiprītirmānavānāṃ yato bhavet |
tejasāṃ cāsahā lokāḥ saumanasyaṃ na yanti hi ||41||
kvacit kāryavaśānmātarmahaiśvaryaṃ dadhāti saḥ |
pradarśayati bhaktebhyaḥ punarlīnaṃ karoti tat ||42||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
gopālanandano mātaḥ sarvāvatāradhṛk sa hi ||43||
tasyāśraye bhaved bhaktānikā sadākutobhayā |
śarkarārasamūrtirvai yathaikatāttvikī bhavet ||44||
tathaikatattve śrīkānte saccidānandadhāmani |
parabrahmaṇi me mātastādātmyaṃ vidyate’dhunā ||45||
yathā vahniḥ praviṣṭo vai tvayogole vilokyate |
na lokyate’yogolastu tathā mātarmayi prabhuḥ ||46||
lokyate paśya sarveśaṃ nāhaṃ dṛṣṭipathāsmi hi |
aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ cāhaṃ vyāptā mahātmanā ||47||
cidānandena kṛṣṇena yatra tyājyaṃ na vidyate |
evaṃvettrī parābrāhmī jñeyā sā brahmavittamā ||48||
prāptā nirvikalpabhāvaṃ sthitaprajñātinirbhayā |
aikāntikīṃ sthitiṃ prāptā kṛṣṇe nirodhitāṃ gatā ||49||
narākṛtau harau jātā dṛḍhasnehānubandhinī |
snehamayī sadā bhaktā nirvikalpā matā sakhī ||4.11.50||
matiḥ kṛṣṇe dṛḍhā yasyāḥ kārṣṇī sā kṛtamokṣaṇā |
vikalpaiḥ saha yoddhavyaṃ nirvikalpecchayā sadā ||51||
ayudhyamānā viṣayairākṛṣyate patatyapi |
sarveśvaraṃ viditvāpi yeśvareśaṃ tyajatyapi ||52||
sā bhaved drohiṇī patyau kṛṣṇe kānte prabheśvare |
evaṃ drohavidhātryāṃ vai kṛṣṇo naiva prasīdati ||53||
kālaṃ karma svabhāvaṃ vā māyāṃ vetti tukāraṇam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hitvā sā bhaved drohiṇī hareḥ ||54||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe muktā brahma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe santi hyavatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ |55||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sarvāḥ śaktayaśca tapāṃsi ca |
aiśvaryāṇi makhāścamatkārāḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||56||
devā lokāśca gatayaḥ santi kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe |
sṛṣṭayaśca samastā vai santi kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ||57||
paraṃ tattvaṃ priyaṃ kāntaṃ viduryā jñānasāgarā |
sā vettrī śrīkṛṣṇadāsau brahmī sā brahmavittamā ||58||
evaṃvidhāyāṃ bhaktāyāṃ bhavet kṛṣṇaprasannatā |
snehātiśayamāptāyāṃ guṇāḥ sarve vasanti hi ||59||
māhātmyajñānayugbhaktā bhavedekāntinī prabhau |
satāṃ sevāprasaṃgena kṛṣṇe bhaktiḥ prajāyate ||4.11.60||
manovāktanubhiḥ sevyāḥ santaḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpiṇaḥ |
sevātmakena dharmeṇa sādhanena kṛtena vai ||61 ||
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavedatra kartavyaṃ śiṣyate nahi |
satāṃ yogena bhagavān bahiścāntaḥ prakāśate ||62||
pataṃgavat svayaṃ kṛṣṇastasyā vṛttimayo bhavet |
ānandaṃ paramaṃ tena yāti mātarharerhi sā ||63 ||
dhṛtasya śuddhakāntasya hṛdi cātmani cākṣare |
harermāyā sneharūpā sukhayatyeva tāṃ satīm ||64||
pratyakṣe bhagavatkānte rasalīnā prajāyate |
kāntā kāntaṃ samāśliṣya brahmānande pramodate ||65||
nimajjati mahānande pare brahmaṇi svāmini |
guṇātīte mahānande premarasaṃ pibatyapi ||66||
māyātītaṃ patiṃ prāpya māyātītā prajāyate |
harau lagnā hariṃ yāti mocayatyeva tāṃ hariḥ ||67||
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prapannāyāḥ kamalātvaṃ prajāyate |
yadyat sukhamabhīṣṭaṃ syādasyāḥ sarvaṃ pravarṣati ||68||
prapannāyā prapattirvai harermithaḥ prajāyate |
mithaścaikāntikatāpi bhaktāyāścācyutasya ca ||69||
muktavat sarvakarmāṇi mithastayorbhavanti hi |
evaṃvidhāyāṃ bhaktāyāṃ mātaḥ satyayugasya tu ||4.11.70||
sarve dharmāḥ pravartante saṃkalpāḥ satyasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
mānasyastatra sarvā vai sṛṣṭayaśceṣṭadāyikāḥ ||71||
bhavanti kṛtakṛtyāyāṃ kṛṣṇayogena kṛṣṇavat |
kṛpālurbhagavān kṛṣṇaścaudāryaṃ vitaratyapi ||72||
mayā sarvavarṣmavatāṃ kartavyaṃ śreya uttamam |
evaṃ kṛpāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā narānnārīrnapuṃsakān ||73||
paśūn drumān pakṣiṇaścoddhārayatyeva yogadaḥ |
api śatrūn rākṣasām̐śca daityānuddhārayatyapi ||74||
pāpasthān strīsamudāyān bhogenoddhārayatyapi |
pāpāḥ prasaṃgamāsādya divyā muktā bhavanti hi ||75||
sarvatattvāni kṛṣṇasya cānupraveśato drutam |
brahmatāṃ yānti māyāpi prayātyakṣarabhāvatām ||76||
netravṛttiḥ sthūlabhāvā raśmirūpāpi taijasī |
bhautikyapi harau lagnā brahmabhāvamupaiti sā ||77||
ataḥ sā nirguṇā bhūtvā brahmaprakāśikā bhavet |
kṛṣṇākārā mahānandasukhamodapariplutā ||78||
kṛṣṇe sā līyate divye tvātmāśnute sukhaṃ tu tat |
evaṃ bhūtvā kṛṣṇarūpā kṛṣṇānandaṃ samaśnute ||79||
mahābhāgavataṃ mātaḥ sukhaṃ kṛṣṇāt prapadyate |
samādhau divyanetrāptaṃ kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ śubham ||4.11.80||
kṣaṇaṃ labdhamapi syāttat sahasrābdakṛtaṃ yathā |
akhaṇḍaṃ nirguṇaṃ pūrṇabrahmānandabhṛtaṃ sukham ||81 ||
bhaktābhiḥ śāśvataṃ vyavasthāsu kṛṣṇe’nubhūyate |
narākāre prabhau kṛṣṇe nṛpe vā sādhurūpiṇi ||82||
antaḥsthe divyarūpe vā tat sukhaṃ tvanubhūyate |
tasya kṛpālayāḥ santo mileyusteṣu cānvaham ||83||
snehavṛttyā sevayāpi tādṛśaṃ sukhamāpyate |
gurormūrteḥ paraṃ divyaṃ sukhaṃ tu sevayāpyate ||84||
gurordrohaḥ satāṃ drohaḥ kṛṣṇadroho vināśakṛt |
guroḥ sevā satāṃ sevā kṛṣṇasevākṣarapradā ||85||
drogdhurbhavet kṛmikīṭaśilākāṣṭhādrilokatā |
yatra mokṣārthayogo na tasmād drohaṃ vivarjayet ||86||
mānaṃ vivarjayeccāpi bhaktāgre kṛṣṇasannidhau |
mānaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ cāsti mahāsurapadasya vai ||87||
āsuratvaṃ nirayāya jāyate dveṣakāritam |
tena mānaṃ nayatyeva nirayādhvani sarvathā ||88||
māninastu harau sādhau kalpayantyaguṇān muhuḥ |
āpakārṣṭyakhyāpanārthaṃ tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim ||89||
mānadveṣādināśārthaṃ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
kṛṣṇābhinnāḥ sādhavaste pāvayantyapi dūṣitān ||4.11.90||
sādhau snehaḥ paraḥ kāryo yena doṣo na codbhavet |
snigdhe doṣo bhavennaiva guṇagrāho bhavet sadā ||9 1 ||
satāṃ guṇagraheṇaiva kṛṣṇaguṇagraho bhavet |
brahmātmadarśanaṃ tena sākṣāddhareśca darśanam ||92||
sarvadā yaugalaṃ bhāvaṃ hariṇā saha vindate |
nāsyā nyūnaṃ bhavet sakhyāḥ sakhyuḥ patyuḥ samarjanāt ||93||
anantakoṭisūryenduvahnividyutsamaprabham |
akṣarasthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sā labhate sakhī ||94||
pṛthvyāṃ sthitaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ sā labhate sakhī |
mahāvīryaṃ mahārūpaṃ mahāśaktiprapūritam ||95||
ānandānāṃ mahāvārdhi kāntaṃ sā labhate sakhī |
muktibījāni sarvāṇi labhate kṛṣṇakāntataḥ ||96||
divyonmattā vartate sā manute svakṛtārthatām |
tasyā darśanakartṝṇāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ vacasāmapi ||97||
muktirdivyākṣaradhāmni bhaved yāntyakṣaraṃ hi te |
mātaścaivaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||98||
prāptāsmi sarvahṛdayaṃ kṛtakṛtyāsmi sarvathā |
na me kṛṣṇādṛte kaścit saṃsāro mānamarhati ||99||
madvidhā śrīpatiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śrībadarīśvaram |
yā bhajiṣyati bhaktānī muktānī sā bhaviṣyati || 4.11.1 00||
evamuktvā virarāma kṣaṇaṃ sā bālayoginī |
badrīpriye punaḥ sā ca mātaraṃ prāha vacmi tat || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ dāsyena nārāyaṇīsvarūpatāprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

<4.12>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
pārvatike śṛṇu badrīpriye ca bālayoginī |
sāha mātre dharmabhṛtaṃ vartanaṃ śīlayoṣitām || 1 ||
yā satī śrīpatiṃ prāpya vartate sā vadhūriti |
sarvasvārpaṇaśīlā ca kṛṣṇadharmā matā hi sā || 2 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ nijaṃ dehaṃ tathā sarvendriyāṇyapi |
ekīkṛtyāntaḥkaraṇairabhinnā jāyate sadā || 3 ||
ākṛṣṭā śrīpatau nityaṃ loṣṭhaṃ vai cumbake yathā |
tathā jāyeta magnā vai samādhau ca nimajjati || 4 ||
tatra koṭyarkabhāvyāptaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ samīkṣate |
kṛṣṇābhinnasvarūpā sā yogasiddhā tapasvinī || 5 ||
bahurūpadharā divyā jāyate bālayoginī |
śṛṇoti dhāmaśabdān sā brahmāṇḍāni ca paśyati || 6 ||
tathā svābhāvikānantaiśvaryāḍhyā jāyate sadā |
yatra dātuṃ samicchet svadarśanaṃ svecchayā tu sā || 7 ||
tatra tatrāvirbhavati kṛṣṇavat kṛṣṇakāminī |
yathā kṛṣṇastathā kārṣṇī vyāpinī jāyate parā || 8 ||
tasyā yogāt kupātraṃ yā nārī kṛṣṇātirekiṇī |
vimukhāpi bhavet sadyaḥsamādhisthā kṛpākṛṇāt || 9 ||
vimucyate sadya eva sevayā kṛṣṇayoṣitām |
mahāpāpānmucyate’pi sādhvīsevāparāyaṇā || 4.12.1 0||
atipuṇyavatī bodhyā tīrtharūpā hi sādhvikā |
sādhvīsaṃyogamāpannā sādhvī satī prajāyate || 1 1||
daivīyogād bhaved daivī divyā muktānikā satī |
anugraho’sti daivītve hetuḥ sādhvyāḥ kuyoṣiti || 1 2||
sevayā sādhavaḥ sādhvyastoṣaṇīyāḥ sadā tviha |
prasādanīyāḥ sarvadānaiśca mokṣapradā yataḥ || 1 3||
kṛṣṇamado hi sādhūnāṃ bhaktisnehamado’pi ca |
tanmadenāśritāṃ sādhvīṃ madayanti hi sādhavaḥ || 14||
kṛṣṇadhyānaikahṛdayāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe ratāḥ |
kṛṣṇe cānyān veśayanti kārṣṇān kurvanti sarvathā || 15||
kṛṣṇetaraṃ sarvasṛṣṭisukhaṃ necchanti sādhavaḥ |
mamāpi mātaḥ kṛṣṇasya sukhaṃ prarocate’nvaham || 16||
tadanyannirayaistulyaṃ bhāsate duḥkhamulbaṇam |
yatra nāsti prabhākāntastatra duḥkhaṃ hi māyikam || 17||
yatrāsti mādhavīsvāmī tatrānando hi śāśvataḥ |
jitendriyatā sā mātaḥ kṛṣṇe yadindriyasthitiḥ || 18||
yāvadarthaṃ praseveta kṛṣṇānvitaṃ jitendriyā |
kṛṣṇasya bahudhā bhaktyā tasyā dināni yānti vai || 19||
nivṛttidharmaniratā sā kṛṣṇārthapravṛttikā |
niḥsaṃgā pramadā cāste badhyate na hariṃ vinā ||4.12.20||
haryājñayā kriyāyāṃ sā vartamānāpi nirguṇā |
nirvikārā bāhyarūpe jaḍevāntastu sanmatiḥ ||21||
kṛṣṇatadbhaktasambandhipravṛttau niratā hi sā |
nivṛttidharmiṇī saiva bhaktiyuktā ca muktigā ||22||
kṛṣṇamṛte kriyā sarvā cāstyadhogatidāyinī |
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvā tyāginī cottamā hi sā ||23||
pravṛttau vartamānāyāḥ kṛṣṇārthāṃ ca satāṃ kṛte |
hareḥ kṛpāpātrikāyāḥ kriyā na bandhadāyinī ||24||
iṣṭaḥ patistu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
rādhāprajñāpāśavatībadrīlakṣmīramāpatiḥ ||25||
akṣare cāpi goloke vaikuṇṭhe badarīvane |
vartate śrīmahārājaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ||26||
sa evānantakoṭyaṇḍasargasthityantakārakaḥ |
vāsudevādirūpaḥ saḥ keśavādisvarūpadhṛk||27||
pratyakṣaḥ sa narākāraḥ koṭyarbudābjaśaktidhṛk |
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vai bālakṛṣṇo virājate ||28||
badaryāṃ śrīnaranārāyaṇaḥ so’pi virājate |
tasya śaktiḥ śīlasādhvī saivāsti bālayoginī ||29||
tasyā dharmā mama dharmā mātarviddhi sadā śubhāḥ |
narākṛterbhagavato līlāḥ śravyā hi mokṣadāḥ ||4.12.3 0||
kāmakrodhādibhāvena yena kena bhayādinā |
snehena svārthabhāvena kṛṣṇaṃ prāptā hi nirguṇāḥ ||3 1||
nirguṇaṃ janmakarmādi caritre śrīpateḥ prabhoḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasparśo’pi nirguṇaḥ ||32||
viditvā nirguṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yātyakṣaraṃ padam |
kṛṣṇalīlāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktairākṛṣṭaidivyatāṃ gataiḥ ||33||
vidhātavyāḥ smaraṇārthaṃ bādhikā yā na dehinām |
lokānāṃ darśanārthaṃ vai sphūrtyarthaṃ bhaktiśālinām ||34||
pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ dhyānārthaṃ snehināṃ tathā |
idaṃkārasmaraṇārthaṃ līlāḥ kāryā hareranu ||35||
nāṭakādi prakartavyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktivivardhakam |
yathākathañcijjīvānāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktirbhaviṣyati || 36||
gurogauṃravabodhārthaṃ bhartavyaṃ supradarśanam |
vidheyadarśanaṃ cāpi yojanīyaṃ harerapi ||37||
evaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇalagnacittānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
pṛthivyāṃ naradehānāṃ sārthakyaṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ||38||
kṛṣṇalīlādarśanena jāyate śreya ityapi |
kṛṣṇastasya bhaktimanto bhaktāḥ śreyaskarāstu ye ||39||
teṣāṃ divyacamatkāralīlāḥ kāryā janairbhuvi |
mumukṣūṇāṃ yathā bhaktirvivardheta viśeṣataḥ ||4.12.40||
vivekena śarīrādau nispṛhatvaṃ yathā bhavet |
ekasmin śrīpatau sārarūpe svātmā yathā laget ||41 ||
saccidānandarūpasya harerdāsyaṃ yathā bhavet| |
tyāgo bhaktirdivyatā ca bhaveyuśca yathā sadā ||42||
tathā kṛṣṇacaritrāṇi tvanukāryāṇi nānyathā |
darśanaiḥ spārśanairbhāvairmuktiḥ syād dehināṃ yataḥ ||43||
brahmībhūtāśca divyāṃgāste na yānti punarbhave |
āvirbhavanti celloke svātantryeṇa harīcchayā ||44||
teṣāṃ tu viṣayā divyā bhavanti bhagavanmayāḥ |
vartante te prahitvaiva dehatrayasya bhāvanām ||45||
saccidānandarūpe sve cintayanti hariṃ patim |
harerbalāttu teṣāṃ vai hṛtyu copaśamasthitiḥ ||46||
vartate’to na viṣayāḥ praveṣṭuṃ tatra vai kṣamāḥ |
ye tvāyānti bhavantyeva divyāste bhagavanmayā |||47|||
kṛṣṇasya ca satāṃ sevāparā divyā tathā bhavet |
sthitiṃ copaśamākhyāṃ ca labhate śrīpatau sadā |
vivekinyāṃ tu dāsyāṃ vai prīyante sutarāṃ hi te ||48||
prīṇanāttu satāṃ sādhvyā nopasargā bhavanti hi |
ātmano divyatāṃ jñātvā modate sā narāyaṇī ||49||
ātmaniṣṭhā tathā mātaḥ kṛṣṇaniṣṭhā tu dehinaḥ |
pakṣau dvāvambare gantuṃ cidākāśe hi cetanau ||4.12.50||
vijñānaṃ sneha evaitau parameśaprasañjakau |
snehaḥ svapne suṣuptau ca turyāyāṃ kṛṣṇayojakaḥ ||51||
pātivratyaṃ vinā naiva mātaḥ kṛṣṇo’nusajjate |
dāsyaṃ vinā na vai kṛṣṇo dāsīṃ gṛhṇāti vakṣasi ||52||
dāsyaṃ tu sarvathā cājñākaraṃ kintu nijārthakam |
pātivratyaṃ tu kṛṣṇasyārthakaṃ svārthavivarjitam ||53||
dāsyācchreṣṭhaṃ pātivratyaṃ patyarthaṃ sarvathārpaṇam |
tadadhīnatvamevedaṃ patnīva gṛhabandhanam ||54||
dāsyaṃ yāvanmano magnaṃ tāvat snehāt pravartate |
mano viyuktaṃ ced dāsyā dāsītvaṃ vigamāyate ||55||
ato vadhvā vadhūṭītvaṃ pātivratyaṃ praśasyate |
sarvasādhanamūrdhanyaṃ svāmivrataṃ praśasyate ||56||
hareḥ prasannatāprāptyai hareḥ prāptyai tu yoṣitā |
āntaraṃ dīyate lakṣmīpataye tu yayā tayā ||57||
prāpta eva hariḥ kāntaḥ sādhitaśca nijīkṛtaḥ |
āntaraṃ sarvathā dānaṃ svāmitāmarjayatyanu ||58||
svāmitvaṃ durlabhaṃ mātaḥ kṛṣṇe prākṛtayoṣitām |
svāminītvaṃ tu sutarāmapuṇyāyā na jāyate ||59||
māṇikītvaṃ ca rādhātvaṃ lakṣmītvaṃ badarītvakam |
akṣare cāpi goloke vaikuṇṭhe badarīvane ||4.12.60||
bahusnehena kṛṣṇasya parayā kṛpayārjyate |
bhaktiryathā parokṣe vai deve bhavati dehinām ||61||
tathā sākṣāddharau kānte gurau kāryā hi yoṣitā |
tasyāḥ sarve prasiddhyanti divyādyarthā hi śāśvatāḥ ||62||
satāṃ yogāddhareryogād guroryogāt punaḥ punaḥ |
prāptavyaṃ labhyate sarvaṃ paraṃ padaṃ kṛtārthatā ||63||
sneho’sti madhunā tulyaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛṣṇe tu mokṣadaḥ |
kṛṣṇayogena kāminyāḥ sanmātraṃ brahma bhāsate ||64||
ātmā brahmatvamāpnoti kāmanā nāvaśiṣyate |
abhyāsavaśataḥ kṛṣṇe brahmaṇi brahmatāṃ vrajet ||65|||
brahmībhūtāyāstu patnyāḥ kṛṣṇe kārṣṇeṣu cānvaham |
sneharasaḥ pravarteta sauhārdaṃ ca pramodanam ||66||
harerguṇākṛṣṭacittāḥ śrīrlakṣmīḥ mādhavī priyā |
māṇikyā rādhikā badrī kurvanti haritoṣaṇam ||67||
harerdayānidheryogāddhariṇyastāḥ sadābhavan |
hareḥ satāṃ sevayā tā nārāyaṇyo’bhavan sadā ||68||
nāsāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā cānyad rocate bhayadaṃ na ca |
nārāyaṇīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ vaśe sarvaṃ pravartate ||69||
etādṛśyastu yā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇakānte śamaṃ gatāḥ |
kṛṣṇasaṃyogadārḍhyena yātāstāḥ paramāṃ gatim ||4.12.70||
yānti tathākṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃ sarvārthapūrakam |
prākṛtā api dehinyaḥ kimu dāsyādiśobhanāḥ ||71||
dehe tvātmātmani śrīśo vartate puruṣottamaḥ |
bhaktāyāḥ paramaṃ prītiṃ vīkṣya bahiḥ sa vartate ||72||
dadātyānandamutkṛṣṭaṃ nijasaṃgamasaṃbhavam |
ramate ramayatyeva cāśliṣyannijamūrtikam ||73||
snehamāhātmyasaṃvyāptā sevā vighnairna hīyate |
pātivratyaṃ kathaṃ nityādhīnaṃ tvabhibhaved dṛḍham ||74||
tannāmasmaraṇāt tasya kīrtanāttasya saṃsmṛteḥ |
tatpraṇāmāttasya saṃgāttasya sparśāttadaṃkanāt ||75||
tadaṃśadhāraṇāttasya śayyāvāsāttadanvayāt |
taddarśanāttadramaṇāt śvādāpi savanāyate ||76||
gaṇikāpi tasya saṃgānmuktāsu gaṇanāyate |
kiṃ punaḥ pātivratyena dāsyena sevikā vadhūḥ ||77||
aho śvādā pramākṛṣṇa nāmayuktā garīyasī |
aho tapāṃsi yajñāśca tīrthāni ca vratāni ca ||78||
kṛṣṇakāntasya nānaiva caritārthāni sarvaśaḥ |
hareḥ sarveśvarasyaiva nāmnā nirbhayatā bhavet ||79 ||
dehināṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetigṛhṇatāṃ bhīrnivartate |
sevayā pādamūle vai viśatyeṣākutobhaye ||4.12.80||
mahatāṃ sevayā kṛṣṇe praveṣṭuṃ kṣaṇa āpyate |
sakāmāpekṣayā mātarniṣkāmāyā mahatsukham ||81||
kṛṣṇārthaṃ tu sakāmāpi niṣkāmā parikīrtitā |
ananyabhaktā sādhvīyaṃ kṛṣṇetaranna vāñchati |||82|||
śreyase sā hariṃ prāptā tato hariḥ prasīdati |
śreyo’rthayā subhaktyā śrīharistūrṇaṃ prasīdati ||83||
sākṣātkṛṣṇe prasanne siddhyanti sarvamanorathāḥ |
sukhado nijabhaktānāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kārṣṇā na cetarāḥ ||84||
ataścātmamatiḥ kāryā kṛṣṇe kārṣṇeṣu sarvathā |
tatpārśvaṃ sarvathā grāhyaṃ rakṣyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ nijaṃ yathā ||85 ||
soḍhavyaṃ svāpamānādi mṛtyurvā pārśvarakṣiṇā |
teṣu prītirviśeṣeṇa kartavyā dehato’dhikā ||86 ||
abhāvo na grahītavyasteṣāṃ mātaḥ kadācana |
evaṃvidhāyā bhaktāyā bhayaṃ nāsti yamādijam ||87||
tāṃ nābhibhavituṃ śaktā mahākālādayo’pi hi |
ataḥ kṛṣṇe mano yojyaṃ vajrabhūvajrakīlavat ||88||
evaṃ kṛṣṇamānasā tu dehe satyasti dhāmani |
kṛṣṇe kārṣṇeṣu yā maitrī sākṣarasya prayojikā ||89 ||
pārthakyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktebhyo vighnaṃ tatra mahattaram |
niḥsnehena vartanaṃ ca dhāmato dūratāpradam ||4.12.9 0||
ātmajñānaṃ harerjñānaṃ bhaktānāṃ jñānamityapi |
gopuratrayamevāsti harerdhāmni praveśane ||9 1 ||
santaḥ sādhvyaḥ sadā jñānatraye tiṣṭhanti sotsukāḥ |
sneho dāsyaṃ sevanaṃ ca trayaṃ cāntargatipradam ||92||
santaḥ sādhvyastrayaṃ labdhvā kṛṣṇāvāsaṃ prayānti hi |
sarvārpaṇaṃ pātivratyaṃ viśvāsaḥ śayanaṃ trayam ||93 ||
santaḥ sādhvyastribhiryānti śrīhareḥ śayanaṃ prati |
tādātmyaikarasaṃ te vai vidanti śayanaṃ gatāḥ ||94||
aparokṣānubhūtyā taṃ sākṣātpaśyanti sadrasam |
kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mahānandaṃ cānubhavanti tanmayāḥ ||95||
evaṃvidhānāṃ bhaktānāṃ saṃsāraḥ kiṃkariṣyati |
kriyāḥ sarvā bhavantyeṣāṃ divyā dehodbhavā api ||96||
brahmāṇḍanāśamāyāti bhaktānāśaṃ vrajanti na |
bhaktāstathāvidhā divyā modante’kṣaramandire ||97||
vṛndāvanaṃ sadā divyaṃ divyaṃ ca tulasīvanam |
badrīvanaṃ tathā divyaṃ divyā kuṃkumavāpikā ||98||
divyā sāketanagarī divyo vai rāsamaṇḍapaḥ |
gopyo divyā brahmapatnyo divyā haripriyāḥ sadā ||99||
divyāste tvakṣare loke cātrāpi santi cāpṛthak |
brahmapriyāḥ sadā divyā divyakāntena divyatā || 4.12.1 00||
kṛṣṇo divyaśca taddhāma divyaṃ vyāpakamatra ca |
tatra ye ye sevakāścālayā bhogā vibhūtayaḥ || 10 1||
divyā eva tato mātardivyeyaṃ bālayoginī |
tvaṃ divyā vartase nityaṃ mā bhautikīṃ vibhāvaya || 102||
śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇaṃ prāptā divyā bhavanti dehinaḥ |
brahmībhūtā bhavantyeva sakhītvaṃ ca vrajantyapi || 103||
nārāyaṇītvaṃ śaktitvaṃ vrajanti kṛṣṇasevikāḥ |
viṣṇutvaṃ ca naratvaṃ ca vrajanti kṛṣṇasevakāḥ || 1 04||
evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇayogo’yaṃ mātaste kathito mayā |
ityuktvā virarāmaiva badri sā bālayoginī || 1 05||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ nārīṇāṃ mahābhāgavatadharmāḍhyatādimattvamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

<4.13>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ sā bālayoginī |
svamātre yatpunaścāha bālayogavṛṣān śubhān || 1 ||
mātarbālatvamādyaṃ vai sarveṣāṃ dehināmiha |
tatra kāmo na na krodho na svārtho nāpi rāgitā || 2 ||
na doṣāścātmani dhrovyā nāntaḥkaraṇe nendriye |
na dehe nāpi tattveṣu vaiśadyaṃ bālake’nvaham || 3 ||
svacchadarpaṇavad bālyaṃ sadā pālyaṃ mumukṣuṇā |
yauvanaṃ na spṛśed yasyāḥ sā sadā bālayoginī || 4 ||
kāmanā yauvane vṛttirlajjācauryādikāriṇī |
bahvanarthāvahā sā tu vāsanādripravardhinī || 46 ||
vikārāśca svabhāvāśca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtistathā |
vijātīyāḥ pravartante ceṣṭāstu yauvane khalu || 6 ||
ta eva doṣāḥ sarve vai nodbhavanti kadācana |
śrīkṛṣṇakāntamāśritya yasyāṃ sā bālayoginī || 7 ||
tapo dharmo virāgaśca niyamaḥ saṃyamastathā |
indriyāṇāṃ jaye heturmanojaye’pi vartate || 8 ||
bālyaṃ sarvajayakāraṃ sahajaṃ bālayogavat |
bālakṛṣṇasya yogo vai sarvendriyajayapradaḥ || 9 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasakhyaṃ sukhāvaham |
māyākālādijayakṛt karmaṇāṃ gaṇanā tu kā || 4.13.1 0||
ātyantikī mahāśaktirmātaḥ kṛṣṇe bhavet sadā |
kṛṣṇe snehācca kārṣṇeṣu snehācchāntiḥ parā bhavet || 11 ||
avarāyāṃ ca bhaktāyā snehācchāntirhi dāsyavat |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktimatyāṃ śāntirhi śāśvatī || 12||
gurvyāṃ pūjyatayā śāntiḥ samānāyāṃ sakhītayā |
evaṃ guṇān gṛhītvaiva bhajet kṛṣṇapadāmbujam || 13||
itastato bhramamāṇo jīvaḥ karmānubandhanaḥ |
kyacinnārī kvacit klībaḥ kvacinnaro bhavatyapi || 14||
svatantraḥ paratantro vā duḥkhī sukhī kvacittathā |
vane’raṇye pattane vā gṛhe bāhye kvacid raṇe || 15||
kārāgāre yāmyaloke svarge kvacittu mānave |
evaṃ karmānucārasya kṛṣṇaprāptirhi durlabhā || 16||
sā cejātā tataścānyanneṣṭavyaṃ dehinā tviha |
cakravartinṛpaddhistu malavat kardamādivat || 17||
saṃbodhyā siddhayaścāpi tṛṇavanmṛttikeva ca |
ātmā kṛṣṇe yojanīyo girivad dhruvavattathā || 18||
mātarbaddhāsmi kamalākānte satsu ca sarvadā |
snehapāśena hariṇā svāyattīkāritāsmi hi || 19||
ato nārāyaṇasaṃgaṃ satāṃ saṃgaṃ prasevanam |
notsahe sarvadā tyaktuṃ śirodānaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ||4.13.20||
īdṛśyasmi harau tasya bhakteṣu prītisañjitā |
tadvinānyatra lagnā na manovṛttirmamāsti hi |||1 ||
kṛṣṇasya kīrtane mātarmattatā me prajāyate |
vihvalāyā mama kṛṣṇe jāyate dehavismṛtiḥ ||22||
tathāpi prājñavad dehe tiṣṭhāmi śaktiyoginī |
dāsītvena harau cāsmi svāmitvena harirmayi ||23||
ataḥ svecchānusāreṇa prabhunaktu harirhi mām |
vimāne vā gaje haṃse vaikuṇḍe vā kṣitāvapi ||24||
svarge badrīvane śvetadvīpe vā kṣīrasāgare |
goloke śrīpure vāpi brahmaloke’kṣare pare ||25||
avyākṛte’mṛte vāpi harirnayatu māṃ sakhīm |
ruciḥ syād yādṛśī tasya tathaiva vidadhātu mām ||26||
na me kṛṣṇapriyād bhinnaṃ naijaṃ priyaṃ hi vidyate |
kṛṣṇasyaiva priyaṃ yattat priyaṃ me mānaruttamam ||27||
na vā kṛṣṇecchayā vṛttau viparītaṃ kvacinmama |
na ca nārāyaṇecchātaḥ prārabdhaṃ tvaparaṃ mama ||28||
sarveśvare prabhau kṛṣṇe sadā prāptāsmi lagnatām |
tataḥ sarvāsvavasthāsu brāhmī sthitirmamāsti hi || 29||
yāmāśritya parā nārī kṛṣṇaikāntikatā vrajet |
tatprasādādbhayaṃ tasyā vighnajanyaṃ na cāsti hi || 4.13.3 0||
sāraṃ kṛṣṇetarannāsti sāraṃ bhayaṃ na vidyate |
aśīlāyāṃ na sāro’sti kṛṣṇastatra na tiṣṭhati ||3 1||
śīlasthāyāṃ hariścāste jāyate bālayoginī |
kārṣṇaṃ sukhaṃ māyikādvai divyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca durlabham ||32||
prāptaṃ mayā tayā prāptaṃ sarvaṃ sāmrājyamuttamam |
kṛpayaiva prajeśasya tatprāptaṃ sāmprataṃ mayā ||33||
brāhmī brahmapriyā jātā nārāyaṇī pareśvarī |
bhūyasīṃ paramāṃ prītiṃ prāptāsmi badarīśvarī ||34||
yādṛśī tādṛśī vāpi kṛṣṇakāntāsmi saṃgatā |
ikṣurasaṃ paraṃ prema prāptāsmi cāmṛtaṃ harau ||35||
antarāyakaraṃ kṛṣṇe mātastyajāmi dūrataḥ |
āsañjanavidhātṛ yad gṛhṇāmi taddhi sādhanam ||36||
viśvāsinī harau nityaṃ bhavāmi bhavanāśinī |
anāsaktā paratrāpi bhavāmi kṛṣṇakāminī ||37||
khānapānaśiraḥpāṇipādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ |
sādhūnāṃ sevane raktā varte’haṃ kṛṣṇasevane ||38||
atipriyaṃ samastaṃ me’rpayāmi mādhavāya vai |
arpayitvā satībhyaśca sādhubhyaścāpi sarvathā ||39||
upayogaṃ tatastasya vastunaḥ prakaromyaham |
dayayā sampradāyaiva śeṣaṃ bhunajmi cājñayā ||4.13.40||
karomi śrīhareḥ sākṣād divyamūrteḥ samarhaṇam |
mānasaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi karomi ṛtuvattathā ||41 ||
pātivratyaṃ puraskṛtya karomi sevanaṃ hareḥ |
pativratāyāḥ kāntānye svapne’pi nāsti cādaraḥ ||42||
patyāveva tathā kṛṣṇe prītiṃ karomi nityadā |
kṛṣṇabhakteṣu caivāpi kṛṣṇasambandhatastathā ||43 ||
aikapatyaṃ harau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’smi me sadā |
sarvāśceṣṭā prabheśārthaṃ niṣkāmā bandhanojjhitā ||44||
bharjitāni ca bījāni coptāni kṣetrake yathā |
nāṃkurāya prabhavanti tathā karmāṇi mādhave ||45||
na janmādipradānyeva jāyante nirguṇāni hi |
śrīkṛṣṇasya prasaṃgena jīrṇānīva bhavanti hi ||46||
vāsanāḥ praśamaṃ yānti saṃkalpā na bhavanti ca |
naṣṭā bhavati sarvā caiṣaṇā viṣayagocarā ||47||
kriyāḥ sarvā harerājñāmayyo nānyā hi me kvacit |
yayā tyaktaṃ jagat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇe prītiḥ kṛtā yayā ||48||
tasyā nānyad gṛhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā mātarhi vidyate |
kṛṣṇārthaṃ yoginī jātā kārṣṇī sāhaṃ tathāsmi ca ||49||
jagaddhartā mato dharmaḥ sa me kṛṣṇo’sti netaraḥ |
ātmaparicayo jñānaṃ sa me paricayo harau ||4.13.50||
snehaścākṛṣṭabhāvo me kṛṣṇe nānyatra kutracit |
bhaktiḥ sevā sarvarītyā kṛṣṇasyaiva na cetarā ||51 ||
sā me sevā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe nivṛttiruttamā |
hareḥ sambandhaśūnyastu dharmo janmāntarapradaḥ ||52||
pravṛttirvā nivṛttirvā nārāyaṇasuyoginī |
mahābhāgavatī bodhyā dharmiṇī satkriyā hi sā ||53||
kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇasādhvarthaṃ sevārhaṃ divyameva tat |
prītiyogyaṃ tadevāsti heyaṃ cānyattu sarvathā ||54||
asaṃkhyānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sammarde’pi hareḥ kṛte |
vāsaṃ kartuṃ samicchāmi nānyathā tu vane’pi vai ||55||
kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇasādhvarthaṃ vanaṃ me nagarāyate |
yatra kṛṣṇastatra haṃsā dṛśyante tu mayā sadā ||56 ||
yatra kṛṣṇo na milati vyāghrāyante dvijā api |
api badrīvanaṃ śītaṃ nārāyaṇena pattanam ||57||
smṛddhaṃ me vidyate mātaḥ sāmrājyaṃ netaranmama |
yatra kṛṣṇaḥ pūjyate na tatsthalaṃ me sakaṇṭakam ||58||
bāṇaśayyā vinā kṛṣṇaṃ puṣpaśayyā tadanvitā |
kṛṣṇaṃ vinā hyabhaktāyā jalānnaṃ rocate na me ||59||
akṛṣṇāyā na me prītirdīpo me mānaso hariḥ |
hāro me hṛdaye kṛṣṇo maṇirme keśaveśane ||4.13.60||
kalpānando mānase me kṛṣṇaḥ kānto rahaḥpatiḥ |
yāsu bhaktirhareścāste yāstvasti kṛṣṇavallabhā ||61||
tā me’pi vallabhāḥ santi mātarnānyāḥ kvacit khalu |
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhācārā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhakriyā ||62||
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaudāryā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhāntarā |
śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho yasyā sā satī badarīśvarī ||63||
māṇikyā cākṣare dhāmni tvadgṛhe bālayoginī |
nārāyaṇī camatkāre rādhā kṛṣṇasya mānase ||64||
lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇasya pārśve sā himādrau badarīśvarī |
sureśvaryā gṛhe kanyā varte’haṃ parameśvarī ||65||
yā pārvatī harapatnī sāhaṃ prabhośca badrikā |
naranārāyaṇavāsā badarī bālayoginī ||66||
kārṣṇyo yā vaiṣṇavīdevyo bāndhavyo mama tāḥ sadā |
sadā tābhiḥ saha vāso rocate me’tra vā pare ||67||
snigdhāḥ satyo durlabhā vai bhavanti mānave bhave |
premabhaktiprapūrāśca sadā kṛṣṇārthakāmanāḥ ||68||
dāsībhāvena vā sādhvībhāvena kṛṣṇamāśritāḥ |
cidrūpāsajjanaprāptyā cidrūpāstāḥ striyo narāḥ ||69||
paraṃ bhāgavataṃ sthānaṃ labdhvā cākṣaradhāmani |
premṇā kāntaṃ prabhuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prasādayanti vai ||4.13.70||
snigdhayā bhaktayā bhāvyaṃ kṛṣṇe rasikayā mudā |
niśchadmasevayā kṛṣṇaḥ prasādaṃ prakaroti hi ||71||
anuvṛttyā sādhavaśca prasannāḥ saṃbhavanti vai |
mānyāḥ prasādyāḥ santaste namanādyairmuhurmuhuḥ ||72||
yathā yathā prasannāḥ syurvidhātavyaṃ tathā tathā |
teṣāṃ prasādalabhyā vai mahatī padavī matā ||73||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisantaḥ pūjyāḥ sadā mudā |
mānasī cārhaṇā kāryā yathartusūpacārakaiḥ ||74||
mātaścāhaṃ sadā prātaḥ karomi pūjanaṃ hareḥ |
uṣṇakāle śītavāri sugandhi cārpayāmi vai ||75||
snapayāmi śītajalaiḥ premṇā sammardayāmi ca |
śītasugandhitailaiśca sugandhisārasadrasaiḥ ||76||
mārjayāmi hareḥ samastāṃgāni sūkṣmavāsasā |
sūkṣmāṇi śobhanānyeva navāni cāmbarāṇyapi ||77||
sugandhipuṣpahārām̐śca śṛṃgāraṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca |
rājādhirājavibhavān taṃ paridhāpayāmi ca ||78||
candanena harerbhāle tilakaṃ candrakaṃ tathā |
kauṃkumaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva karapādatalārcanam ||79||
karomi candanairmātarvakṣaudarapūjanam |
sakthijānuphaṇāgrāṇāṃ karomi pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||4.13.80||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ śrīkhaṇḍādi yathāruci |
śītaṃ vāri polikādi samarpayāmi cakriṇe ||8 1 ||
uttarāpośanaṃ datvā datvā tāmbūlakaṃ tathā |
ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā cāśliṣyāmi muhurharim ||82||
śīrṣṇi bhāle stanayośca dhārayāmi pade hareḥ |
tallagnakuṃkumāktāni mamāṃgāni bhavanti vai ||83||
pariṣvaṃge tadaṃgasthacandanādyaiḥ sucihnitam |
samastaṃ maccharīraṃ ca divyaṃ paśyāmi taddhṛtam ||84||
puṣpodyāne ramayāmi nikuñje svāminaṃ harim |
viharantaṃ ramamāṇaṃ seve prasannamānasam ||85||
komale śayane puṣpadalālaṃkṛtaśobhane |
svāpayāmi prabhuṃ kāntaṃ kāmayāmi yathāyatham ||86||
saṃvāhayāmi cāṃgāni prātarudbodhayāmi ca |
varṣāyāṃ pūjanaṃ naijavallabhasya yathocitam ||87||
karomi tu yathā varṣāśaityaṃ tasya na bādhate |
īṣaduṣṇajalaiḥ kāntaṃ snapayāmi tathāmbaram ||88||
iṣaddhanaṃ tathānyāni dhārayāmi śubhāni ca |
kaisarāktaṃ candanaṃ ca dadāmi pūjane tadā ||89||
tatkālīnasupuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayāmi mameśvaram |
bhojanāni samaśītoṣṇāni cāvātulānyapi || 4.13.90||
dadāmi svāmino mātaḥ sebe śayyāgataṃ harim |
śītakāle paramoṣṇavāriṃ dadāmi sarvathā ||91||
uṣṇāmbarāṇi sarvāṇi tathoṣṇabhojanānyapi |
uṣṇamiṣṭānnapakvānnānyarpayāmi tu śārṅgiṇe ||92||
śayyāyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya pārśvalīnā bhavāmi ca |
prātaryathā na vai śaityaṃ bādhate’sya karomi tat ||93||
evaṃ svasyā mahadbhāgyaṃ jānāmi kṛṣṇasevane |
brahmānandaṃ mahānandaṃ sadā prāpnomi vai hareḥ ||94||
akṣare’pi pare dhāmni sevāprāptestu hetavaḥ |
akṣarasyādhigamanecchāvattvaṃ satataṃ nijam ||95||
ātmaniṣṭhatayā jñānaṃ bhagavanniṣṭhabhāvanā |
bhaktirbhagavataścāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||96||
māyāyā varjanaṃ nityaṃ divyasvātmavicintanam |
mṛṣājñānādivilayaḥ pramājñānodayastathā ||97||
snigdhatā mām̐satīnāthe pātivratyaṃ harau tathā |
satsaṃgaḥ sādhusevā ca śrīkṛṣṇārādhanā sadā ||98||
evamādibhirhetubhiścākṣaraṃ dhāma labhyate |
tatra kṛṣṇasnehapātrībhūtā prāpnoti sevanam ||99||
kṛṣṇāptau svārthadārḍhyaṃ vai yasyāstu vartate sadā |
sā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ kāntaṃ prāpnotyeva na muñcati || 4.13.10 0||
harermāhātmyajñānena jayatyeva hare priyā |
harau prītimatī patnī vivardhate’tisadguṇaiḥ || 10 1||
śrutvā kṛṣṇaguṇān kṛṣṇaṃ cintayet kṛṣṇakāminī |
viniścinuyāt hṛdaye pārvatīśaṃ narāyaṇam || 1 02||
taṃ tu bhuñjīta satataṃ divyaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gatam |
sa eva śrīharerbodhyaḥ prasādo bhoganāmakaḥ || 1 03||
raṃke vā rājasadṛśe samā prasannatā hareḥ |
patrapuṣpārpaṇādyaiśca drutaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati || 1 04||
śraddhāsnehapremabhaktyādibhiḥ śīghraṃ prasīdati |
ityevaṃ badrike bālayoginī mātaraṃ prati || 1 05||
bahudhoktvā sthitiṃ svīyāṃ virarāma harau kṣaṇam |
punaśca bahirāgatya prabhokṛṣṇeti sañjagau ||1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ bālayoginyā kathitānāṃ
bālayogadharmāṇāṃ nirūpaṇamityādināmā trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||

<4.14>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
tato badrīpriye devi mātre śrībālayoginī |
paramaṃ vaiṣṇavayogaṃ prāha te kathayāmyapi || 1 ||
vaiṣṇavā viṣṇuvanmānyā mātaḥ sarvapravaiṣṇavaiḥ |
vaiṣṇavībhirviśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇavat kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 2 ||
sarvathā viṣṇusambandhikriyāsveva hi te ratāḥ |
ātmanāṃ ca vaśe yeṣāmindriyāṇyāntarāṇyapi || 3 ||
brahmacaryaṃ harau yeṣāṃ brahmatā ca prabhau patau |
kṛṣṇaikacetaso bhaktā mānyāḥ pūjyā hariryathā || 4 ||
naite mānavatulyā vā suratulyā na cāpi te |
bhaktānikā na mānavyaḥ kamalāstā hi sarvathā || 5 ||
vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā sevyā yoṣidbhiryoṣitastu tāḥ |
dharmāṃśe pāragāminyaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśe sarvavartanāḥ || 6 ||
haryarthaṃ lokalajjādyāvaraṇādivivarjitāḥ |
kṛṣṇetaropabhogādau doṣabhītisamavṛtāḥ || 7 ||
kārṣṇavaiṣṇavasevāyāṃ kṛṣṇavanmahimānvitāḥ |
māyābandhanahīnāśca divyatāmodabhojanāḥ || 8 ||
kṛṣṇārthadehadānāśca vaiṣṇavārthapravartanāḥ |
kārṣṇakuṭumbamodinyo vaiṣṇavīstrījanābhigāḥ || 9 ||
vaiṣṇavīmaṇḍalaśobhā vaiṣṇavīrucirañjitāḥ |
vaiṣṇavyo hṛdaye yāsāṃ sevyāstāḥ kṛṣṇavat sadā || 4.14.1 0||
rādhāvat kamalāvattāḥ sevyāśca māṇikī yathā |
badrikāvat prasevyāśca śrīrbhūlīlā satī yathā || 11 ||
lakṣmīvat padmāvatīvat sevyāstāśca prabhuḥ yathā |
lalitāvanmahālakṣmīvat sevyāstā haripriyāḥ || 12||
tāstu śubhāśubhāśceṣṭāḥ kriyāḥ spṛśanti naiva ha |
śreyase dehināṃ doṣavilayāya vimuktaye || 13||
hariḥ prajāyate loke tadyogāttā vibandhanāḥ |
kṛṣṇavat kārṣṇavaccāpi kārṣṇīvaccāpi tāḥ sadā || 14||
divyāḥ sevyāstoṣaṇīyāḥ sevābhiścāntarārpaṇaiḥ |
asaṃkucitabhāvaiścānāvaraṇānuvartanaiḥ || 15||
sevāyāṃ naiva mānaṃ vā garvaṃ cāhaṃkṛtiṃ guṇam |
lajjāṃ cāvaraṇaṃ kuryād yā sā sakhī haripriyā || 16||
brahmapriyā sadā brāhmīmaṇḍalaṃ manute hṛdi |
kṛṣṇavat sevate cāpi sarvasvadānasatkṛtaiḥ || 17||
vinītā vaiṣṇavīnāṃ tu sannidhau sarvathāmalā |
ātmaprauḍhivihīnā ca brahmapriyā sadottamā || 18||
ānandamūrtau śrīkṛṣṇe divyā ānandavārdhayaḥ |
romṇi romṇi bhavantyeva cāṇau cāṇau samastaśaḥ || 1 9||
mānaṃ vihāya saṃsevyā ānandā divyacakriṇaḥ |
anyānandāḥ śeṣabhūtā sarvaśo’sya parātmanaḥ || 4.14.20||
sevayā samprasannasya prasīdanti hi sādhavaḥ |
satyevaṃ sarvakāmāśca pūrṇā bhavanti sevinām ||21 ||
kāmayet susatāṃ prasannatāṃ kṛṣṇasya sarvadā |
tadapriyaṃ prajahyācca prasannatāvarodhakṛt ||22||
prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā bandhanīyā na granthayo’parāḥ |
kṛṣṇaprasannatāsādhikāstu dhāryāstadāptaye ||23||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagranthiḥ parā granthirvivāhinī |
tayā tu grathitā baddhā brahmarṣiṇī samucyate ||24||
saiva priyā saiva patnī saiva bhāryā sadharmiṇī |.
saiva svasvāminī kāntā bhagavadgranthiyoginī || 25||
premāmbaraprāntajāṃ tu granthiṃ prāpya parātmanaḥ |
vareṇyasya varārohā jāyate brahmarohiṇī ||26||
kṛṣṇārohā kṛṣṇapārśvā śrīkṛṣṇahṛdayā sakhī |
kṛṣṇe śayanamāpannā kṛṣṇānande pramajjati ||27||
tasyāḥ sambandhataścānyāḥ sakhyo’pi svāminaḥ sukham |
prāpnuvanti spṛhābhaktyā tatastathā bhavantyapi ||28||
kārṣṇyāḥ saṃsargayogena kārṣṇyo bhavanti kṛṣṇagāḥ |
vinā yatnaṃ prajāyante mātastā brahmayogagāḥ || 29||
tata eva hareryogād bālayoginya eva tāḥ |
nārāyaṇyaḥ prajāyante nārāyaṇārdhavigrahāḥ ||4.14.30 ||
kṛpayā sahayogena prajāyante haripriyāḥ |
ātmārpaṇena jāyante brahmapriyāḥ sadā priyāḥ ||3 1 ||
śuṣkacittā doṣadṛśyo na jāyante hareḥ priyāḥ |
pūrṇakāmo hi bhagavān pūrṇānandabharaḥ sadā ||32||
bhaktānāṃ sukhadāḥ kṛṣṇakāntaceṣṭā hi mokṣadāḥ |
pūrṇānandasya mātrābhiścānyasṛṣṭiḥ sukhānvitā || 33||
svātmārāmasya kṛṣṇasyārāmo nāparapekṣakaḥ |
anyārāmāḥ kṛṣṇakāntāpekṣakāḥ śāśvatāṃśakāḥ || 34||
evaṃmatyavahīnānāṃ bhavedajñānamulbaṇam |
mama bhogena kṛṣṇo’yaṃ sukhamānandamaśnute ||35||
itidoṣavatī mātarnaiva syāt mādhavapriyā |
sarvāvatāradhartṛtvaṃ veda yā svāminaḥ satī ||36||
sarvasaukhyapradātṛtvaṃ veda kṛṣṇasya bhāminī |
sā tadagre mānadoṣahīnā jāyeta tatpriyā ||37||
evaṃvidhāyāḥ satataṃ sāhacaryaṃ tu śārṅgiṇā |
kiṃkaryāṃ sarvadā syācca harerbhūriprasannatā ||38||
matsyasya jīvanaṃ vārṣu kiṃkaryā jīvanaṃ harau |
sukhaṃ divyaṃ bhāgavataṃ kiṃkaryā jīvane’sti vai ||39||
jīvanaṃ prāṇade kānte sukhaṃ cāpi ca mādhave |
ākarṣaṇaṃ taijasaṃ ca kānte prāṇaprade prabhau ||4.14.40 ||
kiṃkaryāḥ sarvathā cāsti mātaḥ śrīmādhavīśvare |
sarvaṃ svatvaṃ harau tasyāstasyāṃ svatvaṃ harestathā ||41 ||
tyāginī vā gṛhiṇī vā kṛṣṇe taikṣṇyaṃ paraṃ param |
yasyā āsvādasya tasyā brāhmītvaṃ śrītvamityapi |||42|||
śīlavrataṃ brahmacaryaṃ tasyā evāstyakhaṇḍitam |
vairāgyaṃ cātmaniṣṭhatvaṃ tasyāḥ sādhvītvamityapi ||43||
nyāsinītvaṃ ca muktatvaṃ tasyā divyātvamityapi |
nārāyaṇītvaṃ kamalāsthānaṃ tasyāḥ sadākṣare ||44||
yasyāḥ prathamaṃ śravaṇaṃ māhātmyasya hareratha |
tataḥ snehodbhavaḥ prītistato melanavṛttayaḥ ||45||
ākarṣaṇaṃ sphuraṇaṃ ca tadākārātmavartanam |
suravānandapramodādivāñcchā tato’bhiyojanam ||46||
tataḥ prāptiḥ parokṣasya svapne vā sādhurūpiṇaḥ |
tataḥ sākṣādbhavet prāptirmahānandasya śevadheḥ ||47||
āśleṣaṇaṃ caikatānānandasparśādijaṃ sukham |
sarvaviṣayasaukhyaṃ ca svāmināthāt tadāpyate ||48||
evaṃ bhavet kṛṣṇaratiḥ kṛṣṇapriyā kramātpurā |
satāṃ prasevayā kṛṣṇe bhaktyā tādātmyamāpnuyāt| ||49||
satsevayā tvatiprītyā sarvaṃ sampadyate striyāḥ |
atiprītyaiva kṛṣṇe tā bhavanti rucivartanāḥ ||4.14.50||
vartanaṃ tyāgarūpaṃ tad divyaṃ nārāyaṇe’rpitam |
dehakriyāsu sarvāsu dehabhānavivarjitam ||51 ||
sādhyo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāntaḥ patirmayārjitaḥ |
bhāvanāḥ śrīharau kānte sarvā me santi nāparāḥ ||52||
madāśrayasthitānāṃ ca tathaiva santi bhāvanāḥ |
tāsveva vāsato modo’nyatra dainyaṃ prasajyate ||53||
etādṛśīṃ sthitiṃ prāpya mano me modatetarām |
yo’kṣare rājate svāmī śrīkāntaḥ kānta eva me ||54||
avatārā bhavantyasya śreyase bahavo’pi hi |
sa eva bhagavān sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||55||
ākṣarībhirhi muktābhiḥ sevyamānapadāmbujaḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre’smaddṛṣṭigocaro’sti saḥ ||56||
atyantakaruṇāpūrṇaḥ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ |
kaṃbharāśrīsutaḥ kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuḥ patiḥ ||57||
sadā kiśorarūpaśca sarvakāmātikāmanaḥ |
sarvecchāpūrakaḥ kāntaḥ sarvāsāṃ pāvanaḥ patiḥ ||58||
taṃ prabhuṃ śuddhahṛdayā paśyatyeva hṛdambare |
varṇena vayasā kāntyā puṣṭyā śāntyā balena ca ||59||
yogyo’sti sarvakāntānāṃ samarthaḥ mādhavīpatiḥ |
anubhavitrī jānāti karapāśādhiśāyinī ||4.14.60 ||
divyaṃ kṛṣṇasya kāntasya sukhaṃ vācāmagocaram |
aparokṣaṃ vadhūrvetti vakṣaāśleṣapiṇḍitā ||61 ||
vadhvo bhavanti mātarvai kānte vividhavṛttayaḥ |
kāścit kāntasya hāsye syuḥ prasannā lagnavṛttayaḥ ||62||
kāścit kāntasya vai narmavākyeṣu miṣṭavṛttayaḥ |
kāścit kāntasya vai premapūrṇanetre’tivṛttayaḥ ||63||
kāścit kāntasya saundarye śṛgāre yauvane’tigāḥ |
kāścid bhāveṣu hāveṣu praśaṃsāyāṃ ca keliṣu ||64||
kāścidekāntaramaṇe kāścid viharaṇe bahiḥ |
kāścit prasannā jāyante dyūtajayaparājaye ||65 ||
kāścinmānapradāne ca kāścit sparśe sahādane |
kāścit sahāsane kāścidājñāyāṃ vartane tathā ||66||
kāścittu jalakelyādau kāścit puṣpāvabhūṣaṇe |
kāścit prasannā jāyante vāraṃ vāraṃ vilokane ||67||
kāścid yāne vimāne ca śayyāyāṃ ca nikuñjake |
kāścid vijane sajane bhavantyākṛṣṭavṛttayaḥ ||68||
kāścidvakṣaḥsamāśleṣe kāścit keśādiveśane |
kāścit pāne sugandhe ca kāścit tāmbulake priyāḥ ||69||
evaṃ kāścittu kalahe vaimanasye’tivṛttayaḥ |
rājasyo vāpi tāmasyo bhavantyākṛṣṭavṛttayaḥ ||4.14.70||
evaṃ bhāvavaśā vadhvo bhavanti kāntavṛttayaḥ |
kānto’pi bhagavān bhāvān vijñāyānandayatyapi ||71 ||
āntarastho bahistiṣṭhan yathābhāvaṃ nijapriyām |
samākarṣayati svasmin mahānandaṃ dadātyapi ||72||
divyānandabharākāraḥ sarvānandapayodadhiḥ |
pratyakṣakāntarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’vati ||73||
tanmaryādāṃ mahāmuktā mahāmuktānikāḥ striyaḥ |
avatārāstathā vyūhā īśvarā īśanīstriyaḥ ||74||
surāḥ siddhāḥ satīvargāḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavo’malāḥ |
yoginyo yatayaḥ sarve pālayanti maheśvarāḥ ||75||
tanmaryādā mayā pālyā tatprītaye sadā śubhā |
sa eva lokajīvānāṃ tārako’kṣaranāyakaḥ ||76||
adhamoddhārakaḥ kṛṣṇasvāmī patitapāvanaḥ |
āśritāyā manovṛtteḥ pūraṇārthaṃ tathāvidhaḥ ||77||
svasya rītiṃ tirobhāvyāśritavṛttiṃ dadhāti vai |
aho kṛpālutā tasyāśritāśrayitvamicchati ||78||
nijāyā api naijatvaṃ saṃvibhāvya pramodate |
dhanyā mātarhi sā nārī yā tathā vindati prabhum ||79||
yasyā nānyatra vai śraddhā rucirvā kāntamantarā |
puṃputrarasavittādimāyikāhatamānasā ||4.14.80||
patyarthaṃ cānyamantrādau śraddhā yasyā na vidyate |
prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā yasyā rajanī rañjanī na vai ||81 ||
alaukikendrajālādipradarśayitṛmānave |
yasyā na gauravaṃ śraddhā jāyate harimantarā |||82||
mayi saccitsvarūpe svātmanyeva rājate hariḥ |
tatraiva tu camatkārāḥ siddhayaḥ santi matkṛte ||83||
labdhavyārthāḥ samastā me prabhau kānte bhavanti hi |
bhramo yena bhavedanyo’nyatra nārāyaṇetare ||84||
evaṃvidhātimatimatpatnyāṃ prasannatāṃ vrajet |
prabhuśca prabhuvatpuṇyāḥ santo mahānta uttamāḥ ||85||
satpathasthā harerbhaktā yāsu prasannavṛttayaḥ |
tāsāṃ bhāgyaṃ mahaddivyaṃ tābhiḥ sāraḥ samarjitaḥ ||86||
athaivaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntasvāmyaṃke saṃniṣadya ca |
śrīkṛṣṇetarakoṭyabdheśvaramānaṃ na vāñcchati ||87||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhinne na mohanam |
naranārāyaṇasyeva mohanaṃ na striyāṃ nare ||88||
patiḥ ṛṣirnaranārāyaṇo me tāpasaḥ prabhuḥ |
śīlavrato mahāmāyāpāravartī himālaye ||89||
nirmoho vartate mātarbadarīvanabhūtale |
tathāhaṃ tāpasī mātarbadarīnāthabadrikā ||4.14.90||
varte’haṃ mokṣaśūnyātra gṛhe te bālayoginī |
sadā śīlavratā kanyā lokakalyāṇakāriṇī ||9 1||
matphalaiḥ ṛṣayo yānti vinirdhūtāghakoṭayaḥ |
madakṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma svāmino me’kṣaraṃ padam ||92||
vyasanaṃ me harerjātaṃ tadvinā na kṣaṇaṃ mama |
kevalaṃ vidyate mātarviśiṣṭaṃ tena vidyate ||93 ||
snehatādātmyatanvā me līnatā svāmini prabhau |
sadāsti tadvinā mātarnāhaṃ bhavāmi sākṛtiḥ ||94||
sarvāvasthāsu sukhadaṃ sarvalokeṣu rakṣakam |
prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ priyaṃ kāntaṃ kathaṃ muñcāmyasusthitam ||95||
ādhāramātmanaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sukhāspadam |
śrīlakṣmīmāṇikīsevyaṃ lalitāvaramuttamam ||96||
prabhuṃ nāthaṃ badarīśaṃ pāśavatīpatiṃ harima |
sarvadā śrīmahālakṣmīsevitaṃ pūjitaṃ tathā ||97||
kambharāśrīśvarīdhyātaṃ lālitaṃ pālitāṃ tayā |
prāptaṃ kathaṃ vimuñcāmi vada mātarmanīṣayā ||98||
na śaithilyaṃ harau me’sti na māyāyāṃ pravartanā |
nānyadehe ratirme’sti vadānyaṃ cintayāmi kim ||99||
ityuktvā virarāmāsau badrīśi bālayoginī |
mātā bhāgyaṃ nijaṃ mene dhanyaṃ sureśvarī satī || 4.14.1 00||
vyacintayaddhareḥ prāptyai putrītaḥ sādhanānyapi |
āśīrvādān dadau putryai jñātvā tāṃ badarīśvarīm || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ paramavaiṣṇavīyogavivecananāmā caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||

<4.15>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ śrībālayoginī |
svamātre paramabrahmapremarasaṃ jagāda yam || 1 ||
mātarhṛdi sadā tiṣṭhed vāsudevasya bhāvanā |
prītidārḍhyaṃ sumāhātmyaṃ śraddhā harau prabhūyasī || 2 ||
mahānandaḥ pramodaśca sukhaṃ virāma īśvare |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śāntistiṣṭheyuḥ sarvathā prabhau || 3 ||
yasyāḥ sā bhavati brahmarasavettrī na cetarā |
tasyā āpadi kaṣṭāyāṃ sthairyaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe || 4 ||
anuvṛtāyāḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇāśrayasatāmapi |
sevābhāvayutāyāstu brahmapremaraso milet || 5 ||
śreyaḥsādhanamāptāyā brahmapremarasodbhavaḥ |
ātmanaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanaṃ vinā || 6 ||
kasyā api na śāntiḥ syāt sākṣād yogaṃ vināpi ca |
yogaśca śrīharereva dhyānopāsanabhaktibhiḥ || 7 ||
tadvineṣṭarasaprāptyai vṛthā śramaḥ khalehavat |
kṛpayā śrīhariryogaṃ dadāti bhaktiyoṣite || 8 ||
atīva ramaṇīyāṃgaḥ sarvasaundaryasaṃgrahaḥ |
nityadivyaguṇāḍhyaśca sarvadehimanoharaḥ || 9 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī sevikāśca muktānikāḥ pumuttamam |
bhajanti saṃprasevante sarūpāḥ samakāmanāḥ || 4.15.1 0||
asya yogena nairguṇyaṃ yānti guṇāḍhyadehinaḥ |
antaryāmitayā sarveṣvavasthitasya cakriṇaḥ || 11 ||
sa jīvanaṃ cidacitāṃ kartā bhoktā patiḥ prabhuḥ |
tathā svataḥsiddhabhūrimahaiśvaryakalānidhiḥ || 12||
tasya śrībālakṛṣṇasya yogaḥ saukhyapradaḥ sadā |
saccidānandarūpāyā muktāyā atra cākṣare || 1 3||
paramānandakṛt kṛṣṇaḥ premṇā prasevitaḥ prabhuḥ |
svamūrtau nijabhaktāṃ vai līnīkaroti tadrasaḥ || 14||
adya kālāntare vāpi kṛṣṇe līnatvamāpnuyāt |
yadā tadā kṛṣṇapremarasamāsvādayet sakhī || 15||
ātmaniṣṭhābalaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpaṇam |
ubhayaṃ prāpya kānte vai līnatāṃ tu sadārjayet || 16||
sarvarājādhirājaśrīkṛṣṇe pramodamāpnuyāt |
mahimānaṃ vijānīyād brahmarasamupāharet || 17||
caturdaśāvṛtijuṣṭaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇāvitam |
asaṃkhyāṇḍāni santyeṣāṃ rājā virāṭ supūruṣaḥ || 18||
vairājāste hyasaṃkhyātā mahāviṣṇoḥ suputrakāḥ |
evaṃ mahāviṣṇavo’pi pradhānapuruṣodbhavāḥ || 19||
asaṃkhyāste pradhāneśāḥ prakṛtipuṃsamudbhavāḥ |
sā māyā sa pumān muktokṣare līnau laye matau ||4.15.20||
punaḥ prakāśatāṃ prāptau sṛṣṭyārambhe punaḥ punaḥ |
evaṃvidhākṣarāṃśasya sukhamātrābhisaṃplutā || 21 ||
sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā sukhaṃ bhuṃkte’kṣaraṃ tu sukhavaddhareḥ |
anantākṣaramuktāścānantadhāmāni dhāminām ||22||
avatārā asaṃkhyātā muktā muktānikāstathā |
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni śaktayaḥ pārṣadāstathā ||23||
pārṣadānyaḥ samastāśca yanmūrteḥ sukhabhāginaḥ |
tasyānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||24||
ekaikāṃge sukhānāṃ vidyate romaromasu |
tasyāgre tvīśvarā jīvāścārkāgre visphuliṃgavat ||25||
atitucchā bhavantyeva brahmāṇḍapālakā api |
sarve’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇadattaṃ prabhuñjate ||26||
sukhāṃśaṃ bhuñjate svalpamucchiṣṭaṃ māyikaṃ kṣayi |
etādṛśārthaṃ tapasā yatante svargavāñcchayā ||27||
manvate durlabhaṃ cāpi rājasā mohavṛttayaḥ |
tadā kārṣṇaṃ bhāgavataṃ sukhaṃ kiṃ varṇyagocaram ||28||
sahajaṃ śāśvataṃ yatra sukhaṃ cālaukikaṃ param |
yadaṃśe yogino yogasamādhau yānti līnatām ||29||
sahasravatsarān tatra tiṣṭhantyavyaktamodinaḥ |
mahāsuṣuptau turyāyāṃ bhavanti sukhino’pare || 4.15.3 0||
kāmanāyāṃ ratau cāpi bhavanti sukhino’pi ca |
tathetarendriyajanyasukhairbhavanti nandinaḥ ||3 1||
īdṛksukhābdhirbhagavān svāmīśrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ |
rāmakṛṣṇādirūpāṇāṃ dhartā śrīmādhavīpatiḥ ||32||
avatāryakṣareśaśca sarvamuktābhipūjitaḥ |
sarvaparo bālakṛṣṇo’nantabrahmarasodadhiḥ ||33||
sarvabrahmapriyājuṣṭo haripriyābhinanditaḥ |
yasya pādarajo rādhālakṣmībadarīśaktibhiḥ ||34||
brahmavirāṇmahāviṣṇupūruṣairuhyate sadā |
yatra śrībhagavacchabdaḥ parabrahmeva vartate ||35||
yastveka eva sarveśo yatsamo nādhiko’paraḥ |
yatsevayopāstibhiśca yatsādharmyaṃ vrajanti ca ||36||
tathāpi dāsavat sarve tasyāgre tantritā yathā |
vartante te sarūpāśca sarūpiṇyo’pi śaktayaḥ ||37||
kālo māyā pūruṣādyā yadbhītāḥ kiṃkarā iva |
yadājñāṃ prāpya kurvanti sṛṣṭyudbhavādi sarvadā ||38||
evamacintyavibhavo badarīśo janārdanaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ ||39||
mānavo vartate tvadya kuṃkumavāpikālaye |
yena jalāṃśataścitrā haṃsā mayūrakāḥ śukāḥ ||4.15.40 ||
narāḥ patatriṇaḥ kīṭāḥ paśavaḥ svasajātayaḥ |
nirmitā vaṃśarūpeṇa mahāścaryādilīlayā ||41 ||
tatkṛtaṃ nānyathākartuṃ kenāpi śakyate tviha |
ityādisarvasāmarthyayuktena tena śārṅgiṇā ||42||
racayitvā sṛṣṭijīvān sukhāṃśaṃ pradadau nijam |
tadrase rasavantaśca sarvā bhavanti sṛṣṭayaḥ ||43||
viditvā taṃ kambharāyāḥ sutaṃ śrīkamalāpatim |
badarīśaṃ mādhavīśaṃ bhārgavīśaṃ prabhuṃpatim ||44||
mādhavīsvāminaṃ taṃ śrīlakṣmīnāthaṃ satīpatim |
māṇikyādhipatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ māyāpatiṃ harim ||45||
muktamuktānikānāthaṃ brahmadhāmādhipaṃ prabhum |
rādhāramādhināthaṃ ca rāmakṛṣṇādikāraṇam ||46||
tatra kuryād ratiṃ prītiṃ snehaṃ mohaṃ samutsavam |
ānandaṃ krīḍanaṃ mātarbrahmarasamavāpnuyāt ||47||
evaṃvidhā hi badarī māyike badhyate katham |
baddhāpi mucyate kṛṣṇe muktānyatra na sajjate ||48||
nirmalā jāyate divyā badhnāti śrīharau ratim |
eṣā tu bhāvanā mātaḥ puṣṇātyaṃgāni dugdhavat ||49||
eṣā brahmarasagāthā mātaḥ sarvārthasaṃbhṛtā |
pītā yayā tayā pītaṃ navaṃ brahmarasāmṛtam |||4.15.50||
etādṛśīprabhaktāyāḥ saṃgaṃ karoti yā satī |
sāpi brahmarasaiḥ pūrṇā bhavet kārṣṇī na saṃśayaḥ ||51||
bhaktiraikāntikī kṛṣṇe siddhyedasyāvadhāraṇāt |
asyaiva śrīhareryogādanyatra saṃgavarjanāt ||52||
śṛṇu mātaḥ kathāṃ vacmi cāraṇyā divyayoṣitaḥ |
nāmnā nāgamukhīdevī jātyābhavatta cāraṇī ||53||
raivatādreḥ paścime sā halamādanapattane |
pārśvavane mahiṣīṇāṃ pālikābhūt svadharmiṇī |||54||
patiputravihīnā sā tvekalā janavarjitā |
dadhidugdhaghṛtānnādinirvāhā dharmasaṃsthitā |||55||
sācintayat patirnaṣṭaḥ putrā naṣṭāśca pañca vai |
putrī nāsti kuṭumbaṃ na jātistu vartate mama ||56||
cāraṇyo’pi bhavantyatra bahvyo gārhasthyamāśritāḥ |
mriyante cāpi jāyante vinā tā bhaktimantarā |||57||
patayo bahavaḥ prāptāstābhiścānto na vidyate |
patīnāṃ sutaputrīṇāṃ māyānto’pi na vidyate ||58||
kāmadevasya cānto na viṣayāṇāṃ layo’pi na |
karmaṇāṃ naiva viratiḥ kathaṃ janmakṣayo bhavet ||59||
vāsanāḥ pratyahaṃ nūtnā jāyante bhogasaṃbhavāḥ |
ātmanastatra mokṣo na kāmarasena yoṣitām ||4.15.60||
tasmāccharīramāsādya durlabhaṃ mokṣadaṃ tvidam |
tena labhyaḥ śāśvato yo brahmaraso nirāmayaḥ ||61||
paramātmā sādhavaśca mūrtimanto dharātale |
bhūtvā tu mānavāścāpi mānavyastasya śaktayaḥ ||62||
vicaranti śreyase dehināṃ tyāgasvarūpiṇaḥ |
tasya mānavarūpasya śrīhareḥ sādhurūpiṇaḥ ||63|||
sādhūnāṃ sevayā prasādena kiṃkarīcaryayā |
brahmaraso hyavāpyeta nānyathā tu kathaṃcana ||64||
harirvā hariṇī vātra haribhaktāśca sādhavaḥ |
parabrahmarasābdhisthāḥ pāyayanti parānapi ||65||
tasmānmayā sadā sevyāḥ sādhavaḥ kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ |
sādhvyo lakṣmīsvarūpāśca rādhāramātmikāstathā ||66||
tatprasaṃgena bhagavān miliṣyati priyāpatiḥ |
vinā mastakadānena sāmrājyaṃ nopalabhyate ||67||
vinā sarvasvadānena svāmitvaṃ durlabhaṃ khalu |
karmacite karmaloke kṛtasya phalamaśnute ||68||
ahaṃ dadāmi sarvasvaṃ kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇasevine |
tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svasarvasvaṃ mahyaṃ dāsyati niścitam ||69||
na me vighnaṃ kuṭumbātma na me śāstā patistathā |
na me bandho nṛpasyāpi svatantrāsmi sukhānvitā ||4.15.70 ||
mahadbhāgyodayo jāto yanmāyābandhanaṃ gatam |
adhunā prāpya kṛṣṇasya bandhanaṃ tatsatāmapi ||71 ||
brahmānandamahānandaṃ prāpsyāmi śrīśasevanāt |
vicāryetthaṃ nāgamukhī cāraṇī brahmacāriṇī |||72||
nijāvāse satāṃ sevāṃ cakre tīrthanivāsinām |
sādhvīnāṃ satataṃ sevā cakre dugdhādibhirmudā ||73||
nāgamukhyā bhāvabhaktiṃ śrutvā cāyānti sādhavaḥ |
nivasanti gṛhe tasyāḥ sevate tān mudānvitā ||74||
sādhuvrataṃ vidadhānā vartate sevikottamā |
uṣṇodakaiḥ snapayati tailādyaṃgavimardanaiḥ ||75||
prātardugdhāni coṣṇāni saśarkarailāni bhāvukī |
kesarāḍhyāni sādhūm̐śca saṃpāyayati cāraṇī ||76||
candanena satāṃ bhāle vakṣasyūrvośca pādayoḥ |
pūjanaṃ prakarotyeṣā puṣpamālārpaṇaistathā ||77||
ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā madhyāhnabhojanādikam |
pācayitvā miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ saṃbhojayati cāraṇī ||78||
sādhavo’pi prabhuktvaiva kurvanti bhajanaṃ hareḥ |
sāyaṃ sā cāraṇī sādhūn bhojayitvā tataḥ svayam ||79||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ satāṃ karotyasaṃśayā satī |
sādhurūpaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāste milatyapi ||4.15.80 ||
sādhusevā nirguṇā ca divyā pāpavināśinī |
mokṣadā ceti matvaiva śayyāyāṃ sāti modate ||81||
evaṃ sā cāraṇī devī sādhuvrataṃ karoti hi |
śraddhayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ raṭati nityadā ||82||
sādhusevodbhavaṃ cātmānandaṃ dehasukhādikam |
parabrahmarasaṃ matvā tṛptā tatra pramodate ||83||
asmin sādhau parasmin vā cānyasmin vā hariḥ svayam |
miliṣyati prasanno me sevayeti prasevate ||84||
athaikadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ |
sādhurūpaṃ gṛhītvaiva bahusādhusamāyutaḥ ||85||
yayau tasyā gṛhaṃ mātarbālakṛṣṇasvarūpadhṛk |
rūpe guṇe śarīre ca vilakṣaṇaśca tejasi ||86||
cāraṇyāstu manastatra lagnaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe |
sarvān sādhūn bhojayitvā sevitvā dehamardanaiḥ ||87||
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe tu satataṃ sphurantaṃ taṃ vilakṣaṇam |
rātryardhānte yayau suptaṃ tejaḥparidhimaṇḍitam ||88||
brahmānandabharaṃ śītaguṇaṃ candrātiśītalam |
pīyūṣātisukhavārddhiṃ sundaraṃ puṣṭayauvanam ||89||
āśliṣya prathamaṃ sparśasukhaṃ lebhe tu cāraṇī |
tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇasya mūrteḥ sarvendriyodbhavam ||4.15.90||
ākarṣaṇādisaṃpuṣṭapravāhānandasāgaram |
mahāsukhaṃ cāraṇī sā lebhe sarvendriyodbhavam ||9 1 ||
tallīnā sā jaḍevāsīd dehabhānādivarjitā |
līnābhavat kṛṣṇamūrtau yathā saṃsārapāragā ||92||
āprātaḥ sā harau saktā sarvāṃgasparśamodanā |
nottasthau kṛṣṇasaṃśliṣṭaśayyātaścāraṇī tadā ||93||
daśasāhasrayugajaṃ brahmarasāmṛtāśanam |
labdhvā tṛptiṃ gatā kṛṣṇecchayāpi brahmacāriṇī ||94||
aviplutā kṛṣṇavat sā kārṣṇī divyā vyajāyata |
atha kṛṣṇaḥ prage prāha paśya me rūpamaiśvaram ||95||
ityuktvā darśayāmāsākṣaraṃ dhāma parātparam |
anantamuktajuṣṭaṃ ca nijarūpaṃ suśobhanam ||96||
anantarādhālakṣmyādisevitaṃ badarīpatim |
tato’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kuṃkumavāpyayam ||97||
bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ ca darśayāmāsa sundaram |
tatastūrṇaṃ tirobhāvyāvadat tāṃ cāraṇīṃ satīm ||98||
kimicchasi dadāmyatra tvayā santaḥ pratoṣitāḥ |
ahaṃ phalaṃ pradātuṃ te samāgato’smi tvatpatiḥ ||99||
cāraṇī prāha bhagavan mahiṣīmaṇḍalena vai |
sākaṃ cāhaṃ tava dhāmākṣaraṃ prayāmi dehi tat || 4.15.10 0||
tathāstviti prabhuḥ prāha tāvad vimānamāyayau |
tenaiva divyadehena cāraṇīṃ nāgnakaisarīm || 101 ||
nāma kṛtvā vimāne ca saṃgṛhya parameśvaraḥ |
paśudehān mahiṣīṇāṃ tyājayitvā ca tā api || 1 02||
divyadehā vidhāyaiva nāgnakaisarīdāsikāḥ |
akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ nināya kṛtavallabhaḥ || 1 03||
brahmahrade snapayitvā muktānikā vidhāya ca |
brahmānandarasaṃ datvā mokṣapade rarakṣa tāḥ || 1 04||
evaṃ mātaścāraṇī sā premṇā satāṃ prasevayā |
parabrahmarasaṃ prāpa divyā muktā babhūva ha || 1 05||
so’yaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo rājate śrīpatiḥ patiḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśasyāśramāntike || 1 06||
rājādhirājo bhagavān koṭyarbudābjaśaktidhṛk |
vṛto mayāpi sa svāmī brahmarasaṃ labhāmyapi || 1 07||
ityuktvā badarīdevi kṣaṇaṃ sā bālayoginī |
virarāma patiṃ svasyā vallabhaṃ saṃgatā hṛdi || 1 08||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ parabrahmapremarasavarṇanaṃ nāgnamukhīcāraṇyāḥ satāṃ sevayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptirbrahmarasāptirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||

<4.16>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye tvaṃ yatprāha śrībālayoginī |
narmakartrīsamākhyānaṃ mātaraṃ brahmarāsanam || 1 ||
tatte vakṣyāmi kṛṣṇasya brahmarasāśanapradam |
yacchrutvāpi narā nāryastadrītyā yānti mokṣaṇam || 2 ||
āsīd grāme kāmayāne nāmnā devalako janaḥ |
tasya bhāryābhavat sādhvī narmakāryavicakṣaṇā || 3 ||
audāsīnyagatasyāpi mahāduḥkhagatasya ca |
hāsyavinodaśūnyasya hāsyaṃ janayate tu sā || 4 ||
tatkālocitalāvaṇyapūrṇavākyaistathetaraiḥ |
yāvadrasaprayogaiśca narma janayate drutam || 5 ||
gṛhe samāgatā lokāḥ prasannamānasā hyati |
jāyante vārtayā tasyāḥ samarpayanti copadāḥ || 6 ||
dhanaṃ bhūṣā ambarāṇi miṣṭānnāni śubhāni ca |
dhānyāni copakaraṇānyapi sarve’rpayanti ca || 7 ||
rājā rājasabhāyāṃ ca mahotsave nijotsave |
sūrikāvyottaraṃ tasyā hāsyarasaṃ yunaktyapi || 8 ||
sabhā prasannā bhavati modante mānavā hyati |
rājā tasyai mahāpāritoṣikaṃ pradadātyapi || 9 ||
evaṃ sā devalabhāryā nāmnā vinodinī satī |
saurāṣṭre subhage deśe prasiddhā saṃvyajāyata || 4.16.1 0||
hāsyakalābhyasanārthaṃ tvāyānti yoṣito narāḥ |
tān sā yathāyathaṃ sarvān śikṣayatyapi sarvathā || 1 1||
athaikadāgamattasyā gṛhe satāṃ sumaṇḍalam |
sādhvīnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ cāpi bhagavadbhaktikārakam || 12||
bhojitā vanditāḥ sarve gṛhe svāgatakarmabhiḥ |
tayā prasevitāścāpi rātrau cakruḥ sukīrtanam || 1 3||
sādhūnāṃ kīrtanaṃ śrutvā sādhvīnāṃ gītikāstathā |
parameśamatirjātā bhaktidharmaparāyaṇā || 14||
vinodinyā vicāro’bhūd vinodena hariḥ svayam |
yathā satāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ kītanaiḥ suprasādavān || 15||
santuṣṭo jāyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraprabhuḥ |
tathā bhavet susantuṣṭo nityaṃ tathā karomyaham || 16||
vicāryetthaṃ brahmarasāyanākhyasādhutastu sā |
jagrāha vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ mokṣadaṃ tūlasīsrajam || 17||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ mūrtiṃ jagrāha citrajām || 18||
pupūja tāṃ harermūrtiṃ nityaṃ prasevate mudā |
bhaktā jātā hareḥ śuddhā vinodinī vilāsinī || 19||
sā papraccha guruṃ sādhuṃ brahmarasāyanābhidham |
brahmānandamahāmiṣṭānandarasāptisādhanam ||4.16.20||
atyādareṇa tāṃ śiṣyāṃ prāha brahmarasāyanaḥ |
sarve rasā yatra caikībhavanti parame rase ||21||
śrīmatsvāmibālakṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvatāriṇi |
tadāptistadrasāptestu sādhanaṃ bhagavān svayam ||22||
premabhaktyātmasarvasvaniveditā hareḥpriyā |
ātmanivedanenāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ samavāpyate ||23||
ātmanivedanaṃ snehapremānurāgasaṃbhṛtam |
prātikūlyālasatvāśraddhādidoṣavivarjitam ||24||
anyavṛttyapratihataṃ satatasphūrtigocaram |
divyāparokṣabhānāḍhyaśrīkṛṣṇakāntasaṃśritam ||25||
pañcabhūtaśarīre’syāveśaḥ kṛṣṇasya sarvathā |
indriyāṇāṃ gocareṣu mūrtistasyaiva tadguṇāḥ ||26||
tadviṣayāstanmādhuryaṃ tatsukhaṃ tatpramoditā ||
tadrasastasya saṃsparśastadrūpaṃ tacchravastathā ||27||
tadgandhastasya cādānaṃ tadvihārastatsarjanam |
tadānandaśca mananaṃ tasya sañcintanaṃ matiḥ ||28||
tanmānaṃ tannirṇayaśca tatpramā tatsmṛtistathā |
tatsaṃskārāstadicchā ca sa jñeyo jñaptisaṃgrahe ||29||
sphūrtau bhāne virāme ca sa eva gocaraḥ sadā |
antarbahiśca sa eva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||4.16.30 ||
gupte prakāśe hṛdaye nirjane sajane’pi saḥ |
kriyāyāṃ nijaceṣṭāyāṃ hāsye pramodane ca saḥ ||3 1 ||
sarvathābhūṣaṇādau ca śṛṃgāre’pi harirhi saḥ |
snāne svapane dhūlyādau vinode ca vrate’pi saḥ ||32||
svatve pārakyarūpe ca samarpaṇe grahe’pi ca |
ādāne ca pratidāne vinimaye’pi māpatiḥ ||33||
paritaḥ sanmukhe pṛṣṭhe madhye’dhaścārdhake’pi saḥ |
anuyogī pratiyogī saṃsarge’pi harirhi saḥ ||34||
āsvādye rasyavikṛtau tṛptau peye’tiśītale |
kāmye cākarṣaṇe goṣṭhau vinode’pi ca mādhavaḥ ||35||
gṛhe vane catvare ca vitardau maṃcake’pi saḥ |
dolāyāṃ ca vimāne ca yāne ca vāhane’pi saḥ ||36||
iṣyamāṇe ca tadbhinne mahānandātmako hariḥ |
ānukūlyapravāhe ca pracchādye’pi prabhurhi saḥ ||37||
evaṃ sarvatra bhagavān yasyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva hi |
tasyā bhaktiḥ premapūrṇā sādhanaṃ kṛṣṇalabdhikṛt ||38||
kṛṣṇāptau tadrasāptiśca śāśvatī cānivartinī |
tadyogajā bhaved divyā cātmārpaṇarasādijā ||39||
anyathā nāpyate kṛṣṇo nāpyate tadraso’pi ca |
nāpyate śāśvatānando vinodini kṛpāṃ vinā ||4.16.40||
sevayā tvarjayettasya kṛpāṃ snehena tanmanaḥ |
arpaṇenārjayet kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇena tanmahārasam ||41||
phalaṃ brahmarasaṃ prāpya prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate |
ityuktā guruṇā sādhvī vinodinī tu devalī ||42||
guroḥ sevāṃ tathā cakre yathā śikṣā samarjitā |
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo gururnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||43||
pratyakṣaḥ sarvaphalado yathābhaktānuvartanaḥ |
