gururbrahma guruḥ kṛṣṇo gururjīvahariḥ prabhuḥ ||44||
sa eva toṣitaḥ samyak sarvamānuṣanāṭanaḥ |
tayā pratoṣito deveśvarādhipanarāyaṇaḥ ||45||
matvaivaṃ sā guruṃ bhaktyā toṣayāmāsa sundarī |
brahmacaryaparā dharmaparā sevāparāyaṇā ||46||
gurustasyā gṛhe vāsaṃ ciraṃ cakāra śāntimān |
athaikadā dadhārāsau rūpaṃ devalakasya vai ||47||
atha taṃ sundaraṃ kāntaṃ patiṃ guruṃ vibudhya sā |
uvāca parayā prītyā dhanyāsmyanugrahārthinī ||48||
yatheṣṭaṃ gurudeva tvaṃ mama svāmisvarūpadhṛk |
prasevasva nijāṃ matvā brahmarasaṃ prapāyaya 449||
pātivratyaṃ svāmyadhīnaṃ svāmī tvaṃ vartase’dhunā |
nārāyaṇasvarūpastvaṃ svāmirūpo’si gṛhṇa mām ||4.16.50||
atha prasanno gururāḍ vīkṣya sarvāṃ subhāvanām |
agṛhya tāṃ tataścāśīrvādaṃ dadau hṛdā mudā ||51||
bhava dāsī hareḥ patnī bhaktā caikāntinī parā |
divyalakṣmīsamā śiṣyā nārāyaṇī narottamī |||52||
ahaṃ tvatsevayā tuṣṭo dadāmi te’tivaibhavam |
camatkāraṃ divyarūpadhāriṇī sukhinī bhava ||53||
ityuktvā śrīgururbrahmarasāyano vinodinīm |
pasparśa karamātreṇa pāyayāmāsa vāri ca ||54||
tāvad divyā pararūpā rādhālakṣmīsamā satī |
nirāvaraṇadehā ca sambabhūva vinodinī ||55||
evaṃ jātā divyadevī divyakriyātimānuṣī |
guruḥ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛṣṇapūjāṃ samarpya ca ||56||
tirobabhūva sahasā vidyullateva cāmbare |
vīkṣyaivaṃ paramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ camatkāraṃ gurāvapi ||57||
vinodinī mahāścaryaparā stabdhābhavat kṣaṇam |
tarkayāmāsa bahudhā ko’yaṃ gurusvarūpadhṛk ||58||
sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ kiṃvā naro nārāyaṇānujaḥ |
īśvaro vāntarātmā vā parabrahma prabhuśca vā ||59||
divyatāṃ saṃgatā yasya kṛpayā sparśanena ca |
tathāpi divyadṛṣṭyāyaṃ gururmayā na vīkṣyate ||4.16.60||
ato’tidivyalokastho bhavennārāyaṇo guruḥ |
māyālokāstu me dṛṣṭergocarāḥ santi cādhunā ||61||
dṛśyate na gurustatra tato brahma bhavedayam |
aho prāpto vinodinyā vinodena vinodakṛt ||62|||
athāpi dhanyabhāgyāsmi gurvarpitāmamāyikīm |
kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ bhajiṣye’haṃ yatiṣye labdhaye punaḥ ||63||
ityevaṃ sā mahāśāntiṃ matvā dhyāyati cācyutam |
tāvadanye sādhavaśca sādhvyaścāpi tiro’bhavan ||64||
sarve te śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau layaṃ gatāḥ |
atha prāptā niścayaṃ sā gururmūrtiriyaṃ yataḥ ||65||
sākṣānnārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe sarve’tra vilayaṃ gatāḥ |
gururmūrtiṃ ca me datvā tiro’bhavanna lokyate ||66||
tataḥ so’yaṃ vartate’dya svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
evaṃ tvatiprasantuṣṭā prāha devalakaṃ patim ||67||
mūrtiścāyaṃ svayaṃ sādhurbrahmarasāyanātmakaḥ |
cetano’pi pratimāste dhanyaḥ svāmin bhavasyapi ||68||
āvayoḥ paramaṃ bhāgyaṃ vinodena ca dehinām |
antarātmā pratuṣṭaḥ sannasmadgṛhamapāyayau ||69||
vinodayiṣye satataṃ taṃ sākṣātpuruṣottamam |
sevāṃ karotu bhagavan bhavān svāmin sadāsya vai ||4.16.70||
atha mūrtiṃ sajīvāṃ tāṃ sevete tau mudānvitau |
yathoktarītyā deveśaṃ yathāsatkāramānanam ||71||
devalako nityamevārcayatyacyutamutsukaḥ |
kintu vinodinī bheje prabhuṃ pratyakṣavat patim ||72||
tathāpi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścetanarūpavān |
nāvirbhavati mūrtestu bhāvābhijñaściraṃ kvacit ||73||
asthairyaṃ tu vinodinyāḥ parīkṣituṃ samicchati |
vinodinī gate varṣe mūrteḥ sevanatastataḥ ||74||
vrataṃ jagrāha mūrtyagre’naśanaṃ darśanecchayā |
māsaṃ vrataṃ cakāraiva mūrtyagre kamalāsane ||75||
sanniṣaktā kare mālāṃ dhṛtvā jajāpa keśavam |
netrābhyāṃ tanmūrtirūpaṃ manasā mananaṃ hareḥ ||76||
ātmanā sphuraṇaṃ tasya svapnādau pratimāṃ hareḥ |
ālocayati nānyadvai pūjāyāṃ sparśanaṃ vyadhāt ||77||
yāvadindriyavṛttīḥ sā niyuyojāntare harau |
bāhye harau niyuyoja bāhyabhānāpi sundarī ||78||
bāhyāntaraikyamāpannā caikatānaparāyaṇā |
abhavat sā satī bhaktā vinodinī vare’cyute |||79|||
atha śrībhagavānasyā hāsyarasābhilālasaḥ |
nāvirbhavati vyaktātmā pratīkṣate vinodanam ||4.16.80||
māsottaro vyatīyāya samayastvekakāsane |
tato mūrtervinodaṃ sā kartumārabdhavatyapi ||8 1||
dṛśyase tvaṃ caikamukho tathāpi vimukho hyasi |
dvimukhyāḥ pañjare nyasto bhaviṣyasyamukho’ntare ||82||
prasravaṇapraśūnyastvaṃ cāvyaktasravaṇe dhṛtaḥ |
bhaviṣyasyasravo nityaṃ sasravo bhava matkṛte ||83||
evaṃ vinodavākyāni mūrterhāsyāya māninī |
muktakaṇṭhena satataṃ jagāda kṛṣṇasannidhau ||84||
athāpyāha hariṃ sā ca narmavākyaṃ tataḥ param |
mahadrūpo’si satataṃ vitastimūrtitāṃ gataḥ ||85||
praveṣṭuṃ ca hiraṇgarbhaṃ kimicchasi tathā kuru |
evamābhāṣyāsanāt sā samutthāya nanarta ha ||86||
tāvatprasannatāṃ prāptaḥ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
mūrtiṃ vivṛtya sahasā tejasā vyāptavigrahaḥ ||87||
yuvā kiśoraḥ samabhūddhāsyaṃ kṛtvā puraḥsthitaḥ |
samāśliṣyat satīṃ bhaktāmapāyayad rasaṃ nijam ||88||
mūrteḥ sukhaṃ dadau tasyai sarvendriyādigocaram |
tato vinodinīṃ mūrtau līnībhūtāṃ cakāra saḥ ||89||
yāvat svasya sukhaṃ divyaṃ sarvaṃ tasyai dadau prabhuḥ |
tṛptābhavattu sā divyā divyamuktānikā drutam ||4.16.90||
abhavanmāyayā hīnā brahmaloke sthitā yathā |
tāvat tatra mahāpuṇyairdevalo’pi samāyayau ||91||
vīkṣya kāntena kṛṣṇena kārṣṇīṃ vinodinīṃ satīm |
nijaṃ cāpi tathaicchat saḥ kṛṣṇe dravamavāptavān ||92||
śrīkṛṣṇo’pi paraṃ bhāvaṃ jñātvā devalakāntare |
sakhīrūpaṃ vinodinyā iva taṃ yoṣitaṃ vyadhāt ||93|| |
nararūpaṃ vihāyaiva sakhī devalikābhavat |
vinodinīsamā rūpe sarvathā kṛpayā hareḥ ||94||
yathā lakṣmīḥpriyā rādhā tathā devalikābhavat |
ubhe muktānike jāte divye divyavibhūṣite ||95||
divyabrahmarasāḍhye ca divyakṛṣṇasvarūpike |
līne jāte kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe taddehasaṃsthite ||96||
evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntaste hyubhe dhāma nināya vai |
śāśvate brahmaparamānandasukhe mamajjatuḥ ||97||
mātaścaivaṃ brahmamahārasapānāśanaṃ sadā |
jāyate kṛṣṇabhaktāyāstathā me vidyate’dhunā ||98||
na me’nyatrāsti bhavanaṃ bhāvanā śrīhariṃ vinā |
brahmaraso harāvastītyuktvā maunaṃ samādadhat ||99||
ityevaṃ badarīdevi parabrahmaraso’vyayaḥ |
yathāpyate tayāptaścobhābhyāmāptastathoditaḥ || 4.16.10 0||
yā cānyā vānya evāpi sarvasvabhāvanārpaṇāt |
uktarītyā parabrahmānandarasamavāpnuyāt || 101 ||
parabrahmarasāvāptau parabrahmāsti kāraṇam |
sādhurūpasya sevāpi parabrahmāptikāraṇam || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ parabrahmarasāśanāptaye vinodinyā devalakapatnyā vinodena prasāditabhagavato brahmarasāyanasādhurūpeṇa sākṣātprāptirmokṣaṇaṃ devalakasya sakhītvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||

<4.17>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi punaḥ sā bālayoginī |
sureśvarī mātaraṃ yajjagāda kathayāmi te || 1 ||
saurāṣṭre mahuvāsākhye pattane’bdhitaṭe śubhe |
bahurūpo’bhavacchūdro naikaveṣābhidhārakaḥ || 2 ||
rūpe tvindrasamo dehe yuvā ṣoḍaśavatsaraḥ |
nārīmukhaḥ sujaṭilaḥ keśaveṣābhisundaraḥ || 3 ||
karṇanāsāvibhūṣādidhārakaḥ samayo kvacit |
kvacid rājā kvacid rājñī kvacit senāpatistathā || 4 ||
kvacicchreṣṭhī kvaciccauraḥ kvacit kanyā kumārakaḥ |
kvacid vadhūḥ kvacid devī devaḥ kvacinnaṭaḥ kvacit || 5 ||
kvacid vipraḥ kvacid yoddhā daridro bhikṣukaḥ kvacit |
kvacid vanecaro naukāvāhaḥ kvacittu karṣukaḥ || 6 ||
kvacit preto vānaraśca kvacid bhallukarūpadhṛk |
kvacit putravatī bhāryā kvacid vājiniyāmakaḥ || 7 ||
kvacit sādhuryatiḥ svāmī brahmacārī ca tāpasaḥ |
kvacinnarmakaraḥ sarvaśṛṃgārāḍhyaḥ kvacit khalaḥ || 8 ||
evaṃvidhaḥ sa bhavati veṣarūpāḍhyaceṣṭitaiḥ |
bāhulakaitināmnā taṃ vadanti prajājanāḥ || 9 ||
nṛtye veṣe gāyane taṃ kuśalaṃ vādyavādane |
āhūya cotsavān lokāḥ kurvanti janarañjanān || 4.17.1 0||
pūrvabhāgyavaśāt tasya patnī tatsadṛśī tataḥ |
vivāhitābhavat kanyā nāmnā līlāvatī śubhā || 11 ||
gāndharvīva kalābhijñā sarvaveṣābhidhāriṇī |
caturā naravat prājñā naraveṣeṣu kovidā || 12||
pūrvaṃ samyak kṛto’bhyāso janmāntare phalatyapi |
dharmo dhanārpaṇaṃ sevā bhaktiḥ phalanti kālataḥ || 1 3||
nākṛtaṃ prāpyate kiñciddharyanugrahamantarā |
pūrvadattā śubhā vidyā nārī sampat sukhāni ca || 14||
janmāntare’bhilabhyante guṇā yaśo dhanāni ca |
tathaiva kṛtapāpānāṃ copatiṣṭhanti cādhayaḥ || 15||
sukṛtīnāṃ sūtsavāstu pravardhante dine dine |
bhāryā naivālpapuṇyena labhyate nijasakriyā || 16||
guṇe rūpe svabhāve ca vicāre hṛdaye samā |
cāturye ca viveke ca bahupuṇyena labhyate || 17||
patiścāpi tathā patnyā svānukūlasvabhāvavān |
nālpapuṇyena labhyeta labhyate tapasā tu vai || 18||
hānau duḥkhe tathodvege kaiṃkarye nirdhanasthitau |
roge vipadi pīḍāyāṃ samacittau hi durlabhau || 19||
hānyādau samacittau cet svarge tayoḥ karasthitam |
lābhādau tu bhavetāṃ vai samacittau gṛhegṛhe ||4.17.20 ||
lābhahānyoḥ samacittāḥ sādhavo yogino’malāḥ |
nārāyaṇo’tibuddhāśca puṇyā vā gṛhadharmiṇaḥ ||2 1 ||
evametau yuyujāte kinnvekasya kṛtidvayam |
evaṃvidhau tau sukhinau nāṭyādivyavasāyinau ||22||
nāṭyaprasaṃge copārjya dhanānnāmbaravastubhiḥ |
samyaṅnirvahato yātrāṃ prāṇāderlokadustarām || 23||
prayātastīrthayātrāyāṃ somanāthaṃ ca raivatam |
dvārāvatīṃ camatkārapuraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||24||
tatrākṣare śubhe kṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare |
snātvā śrīlomaśaṃ gatvā nematuḥ sadgurumṛṣīn ||25||
jagṛhaturmahāmantraṃ māyāpāśavināśakam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||26||
vaiṣṇavau paramau jātau bhaktau yathā kṛtaśramau |
uṣaturbahukālaṃ ca bhejaturbālakṛṣṇakam ||27||
gopālabālakaṃ divyaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
nityamānarcatuḥ prītyā bhejatuḥ mādhavīpatim ||28||
cakratuśca sadā tatra satsaṃgaṃ jñānamāpatuḥ |
divyatāṃ prāpatuścobhau vartete dāsyaśobhitau ||29||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
śuśruvatuśca tatratyāvatāracaritāni ca ||4.17.30||
pradadhyatuḥ surāṇāṃ sannṛpāṇāṃ caritānyapi |
muktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ caritānyapi ||3 1 ||
śrutvā hṛdaye saṃklṛpya cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe |
yathāśrutāni sarvāṇi veṣaceṣṭākriyādibhiḥ || 32||
tāvavatārayāmāsaturdarśayāmāsaturmuhuḥ |
rātrau cāndryāṃ hi kaumudyāṃ janebhyo’timudānvitau ||33||
janāstu lakṣaśo dṛṣṭvā bhavanti cakitā hyati |
naṭīṃ naṭaṃ praśaṃsanti bahurūpābhiyoginau ||34||
devatulyāvimau staśca nārāyaṇāṃśakāviva |
purāvṛttaṃ tadākāraṃ yaccopasthāpayanti vai ||35||
mānārhau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre jātau surūpiṇau |
evaṃvidhayoḥ samprāptaḥ samayo bhāgyavardhanaḥ ||36||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanmadinotsavaḥ |
saptadaśastatra devā muktāḥ santaḥ samāyayuḥ || 37||
īśvarā mānavādyāśca sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ |
maharṣitīrthaviprāśca kalāvidaḥ samāyayuḥ ||38||
ramādyāḥ śaktayaścāpi prajā lokāḥ samāyayuḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||39||
sambandhino bhuvanānāṃ vāsinaśca samāyayuḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanmatithyūrjakṛṣṇakāṣṭamīm ||4.17.40||
abhilakṣya niśāyāmāyayuḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ prātarevāyaṃ snātvā śrīkṛṣṇamādhavaḥ ||41||
kṛtamaṃgalapūjādiḥ kṛtakautukaśobhanaḥ |
koṭyarbudābjapatnībhiḥ kṛtārcanasuvandanaḥ ||42||
mātrā pitrā vṛddhajanaiḥ śvaśrūbhiḥ śvaśurādibhiḥ |
kṛtāśīrvādasadbhāgyaḥ kṛtaveṣābhisundaraḥ ||43||
sabhāyāṃ tu viśālāyāṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe |
sarvasṛṣṭijanāḍhyāyāṃ yuktāyāṃ lomaśādibhiḥ ||44||
gajāsane jayakārān śṛṇvan kṛṣṇasadyaśaḥ |
niṣasāda samāgatya tadāvādyanta sarvaśaḥ ||45||
vādyāni sarvalokānāṃ gītayaścābhavan śubhāḥ |
vedaghoṣā maharṣīṇāmabhavan karṇapāvanāḥ ||46||
snehabharāṇi sarveṣāṃ vilokanāni cābhavan |
harṣāḥ pramodā ānandā mūrtimantastadābhavan ||47||
pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ lomaśaḥ ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ |
dvijā nṛpāśca pitaraḥ siddho īśvarakoṭayaḥ ||48||
apsarasaśca devyaśca mānavyo mānavādayaḥ |
pātālādinivāsāśca tīrthāni jaḍacetanāḥ ||49||
samastasiddhayo vṛddhā nāryo devyo ramādikāḥ |
sādhvyaśca sādhavaścāpi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||4.17.50||
tilakaṃ candanādyaiścākṣatakuṃkumamaṃgalaiḥ |
candrakaṃ te pracakruśca puṣpahārān nyadhurgale ||51 ||
gandhasārān śabdasārān mantrasārān śubhāśiṣaḥ |
pradaduścopadāścāpi hṛdayāni viśeṣataḥ ||52||
mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale hārān kaṭakāni ca śṛṃkhalāḥ |
ūrmikāśca maṇīn ratnasvarṇabhūṣāśca te daduḥ ||53||
yaśogānānyabhavam̐śca nartanānyabhavam̐stathā |
tāmbūladānapānādi miṣṭānnamaṃgalāni ca ||54||
hastadhūnanamevāpi tadābhavan samājake |
mahīmānābhiyogāśca sabhāyāṃ cābhavam̐stadā ||55||
ārārtrikaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyarṣigaṇā vyadhuḥ |
muktādyāḥ saṃstavān cakruścaivaṃ mahotsavo’bhavat ||56||
atrotsave tu samprāpyāvasaraṃ bahurūpadhṛk |
bāhulakaśca tatpatnī kṛtaveṣau susundarau ||57||
camatkārakarau sabhyamanoharau sabhāntare |
āyayaturhasantau tāvubhau strīveṣaśobhanau ||58||
kā nārī ko naraścetyaviditau tau sabhājanaiḥ |
rūpātisundarau devairaparīkṣyau tadā kṣaṇe ||59||
samakaṇṭhasvarau hāvabhāvāṃgavyañjanaiḥ samau |
sarvajño’pi hariḥ sākṣāttadarthe mugdhatāṃ gataḥ ||4.17.60||
kā kathā tu tadānyeṣāṃ māyāḍhyacarmacakṣuṣān |
evaṃ sabhāpi sahasā vīkṣya striyau samantataḥ ||61 ||
stabdhatāṃ vai gatā yadvanmugdhā puttalikāmayī |
gāyanaṃ te striyau tatra vālakṛṣṇayaśomayam ||62||
cakratuḥ sarvakāmānāmānandarasapūritam |
prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastābhyāṃ maṇīn dadau ||63||
ratnahārānalaṃkārānāśiṣaśca śubhā dadau |
atha nṛtyaṃ cakratuste striyau bhāvādigarbhitam ||64||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavṛttāntagānayuk |
akṣarādhipatiḥ sākṣāt parameśo’si mānavaḥ ||65||
bhavān yeṣāṃ tu jihvāsu manassu ca matiṣvapi |
ātmasvapi nartako’sti teṣāṃ mokṣo hi śāśvataḥ ||66||
prasanno bhava bhagavan rūpaṃ nṛtyaṃ susārthakam |
kuru tvaṃ cāvayornāryoḥ pādasparśaṃ pradehi nau ||67||
omityāha sabhāmadhye prasannaḥ kṛṣṇanandanaḥ |
drutaṃ nāryau samāyātāṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāntikam ||68||
kṛṣṇacaraṇadhūlīṃ te cohaturmastake tathā |
urasyudare dehe ca tataḥ pādau hareḥ punaḥ ||69||
sparśayāmāsaturvakṣojayoḥ prasannamānase |
paśyatāṃ sabhyalokānāṃ tāvacchāṭīvihīnakau ||4.17.70||
puṃveṣasahitau tūrṇaṃ yuvānau saṃbabhūvatuḥ |
puṃbhāṣāsahitau sarvapumaṃkapariśobhitau ||71 ||
strītvaṃ gataṃ pravīkṣyaiva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
samājaśceśvarādyāśca mahāścaryaṃ prapedire ||72||
jagmuḥ sabhājanāstatra saṃśayaṃ vā narau striyau |
na nirṇayaṃ tadā kartuṃ samarthāḥ ke’pi cābhavan ||73||
mugdhā sabhā samājaśca sarve nirīkṣakāstadā |
athemau kiṃkiṇījālairghurghuraiḥ pādasaṃkramān ||74||
kurvantau raṃgamadhye tau mahānṛtyaṃ pracakratuḥ |
śaṃkaro’pi kṣaṇaṃ mugdho|ntarasaḥ sutarāṃ tadā |||75|||
gandharvā nartakāścānye galadgarvāstadābhavan |
atha nṛtyaṃ vidhāyaiva bālakṛṣṇamahāprabhoḥ ||76||
saṃspṛśya caraṇau prāpyopadāśca pāritoṣikam |
maṇiratnahīrakādi svarṇabhūṣāmbarādi ca ||77||
sabhāmadhye samanyasya tūrṇaṃ puṃbhāvavarjitau |
abhavatāmubhau tatra paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām ||78||
ṣaṇḍhaveṣau ṣaṇḍhabhāvau ṣaṇḍhavilāsanarmadau |
hastatālīparau netrakoṇollāsasamanvitau ||79||
ṣaṇḍhabhāṣāṃ bhāṣamāṇau sabhāhāsyakarāvubhau |
atha kṣaṇānte tatraiko naṭī bhūtvā nanarta ha ||4.17.80||
bhūtvāparo naṭastatra vādyaṃ śreṣṭhamavādayat |
paśyatāṃ devatādīnāṃ naṭī cādṛśyatāṃ gatā ||81 ||
naṭo’pi raṃgasātatyārthaṃ naṭī saṃbabhūva ha |
nanarta yāvad raṃge sā tāvannaṭī samāyayau ||82||
dṛṣṭvā naṭīṃ tu nṛtyantīṃ naro’bhavaddhi sā naṭī |
evaṃ bahusvarūpāṇi vīkṣya sabhātiharṣitā ||83||
tayordvayorbahumānaśabdān jagāda sā sabhā |
atha patnīpatirūpau kṣaṇānte varamālayā ||84||
yojitau dampatīrūpau sabhāmadhye babhūvatuḥ |
namaskāraṃ haraye ca sabhyebhyastau pracakratuḥ ||85||
aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ cakraturvinayānvitau |
tasthatuśca sabhāmadhye yathārtharūpamāsthitau ||86||
tadeśvarādyā devādyā mānavāḥ saṃśayojjhitāḥ |
abhavan ṛṣayaścāpi prasannāścābhavan hyati ||87||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā mātā śrīkaṃbharā satī ||88||
anye’pi lokapālādyā mahāścaryaparāyaṇāḥ |
upadāḥ pradadustābhyāṃ prasannatvaprayojitāḥ ||89||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasannamānasaḥ |
varadānaṃ grahītuṃ tāvuvāca tau tadā śubham ||4.17.90||
parabrahmarasānandaṃ varayāmāsaturhareḥ |
divyānandamahābrahmarasābdhau magnatāṃ parām ||9 1||
arthayāmāsatuḥ kṛṣṇānnārāyaṇāddhi keśavāt |
tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha tata ārabhya vai tayoḥ ||92||
nirvikalpasamādhiśca babhūva kṛṣṇamodadaḥ |
sarvabhūtendriyādīnāṃ vṛttiṣu sphuraṇaṃ hareḥ ||93||
sadā tayorabhavadvai yathākṣarasthamuktayoḥ |
evaṃ harerhi kṛpayā kalayā nijayāpi ca ||94||
bahurūpabhavanayā haryarthakṛtayā tadā |
parabrahmānandamahāsukhamodarasaṃ param ||95||
avāpatuḥ sadā divyaṃ divyadehendriyānvitau |
saptadaśo janmamahotsavaḥ sampūrṇatāṃ gataḥ ||96||
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi samājānāṃ tadābhavan |
pūjāśca paritoṣāśca mahādānāni cābhavan ||97||
evaṃ svāṃ mātaraṃ bālayoginyāha hareḥ rasam |
yau labdhavantau tau bhaktau vṛttau ca mādhavaṃ tataḥ ||98||
evaṃ brahmarasaṃ prāptā kṛpayāpi suśāśvatam |
bālayoginī saṃmagnā smṛtveśaṃ virarāma ha ||99||
evaṃ te kathito badrīpriye brahmarasaḥ paraḥ |
anugraheṇa kṛṣṇasyāvāpyate nānyathā kvacit || 4.17.1 00||
bahavaḥ sevayā prāptā brahmānandarasaṃ param |
kṛpayā bahavaḥ prāptā yathā brahmapriyāstviha || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ bālayoginyā mātre bahurūpadhṛgyugalasya bāhulakalīlāvatīnāmakasya bhaktivṛttāntakathanena parabrahmarasāvāptisādhanoktiḥ śrīhareḥsaptadaśajanmadinyotsavaśceti nirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||

<4.18>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi mātaraṃ bālayoginī |
tataśca punarutkarṣaṃ prāha brahmarasasya sā || 1 ||
bhadragrāme māliyāno mālākāro’bhavat purā |
māliyānasya bhāryābhūnmallikāśrītināmikā || 2 ||
udyānaṃ poṣayantau tau phalādivikrayārthinau |
puṣpamālādikartārau bhaktau tau sambabhūvatuḥ || 3 ||
yatra yatra śrutavantau paritastau surālayān |
saurāṣṭre tau gatavantau surapūjāṃ pracakratuḥ || 4 ||
sūryaṃ dāmodaraṃ somanāthaṃ śrīgopanāthakam |
guptaprayāgaṃ cāpyaśvapaṭṭasaraśca raivatam || 5 ||
camatkāraṃ dvāravatīṃ prajagmatuḥ pupūjatuḥ |
puṣpahāraphalādyaiśca tulasīdalagucchakaiḥ || 6 ||
kamalairvividhaiścāpi sthalapadmairjalābjakaiḥ |
mālatyādikusumaiśca pārijātādipuṣpakaiḥ || 7 ||
campakairbakulaiścāpi vallīpuṣpaistṛṇeśajaiḥ |
tathā ca kadalairmiṣṭairnavaraṃgādibhiśca vai || 8 ||
candanaiḥ śītalaiścāpi kesarādisumiśritaiḥ |
puṣpāṇāṃ bahurūpāṇāṃ bahusugandhaśālinām || 9 ||
aparyuṣitabhāvānāṃ divyānāṃ cittakarṣiṇām |
ūṣṇīṣaṃ pracchadapaṭīṃ catuṣphālaṃ ca dhotrakam ||4.18.1 0||
suravālaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ kambalaṃ cāṃgarakṣakam |
śāṭīṃ ca ghargharīṃ vakṣobadhnikāṃ kacalīnikām || 11 ||
kucalīṃ karpaṭīṃ caulīṃ caulaṃ tvantaḥpaṭīṃ tathā |
evamādīni vastrāṇi pauṣpāṇyeva vidhāya tau || 12||
tatra tatra śubhe tīrthe taddevīdevamūrtaye |
arpayāmāsatuḥ premṇā dhārayāmāsaturhṛdā || 13||
arhayāmāsaturdevaṃ devīṃ rādhāramāpriyāḥ |
mādhavīkṛṣṇaviṣṇuśrīnārāyaṇārkaśaṃkarān || 14 ||
sarvakausumaveṣān saṃklṛptvā dadaturmūrtaye |
mūrtisthā devatā devyo gaṇeśādyā haristathā || 15||
devikādyāḥ prasannā vai bhavanti bhaktivīkṣakāḥ |
atha bhūṣā samastāśca puṣpamayīrvidhāya tau || 16||
arpayāmāsaturnityaṃ devebhyo bhaktiśālinau |
mukuṭaṃ grathitaṃ puṣpaiḥ kuṇḍale karṇapūrakau || 17||
gacchau ca kandukaṃ hārān mālāśca kaṭakau śubhau |
śṛṃkhalā vividhāścāpi raśanāḥ kaṭisūtrakam || 18||
keśahārān stanapatre bhālapatre ca tantikām |
śikhāmaṇiṃ tathā cūḍāmaṇiṃ kaustubhamuttamam || 19||
pādayorjhaṃjharīścāpi cakrāṇi cormikāstathā |
naktakaṃ keśapūrām̐śca tathā dhammilamālikāḥ ||4.18.20 ||
kabarīsrak nābhicandrau tathānitambacandrakau |
sakthimālāḥ śubhāḥ prakoṣṭhapatrāṇi ca mañjarīḥ ||21||
pṛṣṭhasūryāṃ kaṇṭhapatrāṃ caivaṃvidhāni yānyapi |
bhūṣaṇāni bhavantyeva tāni sarvāṇi tāvubhau ||22||
vidhāya vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kalākauśalyaśālinau |
tīrthadevān snehabhaktyā mudā śṛṃgāraśobhitān ||23||
cakratustau pratyahaṃ vai gatvā gatvā surālayān |
śraddhā pravardhate nityaṃ sukhaṃ tayoḥ pravardhate ||24||
khyātiḥ pravardhate divyā puṇyaṃ pravardhate’vyayam |
pūjāṃ prakurvatoḥ pauṣpaistayorhareranugrahaḥ ||25||
devānāṃ kṛtapūjānāṃ prasannatāpi vardhate |
evaṃ tau bahupuṇyau vai jātau priyatamau tathā 26||
akhilānāṃ tu devānāṃ puṣpapūjādikāriṇau |
āśīrvādātipātratvaṃ prāptau devādyanugraham ||27||
athaikadā hariḥ sākṣād dātumiyeṣa darśanam |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre pūjayantau nijaṃ yadā ||28||
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre yāḥ santi divyamūrtayaḥ |
mandirāṇi samastāni devālayāstathā śubhāḥ ||29||
tatra tatra haristasmai mūrtidvārā camatkṛtim |
darśayituṃ pāyayituṃ brahmarasaṃ madhuprabham ||4.18.30||
dātumiyeṣa tau divyaṃ darśanaṃ pratimodbhavam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svarṇālaye yadā ||3 1||
prātastābhyāṃ pūjito vai puṣpaśṛṃgārakāmbaraiḥ |
tadā sa mānavaḥ kṛṣṇo babhūvākṣaradhāmagaḥ ||32||
upaviṣṭo divyagajāsane cākṣaradhāmani |
divyabhūṣāmbarahetiśṛṃgārakautukānvitaḥ ||33||
asaṃkhyamuktasañjuṣṭo’nantamuktānikārcitaḥ |
avatārī hyasaṃkhyānāmavatārādivarṣmaṇām ||34||
anantaiśvaryasāmarthyāścaryaśaktiprapūrṇakaḥ |
rājādhirājaśobhaśca sarvatattvaniyāmakaḥ ||35||
anantagāḍhatejobhiḥ pūrṇamūrtiḥ parātparaḥ |
evaṃ bhūtvā hi bhagavān brahmatejo hyadarśayat ||36||
guṇātītākṣarabrahma sarvatejaḥprakāraṇam |
asaumāsaṃkhyabhāyuktaṃ vyāpakaṃ mūrtiniḥsṛtam ||37||
māliyānāya mallikāśriyai pradarśya dhāma tat |
tatrākṣarīṃ divyabhūmiṃ taijasīṃ śāntaśītalām ||38||
mahānandamayīṃ divyapīyūṣasalilāṃ śubhām |
śuddhacaitanyarūpāṃ tāmakṣarabrahmamūrtijām ||39||
darśayāmāsa bhagavān dhāmeśaśrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
ākṣaraṃ nagaraṃ naijaṃ darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||4.18.40||
anantamuktavasatiṃ darśayāmāsa tau tataḥ |
divyasamādhau tau nītvā darśayāmāsa vāṭikām ||41||
bhadrāyanaṃ śubhaṃ grāmaṃ mahodyānaṃ ca kausumam |
darśayāmāsa bhagavān yatpuṣpaiḥ pūjyate hariḥ ||42||
māliyānasya mallikāśriyā udyāna uttamaḥ |
vartate tvakṣare tatra phalapuṣpadrumātmakaḥ ||43||
śāśvato divyaphalado divyamadhurasapradaḥ |
divyapuṣpodbhavamiṣṭamakarandarasapradaḥ ||44||
tau pradarśya tamudyānaṃ hariḥ prāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ |
pṛthvyāṃ yadarpitaṃ mahyaṃ tatsarvaṃ vāṭikādikam ||45||
udyānajanyapuṣpādi mahodyānaphalādikam |
sarvaṃ vāṃ śāśvataṃ tvatra vidyate kurutaṃ nijam ||46||
kalpadrumā rasaiḥ pūrṇā bhavantyatra hi śāśvatāḥ |
miṣṭaphalapradāḥ santi pibataṃ tadbhavāmṛtam ||47||
miṣṭaphalānāmadanaṃ kurutaṃ divyatṛptidam |
ityuktvā bhagavām̐stābhyāṃ pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||48 ||
phalāhāraṃ prasādena kārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam |
puṣpaśṛṃgāraracanāmarpayāmāsa tau prabhuḥ ||49||
divyaṃ naijaṃ sukhaṃ miṣṭaṃ śāśvataṃ modananditam |
mahānandamayaṃ sarvaṃ dadau tābhyāṃ prabhuḥ svayam ||4.18.50||
yo rasaḥ śaṃkare nāsti nāje nāpīśvareṣvapi |
na viṣṇau nāvatāreṣu na mukteṣvapi yo rasaḥ ||51||
raso yo vartate kṛṣṇatādātmyabhāvimātrake |
kṛṣṇamūrtau sadā tvāste kṛṣṇābhinne ca vartate ||52||
kṛṣṇāṃganāyāṃ rādhāśrīprajñāmādhavikādiṣu |
brahmapriyāsu sarvāsu haripriyāsu yo rasaḥ ||53|||
śrīlakṣmīkamalāpadmāmāṇikyālalitādiṣu | |
yo raso vartate nityapremānandamahodadhiḥ ||54||
snehākarṣaṇatādātmyādvayānandasukhodadhiḥ |
sarvabhānaprabhānādilayamūrchātimūrchanaḥ ||55||
sarvendriyāntaḥkaraṇākṛṣṭipiṇḍaikyarūpadhṛk |
ekatānamahānandāvicchinnamutpravāhaṇaḥ ||56||
etādṛśaṃ parabrahmamahānandarasaṃ hariḥ |
aṃke kṛtvā ca tau bhaktau pāyayāmāsa mūrtijam ||57||
tataścodyānavṛkṣāṇāṃ pāyayāmāsa tanmadhu |
makarandaṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ pāyayāmāsa gandhinam ||58||
kārayāmāsa tṛptiṃ tau tatraivākṣaradhāmani |
athotthāpya samādhestau darśayāmāsa bhūtalam ||59||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ mānavaṃ vigrahaṃ nijam |
bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ divyaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ suvarṇajam ||4.18.60||
athotthitau tau sahasā praṇematurhariṃ muhuḥ |
amūlyāpūrvalāvaṇyāmṛtarasaprapūritam ||61||
stutvā natvārcayitvaiva labdhvā tṛptiṃ tu śāśvatīm |
visarjitau śrīhariṇā yayaturmandirād bahiḥ ||62||
divyabhāvānvitau puṣpahāraśṛṃgārakānvitau |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre devānāmarhaṇāya tau ||63|||
yayatuḥ paścimād bhāgād uttarāṃ diśamutsukau |
śaṃkaraṃ kṣetrapālaṃ cārcayāmāsaturīśvarīm ||64||
mūrtitraye harikṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣayāmāsatū ramām |
trikaṃ dhṛtvā kare pātraṃ mahāmṛtarasānvitam ||65||
pāyayāmāsa tābhyāṃ vai parabrahmarasaṃ param |
gaṇeśaṃ kārtikaṃ durgā rudraṃ pupūjatustataḥ ||66||
teṣu deveṣu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ |
prāpya pūjāṃ puṣpamayīṃ pāyayāmāsa tau rasam ||67||
kuberaindrāgnidharmādīn pupūjatuśca tau tataḥ |
teṣu deveṣu bhagavān svāmīśrīnaravallabhaḥ ||68||
labdhvā pūjāṃ divyarūpaḥ pāyayāmāsa tau rasam |
sūryacandraguruprabhṛtīn devān tau pupūjatuḥ ||69||
teṣu deveṣu bhagavān svāmī kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau tatra pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||4.18.70||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādipratimāpūjanaṃ ca tau |
vyadhātāṃ teṣu deveṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ ||71 ||
pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau tatra pāyayāmāsa tadrasam |
pitṛpratimāpūjāṃ ca pracakratustataśca tau ||72||
teṣu svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇanandanaḥ |
pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau bhaktau pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||73||
siddharṣimūrtiṣu tābhyāṃ pūjitāsu pramāpatiḥ |
pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya tau divyaṃ pāyayāmāsa tadrasam ||74||
īśvarāṇāmīśvarīṇāṃ mūrtiṣu mādhavīpatiḥ |
pratimāsu parāṃ pūjāṃ labdhvā pauṣpīṃ ca tadrasam ||75||
pāyayāmāsa tābhyāṃ śrīkāntaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
muktānikāsu mukteṣu cāvatāreṣu mūrtiṣu ||76||
pārṣadeṣu ca gopeṣu gopīṣu śāradādiṣu |
samastatīrthadeveṣu pratimāsu kṛtārhaṇām ||77||
prāpya svāmiharikṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo’kṣarādhipaḥ |
tābhyāṃ brahmarasaṃ divyaṃ pāyayāmāsa pānavat ||78||
hasan pātraṃ kare dhṛtvā brahmarasaprapūritam |
anyahastaṃ nyasya mūrdhni tau saṃspṛśyāṅkasaṃsthitau ||79||
ādhāya cauṣṭhayoḥ pātraṃ pāyayāmāsa tadrasam |
ghaṭukairghaṭukaiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ premarasaṃ tu śāśvatam ||4.18.80||
pāyayāmāsa mūrtisthastābhyāṃ pūjāphalātmakam |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre ye devāstīrthavāsinaḥ ||8 1||
īśvarāścāvatārāśca maharṣayaśca sādhavaḥ |
siddhāḥ sādhvyaḥ pārṣadāśca śaktyo brahmayoṣitaḥ |||82|||
tatra sarvatra bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
divyaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ datvā pāyayāmāsa tau rasam ||83||
evaṃ taṃ māliyānaṃ ca mallikāśrīṃ hariḥ svayam |
kṛpayā pāyayāmāsa parabrahmarasaṃ nijam ||84||
tena tau divyatāṃ prāptau brahmadhāmādimuktavat |
divyadehau hi sampannau tadā māyāṃśavarjitau ||85||
puṣpaphalādisevāyāḥ phalaṃ divyaṃ prajagmatuḥ |
parabrahmarasapānāt kāyākalpo vyajāyata ||86||
pāñcabhautikatattvāni vyalīyanta tayostataḥ |
indriyāṇi samastāni caitanyāni tadābhavan ||87||
antaḥkaraṇamevāpi nityajñānātmakaṃ hyabhūt |
māyāṃśo vilayaṃ prāpya brahmāṃśaḥ samajāyata ||88||
sarvāṃśāḥ samparāvṛttya brahmāṃśāstvabhavam̐stadā |
nityatṛptau mahānandapūrṇau tau sambabhūvatuḥ ||89||
saptāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ cāyuṣo’ntare |
pūjāṃ kṛtvā divyabhāvaṃ gate te mālimallike ||4.18.90||
divyadehau ṣoḍaśābdavayaskau tau babhūvatuḥ |
bālakṛṣṇasamau rūpe yugalau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ||91 ||
atha vairāgyayuktau tau pṛthvyudyānagṛhādiṣu |
brahmapāradṛśau tūrṇaṃ cārthayāmāsaturharim ||92||
na bhadrāyananagaraṃ na bhūmirna divaṃ tathā |
nau satyaṃ rocate nāpi naiśalokādi sāttvikam ||93||
vinā tvatpādasevāyugdhāmākṣaranivāsanam |
tasmād rakṣaya nau kṛṣṇa yatheṣṭaṃ tvakṣare pade ||94||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre divye’kṣare’tra tatra vā |
arpitau svaścaraṇayostava śrīkānta sarvadā ||95||
ityabhyarthya kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ jagṛhatustato hariḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||96||
itimantraṃ dadau tābhyāṃ vimānaṃ ca dadau śubham |
pārṣadairvāhitaṃ divyaṃ preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram ||97||
kṛpayā śrīharestau vai tenaiva varṣmaṇā tataḥ |
parabrahmarasaṃ pītvā yayaturdhāma cākṣaram ||98||
snātvā brahmahrade sīmni viviśatustato’kṣaram |
muktau caraṇasevāyāṃ vartamānau babhūvatuḥ ||99||
ityevaṃ mātaraṃ badri prāha sā bālayoginī |
parabrahmarasānandamāhātmyaṃ divyamuktidam || 4.18.1 00||
virarāma kṣaṇaṃ sāpi mātā vyacintayad rasam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāt prāpyaṃ hi sevayā || 101 ||
utkarṣaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā dhārayāmāsa taṃ hṛdi |
yat kṛpvāpi satī nārī prāpnuyāt paramaṃ padam || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginyā mātre kathitaṃ māliyānamallikāśrībhyāṃ
mālākārābhyāṃ puṣpaphalādisevayā tenaiva varṣmaṇā parabrahmarasāvāptyā divyatottaraṃ brahmākṣaradhāmaśāśvataṃ cāpunarāgamāya prāptamitinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||

<4.19>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ śrībālayoginā |
svamātre jñānalabhyaṃ yaṃ prāha brahmarasottamam || 1 ||
yādṛṅmohaḥ śarīre sve tatrāpīndriyagolake |
tatrāpi hṛdaye naije tathātmani striyāṃ sute || 2 ||
patyau dhane jīvikāyāṃ dehinaḥ samavartate |
tādṛṅmohaṃ harermūtau kuryānnārī naro’pi vā || 3 ||
anyamohaṃ tyajetsarvaṃ nārāyaṇamṛṣiṃ vinā |
kṣetrajñe śrīpatau kṛṣṇe kuryānmohaṃ narāyaṇe || 4 ||
tatra vṛttiṃ dhārayecca harau śrīpuruṣottame |
ramaṇīyatame kṛṣṇe lagnaṃ mano na cālayet || 5 ||
gurau satsu harau snehaṃ kuryānnānyatra vai kvacit |
āsaktiṃ śrīharau kuryāt tadrase pāvanottame || 6 ||
ātmanyeva hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pradhārayet |
harau sarvaviṣayāṇāṃ sukhānyekatra sarvathā || 7 ||
labhyante’to brahmaraso’vāpyate darśane’pi vai |
evaṃ jñātvā bhajet kṛṣṇaṃ pātivratyena sundarī || 8 ||
prasanno jāyate tasyā bhagavān kṛpayā hyati |
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sevayā taṃ prabhuṃ nāthaṃ prasādayet || 9 ||
anekāvarttasaṃsiddhā sevayā rasamāpnuyāt |
amāyā syāt sadā yasyāḥ pare kānte rameśvare || 4.19.1 0||
siddhadaśā bhavedasyāḥ kṛtārthatā ca śāśvatī |
parabrahmānandarasayogyatāsyāstadā matā || 11 ||
ātyantikaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ sādhvītā cottamā tathā |
prāptavyā tu yayā sādhvyā tayā peyo raso hareḥ || 1 2||
aharniśaṃ smṛtiḥ kāryā kṛṣṇakāntasya svātmani |
dhāryā mūrtirbhagavataḥ sevyā divyena varṣmaṇā || 13||
pūrṇābdhivat sukhaṃ tasya bhaktāyā pūryate’niśam |
rasikāyāṃ rasikasya kṛṣṇasyānandapūrṇatā || 14||
bhaktyā rasikayā kṛṣṇo rasaṃ naijaṃ dadāti vai |
brahmarasaṃ mahānandaṃ bhaktāyai svāmibhāvanām || 15||
nirdoṣadivyabhāvāyā brahmāntaryāmiyuktayā |
bhaktyā cārpitayā kṛṣṇo rasiko rasameti vai || 16||
brahmaikyabhāvayā svāmī sevyaḥ sevikayāniśam |
sevikāpi rasadācchrīkṛṣṇād rasaṃ samaśnute || 17||
kṛṣṇaḥ kāntaḥ prasannaḥ syād bhaktyā vā sevayāpi ca |
ājñayā cānuvṛttyā vā taṃ dharmaṃ pālayet satī || 18||
akhaṇḍacintā kṛṣṇasya yasyā bhavati mānase |
sā tadrasaṃ mahāmiṣṭaṃ prāpnotyanyā na vindati || 19||
ekatānā bhaved yā tu saikarasā prajāyate |
dṛśyate bhagavān yadvan mānavo’pi na mānavaḥ ||4.19.20 ||
nāsya bādho māyikairvai padārthaiśca parābhavaḥ |
alaukikaṃ hi sāmarthyaṃ kṛṣṇakānte virājate ||21 ||
asaṃkhyastrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇo nirlepo’pi rasapradaḥ |
viditvaivaṃ prabhuṃ nāthaṃ bhajate rasabhāginī ||22||
kāntavrataṃ śūratā ca sarvārpaṇaṃ tadātmatā |
pakṣaḥ snehaśca yasyāḥ syāt kṛṣṇe sā rasabhāginī ||23||
satāṃ sevā hareḥ sevā sādhvīsevāpi sarvadā |
padmāvatīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevātmikā yadi ||24||
yasyā bhavati saṃsāre’pyasāre sāragā tu sā |
antarāyakaraṃ sarvaṃ tyajatyeva hi sā satī ||25||
mahatāṃ tu satāṃ sevā harerājñā kṛpā tathā |
arpaṇaṃ sarvathā divyaparabrahmarasapradāḥ ||26||
āhārāḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇe dehendriyāntarātmanām |
yasyā bhavanti satataṃ sā syādvai rasabhāginī ||27||
ātmaniveditāyajñaḥ sarvayajñaśiromaṇiḥ |
parabrahmaṇi deveśe’rpaṇaṃ yat puruṣottame ||28||
āntaraṃ sarvathā dānaṃ bāhyaṃ dānaṃ ca sarvathā |
hareḥ sambandhavat sarvaṃ vartanaṃ sphuraṇādikam ||29||
nirguṇaṃ bhagavadbhāvaṃ prāpya nirguṇavartanam |
mahadbhāgyaṃ paraṃ prāpya paraṃ padaṃ ca nirmalam ||4.19.30 ||
yā sākṣād bhagavatprāptiḥ sarvendriyādihomajā |
rādhālakṣmīsamā sādhvī tayā prajāyate sadā ||3 1||
mūrterbalaṃ tu bahudhā vipulaṃ rakṣyameva yat |
snehastasyāḥ pravardheta baliṣṭhāyā harau prabhau ||32||
harermūrterbalavatyā naiṣkarmyaṃ saṃprasiddhyati |
bhayaṃ nāsyā hi māyāyā mahākālasya vā bhavet| ||33||
pakvabhaktā hi sā tvekāntinī bhaktā hi sā bhavet |
hareḥ svarūpaniṣṭhāyāṃ pakvāyāḥ śreya uttamam ||34||
evaṃvetryāḥ kṛtārthatvaṃ brahmarasābhimagnatā |
sārātisāraprāptiśca śrītvaṃ sampadyate tviha ||35||
yadakṣareśānmuktāśca muktānyaḥ saṃbhavantyapi |
avatārā avatāriṇyaśca rādhāramādayaḥ ||36||
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca gopā gopyo bhavantyapi |
sakhāyaśca tathā sakhyo dāsā dāsyo bhavantyapi ||37||
ātivāhikadevāśca tathādhidevatāḥ surāḥ |
adhyātmānaśca puruṣā vyūhāḥ samudbhavantyapi ||38||
adhibhūtāni sarvāṇi samastataijasāni ca |
utpadyante harermūrterbrahmāntaryāmiśaktayaḥ ||39||
tamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ samāśrayet |
sarvānandapramodānāṃ nidhiṃ brahmarasāśrayam ||4.19.40||
kāmapūraṃ ca niṣkāmaṃ sarvānandarasapradam |
saṃginaṃ cāpyasaṃgaṃ ca bhoginaṃ bhogavarjitam ||41||
lepinaṃ cāpi nirlepaṃ kāntaṃ kāntatvavarjitam |
vareṇyaṃ cāvaraṃ ramyaṃ śayānaṃ śayanojjhitam ||42||
vadhūgrastaṃ ca vidhuraṃ gṛhasthaṃ gṛhavarjitam |
aliṃgaṃ divyaliṃgaṃ ca śāstrayonimayonikam ||43||
indraṃ nirindriyaṃ cāpi śaktaṃ śaktiprayojakam |
śīlinaṃ strīśīlinaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ nirūpiṇam ||44||
aceṣṭaṃ divyaceṣṭaṃ ca sarvacāritryasaṃbhṛtam |
evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ matvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||45||
prāpya sākṣād divyayogaṃ brahmarasamavāpnuyāt |
naitādṛśyāḥ premarasārjane kiñciddhi śiṣyate ||46||
devalokā brahmalokāḥ sarvalokā hareḥ kṛte |
devīlokāḥ parīlokāḥ śrīlokāśca hareḥ kṛte ||47||
guṇātītādilokāśca bhaktalokā hareḥ kṛte |
muktamuktānikālokāḥ śreyasāmālayāstathā ||48||
sampadāmālayāścāpi kalpitāḥ parameśvare |
bhavanti mokṣadāḥ sarve divyasvāmyabhidhiṣṭhitāḥ ||49||
sarvavidhāyāṃ vikṛtau kṛtau jñāne prasevane |
hareḥ prasannatāvāñcchā yasyāḥ sā rasabhoginī ||4.19.50 ||
ātmaprayatnasaṃrūḍhā dehendriyādiśāsikā |
haryarthakṛtasarvasvā brahmarasaṃ samaśnute ||51 ||
ālocanarasān divyān vyāpārasadrasān parān |
ānandamodabhogādīn snehapremasukhotsavān ||52||
kāmasaṃkalpasaktyādīn ratyākarṣaṇamūrchanāḥ |
samastāmṛtapānādīn tāmbūlarasamādhavīm ||53||
sparśamādhuryalāvaṇyābhinnasaṃgodbhavān rasān |
aśnute dattasarvasvā sarvaśṛṃgārajān rasān ||54||
sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ yasyāstasyā brahmarasāśanam |
ghanaśyāmāṃ śvetabhāṃ ca manoharāṃ kiśorikām ||55||
muktānikāmahāmaṇḍalādibhāvaprasevitām |
mūrtiṃ kṛṣṇātmikāṃ prāpya bhaved brahmarasāśanam ||66||
ekarasaṃ mahātejo’kṣarabrahmaprakāśakam |
rasapūrṇaṃ nijaṃ dhāma parabrahmarasātmakam |||57||
sampādayati bhagavān prajñeśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
kaivalyasaṃbhṛtaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ||58||
sa eva mānavaścāste tathāpyamānavo’sti saḥ |
tadvastrālaṃkṛtayaśca divyā vāhanadāsikāḥ ||59||
paricaryāparā dāsā divyāḥ pānāśanārhaṇāḥ |
sarvāvatāradhartā saḥ sarvāvatārakāraṇam ||4.19.60||
alaukiko’pi bhagavān vartate lokavat tviha |
evaṃvettryāstviha mokṣapadaṃ karatale’sti vai ||61||
kartavyaṃ śiṣyate nāsyāḥ sādhanāntaṃ gatā tu sā |
vartate brahmamodasthā parabrahmarasāśanā ||62||
satyaprāṇasthitā cāste bhāgavatāptasadrasā |
ekāntikasatāṃ yogāt tādātmyarūpaniścayā ||63||
nirvikalpasamādhisthā nirguṇabrahmarūpiṇī |
parabrahmarasāsvādā saiva bhavati bhāminī ||64||
yā viśiṣṭā sthūlarūpā māyā tadrasamādhavī |
yā sūkṣmāpi kṛṣṇayogāt prasūtiṃ prakarotyapi ||65||
sā kṛṣṇasya sadā patnī bhogyā māyā tu bandhinī |
jaḍāpi kṛṣṇasambandhād divyā tadrasasaṃbhṛtā ||66||
bhavatyasaṃkhyalokānāṃ kṛṣṇarasābhiṣañjikā |
rādhāramāpriyādyāśca parabrahmarasaiḥ plutāḥ ||67||
rasayanti jagat sarvaṃ tathaiva tannarāyaṇī |
sādhusaṃgatimāpannā cāpradhṛṣyā harītaraiḥ ||68||
rasayatyeva sahajānande nijātmavartini |
parabrahmarase nitye svāmisakte’tiśāntide ||69||
kṛṣṇaniṣṭhāvatī sādhvī kṛṣṇasvarūpalobhinī |
kṛṣṇārthadharmadhartryeva śāntiṃ drutaṃ pragacchati ||4.19.70 ||
tīvraśraddhā hareḥ prāptau tadrasāvāptaye’pi ca |
yasyāḥ sā vindati prajñāprasūtaṃ kṛṣṇajaṃ rasam ||71||
yasyā vihvalatā kṛṣṇadarśanādau sadāsti sā |
tīvravegavatīśraddhāśrayā bodhyā tu bhāminī ||72||
mahātmyajñānayuktāyāḥ śraddhātaikṣṇyaṃ prajāyate |
asaṃkhyarasalobhena kṛṣṇakāntā prajāyate ||73||
kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ vinā bhedaṃ vinā tyāgaṃ prasevate |
sthitaprajñā nirvikalpā dṛḍhaprajñā prabhuṃ patim ||74||
sevate sarvapāpaghnaṃ rasadaṃ cābhayapradam |
so’pi bhaktāṃ tathā naijāṃ sevate puruṣottamīm ||75||
nirvikāraṃ sarvavidhakṣetrajñaṃ lepavarjitam |
yogyāyogyacaritrāṇāṃ gāyikā gāyati prabhum ||76||
ahobhāgyaṃ ca manvānā sthitaprajñā harau hi sā |
ākṣarīṃ sthitimāpannā dhyānakīrtanatatparā ||77||
vandanārcanadānādyaiḥ prasannatāparāyaṇā |
dāsīva sarvasevārhā badrīmuktā yathā tathā ||78||
śvetadvīpanivāsābhā śrīpurābhisthiteva sā |
sveṣṭadevatāśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śritā sadā ||79||
pativratā sā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe prabhaupatau |
manasā varṣmaṇā bhaktyā mūrtau tatsatsu sevayā ||4.19.80||
rādhāramāpramāpadmāvatīsamā prasāditā |
vartate sā labhate’tra parabrahmarasāśanam ||81 ||
yadā sā vartate’nādikṛṣṇasaṃgamasadrase |
tadā brāhmī bhavatyeva divyā māyāparā sakhī ||82||
ātmacaitanyatādātmyaṃ harau labdhavatī satī |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇakāntamātrasaṃsargasaṃbhṛtā ||83||
parabrahmābhiyogena brahmavad vyāpikā tathā |
sarvaiśvaryamahāśaktyasaṃkhyacamatkṛtibhṛtā ||84||
sarvajñeva mahārājñī samrājñī samajāyate |
siddhadaśāvatī patnī mahāmuktānikā yathā ||85||
siddhadaśāṃ parāṃ prāpya tenaiva varṣmaṇā priyā |
golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīpuraṃ tathā ||86||
avyākṛtaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca dhāmanyanyāni yāni ca |
tatra yāti hareryogāt svatantrā rasavedinī ||87||
sṛṣṭitraye’pi sugatirjāyate kṛṣṇabhāminī |
kalyāṇadaṃ hi vijñānaṃ sarvakṛttvaṃ hareḥ sadā ||88||
hareḥ satāṃ caritrāṇi daihikāni parāṇyapi |
sakāmāni tathā yadvā kāmanāvarjitānyapi ||89||
divyānyeva sadā mokṣapradāni pāvanāni ca |
amāyikāni sarvāṇi pratyakṣasya hareḥ satām ||4.19.90||
pratyakṣo bhagavānatra santaḥ sākṣād bhuvi sthitāḥ |
prācīnāvyayadhāmasthasanātanasvarūpiṇaḥ ||9 1||
bhavantyevetimāhātmyajñānaṃ yasyāstvihāsti vai |
sā prāptā paramabrahmacintāmaṇiṃ hi śāśvatam ||92||
kalyāṇaṃ paramaṃ tasyā jāyate jñānayoṣitaḥ |
lakṣyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yasyāḥ prāpyo yasyāḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ ||93||
rājyaṃ kṛṣṇarasāvāptiḥ prajā muktānikāgaṇāḥ |
ānandaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasaṃge kiṃ tasyā nanu śiṣyate ||94||
hariṃ vinā na lobho’sti paratra vā nijātmani |
yāvacca brahmalokeṣu vaibhaveṣvapi kaścana ||95||
yanmano na bhavellagnaṃ sā caikāntikakoṭigā |
sādhvīṃ padavīṃ cotkṛṣṭatamāṃ sādhigatā yataḥ ||96||
sādhvyāstasyā brahmapatnyāḥ pūjāṃ kurvanti devatāḥ |
hareryogena sā prāptā hyalaukikacamatkṛtim ||97||
cintāmaṇiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasyāḥ kare sthitaḥ |
tena śrīkṛṣṇabhagavatpremarasaṃ samaśnute ||98||
ityevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntarasaṃ tvaham |
mātarnityaṃ prāptavatī samaśnāmi tadaṃkagā ||99||
nānyamicchāmi rādheśādbhinnaṃ vā cetanaṃ jaḍam |
ityuktvā virarāmāpi badrike bālayoginī || 4.19.10 0||
prabhokṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa ramāpate |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin mādhavīśa satāṃ pate || 101 ||
śrāvayāmāsa bhajanaṃ mātaraṃ bālayoginī |
nanarta ca kṣaṇaṃ magnā kānte bhāvabharā tadā || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ bālayoginyā mātre upadiṣṭasya jñānalabhyasyottamabrahmarasasya nirūpaṇamityādināmā navadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||

<4.20>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ śrībālayoginī |
punaḥ svamātaraṃ prāha yattadvadāmi te tathā || 1 ||
upāsanāṃ parabrahmarasāsvādanadāyinīm |
ātmanaḥ kiraṇaṃ yadvanmano’ntaḥkaraṇaṃ tathā || 2 ||
mānasīṃ pratimāṃ kṛtvopāsīta manasi prabhum |
avikṛtaṃ manastadvai yatkṛṣṇe cānusaṃhitam || 3 ||
tadeva bodhyaṃ paramabhāgavatasatāṃ manaḥ |
āsaktaṃ yaddharau nityaṃ śītoṣṇabhāvavarjitam || 4 ||
sādhu manastadvijñeyaṃ kṛṣṇe niścalaniṣṭhitam |
akhaṇḍasnehadhārāḍhyaṃ kṛṣṇe viśrāmameti yat| 5 ||
siddhavad yadivadyogijanavanmuktavanmanaḥ |
vadhūvat kāntavadyacca nijeṣṭatamavattathā || 6 ||
yanmano vartate kṛṣṇe yatsphūrtiṃ vidadhāti yat |
yanmagna yatsmṛterhetustadaśnute hareḥ rasam || 7 ||
nirvāsanaṃ mano nityaṃ nirvāsanaharisthitam |
hareḥ satāṃ sevayā ca vāsanā līyate drutam || 8 ||
sevāyāṃ kiṃkarī bhūtvā rājñyapi vartate tu yā |
dānādhīnasamā dāsī prasādaṃ vindati prabhoḥ || 9 ||
bhagavataḥ satāṃ cāpi ruceraviṣayaṃ tu yat |
na kartavyaṃ bhaved yasyāḥ kartavyaṃ kṛṣṇarocakam || 4.20.1 0||
antarāyakaraṃ kṛṣṇasevāyāmiṣṭamityapi |
tyaktavyaṃ ca bhaved yasyā hareḥ prasādamṛcchati || 1 1||
guruvatpitṛvanmātṛvadbhūmipālavattathā |
hariḥ prasannatāmeti śiṣyāyāṃ yā hi rocikā || 1 2||
śreyase yā satāṃ prasannatārthaṃ yatate sadā |
dayātyāgau kṛṣṇasevopāsanāyāṃ kṣatipradau || 13||

puṣpaśṛṃgārahārādyaḥ prasādayet priyampatim || 14||
śayyābhojanapānādyaiḥ toṣayenmādhavīpatim |
sarvasvārpaṇadānādyaiḥ rāmayellalitāpatim || 15||
sarvendriyāntaḥkaraṇairupāsīta śriyāḥ patim |
dehena guṇadharmādyaiḥ prasādayejjayāpatim || 16||
bhaktān prasādayeccāpi sevayā cānusevayā |
bhaktānāmapi bhaktā syād yā sā brahmarasāśanā || 17||
hareḥ prasannatāheturbhaktasevāpi cottamā |
bhaktasaṃpaprasādau ca bhaktasevā rasapradā || 18||
bhūsthāpi sādhusevāyāṃ raktā yā sākṣare sthitā |
na rogāḥ śrīhareḥ saṃge vighnaṃ kurvanti sevane || 19||
sāvadhānā harernāmnāṃ vṛttāntasya śrave’pi ca |
dṛḍhāsaktyā dṛḍhasaṃskāraiśca kṛṣṇamayī bhavet ||4.20.20||
brāhmī bhūtvā bhajet kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ svāminaṃ prabhum |
akṣarātītapuruṣottamaṃ kāraṇakāraṇam ||21 ||
vāsudevaṃ bhagavantaṃ mahāpuruṣapūruṣam |
pitaraṃ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ patiṃ sarvaśarīriṇām ||22||
sākṣiṇaṃ karmiṇāṃ cāntaḥprakāśakaṃ guṇātmanām |
uttamaṃ ca viśeṣaṃ ca puṃsāṃ sarvāvatāriṇam ||23||
svāminaṃ brahmapuruṣairupāsitapadāmbujam |
seveta kambharānandaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam ||24||
kṛṣṇe sambandhamutkṛṣṭaṃ kuryāt sañjīvanī latā |
amṛtāvallikā yadvacchinnā saktāpi jīvati ||25||
vaṭadruvat prakuryācca snehaṃ śrīmativallabhe |
jaṭāṃ svasmāt samudbhāvya śākhāmūlo’pi jīvati ||26||
tathendriyādiviṣayaiḥ snehaṃ kṛtvāpi mādhave |
yā jīvet prāṇamarpayya sā kṛṣṇarasamaśnute ||27||
kṛṣṇaṃ kuṭumbinaṃ naijaṃ snigdhaṃ sarvārthapūrakam |
jñātvā dhṛtvāgragaṃ kṛtvā vihared brahmabhūmiṣu ||28||
dhyātvā sākṣād bālakṛṣṇaṃ saṃkīrtya guṇagāyanaiḥ |
āsevya hṛdaye kāntaṃ rahorasaṃ samarjayet ||29||
smṛtiṃ sadāntaḥkaraṇe kuryācchrīkṛṣṇacakriṇaḥ |
prasannatāṃ hareḥ śreṣṭhāmāsādayet prasevayā ||4.20.30||
niṣkāmatāṃ prālayecca kṛṣṇārthakṛtaniścayā |
sarvasvārpaṇarūpā sā śrīkṛṣṇe sarvakāmanā ||31 ||
evaṃ naiṣkarmyamāsādya niṣkāmaṃ kṛṣṇamarjayet |
upāsīta patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kriyayā sevayehayā |||32||
snehabhaktyā bhāvanayā nijārpaṇavidhānayā |
āsaktyā prajñayā vāsanayātmārpaṇacintayā ||33||
prāṇārpaṇaprakāreṇa rasecchācintanena ca |
sādhvīdharmaviśeṣeṇa tathābhyāsena cārjayet ||34||
kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇarasaṃ kṛṣṇasatāṃ satsaṃgasadrasam |

ātmadarśanakartrī syāt paramātmavilokinī |
hareścaritragītyādyaiścopāsanādibhistathā ||37||
smṛtyā santatayā cāpi kṛṣṇarasaṃ samarjayet |
upāsīta hariṃ sākṣāttaccaritrāṇi kīrtayet ||38||
nāmābhibhajanaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇadharmaṃ prapālayet |
kṛṣṇalīlāmayī bhūtvā kṛṣṇabrahmarasaṃ pibet ||39||
akhaṇḍavṛttiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe samādhinā pravartayet |
śūravīrā bhavet kṛṣṇe snigdhā māhātmyavedinī ||4.20.40||
kṛpāpātraṃ bhaveccāpi sevayā sā rasaṃ pibet |
kṛṣṇaṃ vinānyatucchārthe sneho māyā hi tāṃ jayet ||41||
kṛṣṇājñāṃ saṃvahenmūrdhnā māyā tasyā layaṃ vrajet |
dhanade putrade loke pratītirjāyate drutam ||42||
sā pratītirharau kṛṣṇe yasyāḥ sā prakṛtiṃ jayet |
svabhāvaṃ svaṃ ca sā tyaktvā śrīkṛṣṇe praviśet sadā ||43||
jīvātmano harau tatra tādātmyaṃ snehasaṃbhṛtam |
divyaṃ vai bandhanaṃ kṛṣṇe praveśo raṭanātmakaḥ ||44||
kṛṣṇaṃ vinā mahāduḥkhavipannadivasān nayet |
kṛṣṇe’nādau pare nārāyaṇe tādātmyamāpnuyāt ||45||
dehānte vā sadehe vā kṛṣṇakāntetibhāvayet |
antardṛṣṭyā harau kānte’parokṣānubhavo bhavet ||46||
tena brahmarasaśreṣṭhasukhacaitanyamāpatet |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt svarasaṃ vai samarpayet ||47||
sadā sā kṛṣṇavāmāṃgī rahasyaṃ paramaṃ labhet |
jagatsthityai bhaktatṛptyai vartate bhuvi mādhavaḥ ||48||
anādivāsudevo’pi kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
dharmārthakāmanāceṣṭāḥ kṛtavān prakarotyapi ||49||
jīvā gāyanti śṛṇvanti tāste mucyanta eva ha |

janma karma ratiḥ kāmo mūrtiśceṣṭā kriyā hareḥ |
mūrtirdivyā mokṣadā ca sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya mokṣakṛt ||91 ||
śrīkṛṣṇaparamabrahmopāsanāṃ vidadhati yā |
dṛḍhapratītiyuktā sā vadhūṭīḥ syāt pareśvarī ||52||

bhaktāparādhanirapekṣiṇī kṛṣṇādyapekṣiṇī ||53||

mahāsukhābdhimagnā sā sammānārhā ramā yathā ||54||

daṇḍavatprapraṇāmādiparā sādhvādarānvitā ||55||
ajñātadrohaśāntyarthaṃ dīnavatprārthanāparā |
kṛṣṇapremātimagnā ca sādhvāśīrvādapātriṇī |||96||
bhāgyaṃ mahattamaṃ naijaṃ sevāyāṃ manyate satām |
hareḥ prasannatārthaṃ sā nijakalyāṇahetave |||57|||
sarvasvaṃ saṃpradāyaiva brahmarasaṃ samaśnute |
pratigopisamarūpo dadāti svaṃ rasaṃ param ||58||
koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ pratirūpo babhūva yaḥ |
vivāhe ca ratau vāse rahasye rasasampradaḥ ||559||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ |
akṣarādhipatiḥ svāmī kāntaḥ śrīkambharātmajaḥ ||4.20.60||
svāminīśrīmahālakṣmīlālito mādhavīpatiḥ |
koṭimuktānikāsvāmī pratyātmāntaratatpatiḥ ||61 ||
sarvakāmapradastasya yogasthā rasamaśnute |
snigdhāṃ mugdhāṃ viyuktāṃ na kadācit kurute prabhuḥ ||62||
guṇātītā nijasattāmātrarūpāṃ samutthitām |
nirguṇāṃ brahmarūpātmaprītiṃ sā mādhave’śnute ||63||
yasyāḥ satāṃ bhagavataḥ saṃgo vā darśanaṃ purā |
jātaṃ tasyā divyabhāvo brahmabhāvaḥ sadā bhavet ||64||
nāsyā māyā naiva rāgo vāsanā na harītarā |
badarīnātharamaṇe sarvathā vartanaṃ bhavet ||65||
nirannabhuktātulyā sā hareḥ prasannatāparā |
bhaktaprasādamāpannā tatparā parame pade ||66||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtisaccidānandabhoginī |

tataste saṃprakāśante sadaiva sukhino divi ||68||
śubhaiḥ santastoṣaṇīyā brahmarasāptihetave |

ātmakalyāṇaparamabrahmānandasukhaiṣiṇī |
hareḥ satāṃ prasādaṃ vai sevayā sarvathārjayet ||4.20.70||
hāniṃ vṛddhiṃ hi lokānāṃ dṛṣṭvā yo na viśocati |
bhajate śrīhariṃ divyaṃ satpuruṣaḥ sa kṛṣṇavat ||71 ||

abhāvastādṛśānāṃ tu yasyāḥ sā mṛtasadṛśī ||92||

yā kṛṣṇarasasampūrṇā tasyāṃ kṛṣṇo’pi sarvadā |

evamaikātmyamevāsti sakhīkṛṣṇarasātmanām ||87||

brahmavitsādhusaṃgena vārteyaṃ jñāyate parā |

cintanaṃ sphuraṇaṃ brahmavitsatāṃ saṃgamād bhavet |
lābho mānuṣadehasya nānyo haryāptimantarā ||4.20.90||
sarvendriyāṇi sādhūnāṃ hareḥ sevārthakāni ca |

mukhyā sā haribhaktāsu rādhā lakṣmīḥ prabhau yathā |
ekāntaṃ kṛṣṇakāntasya yasyā rasāya rocate ||92||

yathā nadyaḥ samudreṣu yathāgnau tu pataṃgakāḥ |
śūrā raṇeṣu satyaśca patyau kṛṣṇe tu gopikāḥ ||94||
līnāḥ sarvasvahomāśca bhavanti hi tathā harau |

līnā yā cākṣarī bhaktā divyā strī puruṣottamī |
akhaṇḍitātisnehā ca niḥsīmaprītiyojikā ||96||
sarvadravābhiyogā ca sarvathā kṛṣṇasaṃśritā |
labhate cāśnute kṛṣṇakāntarasaṃ tu śāśvatam ||97||
ātmasattāsvarūpeṇa vartamānā prabhāpatau |
maryādayātitādātmyamāpannā labhate rasam ||98||
ityuktvā badrike tāvadvirarāma hi sā kṣaṇam |
mātāpyupāsanāyogād brahmarasecchukī hyabhūt ||99||
bālayoginī bāleśaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ balīśvaram |
bālarasātmakaṃ prāpya modate mātṛsannidhau || 4.20.10 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntopāsanayā tadrasāvāptiritinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||

<4.21>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi sadā me sahacāriṇi |
tataḥ śrīmātaraṃ prāha yaṃ dharmaṃ bālayoginī || 1 ||
tyāginīnāṃ vṛṣā ye ca yoginīnāṃ ca ye vṛṣāḥ |
gṛhiṇīnāṃ vṛṣā ye ca te’nuyanti pareśvare || 2 ||
sādhvīnāṃ ye vṛṣāḥ proktā dāsīnāṃ cāpi ye vṛṣāḥ |
vadhūnāṃ kiṃkarīṇāṃ ye te’nuyanti janārdane || 3 ||
śobhante te vṛṣāḥ sarve sarvāsāṃ mādhavīśvare |
sarvadhamāśraye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sudharmiṇi || 4 ||
bhogāḥ sarve vilāsāśca kāmāśca sampado’pi ca |
vibhūtayaḥ striyo dāsyo yujyante paramātmani || 5 ||
vane vāso vivāsāśca jaṭitvaṃ cāvamānitā |
kāṣāyakṛṣṇaveṣitvaṃ yujyante’pi parātmani || 6 ||
āśramāścāpi varṇāśca yujyante śrīramāpatau |
śraddhāyutā tato nārī praseveta pareśvaram || 7 ||
sarvadharmāśrayaṃ jñātvā śrīkāntaṃ kambharāsutam |
alpaprajñā tu gṛhṇīyāt svāṃ tu paṇḍitamāninīm || 8 ||
nirdoṣāṃ ca bahujñā ca pareśaṃ buddhivarjitam |
sarvakartāramātmānaṃ sarvakartrīṃ pareśvarīm || 9 ||
lakṣmīpatiṃ badarīśaṃ laliteśaṃ tu kiṃkaram |
śeṣādivanditaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathā vṛthābhimāninam || 4.21.1 0||
nigamāgamavandyaṃ taṃ tucchaceṣṭādikāriṇam |
evaṃ doṣān harau kṛṣṇe samudbhāvya vadedghṛṇām || 11 ||
sā tu dharmānna jānāti dharmamūrtiṃ na vindati |
parameśaṃ na manute manute karmacāriṇam || 1 2|
etādṛśī mohavatī brahmarasaṃ na vindati |
vindatyevārasaṃ kaṣṭaṃ yāmyakṛtaṃ tu dakṣiṇe || 13|
satsaṃgena vaśaṃ yāti prabhuḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
harau satsu ca sādhvīṣu tvātmabuddhiḥ sadā śubhā || 14||
yasyāḥ prajāyate prītijananī sārvakālikī |
saiva vaśaṃ harikṛṣṇadhavaṃ karoti kāminī || 15||
ātmabuddhiryathā dehe nāryāṃ patyau ca mandire |
bhavane pratimāyāṃ ca jale nijajanādiṣu || 1 6||
putre ca viṣaye svaṣṭe tathendriye mukhe śubhe |
rūpe bhoge vilāse ca tathā yasyā harau prabhau || 17||
saiva kṛṣṇarasaṃ pāti pibatyapi muhurvadhūḥ |
saiva kṛṣṇaṃ vaśaṃ sampādayatyeva na cetarā || 18||
yā bhāvinī kṛṣṇakāntā tasyāśceṣṭāpi vaiṣṇavī |
devābhigamanaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanamanvaham || 1 9||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavārtākathārasātimodanam |
satāṃ samāgame vṛttistīrthavāso viśeṣataḥ ||4.21.20||
kṛṣṇabhakteṣu ramaṇaṃ śayana kālayāpanam |
nirbhīkatvaṃ māyikeṣu tathaudāsīnyamanvaham ||21||
tulyatā kṛṣṇabhinneṣu kṛṣṇe viśeṣatā sadā |
sārarūpaṃ tu yat kārṣṇaṃ tadanyat sāravarjitam ||22||
satāṃ prasannatārthaṃ ca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ praceṣṭanam |
hareḥ svarūpacintaiva guṇagānaṃ harestathā ||23||
haryarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvaṃ hayarthaṃ jīvanādikam |
śṛṃgārarūpasaundaryaṃ haryarthaṃ sarvameva tat ||24||
yasyā evaṃ sadā vṛttaṃ bhāvinī sā haripriyā |
parabrahmarasavettrī nārāyaṇī ramānibhā ||25||
ante pakvadṛḍhamūlā parabrahmahṛdaṃgatā |
prītiryasyā harau prāptā viśrāntiṃ sā rasāśanā || 26||
yatrāvaraṇaṃ nāstyeva brahmasattātmavartane |
nirāvaraṇā tadyogād brahmanārāyaṇī bhavet ||27||
anyattyāgavatī sādhvī rodhakasya visarjinī |
prāṇeśasyābhiyānā ca kalyāṇādeśaśāyinī ||28||
saṃginīnāṃ sakhīnāṃ śreyase yatnopadeśinī |
sveṣṭasvāmicaritrāṇāṃ gāyikā copadeśikā ||29||
satāṃ hareśca kaiṃkarye vetti śreyo nijaṃ param |
yasyāḥ santyadhikāḥ santaḥ śreṣṭhā brahmādito’pyati ||4.21.30||
hareḥ satāṃ suyogādvai nānyacchreyaḥ paraṃ matam |
mahāpuṇyavatīnāṃ ca sevāyogaṃ karotyapi ||3 1 ||
snehaḥ satsu yathā patnyāṃ patyau putre ca mātari |
sahodare ca pitari gurau dehe dhane tathā ||32||
kārayitrī harau satsu snehaṃ sā rasapātrikā |
kṛtārthā sā nityasaktā snigdhā bhavati bhāminī ||33||
pūrvabhavādibhiḥ sādhorhareḥ sevāparāyaṇā |
punarbhavaṃ prasādārthaṃ sevārthaṃ saṃgatecchayā ||34||
bhajamānāṃ na lokānāṃ vikṣepāḥ pīḍayanti tām |
harerviyogavikṣepāḥ satāṃ viyogarūpiṇaḥ ||35||
pīḍayantyeva tāṃ bhaktāṃ brahmarasaparāyaṇām |
svayaṃ śrūtvāvamānādi sveṣṭasya ca satāmapi ||36 ||
udvegaṃ hṛdaye neje prāpnoti svāvamānavat |
śrutvā mānaṃ satāṃ cāpi modate sā haripriyā ||37||
sādhusvāmyaparādhādyasahamānā haripriyā |
śiro datvāpi kāntasya kṛṣṇasya rañjane sthitā ||38||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhāve nimnagā na kadācana |
asaṃśayā hareḥ kārye hyupasthitā ca yā bhavet ||39 ||
sapatnīnāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca snehapakṣābhiyoginī |
haryarthārpitasarvasvā mastakaṃ svaṃ dadātyapi ||4.21.40 ||
ājñāṃ prāpyāvicāryaiva karoti sarvathā tathā |
parabrahmarasāsvādā drutaṃ sā jāyate sakhī ||41 ||
dehendriyāntaḥkaraṇairātmanā kriyayā hi sā |
kṛṣṇārpaṇavidhānā vai drutaṃ cāpnoti tadrasam ||42||
manāk vā kṛṣṇasaṃyuktā divyatāṃ yāti tatkṣaṇāt |
sarvaṃ naijaṃ yojayedvai kṛṣṇasevādikarmasu ||43||
varteta śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntaparāyaṇā |
sā śrīrādhāramātulyā jāyate’traiva mādhave ||44||
pātivratyena ca tathā hyātmaniṣṭhātiśobhinā |
dāsyena yāpi sevāyāṃ vartate sākṣarapriyā ||45||
prakāśamānāṃ satataṃ brāhmī cākṣarasannibhā |
brahmabhāve nije rūpe parabrahma prapaśyati ||46||
ataḥ kṛṣṇetarat saukhyaṃ viṣavad bhāsate sadā |
kṛṣṇasaṃge bhavecchāntiritaratra tu tāpanam ||47||
kṛṣṇasaṃgisatāṃ saṃge cāśraye śāntirasti ca |
kṛtārthatā satāṃ saṃgairhareḥ saṃgairviśeṣataḥ ||48||
sevayāpi mahāmokṣo bhavet prākṛtayoṣitām |
kṛṣṇasattāvatīnāryā māyākālabhayaṃ na vai ||49||
satāṃ sattāvatīnāryā vāsanābandhanaṃ na vai |
ātmaniṣṭhāvatīnāryāḥ punarjanmabhayaṃ na vai ||4.21.50||
hareḥ prītimatīnāryā mṛtyupāśo na vidyate |
bhaktasevāvatīnāryā nirayāṇāṃ bhayaṃ na vai ||51 ||
satāṃ darśanakartryāstu vyādhyādhibhīrna vidyate |
santaḥ santi brahmarūpā brahmamūrtaya uttamāḥ ||52||
teṣāṃ sevāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ mokṣo vānyo na vidyate |
balecchā yadi varteta sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||53||
svarūpāḥ śrīhareḥ santo’vatārāḥ śreyasāṃpradāḥ |
paro’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmādhavīpatiḥ |||54||
svāmī sarvāvatārāṇāṃ muktānāṃ brahmaṇastathā |
svāminīnāṃ ca śaktīnāmīśvarīṇāṃ ca kāraṇam ||55||
vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyāstu pūrṇakāḥ |
āveśāḥ parśurāmādyā aṃśāḥ pṛthvādayastathā ||56||
sanakādyāḥ kalāścāpi sūryādyāśca vibhūtayaḥ |
nārāyaṇāśca vibhavā arcāstu śaktimūrtayaḥ ||57||
sarve te brahmadehā vai parabrahmodbhavāḥ śubhāḥ |
parabrahmasamāḥ sevyāḥ parabrahmarasāptaye ||58||
sarve te pūrṇasukhadāḥ saṃbhṛtāḥ sukhasadrasaiḥ |
parabrahmānandadāste sevyā yoṣinnarādibhiḥ ||59||
mokṣadāste matāḥ sarve sarvakāmapradāstathā |
divyānandapradāḥ sarve māyāpārakarāstathā ||4.21.60||
teṣāṃ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ dhārakaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ ||61||
koṭyarbudābjakāntānāṃ kāntaḥ śrīkambharātmajaḥ |
svākṣaraparadhāmastho rājādhirājaśāsanaḥ ||62||
dadāti darśanaṃ sṛṣṭau yatrecchā bhaktapūraṇī |
anādisarvasiddhayāḍhyaḥ sarvāścaryaprapūjitaḥ ||63||
anantacamatkāreśo yugapatsarvarūpadhṛk |
koṭyarbudābjamūrtyātmā sarvayogakalānidhiḥ ||64||
rasiko rasikānāṃ saḥ tyāgināṃ tyāgavartanaḥ |
jñānināṃ jñānadaścāpi sarvamānasapūrakaḥ ||65||
sarvabalacchalakalāmāyājālaphalārthakṛt |
sarvoparisthitaḥ śāstānādisvāminarāyaṇaḥ ||66||
nirmoho dehideheṣu hyalaukikapratāpavān |
bhaktasevāṃ premayuktāmaṅgīkartuṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ ||67||
bhaktadattān viṣayotthān bhogān bhuṃkte patiryathā |
ajñā doṣān kalpayanti manvate saktameva tam ||68||
prākṛtaṃ mānavaṃ yadvat khalā mahimavarjitāḥ |
eṣā bhrāntiśca māyā ca tādṛśānāṃ harāviha ||69||
na jñānaṃ śrīhareryadvai pratyutābhāvadarśanam |
brahmasthitisamāpannā ye tvātmadarśino janāḥ ||4.21.70 ||
na muhyanti harau tatra jānanti parabhāvanām |
nāpi muhyanti māyāyāṃ kuto moho harestadā ||71 ||
nirlepaḥ sarvadā cāsti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvabhoktāpyabhoktāsti pāvanaḥ pāvako yathā |||72||
nāryaḥ pavitrā jāyante tadbhogairgopikā iva |
narāḥ pavitrā jāyante satsaṃgāttasya sarvathā ||73||
evaṃvido narā bhaktā bhaktānikāśca sarvaśaḥ |
jñānaikāntikatānanyadāsyabhaktā matāḥ sadā ||74||
tādṛśānāṃ kṛte kṛṣṇo brahmarasān suśāśvatān |
pravarṣayati mūrtisthān prapāyayati cāśritān ||75||
kṛpā mukhyaṃ sādhanaṃ vai harerbrahmarasāptaye |
āśrayaḥ sādhanaṃ cāpi prapattiḥ sādhanaṃ param ||76||
ananyabhāvanā cāpi dṛḍhopāstiśca sādhanam |
ājñāprapālanaṃ cāpi sevā snehaśca sādhanam ||77||
māhātmyajñānamevāpi smaraṇaṃ ca nirantaram |
sarvasvārpaṇamevāpi viśvāso nyāsa ityapi ||78||
dāsyaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ pātivratyaṃ sādhutvamityapi |
patnītvaṃ svāminītvaṃ ca premabhāvābhiṣañjanam ||79||
kṛṣṇeṅgitānusaraṇaṃ satāṃ prasannatādikam |
sākṣāt satāṃ susatsaṃgo harerbrahmarasapradaḥ ||4.21.80||
yasyāḥ satāṃ bhagavataḥ sākṣātprāptirihāsti vai |
tasyāsteṣāṃ kathāgānaiḥ smṛtyā kālasya nirgamaḥ ||8 1||
tryavasthātītacaitanyātmakātmano nijasya vai |
brahmarūpasya sākṣāt syād darśanaṃ kṛṣṇamiśritam |||82|||
kṛṣṇavajjāyate dhāmni loke’pyatra na saṃśayaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇāśraye ||83||
atra paratra sarvatra vasati rādhikā yathā |
svāminī jāyate tatra sevikānugrahāddhareḥ ||84||
yāvantaṃ ca mahimānaṃ jānāti paramātmānaḥ |
sukhasāmarthyaśobhābhipratāparūpasadguṇaiḥ ||85||
tāvatsamarthā bhavati kārṣṇī nārāyaṇī yathā |
tathāpi śrīhareḥ patyuḥ sāmarthyāderasīmatā ||86||
apāratā mahaiśvaryasaundaryādestu mādhave |
asaṃkhyakoṭayaḥ santi mādṛśyo bhagavannibhāḥ ||87||
prāptāḥ kṛṣṇasakāśāt tā guṇaiśvaryaprabhādikam |
tathāpi mahimā patyuścāpāro vidyate sadā ||88||
leśo’pi nyūnabhāvo na vidyate paramātmani |
sāmarthyaguṇakarmādisaundaryasukhadāyitāḥ ||89||
kalyāṇadharmayogāśca bhavantyanantasaṃkhyakāḥ |
harestairguṇaleśaiśca bhajanaiśca hareḥ pare ||4.21.90||
haritulyāḥ prajāyante hyanantārbudavaiṣṇavāḥ |
tathāpi nāṇumātraśrīharipratāpasadguṇāḥ ||9 1 ||
nyūnatāṃ saṃvrajantyeva paripūrṇatamastataḥ |
agādhāpārasīmādisakhyāntachedavarjitaḥ ||92||
vartate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
bhajanena gatā dhāmni tatsamā api yoṣitaḥ ||93||
apāratāṃ viditvaiva sevante sevikāḥ sadā |
dāsyaḥ sadā pravartante brahmarasān prabhuñjate ||94||
evaṃ kiṃ bahunoktena prāptā sādhanakoṭibhiḥ |
sādhyaṃ kāntaṃ badarīśaṃ māṇikyeśaṃ satāṃ patim ||95||
bhavāmīti na cānyanme prāptavyamavaśiṣyate |
vidheyaṃ śiṣyate naiva vivāhitāyāścakriṇā ||96||
sarve kāmāḥ samāptā me mātaḥ śrībālamādhave |
tato’haṃ sarvadā dāsī kṛṣṇasya bālayoginī ||97||
badarīśī tāpasī ca brahmaśīlā pareśvarī |
bhavāmi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntarasātmikā ||98||
rasaṃ vindāmi tasyaiva jātāpi tava putrikā |
varadānaprapūrtyarthamihāhaṃ samupāgatā ||99||
kṛṣṇārdhāhaṃ kṛṣṇakāntā lalitā māṇikī yathā |
rādhā lakṣmīḥ mādhavī ca yathā kṛṣṇasya vai priyāḥ || 4.21.10 0||
bhaja mātastathā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
ityuktvā sā kanyakā svāṃ mātaraṃ tu sureśvarīm ||1 0 1||
virarāmādhikavāṇyai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛtiḥ |
tataḥ sureśvarī kāntaṃ nikāmadevamāha tat || 1 02||
putrīyaṃ badarīdevī māṇikyā cākṣare sthitā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnī pareśvarī || 103||
putrīrūpā gṛhe’smākaṃ prajātāsti narāyaṇī |
nānyaṃ cecchati viṣayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntamantarā ||1 04||
tadyoge cāvayormuktirbhāvinyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
evaṃ vijñāya vipro’pi mumude cābhajaddharim ||1 05||
bālayoginī bālyādvai babhūva brahmacāriṇī |
sā tvaṃ śrī badarīdevi badaryāśramavāsinī ||1 06||
badrīprabhe bhavasi badrikā tyāgasvarūpiṇī |
smara sarvaṃ tavaivemaṃ vṛttāntaṃ parameśvari || 1 07||
mama premarasaḥ prāptastvayā vai śāśvataḥ sadā |
karoṣi tvaṃ yoṣitāṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ gītayānayā || 108|||
bālayoginīṃ gītāṃ yā nārī śroṣyati vai tathā |
vadiṣyati harau snehaṃ vidhāsyati vadhūriva || 1 09||
sā vaṃśaṃ ca dhanaṃ kīrtiṃ sukhaṃ śāśvatajīvanam |
kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma samavāpsyati dhāmani || 4.21.11 0||
caturṇāṃ puruṣārthānāṃ siddhistasyā bhaviṣyati |
tāmbūlaṃ prāpya kṛṣṇāṃke bhokṣyatyakṣayyatadrasam || 111 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginīgītāyāṃ śāśvatabālayogabrahmarasapradadharmādīnāṃ nirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||

<4.22>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ sā bālayoginī |
kriyāyogaṃ samagraṃ vai harau cakre’titanmayī || 1 ||
caturaṅgaṃ mahāyogaṃ yojayāmāsa mādhave |
vyāpārān karmarūpān sā nidadhe śrīdhave dhave || 2 ||
tadyathā nijadehaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaśayyāvaśaṃ vyadhāt |
hastau nijau hareḥ kaṇṭhāśleṣaṇe samayojayat || 3 ||
pādau kṛṣṇābhigamane kṛṣṇapradakṣiṇādiṣu |
kṛṣṇārthe sā vyadhājjihvāṃ śrīkṛṣṇakīrtane vyadhāt || 4 ||
kaṭidānaṃ ca kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇāṃke svāsanaṃ vyadhāt |
ratiṃ prītiṃ parāsaktiṃ kāmanāṃ haraye’karot || 5 ||
hāvān bhāvān pramodām̐śca ceṣṭāśca haraye vyadhāt |
saṃketān mauninirdeśān kriyārthān haraye’karot || 6 ||
bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ pānaṃ vihāraṃ haraye vyadhāt |
śṛṃgāraṃ śobhanaṃ rūpaṃ divyatāṃ haraye’karot || 7 ||
kañjalaṃ rañjanaṃ sammārjanaṃ keśaprasādhanam |
veṣaṃ bhūṣāḥ sugandhaṃ ca racanāṃ haraye vyadhāt || 8 ||
mālāṃ hāraṃ maṇiṃ ratnaṃ tailaṃ snānaṃ sucandanam |
kesaraṃ kuṃkumaṃ candraṃ patrikāṃ haraye vyadhāt || 9 ||
alaktakaṃ keśaveṣaṃ dhammilaṃ kabarīṃ latām |
tilaṃ tilakaṃ tilakīṃ candrikāṃ haraye vyadhāt || 4.22.10 ||
hāsyaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca gamanaṃ līlāṃ ramaṇaṃ khelanam |
aṃgasvāsthyaṃ suśuddhiṃ ca nārāyaṇāya sā vyadhāt || 1 1||
udgāraṃ prāṇanaṃ niṣadanaṃ dehāṃgabhaṃjanam |
aṃgulisphoṭanaṃ tālīvādanaṃ haraye vyadhāt || 12||
gītiṃ miṣṭasvaraṃ tālaṃ vādanaṃ cāṃgakharjanam |
sandhivalayanaṃ vāryānayanaṃ śākarandhanam || 1 3||
āstaraṇaṃ tāpaśītasahanaṃ haraye vyadhāt |
evaṃ sakhīvayasyābhirbālyakrīḍanakādikam || 14||
kāṣṭhasamitphalapuṣpapatrāharaṇamityapi |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntārthamānayat || 15||
sarvāḥ kalāḥ śrīharaye’karonnātmārthamīśvarī |
evaṃ vyāpārayogāṃgaṃ śrīkṛṣṇārthaṃ vyadhāt sadā || 16||
atha dvitīyaṃ yogāṃgamālocanaṃ harau vyadhāt |
ālocanāni jñānāni sarvāṇi haraye vyadhāt || 17||
darśanāni samastāni yāvanti śravaṇāni ca |
spārśanāni samastāni yāvanti rāsanāni ca || 18||
ghrāṇajāni samastāni jāgratsvapnakṛtāni ca |
mūrchāsuṣuptituryādiprodbhavāni vyadhāddharau || 19||
pratyakṣādīni sarvāṇi pratyabhijñānakānyapi |
dhāryākārāṇi sarvāṇi yāvanti sphuraṇāni ca ||4.22.20||
anumānānumityādīnyapi sā haraye vyadhāt |
upamānaṃ copamitiṃ sādṛśyaṃ śābdamityapi ||21 ||
ākāṃkṣāvaśasaṃsargajñānāni haraye vyadhāt |
arthāpādanamevāpi tarkaṃ siddhiṃ ca nirṇayam ||22||
anupalambhamevāpi saṃbhāvanāṃ kutūhalam |
mānasaṃ cintanaṃ prabodhanaṃ tathābhimānanam ||23||
guṇānāṃ gaṇanāṃ cāpi bhāvanāṃ śubhavāsinīm |
snehaṃ sukhaṃ pramodaṃ ca vāñcchāṃ yatnaṃ vṛṣaṃ śrutim ||24||
vegaṃ copāsanāṃ bhaktiṃ sevāṃ dhyānaṃ dayāṃ kṛtim |
grahaṇaṃ smaraṇaṃ harṣaṃ vihvalatāṃ prasañjanam ||25||
evamālocanānyaṃsyā haryartha vai sadābhavan |
atha tṛtīyaṃ yogāṃgaṃ jīvārpaṇaṃ vyadhāddharau ||26||
ātmā yaścetano dehe prāṇayogena jīvati |
jīvanaṃ bhogasampattirbhogārpaṇaṃ vyadhāddharau ||27||
sukhamodānucaitanyaṃ prakāśaścātmarūpakaḥ |
prakāśasyārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe vyadhādvai bālayoginī ||28||
saccidānandarūpo yo nityānandaprapūritaḥ |
saccidānandatāṃ kṛṣṇe prārpayatsā tu bālikā ||29||
ātmaniveditāṃ kṛṣṇakānte vyadhāttu yoginī |
sadbhāvaṃ satsvarūpe vai cidbhāvaṃ citsanātane ||4.22.30||
ānandaṃ śāśvatānande cātmānaṃ paramātmani |
brahmatāṃ pūrṇatāṃ cāpi jñātṛtā cendratāṃ nijām ||3 1||
śāstṛtva rājatāṃ cāpi kṛṣṇe bālā samārpayat |
atha turyaṃ parabrahmarasabhogātmakaṃ sukham || 2 2||
yogāṃgaṃ kṛṣṇanirvāṇaṃ kṛṣṇānandarasāplavam |
parabrahmarasābhogaṃ kṛṣṇatādātmyasaṃbhavam ||33||
akhaṇḍāsīmasaṃbhogānandāsvādasukhottamam |
svādaikatānatāmūrchātadātmakasamādhitām || 34||
dravībhāvaṃ tadadṛśyātmakatvaṃ rasadivyatām |
lāvaṇyāmṛtamādhuryapīyūṣapānatṛptijām ||35||
sudhāśītalaśāntiṃ sā prārpayat paramātmani |
evaṃ sā badarīdevi kanyakā bālayoginī ||36||
yogāṃgāni tu catvāri samārpayat parātmani |
mātā sureśvarī vīkṣya vismayaṃ yāti nityadā ||37||
nāsyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā tattvaṃ pārthakyaṃ bhajate kvacit |
kṛṣṇaḥ kārṣṇī tathā kārṣṇī kṛṣṇaḥ sā bālayoginī ||38||
vācake’pi na vai bhedo liṅgabhedo’pyalīyata |
mātrā kvacid dṛśyate sā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmikā ||39||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhūtvā dṛśyate bālayoginī |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī lakṣmīrbadarītimuhurmuhuḥ ||4.22.40||
vyāpārālocanajīvabrahmarasasamarpaṇam |
caturaṃgamahāyogaṃ yogīśvare hyavāpa sā ||41||
athaivaṃ vīkṣya tāṃ kanyāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇām |
sureśvarī sutāṃ prāha putri saṃskāramantarā ||42||
deho hyaśuddho bhavati tasmād vivāha iṣyate |
vivāhena sadā śuddhiḥ kanyakānāṃ prajāyate ||43||
dīrghikāyāḥ kumāryāstu svarge tvindrasabhāsthale |
sabhāyāṃ vartamānāyā yadā sabhāvisarjanam ||44||
bhavatyeva tataḥ paścāt tasyā asanamuttamam |
indro matvā hyaśuddhaṃ vai kārayatyeva śodhanam ||45||
jalena prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śuddhiṃ karoti devarāṭ |
tad vijñāya tataḥ pṛṣṭho dīrghikayā sureśvaraḥ ||46||
kathaṃ madāsane cendra prokṣaṇaṃ kriyate’nvaham |
pratyuttaraṃ jagādendro bhavatī yuvatī hyasi ||47||
avivāhitakanyāsi hyaśuddhāsi tato nvaham |
aśuddhamāsanaṃ te’tra śodhayāmi tu siñcanaiḥ ||48||
yadvā vivāhitā bhūtvā bhava śuddhimatī sute |
mānavyasi rajovyāptā patiśūnyā hyaśuddhigā ||49||
patiṃ prāpya vivāhena śuddhā tvaṃ saṃbhaviṣyasi |
vivāhākhyastu saṃskāraḥ patinā ca samāgamaḥ |||4.22.50||
kanyānāṃ dehaśuddhyarthaṃ brahmaṇā tu vinirmitaḥ |
tad yāhi kṛtaśuddhistvaṃ bhava śuddhāsanā sute ||51 ||
ityuktā sā mahendreṇa kṛtvā vivāhamātmanaḥ |
ṛṣiṇā sveṣṭayogyena tataḥ śuddhāsanābhavat ||52||
tat tvaṃ kanye bālike tvaṃ varaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ prabhum |
vidhinā tu vivāhena samāsādaya madgṛhe ||513||
vahniviprajanasākṣye śuddhāpi śuddhimeṣyasi |
māturme vacanaṃ matvā vivāhotsavamāpnuhi ||64||
ityuktā sā mātṛbhaktā sarvadharmārthavedinī |
omityāha prasū tatra mātā modamavāpa ha ||55||
dadhyau sā kanyakā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ varaṃ harim |
kuṃkumavāpikāvāsaṃ pārvībadrīpriyampatim ||56||
gopālabālakaṃ śrīmatkaṃbharātanujaṃ prabhum |
naranārāyaṇarūpaṃ sveṣṭasvāmipumuttamam ||57||
māturmānasasiddhyarthaṃ nitarāṃ magnamānasā |
satataṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dadhyau samādhiṣu ||58||
divārātraṃ sthitā dhyāne tāvat taijasavigrahaḥ |
puṣṭayuvānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hasan hariḥ ||59||
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmī sarvaśṛṃgārabhūṣaṇaḥ |
rūparūpānurūpāḍhyamūrtiḥ kanyāmanoharaḥ ||4.22.60||
svarṇabhāsuraśobhāṃgaḥ svayameka upāgataḥ |
uvāca tāṃ nijapatnīṃ vada kiṃ kāṃkṣasi priye ||61||
yā te vāñcchā kariṣye tāṃ pūrṇāṃ brūhi manogatam |
atha śīghraṃ samutthāya hṛṣṭā sā bālayoginī ||62||
papāta pādayoḥ prāha gṛhāṇa vidhinā tu mām |
varamālābhūṣitaśca vahrimaṇḍapasatkṛtaḥ ||63||
vivāhanaṃ devatānāṃ sannidhau me kuru prabho |
māturme vacanaṃ tathyaṃ kuru nārāyaṇa prabho ||64||
śrutvā bāloditaṃ cānugrahamūrtiḥ svayaṃ hariḥ |
astvevaṃ ceti jagrāha vivāhārthaṃ samutsukaḥ ||65||
atha bālā dadau tasmai madhuparkaṃ prapūjanam |
jagrāha sa tato bālā ninye taṃ nijamātaram ||66||
prāha tāṃ mātaraṃ kanyā mātaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
āyātaḥ kṛpayā cātra tavecchayārthimānakṛt ||67||
kṛtārthaṃ kuru cātmānaṃ mātaḥ prapūjya keśavam |
mānavena svarūpeṇa kṛpayā tvāmupasthitam ||68||
mātā sasaṃbhramā tasya cakre svāgatamāsanam |
anarghyaṃ pradadāvarghyaṃ dadau cakre prapūjanam ||69||
nikāmadevaṃ sahasā jagādāgatamacyutam |
so’pi vīkṣya hariṃ putrīprāṇeśaṃ parameśvaram ||4.22.70||
suprahṛṣṭaḥ paraṃ cakraṃ sanmānaṃ pārameśvaram |
nanarta sa kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyāprāṇapatiṃ patim ||71||
sarvapatiṃ kṛpāpārāvāraṃ mānavavigraham |
gṛhātithiṃ saumyaveṣaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ||72||
atha mātā samiyeṣa draṣṭuṃ rūpaṃ caturbhujam |
divyaṃ śrīsvāminaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ||73||
vijñāya sahasā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo hṛdi sthitam |
caturbhujo’bhavattūrṇaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||74||
rādhālakṣmīpūjitaśca pārṣadādikṛtārhaṇaḥ |
darśayitvā divyarūpaṃ punaḥ sa mānavo’bhavat ||75||
arcito vanditaḥ kṛṣṇo bhojitaḥ sevitastataḥ |
tilakena sucandreṇa puṣpahāraiḥ praśobhitaḥ ||76||
vāgdānena ca kanyāyāḥ praharṣito vidhānataḥ |
vivāhavidhinā kanyāṃ pariṇetuṃ tato’rthitaḥ ||77||
prasthāpitaśca bahudhā śīghrāgamāya cārthitaḥ |
vardhitaścāśiṣā tūrṇaṃ tiro’bhavat tadāmbare ||78||
atha sarve pratīkṣante punarnārāyaṇāgamam |
bālayoginīrūpāyāḥ śriyā vivāhasūtsavam ||79||
tāvannārāyaṇakṛṣṇaḥ preṣayāmāsa bhūsuram |
nāmnā yogīśvaradevaṃ vṛttāntakathanāya vai ||4.22.80||
vipraḥ śīghraṃ samāgatya nikāmadevamandiram |
kṛṣṇoditaṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ nikāmadevanāmine ||8 1 ||
kathayāmāsa sarvasvaṃ vivāhasya kṣaṇottamam |
āṣāḍhadhavale pakṣe caturthyāṃ prātareva ha ||82||
āgamiṣye hi lagnoktavivāhārthaṃ kuṭumbayuk |
ityuktvā prayayau viprastirobhūya nijālayam ||83||
sureśvarī ca tatputrī nikāmadevabhūsuraḥ |
prasannāścābhavam̐statra kanyāvivāhamodinaḥ ||84||
atha nikāmadevaśca lagnapatraṃ vilikhya vai |
preṣayāmāsa śīghraṃ tad vipradvārā tu mādhavam ||85||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ gatvā vipro harīśvaraḥ |
arpayāmāsa lagnasya patraṃ maṃgalabodhakam ||86||
jagrāha bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mudā tu tat |
vipraṃ pupūja puṣpādyairdhanaṃ ratnāni sampadaḥ ||87||
viprāya pradadau śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇa ādarāt |
mātā śrīkaṃbharālakṣmīrmaṃgalāni hyagāpayat ||88||
dadau dānāni bahūni ropayāmāsa maṇḍapam |
kuṭumbibhyaḥ patrikāśca tadbodhikā hyavāsṛjat ||89||
lomaśena samaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ prabhuḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe snātvā nijālaye sthitaḥ ||4.22.90||
piṣṭikāmardanaṃ cakrurnāryastasya haripriyāḥ |
snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ candanādyaiḥ sumarditaiḥ ||9 1 ||
āṣāḍhaśuklatṛtīyāniśāyā parameśvaraḥ |
vibhūṣito yuvā puṣṭo rājādhirājacihnitaḥ ||92|||
mātāpitṛkṛtasarvamaṃgalaḥ sumaharṣibhiḥ |
āśīrbhirvardhitaḥ sarvakuṭumbibhiḥ pramoditaḥ ||93||
tīrthadevaiśca muktaiśca brahmapriyādibhiryutaḥ |
saurāṣṭrabhaktavargaiśca divyāśvagajavāhanaiḥ ||94||
pāresāhasranārībhiḥ samanvitaḥ śubhe kṣaṇe |
sarvairdivyasuśobhāḍhyairyutaśca sādhubhirvaraiḥ ||95||
kuṃkumavāpikāsarvaprajābhiḥ sahito yayau |
pratasthire kṛtājñāśca varavāhinikāyujaḥ ||96||
bahūtsāhabhavā nāryo narāḥ saubhāgyaśālinaḥ |
prātareva brāhmakāle prāpurvarasamanvitāḥ ||97||
dhūnīgrāmaṃ mahodyānābhivyāptaṃ bahuśobhitam |
karuṇāvārigātīre mahodyāne nivāsanam ||98||
viśrāntiṃ lebhire tatra tāvannikāmadevakaḥ |
kuṭumbasahito nārīgītamaṃgalaśobhitaḥ ||99||
viprādisahitaḥ pūjāṃ kartuṃ tūrṇamupāyayau |
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaṃ varaṃ kanyārthamāgatam || 4.22.10 0||
sarvaiśvaryaparipūrṇaṃ vīkṣya harṣaṃ jagāma ha |
divyo varo varavṛddhā divyāḥ kuṭumbinastathā || 101 ||
divyāśca varavāhinyāgatā nāryo narāstadā |
divyā vāhāśca yānāni divyopakaraṇānyapi || 10 2||
divyā devā devatāśca devyo brahmapriyāstathā |
haripriyāḥ prajāścāpi divyataijasavigrahāḥ || 1 03||
sarvaṃ divyaṃ vilokyaiva mahāścaryaṃ yayau mudhā |
cintayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ daśasāhasradehinām || 1 04||
satkārārthaṃ miṣṭamannaṃ miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ ca mandiram |
śayyāsanāni sarvāṇi bhavanānyuttamāni ca || 1 05||
bhojyapātrāṇyanantāni dravyānnarasaśarkarāḥ |
pūjāṃ cakre mahādhairyaḥ smarannārāyaṇaprabhum || 106 ||
putrīpatiṃ sarvasiddhisevitaṃ cāgataṃ harim |
cintāmaṇiṃ prabhuṃ spṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa vaibhavān || 107||
nārāyaṇārthaparyāptān vivāhotsavaśobhanān |
sarvārthān kalpayāmāsa pūjayan svasutāpatim || 1 08||
jāmātāraṃ prabhuṃ prāpya bhayaṃ dāridryasaṃbhavam |
nābhūttasya tadā tatra putryāḥ pratāpato’pi ca || 1 09||
mahārājādhirājānāṃ cintayāmāsa sampadaḥ |
tāvattatra vanoddeśe mahodyānāni sarvataḥ || 4.22.110 ||
phalapuṣpasugandhāḍhyajalābjapūritāni vai |
abhavan tatra sauvarṇasaudhāni paritastadā || 11 1||
dāsā dāsyo’yutānyapi devā devyo’bhavan drutam |
nikāmadevapakṣasya kāryanirvartakāstadā || 1 12||
pākaśālā aśvaśālā rājaśālāśca vai śubhāḥ |
nārīśālā maṇḍapaśca sauvarṇanirmitāstadā || 11 3||
mahānasāni bhojyāni rasāśca madhuśarkarā |
miṣṭānnāni samastāni śākāni dravavanti ca || 1 14||
gandhasārāṇi sarvāṇi dugdhasārāṇi yāni ca |
bhakṣyāṇi lehyacośyāni pratyakṣāṇi tadābhavan || 115 ||
śayyāsanāni paryaṃkā samastabhogyakānyapi |
na nyūnaṃ vidyate tatra kalpavallyo gṛhe gṛhe || 1 16||
yathā svargaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhūnīgrāmastathābhavat |
nāryo narāśca paśavo gṛhāṇi mṛttikāsthalam || 1 17||
sarvaṃ svargasamaṃ tatra jātaṃ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt |
pūjayitvā varaṃ vṛddhān satkṛtvā ca prajāstathā || 1 18||
nikāmadevo vīkṣyāpi vaikuṇṭhābhaṃ nijasthalam |
mumude kṛṣṇajaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ matvā tu vaibhavam || 1 19||
āvāsān kārayāmāsa dadau dāsīśca kiṃkarān |
vādayāmāsa vādyāni vedaghoṣān vyadhāpayat || 4.22.120||
gāpayāmāsa sarvatra maṃgalāni tadā drutam |
preṣayāmāsa bhogyāni rasānnasalilānyapi || 121 ||
apekṣitātivastūni divyamanoharāṇi ca |
sevayāmāsa bhāvaiśca mahīmānānaśeṣataḥ || 122||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bālayoginyāścaturvidhamahāyogavarṇanaṃ mātṛvacanena
vivāhavidhyartham anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhyānottaramāgamanaṃ tirobhāvaśca, vivāhārthaṃ vāhinyā saha dhūnīgrāmamāgamanam, divyavaikuṇṭhavat sampatkaraṇaṃ mahīmānasatkārādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||

<4.23>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi madhyāhnabhojanānyapi |
pravṛttāni samastāni sarveṣāṃ tṛptidānyati || 1 ||
divyāmṛtāni sarvāṇi nihitāni tu cakriṇā |
yadagre māyikāḥ sarve rasā niḥsvādatāṃ gatāḥ || 2 ||
saṃkalpairbālayoginyā brahmarasānvitāni vai |
miṣṭānnāni samastāni bhojanāvasare’bhavan || 3 ||
jalaṃ brahmahradāttatra samudbhūtaṃ tadākṣarāt |
golokāddhṛtadugdhādi dadhyājyanavanītakam || 4 ||
vaikuṇṭhāddivyaśākādi śrīpurādbhojanāni ca |
kṣīrodāt pāyasānnāni badrīkṣetrāt phalāni ca || 5 ||
sūryalokāccaṭanyādi candrācchrīkhaṇḍakānyapi |
hiraṇyayāttu pātrāṇi śrīlokācchayanāni ca || 6 ||
viṣṇulokāt samastāni śṛṃgārakāṇi cāgaman |
nāpūrṇaṃ vidyate tatra kiṃcit saṃkalpitaṃ navam || 7 ||
adṛṣṭaṃ cāśrutaṃ vāpi drāg ramyaṃ samajāyata |
upasthitaṃ drutaṃ bhoktuḥ sannidhau cāvilambitam || 8 ||
sampanne bhojane tvevaṃ badrike mukhavāsanam |
tāmbūlakādi sarvaṃ ca yogyaṃ samarpitaṃ tadā || 9 ||
viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ saudheṣveva te madhyake’hani |
prāpustatastu sajjāścābhavan dinavyayottaram ||4.23.10||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śṛṃgāritastadā |
vararājasvarūpeṇa śobhānvitaḥ suveṣitaḥ || 11 ||
sahasrasūkṣmamaṇibhirmadhye ca mahatā tathā |
maṇinā khacitaḥ śreṣṭho mṛdusauvarṇanirmitaḥ || 1 2||
mukuṭaḥ kalgisahitastejaḥparidhiśobhitaḥ |
saṃvṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaśirasi lalāṭe candramāḥ kṛtaḥ || 1 3||
kajjalaṃ netrayordattaṃ karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale śubhe |
puṣpāvataṃsāḥ parito varabodhanakāriṇaḥ || 14||
mukuṭe lambitā hārāścitrasugandhipuṣpajāḥ |
svarṇahārā ratnayutāḥ kaustubhena samanvitāḥ || 15||
kaṇṭhe dhṛtā pītavarṇanīśāropari vakṣasi |
pītāmbaraṃ svarṇatārairgrathitaprāntaśobhitam || 16||
paṭaṃ kaṭitaṭe baddhaṃ svarṇabhāsuramujjvalam |
pattrāṇe kauśeyajanye raktavarṇe piśaṃginī || 17||
skandhayoḥ śreṣṭhavasanaṃ prāvāravaramuttamam |
sauvarṇaprāntasaṃśobhaṃ puṣpahārāvalibhṛtam || 18||
bhujabandhau prakoṣṭhasthaśṛṃkhale kaṭake tathā |
ūrmikāścāṃgulicakrāṃgulīyakāni vai tathā || 1 9||
ratnāḍhyāni ca divyāni dhāritāni hi cakriṇaḥ |
raśanāṃ svarṇanirmāṇāṃ khaḍgaṃ sauvarṇataijasam || 4.23.20||
dhārayāmāsurevainaṃ nārikelaphalādikam |
caturdantaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ hastinaṃ cādrisadṛśam ||21 ||
mahāśuddhaṃ surūpaiśca rūpitaṃ svarṇakūthinam |
sāmbālikaṃ sūryabhāvat taijasaṃ muktakoṭikam ||22||
śṛṃgārita kṛtasarvakautukaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
ārohayacchatrayaṣṭidharacāmarisevitaḥ || 23||
varavāhinikā devairjuṣṭā maharṣimānavaiḥ |
divyavājigaruḍādyaiḥ śobhate dhāmagā yathā ||24||
pradīpāścauṣadhīnāṃ ca vṛtānāṃ vidyutāṃ tathā |
maṇīnāṃ divyaratnānāṃ tadāsan paritaḥ sukhāḥ || 25 ||
evaṃ sā sarvaśobhāḍhyā vṛddhajanairalaṃkṛtā |
nārīvargairatigītā vāhinī vyacarat puraḥ ||26||
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan |
puṣpavṛṣṭirdivyahastairmuktābhavacca cāndanī || 27||
lājākṣatādimāṃgalyairvardhitaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
hastinā saṃvṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe yayau vivāhamaṇḍapam ||28||
viśālaṃ cāmbaraspṛṣṭaṃ vicitrāmbaraśobhitam |
svarṇastambhapraśākhātoraṇādyairatyalaṃkṛtam ||29 ||
naisargikapradīpādyaiḥ svarṇakalaśairvardhitam |
kalpalatādibhirvyāptaṃ nisargagītigarjitam ||4.23.30||
magalāyatanadaivapratimādyabhirājitam |
kuṇḍavipropakaraṇairvahnidevādhivāsitam ||31 ||
sarvasamitsamājuṣṭaṃ vedaviprābhivardhitam |
etādṛśaṃ dhāmatulyaṃ prāpya vai maṇḍapaṃ varaḥ ||32||
avatīrya gajānnamaskṛtya tanmaṇḍapeśvaram |
śvaśureṇa tathā śvaśrvā satkṛtaḥ pūjito hariḥ |||33|||
lokācāraiḥ saṃskṛtaśca jalādyairmālikādibhiḥ |
akṣatādyairvardhitaśca gṛhopakaraṇaistathā ||34||
nirvighnīkṛta īśeśo viśrāntyai nīta ālayam |
mahāmandiramadhye susvarṇasaudhāntare tadā ||35||
siṃhāsane śvaśurādyairupāveśita ādṛtaḥ |
hāraiḥ svāgatayatnaiśca prasādito’nnavāribhiḥ ||36||
prāghūṇikāḥ samastāśca jalatāmbūladānakaiḥ |
miṣṭānnakaiḥ phalaiścāpi prasāditāḥ sukhīkṛtāḥ ||37||
vādyante tatra vādyāni gīyante gītayaḥ śubhāḥ |
uddhoṣyante vedamantrāḥ pramodante narāḥ striyaḥ ||38||
atha nāryaḥ kumāryaśca saubhāgyayoṣitastadā |
vividhairdivyaveṣādyaiḥ śṛṃgārairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ||39||
prasādhanaiḥ śṛṃgārayāmāsustāṃ bālayoginīm |
sugandhitailasārādyaiḥ salilaistīrthapāvanaiḥ ||4.23.40||
candanaiḥ kesaraiḥ piṣṭaiḥ piśaṃgaiḥ svarṇacūrṇakaiḥ |
saṃsnāpya ghargharīṃ svarṇabuṭṭaratnādisaṃbhṛtām ||41||
nidhārayāmāsurapi śāṭīṃ sauvarṇabhāsurīm |
kañcukīṃ kānakīṃ sūkṣmatantūtthāṃ kacalīṃ tathā ||42||
colīṃ ca kucalīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ ca naktakaṃ śubham |
raktarūpāṃ sūkṣmaśāṭīsahāyiśāṭikāṃ daduḥ ||43 ||
keśaveśaṃ ca kabarīṃ dhammilaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca |
saphulakaṃ grathanaṃ ca kṛtvā sumukuṭaṃ nyadhuḥ ||44||
lalāṭikāṃ bālapāśīṃ cūḍāmaṇiṃ ca śṛṃkhalām |
cūḍāmaṇiṃ karṇabhūṣāmīrayāne ca bālikām ||45||
natthīṃ ca candrikāṃ phullīṃ ṭippakīṃ ratnacakrikām |
paṭṭapatrīṃ phullamālāṃ mudgamālāṃ ca māṣajām ||46||
caṇahārān maṇihārān parvahārān nyadhurgale |
kaṭake śṛṃkhale siṃhakaṭake bhujabandhake ||47||
ūrmikāścāṃgulicakrāṇyapi prapadmapatrikām |
raśanāṃ dhārayāmāsurjhaṃjhīre ghurghurīyute ||48||
kiṃkiṇījālanādāḍhyai kaṭake kāmbike nyadhuḥ|
pādāṅgulīyakānyūrdhvacandrāḍhyāni nyadhustathā ||49||
kaṇṭhīṃ lalantikāṃ graiveyakāṇi kuṇḍalāni ca |
muktāhārādikān hārān gucchagostanamālikāḥ ||4.23.50 ||
kaṃkaṇe mekhalāṃ maṃjīre ca nyadhārayattadā |
nakhālaktakadānaṃ ca karapādatalādiṣu ||51 ||
oṣṭhagaṇḍakapolādau bhāle stanayoḥ rañjanam |
kajjalaṃ netrayordehe veṣe svarṇādicūrṇakam ||52||
nyadhustā yoṣitaḥ kanyārūpe rūpābhivṛddhaye |
puṣpahārānnadhuścāpi vadhūṭīmukuṭe śubhān ||53||
svalpalajjāṃ sūkṣmaśāṭikayā vyaracayan striyaḥ |
tāmbūlacarvaṇaṃ miṣṭabhojaṃ vāripānakam ||54||
daduḥ prāpte muhūrte’tha lāgnike maṇḍapaṃ prati |
varaṃ ca mahīmānādīnānayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||55||
viprā vṛddhā lomaśādyāḥ śiṣṭācāraṃ vyadhustadā |
prakṣālya caraṇau sureśvarī nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ||56||
pupūjākṣatakusumairlājādyaiḥ samavardhayat |
varaṃ cātha gītivedairvardhito mṛtkapālakam ||57||
saṃcūrṇya natvā devām̐śca guruṃ vahniṃ sa maṇḍape |
kuṇḍāgre nyaṣīdad darśitāsane vararāṭ sa hi ||58||
yoṣābhiścākṣatapuṣpairvardhito viprapuṃgavaiḥ |
nipīto grāmayoṣābhiścakṣurbhistṛṣitairati ||59||
hṛdaye gamito divyaścātmanyarpita iṣṭavat |
atha striyaḥ samāninyurmaṇḍapaṃ bālayoginīm ||4.23.6 0 ||
sureśvarīsahitāstā jaguśca lagnagītikāḥ |
viprāḥ kanyāṃ tadā gandhākṣatapuṣpādibhirdrutam ||61 ||
vardhayāmāsuruccaiśca maṃgalāni jagurmuhuḥ |
dinaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsurnyaṣādayan surāntike ||62|||
kanyakāṃ vāmabhāge śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai |
gaṇeśādipūjanaṃ ca kārayāmāsurityapi ||63||
kāmaphalabandhanaṃ ca maṇḍapāgniprapūjanam |
kuṇḍaprapūjanaṃ vipravṛddhādipūjanaṃ tathā ||64||
prāyaścittaṃ tu śuddhyarthaṃ kārayāmāsurityatha |
śrāddhāditarpaṇaṃ cāpi kuladevādipūjanam ||65 ||
kārayitvā varagale kanyāhastena mālikām |
puṣpāṇāṃ dāpayāmāsuḥ puṣpākṣatādivardhanam ||66||
varahastena kanyāyāḥ kaṇṭhe’pi mālikāṃ tathā |
vastragranthimato viprāścakrustato’bhidānakam ||67||
agneḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ caturvāraṃ ca namanārcanam |
kārayāmāsurevaitau havanaṃ haviṣāṃ tathā ||68||
hastagrahaṃ pitā tatra kārayāmāsa dānakṛt |
varahaste dadau hastaṃ kanyāyāstu nikāmataḥ ||69||
nikāmadevo viprarṣiścāśīrvādān dadau tadā |
mahābhāgyavatī putri bhava nārāyaṇī sadā ||4.23.70||
bālakṛṣṇaḥ prajagrāha karaṃ kanyārpitaṃ kare |
sahadharmān caratāṃ vai tādātmyaṃ caratāṃ sadā ||71 ||
dadurviprā āśiṣaśca dānaṃ daduḥ pare janāḥ |
hastadravyaṃ daduścāpi bahuratnādisaṃbhṛtam ||72||
dakṣiṇārhaṇadānāni viprebhyaḥ pradadau pitā |
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ||73||
godānādisamastāni mahādānāni vai daduḥ |
kavalaṃ ca mithastatra jagṛhaturvadhūvarau ||74||
anyonyasya mukhe premṇā dadatustatra maṇḍape |
ūrmikākhelanaṃ tatra cakraturjalapātrake ||75||
parihāraṃ tu bhūdevāścakrurvai yoṣitastadā |
gītikāpūrvakaṃ ramye mandire dampatīṃ śubhe ||76 ||
ninyurhāsyāni cakruśca dadustābhyāṃ subhojanam |
jalapānaṃ tathā tāmbūlakaṃ daduśca vai rahaḥ ||77||
śayanaṃ pradadustatra vadhūṭī pāritoṣikam |
prāpya siṣeve kāntaṃ cātha prāghuṇāstathā prajāḥ ||78||
bhuktvā vyadhuśca śayanaṃ prātarjātaṃ tato janāḥ |
pañcamyāmāṣāḍhaśukle snātvā bhuktvā samutsukāḥ ||79||
dampatīvāhinīyuktāḥ sajjā gantuṃ tato’bhavan |
pitānikāmadevaśca dhanaṃ prādānmahottamam ||4.23.80||
yautakaṃ bahudhā tatra divyaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
pradadau kanyakā sāpi śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||8 1 ||
pati prāha pitarau me saha kṛṣṇa naya tvayā |
dhūnīgrāme pitarau me madviyogena duḥkhitau ||82||
syātāṃ tasmād bhavatkṣetraṃ naya kṛṣṇa kṛpāṃ kuru |
atha tāvat samāgatya pādau dhṛtvā harerapi ||83 ||
prāha nikāmadevo’pi naya nau vai nijaṃ gṛham |
hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ tathā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ||84||
ninye snuṣāpitarau tau nijāṃ kuṃkumavāpikām |
sureśvarī tathā nikāmadevo bālayoginī ||85||
yayuḥ kṛṣṇasya vāhinyā samaṃ kuṃkumavāpikām |
dhūnīgrāmajanāścānye yayurbhaktā harestu ye ||86||
prasthānaṃ cakrire sarve madhyāhne bhojanottaram |
devavādyānyavādyanta puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ||87||
sureśvaryā jitā māyā jitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sutārpaṇāt |
jito mokṣaśceti vāṇī surāṇāmabhavaddivi ||88||
atha svargasamo grāmo maṇḍapo divyakānakaḥ |
yajñaśālā rasaśālā mahānasāni yānyapi ||89 ||
sarvaṃ tiro’bhavat sadyaḥ prasthite parameśvare |
miṣṭānnāni prasādāni devādyā ninyurutsukāḥ ||4.23.90||
tīrthāni ca surādyāśca yayurvismayamacyute |
dāsā dāsyo harikṛtā adṛśyatāṃ yayurdrutam ||9 1 ||
vāhayitvā vāhinīṃ svāṃ bālayoginikāpatiḥ |
bālakṛṣṇaḥ priyāyuk cāyayau kuṃkumavāpikām ||92|||
maṃgalāni samastāni tatrāsan kṛṣṇamandire |
pitā pradadau dānāni bhojanāni madhūni ca ||93||
mahīmānādipūjāṃ sa pracakāra tathārpaṇam |
dhanādīnāṃ yathāyogyaṃ vyasarjayatattaḥ param ||94||
mahīmānāḥ prasannāśca prayayuḥ svālayām̐stataḥ |
vadhvāḥ pitre ca mātre ca bālakṛṣṇaḥ suvarṇajam ||95||
mandiraṃ nityavāsārthaṃ pradadau bhogyajātakam |
prāpatustau parānandaṃ jāmātāraṃ hariṃ prabhum ||96||
prāpyakanyāmahābhāgyaṃ vīkṣya yayaturharṣaṇam |
nivṛttau tāvṛṇāt kanyāṃ datvā tu vidhinā tataḥ ||97||
yuyujāte harermūrtau mokṣārthaṃ tāvaharniśam |
athaikadā śrīnikāmadevaḥ papraccha taṃ harim ||98||
śreyase śreṣṭhamatraiva sādhanaṃ mokṣakṛttu yat |
badrike śvaśuraṃ mokṣamānasaṃ vīkṣya vai tataḥ ||99||
mokṣayogaṃ svajāmātā bodhayāmāsa sarvathā |
yat prāpya mānavāścāpi mokṣaṃ tūrṇamavāpnuyuḥ || 4.23.10 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne mahīmānānāṃ bhojanādi, śṛṃgāraḥ, maṇḍapaṃ
pratigamanam, śrīkṛṣṇasya śṛṃgāro maṇḍapaṃ pratigamanam, vidhiścodvāhaḥ kuṃkumavāpikāṃ pratyāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||

<4.24>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śreyase śvaśuro harim |
papracchātyantikaṃ mokṣaṃ kathaṃ sa syād vadātra me || 1 ||
jāmātā śrībālakṛṣṇo’vatārī puruṣottamaḥ |
upādideśa nikāmadevāya mokṣasādhanam || 2 ||
pūjyatama śvaśurātra vadāmi mokṣasādhanam |
mokṣayogaṃ susulabhaṃ durbhāgyānāṃ tu durlabham || 3 ||
sākṣāt kṛṣṇaprasaṃgena mucyate bhavabandhanāt |
kṛṣṇe sarvasvadātā vai mukto bhavati māyikāt || 4 ||
