kanyāṃ kṛṣṇāya dātā vai yāti matparamaṃ padam |
kṛṣṇatādātmyamāpannā kanyoddharati tatkulam || 5 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā mānavā yānti tatpadam |
śrīkṛṣṇamandirāvāsā vasanti cākṣare tataḥ || 6 ||
śrīkṛṣṇe kṛtaviśvāsā mokṣaṃ yānti hi śāśvatam |
yasya nārāyaṇī putrī sa mokṣagato hi saḥ || 7 ||
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ tārayatyeva vāsinam |
satsaṃgo mokṣadaścāsti kṛto nārāyaṇe paraḥ || 8 ||
satāṃ samāgamaḥ śreṣṭhaśreyasaḥ sādhanaṃ sadā |
satīsādhvīprasaṃgena nāryo yānti paraṃ padam || 9 ||
sevayā prāpyate satāṃ prasannatā tayā hariḥ |
hareḥ prāptau parā prāptirmokṣārthaṃ naiva vidyate || 4.24.1 0||
eṣā tu sulabhā vipravarya bhavatā cārjitā |
prāptavyo vidyate nānyaḥ tato’haṃ parameśvaraḥ || 1 1||
nārāyaṇīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram |
dhyātvā snehena sevitvā mucyate karmabandhanāt || 12||
so’haṃ nārāyaṇaścāsmi lakṣmīśca bālayoginī |
yā sā badrīpriyā badrikāśrame’sti mama priyā || 1 3||
badrikā sā bhavatputrī mama bhāryā tvayārpitā |
evaṃ māṃ tāṃ bhavān dhyātvā madrūpaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 14||
śreyase tvāyayoḥ sākṣātsevājñānaṃ bhavaddhitam |
tat kṛtvātra mahattīrthe svayaṃ mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasi || 15||
gurudevarṣisiddharṣisevā sādhusamāgamaḥ |
brahmātmavedanaṃ bhaktirmokṣasādhanamuttamam || 16||
mokṣayogo mahānasti sarvayogeśvaraḥ sukhaḥ |
harermūrtiḥ sadā yogo mokṣayogo mahattamaḥ || 17||
mūlaṃ saṃsāravṛkṣasya mamāhaṃ ceti nityadā |
tanmamāhaṃ pare kṛṣṇe yojitaṃ mayi mokṣakṛt || 18||
ahaṃ māyāṃkuro bodhyo vāsanā mūlameva sā |
mameti skandhavān vṛkṣaḥ śākhāḥ kṣetragṛhāṇi ca || 19||
dārāḥ sakhyaḥ pallavāśca dhanadhānyādipatrikāḥ |
pāpamañjarikāvyāpto duḥkhādimaladastathā ||4.24.20 ||
tasya prachittaye kṛṣṇamāhātmyajñānamuttamam |
arjayitvā vidyayāhaṃvṛkṣaśchedyo hi paṇḍitaiḥ ||21 |
tato brahmarasaṃ pītvā divyatṛptipradaṃ param |
prayāntyeva parabrahma prājñā nirvṛttimuttamām || 22||
nāyaṃ deho hi vipro’sti nātmā vā vipra ucyate |
vittiṃ prāpto hareryaḥ sa vipro māhātmyavittiyuk ||23||
tvamahaṃ ceti saṃsāro bhinnavāsanayā kṛtaḥ |
mayi vipreśvare kṛṣṇe’rpaṇāt tvamādi līyate ||24||
gṛhaṃ dārā dhanaṃ vaṃśo līyante cāsya vāsanāḥ |
tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasati sā dārā dīryate yayā ||25|||
taddhanaṃ yatsahāyārthaṃ vaṃśaḥ sa yastu śāśvataḥ |
nārāyaṇo gṛhaṃ nityaṃ dārā buddhiḥ pramokṣiṇī ||26|||
bhaktirdhanaṃ dūramārge sahāyadaṃ tathāvyayam |
vaṃśaḥ sa eva muktānāṃ vaṃśā ye te matāśca naḥ ||27||
brahmaraso mahad bhojyaṃ yena jīvati sarvadā |
yanmuktaye kṛtaṃ tadvai puruṣārthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 28||
mūrdhni kaṇṭhe lalāṭe ca hṛdaye ca nije harim |
dhyāyedātmani cātmasthaṃ yaḥ sa mucyeta bandhanāt || 29||
nikāmadeva kāmānāṃ yadā layo mayīśvare |
tadā niṣkāmatāmetya brahmarasān samaśnute || 4.24.30||
yathāgnirvardhate kāṣṭhaistejasvī jāyate bahuḥ |
kāṣṭhāni saṃvidhāyaiva bhasmarūpāṇi nānyathā || 31 ||
tathātmā vardhate puṇyaiḥ suprakāśaḥ prajāyate |
puṇyāni bhasmasāt kṛtvā brahmarasaṃ samaśnute ||35||
puṇyaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ bhavāya tat |
puṇyapāpe’rpayitvā me mahāmokṣaṃ pravindati || 33||
jñātvā māṃ paramātmānaṃ svātmasthaṃ svāminaṃ patim |
prabhuṃ divyaguṇāgāraṃ mucyate brahmarūpabhāk || 34||
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi sthūlavarjitaḥ |
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi sūkṣmavarjitaḥ || 35||
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi hetuvarjitaḥ |
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi vyomavarjitaḥ ||36||
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi sthānavarjitaḥ |
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi mātravarjitaḥ ||37||
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smīndriyavarjitaḥ |
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi prāṇavarjitaḥ ||388||
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi cārthavarjitaḥ |
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmalagno’smi divyatānvitaḥ ||39||
ahaṃ brahma parabrahmaprabhvasmi jñānabhānavān |
parabrahmaṇi lagno’smi śeṣo dāsaśca kiṃkaraḥ ||4.24.40
nānyanme rocate kṛṣṇamantarā dṛṣṭisṛṣṭiṣu |
ityevaṃ tvātmano brāhmīṃ bhāṃ jñātvā mucyate bhavāt ||41
tato na maraṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ na rogo narakaṃ na ca |
na pāpairyujyate vijño niraye na ca pacyate ||42|
na garbhe na tathā bāhye vāso’sya māyikaḥ kvacit |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāptaḥ śvetanārāyaṇo hi saḥ ||43
bhaktyā ca sevayopāsanayā māṃ labhate sa hi |
dhyānena kīrtanenāpi pūjanena japena me ||44|
stavanena vratenāpi dānena ca makhena ca |
mayyarpitena sarveṇa śuddhātmā brahma jāyate ||45|
nārāyaṇetimantreṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena ca |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena yāti mokṣaṇam ||46|
mama bhaktyā niḥkṛṣṭo’pi sarvamāpnoti cottamam |
svargaṃ vā śāśvatānandākṣaraṃ dhāma prayātyapi ||47|
tuṣyāmyahaṃ yathā bhaktyā sevayā cārpaṇena ca |
tathā nānyena tuṣyāmi tuṣyāmi sādhusevayā ||48|
mahatāṃ śreyasāṃ mūle prasavaḥ puṇyasantateḥ |
jīvitasya phalaṃ svādu smaraṇaṃ me sadā dvija ||49|
muñcantyaśrūṇi saṃharṣāt saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ |
gāyanti sāmasūktāni mayi vāsaṃ gatā janāḥ ||4.24.50|
parabrahma pragāyanto brahmarūpetisaṃsthitāḥ |
bhaktyā praṇāmakartāro vaiṣṇavāḥ pāvanā bhuvi ||51 ||
śrībhaktajanavātsalyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānumodanam |
harilīlāśravaḥprītiṃ prāptānāṃ saphalo bhavaḥ ||52||
yena sarvārpaṇenaiva kṛṣṇe bhaktirniveditā |
bhāvo niveśitaḥ kṛṣṇe mahābhāgavato hi saḥ ||53||
arcayatyeva māṃ nityaṃ dhyāyati māṃ raṭatyapi |
sarvarāgavinirmukto mleccho viprottamo hi saḥ ||54||
mokṣagatyai pravṛtto yo matkṛpāpātrameva yaḥ |
pāvanaḥ sa manuṣyāṇāṃ sa pūjyaḥ sa yathā hariḥ |||55|||
punāti śrīharerbhaktaścāṇḍālo’pi tu pāvanaḥ |
yadgṛhe śrīhariścāste yaccitte śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||56||
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ pāvanaḥ pāpināṃ hi saḥ |
śrutvānyaṃ pāpinaṃ pāpamuktaye stauti māṃ hi saḥ ||57||
dayāṃ kuru prapannāya tavāsmīti dayāṃ kuru |
evaṃ bhūtābhayadasya vaśe kṛṣṇo hi vartate ||58||
vedamantrisahasrebhyo vratyayutebhya eva ca |
tāpasānāṃ koṭitaśca kṛṣṇabhakto viśiṣyate ||99||
ekāntino harerbhaktā divyena varṣmaṇākṣaram |
tenaiva vapuṣā bhaktyā yadvā yānti paraṃ padam ||4.24.60 ||
ekāntajñānabhaktyāḍhyaścānanyabhāvasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
hareḥ priyatamo nityaṃ bhaktāvavyabhicāravān ||61 ||
āpatsvapi na muñceta prītiṃ mayyanapāyinīm |
māṃ smaran māṃ cāśrayam̐śca me cittānnopasarpati ||62||
nādhīto na makhī naiva vratī nācāravānnapi |
bhaktiṃ me vahate yastu kṛtyakṛtyaḥ sa vai mataḥ ||63||
tapasāṃ ca makhānāṃ ca vedānāṃ pāragā api |
vinā bhaktiṃ gatiṃ naiva yānti yāṃ bhaktiyoginaḥ ||64||
yaḥ kaścicchrīkṛṣṇabhakto’pyanācāro’pyanāśramī |
tathāpi jagatāṃ sūrya ivoditaḥ sa pāvanaḥ ||65||
api pāpaprayogāśca dehendriyavaśā janāḥ |
bhaktā me yāntyakṣaraṃ yannārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||66||
dṛḍhā nārāyaṇe bhaktiryeṣāṃ cāvyabhicāriṇī |
tucchaṃ svargasukhaṃ teṣāṃ bhaktiḥ śāśvatamokṣadā ||67||
karmamaye’tra saṃsāre prapannānāṃ karāt prabhuḥ |
bhuṃkte’nnajalatāmbūlaṃ tuṣṭo bhavati mokṣadaḥ ||68||
yo na kṛṣṇaṃ bhojayati na pāyayati sevate |
pūjayatyeva naivāpi tasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||69||
kathāṃ na saṃśṛṇute sa badhiro māyayāvṛtaḥ |
darśanaṃ kurute naiva so’trāndho’jñānasaṃvṛtaḥ ||4.24.70||
nāmnāṃ ca kīrtane me’tra na yasya pulakodgamaḥ |
hṛdullāso’pi naivāsti so’sti kuṇapa eva ha ||7 1 ||
mayi bhaktimatāṃ vipra muktirdāsīva vartate |
mayyananyamanasā tu sarvathā bhavasaṃkṣayaḥ ||72||
yamo’pi svadūtavargān prātargadati nityaśaḥ |
vaiṣṇavān varjayitvaiva carantvavaiṣṇavān prati ||73||
nāhaṃ vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ prabhurdaṇḍadharo’pi san |
anācārī durācārī viṣṇubhakto hi mucyate ||74||
ananyabhaktimān kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇaniścayaśobhanaḥ |
sādhudharmā paro divyo bhavatyeva sa uttamaḥ ||75||
yasya bhaktiḥ sthirā kṛṣṇe pratyaṇu varṣmaṇi sthitā |
sarvārthāstasya karagā muktirhaste’sya vartate ||76||
mayā vinirmitā māyā sarveṣāṃ bandhanapradā |
yā sā tasya bhavatyevānukūlā bhaktimokṣadā ||77||
taranti te mama māyāṃ prapadyante tu māṃ dhiyā |
bhaktyā tuṣyāmi śrīnāthaḥ sevayā yāvadātmanā || 78||
nānyopāyaistuṣṭimemi yathaimi cārpaṇātmanā |
saṃsāro gāralo vṛkṣastasya phale śubhe yuge ||79||
mayi snehamayī bhaktistathā sādhusamāgamaḥ |
pitarastasya tuṣyanti pranṛtyanti pitāmahāḥ ||4.24.80 ||
satsaṃgaṃ ca tathā bhaktiṃ kurvan kule’sti cejjanaḥ |
jalānnāni mayā vipra nirmitāni praśāntaye ||8 1 ||
tathāpi naiva māṃ lokā bhajante mohasampadaḥ |
pāpā dviṣṭā mama smṛtyā yāntyamāyaṃ padaṃ mama ||82||
jaḍā api janā ye maccharaṇaṃ saṃgatā bhuvi |
te’pi māyāmatikramya prayānti paramākṣaram ||83||
namasyo jāyate dehī namaskāraparo’pi me |
yo’hamantarniviṣṭo’smi hṛdayālayaśobhanaḥ ||84||
mama yogena divyo me bhakto mukto’sti sarvadā |
taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ namasyeta hṛdāniśam ||82||
namaskāre suśakto’pi na māṃ namaskaroti yaḥ |
so’tra magno mahāghore saṃsāre na tariṣyati ||86||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe caikā mayi bhāvanamaskṛtiḥ |
punāti sadyaścāṇḍālaṃ kimutānyajanāniha ||87||
kṛtvā sudaṇḍavannārāyaṇaṃ māṃ praṇamettu yaḥ |
sa prāpnoti gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sahasramakhajorjitām ||88||
saṃsāre duṣṭakāntāre dhāvatāṃ dehināmiha |
mayi kṛṣṇe namaskāro viśrāntidaśca tārakaḥ ||89||
āsīno vā śayāno vā bhuñjāno viharannapi |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya nama uccaret ||4.24.90 ||
mama nāma sulabhaṃ vai jihvā dattā tadarthinī |
tathāpi na gṛṇantyete nārakāḥ kiṃ tadadbhutam ||91 ||
anantasṛṣṭijā vyāsāḥ śeṣāścānantarūpiṇaḥ |
mama līlācaritrāṇāṃ nāmnāṃ nāntaṃ prayanti te ||92||
matikṣayānnivartante na me guṇakṣayāt kvacit |
avaśo’pi vadet kṛṣṇa mucyate sarvabandhanāt ||93||
baddhaḥ parikarastena sarvathā cākṣaraṃ prati |
svapne’pi māṃ smaratyeṣo mokṣāya kalpyate dvijaḥ ||94||
namaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇāya śrīkṛṣṇasya śubhāya ca |
vahan bhāvena bhakto’sau yamāya naiva kalpitaḥ ||95||
sūryodaye’ndhatamasāṃ kṣayavanmama kīrtane |
pāpānāṃ jāyate vipra kṣayo mokṣastato’pi ca ||96||
pātheyaṃ śrīkṛtaṇanārāyaṇanāma mahādhvani |
gacchatāṃ madhyalokānāṃ vighnānāṃ vinivārakam ||97||
śrīkṛṣṇaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇamādhava |
japannaro’kṣaraṃ yāti yugeṣu sarvadā sadā ||98||
jihvāyāṃ śrībālakṛṣṇahare yasya sa mokṣagaḥ |
sarvasārottamasāraścārādhanaṃ harermama ||99||
pūjyo’si macchvaśuro’si nārāyaṇīpitāsi ca |
sarvathā cānugrāhyo’si mokṣe sthito’si mānada || 4.24.10 0||
jāmātāraṃ ca māṃ labdhvā datvā dānaṃ sutātmakam |
kimanyacchiṣyate mokṣe nikāmadeva me vada || 101 ||
sampannaṃ sarvakāryaṃ te niṣpannaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ śubham |
kṛtakṛtyo’si bhagavan madrahasyaṃ tavoditam || 1 02||
prabhokṛṣṇa jayakṛṣṇa mādhavīkṛṣṇa saṃjapan |
śrīkṛṣṇa lalitākṛṣṇa japan yāhi mamākṣaram || 1 03||
bālāyoginikākṛṣṇa bālākṛṣṇeti saṃjapan |
me kṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ svāmī japan yāhi mamākṣaram || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne nikāmadevākhyena mokṣayogaṃ prati pṛṣṭaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāṇastasmai mokṣayogamupādideśetinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||

<4.25>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
punaḥ svarūpayogaṃ svaṃ subhaktāya tvupādiśat || 1 ||
svarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ mānavavigraham |
āśritya vartate yastu tasya mokṣo’sti sarvathā || 2 ||
pare’kṣare rājamāno rājādhirāja īśapaḥ |
avatārāvatārī yaḥ so’haṃ śrīkṛṣṇa eva hi || 3 ||
anantavāsudevānāṃ vāsudevottamo’smyaham |
anantaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanārāyaṇottamaḥ || 4 ||
anantānāṃ bhagavatāṃ bhagavānuttamottamaḥ |
anantānāṃ puruṣāṇāmasmyahaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 5 ||
anantānāmakṣarāṇāmakṣarottamaśāsakaḥ |
anantānāṃ ca muktānāṃ muktādhipādhipo’smyaham || 6 ||
asaṃkhyānāṃ pārṣadānāṃ pārṣadeśeśvaro’smyaham |
asaṃkhyānāṃ ca śaktīnāṃ mahāśaktīśvaro’smyaham || 7 ||
divyamuktānikānāṃ ca mahāmuktānikeśvaraḥ |
samastasādhusādhvīnāṃ śreṣṭhasādhūttamo’smyaham || 8 ||
asaṃkhyānāṃ vibhavānāṃ mahāvibhūttamo’smyaham |
anantāṃśāṃśarūpāṇāmaṃśī cāsmi paraḥ pumān || 9 ||
anantāveśakartāhaṃ mahāveśeśvaro’smyaham |
asaṃkhyādhikalānāṃ ca kaleśvaro’smyahaṃ prabhuḥ || 4.25.1 0||
vibhūtīnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ mahāvibhūtipo’smyaham |
māṇikyālalitārādhāramādīnāṃ paraḥ patiḥ || 11 ||
satāṃ patiścākṣareśaścākṣarātīta ātmapaḥ |
ātmeśaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ pālakānāṃ niyāmakaḥ || 1 2||
saccidānandarūpo’smi sadā divyo’tisundaraḥ |
divyamūrtiścaikatattvātmako’saṃkhyasukhānvitaḥ || 1 3||
modapramodānandānāmāśrayo’smi mahānaham |
utsavānāṃ samastānāṃ prakāśako’smi pāvanaḥ || 14||
samastānāmamṛtānāṃ sāgaro’smi sudhābhṛtaḥ |
miṣṭātimiṣṭamiṣṭānāṃ rasānāmasmi śevadhiḥ || 15||
ākarṣaṇānāṃ divyānāṃ mahākarṣaṇamūrtimān |
ānandamūrchanānāṃ ca sadāsmyānandamūrchanaḥ || 1 6||
sarvadivyaprasādānāṃ prasannatādivāridhiḥ |
sarvalāvaṇyasukhavān sarvamādhuryasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 17||
sarvaramyaprasaṃgānāṃ prasañjako’smi mādhavaḥ |
yāvanmanorathānāṃ ca pūrako’smi tṛṣāharaḥ || 18||
sarvāsāṃ cāpi tṛptīnāṃ tṛptidātāsmi tarpaṇe |
santoṣāṇāṃ samastānāṃ tuṣṭastoṣaprado’smi ca || 19||
premṇāṃ ca yāvatāṃ premaprado’smi premabhūḥ prabhuḥ |
snehānāṃ snigdhabhāvanāṃ snehapūrṇo bhavāmyaham ||4.25.20 ||
āsaktīnāṃ samastānāmāsaktipatirasmyaham |
śarkarāṇāṃ ca miṣṭānāṃ pīyūṣamadhudo’smyaham |||21||
śītalānāṃ sukhānāṃ ca viśeṣaḥ śītasaukhyadaḥ |
uṣṇānāṃ ca mahānandapradānāmuṣṇasaukhyadaḥ ||22||
śṛṃgārāṇāmasaṃkhyānāṃ śṛṃgārarasado’smyaham |
svādānāṃ ca samastānāṃ mahāsvādabharo’smyaham ||23||
āśleṣāṇāṃ mahānandabharo’smyahaṃ pramīlane |
cūmbanānāṃ samastānāṃ sakampānandado’smyaham ||24||
snehāśrūṇāṃ vāhako’smi premaromodgamo’smyaham |
pulakānāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ prapulako’pi sarvathā || 25||
mohānāṃ ca samastānāṃ mugdhatāsaṃbhṛto’smyapi |
śayanānāṃ suṣuptīnāṃ viśrāntīnāṃ virāmadaḥ ||26||
ārāmāṇāṃ mahārāmo rāmo’smi ramatāmaham |
ramaṇo’smi sakāmānāṃ kāmo’smi kāmināmapi ||27||
ratiścāsmi ratānāṃ ca śāntiśca siddhayoginām |
puṣṭiścāsmi prapuṣṭānāṃ balināṃ balamuttamam || 28||
ātmabalaṃ samastānāmasmyahaṃ nirbhayatvadam |
surabhiḥ saurabhāṇāṃ ca puṣpamasmi c puṣpiṇām ||29||
phalaṃ cāsmi ca phalināṃ dhāturdhātumatāmaham |
suvarṇaścāsmi varṇānāṃ rūpiṇāṃ rūpamasmyaham ||4.25.3 0||
sukaṇṭhīnāṃ miṣṭakaṇṭhaḥ susvarāṇāṃ svaro’smyaham |
gītīnāṃ madhurā gītirnṛtyānāṃ caikatānatā ||3 1 ||
hāvo bhāvastathā ceṣṭā cihnaṃ cāsmi samastagaḥ |
saṃyogo’smi dhṛtiścāsmi vṛṣo’smi sattvavānapi ||32||
ākāṃkṣāsmi samastānāṃ maryādāsmi ca dehinām |
āścaryāṇāṃ samagrāṇāmāścaryamasmi sarvagam ||33||
kautukānāṃ samastānāmasmyahaṃ kautukottamaḥ |
nirvṛttīnāṃ ramaṇīnāṃ kriyānirvṛttirasmyaham ||34||
sarvavidhānāṃ kelīnāṃ kelicāturyavānaham |
yogānāṃ ca samastānāṃ śāśvatānandayogadaḥ ||35||
rāgāṇāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ rāgyahaṃ rañjanārthakṛt |
śobhānāṃ yāvatīnāṃ ca śobhano’haṃ subhāsuraḥ ||36||
madānāṃ mādakaścāhaṃ bhogyānāṃ bhogavardhanaḥ |
ābhogānāṃ mahābhogasvarūpo’smi prabhogiṣu ||37||
dravāṇāṃ yāvatāṃ cāsmi snehadravātmakaḥ prabhuḥ |
vātsalyānāṃ vatsalatā naisargikī bhavāmyaham ||38||
cumbakānāṃ samastānāṃ piṇḍacumbakavānaham |
āntarāṇāṃ praharṣāṇāṃ mahāpraharṣaṇo’smyaham ||39||
samastānāṃ prahāsyānāṃ mandahāsyaṃ bhavāmyaham |
kaṭākṣāṇāṃ ceṅgitānāṃ kaṭākṣeṅgitavānaham ||4.25.40||
hārdānāṃ cāntarāṇāṃ ca mahāhṛdayavānaham |
prakarṣaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mahāprakarṣaṇo’smyaham ||41 ||
śreṣṭhānāṃ ca variṣṭhānāṃ śreṣṭhavareṇyadharmyaham |
pravarāṇāṃ varāṇāṃ ca pravaro varado’smyaham ||082|||
vyāpakānāmambarāṇāṃ mahāvyāpakatāsti me |
kallolānāṃ ca khelānāṃ prakhelako’smi tadgataḥ ||43||
ullāsānāṃ vilāsānāṃ samullāso vilāsakṛt |
bhāvanānāṃ ca bhāvānāṃ mahābhāvanayānvitaḥ ||44||
nivāsānāṃ ca vāsānāṃ vāsanānāṃ vasānakaḥ |
prasthānābhimukhānāṃ ca prabhavāmyavasānakṛt ||45||
pāritoṣikavaryāṇāmupadānāṃ ca toṣaṇam |
svāgatānāṃ ca mānānāṃ mānado’smi pitā prabhuḥ ||46||
prapannānāṃ cāśrayado mahādhāro’smi nāthavat |
anāthānāṃ sunātho’smi dhavo’smi dhavinīgaṇe ||47||
saubhāgyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ mahāsaubhāgyacandravān |
sampadāṃ ca vipulānāṃ sampattirasmi śāśvatī ||48||
ṛddhīnāṃ paramarddhiśca lābhānāṃ cātmalābhadaḥ |
prasevānāṃ cāṃgasevāsvarūpo’smi samarpaṇe ||49||
śuśrūṣāṇāṃ cānuvṛttirasmyahaṃ sādhuvṛttitā |
sādhutā ca kṣamā dainyaṃ tyāgināmasmi mattatā ||4.25.50||
śīladharmaḥ samasteṣu vīryaṃ vīryavatāmaham |
asmi rūpaṃ ca yoṣāsu puṃsu śmaśrurbhavāmyaham ||51 ||
vadhvā alaktakaścāsmi mantharā ca padoḥ gatiḥ |
cāñcalyaṃ navasaṃyogād bhavāmi ca nisargajam ||52||
ānukūlyaṃ dehināṃ copakāriṇāṃ bhavāmyaham |
anugraho dayā kāruṇyaṃ hitaṃ cāsmi sādhuṣu ||53||
jayo jayināṃ mūrdhanyo vidyā cātmavidāmaham |
tarkaḥ sarvajñakalpānāṃ kavīnāṃ kāvyamasmyaham ||54||
vallabhatā vallabhānāṃ kūjanaṃ mantravedinām |
stavanaṃ stāvakānāṃ ca bhavāmi miṣatāṃ miṣaḥ ||55||
lagnatā lagnināmasmi granthiśca grathnatāmapi |
nisargo’smi nisargisthastānastānavatāmaham |||96||
nikāmadeva jānīhi cetanānāṃ tu cetanaḥ |
asmyahaṃ sarvasākṣīti pravartako nivartakaḥ ||57||
sarvakarmaphaladātā sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmāsujīvinām |
sthūlaścāsmi ca sthūlānāṃ dṛśyo’smi netriṇāṃ sadā ||58||
adṛśyo’smi divyanetravihīnānāṃ tu dehinām |
gocaro’smi madarthānāṃ dūre’smi dveṣiṇāmapi ||59||
jīvanaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ jaḍānāmasmi cāstitā |
yoṣitāṃ nābhipadme’smi narāṇāmasmi nṛtvake ||4.25.60||
devānāṃ cāmṛte hyasmi pitṝṇāṃ puṇyasañcaye |
ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmabhāve’smi mānavānāṃ naye’smi ca ||61 ||
śūrāṇāṃ yodhane cāsmi viduṣāṃ bahuvedane |
satīnāṃ satyadharme’smi vadhūnāṃ patidaivate ||62||
patnīnāṃ pātivratye’smi putrāṇāṃ pitṛsevane |
dhanināṃ dānabhāve’smi rājñāṃ dhiṣṇye vasāmyaham ||63||
apsarasāṃ cānane’smi gāndharvāṇāṃ tu gāyane |
nartakīnāṃ nṛtyakārye sabhāyāṃ ca sabhāpatau ||64||
kathāyāṃ vyāsadeve’smi makhe’nale’smi sarvathā |
yuddhe jaye sthitaścāsmi nītāvasmi samudyame ||65||
dugdhe gavādipaśūnāmasmi gundre tu śākhinām |
saṃskāre dvidalādīnāmasmi bhikṣukabhikṣite ||66||
mandirāṇāṃ madhyadeśe bhavanānāṃ tu gopure |
grāmāṇāṃ catvare cāsmi nagarāṇāṃ nayālaye ||67||
araṇyeṣu pippale’smi dehalyāṃ tu gṛhe gṛhe |
tulasyāṃ vaiṣṇavasthalyāṃ vaiṣṇave’smi vane’pi ca ||68||
tīrtheṣu satsu varte’haṃ pṛthvyāṃ bhaktālaye’smi ca |
kāleṣu brāhmakāle’smi sāyaṃ cārārtrike’smi ca ||69||
nakṣatre’smi jayantyādau bimbe’smi śreṣṭhapūjane |
sarvamitre’smi manuje śāstre’smi matkathānvite ||4.25.70||
dharme’smi brahmacarye’haṃ śraddhāyāmasmi dātari |
bhāgyavatāṃ puraścāsmi durbhāgyānāṃ tu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
adhaścāsmi tu pāpānāmūrdhvamasmi divaukasām ||71 ||
ātmanivedināmasmi dehendriyāntarātmasu |
viprāṇāṃ vacane cāsmi māyāyāṃ sāttvike guṇe ||72||
anyāyānāṃ bhayaṃ cāsmi śikṣāsmi śāsyavargiṇām |
vādānāṃ nirṇayaścāsmi phalavyāpto’smi sarvathā ||73 ||
sajātīnāṃ pravāhe’smi cānupūrvyāṃ tu vāṅmaye |
viśiṣṭaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma tatrādvaito vasāmyaham ||74||
ato viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmako’haṃ pareśvaraḥ |
nikāmadeva māṃ yastu jānīyāt susvarūpiṇam ||79||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ cāryaṃ svāminaṃ bālakṛṣṇakam |
muktiṃ gacchenna sandeho madvijño na praṇaśyati ||76||
śrīnikāmadeva uvāca
kathaṃ viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmakastvaṃ vibudhyase |
saṃkṣepānme kathayasva sarvasvāminnarāyaṇa ||77||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca
viśeṣaṇaṃ sthūlamāyā sarvakāryātmikā tu yā |
viśeṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmamāyā sāmyāvasthā guṇatrayam ||78||
tābhyāmacetanābhyāṃ tu viśiṣṭaṃ brahma cākṣaram |
antaḥsthaṃ vyāpakaṃ cāsti viśiṣṭe te hyubhe’kṣare ||79||
viśeṣaṇaṃ sthūlātmānaḥ sarvakarmaphalāśanāḥ |
viśeṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmātmānaḥ karmaphalādivarjitāḥ ||4.25.80||
tābhyāṃ vai cetanābhyāṃ tu viśiṣṭaṃ brahma cākṣaram |
antaḥsthaṃ vyāpakaṃ cāsti viśiṣṭe te hyubhe’kṣare |
akṣaraṃ tvekamevāsti dvitīyena vivarjitam ||8 1 ||
brahmābhidhaṃ dhāma divyaṃ parabrahmaparātmanaḥ |
prakāśākhyaṃ saccidānandātmatejomayaṃ sadā ||82||
tadekaṃ tu caturdhātra viśeṣaṇairviśeṣitam |
viśiṣṭayorviśiṣṭayoradvaitaṃ brahmadhāma tat ||83||
viśiṣṭādvaitamuktaṃ me dhāmākṣarābhidhaṃ dvija |
jaḍeṣu cetaneṣveva sarvāvasthāsu sarvathā ||84||
rājate cākṣaraṃ brahma sarvāścaryasamanvitam |
tatra viśiṣṭādvaite vai dhāmnyakṣare virājate ||85||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
yaḥ so’haṃ tveka evāsmi tulyādhikavivarjitaḥ ||86||
advaito’smi na svo dvau vai parameśau kadācana |
ato viśiṣṭādvetādvaito’haṃ śrīparameśvaraḥ ||87||
parabrahmākṣarātītaḥ sarvātmākṣarabrahmagaḥ |
viśiṣṭaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmādvaitaṃ tatrāsmi caikalaḥ ||88||
madviśiṣṭaṃ brahma sarvajaḍacetanagaṃ matam |
evaṃ cāsmi sadā vipra vyāpino vyāpako’pyaham ||89||
etatte kathitaṃ tattvaṃ mama svarūpavedane |
so’haṃ mūrto’smi sarvatrākṣare mūrte’pi tejasi ||4.25.90 ||
akṣaraṃ brahma madyuktaṃ sarvatrāsti dvijottama |
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ cākṣare’sti viśeṣaṇatayānvitam ||9 1 ||
akṣare santi muktāśca dhāmānyanyāni santyapi |
taddhāma ca samarthaṃ madyogena mūrtimat tathā ||92||
sevāyāṃ vartate cāpi mukteśvaraṃ hi mannibham |
matsārūpyaṃ bhajamānaṃ sarvādhāramapi dhruvam ||93||
pumānnakṣarapuruṣaḥ so’yaṃ brahmapumān svayam |
tadeva vyāpakaṃ divyaṃ bhūmikā taijasī sadā ||94||
tatprāvirbhūtabhogyādi bhogopakaraṇānyapi |
bhogāśca sampadaḥ sarvā vidyante tatra sarvaśaḥ ||95||
yadādhārā yatprapoṣā yadṛddhimanta ityapi |
muktāḥ sarve vasantyeva muktānikāśca dhāmani ||96||
mama mūrteḥ suyogena pūrṇaṃ cākhaṇḍamakṣaram |
avyayaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma tatra vāso hi mokṣaṇam ||97||
nikāmadeva me yogāt tvaṃ gato’si tadakṣaram |
yatrāhaṃ tatra vai dhāmākṣaraṃ nityaṃ hi vidyate ||98||
sā bhūśca sampadaḥ sarvā bhavantyatra mayi prabhau |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tvihāsti vai ||99||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥśrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ |
akṣarastho virāje’tra sarveśaste sutāpatiḥ || 4.25.100 ||
mama yogena mokṣe’si gantavyaṃ te na vidyate |
mama sākṣātprasaṃgo’trākṣare mokṣapradastava || 101 ||
sadā tvaṃ mama mukto’si paśya divyaṃ nijaṃ gṛham |
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam || 1 02||
darśayāmāsa sahasā muktaṃ nikāmadevakam |
muktānikāṃ tathā sureśvarīṃ divyāṃ tu śāśvatīm || 1 03||
badrīpriyāṃ bālayoginīṃ ca padmāvatīsatīm |
māṇikīṃ haripatnīṃ sa pradarśyābhāvayattiraḥ || 1 04||
badrike tvaṃ saiva cāsse yā tatra bālayoginī |
māṇikyavarṇā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vāhinī || 1 05||
pṛthvyāṃ sā māṇikī vāhā vaḍavābhavadacyutā |
brahmaprabhāvatī yuktā yā jayālalitātmikā || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne parabrahmasvarūpayoganirūpaṇaṃ viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmakaparabrahmavivecanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||

<4.26>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tato’nādinarāyaṇaḥ |
bhaktaṃ nikāmadevaṃ taṃ prāha yogaṃ tu nirbhayam || 1 ||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu nikāmadeva tvaṃ nirbhīkayogamuttamam |
yajjñātvā na bhayaṃ tasya māyākālādyakarmaṇām || 2 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhyāturanvaham |
nadānatīrthatapasāṃ puṇyabhogabhayaṃ bhavet| || 3 ||
sarvapuṇyāni vai kṛṣṇe mayi nyastāni yena tu |
tasyākṣaraṃ paraṃdhāma nirbhayaṃ prāpyameva hi || 4 ||
sarvakarmādhikaṃ karmopāsanaṃ mama sarvadā |
smaraṇaṃ cānumananaṃ sarvathā bhayanāśanam || 5 ||
māyāleśānusaktistu pāpaṃ cātra mahātmanām |
hareḥ smaraṇarūpaṃ tatprāyaścittaṃ mahātmanām || 6 ||
muhūrtasmṛtimātreṇa mama dhāmābhigo bhavet |
kiṃ punaḥ satataṃ bhakto nirbhīko’nyasamāgamāt || 7 ||
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptānāṃ pāre tiṣṭhati yogavit |
yogaḥ sa eva manaso vṛttirmayyeva sarvadā || 8 ||
gacchaṃstiṣṭhan śvasan kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ smaret |
pralapan viviśan bhuṃjan raman māṃ sarvathā smaret || 9 ||
sarvakarmasu rakto’pi cittaṃ kuryāttu yo mayi |
tasya lepo na bhogānāṃ bhogamadhyādhivāsinaḥ || 4.26.1 0||
smṛtirme paramo dharmo dhyānaṃ tapaśca vai makhaḥ |
śuddhiḥ sarvā parā śāntiḥ sarvaṃ me smaraṇe sthitam || 11 ||
durlabhaṃ yatparaṃ dūramagocaraṃ yadakṣaram |
tathāpi prāpyamevāsya smarturme kṛpayā mama || 12||
apyadhvaraśatānāṃ yad vaiguṇyaṃ vikramādikam |
nirdoṣaṃ pratyuta pūrṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya smṛtermama || 1 3||
na smṛtyā sadṛśaṃ me’tra śodhanaṃ cādyakāriṇām |
bhavānāṃ dāhikā cāpi mokṣadā sā mama smṛtiḥ || 14||
niṣpannadhyānavṛttestu muktiratraiva janmani |
smarturme’nalavat kakṣaṃ smṛtirdahati vāsanām || 15||
harau cātmasthite cittasthite tu sarvakilbiṣam |
svayaṃ līnaṃ bhavatyeva tato bhayaṃ na vidyate || 16||
kalaho dūṣaṇaṃ doṣo rāga udvejanaṃ kṣayam |
na krāmenmānasaṃ smarturyatastaccittago’smyaham || 17||
tithirmāsaḥ kṣaṇaṃ yogaścandro lagnaṃ śubhaṃ dinam |
tadeva yatra govindaḥ smaryate sarvathā śubhaḥ || 18||
sā kṣatiḥ sā parā hānirvyasanaṃ tatparaṃ tathā |
yatra kṣaṇe’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo na cintyate || 19||
kalau kṛtayugastasya yasya citte janārdanaḥ |
kṛte kaliyugastasya yaccitte na janārdanaḥ ||4.26.20||
agre pṛṣṭhe pura ūrdhve’dho’bhito madhyavartule |
hṛdaye yasya govindaḥ kṛtakṛtyo hi so’sti hi ||21 ||
śubhe’śubhe mano yasyānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇe |
tasya phalaṃ mahat svargaṃ duḥkhadoṣādivarjitam ||22||
asantyajyāpi gārhasthyaṃ smarate māṃ tu yaḥ sadā |
chinatti pauruṣīṃ māyāṃ mayyarpitakriyo hi saḥ ||23||
yasya citte hariścāste kṣamāvān so’parādhiṣu |
ajñeṣu dayayā yukto modavān dhārmikeṣu saḥ ||24||
smarennārāyaṇaṃ māṃ tu tyāgabhogādikarmasu |
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādau duṣkarmasvapi cādhikam ||25||
hṛdayastho’hametasya lābhaṃ jayaṃ yaśo dhanam |
sampādayāmi satataṃ śāntimānandamuttamam ||26||
asaṃkhyapakṣipādapapaśūnāṃ mokṣado’smyaham |
smaratāṃ mama caiśvaryaṃ kiṃ prapannanṛṇāṃ tadā ||27||
śrīkṛṣṇapādapacchāyā śītātapavivarjitā |
amṛtapadadā māyābhīhantrī kiṃ na sevyate ||28||
na śāpasya bhayaṃ tasya na ca rājño bhayaṃ tathā |
na tu yāmyabhayaṃ tasya yasya cittaṃ mayi prabhau ||29||
dhyānaṃ smaraṇasaṃjuṣṭaṃ pavitramuttamaṃ sadā |
yena pāpāśano’pyatra lipyate na kadācana ||4.26.3 0||
yathā tu viṣaye cittaṃ tathā yasya harau mayi |
tathā me satsu satsaṅge sa mukto’tra pramuktidaḥ ||3 1 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktirhṛdaye vāsakāriṇī |
tatsaṅgasaṅgisaṅgāḍhyān tārayatyaghasāgarāt ||32||
tajjñānaṃ śrīhariryatra sā kathā yatra mādhavaḥ |
satkarma tad yatra cāhaṃ taccittaṃ yanmadarpitam || 33||
jihvā sā yā hariṃ stauti sā tvag yā spṛśati prabhum |
tau hastau cāśleṣitau māṃ tadvarṣma yanmadarthakam ||34||
śiraḥphalaṃ namo me’tra pāṇiphalaṃ madarcanam |
manaḥphalaṃ mananaṃ me vacaḥphalaṃ guṇastavaḥ ||31||
merutulyaḥ pāparāśirmatsmṛterdrāgvinaśyati |
sādhvasādhu caritaṃ cārpitaṃ mayi na lepakṛt ||36||
anāthānāṃ harirnātho’balānāṃ tu balaṃ hariḥ |
sakāmānāṃ harirdātā sarveṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ hariḥ ||37||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayo’tra bhūsura |
tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ māyākālakarmādināśakam ||38||
śūdraṃ carmakaraṃ cāṇḍālaṃ vā bhaktiyutaṃ mama |
vipravat pāvanaṃ manye mama yogaṃ gato hi saḥ ||39||
dhanināṃ stāvakāḥ prāyo yadi stuvanti māṃ tathā |
dhaneśvarāniha kṛtvā mocayāmi ca bandhanāt ||4.26.40 ||
vahnirvane’bhisaṃvyāptaḥ śuṣkārdradāhako yathā |
tathāhaṃ hṛdaye nyasto dahāmi vāsanādikam ||41 ||
prajvalantaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ nāśrayanti mṛgeśvarāḥ |
tathā mayā prakāśantaṃ nāśrayanti madādayaḥ ||42||
yāvadvegena bhaktirme viśvāso’pi yathā mama |
tathātra phalamāpnoti kṛpātra me viśiṣyate ||43||
putradārakuṭumbādau magnā sīdanti dehinaḥ |
sīdanti mayi te cedvai drāguttaranti madbalāt ||44||
muktimukhaṃ tu pihitaṃ yena sādhuniṣevaṇam |
tasya muktiṃ na paśyāmi kadāpi bhāvisarjane ||45||
pūjayet paramātmānaṃ māṃ sadā hṛdaye bahiḥ |
dhyāyenmāṃ sarvagaṃ mūrtaṃ kāntaṃ śrīvallabham prabhum ||46||
guruṃ patiṃ svāminaṃ māṃ juṣṭaṃ sākṣiṇamacyutam |
parabrahmānādi kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ||47||
evaṃvidhaṃ tu māṃ dhyāyan pūjya sanmānya mānada |
avāpsyasi dhruvaṃ tāta śāśvataṃ me’kṣaraṃ padam ||48||
ityevaṃ bodhito vipro nikāmadeva ādṛtaḥ |
mahāharṣaṃ samāpannaḥ sāmovāca tu nirbhayam ||49||
nṛtyan gāyan hasan dehaṃ kūrdayan ceṣṭayan muhuḥ |
uvācāveśayogena nirbhayaṃ sāma gāyanam ||4.26.50 ||
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me kālaḥ kariṣyati |
akṣareśaṃ parameśaṃ brahmeśaṃ puruṣottamam ||51 ||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ parameśvaram |
adhokṣajaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati ||52||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpatimacyutam |
gopālajaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me māyā kariṣyati ||53||
sarvāvatāriṇaṃ sarvaśaktisevitamādhavam |
kāṃbhareyaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me pāpaṃ kariṣyati ||54||
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ lomaśasya śubhāśramam |
aśvasaraḥ prapanno’smi kiṃ me karma kariṣyati ||55||
bhagavantaṃ sarvadhāmnāṃ nārāyaṇanarāyaṇam |
rādhākāntaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me tṛṣṇā kariṣyati ||56||
māyātāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīmādhavīpatim |
māṇikīśaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me kāmaḥ kariṣyati ||57||
sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ sākṣād bālayoginīsvāminam |
parameśaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me bhrāntiḥ kariṣyati ||58||
akṣareśaṃ ca mukteśaṃ muktānikāpatiṃ harim |
brahmapriyeśaṃ prāpto’smi kiṃ me sampat kariṣyati ||59||
īśvareśaṃ ceśvarāṇīpatiṃ haripriyāpatim |
prabhumpatiṃ prapanno’smi ki me tamaḥ kariṣyati ||4.26.60||
padmāvatīsvāminaṃ ca jaḍacetanavartinam |
lakṣmīnāthaṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ vāsanā kariṣyati ||61 ||
ekarūpaṃ bahurūpaṃ viśvarūpaṃ tu bālakam |
satāṃ patiṃ prapanno’smi kiṃ me bandhaḥ kariṣyati ||66||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
namo’kṣaranivāsāya namo golokavāsine ||63||
namo vaikuṇṭhanāthāya namaḥ śrīpuravāsine |
namo lalitākāntāya sarvakāntāya te namaḥ ||64||
bālayoginīkāntāya badrīkāntāya te namaḥ |
nikāmadevanāthāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ ||65||
namo’mṛtanivāsāya namo’vyākṛtavāsine |
namaḥ kailāsavāsāya hiraṇyagarbhavāsine ||66||
namaḥ siddhādhivāsāya namaḥ surādivāsine |
namaḥ pitṛnivāsāya namo mānavarūpiṇe ||67||
namaḥ sarvanivāsāya namo madātmavāsine |
sureśvarīhṛdisthāya namo’nantasvarūpiṇe ||68||
namo dehendriyaprāṇāntarātmavāsine sadā |
namaste paramānanda namaste jñānasaṃbhṛta ||69||
namaste jñānavijñānaprada śrīpuruṣottama |
namaste viśvakṛdviṣṇo namaste sarvakāraṇa ||4.26.70||
namaste gopagopīśa namaḥ sarvārthasādhaka |
namaste’nugrahadātarnamaste mokṣada prabho ||71 ||
jaya kṛṣṇa jaya viṣṇo mamābhayada mādhava |
jaya śānta cidānanda saccidānanda keśava |||72||
jaya jīva jayada tvaṃ jaya sākṣājjanārdana |
jaya śāstrādisannyastabījagarbhādyupāsana ||73||
tvaṃ gurustvaṃ pitā bhrātā suhṛd bandhuḥ prasūrmama |
tvaṃ mokṣastvaṃ parānandastvaṃ me sarvasvamacyuta ||74||
tvamuddhartā ca pātā ca netā tvaṃ viratirbhavān |
jagat sarvaṃ tava rūparūpitaṃ saṃprakāśate ||75||
tvaṃ parabrahma bhagavan devādyaistu durāsadaḥ |
mayā tvāsāditaścātra bālayoginīvaibhavāt ||76||
kastvāṃ jānāti cātmeśa muktagamyaṃ parātparam |
sanātanapumāṃsaṃ taṃ purāṇapuruṣottamam ||77||
paraṃ rūpamajānto divaukaso maharṣayaḥ |
avatāramayīmūrtīste bhajanti sugocarāḥ ||78||
avatārā bhajante tvāṃ pumāṃsamavatāriṇam |
nārāyaṇā asaṃkhyāstvāṃ bhajante paramāyaṇam ||79||
nārāyaṇyaśca muktānyastvāṃ bhajante paraṃ patim |
santo muktāstvāṃ bhajante sarvāvasthāsu satpatim ||4.26.80||
tavājñānena bhagavan mānuṣādinisargataḥ |
kṣantumarhasi sarvaṃ me yat kṛtaṃ na kṛtaṃ tava ||8 1 ||
sarvāvasthāsu sarvatra sarvakāleṣu sarvathā |
acalā tu hare bhaktisteṃ’ghriyuge’stu me prabho ||82||
prītistvayyeva satataṃ bhavatvātyantikī mama |
sarvakāmaphaladātastvayi bhaktirdṛḍhāstu me ||83||
stotraṃ kartumanantasya kaḥ śaknoti tu mānavaḥ |
tathāpi vyāpṛtaṃ vākyaṃ kṣamasva nātha te namaḥ ||84||
puruṣottamayogena nirbhayatvaṃ prajāyate |
tava yogena puruṣaḥ puruṣottamatāṃ vrajet ||85||
adhanyo jāyate dhanyastvasādhuḥ sādhutāṃ vrajet |
abhāgyo bhāgyavān syācca te stavāt puruṣottama ||86||
api lokabahiṣkāryā yadi te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ |
sādhuśīlā hi te sarve jāyante paṃktipāvanāḥ ||87||
yeṣāṃ sarvādhipe kṛṣṇe bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī |
api cāṇḍālakarmāṇaste’pi viprottamottamāḥ ||88||
api śaucasamācārāḥ kṛṣṇe te saṃgavarjitāḥ |
śmaśānavāsāste sarve sarvakilbiṣasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||89||
tava dhyānaparā ye ca tava pūjāparāyaṇāḥ |
tava prasādabhoktāraste sadā vighasāśinaḥ ||4.26.90||
ārādhya satataṃ tvāṃ śrīhariṃ sarvasukhapradam |
prāpya tvāṃ paramātmānameṣṭavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||9 1 ||
sādhubhiścintyate yaśca sādhvībhiḥ kāmyate tu yaḥ |
pīyate yogamāpannairyaḥ sa kṛṣṇo’stu me hṛdi ||92||
bhāvapuṣpaiḥ pūjayāmi śraddhāñjaliprado’smi ca |
ātmānaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvārpayāmi te pareśvara ||93||
yathā sarpiḥ śarīrasthaṃ gavāṃ na kurute balam |
nirgataṃ karmasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ tāsāṃ balapradam ||94||
tathā tvaṃ hṛdayastho’pi mānavānāṃ balāya na |
tvameva nirgataḥ sākṣād bhūto balāya vidyase ||95||
vinārādhanayā kṛṣṇa tvaṃ kṛpāvaśago mama |
pratyakṣaṃ mānavaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ nārāyaṇācyuta ||96||
sadaiva sevitaṃ cāpi divyaṃ rūpaṃ pradarśaya |
yadyahaṃ pātramasmyatra kṛpāpātraṃ bhavāmi cet ||97||
vipratvaṃ me gataṃ cāpi tvayyeva tatsamarpitam |
muktatvaṃ vartate me cet sarvāṃśe tava bhaktimān ||98||
evaṃ śrībadarīdevi prārthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
kṛpayaiva bhūsurāya divyaṃ rūpamadarśayat ||99||
akṣarasthaṃ cāvatārairasaṃkhyairāprapūritam |
muktairmuktānikābhiśca sevitaṃ kamalādibhiḥ || 4.26.1 00||
tathā śrībālayoginyā badaryā juṣṭamutsukam |
kṛpayādarśayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nikāmine || 1 01||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛtanirbhayayogopadeśottaraṃ nikāmadevasya divyajñānāptilābhottaraṃ stutirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||

<4.27>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ badarīdevi tvayā nikāmayoginaḥ |
patnyāḥ kathā parā divyā mokṣadāpi tato’bhavat || 1 ||
yāvat paśyati divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
nikāmadevaḥ sahasā divyastabdhākṛtiṃ gataḥ || 2 ||
tāvat tatra samāyātā sureśvarī satī drutam |
pūjārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kamalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 3 ||
sahasrakamalaiścāśvapaṭṭasarobhavaiḥ satī |
candanaiścākṣataiḥ puṣpaiḥ kṛṣṇapūjārthamāgatā || 4 ||
vyapaśyat svapatiṃ stabdhaṃ divyasamādhisaṃsthitam |
anuktvā sā drutaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cakriṇe || 5 ||
kamalāni samarpyaiva candanaṃ cākṣatānyapi |
samastāni supuṣpāṇi samarpya paramātmane || 6 ||
pādasaṃvāhanārthaṃ sā yāvat puro niṣīdati |
tāvacchrīkṛṣṇakāntasya pādayornirgatā prabhā || 7 ||
avyāpnod badrike saudhe tataścatvaramaṇḍale |
nibiḍā ca ghanībhūtāvyāpnodambaramaṇḍale || 8 ||
candranibhābhavat sā tu mādhuryaśītamiṣṭadā |
atha vidyunnibhā jātā svargānalasamā tataḥ || 9 ||
mahābhūtamayī jātā taijasī sā tato’mbare |
atheśvarāṇāṃ yogyā ca gamyā svarganivāsinām || 4.27.1 0||
brahmādīnāṃ tato gamyā tataśceśvarapuṃgavaiḥ |
nibhālyā śrīpure dhāmni yathā vai taijasī prabhā || 11 ||
vāsudevaprabhā paścāt kṛṣṇaprabhākṣaraprabhā |
akṣaraṃ dhāma sarvaṃ sābhavat tābhyāṃ nibhālitam || 12||
muktā muktānikāścāpi brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ |
samastā śrīrmāṇikī ca lalitā ca jayā ramā || 12||
rādhāpadmāvatīśaktayaśca tābhyāṃ vilokitāḥ |
dhāmni cārāmasaudhāni mandirāṇi śubhāni ca || 14||
bhavanāni vicitrāṇi muktānāmālayāḥ śubhāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mukhyamandiram || 15|||
sahasraikakalaśāḍhyabahumandiramadhyagam |
nibhālitāstathā sakhyaḥ sakhāyaḥ paramātmanaḥ || 1 6||
udyānāni vihārāśca divyabhogā vilokitāḥ |
divyātidivyasaundaryamādhuryaujjvalyasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 17||
pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaśca tābhyāṃ tatra vilokitāḥ |
kalpadrumā brahmadrumā brahmavallyo vilokitāḥ || 18||
phalapuṣparddhayasteṣu miṣṭarasā vibhāvitāḥ |
anantabhogasāmagryo’saṃkhyasādhanasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 19||
anantadāsadāsyaścānantaiśvaryavibhūtayaḥ |
anantasiddhadehāśca muktātmāno vilokitāḥ ||4.27.20|||
muktairmuktānikābhiśca sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrasthito dhāmni vilokitaḥ ||21||
divyākṣare pare dhāmni saurāṣṭro’pi vilokitaḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasaro divyaṃ ramyaḥ śrīlomaśāśramaḥ || 22||
maharṣīṇāṃ cāvasathānyapi divyāni tatra ca |
ālokitāni divyāni koṭyarbudābjaśaktayaḥ ||23||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntā vilokitāḥ |
tatra tvaṃ badarī cāsse māṇikyā bhagavatpriyā ||24||
divyagajāsanaṃ kṛṣṇamandire sarvaśobhane |
sarvarddhisaṃbhṛtaṃ cāpi tābhyāṃ vilokitaṃ tadā ||25||
atha tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ |
purāṇapuruṣo badri divyayuvā susundaraḥ || 26||
svarṇakeśaḥ svarṇaśmaśruḥ svarṇāmbaraḥ sutaijasaḥ |
sarvalāvaṇyamūrtiśca mandahāsyānvitaḥ prabhuḥ || 27||
anantacandraśītāḍhyanetradvayavirājitaḥ |
sarvānandapradapremarasāḍhyanetrapadmajaḥ ||28||
mandahāsyasugandhāḍhyamukhamaṇḍalarājitaḥ |
raktauṣṭhasthasumādhuryapriyatābodhabodhakaḥ ||29||
śvetakāntiprasaratsadratnabījābhadantakaḥ |
śrīrūpāvyaktabhāvāḍhyamāṇikyajihvikāntaraḥ ||4.27.3 0||
puṣṭaskandhadvayālambimandārādisraganvitaḥ |
bhujabandhabhujāśobhacchṛṃṅkhalāḍhyaprakoṣṭhakaḥ || 31 ||
dakṣakaratalasthānamīnaśūladhanurdhvajaḥ |
nakhacandrāvalidyotatsamagrābhipuraḥsthalaḥ ||3 2||
ratnabhūṣāvalivyāptakaustubharekhikaurasaḥ |
svarṇāmbarādiśobhāḍhyo raśanākaṭiśobhitaḥ ||33||
kvaṇatkiṃkiṇikākūjatpādabhūṣāvirājitaḥ |
svarṇacitramṛdusvastipādukācaraṇānvitaḥ || 34||
alaktābhacaraṇobhatalādisarvacihnavān |
pārameśaṃ paraṃ chatraṃ mastakordhve virājate ||35||
cāmare cālpamāne’pi śrīlakṣmībhyāṃ dhṛte śubhe |
vyajanena satī bālayoginī yatra tiṣṭhati ||36||
sureśvarī tāmbūlakaṃ yasmai kṛṣṇāya yacchati |
nikāmadevaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavetradharo’tra rājate || 37||
evaṃ divyasvarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastābhyāṃ pravīkṣitaḥ |
athāsya kṛpayā kṛṣṇodyānāni bhavanāni ca ||38||
antaḥ praviśya sarvāṇi tābhyāṃ vilokitāni vai |
anantānandamodāśca tābhyāṃ tatra samarjitāḥ ||39||
prasādāścārjitā divyaśrīkṛṣṇena samarpitāḥ |
tṛptāḥ śāśvatabhāvāśca muktāścāpi vilokitāḥ ||4.27.40||
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca dharmamūrtirvilokitaḥ |
tathā śrīkaṃbharālakṣmīrbhaktirūpāvalokitā ||41 ||
santuṣṭā ca satī bālā kṛṣṇaśaktirvilokitā |
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasādaṃ ca labdhvā bhuktvā ca tau tadā ||42||
tṛptau nārāyaṇadṛṣṭyā golokaṃ samupāgatau |
akṣaraṃ dhāma sahasā samastaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ||43||
goloke śrīkṛṣṇarūpastābhyāṃ sa eva mādhavaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vilokitaḥ ||44||
vaṃśīdharo gopikānāṃ maṇḍaleṣu sarādhikaḥ |
rāsaṃ rāmayan ramayan gopavṛndeṣu vīkṣitaḥ ||45||
gavāṃ susevane sakto dugdhadadhyādibhojanaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vilokitaḥ ||46||
atha tābhyāṃ sa golokastirobhūto vilokitaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhastāvadevaiva sañjāta iti vīkṣitaḥ ||47||
tatra nārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ prabhurvilokitaḥ |
asaṃkhyapārṣadaiḥ sevyo’nantaramādirāmaṇaḥ ||48||
avyākṛtaṃ mahaddhāma tatastābhyāṃ vilokitam |
vāsudevastatra dhāmni vāsudevyādisevitaḥ ||49||
pradyumnādibhrātṛbhiśca sarvasāmarthyaśobhitaḥ |
ālokito hi bhagavān tataḥ śrīpuradhāmani ||4.27.50||
lalitāśrīmahādevyā sevito’nantaśaktibhiḥ |
amṛtākhye tato dhāmni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa ca ||51||
bhūmā hi bhagavān so’pi vīkṣitaḥ kamalāpatiḥ |
tataḥ kailāsarūpe ca sadāśivo vilokitaḥ ||52||
sa eva bhagavām̐stābhyāṃ hiraṇyagarbhadhāmani |
hiraṇmayaḥ svarṇamūrtirmahāviṣṇurvilokitaḥ ||53||
vaikuṇṭhe cāpare tatra sa vai viṣṇusvarūpadhṛk |
padmāśrīsahitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilokitaḥ ||54||
atha sūrye sa evāpi nārāyaṇo hiraṇmayaḥ |
vilokito hi bhagavān vahnau vahnisvarūpadhṛk ||55||
sa eva bhagavān badrikāśrame ca narāgrajaḥ |
tāpaso lokitastābhyāṃ śvetadvīpe’tha śeṣagaḥ ||56||
sa eva bhagavān kṣīre lakṣmīkānto vilokitaḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sarvāvatārarūpadhṛk ||57||
koṭyavatārasahitaḥ koṭikṛṣṇasamanvitaḥ |
vilokitastatastābhyāmanādipuruṣottamaḥ ||58||
athāntaryāmirūpaḥ sa pratyātmāpi nibhālitaḥ |
sureśvaryā hṛdaye’pi nikāmadevamānase ||29||
samagrāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ bālayoginikāsthiṣu |
pratyavayavaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilokitaḥ ||4.27.6 0||
evaṃ pradarśya bhagavān tābhyāṃ divyaṃ mahattamam |
mahimānaṃ nijaṃ paścāt tiro’bhāvayadacyutaḥ ||6 1||
mānavaḥ sahasā jātaścāśvapaṭṭasastaṭe |
pṛthvyāṃ sthito’bhavattatra snānārthakṛtaniścayaḥ ||62|
nikāmadevaṃ hastābhyāṃ pasparśa ca sureśvarīm |
tāvattau carmacakṣuṣkau jātau yadvaddhi mānavau ||6 3||
nipetatuḥ pūrṇakāmau kṛtasarvātmadarśanau |
stutiṃ sāśrudṛṣṭinetrau cakratuḥ svāminaḥ prabhoḥ ||64||
pāvitau kṛpayā kṛṣṇa putrīdānena pāvitau |
rakṣitau sannidhau kṛṣṇa kṛpayā mokṣitāvapi ||65 ||
kṛtakṛtyau prajātau svaḥ prārthitaṃ nāvaśiṣyate |
pareśastvaṃ ciraṃ prāpto bhavārṇave punastviha || 66 ||
bhavo gato gato bhāvo bhayaṃ gataṃ tu naidhanam |
āgatā brahmasaṃvittirbrāhmī tṛptiḥ samāgatā ||67||
yadvā preṣaya tatraiva yatrāsse tva mahākṣare |
yadvā rakṣaya cātraiva pādayoste janārdana ||68||
brahmeśastvaṃ yathārtho’si janmamaraṇatārakaḥ |
jā janirmā mṛtiśceti tastāraka ityasi ||69||
sarvātmako’si bhagavan sarvecchā nau rarāma ha |
na tvāṃ vinā parātmānaṃ kiñcijjagati vidyate ||4.27.70||
tvāmeva viśvarūpaṃ ca paraṃ jñātvā vimucyate |
sarvasthaṃ tvāṃ vilokyaiva samādhiḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ ||71||
tvāṃ dhyātvā yastyajetprāṇān sa yāti brahmadhāma vai |
tvāṃ saṃsthāpya nijātmābje gantavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||72||
kṛṣṇaprakāśakaṃ dhyānaṃ sarvabandhavimocakam |
aho bhāgyaṃ paraṃ nau ca yadatra milito bhavān ||73||
manthanād dṛśyate hyagnirbhavān sarvasamarpaṇāt |
kṛpā te nau vimokṣāya nānyaḥ panthā hi kāraṇam ||74||
śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ tīrthaṃ tapo vratam |
na muktau kāraṇaṃ cātra kṛpā te cātra kāraṇam ||75||
yadā sarve samarpyante kāmā hṛtsthāstvayīśvare |
tadāmṛtapadaprāptiḥ kṛpayā te bhavediha ||76||
sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī tvaṃ kṣetrajñaścātmadīpakṛt |
vilīya vāsanā naijān nayasyakṣaradhāmani ||77||
ityuccārya nama oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te |
namaskāraṃ cakratustau tāvacchrībālayoginī ||78||
āyātā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya dātumuttamam |
sumiṣṭaṃ salilaṃ pānayogyaṃ ca śītalaṃ satī ||79||
divyadṛṣṭyā jñātavatī pitrostūrṇaṃ hi mokṣaṇam |
nātidūre ca sahasā pāyayitvā jalaṃ harim ||4.27.80||
prasādavāri pitṛbhyāṃ dadau sā bālayoginī |
tāvattau kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||81||
jagadaturdivyavācā kṛpayā svāminaḥ prabhoḥ |
prasādavāripānena dehābhyāṃ parivartitau ||82||
divyarūpau taijasau tau bhāgatyāgavivarjitau |
babhūvaturhi tatraiva muktau dhāmagatau yathā ||83||
tāvad vimānaṃ subhagaṃ gajāgrapariśobhitam |
muktamuktānikājuṣṭaṃ jayaśabdādikūjitam ||84||
ambaraṃ pṛthivīṃ svarge prabhāsayad yathākṣaram |
avātaranmandirasya sannidhau setubhūmiṣu ||85||
jayaśabdairharikṛṣṇaṃ svāminaṃ śrīramāpatim |
puṣpākṣatādibhirdivyaiścandanaistamapūjayan ||86||
avatīrya vimānācca śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmṛtam |
jagṛhuśca rajo mūrdhni nidadhuśca papurjalam ||87||
paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ tāvattau mānavāvapi |
divyadehau bālakṛṣṇahastadhṛtau vimānake ||88||
niṣāditau viprasureśvarīnikāmadevakau |
natau putryā ca hariṇā badaryā tatra tāvubhau ||89||
māṇikyayā natau cāpi natau kṛṣṇakuṭumbibhiḥ |
natvā sarvān vimānena yayaturdhāma cākṣaram ||4.27.90||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dehino devakoṭayaḥ |
evaṃ badrīpriye devi śvaśurau paramātmanā ||9 1||
preṣitāvakṣaraṃ dhāma pitarau te tadā matau |
idaṃ ye paramākhyānaṃ śroṣyanti paramādarāt |||2||
śrāvayiṣyanti vā lokān prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim |
kṛṣṇasevā mokṣadā vai sādhusevā ca mokṣadā ||93||
mantro viṣaṃ vārayati vahniḥ śītaṃ haratyapi |
sadā tu tau hi nirdoṣau mantraḥ kṛṣṇo’nalo hi san ||94||
satāṃ yogena muktiḥ syād yathā śrīkṛṣṇayogataḥ |
kṛṣṇayogena mokṣaḥ syād yathā sādhuprasaṃgataḥ ||95||
sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya yogena divyatā varṣmaṇastviha |
sarvārthalābha evāpi śiṣyate nāparaṃ sukham ||96||
bālayoginīgītāyā abhyāsena parātmanaḥ |
patnī syāt kanyakā nārī naro dāsastu pārṣadaḥ ||97||
sakāmāḥ sampadāṃ vāsā niṣkāmāḥ syurvimuktigāḥ |
asiddhāḥ siddhatāṃ ceyurbaddhā nirbaddhatāmapi ||98||
bhramitā brahmabhāvaṃ ca prāpnuyuḥ śravaṇādapi |
mānanāt kṛṣṇatāṃ nididhyāsanāt parameśatām ||99||
prāpnuyuḥ sarvathā badri prāha śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
bālayoginīgīteyaṃ bālakṛṣṇasuyogadā || 4.27.10 0||
śrotavyā satataṃ muktyai gantavyaḥ paramaḥ pumān |
bhoktavyaṃ ca sukhaṃ kārṣṇe suptavyaṃ śayane hareḥ ||1 01 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena nikāmadevāya tatpatnyai ca sarvadhāmadhāmirūpasvadarśanaṃ dattam, nikāmadevatatpatnyoḥ sadehadivyamokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||

<4.28>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ |
kaivartakasya bhaktasya prapannasya vimocinīm || 1 ||
asti jvālālakaṃ nāma nagaraṃ bhadrikātaṭe |
tatrāste nigaḍabhrāmo nāmnā kaivartajātijaḥ || 2 ||
karoti vāsaṃ bhadrāyā nadyāstu sannidhau divā |
matsyagrāhakriyāsaktaḥ kuṭumbabharaṇodyamaḥ || 3 ||
jālamādāya bhadrāyā hrade gatvā tu matsyakān |
pāśayitvā gṛhaṃ yāti sāyaṃ matsyādanaḥ sadā || 4 ||
vikrīya cādhikānmatsyān dhanaṃ prāpnoti yattu saḥ |
tenānnaṃ śākapatrādi krītvā bharate bālakān || 5 ||
putrān putrīstathā patnīṃ bharate tena karmaṇā |
athaikadā striyā sākaṃ vastrakṣālanahetave || 6 ||
bhadrāṃ nadīṃ yayau jālayuto nigaḍabhrāmakaḥ |
sa tu tīre sthito jālaṃ cikṣepāgādhavāriṣu || 7 ||
patnī tasyāmbaraprakṣālanodyatā jalaistadā |
kṣālayatyeva vastrāṇi tatra nirmalavāridhau || 8 ||
vastradhyānaparā yāvanmajjayatyambaraṃ jale |
tāvat tatpatinā jāle pāśitaṃ tu timiṃ patim || 9 ||
vīkṣya drāk ca timeścakrośanaṃ śrutvā bhayāvaham |
timinī pāśabaddhaṃ svaṃ patiṃ kaivarttarodhitam || 4.28.1 0||
ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ jālena bahumatsyasamanvitam |
śaśāpa duḥkhamāpannā rakṣaṇe śaktivarjitā || 11 ||
kaivarttaṃ mānuṣīvāṇyā bhūtvātivihvalā tadā |
kaivartta tvaṃ bhavāvarttānmā muktāḥ karhicid bhava || 12||
muhustimiṅgilo bhūtvā mara kaivartajālagaḥ |
yathāhaṃ duḥkhinī tvatra bhavāmi patināśataḥ || 1 3||
tathā patnī tava cāpi sadāstu duḥkhinīti ca |
evaṃ matsyavadhūścoktvā rurodāpatyavāritā || 14||
tāvat kaivarttikāścaryaṃ śrutvāpaśyajjalāntare |
mīnī rautīti patyarthaṃ patirjālāntarārditaḥ || 15||
śāpaṃ dadau tu sā matsyetyevaṃ veda nijāntare |
sahasā cāmbaraṃ tyaktvā patyuḥ sannidhimetya ca || 16||
vicārya matsyamokṣārthaṃ jālasūtraṃ kare’karot |
patihastānmocayitvā labdhvā jālaṃ jale śanaiḥ || 17||
mumocābandhanāyaiva matsyānāṃ śāpabhīyutā |
jālaśaithilyabhāvena matsyā jālādviniryayuḥ || 18||
sarve’pi tvakṣatā jāle nirgatya viviśurjalam |
saṃvadantaḥ prasannāśca jīva tvaṃ lakṣavatsarān || 19||
sadaiva sadhavā cāpi patisevāparāyaṇā |
dayāvatī ca matsyānāṃ hiṃsākarmādivarjitā ||4.28.20||
hṛṣṭā bhavatu kaivartti sadāsmadrakṣaṇādiha |
evaṃ matsyādayaścoktvā viviśurjalamadhyake ||21||
atha śrutvā tu kaivartto mahāścaryaparo’bhavat |
kṣudhānvito’pi patnyāstat karma vīkṣya dayāparam ||22||
anumene mumocāpi jālaṃ tīre viyatnakaḥ |
patnīṃ papraccha kimidaṃ sahasā jālakarṣaṇam ||23||
patnīṃ taṃ śrāvayāmāsa śāpaṃ matsyoditaṃ tadā |
kaivarttaśca samāśrutya bhayaṃ cāvāpa janmanām ||24|||
matsyayonijaduḥkhānāṃ paśyannānantyamanvaham |
matsyai tu śāpadātryai ca mocayitryai tu yoṣite ||25||
dhanyavādān dadau tatra yat pāpānmocitastviti |
jālaṃ tyaktvā kṣaṇe tatra vahnau prajvālya dhīvaraḥ ||26|||
phalakandānnaśākādastata ārabhya so’bhavat |
badrike puṇyasādhūnāṃ saṃgamaḥ sadgatipradaḥ || 27||
matsyā ime’bhavat sarve ṛṣayo matsyarūpiṇaḥ |
bhadrāyāṃ tajjale’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 28||
bahuvāraṃ gaje sthitvā yatra snānāya gacchati |
tattīrthalobhavaśagā maharṣayo’bhavan jhaṣāḥ || 29||
yastu dhṛto mahān matsyo matsyā cānye ca ye’bhavan |
matsyarūpo’bhavat so’tra maharṣiḥ pipaṭhāyanaḥ ||4.28.30||
sarvajñakalpa ūrdhvadṛk sarvavidyānidhirdvijaḥ |
matsyā patnī ca nāmnāsya pāṭhāyanīti sābhavat || 31 ||
anye matsyādayo viprā vedajñāścābhavan jale |
badrike sa tu kaivarttaḥ pāpo maharṣidaṇḍavān ||22|||
patnyā sadayayā kāntastāritaḥ samayajñayā |
bandhakṛnnirayaṃ yāti bandhahā yāti gauravam ||33||
jīvābhavapradātā tu sarvasvargāni vindati |
bhayadastu patatyeva svargādapi sukhālayāt ||34||
atha kaivarttikī natvā papraccha jalamatsyakān |
ke bhavantaḥ kathaṃ matsyāḥ kathaṃ vāgīdṛśī śubhā ||35||
kathaṃ vā matsyarūpatvaṃ kathayantu dayālayāḥ |
ityabhinoditā viprāḥ pratyūcurnigaḍabhramam ||36||
atrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrād vihartuṃ gajamāsthitaḥ ||37||
rasālāraṇyamāyāti viśrāmyatyatra śādvale |
snāti krīḍati bhadrāyāstaṭe satsalile hariḥ ||38||
bahudhā śrīramālakṣmīrādhāpriyādibhiḥ saha |
mādhavīlalitāmuktājayābhiḥ saha pārṣadaiḥ ||39||
ramate vārṣu taistābhirbhuṃkte phalāni pāti vāḥ |
prasādaṃ pradadātyevopasthitebhyaḥ kṛpāparaḥ ||4.28.40 ||
ṛṣibhyaḥ pārṣadebhyaśca yādobhyaḥ paśupakṣiṣu |
kṣipatyete prasādaṃ taṃ prāpya yānti kṛtādarāḥ ||41 ||
miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi bhojayatyatra mādhavaḥ |
utsavān prakarotyatra dānānyarpayati prabhuḥ |||42||
tadarthaṃ bahudhā cātra viprā dīnāśca sevakāḥ |
vasantyatra prasādānāṃ dānānāmicchayā mudhā ||43||
vayaṃ cāpi vasāmo’tra viprā haryarthameva ha |
pipaṭhāyanamūrdhanyāḥ śataṃ kuṭumbinaḥ śubhāḥ ||44||
āśramāḥ śrīrasālānāmadhaḥ santi vilokaya |
athāpyatra samāyānti jalārthaṃ vanarākṣasāḥ ||45||
kvacid rātrau divā vāpi bahukrūraprakarmiṇaḥ |
pīḍayanti viprajanān praharanti kvacit khalāḥ ||46||
apaharanti ca yoṣidvargaṃ haranti vastukam |
pratikartuṃ vayaṃ śaktā api tvahiṃsayā sthitāḥ ||47||
bhagavallābhayogena cākleśena ca vāriṣu |
kvacit kvacid vasāmo’tra matsyā bhūtvā jalāntare ||48||
kvacittu mānavāścāpi mṛgā vā siddhasādhavaḥ |
bhūtvā bhūtvā vicarāmo cūtāraṇye surāṣṭrake ||49||
vada tvaṃ vai kathamatra ko’si kasmācca hiṃsasi |
kathaṃ vai krūratāṃ hiṃsāṃ vahasyatrāpi mānave ||4.28.50 ||
durlabho mānavo deho mokṣadaḥ svargadaḥ śubhaḥ |
kathaṃ hiṃsayā nirayān vrajituṃ karmakṛd bhavān ||51 ||
hiṃsā stainyaṃ pāradāryaṃ kapaṭaṃ chalatānṛtam |
nindā doṣāropaṇaṃ ca nirayāṇāṃ pradāstvime ||52||
māṃsāśanaṃ surāpānaṃ droho mālinyamārttadā |
parāpaharaṇaṃ krodho nirayāṇāṃ pradāstvime ||53||
sevā satāṃ harau bhaktiḥ parābhayapradānakam |
ahiṃsanaṃ prasādānāmaśanaṃ cāpyanindanam ||54||
paropakaraṇaṃ dānaṃ svargasyaite pradā matāḥ |
śuddhiḥ pūjā darśanaṃ ca satsaṃgo’nnaphalāśanam ||55||
svatvamātreṇa nirvāhaḥ svargāṇāṃ tu pradāstvime |
hiṃsayā jāyate duḥkhaṃ pāpaṃ tannirayapradam ||96||
udarārthaṃ paraprāṇavināśaḥ karma nirghṛṇam |
satsu phaleṣu kandeṣu vividhānneṣu satsvapi ||57||
māṃsāśano bhaved yastu sa yāti rauravaṃ param |
jīvā naiva tu hantavyāḥ phalaṃ bhakṣyaṃ pavitrakṛt ||58||
dugdhaṃ peyaṃ gavāṃ samyak hantavyā gaurna vai kvacit |
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ ca patraṃ ca bhakṣaṇīyaṃ drumādijam ||59||
drumā naiva vihantavyā vṛthā phalādinirvahe |
dugdhaṃ peyaṃ tathā māturmāraṇīyā na jīvataḥ ||4.28.60||
madhu grāhyaṃ kusumebhyo nāśanīyāni naiva ha |
karā grāhyā prajābhyastu bhakṣaṇīyā na sarvathā ||61 ||
kastūrikā hariṇebhyo grāhyā ghātyā na te matāḥ |
evaṃ bhogamayaṃ sarvaṃ yadaṃśe bhogayogi tat ||62||
bhoktavyaṃ na tu hantavyaṃ hananaṃ narakapradam |
tasmāttvaṃ hiṃsako bhūtvā mā yāhi narakān prati ||63||
svargaṃ sādhaya kaivartta tyaja hiṃsā sukhī bhava |
ityupadiṣṭaḥ kaivartto natvā matsyātmakānṛṣīn ||64||
aparādhakṣamāṃ tebhyo yayāce śāpamocanīm |
śāpo’yaṃ matsyikādevyā visarjitaḥ śaro yathā ||65||
lagno me hṛdaye tūrṇamudvejayati cādhikam |
śāpamuktiryathā syānme tathā ṛṣe vidhehi vai ||66||
ityevaṃ tvaṃ tvarthayāmāsa yayāce tatpunaḥ punaḥ |
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā tato badri pipaṭhāyanabhūsuraḥ ||67||
uvāca me vacanātte śāpo niḥsattvatāṃ gataḥ |
kintu me vacanaṃ labdhvā yāhi kuṃkumavāpikām ||68||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra virājate |
aśvapaṭṭasarovārimadhye snānaṃ vidhehi ca ||69||
darśanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāpi vidhehi ca |
pūjanaṃ patrapuṣpādyairvidhehi kurusevanam ||4.28.70||
mantraṃ gṛhāṇa matto’tra pāvanaṃ pauruṣottamam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyasvāmine svāhā ||71 ||
badrike sa samākarṇya mantraṃ prāpya ṛṣerguroḥ |
sapatnīkaḥ sa kaivartto jagrāha niyamān yamān ||72||
ahiṃsanaṃ sādhusevāmacauryaṃ vanyavṛttitām |
kandamūlaphalānnādyāhāraṃ tīrthaniṣevaṇam ||73||
bhajanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti mālayā sadā |
pūjanaṃ ca sadā nārāyaṇasya mādhavīpateḥ ||74||
satsaṃgaṃ lomaśādīnāṃ pipaṭhāyanadarśitam |
bhūtānāmabhayaṃ ceti vrataṃ jagrāha sarvathā ||75||
pūjayitvā guruṃ cāpi gurvīṃ ca pipaṭhāyanīm |
tathānyān sarvabrahmarṣīn jālaṃ tyaktvā nadītaṭe ||76||
jalaṃ pītvā tu bhadrāyāḥ pipaṭhāyanapādajam |
natvā cāśīrvaco labdhvā sapatnīko gṛhaṃ yayau ||77||
putrādīn saha nītvaiva tyaktvā jvālālakaṃ puram |
yayāvaśvapaṭṭasaro harṣito nigaḍabhramaḥ ||78||
tīrthaṃ cakāra devānāṃ darśanaṃ snānamarcanam |
upavāsaṃ cakārāpi lomaśasyāpi darśanam ||79||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyārcanamuttamam |
bhāvadarśanayuktaṃ sa cakāra vandanaṃ tataḥ ||4.28.80||
kṛtakṛtyo’smi bhagavan bhavaccaraṇadarśanāt |
nārāyaṇena bhavatā datto mānavavigrahaḥ ||8 1 ||
dharmārthaḥ sa mayā nīto’dharmārthaḥ kṣapito’dhunā |
pipaṭhāyanasaṃgena bodhamāpto’smi muktaye ||82||
apyahaṃ matsyaśāpācca muktyarthamatra saṃgataḥ |
samuddhara kṛpāsindho prajvālayāghaparvatam ||83||
matsyādo’haṃ matsyamāra eṣa te śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
ityuktvā badrike kṛṣṇapādayornipapāta ha ||84||
tadbhāryāpi hareḥ pādau dhṛtvāṅguṣṭhaṃ cucumba ha |
pādajalaṃ papau pādau dadhārorasi śītalau ||85||
mastake ca rajaścāpi dadhāra bhāvasaṃbhṛtā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ naigaḍīṃ striyam ||86||
nigaḍabhrāmakaṃ cāpi divyamūrtimadarśayat |
kṛpayaiva ca pāpāni jvālayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt ||87||
divyadṛṣṭyā nigaḍo’pi naigaḍī taṃ pareśvaram |
caturbhujaṃ kamalayā sahitaṃ sandadarśa ha ||88||
bhadrānadyāṃ hariṃ tīre ramantamṛṣimaṇḍale |
apaśyad viharantaṃ ca bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ||89||
athainaṃ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre tejasi bhūmni vai |
apaśyat sannidhau cāpi mānavaṃ saṃsthitaṃ prabhum ||4.28.90||
evaṃ pradarśya rūpaṃ svaṃ tamāha nigaḍabhramam |
pipaṭhāyanayogena yāmyakleśo gatastava ||91 ||
mama yogena nigaḍabhrama yāhi madakṣaram |
ityuktvā virarāmāsau śrīharikṛṣṇadharmajaḥ ||92||
nigaḍabhrāmakaścāha nama om paramātmane |
tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ pārameśvaram ||93||
divyaṃ pārṣadasaṃjuṣṭaṃ sarvasauvarṇabhūṣaṇam |
nigaḍo naigaḍī cobhau tatyajaturhi bhautikau ||94||
dehau prāpyāparau divyau yayatuścādhiruhma tat |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīharerdhāma kalpaparyantameva ha ||95||
tato’kṣarapadaṃ tau vai prāpsyataḥ paramātmanaḥ |
tatputrādyāstataścakruḥ pitrostatraurdhvadaihikam ||96||
vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā jātā bālakṛṣṇasamāśritāḥ |
kaiṃkaryaṃ te prakurvanti pañca putrā hareḥ sadā ||96||
putrītrayaṃ harerdāsyaṃ cakruścājīvanaṃ tataḥ |
sādhvyaśca sādhavaste vai jātā bhāgavatottamāḥ ||98||
nāmnā sādhvyaḥ puṇḍarikāsatī nirvāṇikāsatī |
ānandaghanikāsādhvī tisro nārāyaṇāśritāḥ ||99||
putrāḥ pañca jñānadarbhiḥ prabhādarbhirvidarbhikaḥ |
viṣṇudarbhiḥ kṛṣṇadarbhistvete bhāgavatottamāḥ || 4.28.1 00||
abhavan sādhavo divyāstāpasāḥ siddhayoginaḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasarobhūmau svāmisevāparāyaṇāḥ || 101 ||
badrike te’pi kālena parāṃ muktiṃ tato gatāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapratāpapāvanāḥ ||1 02||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bhadrānadyāṃ pipaṭhāyanarṣiyogena nigaḍabhramādikaivarttānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||

<4.29>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā badri māṇikye mādhavi priye |
kathāṃ tvatra kṛtaghnāyā yoṣito muktikāriṇīm || 1 ||
āsīdekā vibhāvaryāṃ puryāṃ saurāṣṭramaṇḍale |
kuthalī nāmato yoṣā dīnā sagarajātijā || 2 ||
ekākinī dīnabālā hyanāthābhavadārttinī |
ābālyānmṛtajananīpitṛbāndhavapālakā || 3 ||
pañcavarṣābhavad yāvat tāvat sā mṛtarakṣakā |
guruṇā sagarāṇāṃ sā poṣitā vardhitā gṛhe || 4 ||
prāptadvādaśavarṣā sā viveda svāṃ tu sāgarīm |
na viprāṃ tena viprāṇyāṃ sneho vicchinnatāṃ gataḥ || 5 ||
yā mātā garbhadhartrī syāt saiva snehasya bhājanam |
anyā tu kṛtrimasnehā kanyāsneho na tatra vai || 6 ||
vadhvāḥ sneho jananyāṃ yādṛśaḥ śvaśrvāṃ na tādṛśaḥ |
janayitryāṃ yathā snehaḥ stanyadāyāṃ na tādṛśaḥ || 7 ||
garbhadhartryāṃ yathā snehastatsapatnyāṃ na tādṛśaḥ |
gurau sneho yathā loke pitṛsnehastato’dhikaḥ || 8 ||
raktasnehāddharmajanyasneho gauṇo hi sarvadā |
āpatkāle raktajaḥ saḥ dharmajādvai viśiṣyate || 9 ||
kuthalī sāgarī kanyā viprāṇyāṃ bhedadṛṣṭitaḥ |
vartanaṃ tvakarottatrājñāyāṃ prasevanādiṣu ||4.29.1 0||
sarvakriyāsu yadvat sā bhrāntacittā hi vartate |
na karoti gṛhakāryaṃ jalasyāharaṇādikam || 11 ||
mārjanaṃ majjanaṃ śayyāstaraṇaṃ peṣaṇībhramim |
prātarutthāya viprāṇyā dattaṃ bhuktvā tu sotsukā || 1 2||
sagarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇyeva prayāti khelane ratā |
vimanaskā vipragṛhe samanaskā tu sāgare || 1 3|
sāgarībhiḥ pramadābhirbodhitā sāgarīti sā |
sāgarī bhavituṃ tatra cecchad drutaṃ vivāhitā || 14||
guruṇā tu kṛtaṃ tasyā upakāraṃ na vetti sā |
ābālyāt pālitā sarvadānaiḥ sā vetti naiva tat || 15 ||
gaṇayatyeva naivāpi mātāpitṛsamau dvijau |
kṛtaṃ prapoṣaṇaṃ varṣasaptakaṃ manute na tat || 16||
abuddhitvāt svabhāvādvā bālātvādvā pradūṣaṇam |
kṛtaghnītvaṃ samāpannaṃ sāgarīsaṃgato’pi vā || 17||
badrike kṛtalābhānāṃ hananaṃ narakāya tat |
kṛtānāṃ hananaṃ puṇyahananaṃ svargahaṃ tathā || 18||
gurogṛhe tu kanyāyā vāso’yutajanuḥphalam |
anyayoniprasūtāyā viprāṇītvaṃ hi durlabham || 19 ||
tadasyāḥ sulabhaṃ jātaṃ tathāpi karmanoditā |
viprātvaṃ sā parityajya sāgarītve mano’karot ||4.29.20||
atha bhāryā guroḥ kanyāmupādideśa śāntaye |
putrike karmasaṃsāro śasanāmūlapoṣitaḥ ||21||
viṣayādyaśano modapramodavāriṣecitaḥ |
dharmādharmādiśākhaśca tṛṣṇādipatrapallavaḥ ||22||
bhogehāṃkuraśobhāḍhyaḥ sukhaduḥkhaphalapradaḥ |
rāgadveṣakusumādyairākṛṣyante’tra dehinaḥ ||23||
ātmā doṣavihīnaśca vṛkṣatāmeti saṃgataḥ |
saṃsārī vāsanābaddhastata ucyata ārttimān ||24||
bālye tvātmā doṣahīno nirmalaścendriyeśvaraḥ |
yauvane doṣasarvasvo malinaścendriyānugaḥ ||25||
kanyā vāpi kumārā vā jihvārasātibandhanāḥ |
yuvatyo vā yuvāno’pi yo niśi śnāti veginaḥ ||26||
sa vego nirjito yena yayā tau mokṣabhāginau |
nityasukhaṃ parameśadhāmni tanmokṣaṇaṃ mahat ||27||
nārāyaṇaprasaṃgena satāṃ yogena kanyake |
mokṣo bhavati saṃsārānnirayastvanyasaṃgataḥ ||28||
garbhe prapācito deho bālye muhuśca saṃskṛtaḥ |
yauvane malino malavannimnendriyamalādhikaḥ ||29||
yadi vegena kāmena vāsanayātivegayā |
paradehe naradehe mugdhā syāt sā vinaśyati ||4.29.30||
mātāpitṛsnehapātraṃ kanyā kumāravanmatā |
tau tyaktyā yetaraṃ yāti sā kṛtaghnā bhavediha ||3 1||
adīyamānā kanyā vai necchayā gantumarhati |
vadhūrbhūtvā preṣitā vai dharmeṇa yāti kāntagā ||32||
tvaṃ viprau poṣakau tyaktvā nityaṃ yāsi gṛhāntaram |
nādya te samayastādṛg vinājñāṃ yāhi mā tathā ||33||
kanyakānāṃ paragṛhe cirayogo bhayāvahaḥ |
hāvabhāvaiśca puṃyogairmaryādānāśa āpatet ||34||
vivāhavarjitā kanyā bhraṃśaṃ labhenna saṃśayaḥ |
sāgarī tvaṃ janmato’pi viprā tvaṃ brāhmaṇīgṛhe ||35||
utpannaphalavat kanye pavitrā tvaṃ hi bhūsurī |
dehaste nirmalo jāto viprapoṣaṇakāritaḥ ||36||
viprāṇīyogamutsṛjya sāgarīgā tu mā bhava |
viprāṇīṃ māṃ vihāyaiva yadi putri gamiṣyasi ||37||
kṛtadhnītvaṃ tadā prāpya bhraśyase nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ityuktā viprapatnyā sā kanyā papraccha mātaram ||38||
kīdṛśyastāḥ kṛtaghnyaśca vada me mātarañjasā |
atha mātā viprapatnī nāmnā sā tvātmaśemuṣī ||39||
putrīṃ prāha kṛtānāṃ yā hantrī kṛtaghnikā tu sā |
śṛṇu putri tathā nāryo bhavantīha narā api ||4.29.40||
tena pāpena nirayān bhuñjate maraṇottaram |
mātṛpuṣṭā bālikā yā mātaraṃ naiva sevate ||41||
sā kṛtaghnī prathamaiva dvitīyā mātṛduḥkhadā |
poṣitāpi ca kanyā yā viparītā virodhinī ||42||
sā kṛtapnā kuṭumbasya doṣavaktrī kṛtaghnikā |
gṛhacchidraṃ bahirvakti kleśaṃ karoti tena yā ||43||
sā kṛtaghnā sadā proktā hantrī kīrteḥ kuṭumbinām |
yā prāptayauvanā yāti vinājñāṃ paramandiram ||44||
svatantrasvavihārā sā kṛtaghnā kulanāśinī
yā vidhiṃ tu samutsṛjya vṛṇute tu svayaṃvaram ||45||
sā pitrorduḥkhadā cet syāt kṛtaghnātvena dūṣitā |
gṛhakāryāṇi yā tyaktvā parakāryaparāyaṇā ||46||
gṛhakāryaṃ mahatīnāmarthe rakṣati sāpi sā |
vadhūrbhūtvā kāntasevāṃ yā karoti na māninī ||47||
sā kṛtaghnā tathā śvaśrūkleśinī tadvidhā tathā |
sapatnīduḥkhadā yā ca gṛhanārī virodhinī ||48||
kāntasambandhikalidā gṛhakleśābhiropiṇī |
kṛtaghnā sā sadā bodhyodāsīnā gṛhakarmasu ||49||
yā vadhūṃ sevikāṃ naiva śvaśrūḥ snehayati kvacit |
sā vṛddhā duḥkhadā vadhvāḥ kṛtaghnā gṛhaśāsinī ||4.29.50||
yā bāleṣu pakṣapātaṃ bhojanādau viśeṣataḥ |
ayogyaṃ prakarotyeṣā kṛtaghnā jñānavarjitā ||51 ||
kṛtopakāraṃ sāhāyyaṃ cāvamatyātivartinī |
doṣān vakti virodhena kṛtaghnā sā sadā matā |||52||
puṣṭā tuṣṭā pālitā ca pālakaṃ sā vihāya cet |
prayātyanyatra paśuvat sā kṛtaghnā sadā matā ||53||
abhyudayaḥ kṛto yena śikṣānnadhanamandiraiḥ |
taṃ cedāpatsu sahasā kṣiped yā sā kṛtaghnikā ||54||
guruṃ devaṃ pālakaṃ ca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ patim |
yā tvāpatsu prakṣipati kṛtaghnā sā prakīrtitā ||55||
kṛtāpakāraṃ vadati nopakāraṃ kadācana |
sā kṛtaghnā kṛtahantrī nirayān yāti bhāminī ||56||
āpadvināśakasyāpi tadāpattau na pakṣadā |
pratyutāniṣṭasaṃyoktrī sā kṛtaghnā matā sadā ||57||
pareśenārpito deho mānavo mokṣalabdhaye |
taṃ pareśaṃ pravismṛtya vartate sā kṛtaghnikā ||58||||
vivāhaḥ kārito yena vivāhitā ca yena vā |
tayorguṇaṃ na gṛhṇāti doṣadā sā kṛtadhnikā ||59||
adhyāpitā śikṣitā yā tathāpattāritā tu yā |
tadguṇaṃ naiva jānāti virodhinī kṛtaghnikā ||4.29.60||
dharmārthaṃ mānuṣo deho dharmaṃ jānāti naiva yā |
adharmārthakṛtadhyānā sā tu dharmakṛtaghnikā ||61||
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu sāhāyyadāstu ye matāḥ |
teṣāmapakṛtau lagnā yā sā kṛtaghnikā sadā ||62||
kṛtaghnānāṃ nirayā vai bhavanti duḥkhadāḥ sadā |
yāmyaloke paratrāpi sarvaṃ tāsāṃ vihanyate ||63||
sukhaṃ na labhate kvāpi kṛtaghnā pāpaparvatā |
kṛtajñā labhate puṇyaṃ svargaṃ sukhaṃ mahotsavam ||64||
kṛtaṃ jānāti yā kanyā nārī vṛddhā naro’pi vā |
upakāraṃ prakuryācca sā syāt svarganivāsinī ||65||
atra putraprapautrādyaiḥ śobhate vaṃśavistaraiḥ |
dhanadhānyāmbarasampatsvarṇādyairabhivardhate ||66||
kṛtaghnāyā vināśaṃ vai yāti sarvaṃ samūlakam |
putri tvaṃ mā kṛtaghnā syā nirayān mā prayāhi ca ||67||
mama santoṣadā bhūtvā pravardhayātisampadā |
yaśasā vaṃśavṛddhyāpi svarge’pi ca tato’dhikā ||68||
ityuktā kuthalī kanyā sāgarī bījadoṣataḥ |
na mene sā mātṛvākyaṃ pāpaṃ yā manute nahi ||69||
na doṣaṃ manute tatra tyajane cāśrayāntare |
niṣekadoṣabhāvena cāvamatya vaco hi tat ||4.29.70||
prāha prativacastatra mātaraṃ mativibhramā |
mātaḥ kṛtaghnatāḥ sarvā ākarṇitā mukhāttava ||71 ||
svārthaste mayi ko’styatra sāgaryāṃ bhinnayoṣiti |
bhinnavarṇodbhavāyāṃ ca bhinnācārādiyoṣiti ||72||
na me bhikṣugṛhe vṛttirbhikṣukī na bhavāmyaham |
ahaṃ sagarajātīyā sāgaraṃ kaṃcidāpnuyām ||73||
tatra śreyo mama cāsti na vipre svāmini kvacit |
bālikāścāpyanāthāśca sarvaiḥ poṣyāstu dharmataḥ ||74||
kṛto’yaṃ sarvathā nyāyo vṛddhaiścāpratidānavat |
bālānāmupakāro yaḥ kartavyaṃ tat samucyate ||79||
tatra nāsti kṛtaghnatvaṃ kanyā dhanaṃ parārthakam |
mātaḥ kṣamāṃ vidhehyatra majjātau tu prayāmyaham ||76||
na bhikṣāvāribahule vipre prayāmi karhicit |
ityuktvā mātaraṃ natvā hyavamatya ca tadvacaḥ ||77||
pratyuta dūṣaṇaṃ datvā viprāṇyā pālanaṃ kṛtam |
aviprāyāstu viprāṇyā pālanaṃ taddhi dūṣaṇam ||78||
yadvā paropakartavyaṃ mamatvavarjitaṃ vṛṣaḥ |
kṛto bhavatyā tatrāyaṃ tvāgrahaḥ putrikātmakaḥ ||79||
kathaṃ vai kriyate sādhvi pūjye vimūlako mayi |
mṛd bhūmau vāri salile vahnistejasi vānile ||4.29.80||
svasvatattveṣu viśrāmaṃ labhante netare kvacit |
tathāhaṃ sāgarī kanyā sāgare śāntimemi ha ||81 ||
prayāmi sāgaraṃ vaṃśaṃ dehi vā na pradehi mām |
ityuktvā badrike sā tu natvā tadātmaśemuṣīm ||82||
kuthalī samparityajya vipragṛhaṃ tu sāttvikam |
rājasaṃ sāgaraṃ veśaṃ svayaṃ gatvā samāśritā ||83||
kṛtaghniketi brāhmaṇyā tadoktā sā tathāvidhā |
poṣikāṃ mātaraṃ tyaktvā yato’nyatra svayaṃgatā ||84||
kṛtaghnātvamahādoṣaṃ prāptā sā kanyakā tataḥ |
kintu vipragṛhe nityaṃ devaprasādabhojinī ||85||
devārcanādisevābhirbahupuṇyavatī hyabhūt |
tasyāḥ puṇyapratāpena kuthalī prāptayauvanā ||86||
vibhāvarīnagaryāstu rājñā nāmnā virāmiṇā |
anāthā sā sagarāya svabhṛtyāya samarpitā ||87||
nāmnā dharmakareṇāpi sagareṇa vivāhitā |
rājñīsevāparā jātā mānyā sampatsubhoginī ||88||
modate bhogasampattyā dharmakaragṛhe sthitā |
ciravarṣāṇi sā bhogān bubhuje puṇyanirmitāna ||89||
viṃśatiḥ putrakāścāsyāḥ kanyakāḥ sapta cābhavan |
puṇyastaro’bhavattasyāḥ sāntaḥ pāpastarastataḥ ||4.29.90||
samprāptastu kṛtaghnātvabhogo viprāṇikoditaḥ |
rugṇā sā tvekadā jātā śītapīḍānvitā jvaraiḥ ||91||
pīḍitā sā rurodāpi māsottaraṃ viśaktikā |
upacārāḥ kṛtāḥ putraiḥ svāminā tatkuṭumbibhiḥ ||92||
tathāpi na jvaraśāntirabhavat sukhamāpa na |
rājayakṣmābhavattasyāḥ sarvanāśakaro’tha sā ||93||
sasmāra brāhmaṇīṃ tatra mātaraṃ poṣikāṃ satīm |
taduktaṃ tat kṛtaghnātvaṃ tatphalaṃ cāgataṃ mama ||94||
kālena bhāvi bhāvyaṃ ca bhavitavyaṃ na līyate |
putraiḥ putryādibhiḥ sā tu sevitā dūrato bhayāt ||95||
rājayakṣmabhayānnānye pārśve tvāyānti karhicit |
evaṃ sā varṣadaśakaṃ pīḍitā rājayakṣmaṇā ||96||
kṛtaghnatāphalaṃ tasyāḥ prāptaṃ nāpnoti cāntatām |
patitā śayane tvāste pañjarābhābhavaddhi sā ||97||
atha putraṃ jyeṣṭhameva prāha sā vigatāśayā |
yathā mokṣo bhavenme ca yathā me maraṇaṃ bhavet ||98||
tathā kuru madarthaṃ vai kṛtaghnatvanivāraṇam |
putrastasyā drutaṃ tvāyāllomaśasyāśramaṃ prati ||99||
prārthayāmāsa taṃ śreṣṭhamaharṣiṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prati |
yadvā rogasya dehasya cātmaśaktistu saṃbhavet || 4.29.10 0||
lomaśastaṃ jyeṣṭhasutaṃ tiraścāyanasaṃjñakam |
jagāda hitakṛdvākyaṃ dayayā pāpanāśakam || 10 1||
mantraṃ gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇasya mātre dehi drutaṃ tathā |
aśvapaṭṭajale snātvā tīrthavāri pradehi ca || 1 02||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalaṃ śubham |
rogāṇāṃ bhavarogāṇāṃ nāśakaṃ saṃpradehi ca || 103||
ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ kṛpayā pāpanāśakam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 104||
mantraṃ prāpya saro gatvā snātvā tīrthajalaṃ śubham |
labdhvānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalaṃ dadhe || 105||
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetijapārthaṃ tu mālikām |
labdhvā śrībālakṛṣṇāt sa yayau svamātaraṃ prati || 106||
mātre’rpitaṃ jalaṃ divyaṃ mantraśca mālikā rajaḥ |
vibhāvaryāṃ kuthalī sā samāptāghābhavad drutam ||107||
pīḍā naṣṭābhavattasyā rājayakṣmā tu mūrtimān |
bahirnirgatya dehāttāṃ kṛtaghnatāstriyā saha || 1 08||
hasannatvā yayau śīghraṃ barburāraṇyakaṃ prati |
kuthalī rogarahitā samādhau saṃvyalīyata || 1 09||
dadarśa tatra deveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
bālakṛṣṇaṃ nikaṭasthaṃ divyaṃ rādhāramāpatim || 4.29.11 0||
prāṇamat sātibhāvena papāta kṛṣṇapādayoḥ |
cucumba bahudhā kṛṣṇapādau samāghisaṃsthitā || 11 1||
kṛtaghnatāyāḥ pāpaṃ te vigataṃ kṛpayā mama |
svasthāsi bhaja govindaṃ dehānte yāhi cākṣaram || 1 12||
ityuktvā prayayau kṛṣṇaḥ svasthā sā bahirāyayau |
utthāya sarvavṛttāntaṃ putrādibhyo nyavedayat ||1 1 3||
tataḥ sarve’nādikṛṣṇabhaktā jātāḥ samantataḥ |
lakṣavarṣāṇi kuthalī jīvitā mokṣaṇaṃ gatā || 1 14||
evaṃ badripriye devi kṛtaghnyāḥ pāpanāśanam |
mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena yoṣitaḥ ||1 15||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne vibhāvarīpurīsthāyāḥ kuthalīsāgaryā mṛtapitṛbāndhavāyā
vipragṛhe vardhanaṃ, svātantryeṇa kṛtaghnitādoṣeṇa sāgarapatnītvaṃ, kṛtaghnatāyāḥ phalaṃ rājayakṣmā, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayeṇa rājayakṣmaroganāśaḥ, mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||

<4.30>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ pratāriṇīstriyāḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṃgānmokṣamārgaṃ tu sā gatā || 1 ||
āsīd grāme dhavalāre saurāṣṭre carmaṭhākule |
nāmnā nārī viṣalāṇī pratāraṇaparāyaṇā || 2 ||
putrapautrayutāpyeṣā pratāraṇe kṛtaśramā |
vañcane sarvathā jñātrī vañcayitrīti viśrutā || 3 ||
vañcayitrī viṣalāṇī yathā nānyā tathā bhuvi |
sarvān sā vañcayatyeva kalayā ca chalena ca || 4 ||
sarvā nāryo viṣalāṇyā bibhyatyeva pure’nvaham |
yadgṛhaṃ viṣalāṇī sā yāti tatra viśeṣataḥ || 5 ||
yathākathañciddhāsyena vārtayā vacanena ca |
kṛtrimārthapradānādyaiḥ satyabhrāntikaraistathā || 6 ||
vastubhirbahudhā dṛṣṭirodhairdṛṣṭipravañcanaiḥ |
moḍanaibhrāmaṇairvyatikramairvinimayaistathā || 7 ||
ādānapratidānaiśca vañcayatyeva nityaśaḥ |
viśvāsinyastu bahvyo vañcanāṃ yānti tatra ha || 8 ||
vañcanākhyāṃ kalāṃ yasmānnisargajāṃ pravetti sā |
yadgṛhe yāti sā tatra vañcayitvā gṛhādhipām || 9 ||
pracchannalābhaṃ saṃgṛhya prayāti tu yathā satī |
vastuhānau vastvalābhe gṛheśī śaṃkate tu tām ||4.30.1 0||
tathā hṛtaṃ bhavedvastu vañcayivyā gṛhānmama |
evaṃ sā vañcanaparā grāmyajanairviniścitā || 1 1||
vañcanācāramātrajñā sarvacāturyahāriṇī |
vañcanādoṣayuktā sā daṇḍapātraṃ tu yadyapi ||1 2||
rājñā tathāpi kalayā yataḥ śreṣṭhānumoditā |
mallānāṃ ca naṭānāṃ ca khelane bahurūpiṇām || 1 3||
raṅgamadhye samāgatya vañcayatyeva tānapi |
parājayaṃ prayāntyeva jayaṃ naivopayānti te || 14||
pāritoṣikadānādyaṃ vañcayitrī pravindati |
evaṃ sā vañcanaparā hyekadā gṛhato bahiḥ || 15||
yātā tayā vīkṣitaṃ vai sādhūnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ mahat |
śataṃ te sādhavaḥ sādhvyo nirvāṇapadabodhinaḥ || 16||
tasyā grāme gopurānte prākārānte vyadhuḥ sthitim |
atha grāmaprajāḥ sarvā militvā sādhubhojanam || 17||
daduścāpūpamauktikadugdhapākaprapolikāḥ |
caṇakāḥ śreṣṭhaśākāni dadurbhojanamuttamam || 18||
sādhavo bubhujuḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tad bhojanottamam |
rasāsvādaparā vañcayitrī cācintayaddhṛdi || 19||
kenopāyena miṣṭānnaṃ milet tad bhakṣayāmyapi |
janā grāmyāḥ sādhavaśca jānīyurna yathā tathā ||4.30.20||
kṛtvātra vañcanaṃ bhuktvā tṛptā yāsyāmi me gṛham |
atha sā nijakeśānāṃ jaṭāṃ baddhvākarojjaṭām ||21 ||
bhasmāḍhyāṃ tāṃ jaṭāṃ naijāṃ tanūṃ cāpyakarottadā |
dhṛtvā kāṣāyavastrāṇi kare triśūlamityapi ||22||
yoginī sādhvikā bhūtvā sādhvīmaṇḍalamāviśat |
bhuktavatīṣu sādhvīṣu sādhvīpaṃktau sthitābhavat ||23||
upaviṣṭā tathā tatra yathā na syāt parekṣaṇam |
bhuktvā pītvā prāpya tṛptiṃ śanairutthāya prasthitā ||24||
na jñātā khalu sādhvībhirgrāmasādhvīti sammatā |
na pṛṣṭā tarkitā kābhiścidiyaṃ grāmayoginī ||25||
grāmajanairvikṛtā sā na yathārthaṃ samīkṣitā |
evaṃ sā vañcanāveṣaṃ dhṛtvā bhuktvā prasādakam ||26||
gṛhaṃ gatvā punarveṣaṃ nijaṃ dhṛtvāsvapat sukham |
evaṃ nityaṃ prayātyeva bhuktvā pañcadināni sā ||27||
āyāti svagṛhaṃ tasyā yāthārthyaṃ na vidurjanāḥ |
sādhusādhvīkṛṣṇaprāsādikaṃ bhuktavatī tu sā ||28||
pāvanaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ kṣālakaṃ tu prasādajam |
jalamannaṃ dalaṃ vāpi phalaṃ śāśvatamuktidam ||29||
pāpino bahavaḥ santi pāpāt pretā bhavanti ca |
adhoyonigatāścāpi jāyante tu ghasāśinaḥ ||4.30.30||
vighasāśī sadā mukto bhavatyevāgharāśibhiḥ |
hareryogaḥ satāṃ yogaḥ sādhvīyogo hi durlabhaḥ ||3 1 ||
satsaṃgo durlabhaścāti mileccenmokṣaṇaṃ drutam |
mahāpāpāni naśyanti prasādānnādibhojanāt ||32||
vañcanādiprapāpāni dahyanti śrīprasādataḥ |
ātmā śuddhyati sahasā mokṣayogyo bhavatyapi ||33||
śrībadrīramovācapratāraṇaṃ tu yatkarma katidhā channameva vā |
yena syānnarake vāsastanme nigada keśava ||34||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi pratāraṇaṃ tu naikadhā |
yena dehī narakān vai yāni vañcanapāpakṛt ||35||
parameśakṛtaṃ dehaṃ prāpya dehena sevanam |
kuryānna parameśasya vañcitastena mādhavaḥ ||36||
ātmamokṣapradaṃ dehaṃ prāpya mokṣārthasādhanam |
yenārjitaṃ na vai tena tvātmā vai vañcito nijaḥ || 37||
sādhūnāṃ yogināṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ maṇḍalādiṣu |
bakabhakto bhavedyastu sādhvādyāstena vañcitāḥ ||38||
dhanastrītyāgavairāgyopadeṣṭā yastu mānavaḥ |
tyājayitvā svayaṃ bhuṃkte pratāraṇaṃ tu tanmahat ||39||
viśvāsya bahudhā lābhaṃ darśayitvā vibhinnakam |
snehaṃ kṛtvā kārayitvā dhanaṃ harati vañcanam ||4.30.40 ||
bālaṃ nārīṃ bālikāṃ vā yuvānaṃ dhaninaṃ tathā |
yuvatīṃ vastumātraṃ vā yatra harati vañcanam ||41 ||
sadṛśaṃ cobhayaṃ vastu nirmūlyaṃ bahumūlyakam |
datvā nirmūlyakaṃ bahumūlyaṃ harati vañcanam ||42||
kāryaṃ pūrṇaṃ kārayitvā paścād yatnaphalaṃ tu yaḥ |
na dadātyalpayatyeva chinatti taddhi vañcanam ||43||
karmaṇā manasā vācā lābhaṃ labdhvā tataḥ param |
na kāryaṃ niṣpādayati vañcako luñcakastu saḥ ||44||
sati dravye dharmakāryaṃ na karoti dadāti na |
na bhuṃkte sā vañcanā vai dravyakṛtā tu nārakī ||45||
tyāgī bhūtvā gṛhasthānāṃ bhogān bhuṃkte dadāti ca |
gṛhasthavaṃśakṛt syād yaḥ saṃsārastena vañcitaḥ ||46||
bhaktyā viśvāsya lokān yaścendriyāṇāṃ vaśo bhavet |
pratāritā tena bhaktirnirayāṇāṃ vidhāyinī ||47||
abhicārādikaṃ kṛtvā svādhīnaṃ prakaroti yaḥ |
punarvaśaṃ kṛtaṃ bhuṃkte dharmastena pratāritaḥ ||48||
yāni kāryāṇi yāvanti sudṛḍhāni bhavanti vai |
tathā teṣāṃ vidhātā na polampolavidhāyakaḥ ||49||
apūrṇakāryakartā ca kaniṣṭhavastuyojakaḥ |
pracchannalābhalobhāḍhyo vañcako nirayānugaḥ ||4.30.50||
ghṛtasthāne tu yastailaṃ jalaṃ takraṃ payastathā |
prayuṃkte ca śubhe’niṣṭaṃ vañcako nirayābhigaḥ ||51||
hastine yatra kariṇīṃ darśayitvā tu gartake |
pātayatyeva tadvastukartā pratārako mataḥ ||52||
kanyāṃ surūpāṃ yuvatīṃ pradarśya maṇḍape tu tām |
vihāyānyāṃ pradadyāt sa vañcako nirayānugaḥ ||53||
dugdhe pānīyamākṣipya rasavikrayakārakaḥ |
anne tu kaṃkarān dhūliṃ piṣṭe cūrṇaṃ sa vañcakaḥ ||54||
śilpakārye kalākārye saudhakārye ca setuṣu |
mahodyāne pattanādau yantramārge mahāpathe ||55||
kṣetre kūpe taḍāgādau prāpya dravyaṃ prapūrṇakam |
ardhavyayena sarvaṃ tat karoti cādṛḍhaṃ tathā ||56||
nirbalaṃ daragarbhaṃ ca vañcanā narakapradā|
kākānāṃ ca śṛgālānāṃ vānarāṇāṃ svabhāvavat ||57||
vartamāno naro loke vañcanāḍhyo bhavet khalu |
dṛṣṭiṃ dhyānaṃ matiṃ sāvadhānatāṃ praṇidhānatām ||58||
pracyāvya tābhyo harati kurute jayate ca vā |
anyāniṣṭaṃ vidhatte sa vañcako nirayaṃgamaḥ ||59||
hastidantasamaṃ kāryaṃ bahirdarśanamātrakam |
antastvanyaccarvaṇārthaṃ dantavat svārthasādhakam ||4.30.60||
parahiṃsādrohakṛcca vañcanā nirayapradā |
evamādīni sarvāṇi vañcanāni bhavanti vai ||61||
śiṣyo bhūtvā guroḥ sevāṃ yo na karoti bhāvataḥ|
vañcanā sā mahāpāpakarī vai nirayapradā ||62||
patnī bhūtvā svāmino yā sevāṃ karoti naiva ha|
patirbhūtvā satīṃ naiva pālayatyeva vaṃcanā ||63||
kiṃkaro na karotyeva śreṣṭhikāryaṃ tu vañcanā |
garadā vahnidā nāśayogadā vañcakāstu te ||64||
stenakarmaratāḥ sarve vañcakā nirayaṃgamāḥ|
etādṛśānāmuddhāraḥ satāṃ samāgame bhavet ||65||
indro bhūtvā gautamābho’halyāmavañcayaddhi saḥ |
ahaṃ jālandharo bhūtvā vṛndāmavañcayaṃ purā ||66||
evaṃvidhā vañcanā vai badrike duḥkhadā matā|
śāpo vā duḥkhamevāpi nirayo vā bhavettataḥ ||67||
yadyapyahaṃ sarvakartā sarvapatiḥ pareśvaraḥ|
nirdoṣaḥ pāvano māyāpāvakaḥ sarvamokṣakṛta ||68||
surakāryakṛte bhaktakṛte kvacittu vañcanām |
karomi daityanāśārthaṃ doṣo me naiva vidyate ||69||
jīvānāṃ karmabhogānāṃ doṣastatra prajāyate |
evaṃ sā chalanā proktā satāṃ saṃgena naśyati ||4.30.70||
sādhūnāṃ saṃgamo badri pāvanaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ|
viṣalāṇī satāṃ saṃgājjātā pāpādivarjitā ||71||
sādhūcchiāṣṭādanāt kāyakṛtāghaṃ saṃvinaśyati |
sādhusparśādiyogenendriyapāpaṃ vinaśyati ||72||
sādhusevābhāvabhaktyā manaḥpāpaṃ vinaśyati |
sādhvarpaṇena jīvasya sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati ||73||
sādhuścāhamahaṃ sādhuḥ sādhuḥ śrīkṛṣṇamādhavaḥ |
mādhavīśaḥ svayaṃ sādhuḥ prabhuḥpatiḥ satāṃ patiḥ ||74||
evaṃ sā sādhupaṃktau vai bhojanena vipāpinī |
śuddhā jātā tataścāsyā vivekaḥ samapadyata ||75||
aho’haṃ vañcanākartrī sarvathā pāpakāriṇī |
yatra pāpāni naśyanti tatrāpi vañcanāparā ||76||
bhojanārthaṃ kṛtā pratāraṇā kiṃ kṣudrakarmaṇā |
mokṣakarma karomyadyādhunā cottarakālikam ||77||
sādhusevāṃ satīsevāṃ kṛtvāparādhanāśanam |
vandanaṃ ca satāṃ mokṣaṃ yāsye vai paramaṃ padam ||78||
iti vicārya sahasā labdhvā dhanāmbarāṇi ca |
yayau sādhunivāsaṃ sā dadau tebhyo dhanāmbaram ||79||
bhojanaṃ pradadau cāpi pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vyadhāt |
satāṃ pādajalaṃ pītvā tuṣṭābhavad rajo nyadhāt ||4.30.80||
śirasyeva śarīre’pi vakṣasi śrīhariśritā|
uvāca sattamaṃ tatra guruṃ bhadrāyanaṃ hi sā ||81||
mokṣo me syād yathā yena vañcanāpāpasaṃkṣayaḥ|
punarjanma bhavennaiva tathā me kuru sadguro ||82||
śrutvā bhadrāyanaḥ sādhurvaiṣṇavottama uktavān |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||83||
raṭa mantraṃ sadā sādhvi kāṣāyāmbaradhāriṇī|
jaṭāyuktā bhasmayuktā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ||84||
yāhi śrīkuṃkumavāpīṃ yatra śrīkṛṣṇamāpatiḥ|
virājate hi bhagavān sākṣāt sarvāntaraḥ prabhuḥ ||85||
avatārī cākṣareśo yatrāste lomaśaḥ ṛṣiḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ vartate pāvanaṃ param ||86||
yatra santi ca tīrthāni maharṣayo’pyanekaśaḥ|
sādhvyaśca sādhavaścāpi muktā muktānikāstathā ||87||
śrīrādhāmāṇikīkṛṣṇāramābhūkamalādikāḥ |
koṭyarbudābjasakhyaśca nārāyaṇasya patnikāḥ ||88||
surāḥ surāṇyo yoginyo vidyante yāhi tatra ha |
bhuktirmuktistava syātāṃ pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ tathā ||89||
yadyapyatra hi sādhūnāṃ sevayā pāpanāśanam |
jātaṃ tava viśuddhiśca jātā mā khedamāvaha ||4.30.90||
tathāpi bhūtale kṛṣṇakāntaṃ prāpya sukhāśrayā|
divyā bhūtvā yāhi mokṣaṃ mā ciraṃ viṣalāṇike ||91||
ityuktā viṣalāṇī sā badrike drutameva hi |
padbhyāmāhiḍya mārgeṣu yayāvaśvasarovaram ||92||
snātvāśramaṃ lomaśasya gatvā pādāvavandayat |
pādajalaṃ tataḥ pītvā natvā maharṣimaṇḍalam | |93||
āśramasya rajo dehe sammṛdya kīrtanaṃ hareḥ|
gāyamānā yayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ harim ||94||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabham prabhum |
pratyakṣaṃ śāntiyugrūpaṃ sundaraṃ puruṣottamam ||95||
dṛṣṭvā mumoha sahasā mūrtau stabdhābhavat kṣaṇam |
āsaktā dhyānamagnā ca kṛṣṇalīneva sābhavat ||96||
sendriyāntaḥkaraṇā sā sajīvā tanmayī tadā |
dehabhānavihīnā ca jātā sā yoginī yathā ||97||
badrike kṣaṇamātraṃ cen mūrtau me sarvathā sthitim |
niścalāṃ labhate kaścit pūto muktimavāpnuyāt ||98||
adhairyapreriyā drāk sā kṛṣṇapārśvamupāgatā|
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāṃke kṛtvā cucumba bhāvukī ||99||
haristāṃ cumbanaṃ datvāpāvayat samatoṣayat |
sparśamātreṇa muktā sā bhavasāgarabandhanāt ||4.30.100||
badrike divyadehā sā rādheva samajāyata |
yuvatī sadguṇairyuktā vāsanādoṣavarjitā ||101||
sarvakarmavihīnā sā brāhmī strīḥ samajāyata |
jñānavatī divyadṛṣṭimatī śrīvallabham prabhum ||102||
astaut sādhvī pādajalaṃ payau harestato drutam |
vimānamāgataṃ divyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ||103||
āruhya tvājñayā divyākṣaraṃ padaṃ yayau hi sā |
evaṃ pratāriṇī nārī viṣalāṇī satāṃ hareḥ ||104||
yogena pāvanī bhūtvā yayau mokṣapadaṃ param |
badrike śravaṇādasya vañcanāghaṃ praṇaśyati ||105||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne vañcayitryā viṣalāṇīnāmikāyāḥ satāṃ prāsādikānnajalabhojanādinā vivekodbhavaḥ, tīrthe’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptyā mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśo’dhyāyaḥ|| 30 ||

<4.31>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kaṭakartryāḥ kathāmapi |
ojasvatītaṭe grāme kālaṃjare drumānvite ||1||
kaṭakartryabhavacchūdrī nāmnā gaṃgāñjanīti vai |
sā saurāṣṭre kaṭān śreṣṭhān grathitvā vaṃśapātrikāḥ || 2 ||
bṛsīrnirmāya ca yāti pattanaṃ vikrayārthinī|
dharmāṃgadapuraṃ gatvā vikrīṇāti yathārhaṇama || 3 ||
sāyaṃ dāmodaraṃ natvā prayāti nijapattanam |
prāpya dhanaṃ cānnamapi vastraṃ yadvā hyapārjitam || 4||
nītvā yāti nijaṃ grāmaṃ kālaṃjaraṃ tu vai drutam |
gatvā gṛhe’nnavastrādi mañjuṣāyāṃ nidhāya sā || 5 ||
yathāpekṣaṃ bhojanādi pācayatyeva bhāminī |
tasyāḥ putryabhavattvekā daśavarṣā kumārikā ||6||
patistu nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ kuṭumbaṃ vidyate’pi na |
vidhavā kaṭakartrī sā gaṃgājanī sudhārmikī || 7 ||
rātrau bhuktvā kare kṛtvā mālāmāvarttayatyapi |
kanyakā kurute gītiṃ śrīkṛṣṇarāsarañjanīm || 8 ||
vidhavā śṛṇute samyak kṛṣṇasaṃlagnamānasā |
evaṃ gītyuttaraṃ nidrāṃ gṛhṇīto mātṛputrike || 9 ||
nityamevaṃ hi kuruto bhajanaṃ śrīharerniśi |
kadācid raivatatīrthaṃ yātaḥ kārtikamāsi te ||4.31.10||
satāṃ ca sādhvikānāṃ ca kurvāte sevanaṃ param |
camatkarān gīyamānān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||11||
śṛṇutaste’tibhāvena kuṃkumavāpikeśituḥ|
asaṃkhyānāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ strīṇāṃ divyacamatkṛtīḥ ||12||
śṛṇutaḥ śrīramārādhākamalānāṃ camatkṛtīḥ|
sādhusādhvībhaktavaryagītasadgaṇasatkriyāḥ ||13||
camatkārān paracām̐śca śṛṇuto bhaktibhāvataḥ |
vikramān dayayā dīnānāthoddhārādikānapi ||14||
śṛṇuto bahudhā tatra pradakṣiṇapathe muhuḥ |
putrī ramāñjanī harṣaṃ prāpya papraccha mātaram ||15||
mātarguṇān pragāyanti sahasraśo’pi sādhavaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||16||
sa bhavet kva miled vā na prabhuḥ rādhāramāpatiḥ |
darśanārthaṃ mano me’tra tīrthe tamanudhāvati ||17||
yatra vā syāt pragantavyaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāsthalīm |
sārthakyaṃ tu tadā me syād darśanaṃ me prakāraya ||18||
atha mātā muktatulyā sadvicāraṃ vibhāvya vai |
santaṃ nāmnā suradevāyanaṃ papraccha sarvathā ||19||
kvāste śrībhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’tra gīyate |
sādhubhiḥ sādhvikābhiśca yātrikairyaḥ prakīrtyate ||4.31.20||
yaccaritrāṇi śṛṇvantyāḥ kanyāyā me mano gatam |
tatprabhuṃ prati yātrārthaṃ mayā gantavyamityapi ||21||
vada me tanmahimānaṃ kīdṛśo bhagavān sa vai |
kathaṃ devaiḥ sādhuvaryairgīyate’yaṃ sthale sthale ||22||
rādhāpatiṃ kamaleśaṃ vihāya māṇikīpatim |
kīrtayanti kathaṃ sādhvyastairthikyaścāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||23||
viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ vāmanaṃ vā dattātreyaṃ nṛsiṃhakam |
vihāya rāmaṃ taṃ kṛṣṇaṃvallabhāryaṃ raṭanti tāḥ ||24||
manye vaiśeṣyamevāsmin bhavettanme nivedaya |
ityukto badrike sādhuḥ suradevāyanastu tām ||25||
jagādopāsanāsiddhyai vastusthitiṃ garīyasīm |
śṛṇu tvaṃ tasya māhātmyaṃ gaṃgāñjani  vadāmi te ||26||
atra dāmodaro devo rājate raivatācale|
vāmanastrivikramaḥ sa balirājaniṣevitaḥ ||27||
bhagavān vartate tasmācchreṣṭhau naranarāyaṇau||
badrikāśramavāsau tau badryā sākaṃ virājitau ||28||
himālaye suragaṃgātīrāvāsau tu tāpasau|
bhagavantau prajānāṃ tu kalyāṇārthaṃ virājitau ||29||
tato’pi bhagavān śreṣṭhaḥ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt ||
nārāyaṇaḥ kamalāyāḥ kāntaḥ śrīdevatādhipaḥ ||4.31.30||
tato’pi ca prabhuḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṣīrasāgaravāsakṛta|
śeṣanārāyaṇaḥ śrīśo vartate siddhasevitaḥ ||31||
tato’pi bhagavānāste śreṣṭho viṣṇuḥ prabhuḥ paraḥ|
jalāvaraṇataścordhve vaikuṇṭhe tu tṛtīyake ||32||
brahmāṇḍānāṃ rakṣakaḥ sa sarveṣāṃ daityanāśakṛt |
tato’pi ca mahāviṣṇurvartate bhagavān mahān ||33||
vairājasya pitā vṛddho śrīpurādhīśvaro hariḥ|
mahālakṣmīpatirhiraṇmayo rājādhirājakaḥ ||34||
yā sā tatra mahālakṣmīḥ sā kṣitau kaṃbharāsatī|
vartate kuṃkumavāpyāṃ mātā śrīparamātmanaḥ ||35||
mahāviṣṇuḥ pitā cāste gopālakṛṣṇanāmavān |
tadgṛhe śrīhariścāste’vatārī parameśvaraḥ ||36||
mahāviṣṇoḥ paraścāste bhūmākhyaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ |
avyākṛte śubhe dhāmnīśvarāṇāṃ nyāyadaḥ prabhuḥ ||37||
tataḥ śreṣṭho’sti bhagavān vāsudevābhidhaḥ prabhuḥ|
amṛtākhye nije dhāmni ramānātho virājate ||38||
tataḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ śreṣṭhe vaikuṇṭhe bhagavān prabhuḥ|
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaścāste yannāmnā saṃhitāsti ca ||39||
lakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ so’yaṃ vartate bhagavān sadā |
tato’pi ca mahānāste rādhākṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ||4.31.40||
asaṃkhyagopikākānto gavāṃ sevāparāyaṇaḥ |
goloke vaṃśikādhṛk sa bhaktakalyāṇakṛt prabhuḥ ||41
evamanyāni dhāmāni rājante tatra viṃśatiḥ|
dve cānye koṭiśaścāpi sāketādīni santyapi ||42||
tatra tatra kṛtavāsā avatārāstu me matāḥ|
tato’pyanante cāpāre brahmaloke’kṣarābhidhe ||43||
dhāmni saṃrājate vyāpte parabrahma svayaṃ hariḥ|
