avatārī parameśaḥ sarveśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||44||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ|
sarvāvatāradhartāsau sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ||45||
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ patirmuktapatiḥ prabhuḥ |
muktānikāpatiḥ sarvaśrīpatirmāṇikīpatiḥ ||46||
sarvasvāmī parabrahma yatsamo nādhiko’paraḥ |
tasyājñāpālakāḥ sarve’vatārāḥ santi dhāmasu ||47||
īśvarāṇāmīśvaraḥ saḥ prabhūṇāṃ sa prabhūttamaḥ |
bhagavatāṃ sa bhagavān harīṇāṃ paramo hariḥ ||48||
kṛṣṇānāṃ paramaḥ kṛṣṇo rāmāṇāṃ rāma uttamaḥ|
nṛsiṃhānāṃ narasiṃhaḥ paramaḥ sa pareśvaraḥ ||49||
sarvātmanāṃ paramātmā śrīśānāṃ śrīśvareśvaraḥ|
paramātmā sa sarveṣāṃ trisṛṣṭiparamātmanām ||4.31.50||
brahmaṇāṃ sa parabrahma pareṣāṃ brahmaṇāmapi |
paramo brahmarāṭ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa vai ||51||
anantāḥ sṛṣṭayastasyāvatārāścāpyanantakāḥ |
anantāḥ śaktayastasyāsaṃkhyapatnyaśca tasya vai ||52||
sarvaṃ yasya śarīraṃ vai bhogyaṃ jaḍaṃ ca cetanam |
tasyākṣarabrahmaṇaḥ sa bhoktā netā prabhuḥ patiḥ ||53||
akṣarātīta evāsau kārṣṇīnāṃ kānta ekalaḥ |
jīvasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭirbrahmasṛṣṭistu yatkṛtā ||54||
yannimiṣe bhavantyeva līyante nimiṣācca vai|
dhāmasṛṣṭaya evāsya saṃkalpādhīnavigrahāḥ ||55||
avatārā bhagavantaścāsya saṃkalpamūrtayaḥ |
sādhvyaścāsya śaktayaśca sarvā vai pāvanīstriyaḥ ||56||
sādhavastu samastānyaiśvaryāṇyasya bhavanti vai|
etādṛśo’yaṃ bhagavān sarveṣāṃ brahmaṇāṃ patiḥ ||57||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkāntavallabhaḥ |
saurāṣṭre bālako bhūtvā bālakṛṣṇo hi vartate ||58||
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya gṛhe śrīkaṃbharātmajaḥ|
yanmūrternetrajāttejaḥkiraṇāt sarvasṛṣṭayaḥ ||59||
tejasvinyaḥ pravartante sūryacandrāgnividyataḥ|
yacchvāsād dehinaḥ sarve vartante prāṇadhāriṇaḥ ||4.31.60||
yadvidhāraṇaśaktyā vai brahmāṇḍagolakānyapi |
ambare sampravartante vyavasthitāni sarvadā ||61||
yadājñaptā mahāmāyā triguṇā sṛṣṭivardhinī |
sarveṣāṃ pūrikā saukhyakartrī sadā pravartate ||62||
yadicchayā samudrāśca meghā jalaṃ dadatyapi |
yadicchayā tu pṛthivī bhūtādhārā sadā matā ||63||
yaḥ sa kṛṣṇapatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hṛdantare |
antaryāmī tu sarveṣāṃ vartate sākṣidarśakaḥ ||64||
indriyeṣu hariścāste tathāntaḥkaraṇeṣvapi |
deheṣu pañcabhūteṣu sa āste puruṣottamaḥ ||65||
ātmasu cetaneṣveva guṇeṣu – karmakoṭiṣu |
bhāvanāsu hariḥ so’yamāste śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||66||
nārīṣu naravargeṣu napuṃsakeṣu sa prabhuḥ|
kanyāsu . sādhusādhvīṣu vṛddhāsu yuvatīṣvapi ||67||
vijñeṣu ca vicitteṣu paśupakṣidrumādiṣu |
devadaityāsuravṛnde cāste sa puruṣottamaḥ ||68||
raivatādrau sa evāste janasaṃgheṣu cāpi saḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ||69||
sa evāste parabrahma koṭyarbudābjaśaktipaḥ|
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ tadā ||4.31.70||
āgantavyaṃ tvayā mātaḥ sahāsmābhiḥ sakanyayā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya parameśituḥ ||71||
pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ sevāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ svayaṃprabhoḥ|
ityuktā sā bhāgavatī gaṃgāñjanī satāṃ puraḥ ||72||
dāsīva vartamānā ca kiṃkarīva vyavartata |
kārtikasya pūrṇimāyā uttaraṃ sādhavaśva te ||73||
sādhvyaśca janasaṃghāśca bhaktāśca koṭiśo’pi ca |
yayuścāśvapaṭṭasaro’kṣarakṣetraṃ tu pāvanam ||74||
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ prati |
aśvapaṭṭasarovāri papuste snānamācaran ||75||
kṛtvā tīrasthatīrthāni lomaśasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ|
maharṣerdarśanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā ṛṣīn munīn ||76||
āpurviśrāntimapi te viśālavanarājiṣu |
lomaśena pradatto vai mantrastebhyo hi pāvanaḥ ||77||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā|
sādhubhyaścāpi sādhvībhyaḥ sevikābhyastathā tadā ||78||
puṃbhyaśca yātrikebhyaśca dadau mantraṃ tu lomaśaḥ |
gaṃgāñjanyai ramāñjanyai dadau mantraṃ tadā ṛṣiḥ ||79||
yayuste’tha tataḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam |
pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ cakrurnyadhuśca vividhopadāḥ ||4.31.80||
puṣpacandanapatrādyaiḥ phalairambarabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
akṣatairmaṇiratnādyairarhayāmāsuracyutam ||81||
bālakṛṣṇaṃ rūpavantaṃ parameśaṃ parātparam |
vilokya mumuhastatra dhyānamagnāstadābhavan ||82||
āsaktacittā nāryaśca narāstu lagnamānasāḥ |
abhavan śrīparameśe janmasāphalyamāpnuvan ||83||
bahavastatra dehām̐śca vivṛttya divyavigrahān |
labdhvā divyavimānaiśca yayuḥ svargaṃ tu śāśvatam ||84||
pare yayuścākṣaraṃ ca dhāma muktāḥ parātparam |
nāryaḥ kṛṣṇe lagnacittāḥ sādhvyaśca divyavigrahāḥ ||85||
āṣoḍaśavatsarāḍhyā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ|
gaṃgāñjanī divyadehā līnajarjaravigrahā ||86||
bhūtvā ṣoḍaśavarṣāḍhyā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ prabhoḥ |
ramāñjanī sutā tasyā mātrājñayā hareḥ puraḥ ||87||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagṛhe |
dāsīva vartamānā sā kiṃkarīva sadāvasat ||88||
evaṃ badrīpriye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai tadā |
camatkāro darśito vai nītāḥ sahasraśo’kṣaram ||89||
api sādhvyaḥ sādhavaśca tathā kartuṃ hi pāragāḥ |
tarhi nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe kimu vaktavyamacyute ||4.31.90||
yatra santaśca sādhvyaśca yatra sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ |
tatra māyā samarthā na na kālo na ca karma ca ||91||
naiva prabhavo niyamā na śāstraṃ na nṛpādayaḥ |
na devā nāvatārāśca samarthāḥ śrīhareḥ puraḥ ||92||
kartuṃ tathāpyakartuṃ cānyathākartuṃ svayaṃ hariḥ|
samarthaśca svatantraśca niyāmako’dhirājakaḥ ||93||
tatkṛtaṃ nānyathākartuṃ kenāpi śakyate kvacit |
anyakṛtaṃ tvanyathākartuṃ sa samartha ekalaḥ ||94||
tamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntamavāpya sā|
ramāñjanī ramātulyā brahmapriyā tato’bhavat ||95||
divyā divyasvarūpāḍhyā divyadehātisundarī |
camatkāraparā sādhvī brahmapriyā hareḥ priyā ||96||
evaṃ badrīpriye  loke sākṣātkṛṣṇasamāgamāt |
śaucahīnā api nāryo nityaśucyo bhavanti hi ||97||
yasya yogena māyāpi divyā prajāyate sadā |
tadā kiṃ māyikānāṃ tu dehānāṃ gaṇanā hareḥ ||98||
tejoyogena sarvaṃ vai tejobhāvamupaiti hi |
kṛṣṇayogena sarvaṃ vai kṛṣṇabhāvamupaiti hi ||99||
gopyo gāvo rāśiyānyaḥ prācīnyaḥ parya ityapi |
hārītakyastathāmaryaścābriktānyastathoṣṇijāḥ ||100||
anyā asaṃkhyayoginyo jātāḥ kṛṣṇārpitā ramāḥ |
ityevaṃ badrike yānti divyatāṃ kaṭinī yathā ||101||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kaṭakartryā gaṅgāñjanyāḥ satāṃ yogena parameśayogānmokṣaṇaṃ ramāñjanyā ramātvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||

<4.32>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi phaṇāgrāmasya vāsinīm |
kulālīṃ kuṃbhakartrīṃ vai bhaktāṃ nāmnā sunāriṇīm || 1||
bhadrātīre phaṇāgrāme’vasat sā kuṃbhakāriṇī |
mṛttikānāṃ supātrāṇi nirmāya patinoditā ||2||
vikrīṇāti gṛhe naije na yāti sā bahiḥ kvacit |
patirnāmnā raṇastambo dhṛtvā pātrāṇi vāhane ||3||
pakkāni bahudhānyeva yāti grāmāntaraṃ kvacit |
vikrayārthaṃ tato mūlyaṃ cānnaṃ prāpya nijagṛham || 4 ||
prayātyeva sadā tvāyadravyād bhāgaṃ daśāṃśakam |
kṛṣṇārthaṃ sādhusādhvyarthaṃ vyayatyeṣo hi dhāmikaḥ ||5||
raṭate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
pātreṣu kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti likhatyeṣaḥ śalākayā || 6||
gṛhe tena kṛtā mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya hi |
badrike pūjanaṃ tasyāḥ karoti kuṃbhakṛt prage || 7||
sunāriṇī ca tatpatnī snātvā karoti pūjanam |
roṭakaṃ cāpi takraṃ ca naivedye pradadāti vai ||8||
jalaṃ dīpaṃ mukhavāsaṃ pūgīphalaṃ dadāti ca |
natvā karoti kāryāṇi pratyahaṃ tadanantaram || 9||
madhyāhne’pi tathā tasmai nivedya bhojanādikam |
prāsādikaṃ sadāśnāti kuṃbhakāro’pi vai tataḥ ||10||
karoti yātrikāṇāṃ ca sevāṃ satāṃ suyoginām |
sādhvīnāṃ ca yatīnāṃ ca bhaktibhāvena bhojanaiḥ ||11||
pādasaṃvāhanādyaiśca jalapānādibhistathā|
āvāsadānaiḥ satataṃ śuśrūṣayā muhurmuhuḥ ||12||
aputrayostayoricchā putrārthinī vyavartata |
sādhūnāmagratastau tu pṛcchamānau susādhubhiḥ ||13||
anapatyau jagadatuścāśīrvādām̐stu sādhavaḥ |
sāpatyau putrikāputravantau bhavatamityamū ||14||
yuñjantyeva sadā bhaktyā prasāditā mahāśayāḥ|
atha kālāntare putro’bhavanmānasarañjanaḥ ||15||
sādhudharmā sādhuvṛttiḥ sarvasampadvivardhanaḥ||
yasya kaṇṭhe’bhavaccihnaṃ mālāyāḥ śobhanaṃ param ||16||
dṛṣṭvā tu mumude mātā pitā cānye’pi darśakāḥ ||
sādhavaśca tathā satyo vīkṣya mālāṃ mudaṃ yayuḥ ||17||
putro’pi satataṃ dhyānī nārāyaṇeti vāṅmayaḥ ||
anabhyasto’pyatra dehe pūrvābhyāsena śikṣitaḥ ||18||
nārāyaṇeti vai nāma jagrāha kākalīgirā|
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ yadgṛhe mālikāyutaḥ ||19||
suto nārāyaṇabhakto vyajāyata satāṃ kṛpā|
suto vyavardhata bhaktyā varṣmaṇā yaśasā dhiyā ||20||
āyānti viśrutaṃ draṣṭuṃ kīdṛṅmālāyuto hi saḥ |
sādhavo bahavaḥ satyo yātrālavo’pyanekaśaḥ ||21||
āyānti mānavāścāpi grāmanagaravāsinaḥ|
deśagāścāpi saurāṣṭranaranāryaḥ sakautukāḥ ||22||
draṣṭumāyānti taṃ bālaṃ mālāyuktaṃ manoharam |
bālo nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥpatim ||23||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ raṭatyati |
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā kṛtvā bālakavandanam ||24||
mahābhaktaṃ tu devāṃśaṃ matvā kṛṣṇāṃśameva vā |
datvopadā annavastramudrāsvarṇaphalāni ca ||25||
ratnamāṇikyapātrāṇi prayānti kṛtipāvanāḥ|
kuṃbhakāragṛhaṃ pūrṇaṃ smṛddhyā jātaṃ susampadā ||26||
janapravāhasaṃśobhaṃ sādhuvāsaistu mandiram |
putraprāptyā prasiddhaṃ ca tīrthaṃ sarvamanoharam ||27||
athaikadā ṛṣistatra sārāyaṇaḥ samāyayau|
sevitaḥ kuṃbhakārābhyāṃ prasāditaśca bhojanaiḥ ||28||
vanditaścāpi pṛṣṭaśca putrasya mālikāṃ prati |
kathaṃ mālāsamaṃ cihnaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhāgyamasya tu ||29||
kīdṛśo’yaṃ ca kiṃkarmā kimāyuḥ kiṃvidho hyayam ||
śrutvā sārāyaṇaḥ sādhurdṛṣṭvā rekhāṃ lalāṭajām ||30||
bhāgyaṃ kṣaṇena vai jñātvā vīkṣya prāgbhavajaṃ tathā ||
uvāca kuṃbhakāraṃ taṃ raṇastambaṃ hitāvaham ||31||
raṇastamba bhavānāste bhaktarāṭ saha yoṣitā|
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād bhagavān sevyate tvayā ||32||
mūrtirūpo gṛhe nityaṃ sevyante sādhavastathā |
sādhvyaśca tīrthatulyā vai sevyante tīrthayāyinaḥ ||33||
tava pātrāṇi sarvāṇi mṛjjātāni tu yāni vai|
tatra tvayā kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa likhyate smaryate hariḥ ||34||
pāvanaṃ hṛdayaṃ te’sti patnī te pāvanī sadā |
bhaktānī vartate sādhvī yathā muktānikā satī ||35||
sādhusādhvīyogiyatijanāśīrvādatastava|
gṛhe putro’yamutpanno nakṣatreśo hi candramāḥ ||36||
patnī te nityamevātra prātaḥ pūjanakāriṇī|
hariṃ cārthayate sādhvī putraṃ candranibhaṃ śubham ||37||
hareḥ kṛpayā sādhūnāmāśīrvādaistathā tava |
nakṣatramālikākaṇṭhaḥ putro’yaṃ samajāyata ||38||
devatā candramāścāste putraste’yaṃ tu mānavaḥ |
api devasamaścāste kṛṣyante yena mānavāḥ ||39||
candrāṃśaṃ taṃ sutaṃ prāpya labha svargasukhāni vai ||
bhāvikāle sutaste’yaṃ mānavānāṃ mahān guruḥ ||40||
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramaḥ śreṣṭho bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
candrastambeti tannāma khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati ||41||
putravān dhanavān bhūtvā tataḥ sādhurbhaviṣyati |
pitrormuktiṃ kārayitvā tyāgavān sa bhaviṣyati ||42||
ityuktvā ṛṣirāṭ sārāyaṇo yayau tu raivatam |
kuṃbhakārau samākarṇya prasannau hṛṣṭamānasau ||43||
candrapitarau svau jñātvā menāte bhāgyamuttamam |
candrastambaṃ devarūpamamanyetāṃ tataśca tau ||44||
bālaṃ saubhāgyasampannaṃ siddhiprasevitaṃ suram |
candrajanmata ārabhya kuṃbhakāragṛhe’niśam ||45||
sampado vai samāyānti samāyānti vibhūtayaḥ|
annasatraṃ mahattena kuṃbhakāreṇa nirmitam ||46||
yatra nityaṃ sahasraṃ vai mānavānāṃ tathādhikam |
bhuṃkte miṣṭānnamutkṛṣṭaṃ rājādhirājarājyavat ||47||
raṇastambaścaikadā tu tīrthayātrāmiyeṣa ha |
sunāriṇīṃ priyāmāha yāsyāmo’kṣaratīrthakam ||48||
gururnau lomaśo yatra yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ||
parabrahma svayaṃ bālakṛṣṇa iṣṭo virājate ||49||
putrasya mantralabdhiḥ syād gurorhareśca darśanam |
satāṃ brahmapriyāṇāṃ ca darśanaṃ brahmavādinām ||50||
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsnānaṃ devatīrthādidarśanam |
bhavecca putrasāphalyaṃ sarvasāphalyamityapi ||51||
ityevaṃ badrike kṛtvā niścayaṃ putrasārthakau|
sunāraṇīraṇastambau yayatuḥ kuṃkumasthalīm ||52||
candrastambo naikasaṃkhyamaṇiratnānnavastrayuk |
pitṛbhyāṃ sahitastadvat phaṇiprajājanaiḥ saha ||53||
śakaṭīyānavāhādyairaśvavṛṣakramelakaiḥ |
sahasramānavairnārīnaraiḥ saha yayau tathā ||54||
māghasya pūrṇimāyāṃ te cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram |
prāpuḥ śrīkuṃkumavāpītīrthavāri papurmudā ||55||
aśvapaṭṭasarovāri papuḥ snātvā dināntake |
sāyamārārtrikaṃ cakruḥ sarovarasya te tadā ||56||
śrībadrīpriyovāca
ārārtrikaphalaṃ śrīmannaranārāyaṇaprabho|
lokānāṃ śreyase mahyaṃ brūhi mokṣapradaṃ param ||57||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
badrike vartikayā tvekayā dhenughṛtāktayā |
ārārtrikavidhātustu mahendrapadamuttamam ||58||
tisṛbhirvartikābhirvai sūryapadamanuttamam |
pañcabhirvartikābhistu bṛhaspateḥ padaṃ bhavet ||59||
saptabhirbrahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ navabhiḥ śivamandiram |
ekādaśabhirvairājyaṃ trayodaśabhirhiraṇmayam ||60||
pañcadaśabhirmahābhaumaṃ bhavet padaṃ paraṃ tataḥ |
ekapaṃcāśadvartikābhirvāsudevadhāma ca ||61||
ekaśatavartikābhirvaikuṇṭhaṃ vai bhavettathā |
ekādhikaśatadvayavartikābhirnirājakaḥ ||62||
golokaṃ yāti badari śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sevate mudā |
ekādhikapañcaśatavartikābhirnirājakaḥ ||63||
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ|
ekādhikasahasravartikābhistu nīrājanam ||64||
yaḥ karoti sa vai tatrākṣare gatvottamottame |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇadvaye ||65||
dāso vā dāsikā bhūtvā śāśvatānandamaśnute |
tādātmyayogamāsādya sarvasvāmitvamaśnute ||66||
sarvaiśvaryādhikāritvaṃ sarvādhikyaṃ samaśnute |
brahmapriyātvaṃ śaśvadvai haripriyātvamityapi ||67||
mahāmuktatvamevāpi mahāmuktānikātvakam ||
aśnute sarvakāmām̐śca saha śrīparabrahmaṇā ||68||
evaṃ phalaṃ badrike’śvapaṭṭārārtrikajaṃ śubham |
aśvapaṭṭajale devāḥ pitaraḥ siddhakoṭayaḥ ||69||
sādhavo munayo yogivaryā gaṇāśca pārṣadāḥ |
brahmavratāstāpasāśca nivasanti ca mātaraḥ ||70||
devyaḥ sarvā nivasanti tīrthānyapi vasanti ca |
rudrabrahmaharayaśca vasanti cāvatārakāḥ ||71||
tadārārtrikakaraṇāt sṛṣṭitrayanīrājanam ||
kṛtaṃ bhavati tatpuṇyaṃ sarvaṃ kartuḥ prajāyate ||72||
kṛtvā cārārtrikaṃ paścāt sāndhyaṃ vidhiṃ vidhāya ca |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya svarṇamandiram ||73||
yayurharerdarśanārthaṃ śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ |
divyagajāsane devairdevībhistu nirājitaḥ ||74||
pūjitaḥ siddhasaṃghaiśca brahmapriyābhirarcitaḥ|
muktairbhaktaiḥ śaktibhiśca tīrthairupāsito dvijaiḥ ||75||
sadbhirgīto maharṣyādyairvīkṣitastaiḥ pareśvaraḥ |
upadābhiḥ pūjitaśca phaṇāgrāmajanādibhiḥ ||76||
kumbhakāraistathā ratnamaṇyādibhiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ |
satkṛtaḥ śrīharirbadri candrastambena cārcitaḥ ||77||
tadā candro’bhavaccandro mṛgavāhana ujjvalaḥ |
paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāmoṣadhīnāṃ patistu yaḥ ||78||
amṛtasya ghaṭaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya saḥ |
pradadāvupadārūpaṃ candrakāntamaṇiṃ tathā ||79||
harirjagrāha sahasā prasannastaṃ maṇiṃ ghaṭam |
dhārayāmāsa kaṇṭhe taṃ maṇiṃ ghaṭaṃ śriyai dadau ||8||
nīrājanaṃ vyadhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te tataḥ||
hariścāpi dadau tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ nijāmṛtam ||81||
akṣarabrahmadhāmotthaṃ pāyayāmāsa tām̐stadā |
tṛptayāmāsa tān sarvān satkāraṃ pracakāra ca ||82||
kṛtakṛtyāśca te bhūtvā yayuḥ śrīlomaśāśramam |
pūjayāmāsurenaṃ te daduḥ phalādikaṃ śubham ||83||
nyūṣustatrāśrame rātrau viśāle sukhasāgare |
bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ cakrū rātrau śrīparamātmanaḥ ||84||
prātarmantraṃ jagṛhuśca guroḥ śrīlomaśānmuneḥ|
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||8||
tato nyūṣuḥ pakṣakālaṃ hyamāyāṃ niśi vai tataḥ|
āścaryaṃ darśayāmāsa candrastambo niśārdhake ||86||
pūrṇacandraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā kaumudīṃ samavāsṛjat |
dugdhāyamānāṃ pṛthivīmambaraṃ ca sarovaram ||87||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ samantāddhavalaṃ vyadhāt |
āprātastādṛśo bhūtvā tejastiro vyadhāttataḥ ||88||
kuṃbhakārasuto bhūtvā vyarājata janādiṣu |
evaṃ devaḥ svayaṃ bhaktagṛhe saurāṣṭrake sadā ||89||
bhūtvā tu mānavaścāste lokakalyāṇahetave |
tataścāntadine śrīmallomaśasyopadeśanam ||90||
śrutvā vairāgyavegena sarve tyaktvā gṛhāśramam |
tyāgāśramaṃ jagṛhuśca sādhvyaśca sādhavo’bhavan ||91||
candrastambāyananāmābhavaccandro hi sādhurāṭ ||
raṇastambāyanasādhuḥ pitābhavattadaiva hi ||92||
sunāriṇī satī tatrābhavat sādhvī narāyaṇī|
anyā anye ca tatraiva tasthustvājīvanaṃ mudā ||93||
phaṇāgrāmajanāścāpi śrīkṛṣṇa hariyogataḥ|
muktimāpuḥ samayena mahākṣarapadaṃ yayuḥ ||94||
raṇastambo’pi kālena sunāraṇyā samaṃ tataḥ|
muktimavāpa paramākṣaradhāmni pade hareḥ ||95||
sevāṃ lebhe tataścandrastambāyano’pi muktarāṭ |
candrāṃśaṃ divi cotsṛtya dhṛtvā muktasvarūpakam ||96||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayākṣaraṃ padam |
yayau mukto mahān bhūtvā pādayoḥ paramātmanaḥ ||97||
kimu te mahimā badri kathayāmi hareriha |
māṇikīsvāminaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇakāntasya cātmanaḥ ||98||
phaṇāgrāmastato jātaścandragrāmeti viśrutaḥ|
aśvapaṭṭasarovāritīrthaṃ cāndraṃ ca tatra tu ||99||
kaumudīnāmakaṃ tīrthaṃ tata ārabhya gīyate |
paṭhanācchravaṇāttasya badrike taijasaṃ vapuḥ ||100||
samprāpya muktatāṃ labdhvā mahāmokṣamavāpnuyāt |
naro nārī mahānīrājanapuṇyaṃ labheta ca ||101||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne saurāṣṭre phaṇāgrāmasthasya raṇastambākhyakuṃbhakārasya gṛhe sunāriṇīstrībhaktyā candrajanma, candrastambādikṛtā kuṃkumavāpīyātrā, tatra sarveṣāṃ vāso mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ|| 32||

<4.33>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi svarṇakāriṇikākathām |
madhyadeśe narmadāyāstaṭe māṇikyapattane ||1||
svarṇakārakuṭumbāni bhūpālamānitāni vai|
avasan svarṇarūpyāṇāṃ kalākauśalyavanti hi || 2||
putrāḥ putryaśca dāsāśca vartante svarṇakāriṇām |
vyāpārān kānakān sarve kurvantyābhūṣaṇāni ca || 3 ||
vibhinnānyapi pātrāṇi tathopaskaraṇāni ca |
pradarśanāni rūpāṇi racayanti bahūnyapi || 4 ||
dhātujāni naikadhā saṃvikrayādi dadhatyapi |
rājāno rājyamānyāśca rāṣṭramānyāśca vai prajāḥ || 5 ||
prajeśvarāḥ śreṣṭhinaśca krayaṃ kurvanti cāpaṇāt |
svarṇakārāḥ kalayā vai suvarṇe melanaṃ manāk || 6||
bahu vā bhinnadhātūnāṃ kṛtvā kurvanti bhūṣaṇam |
śuddhaṃ tu kundanaṃ kaścid bhūṣārthaṃ cārpayatyapi || 7 ||
tatrāpi dhātusammelaṃ kṛtvā niṣkāsayanti tat |
miśre svarṇe viśeṣeṇa miśraṇaṃ vidadhatyapi || 8||
stenakarma vidhāyaiva racayanti hi bhūṣaṇam |
evaṃvidhāḥ svarṇakārā rājyabhūṣākarā api || 9||
bhavanti sma ca lakṣāṇāṃ koṭīnāṃ bhūṣaṇākarāḥ |
śṛṃgārakāriṇaścāpi stainyena dhanino’bhavan ||4.33.10||
stainyaṃ tu badrike naiva hitakṛt kasyacit kvacit |
prāpte tu daśame varṣe samūlaṃ hi vinaśyati ||11||
athaikadā tu taddeśe’vagrahaścābhavanmuhuḥ |
durbhikṣapīḍitā lokā labhante’nnaṃ na vai kvacit ||12||
mahārāṣṭre’bhavadannaṃ tvasaṃkhyaṃ vṛṣṭiyogataḥ |
vinā mūlyaṃ na cāpyeta dhanaṃ nābhūt prajākare ||13||
prajā nirdhanadāridryaduḥkhitā annavarjitāḥ|
ucchṛṃkhalāstato jātā lūṭanaṃ cārabhanta vai ||14||
yuddhasainyasamānyeva prajānāṃ maṇḍalāni vai |
udvṛttāni lūṭakāni prāsarat pattane’bhitaḥ ||15||
rājagṛhe tathā śreṣṭhivasatau svarṇakāriṣu |
yatra yatrābhavat svarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ tāmrajaṃ dhanam ||16||
apahṛtya samastaṃ tad yayurannārthamulbaṇāḥ|
mahārāṣṭrapradeśeṣu gatvānnāni tu lebhire ||17||
svarṇakārā dhanahīnā mūladhanaiśca varjitāḥ|
tato’nnavarjitāścāpi babhūvuḥ kṣutprapīḍitāḥ ||18||
prajābālā bālikādyāḥ putrāḥ pautrādayo’varāḥ |
pīḍyante tvannavidhurā mriyante kṣutprapīḍitāḥ ||19||
vikarālasvarūpaṃ vai duṣkālena dhṛtaṃ tadā |
prajā mṛtyubhayāccakrurnāmayajñān sthale sthale ||4.33.20||
maṇḍalāni militvāpi grāme grāme pure pure |
harernāmnāṃ kīrtanāni kurvanti vṛṣṭivāñcchayā ||21||
pūjanāni prakurvanti śuṣkapatrādibhiḥ prajāḥ |
bhāvadravyaiḥ pūjayanti cārtanādaiḥ stuvantyapi ||22||
mṛtadehānarpayanti haraye sutabāndhavān |
evaṃ jāte hi duṣkāle śaraṇyo nopalabhyate ||23||
tatra vṛddhā bhaktimatī svarṇakartrī tu pāvanī|
āsīnnāmnā hemasudhā saṃkalpasiddhiśālinī ||24||
yā pūrvaṃ svājñayā patyuḥ pitṛbhyāṃ sahitā yayau|
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tatra śrīlomaśaṃ munim ||25||
guruṃ cakāra sā nārī mantraṃ jagrāha tanmukhāt |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||26||
jajāpa sā nityameva mantraṃ sahasravārakam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti raṭanaṃ sadā ||27||
bālakṛṣṇahare kṛṣṇakānteti bhajanaṃ muhuḥ |
cakre karmasu sarveṣu vārdhakye’pi tu bhāvataḥ ||28||
pūjāṃ prātaḥ karotyeva mūrteḥ puṣpajalādibhiḥ |
naivedyaṃ cārārtrikaṃ ca śayanaṃ kārayatyapi ||29||
militvā bahudhā nāryastadgṛhe cotsavaṃ hareḥ||
kurvantyapi sādhavaśca satyaścāyānti tadgṛham ||4.33.30||
sevate’nnajalavastraiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ |
satīḥ sādhūn yatheṣṭaṃ ca dānena rañjayatyapi ||31||
āśīrvādān sādhavaste datvā yānti sthalāntaram |
evaṃ puṇyavatī sāsīd yadgṛhaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||32||
pāvanaṃ sarvadā tvāsīt sadā nārāyaṇāśrayam |
siddhyāśrayaṃ tathāsīcca duṣkāle’pyannamakṣayam ||33||
yadgṛhe vartate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapratāpataḥ |
vardhante divyakaṇakāḥ kusūle vardhate dhṛtam ||34||
yadannaṃ ceyamicched vā prātarnaivedyakāriṇī |
tat kusūle labhyate’pi śākapatrādikaṃ tathā ||35||
evaṃ siddhimatī sāsīnnānye jānanti tādṛśīm |
tathāpi duḥkhitā lokā maranti tān vilokya sā ||36||
dayāparābhavada vṛddhā paropakṛtiśālinī|
bālikābhyaśca bālebhyo vidhavābhyastathā dine ||37||
sagarbhābhyo’tivṛddhābhyo dīnānāthebhya ityapi |
madhyāhne svagṛhaṃ yātebhyo dadāti hi roṭakam ||38||
niṣkāsya svagṛhacullīpārśvasthakoṣṭhalāttataḥ |
premṇā dadāti sā vṛddhā bhuktvā yānti kṣudhākulāḥ ||39||
naitad viditaṃ sarveṣāṃ tato’nye mānavāḥ striyaḥ |
bhaktāyā durbhikṣakāle bhaktiṃ nindanti duḥkhitāḥ ||4.33.40 ||
aho bhaktirna vai loke roṭakaṃ pradadāti hi |
na duṣkālaṃ mārakaṃ ca nivārayati cāgatam ||41 ||
na bhaktyā pūryate sthālī na mukhaṃ nodaraṃ tathā |
na bhaktyā kṣunnivṛttiśca tṛṣānāśo’pi naiva ca ||42||
na bhaktyā kālanāśaśca na vā mṛtyornivāraṇam |
na bhaktirbhojanārthaṃ vai jāyate kavalātmikā ||43||
kiṃ bhaktyā śuṣkayā tvatra sāhāyyaṃ tu yayā na vai |
mṛṣā bhaktirhi devānāṃ mṛṣā nārāyaṇasya ca ||44||
etādṛśe mahākāle nānnaṃ bhaktirdadāti vai |
na bhaktīnāṃ kavalā vai bhavanti sā mṛṣā tataḥ ||45||
na vā kṛṣṇo na vā viṣṇurduṣkāle’nnaṃ prayacchati |
bālāśca bālikāścāpi mriyante teṣu nirghṛṇaḥ ||46||
paśyantviyaṃ mahāvṛddhā hemasudhātra pattane |
bhaktimatī vidyate’pi duḥṣkāle’nnaṃ dadāti na ||47||
bhaktistasyā niṣphalāsti jātaṃ durbhikṣakaṃ katham |
bhaktirnaiva mahākālaṃ nivārayati bhāti naḥ ||48||
dhik tatra sādhavaḥ sādhvyaḥ khādantyāyānti yānti tān |
na sāhāyyaṃ prakurvanti duṣkāle harijīvinaḥ ||49||
evamajñajanāstasyā nindāṃ kurvanti vai tadā |
badrike sādhusādhvīnāṃ bhakternindāṃ harestathā ||4.33.50||
bubhukṣitā janā lokā mithaḥ kurvanti pīḍitāḥ |
saiṣā vāṇī karṇaparamparayā vṛddhayā śrutā |||51 ||
atha kālaṃ camatkārasyaiva vijñāya bhāminī |
hareḥ pratāpamutkṛṣṭaṃ darśayituṃ tadā svayam ||52||
iyeṣa vṛddhā sahasā hemasudhā haripriyā |
prātaḥ sā sthālikāṃ dhṛtvā kare ca daṇḍikāṃ kare ||53||
pīṭayitvā dhvanayitvā nirjagāma tu pattane |
mahāpathe vicitteva śrāvayatyeva mānavān ||54||
yebhyo vai bhojanaṃ cāstyapekṣaṇīyaṃ gṛhe mama |
āgantavyaṃ hi madhyānhe durbhikṣaduḥkhitairjanaiḥ ||55|||
evaṃ sā nagare kṛtvā prakāśāmantraṇaṃ tataḥ |
āyātā svagṛhaṃ tatra sasmāra śrīpatiṃ harim ||56 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca lomaśam |
sākṣāt te tvāyayurbhaktyā niṣeduḥ satkṛtā gṛhe ||57||
divyā divyavibhūṣāḍhyā rūparūpānuyoginaḥ |
prasannavadanāḥ sveṣṭadevāḥ kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ||58||
vanditāḥ pūjitā bhaktyā satkṛtā bhojitāstathā |
arthitāḥ prārthitāḥ sthātuṃ pūrayituṃ niveditāḥ ||59||
bhaktivaśāste vṛddhāyāstathaiveti samācaran |
viṣṇuścotpādakastatra roṭakāṇāṃ tadābhavat ||4.33.60 ||
lakṣmīścāpūrikā tatra bhojanānāṃ tadābhavat |
lomaśaścābhavat tatra dātā satatayatnavān ||61 ||
hemasudhā jalānāṃ ca pradātrī tu tadābhavat |
tāvadvai mānavā dīnā anāthā bhikṣukāḥ striyaḥ ||62||
narā nāryaḥ sādhavaśca satyaśca kṣutprapīḍitāḥ |
anye khalāśca nindādikartāro’pi kṣudhānvitāḥ ||63||
kutūhalāttu hāsyārthaṃ vīkṣituṃ tatra cāgatāḥ |
vṛddhā jātā vicittā kiṃ bhānahīnā mṛṣā ca kim ||64||
kiṃ satyaṃ vartate tatra bhaktiḥ kiṃ phalitā kṛtā |
dadāti cānnaṃ yadvā sā duṣkālaparipīḍitā ||65||
āhvayatyeva vai sthālyā vṛthā mithyā ṛtaṃ ca vā |
ityāścaryaparā lokāḥ sahasraśaḥ kṣudhānvitāḥ ||66||
āyātā bhāvayuktā vā abhāvasahitā api |
atha śrīlomaśo devaḥ prārabhata pradānakam ||67||
roṭakāṇāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ sahaivaikakṣaṇe kṣaṇe |
mānavā vyomamārgeṇa kṣiptān sarvān hi roṭakān ||68||
gṛhṇanti na bhuvaṃ yānti roṭakāḥ kṣudhitairdhṛtāḥ |
bhuktvā bhuktvā prayāntyeva viśāle bhūtale tadā ||69||
sammardastu mahām̐statra jāyate’pi na bādhakṛt |
āsāyaṃ dattavān cānnaṃ lomaśākhyo gurustadā ||4.33.70||
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇastatra virājete vidhāyakau |
roṭakā godhūmajā vai miṣṭamiśrā ghṛtānvitāḥ ||71 ||
prāpyante cāpi bhujyante tṛptiṃ yanti tu bhojinaḥ |
evaṃ vai lakṣaśo lokā bhuktvā proktvā jayaṃ muhuḥ ||72||
prayānti svagṛhaṃ sāyaṃ camatkāro’bhavad bhuvi |
rātrau hemasudhayānnasatraṃ cānargalaṃ kṛtam ||73||
deśagrāmādibhya īyurmānavā bhikṣukā iti |
tebhyo’nnaṃ te dadū rātrāvāprabhātaṃ dine yathā ||74||
evaṃ durbhikṣaduḥkhāḍhyā narā nāryastu lakṣaśaḥ |
āyayuḥ paritaḥ śrutvāścaryaṃ vai dinasaptakam |||75||
rātrindivaṃ pravāhāstu mānavānāṃ samudrabhāḥ |
udvelā iva sañjātā bhikṣāścaryaprapreritāḥ ||76||
bhikṣukāste prasādānnaṃ bhuktvā bhuktvā vyaghāḥ śubhāḥ |
babhūvuḥ pāvanā bhaktāścakruśca bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||77||
prabhokṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa śrīkṛṣṇamādhavīpate |
vṛddhānāryā kṣudhā vināśitā te kṛpayādhunā ||78||
praśaṃsanti hariṃ te tu stuvanti nityatarpitāḥ |
ekavāraṃ yena bhuktaḥ prasādaḥ paramātmanaḥ ||79||
māsaṃ māsaṃ na vai teṣāṃ kṣudhāmāsīddhi badrike |
evaṃvidhaṃ camatkāraṃ prāpuste mānavāstadā ||4.33.80||
āgatyāgatya tu sarve jagṛhurmantramuttamam |
vṛddhā tebhyo lomaśādvai dāpayatyeva tanmanum ||81||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
lakṣaśo mānavāstatra vaiṣṇavāścābhavan śubhāḥ |||82||
vṛddhayā cārthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi varṣaṇam |
pracakāra tato bhūmau tṛptidaṃ śītalairjalaiḥ ||83||
araṇyāni ca vāṭyaśca kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca |
mānasāni cāpaṇāni jātānyaudāryavanti ca ||84||
patrānnaphalapuṣpādyaiḥ ṛddhāni tāni cābhavan |
vṛddhā sā hemasudhikā devatāvat prapūjyatām ||85||
avāpa kṛṣṇayogena tāpasī lokarakṣiṇī |
hemasudhānnadā devī tvannapūrṇābhavad bhuvi ||86||
tataḥ pūjāṃ parāṃ prāpya lakṣmīlomaśamādhavāḥ |
tiro’bhavan tataḥ sthānāt kuṃkumakṣetramāyayuḥ ||87||
hemasudhānnapūrṇā tu divyadehā vyajāyata |
kathayitvā hi sarvebhyo gantuṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||88||
tiro’bhavat sahasā sā paśyatāṃ lakṣadehinām |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetramambareṇa samāyayau ||89||
hareḥ sevāparā nityaṃ vartate caraṇāmbuje |
divyadehā divyamuktānikā dāsī tu pāvanī ||4.33.90||
ṣoḍaśābdā divyamūrtirnityaṃ tasthau hareḥ puraḥ |
atha te nārmadakṣetravāsā māṇikyavāsinaḥ ||91||
yātrārthaṃ tvāyayurdivyaṃ kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām |
lakṣaśo mānavā nāryo narā janmamahotsave ||92||
aṣṭādaśe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajayantikotsave |
darśanārthaṃ pūjanārthaṃ kalyāṇārthaṃ tathāyayuḥ ||93||
pradaduścopadāḥ sarve pupūjurmaṇiratnakaiḥ |
candanairakṣataiḥ pauṣpahāramālābhiracyutam ||94||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīmāṇikīpatim |
lomaśaṃ ca tathā cāśvasaro lakṣmīmapūjayan ||95 ||
tīrthavidhiṃ pracakruśca nyūṣurmāsacatuṣṭayam |
māghasnānaṃ vidhāyaiva kṛtakṛtyāśca te’bhavan ||96||
sahasraśo narā nāryo līnasaṃkalpavāsanāḥ |
bālakṛṣṇaprabhāveṇa yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||97||
anye’bhavan sādhavaśca sādhvyaścāpyabhavam̐stadā |
apare vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve kṛtvā tīrthaṃ yayurgṛham ||98||
ityevaṃ badrike lokakalyāṇakāriṇī satī |
suvarṇakārapramadā jātānnapūrṇikā surī ||99||
tataḥ kālāntare prāptā padaṃ śāśvatamakṣaram |
svarṇakārādijātīnāṃ prajānāṃ pāpanāśanam || 4.33.10 0||
hareḥ prasādabhojyādidānena sā cakāra ha |
bhuktimuktipradā nārāyaṇī sā ca tato’bhavat || 101 | ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne māṇikyapattanīyāyā hemasudhānāmnyāḥ svarṇakāriṇyā
bhaktyā bhagavatāsaṃkhyamānavānāṃ bhojanādidurbhikṣe’rpitaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ sāpi muktiṃ nītetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||

<4.34>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi viṣṭināryāḥ kathāṃ śubhām |
saurāṣṭre dhanadhṛṅnāmni nagare cātiśobhane || 1 ||
rājño devarddhisiṃhasya śāsane saṃpravardhite |
viṣayo bahavaścāsan manuṣyavāhakottamāḥ || 2 ||
yatskandheṣu sthitāḥ śibyo na kampaṃ yānti vai manāk |
śivikāsthā na manyante bhedaṃ śibīvimānayoḥ || 3 ||
viṣṭayaste kṛtābhyāsā vahanti nṛpatiṃ gurum |
mātṝm̐śca rājamātṝm̐śca vadhūjanān satījanān || 4 ||
nirvahante śramavāhā vahanodbhavasaddhanaiḥ |
rājñaḥ kuṭumbinaścāpi paricaranti dāsavat || 5 ||
yātrālumānavānnārīvargān varān vivāhitān |
śreṣṭhinaśca tathā rājyādhikāriṇo vahantyapi || 6 ||
kvacit sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīrvahanti tvātapādiṣu |
tīrthāt tīrthāntaraṃ cāpi prasevante tu vaiṣṇavān || 7 ||
devānāmutsaveṣvete vahanti devatāstathā |
paribhramanti nagare devamūrtīḥ samūhya vai || 8 ||
evaṃ sevāparāḥ sarve viṣṭayo bhoyisaṃjñinaḥ |
dāsavargā narā nāryaḥ prasevante mahajjanān || 9 ||
satāṃ tannagare tvāsīnmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtamandiram |
saduttamo’bhavattatra svāmī śrīrādhikāyanaḥ ||4.34.10||
rādhātulyo harerbhakto virāgavān harau rataḥ |
tatrānye sādhavaścāsan pañcāśat śiṣyaśākhinaḥ || 1 1||
sādhvyaścāsan viṃśatiśca śrīkṛṣṇapratimāpi ca |
bālakṛṣṇapratimā śrīyutā tanmandire’bhavat || 12||
kīrtanāni bhavantyeva viṣṭīnāṃ sadbhirādarāt |
sahitānāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ gītikāśca bhavanti vai || 13||
pūjanaṃ protsavāścāpi bhavanti viṣṭibhiḥ kṛtāḥ |
viṣṭayo’pi sahasraṃ te rādhikāyanasevinaḥ || 14||
rādhikāyanaśiṣyāste hyāsan paramavaiṣṇavāḥ |
prātaḥ snānaparā dhyānaparā naivedyabhojanāḥ || 15||
tīrthārcanaparāḥ sādhusevāparāśca te’bhavan |
narā nāryaḥ samastāste bālāśca bālikāstathā ||16||
bālakṛṣṇātibhaktāścābhavan niḥsaṃśayānugāḥ |
dehena manasā dravyaiḥ sādhusevāparāyaṇāḥ || 17||
yeṣāṃ vai saṃśayo nābhūt satāṃ kriyāsu sarvathā |
bhojane śayane snāne mardane cāṃgavāhane || 18||
vihāre hasane divye camatkāre ca laukike |
vivastre vā savastre vā vikāre nirvikāriṇi ||19||
ramaṇe rāmaṇe vāpi bhuvi dolādhirohaṇe |
gamane dhāvane vāpi gāyane kalahe’pi ca ||4.34.20||
sarvathā sādhucaryāsu saṃśayo naiva yaddhṛdi |
tādṛśā viṣṭayaścāsan kṛpāpātrāṇi te satām ||21||
rādhāyanasataḥ prāptamantrāḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ |
ātmanivedinaḥ sarve sarvasvārpaṇatatparāḥ ||22||
sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ pramanyante nārāyaṇaṃ narāyaṇīm |
nārāyaṇayoryogena nārāyaṇatvamāpyate ||23||
evaṃvidhānāṃ viṣṭīnāṃ viśvāsavaśago hariḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi vaśago’bhavat ||24||
tatra viṣṭikṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti nityamandire |
gṛhe gṛhe harirgatvā gṛhṇātyarhaṇamuttamam ||25||
pratyakṣasya śrīhareste kurvanti pūjanaṃ mahat |
candanairakṣataistailaiḥ sugandhibhiśca kuṃkumaiḥ ||26||
hārdairbhāvaistathā premṇā snehena hṛdayārpaṇaiḥ |
dehārpaṇaistathā sarvārpaṇairnāryo’rcayantyapi ||27||
śṛṃgārayanti viṣṭīnāṃ kanyakā mugdhamānasāḥ |
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ kāntaṃ vīkṣya sarvāṃgasundaram ||28||
kācit kṛtvā stanayośca caraṇau paramātmanaḥ |
kaṇṭhe kṛtvā karau tasya sukhaṃ bhuṃkte hi śāśvatam ||29||
kācit svasyā mukhe kṛṣṇamukhaṃ cākṛṣya sarvathā |
svamukhaṃ tanmukhe yuktyā svādaṃ bhuṃkte parātmanaḥ ||4.34.30||
kācit kṛṣṇaṃ nijaṃ kāntaṃ matvā śayyāgatā satī |
āsajjya sarvathā dehe kāmasukhaṃ samaśnute ||3 1||
kācit kṛṣṇaṃ nijadehāsane dhṛtvā svapityati |
kācit sparśaṃ gaṇḍayośca sakthnośca jaṃghayostathā |||32||
jaghanasyodarasyāpi karoti modate muhuḥ |
kācid dhṛtvā kṛṣṇapādau saṃvāhanaṃ karoti ca |||33|
kācit svorasi kṛtvaiva tādātmyaṃ yogameti ca |
kācit pracumbate kṛṣṇaṃ kācidāśliṣya tiṣṭhati ||34||
nakhānnārāyaṇaṃ tvanyā śikhāparyantameva tam |
sarvāṃgaṃ tṛṣṇayā divyaṃ vilokayati sundarī ||35||
aparā śrīharaye tu naivedyaṃ miṣṭamuttamam |
dugdhasārādikaṃ kṛtvā saṃbhojayatikanyakā ||36||
itarā śākapatraṃ pācayitvā svādagarbhitam |
polikābhiḥ samaṃ kāntaṃ prabhojayati kanyakā |||37||
parā tu śrīhariṃ kaṇṭhe pādayoḥ karayostathā |
svarṇabhūṣā dhārayati mukuṭādīni sundarī ||38||
tathānyā kajjalaṃ kṛṣṇanetrayoḥ pradadātyapi |
candanaṃ bhālaphalake talayoścāpyalaktakam ||39||
oṣṭhayo rañjanaṃ dehe tailaṃ dadāti bhāvukī |
nakharañjanakāryaṃ ca karotyanyātimohitā |||4.34.40||
kṛṣṇamekāntamālambya mahānandaṃ samaśnute |
dadhi bhaktaṃ saha bhuṃkte sthālyāṃ mukhe dadātyapi |||41|||
jalaṃ śītaṃ ca pibati tāmbūlaṃ pradadātyapi |
atisnehabharā kāntā bhuṃkte tāmbūlajaṃ rasam ||42||
anyā vṛddhā bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣya vīkṣya tu sundaram |
antaḥsukhaṃ bhuñjate vai dhyāyantyekāgramānasāḥ ||43||
siṃhāsane sukhaṭvāyāṃ śubhāsane narāyaṇam |
upāveśya svayaṃ cāgre hyāsīnā modate kṣaṇam ||44||
vyajanenānilaṃ śītaṃ dadāti paramātmane |
puṣpahārān grathitvā taṃ śṛṃgārayati sarvathā ||45||
dehasya mardanaṃ cānyā dravaiḥ kurvanti tatkṣaṇe |
snapayanti jalairgandhaiḥ snehaidravārpaṇaistathā ||46||
śṛṃgāritasya nāthasyārārtrikaṃ hyācaranti ca |
avasthāpyoccaparyaṃke puraḥ sthitvā striyo’parāḥ ||47||
nṛtyanti cāpi gāyanti gītikā maṇḍalātmikāḥ |
rāsaṃ kurvanti dehānāmutkṣepaṇābhikarṣaṇaiḥ ||48||
kṛṣṇastāsāṃ mānasāni pūrayatyeva sādaraḥ |
nītvā bhāvabharāṃ bhāvaṃ pūrṇaṃ karoti vai rahaḥ ||49||
udyānādau vāṭikāsu kṣetreṣu mandireṣvapi |
vṛkṣastambāntare nadyāṃ pulīneṣu vaneṣvapi ||4.34.50||
gṛheṣu goṣṭhabhāgeṣu garteṣu gahvare’pi ca |
gṛhakakṣāsvapi yathā yathecchāvatī tatra ha ||51 ||
nārāyaṇo bhāvavaśo yāti tasyāṃ sukrīḍati |
bhaktamānasapūro’yaṃ bhaktānandapradāyakaḥ ||52||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sukhaṃ dadāti hi |
badrike tvābālavṛddhā viṣṭisundaryaṃ utsukāḥ ||53||
kṛṣṇaṃ bubhujire’tyarthaṃ dehendriyātmamānasaiḥ |
evaṃ viṣṭijanāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ satkārayanti tatkṣaṇe ||54||
rājādhirājavad vṛddhāḥ pūjayanti sma mādhavam |
yuvāno yuvabhāvāḍhyaṃ rañjayanti susevayā ||55||
kumārāstu sakhāyaṃ taṃ prasādayanti khelanaiḥ |
yatheṣṭaṃ sa harirviṣṭijanatoṣaṇamāvahat ||56||
sarvaviṣṭikuṭumbāni pāvitāni hi cakriṇā |
evaṃ bhaktivaśo nātho badrike’pāvayattadā |||57|||
saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ te’tra pratyahaṃ pāvayatyapi |
etādṛśānāṃ bhaktānāṃ kṛṣṇastvekāntatāṃ gataḥ ||58||
na yamā na niyamā nāmnāyo nāpi ca śāsanam |
na paddhatirna cācāraḥ sarvanāthe pravartate ||59||
sarvanāthena ye bhaktimanto janāstu nāthitāḥ |
tādātmyasvīkṛtāsteṣu pravartante na te tathā ||4.34.60||
kṛṣṇācārastadā dharmaḥ kṛṣṇasnehaśca satkṛtiḥ |
kṛṣṇāptiḥ satphalaṃ divyaṃ kṛpā kṛṣṇasya sādhanam ||61||
kṛṣṇakriyā mahāyajñaḥ kṛṣṇārthaṃ puruṣārthakaḥ |
kṛṣṇabhāvo mahāyogo vijñānaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ||62||
kṛṣṇasya śayanaṃ dhāma muktistu kṛṣṇabhogitā |
siddhayaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sāphalyamuttamam ||63||
jīvanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapārśve vartanaṃ harisannidhau |
vihāro’pi rahaḥ kṛṣṇe nivṛttiḥ kṛṣṇaśāntatā ||64||
pravṛttiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaceṣṭānuvartanam |
kartavyaṃ ca vidhiścāpi kṛṣṇaprasādanārthakam ||65|||
ratiḥ prītiśca saṃkalpaḥ kāma ānanda utsavaḥ |
sarvaṃ tṛpte harau cātmanivedināṃ tu badrike ||66||
nātmanastatra pārthakyaṃ jānāti bhaktidāsikā |
nāpi kṛṣṇetaraṃ bhuṃkte lāvaṇyavarjitaṃ tu tat ||67||
sarve rasāḥ sarvagandhāḥ sarvasparśā narāyaṇe |
sarvāḥ śrutayaḥ śrīkṛṣṇe sarvārthadarśanaṃ harau ||68||
āhārāśca vihārāśca yeṣāṃ sarve hi mādhave |
ānandāśca pramodāśca nārāyaṇe śriyaḥ patau ||69||
bhāvā hāsā vilāsāśca yugalatvaṃ harau tathā |
varatvaṃ svāmitā kṛṣṇe nāthatā ca vivāhanam ||4.34.70||
lagnagranthirharau yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ mokṣe na saṃśayaḥ |
jīvatāṃ bhuktimokṣākhyā mahānandā harergṛhe ||71 ||
dehānte nityabhogā sā parānandākṣare pade |
sarvathā mandire tasya vāso bhaktimatāṃ śubhaḥ ||72||
nirmitaḥ kṛṣṇakāntena śrīkṛṣṇātmanivedinām |
badrike viṣṭayo bhoyibhaktāstvātmanivedinaḥ ||73||
dhanadhṛgvāsinaḥ sarve vaiṣṇavāścābhavam̐stathā |
yadgṛheṣu svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣāttiṣṭhan pramodate ||74||
viṣṭikule’bhavannārī nāmnā vidrumiṇī satī |
sā tu bhaktyā turyabhāve vartate kṛṣṇamohitā ||75||
śṛṇu tvaṃ badrike lajjāṃ tyaktvā tyaktvā patiṃ gṛham |
hitvā ca mānavīṃ rītimudvṛttāntā tato’bhavat ||76||
kṛṣṇe tvātmā mano buddhirahaṃ cittaṃ janārdane |
dehendriyāṇi vai kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇaraṃgamayāni ca ||77||
yathā kṛṣṇastathā sāpi divyaceṣṭā babhūva ha |
āścaryajanikā tatra viṣṭīnāṃ sarvato’bhavat ||78||
yathā vicittā yuvatī yathonmattā ca mādinī |
yathā mastānikā vāpi pramadā pramadānvitā ||79||
vartate kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti gāyatyapi hasatyapi |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ raṭatyapi milatyapi ||4.34.80||
janāstāṃ tādṛśīṃ vīkṣya rurudhurbaddhamandire |
pihite’pi kapāṭe sā niryayau divyavigrahā ||81||
gṛhe kṣiptā jale kṣiptā peṭāyāṃ pūritāpi sā |
nirāvaraṇabhāvā tanniryānti divyavigrahā ||82||
gṛhād gṛhāntaraṃ nirgacchati bhittiṃ vibhidya sā |
evamadṛśyatāṃ yāti paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām ||83||
kvacit kanyā yuvatī vā vṛddhā vā sundarī śubhā |
saumyahāsyavatī kāntā kvacid rudrī bhavatyapi ||84||
prabhākṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti svāmikṛṣṇeti gāyati |
ekānte taṃ svāmikṛṣṇaṃ nītvā rahasi modate ||85||
sā vai paśyati kānteśaṃ kāntā kṛṣṇamanasvinī |
kṛṣṇadhyānaparā kṛṣṇaceṣṭā kṛṣṇasvarūpiṇī ||86||
kṛṣṇarūpā kvacid rādhārūpā kvacicca māṇikī |
kvacit priyā tu lalitā pārvatī ca jayā kvacit ||87||
evaṃvidhāṃ tāṃ janatā jñānavatyeva sarvathā |
divyeyaṃ khalu sampannā mahāmuktānikā tviti ||88||
matvā tāṃ siddhadehāṃ ca mahāsādhvīṃ tu rādhikām |
lokā nāryo narāstasyāḥ pūjāṃ cakrustato’rhaṇām ||89||
pādajalaṃ papuścāpi bhojayāmasurutsukāḥ |
prasādaṃ phalapuṣpādi miṣṭānnaṃ jagṛhustathā ||4.34.90||
sāpi māyāmayaṃ spṛṣṭvā divyaṃ karoti tatkṣaṇam |
pāpijanān pāpinārīḥ karoti puṇyaśālinīḥ ||9 1||
darśayitvā harikṛṣṇaṃ sampreṣayati cākṣaram |
vimocayati tṛṣṇāṃ ca prajvālayati vāsanām ||92||
kṛṣṇaprāptiṃ kārayati prasaṃgamayatyacyutam |
mokṣamārgaṃ diśatyeva prāpayatyūrdhvagaṃ padam ||93||
vidrumiṇyāḥ prasaṃgena narā nāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi parāṃ muktimagustadā ||94||
santaḥ sādhvyaśca tacchiṣyā babhūvurvai sahasraśaḥ |
janāśca lakṣaśastasyā mukhānmantrau prajagṛhuḥ ||95||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||96||
bālakṛṣṇo harikṛṣṇaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
sadāvatu prabhuścāsmān stutiṃ tvevaṃ pracakrire ||97||
evaṃ śrībadrike viṣṭinārī vidrumiṇī satī |
tenaiva varṣmaṇā divyā rādhāsamā vyajāyata ||98||
āyayau sā tīrthavāsaṃ kartuṃ lakṣajanaiḥ saha |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ||99||
tādātmyayogamāpannā bālakṛṣṇe tiro’bhavat |
brahmapriyāsu divyāsu vartamānāvasat tataḥ ||| 4.34.100 ||
narā nāryaśca bahudhā nyūṣurnirantaraṃ tataḥ |
tyāgāśramaṃ parigṛhya santaḥ sādhvyaśca tāpasāḥ || 10 1||
yoginyastāpasinyaśca bhūtvā ca yatayastathā |
ākṣare divyasaṃvāse nyuṣuścāśvasarastaṭe || 1 02||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇāśraye |
bhajitvā saṃprasevitvā prasādya parameśvaram || 1 03||
yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ lakṣaśo viṣayo’pi ca |
vidrumiṇī vimānena yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ prabhoḥ || 1 04||
evaṃ badrīpriye devi sābhavad rādhikāsamā |
mahāmuktānikā yasyāḥ smaraṇānmucyate hyaghī || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne dhanadhṛkpattanasthāyā viṣṭināryā vidrumiṇyāḥ prasatsaṃgena lakṣādhimānavānāṃ divyatā mokṣaṇaṃ tasyāśca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||

<4.35>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śavahartryāḥ kathāṃ śubhām |
saurāṣṭre mālavagrāme śavadāhakarī sadā || 1 ||
āsīdekā śvapacī vai śmaśānāvāsakāriṇī |
patiputrasutāyuktā sambandhibāndhavānvitā || 2 ||
karoti nityameveyaṃ śmaśāne śavadāhanam |
karaṃ labdhvā karotyeva nijakarma svabhāvajam || 3 ||
nityaṃ śavānāṃ dāhena vairāgyaṃ jāyate śubham |
kṣaṇaṃ vāpi ciraṃ vāpi mṛtasya darśanāt khalu ||4 ||
śvapacyā mālavānyāstu vairāgyaṃ vartate tathā |
nityaṃ śocati pherūṇāṃ viṣaye maraṇaṃ svakam || 5 ||
aho nityaṃ vyasavyo vai bālā yuvati vṛddhigā |
jāyante ca naraścāpi bālā yuvāna ūddharvagāḥ|| 6 ||
tathāhaṃ maraṇaṃ lapsye’kasmādeva na saṃśayaḥ |
pitarau me mṛtau cāpi śvaśurau me mṛtau tathā || 7 ||
rājā vṛddho mṛtaścāpi mriyante dehino’niśam |
vijetāro mṛtāścāpi vaimānikā maranti ca || 8 ||
sarve nāśaṃ samāyānti nāśameṣyāmyahaṃ tathā |
mṛtyukāle na kānto’pi sāhāyyārthaṃ balī tadā || 9 ||
anyeṣāṃ kā kathā tatra tataḥ sādhyaḥ sahāyadaḥ |
dharmaḥ sahāyakṛlloke paraloke’pi pārśvadaḥ || 4.35.1 0||
sukhaṃ dharmāt prabhavati yatra prāṇī prajāyate |
tatra dharmaḥ samaṃ yāti puṇyākhyaḥ paramo guruḥ || 11 ||
puṇyaṃ tvātmasahāyaṃ syād dānajaṃ sevanādikam |
godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ vastrānnajaladānakam ||1 2||
chatropānaccāmarādipradānaṃ prasahāyadam |
puṣpapatraphaladānaṃ bhakṣyabhojyapradānakam ||1 3||
gṛhadānaṃ vastudānaṃ copakaraṇadānakam |
dehadānaṃ putradānaṃ putrīdānaṃ sukhārpaṇam || 14||
vratadānaṃ cātmadānaṃ kaṭidānaṃ pramodadam |
dhanadānaṃ bhūṣaṇādyarpaṇaṃ kṣetrapradānakam ||15||
evaṃvidhāni dānāni sarvāṇyeva mahāpathe |
paraloke cāgragāṇi copatiṣṭhanti sarvathā || 16 ||
dattaṃ tat prāpyate svagre nādattaṃ prāpyate kvacit |
tasmānmayā śvapacyā vai dātavyaṃ dānamuttamam || 17||
satpātraṃ labhyate tasmai dātavyaṃ śreyase mama |
vicāryetthaṃ śvapacī sā phalānyāhṛtya vai vanāt || 18||
badarāṇi cāmṛtāni kadalāni yathartu ca |
karmadāni jambūphalānyāhṛtya sā dadāti vai || 1 9||
kandān patrāṇi puṣpāṇi madhu miṣṭekṣudaṇḍakān |
tathānyāni pavitrāṇi yogyāni pradadāti sā || 4.35.20 ||
dānaṃ mārgāgatebhyo vai yatibhyaḥ sadbhya ityapi |
upayuñjanti santaśca prakṣālya tatphalādikam ||2 1 ||
kāṣṭhāni mūttikāścāpi samāhṛtya dadāti sā |
evaṃ karoti dānāni vṛkṣatvacāṃ tathā tu sā ||22||
kaṭānāmāsanānāṃ ca pāṣāṇānāṃ pramardinām |
oṣadhīnāṃ ca vallīnāṃ karoti dānamityapi ||23||
athaivaṃ dānadharmeṇa vikhyātā mālavānikā |
abhavanmālave grāme dātrītimālavānikā || 24||
dānapuṇyapratāpena tvekadā dharmadevatā |
nārī sādhvī svayaṃ bhūtvāyayau śvapacīmandim ||25||
asnātābhūnmālavānī rajasvalā śmaśānagā |
śavārdhadāhasampannā prātareva malānvitā ||26||
malināyā gṛhe sādhvī yātrāmārgeṇa vai prage |
samāyātaikalā kācit tyāgadharmavatī satī ||27||
vīkṣya tāṃ tyāginīṃ sādhvīṃ tvekalāṃ śramayojitām |
sahasotthāya caṇḍālī nanāma pādayordrutam || 28||
uvāca svāgataṃ devi mātarnamāmi cādarāt |
yathārhe samaye sevāṃ kariṣye rocate yathā ||26||
asmyahaṃ śvapacī jātyā tatrāpyasmi rajasvalā |
asnātā ca malasyāpi visargottarasaṃsthitā ||4.35.3 0 ||
śavārdhadāhasampannā śmaśānasthā bhavāmi ca |
kiṃ karomi pavitrāyāḥ satyā arthe vadātra me || 31
atrāgatāyāste sevā sādhvi yathā bhavenmayā |
svāgatārthaṃ kṛpayā te yadahaṃ tannivedaya||32
prasannā bhava me sādhvi yogyaṃ karomi sandiśa
bhaktāsmi bhāvayuktāsmi sevikāsmi karomi te || 33 ||
sevanaṃ yogyamevātra mataṃ tava karomi tat| |
dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ mama mātardinaṃ me saphalaṃ tviha ||358||
darśanādapi sañjāta sevanāttu viśeṣataḥ |
bhavedeva tathā mātarbrūhi śīghraṃ karomi te ||35||
ityevaṃ prārthitavatī bhāvaśuddhā tu sā tadā |
dharmā dharmamatiṃ vīkṣya prasanno’bhūttadā drutam ||36||
uvāca tāṃ tadā dharmadevatā sādhvikā satī |
dehi me tvāsanaṃ tūrṇaṃ pavitraṃ tatsadā matam ||37|| |
dehi me cāpi patrāṇi tulasyāḥ santi te yadi |
dehi me phalapuṣpāṇi gṛhe te santi vai yadi ||38||
dehi me kāṣṭhapatrāṇi santi te yadi mandire |
naita tyaśuddhabhāvāni kadācit santi bhūtale || 39||
pāvanāni sadā santi dehi me yadi santi te |
tilān vai santi ced dehi taṇḍulakān pradehi ca ||4.35.40||
samprokṣyāhaṃ grahīṣyāmi pāvanān vai sadā bhuvi |
ityuktā tā bhāvabhinnā gatvā nijaṃ tu mandiram ||41 ||
ānāyya pradadau sādhvyai sādhvī saṃprokṣya jagṛhe |
vṛkṣalaye yayau tatrāsanaṃ nikṣipya cullikām ||42||
kṛtvā saṃpacya devebhyo vaiśvadevaṃ baliṃ dadau |
gave baliṃ dadau bhūtavaliṃ dadau tataḥ param ||43||
pitṛbaliṃ dadau cāpi nārāyaṇabaliṃ dadau |
tato yāvat prabhoktuṃ vai patrāvalīprapūraṇam ||44|||
karoti tāvadevātra kaścidabhyāgataḥ śubhaḥ |
āyayau śvapaco bhūtvārthayāmāsa tu bhojanam ||45||
sādhvī tasmai dadau tṛptipradaṃ bhuktvā yayau sa hi |
tataścānyā jaraṭhā cābhyāgatā tatra cāgatā ||46||
tasyai sādhvī dadau tṛptipradaṃ sā bubhuje satī |
bhuktavatī niṣasāda tarośchāyāśraye tale || 47||
japaṃ vidadhatī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti mālayā |
o namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |||48||
uccāraṇaṃ karotyeṣa mālākarā tu sādhyikā |
śrutvā tu pācikā sādhvī tāmapṛcchat tadā drutam ||49|||
kā tvaṃ kiṃ japasi śrīmannārāyaṇaṃ hi mālayā |
kiṃ tena jāyate puṇyaṃ phalaṃ vānyad vadātra me || 4.35.50
abhyāgatā tadovāca śṛṇu tvaṃ pācike sati |
mantreṇānena bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo milet ||51 ||
śvapacyapi ca cāṇḍālī dvijatulyā prajāyate |
pāvanī sarvavarṇānāṃ mantreṇānena cakriṇaḥ ||52||
māṃsādāścāpi madyādāḥ kravyādāḥ kuṇapāśanāḥ |
pūyante manunā kṛṣṇadaivatena na saṃśayaḥ |53||
yaḥ sākṣāt paramātmāsti dhāmeśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
malamāso’pi yadyogānnirmalaḥ pāvano’bhavat ||54||
malinā sarvadā māyā nirmalā rādhikā tu sā |
ajāyata hi tadyogāt tanmantraṃ prajapāmyaham |||55||
prabhokṛṣṇa vālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa |
māṇikīmādhavīlakṣmīrādhāramāpate prabho ||56||
śuni kroḍe khale kāke śave cāṇḍālake yame |
rākṣase dhvajini drohiṇyapi yo vartate prabhuḥ ||57||
gavi mṛge sati haṃse jīve dvije gurau sure |
nṛpe devālaye mitre vartate yo narāyaṇaḥ |||58||
pavitraḥ pāvakaḥ kṛṣṇastamahaṃ prajapāmi vai |
bhaktāsmi pāvanī jātā prasādabhakṣaṇādinā ||59|||
nāmnāsmi śabalāyoniścāṇḍālī vaiṣṇavī sadā |
ityuktvā sā divyarūpā divyavimānagābhavat ||4.35.60||
pācikā drutamevāsyāḥ sakāśānmanumārthayat |
sāpi vimānagā mantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||61 ||
pācikā tatparaṃ mantraṃ jagrāha satvaraṃ tadā |
tāvat tatrābhavat sākṣāt pūrvabhoktā narastu yaḥ ||62|||
so’pyayācata mantraṃ taṃ vimānasthā dadau manum |
tasmai kṛṣṇasya nāmāpi datvā svargaṃ gatābhavat ||63||
aho bhāgyaṃ śabalāyā dharmadravyarpitādanāt |
svargaṃ lebhe tato dharmadevatāpi tato manum ||64 |
lebhe labdhvā dadau tatra cāṇḍālyai śreyase drutam |
cāṇḍālī tanmanuṃ prāpya divyatejomayī hyabhūt| ||65 |
dharmadevīkarād yastu jagrāha mānavaḥ phalam |
bhojyaṃ sa tu manuścāsīt vaiṣṇavo mūrtimām̐ratadā ||66 ||
dharmadevyāḥ pāvanītvaṃ prādarśayanmanuḥ svayam |
ṣoḍaśārṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisvadaivataḥ ||67||
evaṃ vai kṛpayā tatra pāvanī dharmadevatā |
mantro’pi pāvanaścāpi cāṇḍālī pāvanī tadhā ||68||
kṛṣṇārpitāpi śabadāyonirvai pāvanī tathā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogānnikṛṣṭayonijāpi yat || 69||
pāvanī jāyate yatra kṛṣṇo’sti pāvanaṃ tu tat| |
yadrike dharmadeṣyāḥ sā saṃśrutvā dāsikā tataḥ ||4.35.70 ||
ātmanivedinī jātā dharmadevī tiro’bhavat |
evaṃvidhāṃ dharmadevīṃ vīkṣya caṇḍālanī drutam ||7 1 ||
stutiṃ cakre darśanārthaṃ punastatrātimohinī |
namo dharmadevatāyai nārāyaṇyai namo namaḥ ||72||
namaścāṇḍālikābhaktyā prasannāyai ca te namaḥ |
namaḥ śabalikāyonisvarūpāyai ca te namaḥ ||73||
namo mantrasvarūpāyai mahādhātryai ca te namaḥ |
namo’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāṇyai ca te namaḥ ||74||
namaḥ śaktyai mahāśaktyai pāvayitryai ca te namaḥ |
namaḥ kalyāṇakartryai te divyamātre ca te namaḥ ||75||
mālavānyā meladātryai dharmadāyai ca te namaḥ |
punarme darśanaṃ dehi mātarniḥsaṃśayāya me ||76||
yāhaṃ pṛṣṭvā bhavapāraṃ yāsyāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
ityarthitā dharmadevī prādṛśyate tadā punaḥ |77||
mālavānī namaścakre papraccha mokṣaṇaṃ pre |
kathaṃ mokṣaṃ prapadye’haṃ kathaṃ pāraṃ prayāmi ca ||78||
kā tvaṃ me vada kānte’tra kiṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ prayāsyapi |
kimarthaṃ tvaṃ samāyātā kā me bhaktiranuttamā ||79||
kathaṃ vā bhāvi me bhāgyaṃ vada me guruyogini |
ityevaṃ badrike śiṣyā papraccha dharmadevatām ||4.35.8 0||
dharmadevī samuvāca sarvaṃ tasyai yathātatham |
āyātāhaṃ parīkṣārthaṃ svīgatārthe’tibhāvukīm ||8 1 ||
kīdṛśī tvāṃ tu tāṃ jñātuṃ tvayā bhāvo’ti daśitaḥ |
dharmadevo’smyahaṃ devīsvarūpo’tra samāgataḥ ||82||
bhāvaṃ hārdaṃ ca te bhāvaṃ dharmaṃ jñātvātiharṣitaḥ |
svāgataṃ bhajana jñātvā dāsyaṃ jñātvātiharṣitaḥ ||83||
saṃprāptaṃ pācitaṃ tvannaṃ mayā te śreyase tviha |
prasādasya pradānāya tuṣṭaye te tathā tviha ||84||
athāhaṃ te manuṃ dātumicchāṃ cakāra śobhanām |
tāvānmantrāḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pāvanaḥ ||85||
ṣoḍaśārṇo naro bhūtvā tvatkṛpārthaṃ samāgataḥ |
pāvano’pi manurdharmāt pāvanatara iṣyate ||86||
ityevaṃ sa manurbhikṣāṃ bhuktvā tvatrābhyadarśayat |
cāṇḍālī śabalāyoniryā sā māyā pramādinī ||87||
sarvajantukhanirūpā cāyātā kāraṇātmikā |
sarvayonimayī māyā sarvathā malinā hyati ||88||
sāpi dharmācchuddharūpā kṛṇāyogāttu sarvathā |
śuddhaiva jāyate nārāyaṇārpitā hi muktidā ||89||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathāntyajā api |
cāṇḍālāśceti sarvā yā bhūtānā yonayo bhuvi ||4.35.9 0||
tāḥ sarvāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogena divyatām |
yānti sarvārpaṇabhaktyā cāṇḍālī śuddhimeti ca ||9 1 ||
tvaṃ bhaktā saṃvīkṣya sarvaṃ jagrahitha manūttamam |
matto’tra tena sahasā jātāsi pāvanī śubhā ||92||
tava yogena cānyāsāṃ cāṇḍālīnāṃ pramokṣaṇam |
bhaviṣyati na sandehastvaṃ jātādya narāyaṇī ||93||
bhaktyā pūtāsi cāṇḍāli kṛpayā pāvitā mayā |
manunā pāvitā samyag viprāṇyasi tvitaḥ param ||94||
mahāmuktānikā cāsi brahmadhāmanivāsinī |
tava sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ vai pāvanaṃ brahmagotrakam ||95||
adyataḥ khalu sañjātaṃ bhaja śrīvallabhamprabhum |
tyaja vai tāmasaṃ karma prasevaya tu sāttvikam ||96||
prabhuṃnārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ labdhvā yāhyakṣaraṃ padam |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ prayāhi sakuṭumbinī ||97||
sākṣātkṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ labdhvā yāhi paraṃ padam |
ityuktvā badrike dharmadevaścādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||98||
mālavānī prasādaṃ tu bhuktvā tyaktvā nijakriyām |
kuṭumbasahitā prāptā kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ||99||
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre jale snātvā papau jalam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra vyalokayat || 4.35.10 0||
kāntaṃ susundaraṃ viṣṇuṃ caturbhujaṃ subhūṣaṇam |
sutejasaṃ hariṃ vīkṣya kuṭumbena samaṃ drutam | | 101 ||
mūrchāmavāpa tatraiva cāṇḍālī mālavānikā |
divyaṃ vimānaṃ subhagaṃ tvāyātaṃ tatra śobhanam || 1 02||
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānaṃ cāpyarūruhat |
kuṭumbasahitā divyā divyadehātisundarī || 1 03||
anādiśrīhariṃ dhyātvā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ param |
evaṃ badrīpriye bhaktā mālavāni haripriyā ||1 04||
kuṭumbena sahitā sābhūt dharmakṛpayā tadā |
mahābhāgavataṃ dharmaṃ labdhavatī prabhumpatim || 1 05||
kāmyadharmeṇāpi sādhyadharmaḥ saṃprāpyate kvacit |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasyāvāpyate dharmajo vṛṣaḥ || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne mālavānyāścāṇḍālyā dharmabalena sevābalena dharmadevatādarśanaṃ mūrtimatṣoḍaśokṣaramanudarśanaṃ śabalikāyonipāvanatādarśanaṃ tataḥ kuṃkumavāpikāgamanottaraṃ sakuṭumbāyā mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||

<4.36>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi rathyāmārjanikākathām |
āsīt śrīkaralāgrāme nāmnā kārelikā satī || 1 ||
jātyā śūdrī grāmarathyāmārjanādikriyāparā |
yatpatiścāpi kurute rājacatvaramārjanam || 2 ||
yatputrāścāśvapālitvaṃ kurvanti nṛpateḥ khalu |
rājā tadgrāmaśāstāpi nāmnāsīd vidhamaṃkaraḥ || 3 ||
tasya rājye sadā sāyaṃ kathāṃ karoti bhūsuraḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā nāmnā hitāñjaliḥ || 4 ||
tatra gatvā grāmajanāḥ sāyaṃ śṛṇvanti tatkathāḥ |
kārelikāpi ca tasyāḥ putrādyāśca patistathā || 5 ||
putryaścāpi kathāḥ śreṣṭhā nityaṃ śṛṇvanti sādarāḥ |
śrutaṃ kathāyāṃ moho’sti jīvānāṃ bandhakṛt tviti || 6 ||
moharūpaṃ sthūlā cāsmi nāmajātyādiśobhanā |
rūparaṃgaguṇairāḍhyā bālyayauvanagarvitā || 7 ||
mamedaṃ bālabālādyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ dhanādikam |
evaṃ naijāsmitābuddhirmohastatra śruto’nayā || 8 ||
tattyāgo mohaśūnyatvaṃ nāsmi dehādibhinnatā |
ātmā brahmasvarūpāsmi brāhmyahaṃ mohavarjitā || 9 ||
na me netre na me karṇau rūpaśabdādayo na me |
na me nāsā na me tvak ca gandhasparśādayo na me || 4.36.1 0||
nāhaṃ jihvā na vā vāṅ me na me vāṇī na bhobhavā |
nāhaṃ hastau ca pādau ca nādānaṃ me na vā gatiḥ || 11 ||
nāhaṃ yonirnavā śiśnaṃ na me geho na tadratiḥ |
nāhaṃ gudā na me prāṇādayo nāpi visarjanam || 12||
nāhaṃ deho na me daihyaṃ jāgrat svapnaṃ suṣuptakam |
nāhaṃ varṣma na me bālyaṃ yauvanaṃ vṛddhatādikam || 1 3||
nāhaṃ nārī na pumān vā napuṃsakaṃ na cāsmyaham |
na me māyā na me sattvaṃ rajastamo na me guṇāḥ || 14||
na me duḥkhaṃ na me cādyaṃ na me puṇyaṃ sukhaṃ na ca |
na me karma na me yatno na me bhogo na me kaliḥ || 15||
na me kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ svāmī patnī putrāḥ sutā suhṛt |
na me dhanaṃ naiva lokaḥ kuṭumbaṃ me na cāpi vai || 16||
tato me sūtakaṃ nāpi na harṣo rodanaṃ na me |
sarvaṃ tvajñānasaklṛptaṃ hyātmāsmi jñānavānaham || 17||
ahantā vimalā me’sti mamatā paramātmani |
yadyaduktaṃ samastaṃ me vartate śrīpatau harau || 18||
nirguṇaṃ cāpi nirbandhaṃ divya mokṣapradaṃ sadā |
naiṣkarmyaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’sti me śubham || 1 9||
bhajanaṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi bhājanaṃ bhagavānmama |
bandho mokṣo harirme’sti bhāvanāvāsanāśrayaḥ ||4.36.20||
ratirvirāmaḥ kṛṣṇo me mahānande harau mama |
tṛptirme sarvadā kṛṣṇaḥ śāntirviśrāntiracyutaḥ ||21||
gocaro me hariścāsti sākṣāt svapne suṣuptake |
ahaṃbhāvo’ntare tasmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’sti me ||22|||
vyavahāraḥ sphuraṇaṃ me nitye śrīparamātmani |
nidrā turyā mūrchanā me prabhaukānte’ntarātmani ||23||
evaṃ śrutā kathā tena badrike saṃhitāgatā |
vicāritā tathā sā ca nijātmani sthirīkṛtā ||24||
nityaṃ putrasutāsvāmiṣvapi tadvat kathāmṛtam |
pacyate niśi mananāt satsaṃgāt svagṛhe’niśam ||25||
tena sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ vai mārjayitryā vimohakam |
harṣaśokavihīnaṃ vai māyāpāśavivarjitam ||26||
vartate śrīkṛṣṇakāntamahānandapariplutam |
moho nāsti na rāgo’sti nāvidyā dveṣaṇaṃ na ca ||27||
na bhayaṃ vidyate cāpi nātmārāmasya bandhanam |
nirmohinī tato jātā siddhā kārelikā bhuvi ||28||
yathā mātā tathā putrāḥ putryaḥ patistathāvidhaḥ |
nirmohi tatkuṭumbaṃ vai kṛṣṇamohanamātrakam ||29||
hitāñjalimunirnārāyaṇaṃ bhajan kathāmṛtam |
pāyayatyeva lokāṃśca mantrān dadāti mokṣadān ||4.36.3 0||
nirmohakārakaṃ mumukṣubhyo dehibhya ādarāt |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||3 1 ||
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt |
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ||32||
śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā |
brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ ||33||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me |
bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ||34||
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ |
oṃ māṃ śrībālakṛṣṇāya samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ||35||
oṃ śrīlakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai duḥkhabhaṃktryai śriyai namaḥ |
kṛṣṇasya vallabhokto’haṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||36||
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaścāryaḥ śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama |
śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||37||
prabhuḥkṛṣṇo mālatīnārāyaṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
hitāñjalimunirbadri mantrānevaṃvidhān bahūn ||38||
mumukṣubhyo’rpayatyeva karoti bandhavarjitān |
mahābhāgavatān lokān kṛtvā dadāti mokṣaṇam ||39||
bahavo mohaśūnyā vai bhaktā bhāgavatā bhuvi |
narā nāryo’bhavam̐stasya kathābhiśca samāgamaiḥ ||4.36.40||
kārelikā tvātmavettrī mokṣamārgaparāyaṇā |
kuṭumbasahitā sādhvī mantrān jagrāha vaiṣṇavī ||41||
mohaśūnyā haristhairyā śrīkṛṣṇānandinī satī |
ajāyata mahāmuktānikā kṛṣṇaparāyaṇā ||42||
yatprasaṃgenāpi cānyāḥ striyo muktiṃ prapedire |
jantavaścāpi mārjanyā yasyāḥ sparśamupāgatāḥ ||43||
sarve te karmabhirhīnā bhūtvā pramokṣaṇaṃ gatāḥ |
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇeti sādhvī sā bhajate prabhum ||44||
snātvā sampūjya rādheśaṃ śṛṃgārabhūṣaṇādibhiḥ |
ārārtrikaṃ sunaivedyaṃ phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ||45||
jalaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ kṛṣṇakāntāyārpya prasādijam |
bhuṃkte sā sakuṭumbaiva mahābhāgavatī satī ||46||
mārjane cāpi rathyādau vīkṣya jantūn tatastu sā |
śrāvayatyeva nāmāni tebhyaḥ kṛṣṇahare prabho ||47||
ajñātamṛtyubhāve’pi jantūnāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
śrūyate śrīkṛṣṇanāma yatra śrībadrike sthale ||48||
tatra dahyanti karmāṇi yāmyā dūtā na yānti ca |
vāsanāśca kṣayaṃ yānti śrotāro yānti mokṣaṇam ||49||
nirmohināṃ prasaṅgena yānti nirmohatāṃ janāḥ |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi jantavaḥ pādapā api ||4.36.50||
prāṇamātradharāścāpi nirmohatāṃ vrajanti vai |
kā kathā vaiṣṇavīnāṃ vai samāgame hi mokṣaṇe ||51||
vaiṣṇavīnāṃ bālakā vai muktā eva bhavantyapi |
vaiṣṇavīnāṃ jalamannaṃ gṛhamambaramityapi ||52||
pāvanaṃ pāpahaṃ badri jāyate jīvamokṣakṛt |
parokṣe’pi prasādaśced vaiṣṇavīnāṃ pralabhyate ||53||
prāṇaprayāṇasamaye yātā mokṣaṃ prayāti hi |
vaiṣṇavīnāṃ darśanaṃ ca sparśanaṃ ca samāgamaḥ ||54||
sratsaṅga āśīrvādāśca bhavanti mokṣadāḥ sadā |
vaiṣṇavyo yatra vartante bhūmiḥ sā harimandiram ||55||
kuṭumbaṃ śrīharestatra badrike tiṣṭhate sadā |
vaiṣṇavī kamalā rādhā ramā lakṣmīśca pārvatī ||56||
vaiṣṇavī lalitā vāṇī prajñā śrīrmāṇikī jayā |
santuṣṭā vaiṣṇavī brāhmī kṛṣṇā nārāyaṇī matā ||57||
tābhiḥ sandhāryate kṛṣṇovallabhaḥ prāpyate hariḥ |
tābhiḥ saṃsevyate kṛṣṇastābhiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ prakāśyate ||58||
kṛṣṇaṃ vinānyatra yāsāṃ mohaḥ prītiḥ ratirna vai |
parabrahmanivāso vai vaiṣṇavyāṃ śrīsthitistathā ||59||
vaiṣṇavīnāṃ harau nityaṃ tādātmyaṃ cāpi tattathā |
ato vai pāvanī devī vaiṣṇavī pramadā parā ||4.36.60||
kārṣṇī sā badrike nārāyaṇī sā puruṣottamī |
vāsudevī tathā badrīnārāyaṇī hi sā matā ||61 ||
gaṅgā sā yamunā sarasvatī brahmahradātmikā |
aśvapaṭṭasarāsthā ca śāsti kuṃkumavāpikā ||62||
vaiṣṇavī sarvathā tīrthottamā sarvavidhāriṇī |
sarvapuṇyapradā mokṣapradā mohavikhaṇḍinī ||63||
etādṛśī mohaśūnyā kārelikābhavat satī |
sāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇe kīrtanaṃ prakaroti sā ||64||
tato vai śayanaṃ yāti kroḍe kṛtvā narāyaṇam |
prātaścaivaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā bhajate nityavat satī ||65||
athaikadā tu vai tasyāḥ putryaḥ pañcātiśobhanāḥ |
mārgaśīrṣe kṣudrabadrīphalānyāhartumutsukāḥ ||66||
sīmni kṣetreṣu viśveṣu yayurvaneṣu śākhiṣu |
tatrarṣirnāmato badrikāyano badrikātale ||67||
badrikāṣaṇḍamadhyasthastāpasaḥ śaśabindunā |
maharṣiṇā samaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ kanyābhiḥ pañcabhistadā ||68||
śaśabinduḥ kanyakāstā dṛṣṭvā kṣetrāntaraṃ yayau |
dhyānasthastu ṛṣirbadrikāyanaḥ prabubodha ha ||69||
apaśyat kanyakāḥ pañca badrīphalābhicāyane |
dattadhyānāstataḥ so’pi papraccha yūyamatra kā||4.36.7 0 ||
kathaṃ sīmni badrikāṇāṃ ṣaṇḍe bhramatha kiṃphalāḥ |
kanyakāstu mahāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāptā munīśvaram ||7 1 ||
tāpasaṃ jaṭilaṃ saumyaṃ śuṣkaṃ dṛṣṭvā śanairmunim |
natvā prāhurvayaṃ śūdryo nirmohivaṃśajāḥ sutāḥ |172||
kārelikāyāḥ putryaḥ smo namaste bhagavanniha |
śrutvetthaṃ nirmohijāstāḥ parīkṣitumiyeṣa saḥ ||73 ||
rūpaṃ tvindrasamaṃ tūrṇaṃ cakāra kāmagarvaham |
sūryavat taijasaṃ svarṇasamaṃ cakṣurmanoharam ||74|.|
candravacchītalaṃ lakṣmīkāntavat kāntisaṃbhṛtam |
sarvābharaṇasaugandhyaśṛṃgāramanmathānvitam ||75||
mohanārthaṃ kanyakānāṃ cañcalendriyagarbhitam |
mandasugandhaśītalānilakṛtātimodakṛt ||76||
ṣoḍaśottaravarṣaṃ vai puṣṭaṃ vīryabhṛtaṃ dṛḍham |
mandahāsyamayaṃ dṛṣṭikaṭākṣabhāvagarbhitam ||77||
premavarṣānvitanetraṃ cāhvānauṣṭhakriyāparam |
ākārayat sarvabhāvairiṅgitairanivartibhiḥ ||78 ||
rūpātirūpasaundaryamārdavasnigdhatābhṛtam |
camatkṛtibhṛtaṃ ramyaṃ netracittātmaveśitam ||7 9 ||
tyajamānamapi tyāgaṃ naiva prāptaṃ vilokitam |
kṛṣṇavat sundaraṃ sarvakāmapūramupasthitam ||4.36.8 0 | |
etādṛśaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ dadhāra munirāṭ sa tu |
kintu tāḥ kanyakā matvā mahāpuruṣamuttamam | |8 1 ||
sattvabhāvanayā mānadṛṣṭyā cakrurnatiṃ muhuḥ |
puttalaṃ māyikaṃ matvā jahudṛṣṭiṃ tu vaikṛtim ||8 2| |
na kṣobhaṃ nāpi cāñcalyamavāpustatra puttale |
navadvāranarakāḍhye naśvare’śucisaṃgrahe || 83 ||
svadehavad vartamāne garbhavikṛtisaṃbhṛte |
asve cātmapṛthagbhūte jaḍe kardamite kṛtau || 8 4||
sarvamalakṣaraṇāḍhye durgandhe bahirujjvale |
mohamātrāṃ manāk tāstu nāpuḥ sundaradurbhage ||86 ||
tadā tāḥ kanyakāḥ sarvā nirvikārā vilokya saḥ |
badrikāyanaṛṣiruvāca mohakṛdvacaḥ || 8 6| |
bhavatīnāṃ svāgataṃ vai karomyatra vanāntare |
yuvatīnāṃ kanyakānām ṛṣiścāhaṃ prarakṣakaḥ ||87||
samartho’smi yāvadarthapūraṇe siddhimāniha |
ananyapūrvāścet prāptayauvanā bhavatha priyāḥ || 88 | |
māṃ saṃvṛṇuta sundaryo daivāt prāptaṃ tu sundaram |
varaṃ tvananyasadṛśaṃ svānurūpaṃ spṛhāyutam || 89 ||
indraścandro raviḥ śaṃbhuḥ śiṣyā me santi devatāḥ |
taṃ māṃ trilokanāthābhaṃ patiṃ vṛṇuta cārthinam || 4.36.90 ||
śrutvā tāḥ kanyakā badri prāhurmohavivarjitāḥ |
svāgataṃ brahmaṇo vidvan sarvāntaryāmiṇo’stu vai || 91 ||
na svāgataṃ tu nārīṇāṃ ṛṣikalyāṇakṛt kvacit |
yuvatīnāṃ rakṣako’sti cāntarātmā janārdanaḥ || 92 ||
yo’sti nityaṃ vane tvatra ṛṣeścāpi prarakṣakaḥ |
na dehe rakṣayitṛtvaṃ rakṣye bhavati vāstavam || 93 ||
āvayoḥ sarvathā sāmyaṃ rakṣye dehe na rakṣitā |
yāvadarthāḥ sakāmānāṃ satṛṣṇānāṃ prapūraṇe || 94||
vāñcchitāḥ saṃbhavantyeva niṣkāmānāṃ nirarthitā |
sāmarthyaṃ siddhayaścāpi tuṣṭimatāṃ tu dehinām || 95||
mohināṃ saṃbhavantyeva nirmohināṃ na siddhayaḥ |
ananyapūrvo jīvātmā śāśvataḥ sarvadā priyaḥ ||96||
paramātmā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ priyatamo’sti naḥ |
ātmātmanāṃ priyatamo na nārīvarṣma tattathā ||97||
durgandhaṃ pauruṣaṃ varṣma nārīvarṣmāpi tattathā |
kiṃ priyatvaṃ tatra cāste hyapriye rāgavarjite ||98||
aśāśvatī priyatā vai naśvarā na hitāya sā |
indravāruṇikāyāstu phalavad varṣma sundaram ||99||
bahiḥ rūpacamatkārakaraṃ mohitacakṣuṣāma |
antarnetravatāṃ duṣṭaṃ sarvathā malasaṃbhṛtam || 4.36.100 ||
sundarī sundaro vāpi malānāṃ vācako’sti saḥ |
kaphapittādidhātūnāṃ rāgau saundaryamatra kim || 101 ||
yauvanaṃ vārānāḍhyaṃ vai nirvāsanā tu vṛddhatā |
śāntirjīvanamuktiśca brahmānando’timuktatā || 1 02||
varo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastadanye tvavarā matāḥ |
spṛhā yatrāsti kiṃ tasya varatvaṃ nirayārthinaḥ || 103 ||
yonilobho hi narakaṃ mūtrākāṃkṣā yamālayaḥ |
svānurūpā matiste’tra rajokedārake yadi || 1 04||
tadā narakavāñcchā te nivṛttā naiva sarvathā |
ārṣatvaṃ te śobhate na yadātmabrahmabhāvitam || 1 05|
tasmād yāhi yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ mahāvanāntaraṃ tvitaḥ |
āśā hi narakaṃ proktaṃ tatrāpi strī tato’dhikam || 1 06||
strīyogī puruṣastasmādatyadhiko hi nārakī |
narakāṇāṃ mohakartā teṣu pātayitā tathā || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā caturthe tiṣyasantāne kārelikābhidhāyāḥ śūdryāḥ kathāśravaṇena nirmohitvaṃ
tasyāḥ pañcaputrīṇāmapi nirmohitvam, hitāñjalimunidvārā prāptabodhatvam, badrikāyanarṣikṛtaṃ tāsāṃ parīkṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||

<4.37>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śrutvā tatkanyakāvacaḥ |
badrikāyanamunirāṭ kanyakā mohavarjitāḥ || 1 ||
niścikāya tirobhūya yayau tāsāṃ gṛhaṃ prati |
mam tāsāṃ bhrātarastu rathyāmārjanakarmiṇaḥ || 2 ||
kurvanti mārjanaṃ tatra gatvā ruroda vai ṛṣiḥ |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ saṃrudantaṃ te papracchuḥ kāraṇaṃ tadā || 3 ||
uvācarṣirmahāduḥkhabhṛtaḥ śvāsaṃ manāg dharan |
ahoho bahvaniṣṭaṃ va mamāśramasya sannidhau || 4 ||
sañjātaṃ tvadya vacmyatra śrotavyārhaṃ na vidyate |
rākṣasāḥ pañca cāyātā mama kuṭyāḥ samīpataḥ || 5 ||
kṛtrimaujjvalyasampannā mahāmohakarāḥ khalāḥ |
kārelikāyāḥ pañcāpi kanyakā vavrire tu tān || 6 ||
rākṣasāstā drutaṃ nītvā yayuścābdhitalālayam |
aho’niṣṭaṃ paraṃ jātaṃ bhaktāyāścātiduḥkhakṛt| || 7 ||
śaśākāhaṃ na tatsoḍhuṃ jñāpanārthamupāgataḥ |
śrutvaitat pañca sabalāḥ sahodarāḥ sahāyinaḥ || 8 ||
kārayantu kanyakānāṃ svasṛṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
aho mohaḥ kanyakānāṃ śavādānāṃ striyo’bhavan || 9 ||
ityuktvā bahudhā sādhuḥ śuśoca bhrātṛsannidhīau |
bhrātaraste vīkṣya caitad ṛṣiṃ prāhustadottaram || 4.37.1 0||
ṛṣe te darśanādadya janmasāphalyameva naḥ |
svasṝṇāṃ janmasāphalyaṃ yad bhavadāśramāntike || 11 ||
bhavato darśanaṃ kṛtvā patiprāptiṃ gatāstu tāḥ |
bhavatā vīkṣitāścāpi śaucitā muktaye’pi ca || 1 2||
rākṣasā api ṛṣirāḍ bhavatā tu nibhālitāḥ |
bhavatpratāpataste’pi bhaviṣyanti maharṣayaḥ | 12 ||
kanyakāḥ pañca evāpi vaiṣṇavyaḥ santi dhārmijāḥ |
dharmavatyaśca pāvanyaḥ pāpināṃ mokṣadā api || 14||
rakṣasāmapi tāsāṃ saṃprasaṅgena pramokṣaṇam |
bhaviṣyati na sandehastatra śoko na vidyate || 15||
kanyāratnaṃ pradātavyaṃ yasmai kasmai tu karmiṇe |
karmabandhena jāyante patnyaśca patayastviha || 16||
tāsāṃ bhāgyeṣu puruṣā rākṣasā likhitā yadi |
patayaste prajātā vai tatra kā parivedanā || 17||
kanyādhanaṃ parakīyaṃ puṃsāpekṣaṃ sadā matam |
tajjātaṃ samaye tāsāṃ tatra kā parivedanā || 18|
śarīrāṇi samastāni samavikṛtivanti vai |
bhautikāni bhavantyeva tatra kā parivedanā || 19||
pumān vā yadi vā nārī mūtramalādivikṛtiḥ |
sarvatra sadṛśī vedī tatra kā parivedanā || 4.37.20||
yadi nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajata nahi mānavaḥ |
vipro’pi rākṣaso bodhyastatra kā parivedanā ||2 1 ||
rākṣaso’pi hareryogaṃ bhaktayogaṃ ca vindati |
vipraḥ sa eva bhaktyāḍhyastatra kā parivedanā ||22||
sarve bhaktiṃ vinā devā mānavāśca maharṣayaḥ |
varṣmamohaparā varṣmabhoktāro rākṣasā matāḥ ||23||
dehendriyāṇāṃ bhogām̐stu tyaktvātmavedinastu ye |
antarātmaparāsaktāsta eva ṛṣayo matāḥ ||24||
yeṣāṃ sarvamidaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ kṛṣṇaśarīrakam |
kṛṣṇānvitaṃ samastaṃ vai teṣāṃ daivitvamucyate ||25||
yeṣāṃ rūpe rase svāde kāme dehe ca vāsanā |
bhedadṛṣṭirvartate’pi te narā rākṣasāstviha ||26||
bhaktimatyaḥ kanyakāstā ātmanivedanānvitāḥ |
santi mahābhāgavatyastāsāṃ saṃgaṃ gatāstu ye ||27||
tāsu bhāvaparā ye ca tāsu raktāśca ye narāḥ |
tāsu snehaparā jātā daivāste na tu rākṣasāḥ ||28||
parakīyaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ parahaste gataṃ bhavet |
sahasā vārpitaṃ vāpi prasahyāpi gataṃ bhavet ||29||
gataṃ kāle yathārekhaṃ tatra kā parivedanā |
saṃsārasya gatiśceyaṃ kanyānyasmai pradīyate ||4.37.30||
tāratamyaṃ tataḥ snehe dampatyorvyajyate hyanu |
mithaḥ snehe vivṛddhe tu sukhaṃ tayoḥ prajāyate || 31 ||
svargaṃ daivādhivāsārhaṃ tadgṛhaṃ procyate tayoḥ |
yadi sneho mitho naiva jāyate naiva vardhate ||32||
vaimanasyaṃ kalahaśca narakaṃ tat sadā tviha |
sthitiścaitādṛśī yatra rakṣodharmāstu tatra vai ||33||
prāyaśaḥ khalu sṛṣṭau vai rakṣodharmā bhavanti hi |
ekatrotpadyate sarvaṃ poṣaṇaṃ caiti bhautikaiḥ ||34||
bhujyate tvapareṇaitat phalakanyādhanādikam |
svasṛmātṛvyavahārāḥ sāpekṣā nirmitāstviha ||35||
kanyā ced rākṣasaṃ bhaktyā vṛṇute tanmanasvinī |
tāṃ tu nivārayituṃ na śaktaḥ kaścid bhavediha ||36||
kanyā cet vimanā deve dattāpi na suraiṣiṇī |
preṣayituṃ na tāṃ śaktaḥ kaścid bhavet svayaṃvarām ||37||
yatra mano gataṃ lagnaṃ yasyāḥ sa eva tatpatiḥ |
alagnaṃ tu mano yatra tatra svāmitvameva na ||38||
evaṃ sthite’tra saṃsāre naḥ kātra parivedanā |
maharṣe tvaṃ vṛthā śokaṃ kuruṣe viṣame vṛṣe ||39||
bhogyaṃ bhoktā bhunaktyeva bhogyaṃ bhoktāramṛcchati |
tatra kaḥ śokaḥ ko mohaḥ kā tatra vedanāpi ca ||4.37.40||
svāgataṃ te’rhaṇaṃ brahman gṛhāṇa bhojanādikam |
madhuparkaṃ gṛhītvāpi pāvayitvā ca nastviha ||41||
madhvāśīrbhirnaḥ prayujya yāhi vidvan yathāgatam |
mā mohaṃ ca śucaṃ vidvan yāhi nisargasarjane ||42||
kariṣyāmo yathāyogyaṃ tatra kā parivedanā |
ityukto badrike bhrātṛbhiścarṣirvismayaṃ gataḥ ||43||
nirmohā bhrātaraḥ sarve niścikāya śamaṃ yayau |
atharṣirmātaraṃ gatvā kanyakānāṃ jagāda tām ||44||
aho putrā nirdayāste nirghṛṇā svasṛśatravaḥ |
svasṝṇāṃ cāpaharaṇe rākṣasairvihite’pi te ||45||
prabodhitā mayā cāpi sāhāyyārthaṃ na yānti vai |
pratyuta jñānavantaste nivārayanti māmapi ||46||
svasṛbhāvaṃ manāṅ naiva vijñāpayanti laukikam |
śuṣkahṛdayabhāvāste śṛṇvanti nāpadaṃ tava ||47||
śṛṇu mātarmahāniṣṭaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ matpadāśraye |
rākṣasaiste kanyakānāṃ prasahya haraṇaṃ kṛtam ||48||
atyaniṣṭaṃ hi tajjātaṃ mātarmocaya putrikāḥ |
śocāmyahaṃ tadarthaṃ vai sannidhau te samāgataḥ ||49||
vinā tu rakṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ nāśo vā syāttu rākṣasaiḥ |
bhogaṃ vā pramadānāṃ te kariṣyanti svakīyavat ||4.37.50||
yadvā mugdhāḥ svapatnītvaṃ kariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ |
yāhi śīghraṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ saha cāyāmyahaṃ drutam |||7 ||
ityuktā badrike mātā kārelikā munīśvaram |
śocantaṃ phutkārayuktaṃ śirohastadvayaṃ tadā ||52||
prāha mune kathaṃ kanyākṛte śokaṃ karoṣi vai |
na te kanyā na te yogaḥ sambandhaste na vidyate ||53||
saṃsārottīrṇa evāsi kathaṃ saṃsarasi kṣaye |
avināśaṃ nijātmānaṃ smara saṃsāravarjitam ||54|||
asmādṛśīnāṃ saṃsāraḥ so’pi yāvannijārthakaḥ |
bhavādṛśānāṃ saṃsāraścāsāraḥ sarvadā mataḥ ||55||
tat kathaṃ munirāṭ cintayasi strījanaceṣṭanam |
kanyakā yāstu tāḥ kālāntare yāsyanti bhogyatām ||56||
patnītvaṃ parakīyātvaṃ pare tu mānavāḥ surāḥ |
yadvā daityā rākṣasā vā narā vai patayo matāḥ ||57||
yathā bhāgyaṃ tathā jātaṃ jāyate’pi tathaiva hi |
pūrvasañcitavegena jāyante gṛhamedhinaḥ |||58||
yadarthaṃ nirmitā kanyā patiḥ sa eva tiṣṭhati |
anirmito na vai svāmī kadācidapi jāyate ||59||
rākṣasāḥ patayastāsāṃ nirmitā yadi santi cet |
labdhavantaḥ runyakāstāstatra kā parivedanā ||4.37.60||
yāhi vidvan brahmamārgaṃ bhramamārgaṃ tu mā vaha |
mohaṃ mā kuru pārakye daihike vāpyadaihike ||61 ||
prarakṣitaṃ gṛhe dravyaṃ parakīyaṃ bhaved yadi |
pārakyaṃ parahaste tad yathābhāgyaṃ gamiṣyati ||62||
parityaktaṃ jane dravyaṃ svakīyaṃ ced bhaved yadi |
svatvavannijahaste tat prasahyaivāgamiṣyati ||63||
abdhyudbhavā ghanāścāpi ratnāni mauktikānyapi |
bhāgyavatāṃ gṛhe rāṣṭre prayāntyambaramārgataḥ ||64||
gṛhodbhavāḥ kumārā vā kumāryo yatidharmagāḥ |
bhāgyavaśāt prayāntyeva vanāraṇyaguhādikam ||65||
nārikelaphale vāri pracchannamapi rohati |
dīyamānamapi vāri kamale nādhirohati ||66||
tasmāt pūrvakṛtā yogā bhavanti narayoṣitām |
tathā jātāḥ kanyakānāṃ tatra kā paridevanā ||67||
mayā sṛṣṭāḥ kanyakāstā badrīphalārthamutsukāḥ |
svayaṃ yātrā dhṛtāstatra paraiḥ kā parivedanā ||68||
kanyakātvaṃ dhruvaṃ nāsti mātṛgṛhaṃ dhruva na ca |
paragṛhaṃ sutarāṃ na tataḥ kā parivedanā ||69||
īkṣaṇaṃ na dhruvaṃ cāste parīkṣā na dhruvā tathā |
parīkṣako dhruvo nāsti tataḥ kā parivedanā ||4.37.70||
yāhi vidvan kuṭīṃ naijāṃ mā mohaṃ yāhi tatkṛte |
kariṣye kārayiṣye vā yogyaṃ matkanyakākṛte ||71||
ityevaṃ bodhito vipro mahāścaryaparo’bhavat |
kanyakāvad bhrātaraśca mātāpi mohavarjitā ||72||
atha yāmi pitaraṃ vai kathayāmi niyojitam |
vicāryetthaṃ śuṣkamanāḥ śokodgāraparāhataḥ ||73||
nistejā iva saṃbhūtvā kanyānāṃ janakaṃ yayau |
pīṭayāmāsa hastābhyāṃ kapolau bhālagaṇḍakau ||74||
mumocāśrūṇi bahūni paraṃ śokaṃ tvadarśayat |
āśvāsito dayāyuktaivākyairdhairyaṃ pradāpitaḥ ||75||
pitrā śanaiśca saṃpṛṣṭaḥ kāraṇaṃ prati bhūsuraḥ |
uvāca hikkāsahitaḥ kampayan mastakaṃ nijam ||76||
aho duḥkhamaho kaṣṭamaho nyāyavivarjitam |
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ nirghṛṇāḍhyaṃ kanyakānāṃ madantike ||77||
mamāśrame pañcabhiśca rakṣobhiḥ prabalairdrutam |
kṛtaṃ tvapaharaṇaṃ vai nirbalānāṃ prasahya tu ||78||
rakṣaṇārthaṃ drutaṃ tāsāṃ samāgaccha vibhañjana |
tvaṃ pitā rakṣakastāsāṃ śīghraṃ kuru mayā saha ||79||
vibhañjanābhidho rathyāmārjakaḥ prāha taṃ munim |
svāgataṃ munirāṭ te’stu dhanyavādaṃ dadāmi te ||4.37.80||
vairāgyamārgavāsasya rāgaceṣṭāvidhāyinaḥ |
tyaktakuṭumbayogasya parārthayogaśokinaḥ ||8 1||
vṛthā mohagatasyātra cātmārāmasya rogiṇaḥ |
kiṃ te gataṃ kanyakānāṃ gamane rākṣasaiḥ saha ||82||
kanyāhastagrahāḥ sarve rākṣasā mānavā bhuvi |
narahastagrahā nāryo rākṣasyastāstathā bhuvi ||83||
tyaktalajjādharmakarmāṇo ye te rākṣasā matāḥ |
patnyaśca patayastadvannagnā vai rākṣasāḥ sadā ||84||
kuṇape snehavanto ye mūtragolakalubdhakāḥ |
mitho yujyanta udvṛttāḥ pracchannā rākṣasāstu te ||85||
deho’yaṃ rākṣasaḥ proktaḥ paradehasya bhakṣakaḥ |
mune saṃsāravelāto bahiścāsi prayāhi vai ||86||
svakhedaṃ kuru viprendra rākṣasatvavimuktaye |
parakhedaparatve tu viśeṣo rākṣasāttu kaḥ ||87||
karmaṇā yogamāsādya viyogaṃ yānti karmabhiḥ |
karmasambandhisaṃsāre kā te me parivedanā ||88||
pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa viprendra bhojanaṃ kuru bhāvataḥ |
vāsaṃ vidhehi viśrāntiṃ śāntiṃ gṛhāṇa mā śucaḥ ||89||
sarvaṃ kālavaśaṃ loke jāyate copatiṣṭhati |
kāle gate punastadvai viyujyate na tiṣṭhati ||4.37.90||
yathāyogyaṃ tu satkāraṃ labdhvā yāhi nijālayam |
tyaktāhaṃmamatābhāve kathaṃ śokastvayi sthitaḥ ||91||
deho’yaṃ bhogya evāsti bhogasthānaṃ sadātmanaḥ |
ātmā bhuṃkte nijaṃ matvā dehaṃ dehāntaraṃ ca vā ||92||
bhogo mohaḥ paraḥ prokto nirbhogo mohavarjitā |
sukhaduḥkhaikasākṣātkārastu bhogo hi manyate ||93||
mune mā te’stu muktasya mā māṃ yojaya tatra ca |
nirañjano’smi nā cāsmi mohabhañjanako’smi ca ||94||
kanyakānāṃ na me mohaste kathaṃ vartate tviha |
alakṣye mohanaṃ te me vijñāpayati kṛtrimam ||95||
śokaṃ sandarśayase’tra yāhi yogin yathāgatam |
vidhāsye rakṣaṇaṃ yogyaṃ svasti te me’stu sarvathā ||96||
ityuktvā bhañjanaḥ śūdro bhojanādi samārpayat |
tāvat tāḥ kanyakāstatra pakvabadrīphalāni tu ||97||
saṃgṛhya tvāgatāstūrṇaṃ sarvāḥ prasannamānasāḥ |
pṛṣṭāstā bhrātṛbhirmātrā pitrā tathānyamānavaiḥ ||98||
rākṣasopadrave tāstu śrutvā taṃ badrikāyanam |
asatpralāpinaṃ jñātvā munidharmacyutaṃ tathā ||99||
asthānakṛtajijñāsaṃ śepurmūko bhavādhunā |
ityukte mūkatāṃ sādhuravrajad vāgvidūṣaṇaiḥ || 4.37.1 00||
prārthayāmāsa manasā nirmohikanyakāstathā |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhrātṝnarthayāmāsa bhāṣaṇam || 101 ||
dayāparā dharmadhartryaḥ kṛṣṇakāntaparāyaṇāḥ |
kuṭumbinaḥ samastāste cakrurnirmūkatāṃ muneḥ || 102||
munirviveda sarveṣāṃ nirmohitvaṃ mahattamam |
jijñāsāyāḥ svayaṃ mohaṃ tyaktvā natvā punaḥ punaḥ || 1 03||
mānaṃ hitvā yayau pūjāṃ prāpya daṇḍabhayād drutam |
evaṃ badraupriye devi kanyakā bhrātaraḥ pitā || 1 04||
mātā ca mohaśūnyāste’bhavan kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
nirañjanaśca nirvāṇo nirmoho’pi nirīhakaḥ || 1 05||
nirāśayaśca te pañca bhrātaro nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ |
niḥsvarūpā nirabhidhā nirantarā nirāgasā || 1 06||
nijānandā ca pañcaitāḥ putrikā nāmatastu tāḥ |
sarve’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 1 07||
janmajayantyutsave caikonaviṃśe yayustataḥ |
prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ labdhvā pūrṇāśāḥ pūrṇakāmanāḥ || 1 08||
babhūvurdivyarūpāśca śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādataḥ ||
hariṃ prapūjya bhāvena cāvatārya nijāntare || 109||
āgatena vimānena cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe |
bālakṛṣṇecchayā tūrṇaṃ yayuścākṣaramuttamam || 4.37.110 ||
evaṃ badrīpriye devi kārelikākuṭumbinaḥ |
bālakṛṣṇasya vai bhaktyā badrikāyanayogataḥ || 111 ||
divyabhāvaṃ samavāpya nirmohatāṃ pragamya ca |
paraṃ mokṣaṃ yayuḥ sarve kṛṣṇakāntasya bhaktitaḥ || 1 12||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mananācchravaṇādapi |
bhuktimuktyau bhavetāṃ vai kṛṣṇakāntakṛpālavāt || 1 13||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kārelikāśūdrāṇyā mārjayitryā nirmohitvaparīkṣāyāṃ
badrikāyanarṣermūkatvaṃ, śāpanivṛttiḥ, pañcakanyakānāṃ pañcaputrāṇāṃ patyuśca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||

<4.38>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi yantrakartryāḥ kathāṃ tathā |
kṛṣṇānāmnīnadītīre dvijavāṭītipattane || 1 ||
yantrakartrī satī nārī kuṭumbinī purābhavat |
patiputravatī putrīsuhṛdbandhumatī tathā || 2 ||
dhanadhānyavatī sampatprapūritasumandirā |
harau bhaktimatī dharme niṣṭhāvatī suyoginī || 3 ||
sarvasaubhāgyasampannā satāṃ sevāparāyaṇā |
hiṃsādivarjitā śīladharmāḍhyā satyamāśritā || 4 ||
devārhaṇaparātithisatkārādipramodinī |
ātmasādhanasaṃraktā māyāmāyikanispṛhā || 5 ||
bhajate bhagavantaṃ sā śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam |
kṛṣṇāyāṃ pratyahaṃ prātaḥ snātvā devārhaṇaṃ śubham || 6 ||
kṛtvā vṛddhānnamaskṛtya patiṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ |
patyuḥ pādajalaṃ dhṛtvā mukhe śirasi varṣmaṇi || 7 ||
devaprasādatulasīpatraṃ nyasya mukhe tataḥ |
putrādyarthaṃ payaḥpānaṃ sampādayati bhāminī || 8 ||
nāmnā tu gomatīdevī gavāṃ sevāparāyaṇā |
patistasyā nayarājābhidhaḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ || 9 ||
putrāḥ putryo bāndhavādyāḥ sarve’pi vaiṣṇavottamāḥ |
bhajante paramātmānaṃ sevante sādhumaṇḍalam || 4.38.10||
vihāya bandhanīṃ māyāṃ kurvanti tvātmanā hitam |
vartante dharmakāryeṣu nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 11 ||
kintu te jīvikārthaṃ vai lohayantrāṇi yānyapi |
ikṣurasopayuktāni tailaniṣkāsanāni ca || 12||
evaṃvidhāni tvanyāni racayanti sma vṛttitaḥ |
teṣāṃ krayeṇa labdhaṃ yaddhanaṃ tena tu jīvikām || 13||
nirvahantyeva te sarve mahābhāgavatā janāḥ |
loharasadravārthaṃ te bhrāṣṭrīṃ kurvanti vai yadā || 14||
jīvāstatrāpi dahyanti pātakaṃ tat prajāyate |
yantrairikṣusamūhāśca pīḍyante rasalabdhayai || 15||
tatrekṣudaṇḍakīṭādyāḥ pīḍyante rasamiśritāḥ |
tilānāṃ pīḍane bhūmiphalīnāṃ pīḍanādiṣu || 16||
jantavo’pi prapīḍyante kārpāsayantrake’pi ca |
mriyante’saṃkhyakīṭādyāstatpāpaṃ hiṃsanātmakam || 17||
pīḍakānāṃ yantravāhakānāṃ kaṇapradāyinām |
yantraracanākartṝṇāṃ yantrāṇāṃ svāmināṃ tathā ||18||
bhṛtyānāṃ jāyate hiṃsā tathaiva karmacāriṇām |
evaṃ yantrakṛtāṃ badri pāpabhāgaḥ prajāyate || 1 9||
tena pāpena lipyante nirayān yānti dāruṇān |
mahābhāgavatāścaite jātikarmaparāyaṇāḥ ||4.38.20||
api puṇyamayāḥ sarve tathāpi pāpabhāginaḥ |
asaṃkhyānāṃ tu kīṭānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ nityadā bhavet ||21 ||
yantreṣu yantrakartṝṇāṃ pāpaṃ tvasaṃkhyakaṃ sadā |
āyātyeva tatasteṣāṃ muktistu sārgalā bhavet || 29|
ātatāyimahāpāpaṃ sarvanāśakaraṃ matam |
yantrakārā yantrapāpairlipyante tvātatāyivat |||23||
pāpairvaṃśavināśaśca smṛddhināśo’pi jāyate |
pretā bhavanti mṛtvā te bāndhavān pīḍayantyapi ||24||
evaṃ badrīpriye yantrakārāṇāṃ kālaparyaye |
nayarājaprabhṛtīnāṃ kuṭumbe rājayakṣmakaḥ ||25||
vāsaṃ cakāra rogo’yaṃ kṣīṇatāmanayajjanān |
gomatī tu vicāryetthaṃ bhaktānāṃ rugṇatā katham || 26||
kathaṃ vā bhagavadbhaktau kṣayavāsaḥ pravartate |
ābālavṛddhayoṣādyāḥ kathaṃ rogābhisaṃplutāḥ || 27||
praṣṭavyaṃ vedaviduṣe bhāgyajñāya tu sarvathā |
vicāryetthaṃ yayau vipraṃ nāmnā prabhātabodhinam ||28||
papraccha taṃ tadā devī gomatī rogakāraṇam |
praśnakālaṃ vīkṣya vipro jagāda yantrajaṃ phalam ||29||
yantrajā jīvahiṃsā yā sāpi kartari bhāgataḥ |
saṃkramate tathā nirmātari yojayitaryapi ||4.38.3 0||
vāhayitari patyau ca svāminī kriyayānvite |
nirīkṣake saṃkramate tathā sañcālake’pi ca ||31||
gomati tvatkuṭumbaṃ vai yantranirmāṇakartṛ yat |
tataḥ pāpaṃ tu kīṭādihiṃsāyāḥ kramate sadā || 32||
nistāro’sya prakartavyo’nyathā vaṃśavināśanam |
bhaviṣyati na sandeho yatheṣṭaṃ kuru bhāminī ||33||
śrutvā sā badrike prāha vipraṃ prabhātabodhinam |
prāyaścittaṃ dehi no’tra nistāro yena jāyate ||34||
prabhātabodhastāṃ prāha prathamaṃ tvagharodhanam |
prāyaścittaṃ tato dattaṃ phalaṃ karoti nānyathā ||35 ||
yantrāṇāṃ racanāṃ tyaktvā loṣṭhādīnāṃ tu vikrayam |
krayaṃ vā prāṇayātrārthaṃ khanikhātaṃ karotvapi ||36 ||
ato yantranirmitestu pāpabhāgo hi ruddhyate |
navaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate na jātasya niṣkṛtiṃ kuru ||37||
kuṭumbena sahitā tva tīrthayātrāṃ vidhehi vai |
godāvarīṃ narmadāṃ ca tāpīṃ sābhramatīṃ tathā ||38||
śatruñjayāṃ ca hariṇīṃ bhadrāṃ ca gomatīṃ tataḥ |
svarṇalekhāṃ ca kuṃkumavāpīmaśvasarovaram ||39||
puṣkaraṃ sārasaṃ tīrthaṃ yamīṃ gaṃgāṃ ca pāvanīm |
sarayūṃ gaṇḍakīṃ brahmaputrāṃ tathendradyumnakam ||4.38.40||
tāmraparṇīṃ ca kāverīṃ pampāsaraśca sāgaram |
kṛtvā krameṇa tīrthāni niṣpāpā bhava bhāminī ||41||
pāpakṣayo roganāśo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
śrutvā tu gomatīdevī vicāramakarottadā ||42||
roṃgiṇāṃ śakyamevaitannāsti tīrthapravāsanam |
durlabhaṃ bhramaṇaṃ dīrghaṃ cirakālābhinirvaham ||43||
tasmādanyat pāpanāśakaraṃ darśaya buddhimat |
yasminnanuṣṭhite sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavedapi ||44||
prāyaścittaṃ prajāyeta rājayakṣmavināśanam |
sukhaṃ bhavet kuṭumbasya śrīnāśo na bhavedapi ||45||
śrutvā vipro’tisaralāṃ bhūyaḥphalāṃ tu niṣkṛtim |
jagāda tatra vai yogyāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ mahauṣadhim ||46||
gomati tvaṃ yathāśaktā yathā vikṛtitatparā |
yathāsi vaiṣṇavī tadvad darśayāmi tu niṣkṛtim ||47||
adyārabhya tu satataṃ karotu sādhusevanam |
sakuṭumbā bhāvayuktā sasnehā saṃśayojjhitā ||48||
divyabuddhyā divyadṛṣṭyā divyasevā tu yāvatīm |
prakarotu yathā santaḥ prasannāḥ syustavopari ||49||
dehena manasā vācā karmaṇā cendriyairapi |
sampadā dhanaratnādyairannavastrārpaṇairapi ||4.38.50||
śayyārpaṇopakaraṇairdāsīvad dāsavattathā |
prakāśe vā rahaścāpi pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ||51||
putrībhiśca sutaiścāpi bālairvṛddhaiḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ |
vadhūbhirgṛhadānaiśca gobhiḥ svātmārpaṇairapi ||52||
sevāṃ satāṃ prakurvantu sādhvīnāmapi sarvathā |
ātmanivedanādyaiśca sādhusevā hi bheṣajam ||53 ||
sevayā cānuvṛttyā ca nirāvaraṇayānvaham |
kṛtayā niḥsaṃśayayā prasīdanti hi sādhavaḥ ||54||
prasādapreritā āśīrvādān dadati sādhavaḥ |
dhanavān putravānārogyavān sampatsamedhitaḥ ||55||
sukhavān modavān sarvotsavavān bhava sarvadā |
vighnā yāntu tava dūraṃ śatravo yantu saṃkṣayam ||56||
pāpānāṃ pralayaste’stu puṇyādriste bhavatvapi |
śrīrvarcasv mahāpuṇyamādhivyādhivināśanam ||57||
iṣṭānāṃ saṅgamaścāpyaniṣṭānāṃ saṃkṣayo’stu te |
satāṃ sevāphalaṃ divyaṃ sukhaṃ cātra paratra ca ||||58||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhaktiśca śāśvatī |
sarvanāthe prabhaukṛṣṇe cātmaniveditāstu te ||59||
gṛhe te sādhavaḥ santu vāṭikāyāṃ ca sādhavaḥ |
santaste hṛdaye santu jīvātmanyapi sādhavaḥ ||4.38.60||
dehendriyeṣu santaste pṛṣṭho’gre santu sādhavaḥ |
adho vordhve pārśvabhāge sadā te santu sādhavaḥ ||61||
jāgradbhāve prasvapane suṣuptau santu sādhavaḥ |
yāne pravāsane vāse cāsane śayane sthitau ||62||
jṛṃbhaṇe kṣuvane pramodane ca modane’pi ca |
kriyāyāṃ krīḍane śoke sahagāḥ santu sādhavaḥ ||63||
sahāyā rakṣakāḥ santo bāndhavāḥ santu cānvitāḥ |
yāmyaduḥkhaharāḥ santo daivaduḥkhaharāstathā ||64||
karmanāśakarāḥ santaḥ santu te sukhakāriṇaḥ |
ādhibhautikapīḍānāṃ nāśakāḥ santu sādhavaḥ ||65||
prāṇānāṃ rakṣakāḥ santu santaste bhagavatparāḥ |
iha yātrākarāḥ santaḥ parayātrākarā api ||66||
mahāyātrākarāḥ santaḥ santu te sarvato’nvitāḥ |
evaṃ dvādaśasaṃślokaṃ stotraṃ dāsyanti sādhavaḥ ||67||
yatpāṭhena tathā sevābhiśca rakṣā bhaviṣyati |
śīghramadyasamāramya sādhuśālāṃ suśobhanām ||68||
mandiraṃ śrībālakṛṣṇamūrteḥ prakārayatvapi |
mā ciraṃ tena vighnāste vinaṃkṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||69||
yadyapi tvaṃ mahābhaktā kuṭumbaṃ te ca bhaktimat |
tathāpi sāghusevābhiḥ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ||4.38.70||
yannendro naiva rudro’pi na yamo na ca viśvasṛṭ |
na viṣṇurnaiva kālo’pi na dharmo na vrataṃ tapaḥ ||71 ||
naiva nārāyaṇaścāpi kartuṃ śaknoti durvaham |
tatkartuṃ śaknuvantyeva kṛṣṇādhikā hi sādhavaḥ ||72||
sādhusaṃkalpitaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
kṛṣṇasaṃkalpitaṃ yanna tat syāt sādhuprakalpitam ||73||
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ puṇyaṃ sādhusaṅgo hi puṇyadaḥ |
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyādrayo hi sādhavaḥ ||74||
ānakhādāśikhaṃ santaḥ pāvanā divyavigrahāḥ |
rajo rajo’ṇumātraṃ vai pāvanaṃ sādhuvigrahe ||75||
atha patyau yathā patnyāṃ yathā putre dhane’pi ca |
yathā vadhvāṃ yathā pitroryathā gurau harau yathā ||76||
tathā snehaḥ sadā kāryaḥ satsu sādhvīṣu bhāvataḥ |
śraddhayā sevanaṃ kāryaṃ sarvārthasādhakaṃ tu tat| ||77||
bhojanīyāḥ pūjanīyāstarpaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
modanīyāḥ sevanīyāḥ prasādanīyāḥ sādhavaḥ ||78||
mānanīyā rakṣaṇīyāstoṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
darśanīyāḥ sparśanīyā namanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ||79||
cayanīyā dhāraṇīyā dhyātavyāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā |
sādhūnāṃ tviha satsaṃgāt svargaṃ mokṣaśca śāśvataḥ ||4.38.80||
sādhavaḥ suprasannāśca cintāmaṇaya eva te |
kalpadrumā akṣayabhājanāni sādhavaḥ sadā ||81||
