kāmagāvaḥ sādhavo vai kṛṣṇarūpā hi sādhavaḥ |
teṣāṃ samāgamo mokṣaḥ satsaṃgo bhavapārakṛt ||82||
taṃ samācara yatsaṃgaṃ roganāśaṃ prayāhi ca |
svasti te’stu nīrugṇatvaṃ dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ ca te’stvapi ||83||
ityuktā badrike devīgomatī vipramuttamam |
prapūjya svagṛhaṃ gatvā śrāvayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ||84||
patiṃ pumān kuṭumbaṃ ca tataḥ sarve samāhitāḥ |
gṛhamekaṃ sādhuśālātmakaṃ pṛthak pracakrire ||85||
tatra santaḥ samāyānti tān sevante’tibhāvataḥ |
gomatyādyā annavastradhanārpaṇopavastubhiḥ ||86||
nārāyaṇasvarūpān vai sādhūn matvā prapāvanān |
sevante sma kuṭumbādyā yathoktabhāvakarmabhiḥ ||87||
athāśīrvādamālabdhvā satāṃ te pāvanāstathā |
prabhavanti śanai rogavināśārambharohitāḥ ||88||
satāṃ hṛdaye bhagavānanādinidhanaḥ prabhuḥ |
jñātvā sevāṃ paraṃ bhāvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||89||
kṛṣṇāyanābhidhānaḥ sa sādhurbhūtvā tathā śriyam |
sādhvīṃ kṛtvā yayau tasyā nagaraṃ ca gṛhaṃ tataḥ ||4.38.90||
sādhuśālāsthale gatvā gomatyādibhirādṛtaḥ |
kṛṣṇāyanaḥ kṛtapūjāsvāgataḥ samuvāsa ha ||9 1||
tayoḥ sevā bahudhā vai kuṭumbena kṛtā tadā |
dhanaiścitrairvarṣmabhiśca bhojanādyaiḥ samarcanaiḥ ||92||
yathā yathā hariścaicchat tathā tathā dadustu te |
prasanno bhagavān jātaḥ sevayā narayoṣitām ||93||
śayane bhojane yāne sarvathā sevitaḥ prabhuḥ |
varadānāya tāṃ nārīṃ prairayat sāpi tatkṣaṇam ||94||
nirogārthaṃ sampadarthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ samayācata |
satāṃ sevārthamevāpi hareryogārthamityapi ||95||
hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ sarvaṃ te samprajāyatām |
hareḥ pādāṅguṣṭhavāri pītvā sarve hi pāvanāḥ ||96||
tadā jātā atha rogo rājayakṣmā tu mūrtimān |
nirgataḥ sahasā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇājñayā drutam ||97||
natvā yayau sa kailāsaṃ kuṭumbaṃ rogavarjitam |
jātaṃ praphullahṛdayaṃ modānanaṃ śubhāśrayam ||98||
atha kṛṣṇāyanaḥ kṛṣṇastebhyo mantraṃ dadau nijam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||99||
mūrtiṃ nijāṃ dadau kārṣṇāyanīkṛṣṇāyanātmikām|
darśanaṃ pradadau divyaṃ caturbhujaṃ narāyaṇam || 4.38.100||
vīkṣya śrīkāntadeveśaṃ paramātmānamacyutam |
prasannāste kṛtakṛtyā jātā gomatikājanāḥ || 101 ||
niṣpāpāḥ puṇyapuñjāste divyā mokṣābhiyoginaḥ |
sarve nemuḥ pupūjuśca hareḥ pādajalaṃ papuḥ || 1 02||
prasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsurarcayāmāsuracyutam |
śriyāḥ sādhvyaḥ kanyakādyāḥ sarvāḥ striyo’rhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ || 103||
evaṃ badrīpriye teṣāṃ nīrogitvaṃ vidhāya saḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo drutaṃ tiro’bhavat || 1 04||
atha te’pi ca saṃbhūya tīrthārthaṃ nirgatāstataḥ |
viṃśe’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇajayantikotsave || 1 05||
āyayustīrthayātrāyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovaram |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ lomaśasyāśrayaṃ śubham ||1 06||
snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇavallabham priyam |
kṛṣṇāyanaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣya prapūjya mādhavam || 1 07||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prasevya bhāvataḥ |
nyūṣustatraivākṣarākhye kṣetre tvājīvanaṃ tataḥ || 108||
hareḥ padāśraye sarve yantrakārā haripriyāḥ |
divyadehā abhavaṃśca jīvanmuktāḥ prabhupriyāḥ ||1 09||
harikṛṣṇasya vacane sthitāḥ sarve sadā tataḥ |
haryājñayā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ vimānasaṃsthitāḥ || 4.38.11 0||
sarve satāṃ vimānairvai prāpuḥ kṛṣṇaparāspadam |
ityevaṃ badrike devi bhagavām̐stānatārayat || 11 1||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanāt pāpanāśanam |
svargaṃ mokṣo bhavedeva prabhukṛṣṇabalād drutam || 1 12||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne yantrakartryā gomatīnāmnyā śūdrāyāḥ sakuṭumbāyāḥ
kṣayarogaḥ satāṃ sevayā sādhurūpeṇa bhagavatprāptyā roganāśo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||

<4.39>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ dhūrtāvimokṣiṇīm |
dhutārapuravāstavyā cāmaṭhājātijā hyapi || 1 ||
nārāyaṇaparā nārī nāmnābhūt kanakāṃgadā |
patiputravatī putrīmatī bhrātṛkuṭumbinī || 2 ||
nagarābhyāśavāsā ca śakaṭacchāyavartinī |
vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca vatsānāṃ krayavikrayakāriṇī || 3 ||
jīrṇopakaraṇānāṃ ca saṃskāroddhāratatparā |
krayavikrayakāryāḍhyā tathā nirvāhayoginī || 4 ||
harerbhaktāpi vai jātisvabhāvā dhūrtatānvitā |
anṛtakapaṭāsatyaśāṭhyādyuktā hi vartate || 5 ||
vāṇyāṃ kriyāyāṃ manasi pratāraṇaparāyaṇā |
yathākathañcid vyāmohya pradarśyāpi phalaṃ bahu || 6 ||
viśvāsaṃ bahudhotpādya karoti vañcanāṃ tataḥ |
labdhaṃ vañcanayā yattaddhanaṃ raupyaṃ ca kāñcanam || 7 ||
śīghraṃ nītvā prayātyeva grāmāntaramanoyutā |
anasā saumabhāgeṣu kṣetreṣu vāṭikāsvapi || 8 ||
annānāṃ haraṇaṃ cauryaṃ karoti karmasandhinī |
evaṃvidhāpi mārgeṣu catuḥsaṃgeṣu vai niśi || 9 ||
śakaṭacchāyayā kālaṃ niryāpayati sīmani |
tatra kaścit samāyācced bhikṣuko bhikṣukī tu vā || 4.39.1 0||
tasmai datvā yathāyogyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhuṃkte tatastu sā |
evamabhyāgataparā bhikṣuke kṛṣṇamāninī || 1 1||
nārāyaṇaṃ bhikṣukaṃ tu matvārhaṇāṃ karotyapi |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ rātrau divā dehaprasevanam ||12||
jalapuṣpādyarpaṇaṃ ca kṛtvā bhuṃkte tataḥ param |
evaṃ sevāparā cāste niyame bhikṣukārcane || 1 3||
vartamānā bhikṣukāya nirdaṃbhā dhūrtatāṃ nijām |
nivedayati vijñā sā niṣpāpatvāya sarvathā ||14||
sā tu jānāti guruto nāmnā cārvaṃkarādhanāt |
sādhave nijakṛtyaṃ vai nivedanīyamādarāt ||15||
satyaṃ vācyaṃ yacca tacca guhyaṃ vāpi prakāśajam |
anyāyyaṃ vā nyāyayuktaṃ pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ pratāraṇām ||16||
dhūrtatā śubhatā cāpyaniṣṭatā kleśatā tathā |
cauryaṃ cāpaharaṇaṃ ca vācyaṃ śrīgurave sadā || 17||
garhitaṃ vā praśastaṃ vā vācyaṃ cāvācyamityapi |
sarvaṃ śrīgurave nivedanīyaṃ śuddhihetave ||18||
ityevaṃ jāyate karturniṣpāpatvaṃ pavitratā |
bandhanaṃ jāyate naiva pāpaphalaṃ na jāyate ||1 9||
upārjitāt tathā nyāyānyāyābhyāmapi sarvadā |
dātavyaṃ gurave cābhyāgatāya bhikṣukāya ca ||4.39.20||
nirdoṣatvaṃ jāyate ca tena pāpaṃ vyapohati |
aniveditabhoktaiva pāpena parilipyate ||21 ||
niveditānnabhoktā tu pāpena nopalipyate |
udarārthaṃ kuṭumbārthaṃ dasyūnāṃ dasyukarmasu ||22||
dūṣaṇaṃ jāyate naiva jātaṃ ced gurave’rpaṇāt |
nirdoṣaṃ jāyate tasmād guruḥ sevyaḥ pramokṣadaḥ ||23||
gurureva parabrahma gurureva janārdanaḥ |
gurureva vidhātā ca gurureva parāgatiḥ ||24||
gururevānalaḥ sūryo gurureva prakāśadaḥ |
gurureva paraṃ puṇyaṃ gururdharmaḥ sukhaṃ dhanam ||25||
guruḥ svargaṃ gururviṣṇurguruḥ śaṃbhurgururvratam |
gurvarpaṇaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ tasmācchrīgurave’rpayet ||26||
anyatra vai kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gurvegre saṃvinaśyati |
gurau pāpaṃ na kartavyaṃ gururvai paramā gatiḥ ||27||
na vai nārāyaṇo bhūmau śaṅkhadhārī milatyapi |
gururnārāyaṇaḥ satyadhārī milati bhūtale ||28||
satāṃ samāgamāt tena niṣpāpatā prajāyate |
santaḥ śrīguravastasmāt sevanīyā viśuddhaye ||29||
aśuddhaḥ khaluḥ saṃsāraḥ śuddhastatra gururhariḥ |
aśuddhirlīyate sarvā guroryogena daihikī ||4.39.30||
mānasī līyate cāpyaśuddhirbhaktyā guroḥ sadā |
gurornāmasmaraṇena cātmā pāvanatāṃ vrajet ||3 1 ||
gurave tvarpaṇāt sarvavastūnāṃ syāt pavitratā |
narā nāryaḥ praśuddhyanti guruyogena bhūtale ||32||
gurormūrtirharermūtiḥ pāvanī pāpināmiha |
tasmāt satsaṃgatiḥ kāryā pāpibhiḥ pāpahānaye ||33||
evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ gurutaḥ sā hyavāpa tu |
tena sādhujanasevāṃ karoti daṃbhavarjitā ||34||
samastaṃ tatkuṭumbaṃ vai satāṃ karoti sevanam |
cārvaṃkarādhanaḥ sādhurdadau tasyai manuṃ hareḥ ||35||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
dadau mūrtiṃ dadau jñānaṃ gurusevātmakaṃ tathā ||36||
evaṃ gurvājñayā nityaṃ vartate kanakāṃgadā |
gurusevāparā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaparānvaham ||37||
dhūrtatāpāpanāśārthaṃ sevate śrīhariṃ gurum |
bhāvena nityamevaiṣā kṣudhāṃ tṛṣā ca sevate ||38||
akṛtvā sā guroḥ pūjāṃ cānivedyānnamityapi |
vāri puṣpaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ na bhuṃkte sā kvacit khalu ||39||
evaṃ niyamamāsādya vartate gurutatparā |
athaikadā tu saptāhaṃ gururvanāntaraṃ yayau ||4.39.40||
abhyāgataśca vā sādhuḥ kaścid gṛhaṃ ca nāgataḥ |
hariṃ prapūjya sā sādhvī vāṭaṃ paśyati cotsukā ||41 ||
kṣudhinā tṛṣitā rātrindivaṃ paśyati vāṭinam |
saptāhaṃ nāgataḥ sādhurabhyāgato’pi nāgataḥ ||42||
adattvā sādhave sādhvī na bhuṃkte’nnaṃ prasādajam |
anyānyasya tu kā vārtā badrike dṛḍhabhaktigā ||43||
nāpi papau ca sā vāri tvanivedya hi sādhave |
tadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrī kṛṣṇagopajaḥ ||44||
antaryāmī sarvavijñaḥ sādhurbhūtvā samāyayau |
dhṛtakāṣāyavasano dhṛtakanthākamaṇḍaluḥ ||45||
dhṛtapāvaṭikākukṣirdhṛtabhasmādijolikaḥ |
nārāyaṇahare viṣṇo kṛṣṇaśrībhagavāniti ||46||
raṭannuccairvadad śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo jayatyapi |
hare kṛṣṇa prabhokṛṣṇa padmāvatīpate prabho ||47||
dharminiyamirakṣaka tvaṃ bhakṣarakṣakaraprabho |
evaṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ japan śakaṭīmāyayau ||48||
āsanaṃ pāvaṭīṃ jolīṃ nyasya bhūmau hare hare |
kathayitvā niṣasāda jayo bhavatu cakriṇaḥ ||49||
sukhinī syāḥ kānakāṃgi cārvaṃkarādhano’pi ca |
sukhinaste kuṭumbaṃ ca putrāḥ putryo bhavantvapi ||4.39.50||
ityevaṃ samacittaśca hyāśīrvādaparāyaṇaḥ |
sādhurayaṃ daivayogādāgato madgṛhaṃ tviti ||51 ||
matvotthāya druta sādhvī kanakāṃgī śubhāsanam |
dadau natvā jalaṃ śuddhaṃ dadau phalāni vai tadā ||52||
annaṃ navaṃ dadau tasmai pavanaṃ vyajanena ca |
puṣpāṇi tulasīpatrāṇyapi dadau tu bhāvataḥ ||53||
bhojanaṃ kuru sādho tvaṃ madhuparkaṃ gṛhāṇa ca |
snānamācamanaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ vāri gṛhāṇa ca ||54||
āśīrvādaṃ dehi sādho pāpaṃ me nāśamāpnuyāt |
mama bhāgyavaśāt prāpto nārāyaṇasvarūpavān ||55||
vāsaṃ gṛhe mama sādho kuru sevāṃ gṛhāṇa ca |
oṃ namo’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya sādhave |||56||
yogine sarvavijñāya bhaktarakṣākarāya ca |
adhamoddhāraṇakartre dīnānāthadayālaye ||57||
namaḥ sādhusvarūpāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ |
kaṃbharānandabālāya gopālabālakāya te |||68||
namo rādhāvihārāya kamalāpataye namaḥ |
namo’ntaryāmiṇe bhaktabhāvukāya sate namaḥ ||99||
antarātmā paramātmā prasanno bhava sarvadā |
sādhusevā tava sevā nārāyaṇa gṛhāṇa tām ||4.39.60||
ityevaṃ bhāvabhinnā sā dadau tat kanakāṃgadā |
putrāḥ putryaḥ samastāstā daduryatheṣṭavastukam ||61 ||
cārvaṃkarādhanaścāpi sādhusevāṃ tadākarot |
miṣṭavāṇyā caraṇayoḥ saṃvāhanaṃ vyadhānmudā ||62||
evaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ vai cāmaṭhājātijaṃ tadā |
sevāparāyaṇaṃ jātaṃ saptāhānaśanānvitam ||63||
sādhuṃ saṃbhojayitvaiva pāyayitvā jalaṃ tathā |
sevayitvā yathāyogyamājñayā ca tataḥ param ||64||
prasādānnaṃ jalaṃ sarve jagṛhurbhāvataḥ khalu |
śayane cāpi sarve te cakruḥ sādhoḥ prasevanam ||65||
āprātaḥ sevanaṃ cakruḥ pādasaṃvāhanādikam |
prātaḥ sādhustataḥ prāha vara vṛṇuta cāmaṭhāḥ ||66||
prasanno’smi niyamena bhaktyā satāṃ prasevayā |
bhābenāhaṃ prasanno’smi gaṇayāmi na dūṣaṇam ||67||
mahāpāpātipāpāni śāṭhyāni vividhānyapi |
pratāraṇāni sarvāṇi nāśayāmi kṛpāvaśaḥ ||68||
dhūrtatāṃ sarvathā cāpi viśvāsaghātanaṃ hyapi |
cauryapāpaṃ tathā dravyāpaharaṇodbhavaṃ tvagham ||69||
sarvaṃ prasannabhāvo’haṃ nāśayāmi kṛpāvaśaḥ |
uktvetthaṃ sādhurūpo’pi mūrtirūpo’bhavat kṣaṇam ||4.39.70||
nārāyaṇasvarūpaśca caturbhujo’bhavat kṣaṇam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntavallabhaḥ |||71|||
śrīpriyāmādhavīrādhāmāṇikīlalitāpatiḥ |
abhavattūrṇamevāsau sarvadivyavibhūṣaṇaḥ |||72||
divyatejo’bhisaṃvyāpto divyasaundaryabhājanaḥ |
atha tūrṇaṃ sampradarśya rūpaṃ divyamanoharam ||73||
tiro’bhavattato mūrtau tataḥ sādhusvarūpavān |
vyadṛśyata svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛpāvaśaḥ ||74||
atha sarve kṣaṇaṃ mugdhā niṣpāpā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ |
jātā bhaktivaśāḥ kṛṣṇavaśā gadgadasusvarāḥ ||75||
bhavapāraṃ samastāste hyayācan duḥkhanāśanam |
śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ muktimayācan tvakṣare pade ||76||
dhūtapāpāni sarvāṇi kṣamāpayeti cārthayan |
pāpajāteḥ samuddhāraṃ kuru kṛṣṇeti cārthayan ||77||
atha badrīpriye svāmī svayaṃ śrīharivallabhaḥ |
pādajalaṃ pāyayitvā divyadehān vyadhāddhi tān |||78|||
vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ tatra divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsinām |
pārṣadānāṃ tatra sarve’dhyarohan pramudānvitāḥ ||79||
yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ te vai prāpya vaikuṇṭhamuttamam |
śrīhareḥ pādavāsaṃ te prāpurbhaktyātibhāvayā ||4.39.8 0||
sādhurūpo haristatra tūrṇaṃ tirobhavat kṣaṇāt |
evaṃ śrībadrike bhaktā kanakāṃgī tu cāmaṭhī ||8 1 ||
sakuṭumbā yayau mokṣaṃ dhūrtāpi bhaktipāvanā |
śravaṇātpaṭhanādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā |||82||
pāpanāśo bhaveccāpi svargarddhiḥ saṃbhavedapi |
sādhusevāphalaṃ sākṣāt kṛṣṇaprāptirbhavedapi ||83||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne cāmaṭhījātīyāyāḥ kanakāṃgadāyāḥ sakuṭumbāyāḥ
sādhusamāgamena paramabhaktyā sādhurūpeṇa bhagavatprāptimokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||

<4.40>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tathaiva pāvanīṃ kathām |
dyūtakārastriyā nāmnā bhāṇavāṇītiyoṣitaḥ || 1 ||
sindhunadyāstaṭe ramye śarkarāpattane purā |
dyūtajñavaṃśajā lokā nyavasan vai narāḥ striyaḥ || 2 ||
dyūtaṃ jānanti bahudhā śaṃkāranagare tathā |
dyūte prāyo vijayaṃ vai striyo yānti na saṃśaya || 3 ||
evaṃvidhāḥ prajāḥ sindhe deśe dyūtaparāyaṇāḥ |
rājāpi rājalokāśca rājabhṛtyāstathāvidhāḥ || 4 ||
āsan dyūtakalāvijñāḥ prajāśca prāyaśastathā |
nirdhanā dhanavantaśca dyūte sīdanti vai muhuḥ || 5 ||
rājā sindhupradeśānāṃ nāmnā rāyaharīti vai |
dyūtotsavān prativarṣaṃ karotyāmantritairnṛpaiḥ || 6 ||
āyānti dyūtavijñāśca nṛpā rāṣṭrāntarodbhavāḥ |
dīvyanti bahuratnādyairharanti hārayantyapi || 7 ||
jayanti pracuraṃ lābhaṃ rājyaṃ tadāpnuvanti ca |
arāṣṭrāśca prajāyante rāṣṭrādhipāstadā nṛpāḥ || 8 ||
viparītāśca jāyante dyūtakarmābhibhūtinaḥ |
dyūtajñeṣu tadā kāle bhāṇavāṇītibhāminī || 9 ||
prasiddhābhūjjaye dhrauvye yatrasthā tatra vai jayaḥ |
yasyārthe sā pratinidhirbhūtvā dyūte niṣīdati || 4.40.1 0||
tasya jayo bhavatyeva pāśaiḥ samanukūlagaiḥ |
bahūnāṃ dyūtasamaye karoti dhanahīnatām || 11 ||
śarkarānagareśastāṃ bhāṇavāṇīṃ rarakṣa ha |
nijālaye sadā dyūtadevanārthaṃ tu mānavaḥ || 12|
saudhabhojanapānādyairvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
udyānayānavāhādyairdāsadāsībhirādṛtām || 1 3||
rājñīmiva nṛpo nityaṃ manyate tāṃ kṛtādarām |
jātyā ca kṣatriyāṃ nimnakṣatragṛhodbhavāmapi || 14||
sājātyena ca lābhena rājñīmiva sa manyate |
sāpi mānaṃ vihāyaiva dāsīva nṛpatiṃ prati || 15||
prati rājñīṃ kiṃkarīva vartate guṇaśālinī |
ataḥ prasādapātraṃ sā rājñyā rājñaśca bhāminī || 16||
rājaśayyāṃ sevate’pi patiputrādimatyapi |
rāyaharirnṛpastasyā guṇaṃ lābhaṃ vicārya ca || 17||
svīyāṃ matvā sevate’pi bhujiṣyāmuttamāmiva |
evaṃ rājāśrayaṃ prāpyaidhitā kīrtyā ca sampadā || 18||
sakuṭumbā nṛpasaudhe tato vāsaṃ vyadhānmudā |
rājyalābhaṃ pragṛhṇāti bhuṃkte sukhaṃ navaṃ navam || 19||
athaikadā rāyaharirnṛpaḥ śrīśarkarādhipaḥ |
āhvayāmāsa rājānaṃ hayodarādhipaṃ śubham ||4.40.20 ||
koṭirāyābhidhaṃ dyūte devanārthaṃ nijālaye |
koṭirāyo’pi sahasā śrutvā dyūtādyamantraṇam ||21||
saharṣaṃ tvājagāmāpi rāyaharipramandiram |
dyūtadevanamevāpi samāje sarvaśobhane ||22||
yojayāmāsa nṛpatiḥ rāyahariḥ samutsukaḥ |
rāyahareḥ pratinidhirbhāṇavāṇī tadābhavat ||23||
devane sā sthitā pūrvaṃ pāśān jagrāha bhāminī |
tadānye’pi ca rājanyā amātyāḥ śreṣṭhino’pi ca ||24||
mahāsanāni sadasi bhejire dyūtavīkṣakāḥ |
prāvartata tato dyūtaṃ parasparāpahārakam ||25||
koṭirāyastataḥ prāha hāro’yaṃ maṇiśobhitaḥ |
kānakaḥ kaṇṭhabhūṣā me dhanaṃ paṇe’tra yojitam ||26|||
kaste’tra sadṛśaḥ pratipaṇo’sti paṭṭake kuru |
rāyaharistadovāca maṇyo me’tra santi ye ||27||
hārāścāpi dhanaṃ cāpi yojitaṃ vijayasva tat |
tataḥ sākṣān pracikṣepa bhāṇavāṇī durodare ||28||
koṭirāya jitaṃ tvetat prasannā satyabhāṣata |
koṭirāyastadā tatra niṣkasahasraśobhanām ||29||
mañjūṣāṃ sthāpayāmāsa prāha jayasva me dhanam |
koṭirāya jitaṃ tvetad bhāṇavāṇī hyabhāṣata ||4.40.30||
atha lakṣaṃ suvarṇānāṃ raupyāṇāṃ daśalakṣakam |
sthāpayāmāsa ca koṭirāyaḥ prasannamānasaḥ ||31||
bhāṇavāṇī pracikṣepa pāśān jitamabhāṣata |
atha ratnānyuttamāni mauktikānyuttamānyapi ||32||
paṇe mumoca ca koṭirāyaḥ koṭisamāni vai |
koṭimūlyān hīrakām̐śca paṇe mumoca sa nṛpaḥ ||33||
bhāṇavāṇī nyasya pāśān jitamityabhyabhāṣata |
atha rājā koṭirāyaḥ svabhūṣāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ||34||
ratnahīrakanaddhāśca koṭyarbudādimūlyakāḥ |
asthāpayat paṇe tatra maṇīnasaṃkhyamūlyakān ||35||
bhāṇavāṇyāḥ prasaṃkṣiptāḥ pāśā devāt parāṅmukhāḥ |
koṭirāyajayārthaṃ vai patitā harṣamuttamam ||36||
sabhāyā janayāmāsurmahāścaryamatarkitam |
bhāṇavāṇī gatā parājayaṃ kalāvatī hyapi ||37||
rājā rāyahariryāvajjitavān dhanamuttamam |
tat sarvaṃ ca svīyamanyat sarvaṃ paṇe tu maṇḍitam ||38||
parājitavān saṃśokaṃ prāptavān kṣaṇamityapi |
tataḥ sa nijaratnāni maṇīṃśca mauktikānyapi ||39||
hīrakān svarṇabhūṣāśca mañjūṣā ratnanirmitāḥ |
rathaṃ svarṇamayaṃ divyaṃ caturhastisamanvitam ||4.40.40||
glahe saṃsthāpya covāca dīvyabhyanena vai tvayā |
śrutvā koṭirayaścāpi paṇe sābhyadhanaṃ dadhau ||41 ||
koṭirāyastataḥ pāśān mumoca vijayaṃ gataḥ |
atha rāyaharistatra śataṃ dāsī surūpiṇīḥ ||42||
sarvābharaṇasaṃśobhāḥ paṇo’maṇḍayadutsukaḥ |
koṭirayo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata ||43||
atha rāyaharistatra sahasraṃ dāsyakarmiṇaḥ |
sarvābharaṇayuktāṃśca glahe’maṇḍayadutsukaḥ ||44||
koṭirayo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata |
atha rāyaharirnāgān sahasrasaṃkhyakottamān ||45||
svarṇakūthāmbālikāḍhyān hemamālān sudantinaḥ |
paṇe’nyasattathā hastinikāsahasramityapi ||46||
koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata |
atha rāyahariḥ svarṇarathān sahasrasaṃkhyakān ||47||
svarṇadaṇḍān svarṇaratnamaṇyāḍhyān dantiyojitān |
glahe’maṇḍapadevāpi sotsāhaḥ svarṇacakrakān ||48||
koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata |
atha rāyaharistatra vājinaścitracarmiṇaḥ ||49||
lakṣaṃ vai saindhavām̐statra glahe’maṇḍayadutsukaḥ |
koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata ||4.40.50|
atha rāyaharistatra naravāhanakānyapi |
kānakāni śibikāśca svarṇahīrakanirmitāḥ ||5 1 ||
lakṣaṃ glahe’maṇḍayadvai chatracāmaraśobhitāḥ |
koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitamityabhyabhāṣata ||52||
atha rāyaharistatra daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakān |
yoddhṝn śastrānvitān svarṇavarmaveṣasamanvitān ||53||
glahe’maṇḍayadevāpi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitān |
koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhyabhāṣata |||54||
atha rāyaharistatra kośān daśa suvarṇakaiḥ |
saṃbhṛtān rājyasarvasvānamaṇḍayadrūpavyarthai ||55||
koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitā ityabhya|
atha rāyahariḥ rājyamandirāṇi mahānti ca ||56||
saudhān śaśāṃkadhavalān glahe’bhyamaṇḍayattadā |
koṭirāyo nyasya pāśān jitānītyabhyabhāṣata ||57|||
atha rāyahariḥ rājyaṃ samastaṃ cāpyamaṇḍayat |
anena mama rājyena dīvyāmyadya tvayā saha ||58||
tvayā pratiglahe kiṃ vā nyasyate vada me drutam |
ityuktaḥ sahasā koṭirāyo rājyamamaṇḍayat ||59||
atha pāśān mumocāpi parāvṛttiṃ tadā hyaguḥ |
parājayaṃ dattavantaḥ pāśā koṭirayāya vai ||4.40.60||
rāyaharirjayaṃ labdhvā sabhāvandyo babhūva ha |
asthāpayad glahe tatra bhāryāṃ nijāṃ dineśvarīm ||61 ||
koṭirāyaṃ tathā prāha glahe kiṃ sthāpyate tvayā |
koṭirāyo nijāṃ patnīṃ candreśvarīmamaṇḍayat ||62||
bhāṇavāṇī tataḥ pāśān pracikṣepa kalānvitā |
nikṛtyāha jitā rājñī śrīrāyahariṇā tviha ||63||
sabhāyāṃ prāsarat śokaḥ koṭirāyo vibhāryakaḥ |
rājyahīnaḥ kṛtaścātra bhāṇavāṇyā glahe’ntime ||64||
candreśvarī tadā pātivratyadharmaparāyaṇā |
bhāṇavāṇīṃ śaśāpaiva parahastāghaduḥkhitā ||65||
galatkuṣṭhā bhavaśīghraṃ vicittā durbhagā tathā |
kṣayarogavatī cāpi yonirugṇā sadā bhava ||66||
unmattā śūkarītulyā bhava viṣṭhādanī sadā |
anena varṣmaṇā duṣṭe rājñā samaṃ tu rākṣasī ||67||
bhava rāyahariṇaiva sākaṃ duṣṭavane’niśam |
evaṃ śaptā drutaṃ tatra sabhāyāṃ bhāṇavāṇikā ||68||
rājā rāyahariścāpi tathābhāvamavāpatuḥ |
utthāyotthāya sahasākūrdayatāmubhau tadā ||69||
nagnau bhūtvā nijadantānadarśayatāmudvratau |
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā samājastau śokaparo’bhavat tadā ||4.40.70||
rājyajaye’pi tu buddheḥ parājaye nu kiṃ kṛtam |
dravyajaye’pi lajjāyā vigame’pi nu kiṃ kṛtam ||71||
sarvajaye’pi tu duḥkhājaye tatra nu kiṃ kṛtam |
nārījaye’pi tadvākyājaye tatra nu kiṃ kṛtam ||72||
arthajaye’pi dharmasyājaye tatra nu kiṃ kṛtam |
evaṃ tatra samājo vai tayoḥ kṛte tvabhāṣata ||73||
pativratāyāḥ śāpo’tra bhāṇavāṇyā jito nahi |
jito rājā jitā rājñī jitaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ gṛham ||74||
rājñyātmā na jitastatra sarvaṃ jitaṃ tu niṣphalam |
dineśvarī tadā rājñī prārthayaccandrikeśvarīm ||75||
mātaḥ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ yad glahe’tra pramaṇḍitam |
svāminā te tavaivāstu patirme svasthatāmiyāt ||76||
bhāṇavāṇī svasthacittā bhavatvatra sukhānvitā |
kṛpāṃ kuru mahārājñi dāsyahaṃ te vadāmi vai ||77||
ityuktvā caraṇau dhṛtvā sā ruroda kṣaṇaṃ tadā |
satī candreśvarīṃ prāha śṛṇu tvaṃ hitamuttamam ||78||
durodaraṃ tvasya nāma duṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tadātmanām |
anyatarasya vā tvanyatamasya sarvanāśakam ||79||
āyatiṃ sāmpratabhāvaṃ vināśayati cobhayam |
akṣāḥ kṣayakarā loke mumūrṣūṇāṃ nipātinaḥ ||4.40.80||
satṛṣṇāśca madāndhāśca hyapariśramasampadaḥ |
rājāno naiva jānanti kāṃ daśāṃ prāpnumo glahe ||8 1 ||
ātmalābhaḥ paro lābho lābhaśca paramātmanaḥ |
alābho rājyalābhādiścāsthiraḥ sarvaduḥkhakṛt ||82||
bhāṇavāṇī dyūtapāṇiḥ paranāśavināśinī |
svasyā nāśakarī cāpi rājño nāśavidhāyinī ||83||
akṣairanakṣitulyaiḥ sā sarvasvaṃ harate sadā |
sarvasvajīvikāhantrī mahāpāpaprayogiṇī ||84||
bhuṃkte pāpaphalaṃ tvadya śāpo nimittamātrakam |
rājāpi dyūtinīsaṅgī phalaṃ bhuṃkte svakarmajam ||88||
śāpo me na nivṛttaḥ syāt kintu rājyaṃ patirmama |
sarvaṃ kuryācchanaiḥ svāsthyaṃ patyuste saṃbhaviṣyati ||86||
rājyaṃ tato’rdhabhāgena svāminaste bhaviṣyati |
tvaṃ svasā me na vai dāsī prasannāsmi sukhaṃ bhavet ||87||
ityuktā sā tathā mene sarvaṃ rājyaṃ satīkare |
dadau dīneśvarī devī patyurhitāya sarvathā ||88||
candreśvarī satī dineśvarīṃ mene’tibhāvataḥ |
candreśvaryāḥ patiḥ koṭirāyo mene nṛpaṃ bahu ||89||
bahubhāvena satataṃ kurvan rājyaṃ samastakam |
rāyahariṃ samaicchat sa śīghraṃ tu sukhinaṃ sadā ||4.40.90||
śāpanivāraṇaṃ svāsthyaṃ tvaritaṃ tu yathā bhavet |
tathopāyān samapṛcchad daivibhyaste’vadam̐stataḥ ||9 1 ||
satāṃ sevāsamaṃ nāsti sādhanaṃ duḥkhavārakam |
sādhavaḥ khalu saṃpūjyāḥ smartavyā vipadāṃ harāḥ ||92||
toṣaṇīyāḥ sarvadānairvighnānāṃ nāśakāriṇaḥ |
sarvasaubhāgyadāścāpi bhāgyottamatvakāriṇaḥ ||93||
satsaṃgaḥ sarvadā kāryaḥ sādhusaṃgapradaḥ śubhaḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā yā divyāsti bhūtale ||94||
tatkathāvācanaṃ varṣaparyantaṃ yojayatviha |
tatrāmantraṇamāsādya tvāyāsyanti hi sādhavaḥ ||95||
sādhvyo’pi yoginaścāpi mahāśīrvādayojinaḥ |
teṣāṃ kṛpāṃśataḥ sarvaṃ svāsthyaṃ suṣṭhu bhaviṣyati ||96||
iti daivijanairukte koṭirāyo nṛpastataḥ |
kārayāmāsa vai śreṣṭhaṃ sabhāmaṇḍapamuttamam ||97||
viṣṇumūrtiṃ śriyā yuktāṃ svarṇamayīṃ suśobhanām |
vedikāṃ homalābhārthaṃ kārayāmāsa cottamām ||98||
rasaśālā vāsaśālāḥ kathāśālāṃ vyadhāttadā |
samāhvayat saṃhitājñān tvaśvapaṭṭasarovarāt ||99||
vimānenāyayuḥ santaḥ saṃhitājñāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ |
saurāṣṭratīrtharūpāste pāvanāḥ pāvakā iva || 4.40.10 0||
avaterurmaṇḍapāgre divyadṛṣṭyā vimāninaḥ |
jayakāraṃ prakurvantaḥ śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ || 101 ||
sindhutulyā saṃhitāpi lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidhā |
pañcaviṃśatisāhasrādhikalakṣābhisaṃkhyayā || 10 2||
ślokānāṃ rājamānā sā sādhubhiḥ saha cāyayau |
lakṣmītulyā svarūpeṇātmanā sarasvatīsamā || 1 03||
vijñānena samā vaidaiścamatkāre ramāsamā |
mokṣaṇe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyā suśobhanā || 1 04||
śaitye prabhānvitā tyāge pārvatīśāsamā śubhā |
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā puruṣārthasamanvitā || 1 05||
āyayau sā vimānena śreyase sarvadehinām |
badrike yatra santo me tatrāhaṃ sādhuvallabhaḥ || 1 06||
tatra lakṣmīḥ saṃhitā ca lalitā maṃjulā jayā |
suguṇā haṃsikā rādhā virājante na saṃśayaḥ || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sindhunadīpradeśānāṃ nṛpayordyūtakhelane sarvasvāpaharaṇe pativratāyāḥ śāpena unmattatāṃ gatayorbhāṇavāṇīrāyaharinṛpayoḥ śreyase śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāprastāve’śvapaṭṭasarovarāt sādhūnāmāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||

<4.41>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye tatra śarkarākhye supattane |
rāyaharermandire tu mahodyānasumaṇḍite || 1 ||
kathāśālāsthale pārāyaṇaṃ vatsaravartanam |
koṭirāyo nṛpo rāyahareḥ śreyo’bhilabdhaye || 2 ||
yojayāmāsa vai sa māse tvāṣāḍhaikādaśīdine |
āditaścāhvayāmāsa dūtaiḥ sādhūm̐śca bhūsurān || 3 ||
vyāsān prapāṭhakām̐ścāpi jāpakām̐śca sahasraśaḥ |
āyayuḥ sarvataḥ santo viprāḥ sādhvyaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ || 4 ||
svaprakāśo hi bhagavān mukhyavaktābhavattadā |
lomaśaśca munistatra guruḥ pūjākaro’bhavat || 5 ||
anye saurāṣṭradeśīyā ājanābhāśca pūrvajāḥ |
prācīnabrahmabhūmisthā rāśiyānodbhavāstathā || 6 ||
parīpradeśajāścāpi tathāmarīpradeśajāḥ |
abriktādipradeśotthāḥ santo viprāḥ samāyayuḥ || 7 ||
uṣṭrapradeśajātāścāpyārārtrikotthāśca sādhavaḥ |
dvīpopadvīpajāścādrivanāraṇyasamudrajāḥ || 8 ||
saṃhitārasavettāraḥ santastatra samāyayuḥ |
sādhvyaśca sāṃkhyayoginyo muktānikāḥ samāyayuḥ || 9 ||
ṛṣayo munayo viprā vidvāṃsastatra cāyayuḥ |
āmantritāḥ sarvabhuvāṃ vaiṣṇavā lakṣakoṭayaḥ || 4.41.10 ||
cāturmāsye vrate pārāyaṇe tathā viśeṣataḥ |
vārṣike vṛṣaniṣpādye cāyayurbrahmavittamāḥ || 11 ||
teṣāṃ kṛte samastānāṃ rājyaprāsādabhūtayaḥ |
arpitāḥ svāgatasaukhyabhogavāsārthamuttamāḥ || 1 2||
yathā rājarddhayo rājabhogyāstathā tu bhūsuraiḥ |
aviśeṣeṇa bhogyā vai hyāsan badrīpriye tadā || 1 3|||
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā rasakulyā saśarkarāḥ |
madhukulyāḥ payaḥkulyāḥ pānakulyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 14||
sindhusarittaṭe tatra nirmitā dīrghavāhikāḥ |
viśālā bhojyaśālāśca divāniśaṃ pravartitāḥ || 159||
pānabhojanadāyinyo dāsyo dāsāśca lakṣaśaḥ |
yāvaddravyāṇi tu paṇe nyastāni vijitānyapi || 16||
ubhābhyāṃ tu nṛpābhyāṃ vai tāni yajñārthameva ha |
arpitāni vyayārthaṃ vai koṭirāyeṇa sarvathā || 17||
mahāsaudhe pūrito’sti rāyaharirnṛpastadā |
unmatto rākṣaso yadvad bhāṇavāṇī tathāvidhā || 18||
sarve paśyanti rājānaṃ śāpadagdhaṃ vicittakam |
bhāṇavāṇīṃ sarvanāśakarīṃ durodarodarām || 19||
śāpadagdhāṃ tathonmattāṃ vyapaśyanti janāstadā |
etayoḥ śreyase pārāyaṇaṃ prajāyate tviti ||4.41.20|||
vadanti darśakāstatra śaṃsanti candrikeśvarīm |
pativratāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ paśyanti ca namanti tām ||2 1 ||
mahāścaryaparā lokāḥ koṭiśo vaiṣṇavāstadā |
khānapānanivāsasvāgatādyaiḥ paritoṣitāḥ ||22||
āṣāḍhaikādaśīprātaḥkāle sabhāsthale yayuḥ |
maṇḍapaṃ tu viśālaṃ yojitaṃ svarṇasurūpiṇam ||23|||
vyapaśyan cāparaṃ svargaṃ sudharmāṃ vā sabhāmiva |
vimānamiva tatrāsīd vyāsāsanaṃ mahattamam ||24|||
svarṇahīrakasannaddhaṃ svarṇatoraṇamaṇḍitam |
vitānacandrabhāsvacca bahumauktikasaṃbhṛtam ||25||
puṣpahārādibhiḥ śṛṃgāritaṃ haṃsādirājitam |
patākikādhvajavyāptaṃ hāratoraṇakojjvalam ||26||
mṛdugendukapārśvadhrapṛṣṭhadhrādisamanvitam |
darpaṇādyaiścittaharaṃ svarṇavastrādibhūṣitam ||27||
svarṇakadalīsaṃstambhaṃ saṃhitāpaṭṭakānvitam ||28||
pūjāsāmagrikāpātrasarvopacārasaṃhitam |
kṛtracāmaravetrādyairalaṃkṛtajanairyutam ||29||
vipraiḥ sadbhiścākṣatādyaiḥ puṣpahāraiḥ pravardhitam |
vyāsāsane tatra vipraḥ svaprakāśaparāyaṇaḥ || 4.41.3 0||
saṃhitāyā mukhyavaktā niṣasāda śubhe kṣaṇe |
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathābhavan || 31 ||
saṃhitā paṭṭake nyastā pūjitā pārameśvarī |
lomaśena mahāmuktavaryeṇa badrike tadā || 32|
lakṣmīdevī svayaṃ sākṣāt saṃhitāyāṃ vyadṛśyata |
divyā prasannavadanā sarvatejobhivardhitā || 33||
sarvālaṃkāraśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā sumanoharā |
nārāyaṇaṃ hṛdye sve dadhānā jñānasāgarā ||34||
atha nārāyaṇakṛṣṇastadā tasmim̐stu vaktari |
vyadṛśyata caturbāhuḥ svaprakāśaparāyane ||35||
sarvaśobhākaraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prameśvaraḥ |
māṇikīlalitārādhāramāśrīmādhavīpriyāḥ ||36||
sarvāstadābhavan pārśve pūjāpātrādidhārikāḥ |
muktā muktānikāścāsam̐stadā tatsannidhau śubhāḥ ||37||
viprāśca munayaḥ santaḥ sādhavaśca maharṣayaḥ |
surā devyaśca tīrthāni tatra tvāsannupasthitāḥ || 38||
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena śrīsūktena tathā tadā |
nārāyaṇena sūktena devīsūktena vaidikaiḥ || 39||
mantraiḥ pūjāṃ saṃhitāyāstathā vyāsasya lomaśaḥ |
akarod vidhinā tatrārārtrikaṃ koṭirājakaḥ ||4.41.40||
akaroccandanapuṣpākṣatāmbarasuvarṇakaiḥ |
dhanaistathopacāraiśca gandhisārādibhiḥ phalaiḥ ||41||
maṅgalaṃ vācayāmāsa mahāśīrvādapūrvakam |
saṃkalpaṃ kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ śreyase tayoḥ |||42||
kathāśravaṇamagnāścopatasthire kṣaṇe’tra ca |
sabhā pūrṇābhavallakṣalakṣalakṣādhimānavaiḥ ||43||
svaprakāśo’pi bhagavān śiṣyaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya maṅgalaṃ vyadhāt ||44||
śrīmadbrahmapurādhipo’kṣarapatiḥ sarvāvatāreśvaro,
muktabrahmaniṣevitāṃghriyugalo rādhārameśeśvaraḥ |
yaścāsaṃkhyanarāyaṇādhivasatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇeśvaraḥ,
so’yaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇo’stu sukhadaḥ saurāṣṭradhāmeśvaraḥ ||45||
yaḥ pṛthvyāṃ vicaran purā kṣitibhṛtāmokṣapramodāvaho,
daityānāṃ vilayaṃkaro’rbudasatīsādhvībhujādhārakaḥ |
jīvānāṃ narayoṣitāmaghaharaḥ śreyovidhātātmanāṃ,
so’yaṃ kuṃkumavāpikākṣararaviḥ śrīsaṃhitādaivatam ||46||
natvā taṃ paramātmānaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakam |
tadvijñānamayaṃ śāstraṃ śrāvayiṣyāmi mokṣadam ||47||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu hṛdaye sadā |
kathāsu jāyamānāsu mokṣado bhaktavallabhaḥ ||48||
parabrahma namaskṛtya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim |
kaṃbharāśrīṃ ca gopālaṃ natvā jayaṃ samuccaret ||49||
smarāmi paramātmānaṃ namāmi vallabhamprabhum |
nirdiśāmi harerbhaktiṃ śaṃsāmi sevanaṃ satām ||4.41.50|||
ityevaṃ badrike kṛtvā maṃgalaṃ bījasaṃbhṛtam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāmavācayat ||51 ||
tadā devā mānavāśca pare’pi dehinaḥ khalu |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānārthino’bhavan ||52||
kṛṣṇamūrtau kathāmūtau dattadhyānāstadābhavan |
kathāsāraṃ papustatra saṃkṣepād vistarādapi |||53||
pratyahaṃ tu kathānte te kurvanti paramātmanaḥ |
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harinārāyaṇa prabho ||54||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa mokṣapradaprabho |
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ tvevaṃ samastā vādyasaṃgatāḥ ||55||
tālikābhirnṛtyagītairbhajanaṃ cakrire mudā |
kathānte jāyate tvārārtrikaṃ naivedyamuttamam ||56||
pūjā vyāsasya tatraiva jāyate pratyahaṃ śubhā |
jāpakā bhūsurādyāśca jayanti parameśvaram ||57||
sāyaṃ homaḥ sadā tatra prajvāyate’nalaprabhau |
prāghūṇikānaneṣvatra miṣṭahomā bhavanti ca ||58||
dugdhāpānāni devānāṃ havanāni bhavanti ca |
bhūsurāṇāṃ satāṃ bhojyaṃ dugdhasārādi cāmṛtam ||59||
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tatra bhedabhāvo na vidyate |
yaddevānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ carṣīṇāṃ tat sarvadehinām ||4.41.60||
pratyahaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādi khānapānādi sadṛśam |
kathā prajāyate prātastathā sāyaṃ tu sarvadā ||61 ||
ārārtrikaṃ samāptau ca pratyahaṃ pūjanādikam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanāmadhunyaṃ prajāyate’niśam ||62||
vitaraṇaṃ prasādānāṃ bhojanānāṃ pradānakam |
suvarṇādipradānānāṃ cārpaṇaṃ pratyahaṃ tadā ||63||
evaṃ samutsavo jāto badrike saṃhitātmakaḥ |
lakṣaśo mānavā jñānāmṛtaṃ pītvā tu pāvanāḥ ||64||
bhūtvā bhūtvā mahābhāgavatā bhavanti tatra vai |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||65||
itimantrapradānaṃ ca karoti lomaśo muniḥ |
āścaryāṇi kathāyāṃ tu vicitrāṇi bhavantyapi ||66||
vimānāni surāṇāṃ vai śravaṇārthaṃ tadāmbare |
samāgatyāvatiṣṭhanti puṣpacandanavarṣaṇam ||67||
kṛtvā prayānti satataṃ svargaṃ svargāgatāni vai |
adṛśyā divyadehāśca tīrtharṣiyoginastadā ||68||
āgatyākarṇya khe sthitvā nītvā yānti prasādakam |
vādyāni devalokānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca gītayaḥ ||69||
apsarasāṃ gītikāśca nartanaṃ vārayoṣitam |
sādhvīnāṃ bhajanaṃ ghoṣā vipravedodbhavāstadā ||4.41.70||
utsavānte prajāyante pratyahaṃ vyāsasevanam |
gurūṇāṃ sevanaṃ sādhuvargāṇāṃ pūjanādikam ||71 ||
svāgataṃ tvāgatānāṃ vigatānāṃ mānapūjanam |
madhuparko nūtanānāṃ prācīnānāṃ tu dakṣiṇāḥ ||72||
dīyante pratyahaṃ tatrānāthādīnāṃ yatheṣṭakam |
pretā āgatya śṛṇvanti kathāṃ paramapāvanīm ||73||
prasādaṃ saṃpragṛhṇanti yānti mokṣapadaṃ tataḥ |
vimānaiste prayāntyeva kathayitvā hyudantakam ||74||
ahaṃ bhogyaṃ sindhujānāṃ tadā śrībadrike param |
mahābhāgavatāḥ santo rājante yatra vaiṣṇavāḥ ||75||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathā bhavanti ca |
pravartante harerlīlājñānadharmayutāḥ kathāḥ ||76|||
saṃhitātīrthamatredaṃ khyātaṃ tarhyabhavattataḥ |
bhāṇavāṇī rāyahariḥ śṛṇutaḥ pratyahaṃ kathāḥ ||77||
bhuṃjāte ca prasādau tau pibataśca jalāmṛtam |
pāpaprakṣālanaṃ prajāyate śanaiḥ kathāmṛtaiḥ ||78||
kathāśravaṇayogena jāyate tvātmaśodhanam |
satāmāśīrvādalābhairjāyate śāpamokṣaṇam ||79||
evaṃ śuddhiḥ śanairjātā cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ |
vratadānaphalānāṃ cārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ kuṭumbibhiḥ ||4.41.80 ||
tatpuṇyena tayoḥ svāsthyaṃ śanaiḥ śanairudaicchubham |
kathāyāṃ vartamānāyāmūrjamāsaḥ samāyayau ||8 1||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ bālakṛṣṇajanmajayantikotsavam |
cakrurnṛpāḥ prajāścāpi mahīmānā narāḥ striyaḥ ||82||
maharṣayastathā devā mānavāḥ sādhavastathā |
sādhyo viprā vaidikāśca pracakruste mahotsavam ||83||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nṛpaḥ koṭirāyaḥ parimeyapuraḥsaraḥ |
prāpya patraṃ lomaśarṣeḥ śrīkṛṣṇānayanāya saḥ ||84||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram |
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ saurāṣṭre vyomavartmanā ||85||
vimānenāyayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayāntikam |
avātaranmandirāgre bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokitum |||86 ||
pūjayituṃ tathāmantrayituṃ kṛṣṇāgrato’bhavat |
kṛtāñjaliḥ kṛtapūjaḥ svāgataṃ prāpya darśanam ||87||
modaṃ prāpya śrīharaye hṛdayaṃ prasamarpya ca |
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa prārthayāmāsa kāraṇam ||88||
janmajayantī bhagavannekaviṃśatikā śubhā |
āgatya sindhujān deśān śarkarānagarāntike ||89||
saṃhitāmaṇḍape kāryā svayaṃ bhagavatā prabho |
kṛpayā netumāyātaḥ śvo gatistatra rocate ||4.41.90||
saptamyāṃ śarkarābhūmau madhyandine samāgamaḥ |
kartavyo bhavatā tatra mahāsvāgatamuttamam ||9 1||
bhavitā bhagavam̐stasmādāgantavyaṃ kṛpālunā |
hariḥ prāha śubhaṃ bhūyādāgantā omiti drutam ||92||
rājā rātrau tu viśrāmaṃ jagrāha tīrthamācaran |
prātaḥ sajjo babhūvāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā ||93||
mātā pitā ṛṣayaśca santaḥ sajjāstato’bhavan |
vidhāya svaṃ dvidhā rūpaṃ vimānaṃ cāruroha vai ||94||
vimānasthāḥ samastāste dvedhā kṛtāḥ parātmanā |
vimānaṃ prayayau tūrṇaṃ cāmbareṇa tu badrike ||95||
sindhudeśaṃ samaprāpacchrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ ||96||
janmāhotsavalābhārthaṃ svagṛhe śrīhariṃ svayam |
āgatānāṃ manastuṣṭyai kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ ||97||
sindhujānāṃ manastuṣṭyai sindhudeśaṃ gato’pi ca |
evaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ sindhutīramavātarat ||98||
sūryabhāsvadvimānaṃ tat pūjitaṃ prathamaṃ janaiḥ |
harirniyet vimānācca jayaśabdaiḥ prapūjitaḥ ||99||
netrārpaṇairharṣanādairakṣataiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
pūjitaścandanādyaiśca puṣpahāraiḥ prapūjitaḥ || 4.41.100 ||
lājābhirvardhitaścāpi karāñjalibhirarcitaḥ |
hārdairbhāvairiṅgitaiśca nijanāthaukṛto janaiḥ || 101 ||
pratikṛtisahasrātmā chāyāmūrtiḥ kṛto hariḥ |
nārībhiśca naraiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pratibimbita ātmasu ||1 02||
atha kṛṣṇo yayau koṭirāyadarśitamandiram |
lomaśādyāḥ praṇemustaṃ pupūjuḥ svāgatādibhiḥ || 10 3||
jalapānaṃ daduścāpi candreśvarī mahāsatī |
candrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ cāpyakṣatairyuktaṃ cakāra sā || 1 04||
puṣpamālāṃ dadau kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasya candrikeśvarī |
dineśvarī harestatra pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ || 1 05||
sammānamācarat pūjāṃ vyadhād bhāvabharā tadā |
anye’pi śrīharerlokā devāḥ prajājanā api || 106 ||
maharṣayaśca ṛṣayo vyadhuḥ pūjāṃ harestadā |
yayuḥ sarve kuśalaṃ vai pṛṣṭāḥ svasvaniketanam || 1 07||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra viśrāntimāpa vai kṣaṇam |
badrike sarvatastatra parānando vyavartata || 1 08||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇauyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarānagare saṃhitākathārambhe sarvalokavāsināṃ
tathā janmajayantyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cāgamaḥ svāgatādikaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||

<4.42>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tatastatra mahotsave |
saptamyāṃ śrīharerdarśanārthaṃ saṃsanmahatyabhūt || 1 ||
divye gajāsane ramye svarṇaratnādibhāsvati |
uccairuccatame kṛṣṇo nyaṣīdad divyavigrahaḥ || 2 ||
lakṣalakṣātilakṣāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ hi gocaraḥ |
mahāsane’bhavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’rkavattadā || 3 ||
divyatejo’mbārayukto divyaiśvaryapratāpavān |
asīmānavadhiprāgalbhyaudāryaujjvalyamaṇḍitaḥ || 4 ||
tādṛksauṣṭhavamādhuryalāvaṇyahāsyaśobhitaḥ |
tādṛksaundaryasādrūpyākarṣaṇānandapūritaḥ || 5 ||
tādṛgyauvanagāmbhīryavīryabalavirājitaḥ |
tādṛkkṛpādayāsnehapremānugrahavarṣakaḥ || 6 ||
koṭikāmapramohāḍhyasauṣṭhavaghaṭṭanātmakaḥ |
vyadyotatākṣaradhāmnā tejasā mūrchanākaraḥ || 7 ||
naranārīhṛdayastho’ntarātmā netragocaraḥ |
sarvāvatārabhagavān tadānīṃ kṛpayābhavat || 8 ||
pūjito vanditaḥ sarvaiḥ svāgataṃ tu navaṃ navam |
kṛtaṃ lokairbhaktavargairāsāyaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 9 ||
hariścopādideśāpi kṛpātmakaṃ tu saṃsadi |
nijārthakṛtasarvasvabhaktebhyo’nugraheṇa vai || 4.42.1 0||
sarve bhavantu sukhino darśanānmama dehinaḥ |
bhavatāṃ sukhalābhārthaṃ samāgato’smyanugrahāt || 11 ||
pare dhāmnyakṣare loke divyo’haṃ prabhavāmi yaḥ |
sarvāvatāradhartā śrīpatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 12||
sarveśvaraniyantā ca sarvaśaktipatiḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvasiddharṣipitrṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ daivataṃ param || 1 3||
antarātmā kālamāyāmahāpuruṣaśāsakaḥ |
sohameva bhavāmyatra bālakṛṣṇo bhavādṛśaḥ || 14||
mama yogaṃ gatā ye ye te dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ |
vāsudevā asaṃkhyātā nārāyaṇā hyasīmakāḥ || 15||
śrīkṛṣṇāścāpyasaṃkhyātā viṣṇavo’saṃkhyamūrtayaḥ |
rāmā nareśvarāḥ siddheśvarāścāpyatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1 6||
mama yogena jāyante klṛptā vāṃśodbhavā mama |
matsvarūpā mattādātmyā madabhinnā bhavanti te || 17||
māmāśritya samastāsu sṛṣṭiṣu pārameśvarāḥ |
niṣpadyante’nantaśaktidharā matkṛpayā hi te || 18||
so’haṃ samastasṛṣṭīnāṃ kṛpākaṭākṣapāvanaḥ |
gocaro’smi bhavatāṃ cāvatārī puruṣottamaḥ || 1 9||
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ ye’tra śṛṇvanti saṃsmarantyapi |
teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā māyāsaṃsāravāridheḥ ||4.42.20||
ye māṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃbhajanti vai |
tān matvāhaṃ nijān bhaktān tārayiṣyāmi mohataḥ ||2 1 ||
narā nāryaśca ṣaṇḍhāśca ye bhajiṣyanti māṃ tviha |
seviṣyante ca sarvasvārpaṇaiste dhāmino mama |||22||
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ karmatulyaṃ phalaṃ dadāmyaham |
nītireṣā tu saṃsāre kṛpā me tvatirekiṇī || 23||
kṛpāyāṃ niyamo nāsti phalakarmābhibandhakaḥ |
uddharāmi jagatsarvaṃ prasādena na saṃśayaḥ || 24||
vahneryogāt samastaṃ vai pāvanaṃ jāyate yathā |
mama yogena sarvaṃ vai pāvanaṃ jāyate tathā || 25||
yathāhaṃ pāvanaścāsmi tathaiva mama mūrtayaḥ |
santo me pāvanāḥ sarve vāṇī me pāvanī sadā || 26||
saṃhiteyaṃ mama vāṇī pāvanī sarvadehinām |
lakṣmīścāhamahaṃ lakṣmīścaikaṃ tattvaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ||27||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaścāhaṃ saṃhitā me sarasvatī |
tasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa madakṣaramavāpyate ||28||
śabdamūrtiḥ sādhumūrtirdhātumūrtirmadātmikā |
ahaṃ trimūrtikaścāsmi sādhvīmūrtistridhā mama |||29||
bhaktimūrtistathopāstimūrtirdīkṣātmamūrtikaḥ |
ṣaṇmūrto’haṃ sadā cāsmi milāmi tatra tatra ha ||4.42.30||
sākṣādahaṃ virāje’dya sindhutīre bhavanmaṭhe |
kalyāṇārthaṃ bhavatāṃ vai kṛpayā manujākṛtiḥ || 31 ||
nāryaścopāsate māṃ tu patirūpeṇa nityadā |
upāsate patayo māṃ dhāturūpeṇa nityadā || 32||
ṣaṇḍhāḥ saṃkalparūpeṇopāsate māṃ phalojjhitāḥ |
vṛkṣā rasapradaṃ māṃ tūpāsate pṛthivībhujaḥ ||33|||
pakṣiṇaścāmbarātmānaṃ paśavaścauṣadhivrajam |
devāḥ sudhāṃ daityavaryā balaṃ kledaṃ tu jantavaḥ || 34||
upāsate yathāyogyasvabhāvānuguṇaṃ tu mām |
cakṣuṣmantaḥ surūpaṃ māṃ vinetrā sūpavarjitam ||35 ||
sendriyāḥ sendriyaṃ nirindriyā māṃ tu nirindriyam |
satattvā māṃ tattvayuktaṃ nistattvā tattvavarjitam || 36||
saguṇā guṇavantaṃ māṃ nirguṇā guṇavarjitam |
sasnehā māṃ snigdhamūrtiṃ nissnehā rūkṣamavyayam ||37||
satyaścānandadātāraṃ santaḥ śāntikhanīśvaram |
upāsate yathāyogyaṃ phalaṃ tathā dadāmyaham || 38||
dehino dehavantaṃ māṃ videhā dehavarjitam |
svārthāḥ parārthaghātāraṃ nissvārthāścāparigraham ||39||
jñāninaḥ svaprakāśaṃ māṃ jaḍā bhūtātmavartinam |
vipannāstrāṇakartāraṃ sampannāḥ sampadātmakam ||4.42.40 ||
śrāntā udyamarūpaṃ māṃ vyāpṛtā yatnarūpiṇam |
upāsate’lasāḥ phalojjhitaṃ māṃ rāgiṇaḥ sukham ||41 ||
teṣāmupāstimālambya dadāmīṣṭaphalaṃ sadā |
ahaṃ vai kṛpayā labhyo mantralabhyo bhavāmi ca |||05||
bhaktilabhyaḥ snehalabhyaḥ samādhilabhya ityapi |
alabhyaḥ sulabhaścāsmi saṃhitāpāṭhināṃ tviha ||43||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
itimantraprajaptustu sulabho’haṃ nirantaram ||44||
guroḥ sevāphalaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāptiruttamā |
sākṣādatra bhavecceti tathā prāpto’smi vastviha ||45||
yo māṃ smarati namati caṣṭe dhyāyati sevate |
tasyāhaṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ viśeṣeṇa puro’pi ca ||46||
yaḥ patnyāṃ śriyamīkṣeta patyau nārāyaṇaṃ tu yā |
apatye pārṣadānme ca tadgṛhaṃ me’kṣaraṃ padam ||47||
yaḥ pravṛttau mamājñāṃ vai nivṛttau ca mayi sthitim |
jīvane mama tādātmyaṃ dadhāti sa prayāti mām ||48||
yasyendriyāṇi sarvāṇi kṛṣṇārthāni mano’pi ca |
ātmāpi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthaḥ sa pumarthavān ||49||
api loke durācāro yo’nanyāśrayavān mayi |
madbhaktiṃ kurute nityaṃ sa sādhurmokṣasādhanaḥ ||4.42.50||
api dharmavirāgāḍhyo niṣparigraha ātmavān |
vihāya māṃ vartamānastasya hānirmahattamā ||5 1 ||
asādhuḥ sa tu mantavyo yo na bhajate māṃ prabhum |
na vā sādhūn sevate’pi naṣṭārthaḥ sa tu sarvathā ||52||
apīndradhiṣṇyamāpanno dharmarājapratāpavān |
sūryatejo’bhisampanno bhaktihīnastu nārakī ||53||
api bhautikatattveśaḥ siddhyaiśvaryaikaśevadhiḥ |
bahvaṇḍānāṃ niyantā ced bhaktihīnaḥ sa nārakī ||54||
buddheḥ pāraṃ gataścāpi māyāpāraṃ gato’pi ca |
brahmabhāvaṃ gataścāpi bhaktihīnastu nottamaḥ ||55||
prajāpālanaśakto’pi sarvācāraparāyaṇaḥ |
satāṃ sevāvihīno yaḥ sa phalgujanmavāniha ||56||
sarvavidyādharaścāpi sarvaśāsanavīryavān |
satāṃ sevāvihīnaścet phalgujīvanavāniha ||57||
devakoṭiṃ gataścāpi maharṣitāṃ gato’pi cet |
mama satāṃ kṛpāśūnyastasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||58||
kāmadhenurgṛhe yasya kalpadrumaśca mandire |
yasya gṛhe na vai santastadgṛhaṃ pherurājavat ||59||
dṛṣṭiryasyātidivyāpi sattvaṃ cāntaḥsthitaṃ tathā |
satāṃ darśanahīnaścet sadāndhaḥ sa tu nārakī ||60||
pūjābhiḥ pūjitaścāpi kīrtyā prakāśamānapi |
satāṃ darśanahīnaścet sadāndho dīnakiṃkaraḥ ||61 ||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu gatimānapi sarvathā |
sādhūn prati gatihīno durgatiḥ sa tu nārakī || 62||
āraṇyako muniścāpi tyāgavairāgyaśīlavān |
sādhusatsaṃgahīnaścet sa syādāraṇyakaḥ paśuḥ || 33||
māyāpāśāt paśutvaṃ vai jīvānāṃ vidyate sadā |
māyā tu vāsanā bodhyā bhaktyantarāyakāriṇī || 64||
sā tu prakṣālanīyā vai satāṃ hareśca sevayā |
ātmārpaṇaṃ harau kāryaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ tu satsvapi ||65||
mayi nyasya kriyāḥ sarvā bhāvyaṃ brahmātmanā tviha |
saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhāvyaṃ madātmanā tataḥ ||66||
mama bhāvayuto yaḥ syāttamuddharāmi sarvathā |
svastyastu bhavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sākṣānmama prasādataḥ ||67||
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra tu badrike |
virarāma tataḥ śrīmān lomaśāstān manuṃ param | | 68 | |
śrāvayāmāsa ca sarvān vaiṣṇavān paramāna vyadhāt |
sabhāvirāmaḥ sañjāto hariḥ prapūjito janaiḥ | | 69 ||
viśrāmārthaṃ yayau naijaṃ sthānaṃ tatra nṛpādibhiḥ |
ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ śrīharervihitaṃ śubham | |4.42.7 0 | |
anyeṣāṃ bhojanapānāsanasatkārapūjanam |
yathāyogyaṃ nṛpādyaiśca kṛtaṃ niśāmukhe tadā | |7 1 | |
rātrau nāryo narā rājñyo rājāno lomaśaṃ munim |
svaprakāśāyanakaṃ te vaktāraṃ samasevayan ||72||
sādhūn siṣevire cāpi pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ |
atoṣayan śreyase tān divyabhāvanayā yutāḥ ||73 ||
rātrau tatra tu devānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca gītayaḥ |
apsarasāṃ nartanāni gāyanāni ca yoṣitām ||74||
kavīnāṃ prācīnakathālaharyaścābhavam̐stataḥ |
nāṭakānāṃ darśanāni caritrāṇāṃ harestathā ||75||
indrajālānyanekāni kalāvidāṃ tadābhavan |
bhajanāni satīnāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ kīrtanāni ca ||76||
samādhayo yogavidāṃ tadābhavam̐stu badrike |
sevā śreṣṭhā mumukṣūṇāṃ tādātmyaṃ tu nijātmanām ||77||
sarvārpaṇaṃ prabhaktānāṃ tadābhavam̐stu badrike |
dravībhāvaścātmavidāṃ snehināṃ paramātmani || 78 ||
jñānināṃ tvekatānatvaṃ pratyayānāṃ tadābhavat |
pramodāmodaparamānandā abhavan dehinām ||79 ||
kṣetrāṇāṃ pulako jātaḥ svedastu saritāṃ tadā |
pravāhāṇāṃ pāvanatvaṃ jātaṃ śrīkṛṣṇayogataḥ || 4.42.80 ||
satāṃ prakāśanaṃ tatra maharṣīṇāṃ vinodanam |
prajānāṃ dhānyasaṃskārāstadābhavan hi badrike ||8 1 ||
paśūnāṃ tu pavitratvaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ yādasāmapi |
jambūnāṃ jīvanotkarṣo bhāvī jāto hi badrike ||82||
vallīnāṃ pādapānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ tṛṇaśākhinām |
kandānāṃ bhūtale tatra yajñārhatvaṃ tadābhavat ||8 3 ||
sārthakyaṃ tatra vāyūnāṃ vahnīnāṃ khasya cābhavan |
vārīṇāṃ tadvikārāṇāṃ sārthakyaṃ kṛṣṇayogataḥ ||84||
śayyānāṃ mandirāṇāṃ ca vastūnāṃ kṛṣṇasañjuṣām |
pāvanatvaṃ sadā jātaṃ mokṣadāyitvamuttamam ||85||
badrike kā kathā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ karṇe tu saṃhitā |
yeṣāṃ bhūmau bālakṛṣṇo yeṣāṃ dṛṣṭau tu sādhavaḥ ||86||
sureśvarāḥ samāgatya rātrau śrīśaṃ śrīvallabhamprabhum |
divyadravaiḥ pūjayitvā prasādaṃ prāpya saṃyayuḥ ||87||
tīrthāni bhūvyomagāni samāgatya rahastataḥ |
hareḥ pādaspṛṣṭajalaṃ pītvā yayurnijasthalīm ||88||
siddhajanā adrivāsā āgatya yogavarṣmabhiḥ |
sevayitvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ yayurnaijaṃ tu gahvaram ||89||
dyauḥ svayaṃ yuvatī bhūtvā siṣeve dyupatiṃ harim |
kṛtakṛtyā yayau naijaṃ nivāsaṃ tvambare tataḥ ||4.42.90||
śvetadvīpādivāsāśca muktā muktānikāstathā |
kṣīravāsā badrikāsthāḥ siṣevire narāyaṇam ||9 1 ||
rādhāramādyāḥ sakalāḥ śaktayaḥ prāṇarakṣakam |
kāntaṃ siṣevire kāntā divyamūrtaya eva tāḥ || 92||
naikarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇovallabhāryo niśāntare |
jagṛhe tvarpitāṃ sevāṃ narāṇāṃ yoṣitāmapi ||93||
niśānte sa kṣaṇaṃ nidrāṃ yoganidrāṃ nijapriyām |
jagrāha ghaṭikāmātraṃ samuttasthau tataḥ prabhuḥ || 94||
anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ parātparam |
dadhyau naijaṃ mūlarūpaṃ samutthāya kṣaṇaṃ prabhuḥ |||95||
tadāvatārāḥ sarve’pi sarvāvatāraśaktayaḥ |
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca divyādṛśyasvarūpakaiḥ ||96||
jayantīpūjanalābhaṃ rahastatra pralebhire |
muktāḥ samādhiniṣṭhāśca dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ || 97||
pārṣadā api kṛṣṇasya pūjālābhaṃ prapedire |
pārṣadānyo gopikāśca pūjāsevāṃ pracakrire || 98||
gajo garuḍaḥ śeṣaśca vājī vāhottamāstadā |
āgatyādṛśyarūpaiste rahaḥpūjāṃ vyadhurhareḥ || 99||
badrike tvaṃ mayā sākaṃ nareṇa tanunā saha |
maharṣibhiḥ rahaḥpūjālābhaṃ prāptavatī tadā || 4.42.10 0||
evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇorjāṣṭamikāprage |
jayantīmiṣamālambya divyā devamapūjayan || 101 ||
lebhire prathamaṃ lābhaṃ cāprakāśaṃ parātmanaḥ |
tato brāhmamuhūrtārdhavigamo’bhavadeva ha || 102||
jajāgāra harirlokavyavahāreṇa vai tataḥ |
jajāgarurdehinaśca miṣṭavādyasvaraśravaiḥ ||1 0 3||
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātarjayantīdevatā mudhā |
bhūtvā kumārikā divyā sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitā || 1 04||
āyayau divyadehenāpūjayacchrīpatiṃ patim |
adṛśyā nyavasat kṛṣṇe tato’khiladinaṃ satī ||1 05||
evaṃ badrīpriye jāto mahotsavastu dehinām |
pūjanārthaṃ janāḥ sajjā bhavanti sarvatastadā || 1 06||
divyacintāmaṇikalpyāḥ sāmagrīḥ sarvajātikāḥ |
saha nitvāyayuḥ pūjākaraṇārthaṃ tadantikam || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarāpattanamaṇḍape sāyaṃ sabhāyāṃ śrīharikṛtopadeśo hareḥ pūjanaṃ niśyutsavāḥ prātardevādikṛtarahaḥpūjanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||

<4.43>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śrīkṛṣṇasya mahotsavam |
ekaviṃśatike janmadine kṛṣṇe tu kārtike || 1 ||
prātareva hariṃ rājñyaḥ snapayitvā janārdanam |
sarvakāmapradaṃ kāntaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 2 ||
candanairgandhasāraiśca mahauṣadhirasānvitaiḥ |
jalaistīrthāhṛtaistailamiśritaiḥ kaisarai rasaiḥ || 3 ||
upasaṃprasumṛdyābhiṣiñcya mārjanamācaran |
vastradhāraṇaśṛṃgārabhūṣāpuṣpādyadhārayan || 4 ||
mukuṭaṃ kaṭake svarṇajāte hārām̐śca kānakān |
ratnamāṇikyahīrakamauktikasphaṭikānvitān || 5 ||
adhārayan hareḥ kaṇṭhe tilakaṃ candrakaṃ vyadhuḥ |
bhāle kaisaracandraṃ ca kajjalaṃ netrayostathā || 6 ||
karṇāvataṃsakau ramyau karṇapūrau nyadhārayan |
raśanāṃ kānakīṃ kaṭyāṃ nūpure pādayostathā || 7 ||
prakoṣṭhayoḥ śṛṅkhale cāṅgulyādāvūrmikādikam |
cūḍāmaṇiṃ kuṇḍale ca graiveyakīyamālikāḥ || 8 ||
kaṭake ca maṇīn nyadhārayan suvarṇapāduke |
koṭyarbudābjamūlyādhimahāmaṇīnadhārayan || 9 ||
yatprakāśastu sarvatra madhyandinabhramāvahaḥ |
pādahastatalayoścālaktakādi nyadhārayan || 4.43.10 ||
sauvarṇacūrṇasaṃvyāptagātrāṇyapi hyakārayan |
saindhavāśvanibhe svarṇāsane śrīsvāmivallabham || 11 ||
nyaṣādayam̐stadā rājñyaḥ sindhujānāṃ tu bhūbhujām |
prathamaṃ tā maṃgalāni kṛtvā kṛṣṇamapūpujan || 12||
dhṛtvopadāḥ svarṇarūpyamaṇihāramayīḥ puraḥ |
nyadhuste pādayorvāri prakṣālitaṃ papuḥ payaḥ || 13|
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhū rājñyaḥ puṣpākṣatādivardhitam |
duḥkhahānyañjalīn kṛṣṇaśiraṣṭaścāvatārayan || 14||
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca kṣamāṃ yayācire dayām |
dineśvarī bhāṇavāṇyā rāyaharervicittatām || 15||
nivedyāyācata svāsthyaṃ sukhaṃ ca śāśvataṃ tataḥ |
haristāṃ samuvācāpi svāsthyamadyaiva śobhanam || 1 6||
bhaviṣyatyeva mā cintā kuru rājñi sukhaṃ bhavet |
kṣaṇānte koṭirāyo’pi rāyahariṃ nṛpaṃ tviha || 17||
nītvā tvāyāspati pūjāṃ kartuṃ me svasthamānasam |
bhāṇavāṇīṃ puro me’tra samānaya dineśvari || 18||
ityuktā badrike dineśvarī rājñī drutaṃ tadā |
bhāṇavāṇīṃ vicittāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntike || 1 9||
dineśvaryānayat kṛṣṇo bhāṇavāṇīṃ tu mastake |
pasparśa pāṇinā mīnadhvajaśūladhanuṣmatā ||4.43.20||
tāvat sā svasthitimatī pāvanī jñānayoginī |
nirāmayā ca nirvyādhiḥ paṇḍitevābhavad drutam ||21||
vaicittyaṃ vigataṃ tasyāḥ subuddhātvaṃ samāgatam |
patitā pādayoḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sā tataḥ ||22||
pūjāṃ kṛtvā śrīhareścopadā dadau ramājuṣe |
ārārtrikaṃ vidhāyāpi kṛṣṇapādajalaṃ papau ||23||
arthayāmāsa mokṣaṃ sā sarvapāpavināśanam |
bandhanānāṃ vāsanānāṃ mūlanāśaṃ samārthayat ||24||
dyūtapāpavināśaṃ ca vyavāyapāpanāśanam |
muktānikāsthitiṃ sāpi prārthayat paramātmataḥ ||25||
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tāvat sā divyatāṃ gatā |
divyadehā devatāvad divyaiśvaryā babhūva ha ||26||
kṛpāleśena kṛṣṇasya nirvāṇikābhavat satī |
jīvanmuktābhavattūrṇaṃ dehāvaraṇavarjitā ||27||
aho kṛpā harerjātā yatnaśūnye’pi vigrahe |
sayatnānāṃ tu vai siddhiḥ pūrvabhāvaṃ na saṃgatā ||28||
atha tatra mahāścaryaṃ vīkṣya kanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
saubhāgyavatyo nāryaśca sadhavā vidhavā api ||29||
bālikāścāpi vṛddhāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram |
bhāṇavāṇīṃ divyadehāṃ vyadhāt kṛṣṇeti mohitāḥ ||4.43.30||
tāḥ sarvā bhāvanāyuktā yathābhāvāstathābhavan |
divyaguṇā divyadehā divyakriyāḥ sudevatāḥ ||3 1 ||
divyanetrā divyabhāvā rādhāramāsamāstadā |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasparśena yoṣitaḥ ||32||
brahmapriyā abhavam̐śca haripriyāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
mantraṃ tā jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇamukhāt kārṣṇībhavecchayā ||33||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
bahvyastatrābhavan rugṇāstadrogān sa nyavārayat ||34||
bahvīnāṃ tvanapatyatvaṃ kṛṣṇastat sannyavārayat |
anyāsāṃ kleśavattvādi kleśām̐stāsāṃ nyavārayat ||35||
tathānyāsāṃ nirdhanatvaṃ dāridryaṃ sa nyavārayat |
anyāsāṃ tu patiprāptimattvaṃ sa kṛpayākarot ||36||
saubhāgyavattvamanyāsāṃ sampadvattvaṃ samuttamam |
cakāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvasukhārpaṇam ||37||
rājñīnāṃ pūjanakāryaṃ samāptaṃ ca prajāstriyaḥ |
apūjayan hariṃ sarvā lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśaḥ striyaḥ ||38||
koṭirūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vyajāyata |
tattannārīpuraḥsthitvā kāntaḥ pūjāmavālabhat ||39||
āśīrvādām̐stā agṛhṇan śubhāśiṣo dadau hariḥ |
sarvāsāṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇo divyavāsaṃ sadā vyadhāt ||4.43.40||
evaṃ ghaṭikāmātraṃ vai mahāścaryacamatkṛtim |
pradarśya tu tatastirobhūyaikarūpatāṃ yayau ||41 ||
nārīvarge na cāpyekā kṛṣṇayoge’vaśiṣyate |
dayāṃ kṛtvā tathā kṛṣṇaḥ pūjāṃ jagrāha sarvadhṛk ||42||
atha tṛptiṃ gatā nāryo dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā prapūjya tam |
prāpya prāsādikaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ dalaṃ jalam ||43||
snehaṃ netrakaṭākṣaṃ ca saumyahāsyaṃ manastathā |
kṛtakṛtyā abhavam̐stā divyabhautikavigrahāḥ ||44||
evaṃ hariḥ prāpya pūjāṃ nārīṇāṃ divyabhāvanām |
divyaiśvaryayutāṃ cāpi tirobhāvaṃ gato’cyutaḥ ||45||
tataḥ sarvāḥ sthiravṛttyā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vilulokire |
parabrahma punaḥ kaścinnārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim | |46||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikākāntaṃ lalitāsvāminaṃ harim |
svāmināthaṃ tu māṇikyāḥ padmāvatyāḥ patiṃ tathā ||47||
kāścittu badrikānāthaṃ kāścicchrībhūpatiṃ tathā |
kāścittu kamalānāthaṃ prajñeśaṃ vilulokire ||48||
tataḥ śrīkuṃkumavāpīnāthaṃ taṃ vilulokire |
evaṃ vīkṣya mahānandaṃ sarvānandām̐śca lebhire ||49||
saindhavyaḥ śrīhariṃ prāpya dhāminyaḥ saṃbabhūvire |
vaiṣṇavyaḥ paramā jātāḥ puṇyānāṃ sarito yathā ||4.43.50||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminvallabhāyeti tā jaguḥ |
dadhyuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ cāntarasthaṃ bahiḥsthitam ||51 ||
evaṃ badrīpriye prātarnārīpūjanamuttamam |
nivṛttaṃ ca tato rājā koṭirāyaḥ samāyayau ||52||
bahubhirnṛpaśārdūlai rājanyai rājayogibhiḥ |
rājyapālai rāṣṭrapālaiḥ sainyapālaiḥ sahāyayau ||53||
rājopacāraiḥ sakalaiḥ pūjayāmāsa mādhavam |
koṭimūlyamaṇiratnanaddhaṃ mukuṭaṃ kānakam ||54||
kuṇḍale ratnakhacite kaṇṭhahārān suvarṇajān |
karṇapūrān kaṭakām̐ścāṃgadān suvarṇaśṛṃkhalāḥ ||55||
ūrmikā raśanāṃ ratnanaddhāṃ hārān suvarṇajān |
maṇimālā maṇikalgiṃ maṇimañjīranūpurān ||96||
ārpayaddharaye bhāle kṛtvā cāndanacandrakam |
sugandhamarpayāmāsa puṣpahārān sumālikāḥ ||57||
bhūṣāśṛṃgāravastrāṇi bahumūlyāni cārpayat |
svarṇapātrāṇi ramyāṇi svarṇahetīn susundarān | |58||
sauvarṇakhelakām̐ścāpi śrīkṛṣṇāya tadārpayat |
dhūpadīpākṣatavārinaivedyārārtrikādibhiḥ ||59||
amūlyaratnamaṇibhirbhṛtaiḥ sthālaiḥ suvarṇajaiḥ |
svarṇāḍhyopakaraṇādyaiśchatracāmaravetrakaiḥ ||4.43.6 0||
pūjayitvā hariṃkṛṣṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ |
tilakaṃ subhagaṃ bhāle kṛṣṇasya nṛpamācarat ||61 ||
nṛpāścānye ca rājanyāḥ kumārā rājayoginaḥ |
rājasambandhinaḥ śreṣṭhivaryā rājyādhikāriṇaḥ ||62||
kastūrīkesaragandhasārakuṃkumakardamaiḥ |
puṣpākṣatajalavṛndāpatrayavāṃkurādibhiḥ ||63||
prapūjya mādhavīkṛṣṇaṃ natvā pītvā padāmṛtam |
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuścāśīrvādān daduḥ śubhāvahān ||64||
koṭirāyastadā rāyahariṃ svasthasthitiṃ gatam |
prairayat parameśasya pūjārthaṃ tatra sotsukam ||65 ||
nirāmayo gataśāpaḥ sarvabhānaprabodhavān |
śrīkṛṣṇaṃvallabhaṃcāryaṃ pupūja paramādarāt ||66||
atha sarvaprajāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ janmajayantikotsave |
utsukāḥ pūjayāmāsurīśeśvareśvareśvaram ||67||
tadānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇadivyasvarūpakam |
vyadyotatākṣaradhāmāśritaṃ yadvat parātparam ||68||
lomaśādyā munayo’pi maharṣayaśca devatāḥ |
siddhāḥ satyaḥ sādhavaścānarcuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakam ||69||
āśīrvādān daduścāpi sūtamāgadhacāraṇāḥ |
bandinaḥ kavayo bhaṭṭā vavandire śubhāśayāḥ ||4.43.70 ||
evaṃ madhyāhnavelāntaṃ janmajayantikotsavaḥ |
samabhavattadā badri bhojanāni tato’bhavan ||71||
sāyaṃ sabhābhavad ramyā lakṣādhimānavāśritā |
svaprakāśo hi bhagavānnupādideśa tatra ha |||73||
mānave khalu loke’tra śreṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ pareśvaraḥ |
parameśakṛtamānā mānitā netare kvacit ||73||
śrīkṛṣṇaśrīpatinārāyaṇānādipumuttamaḥ |
virājate’tra bhagavān bhavatāṃ mānakārakaḥ ||74||
bhavadbhirmānitaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavanto mānitāstataḥ |
yeṣāṃ mānaṃ hareragre teṣāṃ sarvatra mānitā ||75|||
yadgṛhe bhagavānāste sarve divyā hi te matāḥ |
gṛhastho’pi hariṃ naije gṛhe yaḥ sthāpayet sadā ||76||
sādhureva gṛhasthaḥ sa yadgṛhaṃ mādhavātmakam |
nārī nārāyaṇapūjākarī sādhvī tu sā matā ||77||
rājāpi rājate yatra śrīkṛṣṇena parātmanā |
sa rājā sādhurevāsti yadgṛhe śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||78||
rājñī nirmānadāsīva sevate parameśvaram |
sā rājñī sarvadā sādhvī yato nārāyaṇaśritā ||79||
rāṣṭrīyāstu prajā yā yāḥ sevante mādhavīśvaram |
sarvāḥ sādhvyo hi mantavyā yadgṛhe bhagavāniti ||4.43.80||
dhanavanto hariṃ ye tu sevante sādhavo’pi te |
dhanaṃ nārāyaṇo yeṣāṃ te santaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ ||81||
san vai nārāyaṇastaṃ ye cānte dharanti sarvathā |
taranti tena cānyām̐śca tārayanti bhavārṇavāt |||82||
santaste tvatra saṃsāre sādhnuvanti pumarthakam |
vyāpārastu bhaved yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ sādhavastu te ||83||
vyavasāyo bhaved yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇātmā sādhavo’pi te |
yatayo yatnavanto ye harau te santa īritāḥ ||84||
saṃnyāsino harau ye te santo mokṣaparāyaṇāḥ |
vane vāsakarāḥ kṛṣṇe magnāste sādhavo matāḥ |||85||
yogaṃ kṛṣṇe prayuñjānāḥ sādhavaste’pi yoginaḥ |
tapaḥ kṛṣṇaparaṃ yeṣāṃ tāpasāḥ sādhavastu te ||86||
vrataṃ yeṣāṃ pare kṛṣṇe sādhavo vratinaśca te |
yajñā yeṣāṃ harau kṛṣṇe sādhavo yajñinastu te |||87||
jīvanaṃ śrīharau yeṣāṃ jīvanmuktā hi sādhavaḥ |
rāgo’rpito harau kṛṣṇe vītarāgā hi sādhavaḥ ||88|
indriyārthāḥ kṛtāḥ kṛṣṇe sādhakāḥ sādhavastu te |
pravṛttiṃ parameśe ye kurvanti sādhavo’pi te ||89||
brahma śrīparamātmaiva tatra caranti muktaye |
ye te brahmacarāḥ proktā brahmacāriṇa eva te ||4.43.90||
mananaṃ śrīhareryeṣāṃ munayaḥ sādhavo hi te |
ārṣaṃ jñānaṃ hareryeṣām ṛṣayaḥ sādhavastu te ||9 1 ||
divyabhāvo harau yeṣāṃ devatā api sādhavaḥ |
karma sarvaṃ pare yeṣāṃ parārthāḥ sādhavo’pi te ||92||
vṛttayaḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇe yeṣāṃ te dhyānisādhavaḥ |
samādhānaṃ harau yeṣāṃ samādhisthā hi sādhavaḥ ||93||
kuṭumbaṃ yasya kṛṣṇārthaṃ santaḥ kuṭumbinastu te |
saṃkhyāḥ sarvā harau yeṣāṃ sāṃkhyāste sādhavo matāḥ ||94||
ajñānāt prathamaṃ janma tato jñāne dvitīyakam |
dvijāste sādhavo bodhyā mokṣajñānaparāyaṇāḥ ||95||
dehāttu prathamaṃ janma dīkṣayā tu dvitīyakam |
nārāyaṇe dīkṣitā ye dvijāste sādhavo matāḥ ||96||
saṃsāraḥ prathamaṃ janma mokṣo janma dvitīyakam |
mokṣadvijāḥ sādhavaste sarveṣāṃ tārakā bhuvi ||97||
māyāyāṃ sādhanaṃ tvādyaṃ tataḥ sādhuṣu sādhanam |
ta ete tyāginaḥ santaḥ sarvamāyāvivarjitāḥ ||98||
patiyogaṃ prapannāpi prapannā yā narāyaṇam |
sā patnī strī bhavet sādhvī nārāyaṇī satīśvarī ||99||
udāsīnā gṛhe yā tu nārāyaṇe tu yā sthitā |
sādhusevāparā sādhvī bhavet sā brahmacāriṇī || 4.43.10 0||
ātmasādhanasañcārā mokṣasādhanatatparāḥ |
sakriyāste sādhavo vai kṛṣṇakarmaparāyaṇāḥ || 101 ||
kṛṣṇe śaucaṃ sadā yeṣāṃ śucayaḥ sādhavastu te |
kīrtanaṃ sarvadā kṛṣṇe svādhyāyasādhavastu te ||102||
hareḥ puro bhaved yasyāsanaṃ sādhuḥ sadāsanaḥ |
prāṇe prāṇe hariryasya sādhuḥ prāṇāsanaḥ sa hi || 1 03||
āhāre bhagavān yasya sādhurāhāranāmavān |
śāntirharau bhaved yasya śāntaḥ sādhuḥ sa vai mataḥ ||104||
yoginā śrīharau kṛṣṇe bhavitavyaṃ tu dehinā |
sahanīyaṃ kaṣṭamādyaṃ kṣamā kāryāparādhiṣu || 1 09||
na kaṣṭaṃ sampradātavyaṃ kasyacidapi karmaṇā |
manasā vāpi dehena vacasāpi kadācana || 1 06||
satyaṃ sampālanīyaṃ ca stainyaṃ tyājyaṃ tu yoginā |
santoṣaḥ sarvathā rakṣyo bhāvyaṃ pāṣāṇakalpinā || 1 07||
svādastu sarvathā grāhyo yoginā paramātmani |
ratiḥ prītirharau deyā yoginā brahmacāriṇā || 1 08||
ācāro’pi harau pālyaḥ sādhunā kṛṣṇayoginā |
śrutārthaṃ śrīharau kuryācchrautaḥ sādhuḥ sa yogirāṭ || 1 09||
smṛtārthaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇe yuñjyāt sādhuḥ sa yojakaḥ |
bālyaṃ vā yauvanaṃ vāpi vārdhakyaṃ parameśvare || 4.43.11 0||
naratvaṃ pramadātvaṃ cārpaṇīyaṃ parameśvare |
ta ete sādhavaḥ santi sādhanācchrīpaterhṛdi || 111 ||
bhūtvā sādhava evātra kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā nijaṃ patim |
prayāntu vai narā nāryo dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ prabhoḥ || 112||
adyajanmajayantyasti hyanādiparamātmanaḥ |
vardhitā sā bhavadbhirvai mahotsavena yojitā || 11 3||
bhavatāṃ sindhulokānāṃ karotvabhyudayaṃ param |
paraṃ niḥśreyasaṃ cāpi kalyāṇaṃ paramaṃ tathā || 1 14||
śāśvataṃ ca mahānandaṃ karotu śrīhareḥ pade |
enaṃ tvanādinidhanaṃ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam || 1 15||
sadā dhyāyantu hṛdaye santo bhavantu sādhavaḥ |
sarvavidhāni svargāṇi bhavantu bhavatāmiha || 1 16||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasādatastviha |
prasanno bhagavānnasti bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 1 7||
svasti vo’stu kuśalaṃ vo mahāsvargaṃ sadāstu vaḥ |
mahāvaṃśādivistāro vaiṣṇavo’stu sadā tu vaḥ || 1 18||
bhavatāṃ ca gṛhe kṣetre sādhuvāso’stu mokṣadaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāso bhavatsu ca || 1 19||
ityāśīrvacanānyuktvā prasvaprakāśaḥ īśvaraḥ |
upārarāma yugapajjayanādāstato’bhavan || 4.43.120||
jayatvanādibhagavān bālakṛṣṇo jayatviha |
sarvāntargatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatviha || 121 ||
ityevaṃ jayanādaiśca tūryanādaiḥ surādibhiḥ |
kṛtābhivādanādaiśca sabhā samāptimāgamat || 122||
hariryayau nijāvāsaṃ yayuḥ sarve nijālayān |
koṭirāyo rāyahariṃ natvā kṛṣṇālayaṃ yayau || 1 23||
uvāca paramātmānaṃ yadarthaṃ bhagavānniha |
āhūtaḥ sarvamevātra sampannaṃ nṛpamokṣaṇam || 124|||
śāpamokṣo’tra sañjātaḥ paro mokṣo’pi vartate |
kare gato bhagavato vīkṣaṇena hi dehinām || 125 ||
atha kṛṣṇājñayā rājyaṃ sindhudeśapradeśajam |
ardhamardhaṃ cakratustau hāyaudaryaṃ ca śārkaram ||1 26||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā lebhāte śāśvataṃ sukham |
rātrau bhojanapānādi kṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 1 27||
viśrāntiṃ paramāṃ lebhe siṣevire janāstu tam |
badrike śrīharirnidrāmavāpa divyavigrāhām || 128||
evaṃ siddhiṃ parāṃ divyāṃ dadau tebhyo hariḥ svayam |
hareḥ kṛpā satāṃ yadvā mokṣadā sarvaśāntidā || 1 29||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā tu sādhvī hi mokṣadā |
sarvasiddhimayī vidyā parabrahmaprasañjinī || 4.43.1 30||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne janmajayantyutsave nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ pūjāgrahaṇaṃ bhāṇavāṇīrāyaharyornirāmayatākaraṇaṃ, sabhā, sādhutvavivecanaṃ viśrāntiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||

<4.44>
śrībadrīpriyādevī uvāca
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre naranārāyaṇaprabho |
bālakṛṣṇabhagavato janmajayantikotsavaḥ || 1 ||
kīdṛśo’pyabhavat tatra dvitīyarūpayoginaḥ |
saṃkṣepācchrotucchāmi kathāṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ || 2 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi divyarūpo haristadā |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bahurūpāṇyadhārayat || 3 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ |
lomaśo’pyabhavat sarvamaharṣirūpavām̐stathā || 4 ||
svayaṃprakāśasvarūpaśca dāsadāsīsvarūpavān |
bhaktabhaktānikārūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇastadābhavat || 5 ||
ye ye sindhuṃ gatāsteṣāṃ mūrtidhṛg veṣadhṛk prabhuḥ |
sarvacihnopakaraṇadhṛkprabhustu tadābhavat || 6 ||
viśvakarmā samāhūto nārāyaṇena tatra ca |
brahmā viṣṇurmaheśaśca mahendravaruṇādayaḥ || 7 ||
siddhā maharṣayo muktā muktānikāstatheśvarāḥ |
devā devyaśca bhūdevāścaikaviṃśatikotsave || 8 ||
āyayuḥ śrīhareḥ pūjākaraṇārthaṃ prage tadā |
aṣṭamyāṃ kārtikekṛṣṇe viprāścāpi samāyayuḥ || 9 ||
surāḥ surāṇyo devāśca lokapālāḥ samāyayuḥ |
saurāṣṭravāsinaścānye kṣitidvīpanivāsinaḥ || 4.44.10 ||
janmajayantikāmahotsavaṃ kartuṃ samāyayuḥ |
tadā brahmapriyāḥ sarvā haripriyāśca devatāḥ || 11 ||
śṛṃgāraṃ śrīpatikṛṣṇasvāminaḥ saṃvyadhurmudā |
abhiṣekottaraṃ veṣaṃ bhūṣāśobhāṃ pracakrire || 12||
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle kuṃkumākṣatakardamaiḥ |
kesaraiḥ kastūrikaiśca sugandhisārasaddravaiḥ || 13||
prapūjyārārtrikaṃ cakruḥ puṣpadīpapradānakaiḥ |
āśīrbhirvardhayāmāsuḥ prajñeśaṃ mādhavīpatim || 1 4||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vikuṇṭhāparameśvaram |
upadābhirvividhābhistoṣaṇaṃ tasya saṃvyadhuḥ || 15||
divyajñānā devavaryā āścaryaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ |
sindhutīre haristvāste tathāste’śvasarastaṭe || 16||
nijajanmajayantyā utsavārthaṃ kṛpayā dvidhā |
brahmā nīrājanaṃ cakre, lokapālāḥ pracakrire || 17||
viprā mantrairdravyavaryaiḥ pūjāṃ cakruḥ parātmanaḥ |
evaṃ prātarmahāñjāta usivo’śvasarastaṭe || 18||
bhojanānyabhavam̐ścāpi sāyaṃ sabhābhavacchubhā |
lomaśo divyarūpeṇa sabhākāryaṃ tadā vyadhāt || 1 9||
upādideśa bahudhā saurāṣṭrīyaprajājanān |
utsave cāgatām̐llokān sarvabhūminivāsinaḥ ||4.44.20 ||
lokakalyāṇakartāyaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
ekadhā bahudhā cāste sarvaśreyaḥkṛpāvaśaḥ ||2 1||
sindhudeśe vartate’dya saurāṣṭre cātra vartate |
akṣare parame dhāmni vartate hṛdayeṣu naḥ ||22||
kṣīrākhye sāgare cāste śvetadvīpe’pi vartate |
śrībadaryāśrame cāste kṣetre ca pauruṣottame |||22|||
mūladvāravatīpūryāṃ tathā merau virājate |
bhṛgorgṛhe sa evāste dharmadevagṛhe’pi ca ||24||
vahnau sūrye tayā candre satyaloke virājate |
vaikuṇṭhe śrīpure cāste’vyākṛte cāmṛte pade || 25||
goloke sa hariścāste tathākṣare pare pade |
sarvadhāmasu sarveśaḥ sa evāste hariḥ svayam ||26||
harerjanmotsavaścādyaikaviṃśatiguṇātmakaḥ |
sarvalokeṣu sarvatra mahīyate sthale sthale ||27||
tatra tatrānyarūpeṇa vartate bhagavānayam |
bhaktivaśo hi bhagavān bhajatāmeti bhaktatām ||28||
viguṇo nirguṇo vāpi bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ |
durācāro hyanācāro bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ ||29||
ajñaḥ sujñaśca vijño vā bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ |
nirmalo vā vimalo vā bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ ||4.44.30||
nārī ṣaṇḍho naro vāpi bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ |
devo daityo rākṣaso vā nāgo vā cañcumānapi ||3 1||
sakhuro vā sapuccho vā bhaktaḥ priyaḥ parātmanaḥ |
api māyāmayo dehī māyāyogaparāyaṇaḥ ||32||
cet sa bhakto’nanyabhaktaḥ sa priyaḥ paramātmanaḥ |
kṛṣṇasya sādhanāt sādhuḥ priyaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||33||
vṛddhaścālolupaścāpi tathātmavānnadāmbhikaḥ |
samyagvinītaḥ saralaḥ priya ācārya īśituḥ ||34||
dayāvatāṃ bhajaneṣu sthitānāṃ sutapasvinām |
mayi nyāsavatāṃ snehavatāṃ ca vaśagātmanām ||35||
viraktānāṃ jñānijāṃ ca dāntānāṃ dānināṃ tathā |
satyasthānāmalubdhānāṃ brahmātmabhāvadarśinām ||36||
kṛṣṇabhaktyaviruddhānāṃ prasīdati pareśvaraḥ |
yasyālasyaṃ na vai bhaktau pramādo nāsti sarvathā ||37||
śraddhā ca vartate kṛṣṇe tasmin kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati |
daurmanasyaṃ ca nāstikyaṃ yasminnaivāsti sarvathā || 38||
svārthabuddhirna yasyāsti bhaktau mānaṃ na vidyate |
saṃśayo yasya naivāsti tasmin kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||39||
utsāhasahite nityaṃ saṃsmartari parātmanaḥ |
sevāparāyaṇe bhakte dāse kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||4.44.40||
sarvaśrave sarvadarśinyarthabodhayute’niśam |
sarvasparśavidi bhaktiyute kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||41 ||
sarvāsvādavati divyagandhamātrādisaṃvidi |
seśvarye’nāvaraṇāḍhye bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||42||
jalavāse’nalavāse bhūvāse gahvarasthite |
apyākāśanivāse’pi bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||43||
meghadhāre’dridhāre ca svargadhāre dharādhare |
api bhaktidhare kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdatyeva nānyathā ||44||
dehādagnivinirmāṇaśakte tāpabhayojjhite |
dāhavāraṇaśakte’pi bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||45||
jalamadhye’nalarakṣākare’nale jalagrahe |
bhasmībhūte’pi nirmāṇe śakte bhakte prasīdati ||46||
parakāyapraveśādau śakte parvatadhāraṇe |
pāṇibhyāṃ vāyurodhe ca śakte bhakte prasīdati ||47|||
aṃgulyagranighātena bhūkampe śaktiśālini |
sahasrarūpadhāre’pi bhakte kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||48||
ākāśagamane śakte sarvaśabdāvagāhane |
yathākāmopalambhe ca śakte bhakte prasīdati ||49||
chedane tāḍane bandhe saṃsāraparivartane |
mṛtyorjaye pralaye’pi śakte bhakte prasīdati ||4.44.50 ||
vaitṛṣṇye vartamāno’pi kṛṣṇalīlāparo na cet |
kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnaścet kṛṣṇo nātra prasīdati ||51||
ākāśe krīḍate yaśca sūkṣmānarthān samṛcchati |
sarvarutajñatāṃ yāti bhaktiṃ cenna karoti saḥ ||52| |
tasmin śuṣke jane kṛṣṇaḥ kadāpi na prasīdati |
tejorūpāṇi sarvāṇi yastu yadyapi paśyati ||53||
devabimbānyanekāni vimānānyapi paśyati |
paśyati brahmaviṣṇvindrayamāgnivaruṇeśvarān ||54||
grahanakṣatratārāśca pātālabhuvanānyapi |
yadyātmānaṃ parātmānaṃ snehabhaktyā na paśyati ||55||
ātmavidyāvihīnaścet kṛṣṇasevojjhitastathā |
sattvaprasādahīnaśca kṛṣṇakṛpāmṛtojjhitaḥ ||56||
sādhusevāvihīnaścet tasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam |
aśāśvataṃ kālabhojyaṃ tasyānte vai nirarthakam ||57|||
anaiśvaryaṃ tathājñānaṃ hyadharmo rāga ityamī |
yatra syuḥ so’pi bhaktaścet tasmin kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ||58||
bhaktyā tuṣyati sarveśo bhaktihīne na tuṣyati |
sādhusevāpare kṛṣṇo viśeṣeṇa pratuṣyati ||59||
sādhvīsevāparāyāṃ tu nāryāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sadā
santuṣṭo bhavati prabhākṛṣṇo dayāluracyutaḥ ||4.44.60||
paiśācaṃ bandhanaṃ kāmo rākṣasaṃ bandhanaṃ striyaḥ |
yākṣaṃ tu bandhanaṃ dravyaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||6 1 ||
gāndharvaṃ bandhana nāṭyaṃ māhendraṃ mandirāṇi vai |
saumyaṃ tu bandhanaṃ kīrtistattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||62||
sauraṃ tu bandhanaṃ sattā prājāpatyaṃ tu vaṃśajāḥ |
vaidhasaṃ bandhanaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||63||
patistu bandhanaṃ raudraṃ sampado vaiṣṇavaṃ tu tat |
vāsanā bandhanaṃ yāmyaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||64||
dānavaṃ bandhanaṃ lobho tṛṣṇā daiteyabandhanam |
viṣayā bandhanaṃ sārpaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||65||
āgneyaṃ bandhanaṃ vairaṃ dveṣo nairṛtamucyate |
bandhanaṃ nārakaṃ śaiśnaṃ yaunaṃ garbhaṃ tu bandhanam ||66||
pratiṣṭhā bandhanaṃ daurgaṃ gauravaṃ tattu rauravam |
gārvaṃ tu bandhanaṃ bhautaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||67||
vicchidya śithilīkṛtya jīrṇīkṛtya vināśya ca |
bandhanāni vinirbandho yastasmim̐stuṣyati prabhuḥ ||68||
puṇyaṃ tu bandhanaṃ vārṣaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tattu daivatam |
brāhmaṃ sattvotkarṣarūpaṃ tattyāge tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||69||
nirguṇaṃ bandhanaṃ kārṣṇaṃ bhaktirnirvāṇabandhanam |
bandhanaṃ sat sādhusevā tadgrahe tuṣyati prabhuḥ ||4.44.70||
varṣmaṇā manasā dravyaiḥ sevanīyā hi sādhavaḥ |
sādhvyaḥ sarvārpaṇaiḥ sevyā mokṣadā hi prasāditāḥ ||7 1 ||
hariḥ satsu ca sādhvīṣu vartate mūrtimānapi |
sarvakāmaprapūro naḥ sevanīyaḥ sa tadgataḥ ||72||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
japanīyaḥ sadā caivaṃ mantrātmā parameśvaraḥ ||73||
hṛdaye rakṣaṇīyo’yaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ |
mokṣāmṛtamahānandapradātā kṛṣṇayogakṛt ||74||
kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī mamādastīti smartavyaḥ sarvadā hariḥ |
sarvavāñchitadātāyaṃ sākṣād bhavati sarvathā ||75|||
dānaṃ deyaṃ haraye vai vrataṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ kṛte |
tapastapyaṃ tu kṛṣṇārthaṃ yogaḥ sādhyo hareḥ kṛte ||76||
makhaḥ kāryastu kṛṣṇārthaṃ tīrthaṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ kṛte |
japaḥ kāryastu kṛṣṇārthaṃ snehaḥ kāryo hareḥ kṛte ||77||
satkarmāṇi samastāni kartavyāni hareḥ kṛte |
ātmasaṃśodhanaṃ kāryaṃ śrīkṛṣṇārthaṃ sadā śubham ||78||
divyabhāvo grahītavyo mokṣārthaṃ harimandire |
sevā satāṃ svātmavattu kartavyā kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ||79||
ākṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ sevanīyaṃ vimuktaye |
kuṃkumavāpikā sevyānādikṛṣṇasya labdhaye ||4.44.80 ||
raktaṃ tu kuṃkumakṣetraṃ śvetaṃ cāśvasarovaram |
kṛṣṇakṣetramanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||81 ||
trayaṃ sevyaṃ sadā bhaktyā prītyā sattvena śraddhayā |
prītiśca kaukumaṃ kṣetraṃ sattvaṃ tvaśvasarovaram |||82||
śraddhā kṛṣṇamayī bodhyā tryātmakaṃ mokṣasādhanam |
prītiḥ kṛṣṇe sadāsaktiḥ sattvaṃ kṛṣṇe nijasthitiḥ ||83||
śraddhā kṛṣṇe’rpaṇaṃ naijaṃ tryātmakaṃ mokṣasādhanam |
raktatā kuṃkumaṃ kṛṣṇe śvetatā ca raso harau ||84||
kṛṣṇatā karṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe tryātmakaṃ mokṣasādhanam |
mayi kṣetre harī rakto mayi sāre ito hariḥ ||85||
mayi kṛṣyāṃ harirvaptastato’haṃ harireva hi |
tādātmyaṃ hariṇā sākaṃ haryātmāhaṃ samaśnuve ||86||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisarvānandabhṛtaprabhum |
evaṃ nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe kartavyo yoga uttamaḥ ||87||
bhavapāre’tisaṃsāratārake parameśvare |
svasti vo’stu svāgataṃ vo vidāyaṃ vo bhavatvapi ||88||
kṣamāpanīyo bhagavān sammāne laukike kṛte |
ityuktvā lomaśaḥ sāyaṃ sabhāntaṃ prākarot tadā ||89||
bhuktvā pītvā ca haryājñāṃ nītvā yayurnijālayān |
rātrau sammānitāḥ samyag bhojitāḥ pūjitā api ||4.44.90||
sevitā nidritā mahīmānāḥ prātaryayustataḥ |
praśaṃsanto harernāma lomaśasyopadeśanam ||91 ||
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca kambharāśrīṃ ca mātaram |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tathā cāśvasarovaram ||92||
praśaṃsanto hariṃ svargādikaṃ yayuḥ sureśvarāḥ |
ityevaṃ badrike tatra janmajayantikotsavaḥ ||93||
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmanā |
kṛto manoharaḥ śreṣṭho lomaśena maharṣiṇā ||94||
brahmādyā devatāstūrṇaṃ sāyaṃ vimānatastataḥ |
saurāṣṭraṃ samparityajyāyayuḥ sindhupradeśakān ||95||
yatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāste tu śārkare |
nagare sindhuje deśe yatrāste lomaśo muniḥ ||96||
svaprakāśo’pi yatrāste saṃhitāvācako muniḥ |
yatra lakṣmīśasaṃhitāpārāyaṇaṃ bhavatyapi ||97||
yatra yajño vartate ca ṛṣayaḥ santi saṃhitāḥ |
tatrāgatya hariṃ nemuḥ pupūjuḥ śrutivallabham ||98||
jayaśabdān pracakruśca jayantīmaha ācāran |
upadāśca nyadhuḥ kṛṣṇapādayoḥ punarityapi ||99||
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhū rātrau sevāṃ cakruḥ sukhapradām |
rātriṃ ninyurmānitāste bhojitāḥ svāgatādibhiḥ ||4.44.10 0||
toṣitāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sarvadevatāḥ |
prātargantuṃ prasannāḥ saṃgṛhyājñāṃ paramātmanaḥ || 101||
āśīrvādānnṛpādīṃśca prayujya prayayurdivam |
prātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇabhagavān snānavidhiṃ samācaran || 102|
utsavā gītayaḥ kīrtanāni vādyaninādanam |
bhāṭacāraṇabandīnāṃ stutayaḥ parito’bhavan || 103||
ityevaṃ badrike sarvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam |
ākṣaraṃ tu yathā kṣetraṃ saindhavaṃ tattathābhavat ||1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre’pi dvitīyarūpeṇaikaviṃśatitamajanmajayantīdinotsave śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyopasthitirlomaśasyopadeśo devādīnāṃ mahotsavavinirvartanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||

<4.45>
śrībadrīpriyovācabhagavan karuṇāsindho sindhudeśe tataḥ param |
kiṃkiṃ cakāra bhagavān vada me sarvamañjasā || 1 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
prātarutthāya bhagavān navamyāṃ snānamācarat |
veṣaṃ bhūṣāśca śṛṃgāraṃ yogyaṃ sarvaṃ dadhāra ha || 2 ||
tadā tūryāṇyavādyanta strīṇāṃ ca gītayo’bhavan |
stāvakānāṃ giraścāpyaśrūyanta maṅgaloditāḥ || 3 ||
vaidikānāṃ mantraghoṣā abhavan maṇḍapāntike |
yantraśabdā abhavam̐śca kṛṣṇaprabodhasūcakāḥ || 4 ||
ṛṣayo munayaḥ santaḥ pūjārthaṃ tatra cāyayuḥ |
apūjayan parameśaṃ yathālabdhopacārakaiḥ || 5 ||
atha nāryo rājapatnyaḥ pūjārthaṃ tatra cāyayuḥ |
apūjayan hariṃkṛṣṇaṃ mūrtiṃ tāṃ hṛdaye nyadhuḥ || 6 ||
atha rājādayastatra pūjanārthaṃ samāyayuḥ |
bahumūlyopacāraistaṃ prāpūjayan mahīśvarāḥ || 7 ||
prajā nāryo narāstatrāyayurviprāśca devatāḥ |
pūjanārthaṃ bhagavantamapūjayan vidhānataḥ || 8 ||
sarvalokā hariṃ pūjayitvā kṛtārthino’bhavan |
tataḥ prāvartata dugdhapānaṃ ca bhojanādikam || 9 ||
tāmbūlārpaṇamevānte vidāyaṃ ca tato’bhavat |
koṭirāyo rāyahariḥ prāghurṇikebhya ādarāt || 4.45.10||
pāritoṣikamutkṛṣṭaṃ pṛthag dadaturutsukau |
mahīmānā yayurnaijān deśān vimānakaistataḥ || 11 ||
saṃhitāyā vācanārthaṃ kṛṣṇa ādiśya sevakam |
svaprakāśaṃ ca sahasārārtrikaṃ saṃvidhāya ca || 1 2||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kṛtvā ca pūjanam |
sajjo’bhavannijaṃ kṣetraṃ gantuṃ śrīkuṃkumākṣaram || 1 3||
tāvattatra samāyāto rājā kacchapradeśajaḥ |
nāmnā mādhavarāyeti prārthayat parameśvaram || 14||
nārāyaṇasarastīraṃ pāvayituṃ ca kacchakam |
bhujaṃganagaraṃ pāvayituṃ cārthayadīśvaram || 15||
tathā maharṣayo nārāyaṇasaronivāsinaḥ |
dharmamokṣāyanādyāśca prārthayan parameśvaram || 16||
haristathāstviti prāha prasthitastaiḥ samaṃ tadā |
sarvaiḥ prasthāpitaḥ sindhubhūbhṛdbhiḥ svīyasajjanaiḥ || 17||
svakīyena vimānena vidāyamānamānitaḥ |
ambareṇa yathā tūrṇamāyayau kacchabhūtalam || 18||
nārāyaṇasarastīre’vātarat sa vimānataḥ |
sasnau kṛtvā paraṃ tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 1 9||
tīrthatīre niṣasāda yāvattāvattu śaṃkaraḥ |
āyayau pārvatīyukto bhraman kacche tu paścimāt ||4.45.20||
śvetarūpaṃ dharan śiṣyaiścaturbhiḥ saha mānasaiḥ |
sanandena nandanena viśvanandanakena ca ||2 1||
upanandena sahitaḥ sadyojātābhidho haraḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamam ||22|
pupūja daṇḍavattatra praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ |
tuṣṭāva paramātmānaṃ mokṣadaṃ lokarakṣakam || 23||
nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇa pāvitaṃ śrīsarovaram |
tava nāpnā parāṃ khyātiṃ yathā gacchet tathā kuru ||24||
harirjagāda viśveśaṃ śaṃbho nārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ |
śrīsaraśceti yat pūrvaṃ nārāyaṇasaro’dhunā ||21||
khyātiṃ yāsyati caitadvai purorvaśyā tu pāvitam |
ūrvaśītīrthametacca caṭakātīrthamityapi ||26||
śrītīrthaṃ ca tathā sadyojātatīrthaṃ pramuktidam |
nārāyaṇamahātīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||27|||
vāso’tra te mahādevasadyojāta bhavatviti |
sadyojātamahātīrthaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati || 28||
kālāntare ca te nāmānyaparāṇi śubhāni vai |
bhaviṣyantīti tīrthaṃ tat koṭīśvaraṃ bhaviṣyati ||29||
ityuktvā bhagavān śaṃbhuṃ nivāsāya sarastaṭe |
ājñāṃ cakāra tatraiva śaṃbhurvāsaṃ sadākarot || 4.45.30||
tāvattatra samāyātā divyā gauḥ śvetalohitā |
catuḥśṛṃgī caturvaktrā catuṣpādā caturmukhī ||3 1 ||
caturhastā caturnetrā caturdaṃṣṭrā catuḥstanī |
nanāma pādayostūrṇaṃ vyomnā cāgatya vai puraḥ || 3 2||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādatale lileha jihvayā |
harirvāri dadau tasyai jihvāyāṃ sā papau drutam ||33||
kumārī sābhavattatra viśvarūpā sarasvatī |
tuṣṭāva paramātmānaṃ śrīpativallabhaṃnijam ||34||
namo’nādikṛṣṇakānta ramākānta ca te namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīmāṇikīkānta lakṣmīkānta ca te namaḥ || 35||
namaḥ sarasvatīkānta rādhākānta ca te namaḥ |
sukhadāśrīkānta padmāvatīkānta ca te namaḥ ||36 ||
ahaṃ śaktirbhavān śaktaḥ kṛṣṇāhaṃ kṛṣṇa te namaḥ |
ahaṃ bhagavatī bhāryā bhagavām̐stvaṃ patiḥ prabhuḥ ||37||
tapastaptaṃ samāyātā golokāttu tavājñayā |
pāvanīṃ māṃ samājñāpya sthāpayātra sarastaṭe ||38||
tīrthaṃ tvatra hare kṛṣṇa mannāmnāpi vidhehi ca |
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha badrike tāṃ sarasvatīm ||39||
asthāpayat sarastīre mahādhenuṃ sarasvatīm |
nārāyaṇasarastīre tīrthaṃ sārasvataṃ śubham ||4.45.40 ||
pāvanaṃ sarvalokānāmabhavat snānamātrataḥ |
jñānadaṃ cātmabodhādipradaṃ brahmāvabodhadam ||41 ||
tasyā nāmāni bhagavām̐ścakāra pāvanānyapi |
gopī māyā ca vidyā ca kṛṣṇā haimavatī satī ||42||
pradhānā śrīḥ prakṛtiśca viśvamātā narāyaṇī |
maheśvarī śvetaraktā dvādaśeti śubhāni vai ||43||
evaṃ nāmāni samprāpya tīre sāpi tiro’bhavat |
tāvattatrāpi puruṣaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ samāyayau ||44||
sahasraśīrṣā viśvātmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadevamayaḥ prabhuḥ||45||
sakaustubhaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmādihetimān |
tuṣṭāva daṇḍavat kṛtvānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||46||
namo’nantasvarūpāya sarvakāraṇacāriṇe |
pareśāya parakṛṣṇasvarūpāya ca te namaḥ ||47||
parabrahmaṇe kṛṣṇāya parameśāya te namaḥ |
vāsudeveśa kṛṣṇeśa nārāyaṇeśa te namaḥ ||48||
brahmeśasarvamukteśākṣareśa te namo namaḥ |
sarvadhāmādhipataye namaste paramātmane ||49||
mādṛśā viṣṇavo’nantā udbhavanti madaṃśataḥ |
taṃ vande parameśeśeśvareśvareśvareśvaram ||4.45.50||
bhagavan sarvadeveśa kālamāyeśa sarvadā |
tīrthe nārāyaṇasarovare tvatpādapāvite ||51 ||
sadyojātena devena sthātumicchāmi sarvadā |
māmatra sthāpaya kṛṣṇa lokakalyāṇahetave ||92||
tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha viṣṇurvāsaṃ sadākarot |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasmai sthāpayāmāsa pippale ||53||
sahasraśīrṣaplakṣākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ hyabhūt |
tīro’bhavat plakṣavṛkṣe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ prabhuḥ ||54||
athāyayau vyomadeśāt śmaśrulaḥ puṣṭarūpavān |
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sarvātmā sarvasṛṣṭiprabījavān ||55||
bhartā hartā jagatkartā brahmā sarvāṇḍasarjakaḥ |
neme nārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ papāta pādayostathā ||56||
tuṣṭāva svāgataṃ prāptaḥ śrīpatiṃkṛṣṇakeśavam |
harikṛṣṇa hariviṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ||57||
sarvasvāmin sarvadhāmin sarvaśaktipradāyaka |
sarvarakṣāvidhātastvaṃ nārāyaṇo’tra cāgataḥ ||58||
kalyāṇārthaṃ tu lokānāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāvanāya ca |
nārāyaṇe sarasyatra śaṃbhurviṣṇuḥ sarasvatī |||59||
yathā vāsaṃ vyadhustadvad vāsaṃ me rocate’pi ca |
ājñāpaya pratiṣṭhāṃ me kurvatra bhagavanniha ||4.45.60||
tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha badrike parameṣṭhinam |
brahmā tatra palāśe tu drume vāsaṃ tadākarot ||61 ||
raktavastro’bhavad vṛkṣo raktapuṣpāvaśobhitaḥ |
pāvanaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yajñānāmupakārakṛt ||62||
evaṃ devā avasan vai lokakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ |
badrike ca tatastatrāścaryaṃ paramamadbhutam ||63||
abhavad tat divyarūpaṃ samākarṇaya śobhanam |
śabalāśvāścaharyaśvāḥ putrā vai vedhasaḥ purā ||64||
nāradasyopadeśena vairāgyaṃ samupāśritāḥ |
saptadaśasahasrāṇi tapo’rthaṃ tatra ye sthitāḥ ||65||
sarve nārāyaṇaṃkṛṣṇaṃ prāpya tatra puro’bhavan |
tāpasā jaṭilāḥ śuṣkāḥ karamālāvirājinaḥ ||66||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminārāyaṇajapānvitāḥ |
prasannamānasā divyatejaḥparidhiśobhanāḥ ||67||
pratyāhṛtendriyavegā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ |
śāntā nirguṇarādheśasmaraṇe dhṛtamānasāḥ ||68||
bālasvarūpiṇaścāpi puṣṭā yauvanaśālinaḥ |
saṃkīrtanaṃ prakurvantaḥ kūrdayanto’tiharṣitāḥ ||69||
karatālaiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmītivādinaḥ |
aho aho hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ||4.45.70||
kalyāṇakṛnmahākṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vibho prabho |
evaṃ raṭantaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hyupasthitāḥ ||71 ||
praṇemurdaṇḍavadbhaktyā dhūlīṃ te śirasi nyadhuḥ |
dhūlyāmāloṭayantaste kṛṣṇapādajalaṃ papuḥ ||72||
tuṣṭuvuḥ śrīhariṃ tatra evam hṛdayārpaṇaiḥ |
nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇa mokṣārthaṃ vayamāgatāḥ ||73||
bhavān mokṣapradaścāste dehi mokṣaṃ bhavārṇavāt |
vayaṃ sarve brahmaputrāḥ śiṣyā nāradayoginaḥ ||74||
pratīkṣamāṇāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vasāmo’tra japānvitāḥ |
daivād vā kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa bhavāniha ||75||
no mokṣārthaṃ samāyāto dehi mokṣapadaṃ param |
śrutvā prāha haristām̐stu mokṣaṃ dadāmi śāśvatam ||76||
brahmatulyāḥ samarthāḥ stha naikarūpadharāḥ parāḥ |
tāpasā manniyogena mūlarūpaistu sarvathā ||77||
divyatāṃ muktatāṃ prāpya yāntu dhāmākṣaraṃ mama |
dvitīyastu svarūpaivaiṃ tiṣṭhantu cāṃśatastviha ||78||
nārāyaṇaparā nityaṃ devasevāparāyaṇāḥ |
tīrthasya munayo bhūtvā tiṣṭhantvatra sadā sthirāḥ ||79||
ityuktā badrike te tu dvedhārūpāstadābhavan |
aṃśato munirūpāste mūlato muktarūpiṇaḥ ||4.45.80 ||
munirūpā nyavataiṃste nārāyaṇasarastaṭe |
muktarūpā divyarūpā cāgate suvimānake ||8 1 ||
pārṣadairdivyadehaiste niṣadyākṣaradhāma me |
prayayurmuktatāṃ prāptāḥ śāśvatānandabhojinaḥ ||82||
kṛpayā me samastāste jātā matsamaśaktayaḥ |
evaṃ hi badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo narāyaṇān ||83||
mādṛśān sarvathā kṛtvā tatastīrthasthitān janān |
pāvayitvā pradāyāpi dānavastu yatheṣṭakam ||84||
tīrthottamaṃ saraḥ kṛtvā niṣadya svavimānake |
bhujaṃganagare sāyaṃ prāyayau rājavāṭikām ||85||
avātarad vimānaṃ tu tadā vai rājavāṭikā |
śṛṃgāritābhavat tūryaninādairabhigarjitā ||86||
sammānakaralokaiśca tathā rājakuṭumbibhiḥ |
prajābhiḥ svāgatārthaṃ sā vāṭikā saṃkulā hyabhūt ||87||
harirvimānatastatra yadā vai bahirāyayau |

kuṃkumākṣatavarṣābhirvardhayāmāsuracyutam |
jayaśabdairmahāharṣakṛtairnārāyaṇābhidhaiḥ ||89 ||
