ghaṭikāmātramevādau sthito vimānakāgrake ||4.45.9 0||
datvā svadarśanaṃ kṛṣṇo viveśa nṛpamandiram |
rājā mādhavarāyaśca rājñī kalyāṇikā satī ||9 1 ||
pupūjatuḥ pareśaṃ taṃ papatuḥ pādavāryapi |
pūjayitvopacāraiśca mukuṭādyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ||92||
veṣaiścātipramūlyaiśca svarṇaratnādihīrakaiḥ |
maṇibhiḥ svarṇamudrābhiḥ prapūjyārārtrikaṃ tataḥ ||9 3||
vyadhātāṃ bhāvabhinnau tau rājyavargāstataḥ param |
pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ yathārhabhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ||94||
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruste tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram |
saṃsārād bhagavan kṛṣṇa jīvānnastārayaprabho ||95||
sākṣāttava prasaṃgena yadi divyā vayaṃ nahi |
tadā keṣāṃ prasaṃgena vayaṃ divyā bhavemahi ||96||
śrutvā haristu tānprāha satāṃ saṃgena divyatā |
bhaviṣyati na sandeho mokṣo vaśca bhaviṣyati ||97||
mayā nārāyaṇatīrthe rakṣitāḥ śabalāśvakāḥ |
haryaśvakā brahmaputrāḥ sādhavaste madāśrayāḥ |||98||
matto mantraṃ ca samprāptā bhajante māṃ nirantaram |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||99||
evaṃvidhaṃ tu me mantraṃ dāsyanti vo vidhānataḥ |
tatra yūthaṃ prāpya tīrthaṃ prayāsyatha paraṃ padam || 4.45.1 00||
sajjā bhūtvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā natvā ca tān sataḥ |
sevitvā tān bhajanena prayāsyatha paraṃ padam || 101 ||
ye sajjāstaiḥ pragantavyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ cānivartinam |
ityuktvā badrike kṛṣṇa uṣitvaikaniśāṃ sukham || 1 02||
bhojanaṃ pūjanaṃ labdhvā rājñe rājñyai manuṃ nijam |
datvā sevāṃ parāṃ prāpya prātarutthāya mādhavaḥ || 10 3||
naijaṃ vimānamāruhya yayau kuṃkumavāpikām |
viśrāntiṃ paramāṃ prāpto nārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ || 1 04||
sindhuvārtāṃ kacchavārtāṃ cakāra janasaṃsadi |
snānapūjābhojanādi cakre śāntimavāpa ha || 10 5||
ityevaṃ badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ |
divyaṃ caritraṃ subhagaṃ mokṣadaṃ pracakāra ha || 1 06||
sarvaṃ te kathitaṃ ramyaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktibhāg bhavet || 1 07||
api pāpo vicittaśca dharmavarjita ityapi |
śrutvā labdhvā guṇaṃ yacchet svargaṃ divyayugāyutam || 1 08||
kā kathā tu tadānyasya sevino bhaktiyoginaḥ |
yatheṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dadyāt kṛpākaraḥ || 1 09||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kacchanṛpatirmādhavarāyo hariṃ kacchamāniyāya, harirnārāyaṇasarasi śivaviṣṇuvedhaḥsarasvatīnāṃ tīrthāni kṛtavān, śabalāśvaharyaśvānāṃ dvedhā rūpāṇi kārayitvā tīrthe vāsaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca dattavān, bhujaṃganagare mādhavarāyanṛpatikuṭumbaṃ pāvayitvā kuṃkumavāpīmāyayau ceti nirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||

śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kusārajātiyoṣitaḥ |
satkathāṃ pāvanīṃ tatra mokṣadāṃ bhaktisaṃbhṛtām || 1 ||
sindhudeśe tu ye bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritāḥ |
abhavam̐ste militvā vai kecit saṃghātmakāstataḥ || 2 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇe śubhe |
kārtike śuklapakṣe vai prātaścaikādaśīdine || 3 ||
pūjanārthaṃ saṃhitāyā āyayuścopadākarāḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā dāsāśca dāsikāḥ || 4 ||
yāvantaḥ puṣpahārādyaiḥ kuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ |
dhūpadīpasunaivedyairānarcuḥ saṃhitāśriyam || 5 ||
ārārtrikaphalapuṣpāñjalisvarṇārpaṇaistathā |
maṇiratnahīrakādyaiḥ svarṇabhūṣāmbarādibhiḥ || 6 ||
te svaprakāśaṃ vyāsaṃ cānarcuḥ sarve tathāvidhaiḥ |
divyottamairupacāraistataḥ śrīkṛṣṇakīrtanam || 7 ||
cakrurvādyaviśeṣāḍhyaṃ tālikānādagarbhitam |
hare kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho || 8 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkānta sadvibho |
evaṃ dhūnye prabhavati magnānāṃ sarvadehinām || 9 ||
ekāgramānasānāṃ vai tadāścaryaṃ mahaddhyabhūt |
vimānamāgataṃ divyaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham ||4.46.10||
tatraikā dyotikānāmnī kaṃsārī divyavigrahā |
bhūtvāruhya vimāne sā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ param || 1 1||
śrībadrīpriyovācakā sā vai dyotikānāmnī kathaṃ sā divyavigrahā |
kena puṇyena sā yātā dhāmākṣaraṃ tu tadvada || 12||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi sāsīd vai karmacāriṇī |
bhṛtyā dāsī vetanena rāyaharernṛpasya vai || 1 3||
jātyā śūdrā hi kaṃsārī pātramañjanakāriṇī |
mārjanādiparā tatra nṛparājñyāstu kiṃkarī || 14||
bhaktāsīt pūjane kārṣṇe kaṃsārī tu kusāriṇī |
nityaṃ sā śṛṇute lakṣmīsaṃhitāṃ niyamānvitā || 15||
rājñīkāryāṇi nirvartya derahakāryāṇi sarvathā |
rājñyālayasamastāni kāryāṇi pravidhāya sā ||16||
kṛtasnānajapapūjā kṛtadāsyasamastikā |
kṛtādarā bhaktiniṣṭhā kathāyāmupatiṣṭhate || 17||
puṣpahāreṇa sahitāṃ puṣpahāreṇa vācakam |
kuṃkumākṣatamudrābhiḥ samarcayati nityaśaḥ || 18||
karamālā sthiracittā natvā vyāsaṃ sabhāṃ tataḥ |
śravaṇārthā sabhāyāṃ sā niṣīdati hyatandritā || 19||
tasyāḥ patiḥ kusāro’pi kṛṣṇasārābhidhaḥ sadā |
kathāṃ śrotuṃ samāyāti śīghraṃ yāti ca karmaṇe ||4.46.20||
rājasevāparaḥ patnyāḥ kāryaṃ śeṣaṃ karoti saḥ |
patnī bhāvaprapūrṇā sā kathāḥ śṛṇoti sarvathā ||2, ||
śratvā sandhārya rātrau svasvāmine kathayatyapi |
evaṃvidhādaraparā kathāśravaṇamātrataḥ ||22||
pāvanī sā tu saṃbhūtā sarvapāpavivarjitā |
tayā mantro harestatra gṛhīto vyāsataḥ śubhaḥ ||23||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
nityaṃ mantraṃ japati sā tathā karoti kīrtanam ||24||
harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīparameśvara |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ||25||
evaṃ karoti bhajanaṃ bhojanaṃ caikavārakam |
prasādaṃ vā phalādyaṃ vā gṛhṇātyeva na cāparam ||26||
evaṃ vai vartamānayāḥ kaṃsāryāḥ pāpamocanam |
puṇyānāmudayaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasannatā ||27||
sarvaṃ jātaṃ svabhāvena guroḥ karoti sevanam |
svapanaṃ gātrasaṃvāhaṃ vastrakṣālanakādikam ||28||
vyāsasevāprapuṇyena bhaktibale pravardhitā |
vyāsāsanādiklṛptyā ca sabhāsthalādimārjanāt ||29||
mahāpuṇyapratāpena karmakṣayo vyajāyata |
dehatyāgasamayo’syāḥ prāptastadā hariḥ svayam ||4.46.30||
vimānaṃ divyamāruhya svayaṃ netuṃ samāyayau |
divyadṛśāṃ gocaro vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||31 ||
kirīṭī kuṇḍalī cakrī vāsasvī śrīsamanvitaḥ |
prabhāsayan diśāḥ sarvā āgatya tu kathāsthale ||32||
avatīrya vimānāt sa tāṃ jagrāha kare hariḥ |
sāpi dehaṃ bhautikaṃ vai tyaktvā natvā sabhāṃ tathā ||33||
svataḥprakāśaṃ divyaṃ svaṃ sadguruṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam |
lomaśaṃ ca muniṃ sādhūnanyānnatvā punaḥ punaḥ || 34||
yācitvā ca kṣamāṃ divyadehā muktānikā śubhā |
divyā kārṣṇī kṛṣṇatulyā rādhātulyā manoharā ||35||
bhūtvā vimānamāruhya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānvitā |
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ paśyatāṃ divyacakṣuṣām ||36||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tadvai kathāśravaṇasatphalam |
abhavadvai tathā badri mahāmokṣapradaṃ param ||37||
kusāriṇī dyotikā sā kaṃsārī kṛṣṇasāriṇī |
prasañjātā yathā ladamīrdivye dhānni vyarājata ||38||
evaṃ tadā bahavo vai narā nāryaśca pāvanāḥ |
kathāṃ śrutvābhavan loke jīvanmuktā hareḥ priyāḥ ||39||
amṛtaṃ bheṣajaṃ badri karotyeva nirāmayam |
kṛṣṇāmṛtaṃ tu māyānāṃ rogānnāśayati drutam ||4.46.40 ||
satāṃ sevā guroḥ sevā bhaktiśca bhajanaṃ hareḥ |
ātmano divyatāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kurvantyeva pramokṣaṇam ||41 ||
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi sāyaṃ tvekādaśītithau |
ūrje tatra mahāścaryamaparaṃ saṃvyajāyata ||42||
kulālasya kuṭumbaṃ vai sevāyāṃ sarvathābhavat |
kuṃbhakāro nararājastathā bhāryāsya rakṣikā ||43||
putrāḥ putryaḥ samastā vai pārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ nityaṃ vai sevate tatsabhāsthalam ||44||
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe jalapānaṃ dadātyatīva śītalam |
pātrāṇāṃ bhañjanaṃ vāyovyajanaiḥ supradānakam ||45||
āstaraṇāstaraṇādi rajasāṃ mārjanādikam |
kathānte riktabhāve tvāstaraṇānāṃ pramoḍanam ||46||
rakṣaṇaṃ ca sthale yogye kaccarādinikāsanam |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ darśanādikam ||47||
kulālasya kuṭumbaṃ vai sarvaṃ prasevate sabhām |
kathāṃ śṛṇute nityaṃ tad bhajate pārvatīpatim ||48||
evaṃ dhvastāghamevāto mantraṃ jagrāha sadguroḥ |
vyāsāt prāptvā harernāmamāhātmyaṃ ca tataḥ param ||49||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
mantraṃ jepuḥ kulālāste bhajanaṃ cakrire mudā ||4.46.50||
harekṛṣṇa prabhokṛṣṇa bālanārāyaṇa prabho |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pāraṃ kuru prabho ||51 ||
mālāvartanamācakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca |
sevāṃ cakruḥ sabhāyāste vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ ||52||
tena dagdhāni pāpāni teṣāṃ ca vāsanākṣayaḥ |
janmamṛtyupravāhasyādhikāro nāśatāṃ gataḥ ||53||
sāyaṃ kathānte dhunyānte bhajanānte hareḥ puraḥ |
sabhāntike kuṭumbaṃ tat samastaṃ divyabhāvanam ||54||
śrīhareḥ kṛpayā divyadehaṃ jātaṃ drutaṃ tadā |
tāvat tatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ vyomamārgataḥ |||55||
yatra nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo rādhāyukto’bhavat prabhuḥ |
prakāśayan diśaḥ sarvā vimānāt samavātarat ||56||
bhūmau tatra kulālāgre paśyatāṃ divyacakṣuṣām |
sarvān vidhāya bhagavān kulālāt divyavigrahān ||57||
vimāne sve hyavasthāpya parāścaryaṃ prasārayan |
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ divyaṃ kṛpālurbhaktavatsalaḥ ||58||
kulālānāṃ sthūladehā nādṛśyanta tadā bhuvi |
sthūlāste divyatāṃ prāptāḥ sevayā śrīguroḥ satām ||5 9 ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ sevayā ca kathāyāḥ sevanāttathā |
bhaktyā dhyānena kṛṣṇasya kārṣṇatāṃ te yayustadā ||4.46.60||
lakṣaśo vai janāstatrāścaryamagnāstato’bhavan |
aho kathāyā māhātmyaṃ badrike divyamokṣakṛt ||6 1 ||
śṛṇu rātrau tato jātaṃ mahāścaryaṃ vadāmi te |
rātryārambhe kīrtanaṃ vai cakrire sarvavaiṣṇavāḥ ||6 2||
ekādaśyā jāgaraṇe yayuḥ kṛṣṇaikatānatām |
vādyayukte kīrtane vai premamagnāstadābhavan ||63||
tatraikā svarṇakārastrī dhātudhmastrī tathāparā |
sumbālikābhidhā cādyā parā nāmnā vinodinī ||64||
kīrtayantyau sahasaiva tanmayyau cittarodhatām |
prāpyaikatānatāṃ labdhvā samādhiṃ bhejaturdrutam ||65||
tayoragre’bhavattejomayī mūrtiḥ sanātanī |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yauvanānvitā ||66||
ramaṇīyā sūryacandravahnividyutsamaprabhā |
dedīpyamānā subhagā puṣṭā sarvāṃgasundarī ||67||
vimānaṃ divyatejomacchobhanaṃ paramādbhutam |
tatrādṛśyata vai rātrau bhūtale harisannidhau ||68||
pārṣadairbahubhiryuktaṃ muktānikābhiśobhitam |
cakṣuṣmatāṃ darśanārhaṃ sarveṣāṃ dṛṣṭigocaram ||69||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām |
pasparśa te striyau dakṣakareṇa yāvadeva hi ||4.46.70||
tāvadvidyutsame śvete cojjvale te babhūvatuḥ |
divyarūpe divyabhūṣādhare divyasuvigrahe ||71||
tayordehau bhautikau tu tatraivādṛśyatāṃ gatau |
divyadehau suniṣpannau śubhau rādhāramāsamau ||72||
yuvatyau te hariṃ natvāruruhaturvimānakam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo drutaṃ hasan hariḥ ||73 ||
svaṃ vimānamadhiruhya nītvā te muktayoṣitau |
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ tūrṇaṃ divyenāmbaravartmanā ||74||
evaṃ tatrāścaryametaccamatkāramayaṃ hyabhūt |
kathāyāḥ kīrtanādeśca phalaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ||75||
badrike dvādaśīprātaḥkāle brāhme muhūrtake |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ saṃvadāmi te ||76||
nāṭyakāro’bhavattatra nāmnā rañjanakovidaḥ |
sa kṛtvā jāgaraṃ snātvā brāhme muhūrtake prage ||77||
nītvā puṣpāṇi ca mālāṃ candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ phalam |
akṣatān darbhapatrāṇi tilān gūḍhaṃ ca śarkarāḥ ||78||
godhūmān śvetadhotraṃ ca svarṇamudrāṃ ca kambalam |
pūjārthaṃ saṃhitāyāḥ sa samāyayau tu maṇḍapam ||79||
yāṃ saṃhitāṃ strījanaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ karoti vai |
narā natvā pūjayitvā yānti gurvarcanāya ca ||4.46.8 0||
tatra gāyan pūjanārthaṃ prāpto rañjanakovidaḥ |
neme cānarca tāṃ saṃhitāṃ puṣpādibhirādarāt ||8 1 ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārāpi tataścārārtrikaṃ vyadhāt |
tatkṣaṇe ruddhacitto’sau turyāvasthāṃ viveśa ha ||82||
bhānahīnaḥ papātāsya dehastatraiva bhūtale |
tāvad divyaṃ samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ projjvalaṃ śubham ||83||
ambarāt sahasā bhūmāvavātarat taḍid yathā |
tatra nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo divyamūrtiradṛśyata ||84||
sarveṣāṃ gocaraḥ sākṣād ramārādhāpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
māyāmuktaṃ divyadehaṃ hariḥ rañjanakovidam ||85||
muktātmānaṃ vimāne sve nītvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau |
mahāścaryamabhūttatra badrike prātareva tat ||86||
tāvat kaścit samāyātaḥ kadaryastatra bhūsuraḥ |
patrapuṣpajalayuktaḥ saṃhitāpūjanāya vai ||87||
ślokamuccārayan tasthau sammarde yoṣitāṃ tathā |
namaḥ saṃhitārūpāya mādhavīsvāmine namaḥ ||88||
nirmalānāṃ hṛdisthāya mokṣadāya ca te namaḥ |
namo rādhāramālakṣmīśrīrūpāyai muhurmuhuḥ ||89||
mokṣadātryai divyamātre jñānadāyai ca te namaḥ |
namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇakāntāyai māṇikyāyai ca te namaḥ ||4.46.90||
brahmavidyāsvarūpāyai dhāmaśaktyai ca te namaḥ |
namaḥ śrībadarīdevyai jayādevyai ca te namaḥ ||91 ||
namaḥ priyāyai divyāyai pāraṃgatyai ca te namaḥ |
namo mātre mahālakṣmyai lalitāyai ca te namaḥ ||92||
brahmadātryai parabrahmayogadātryai ca te namaḥ |
ityevaṃ sa harikṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭāva saṃhitāśriyam ||93||
tāvannāryo dadustasmai pūjāvasaramuttamam |
pupūja paramātmānaṃ kadaryo viprarāṭ tu saḥ ||94||
saṃhitāṃ pūjayāmāsa kūrdanaṃ nartanaṃ tathā |
tālikāvādanaṃ gālavādanaṃ sakthiśabdanam ||95||
ghurghurāvādanaṃ cāsye cakāra kīrtanaṃ tathā |
kṣaṇaṃ stabdhā darśakā vai mānavāstu tadābhavan ||96||
athaivaṃ kīrtane magnaścaikacitto’tirodhakṛt |
mūrtau tvekātmatāṃ prāpto brahmarandhre viveśa ha ||97||
brahmarandhrāt tasya tejaḥ sahasrasūryasadṛśam |
niryātaṃ sahasā tatra hyandhīkurvajjagattrayam ||98||
netramūrchāṃ gataḥ sarve narā nāryaśca badrike |
tāvacchāntaṃ candrasamaṃ śanairdṛśya hi cābhavat ||99||
tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī vyadṛśyata |
kare gṛhṇan kadaryaṃ taṃ nāmnā śrīrāmasundaram || 4.46.100 ||
tāvattatra vimānaṃ vai samāyātaṃ mahāmbarāt |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra nītvā śrīrāmasundaram || 10 1||
divyadehaṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ tūrṇaṃ śriyaḥ patiḥ |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ sarvayoṣitāṃ kṛṣṇadarśanāt ||1 02||
abhavad vai narāṇāṃ ca protsāhaḥ paramo’bhavat |
kadaryasya śarīraṃ tat tatraiva līnatāṃ gatam || 103 ||
etadvai tanmahāścaryaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā janāḥ punaḥ |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇādetanmokṣaṇaṃ pūjanāttathā || 1 04||
sañjātaṃ śrīkadaryasya divyadehena cākṣaram |
nivāsāya sadā jātaṃ dhāma yacchāśvataṃ prabhoḥ || 1 05||
ityevaṃ badrike sindhudeśe pārāyaṇakṣaṇe |
nityaṃ nityaṃ prajāyante dehināṃ mokṣaṇāni vai || 1 06||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya camatkārasya kīrtanāt |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi divyā gatiḥ paraṃ padam || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne saṃhitāyāḥ śravaṇena pūjanena ca vidyotānāmnyāḥ kaṃsāriṇyāḥ, kuṃbhakārasya nararājasya kuṭumbasya, svarṇakārastriyā ambālikāyāḥ, dhātudhmastriyā vinodinyāḥ, nāṭyakārasya rañjanakovidasya, kadaryasya śrīrāmasundarasya, ca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||

<4.47>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ paramapāvanīm |
sindhudeśe saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrotuṃ tu nityaśaḥ || 1 ||
vimānena samāyāti kṣārapurakṣitīśvaraḥ |
nāmnā kṣīrodavīrākhyastathā rājñī ruhāraṇiḥ || 2 ||
ubhau śṛṇuta sadasi pūjayitvā tu vācakam |
saṃhitāṃ pūjayitvāpi praṇamyarṣīn munīn gurūn || 3 ||
samāsīnau rājavargāsanayoḥ kṛṣṇamānasau |
śravaṇena tato jātau pāvanau tau nṛpīnṛpau || 4 ||
jagṛhaturmanuṃ vyāsāt svīyaprakāśakāddhi tau |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 5 ||
priyakṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca |
jepaturmālikādvārā nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ || 6 ||
cakratustau satāṃ sevāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇau |
priyakṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti tau || 7 ||
ūcatuḥ satataṃ ceti prātaḥ pūjāṃ pracakratuḥ |
naivedyaṃ haraye dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tāmcūlakaṃ jalam || 8 ||
arpayāmāsaturdhyānaṃ cakratuḥ mālatīpateḥ |
mahābhāgavatau tvevaṃ jātau divyaguṇānvitau || 9 ||
nirmānau dāsavannityaṃ vartamānau sabhāsthale |
kathāmūrtiṃ kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ dhārayāmāsatuḥ sadā || 4.47.1 0||
tayoḥ prajājanāścāpi samāyānti kathārthinaḥ |
narā nāryaḥ pavitrāśca jāyante śravaṇādibhiḥ || 11 ||
bahavaste harermantraṃ jagṛhuḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ |
kārtike dhavale pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ tu kathāsthale || 12||
kṣīrodavīro nṛpatiḥ ruhāraṇyā samaṃ tathā |
prajājanaiḥ samaṃ tatra kathāyāṃ samatiṣṭhata || 1 3||
śratvā kathāṃ saṃhitāyā ārārtrikaṃ vyadhāttadā |
prasādaṃ śrīhareḥ prāpya bhuktvāsvādyajalāmṛtam || 14||
sabhāyāṃ tatra lokānāṃ paśyatāṃ samupāviśat |
rājñī cāpi tadā tatra sannidhau samupāviśat || 15||
tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ divyataijasam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇādhiṣṭhitamujjvalam || 16||
avātarat sabhāpārśve tasmānnārāyaṇaprabhuḥ |
niḥsasāra kṣitāvetya kṛtvā tau divyavigrahau || 17||
nṛpīnṛpau vimāne tu nītvā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau tadā prabhuḥ || 18||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vīkṣya lokā modamupāyayuḥ |
na dehau bhautikau tatra tayoḥ staśceti tanmahat || 19||
sāmarthyaṃ vīkṣya nṛpayoḥ kṛpāṃ nārāyaṇasya ca |
anenaiva tu dehena mokṣaṃ nayati mādhavaḥ ||4.47.20||
vicāryetthaṃ tu bahavo narā nāryaḥ samutsukāḥ |
gantuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ sajjā babhūvustatra badrike ||21||
tatra sahasraśaḥ santo maharṣayaḥ sahasraśaḥ |
vṛddhāḥ sahasraśaścāpi striyo’nāthāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||22||
pāpā yadvā ca niṣpāpāḥ kathāśravaṇakāriṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhāmākṣaraṃ gantuṃ sutatparāḥ ||23||
abhavan dvādaśīsāyaṃ kathānīrājanottaram |
kīrtanānte harirjñātvā bhaktānāṃ vāñchitaṃ śubham ||24||
kathāśravaṇadhautāghān śaraṇāgatisaṃplutān |
tyakteṣaṇān bhaktimato netuṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samāyayau ||25||
labdhamantrān samastān vai narānnārīstadā hariḥ |
kṛtvā sarvān divyadehān taccharīrāmṛtān hi tān |||26||
vimāne suviśāle vai dhṛtvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ badri kṛṣṇenaitat tadā kṛtam ||27||
amantrāścāguravo ye te tu naivādhikāriṇaḥ |
avaśiṣṭāścādhṛtāśca sthitāstatraiva te tadā ||28||
te’pi kathāśravaṇānte lomaśāt tatra vai manum |
jagṛhuḥ pāvanāḥ sarve sajjāstato’bhavan khalu ||29||
athāyayau bhagavān śrīpatirnetuṃ samantrakān |
rātrau vimānake dhṛtvā divyadehān prasajjitān ||4.47.30 ||
ninye’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam |
sahasraśo narā nāryo vṛddhā vā vāsanojjhitāḥ ||3 1 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau premasnehaparāyaṇāḥ |
viṣavatkṛtasaṃsārāstyaktalokeṣaṇāstathā ||32||
niruddhavṛttayaḥ kṛṣṇe prapattiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ |
kṛpayā cecchayā viṣṇoryayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 33||
aho bhāgyaṃ hi balavad baliṣṭhā ca kṛpā hareḥ |
koṭikalpatapolabhyaṃ labdhavanto’kṣaraṃ yayā ||34||
narṣayo yatpadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yaṃ hariṃ vārjayantyapi |
tapobhiralpabahulaistaṃ hariṃ te prapedire || 35||
yadarthaṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ bhūmiṃ rājyaṃ tyaktvā tapantyapi |
tathāpi nāpnuvantyenaṃ taṃ prāptāḥ kṛpayā prabhoḥ || 36||
durlabhaḥ sulabho jāto dhāmeśo bhūtale tviha |
adṛśyo dṛśyatāṃ prāptaḥ kṛpayā sarvadehinām ||37||
kaṣṭasādhyo haristvadya kṛpāsādhyo’sti sarvathā |
kathamanyathā pāpānāṃ cakṣuṣorgocaro hariḥ ||38||
janā ūcuḥaho bhāgyaṃ śubhaṃ śreṣṭhamasmākaṃ yaddharistviha |
nije gṛhe svayametya dadāti darśanaṃ nijam ||39||
evaṃvidhaṃ tu sulabhaṃ prāpyāpi na bhajanti ye |
ta eva karmahīnā vai durbhāgyā mānavā api ||4.47.40||
paśuvajjīvanaṃ teṣāṃ gataṃ bhavati mokṣadam |
na punarmānavo deho’vāpsyate’to bhajantu tam ||41||
gṛhṇantu śrīharermantraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāntu sarvathā |
tanvā lakṣmyā dhiyā kṛṣṇaṃ prasevantāṃ kṛtādarāḥ ||42||
gṛhaṃ vāṭī sutā nārī patiḥ putrāśca vājinaḥ |
sampadaścañcalāḥ sarvāstābhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ labhantviha ||43||
evaṃ badrīpriye tatra janāḥ procuḥ parasparam |
jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇamantrām̐śca babhūvurvaiṣṇavāstadā ||44||
bhejire śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sādhūn siṣevire |
narā nāryaḥ parāṃ pavitratāṃ prāpya tataḥ sadā ||45||
mahābhāgavatā bhūtvā pratīkṣante sma mādhavam |
kadā nārāyaṇakṛṣṇo dhāmāsmānneṣyati prabhuḥ ||46||
kadā sākṣānnijān kṛtvā grahīṣyati karaṃ prabhuḥ |
āturā evamarthāste nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ||47||
ābālavṛddhā abhavan vivekabhaktitatparāḥ |
badrike sindhujā deśāḥ kathāprabhāvatastataḥ ||48||
prāyo bhāgavatairbhaktaiḥ sampannā divyatāṃ gatāḥ |
sthale sthale bālakṛṣṇo vimānena svadarśanam ||49||
datvā bhaktaṃ ca bhaktāṃ ca nayatyakṣaradhāma saḥ |
evamāścaryamaniśaṃ pratyahaṃ tatra vartate ||4.47.50||
badrike parito deśe rāṣṭre grāme ca pattane |
vārtteyaṃ sampravṛttā yat parāyaṇaṃ hi muktidam ||51 ||
yanti muktiṃ māvanāstu śrutvā pārāyaṇaṃ prabhoḥ |
kṛtvā tu darśanaṃ sākṣād yānti dhāma vimānagāḥ |||52||
na pāpaṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇo gaṇayatyatra pāpinaḥ |
pāvayitvā kṛpayaiva nayatyūrdhvākṣaraṃ padam |||53||
śrutvānye’pi mahāpāpāḥ pāpasantrastamānasāḥ |
āgatya badrike śrutvā kathāṃ yanti paraṃ padam ||54||
evaṃvidhaṃ camatkāraṃ bahumānavakīrtitam |
śrutvā pāpā mahāpāpā āyayuḥ saṃhitāsthalam ||55||
hiṃsakā ghātakāścaurāḥ kṛtaghnāśca pratārakāḥ |
viśvāsaghātakā madyapānā māṃsādanā api ||56|||
mumukṣāpreritāstrastāḥ karmabhiḥ svakṛtaistadā |
niṣṭhāśraddhāprapattiviśvāsadharmāstu te hareḥ ||57||
kathāṃ śrutvā narā nāryo lebhire’tipavitratām |
śṛṇu śrībadrike tatra mahāpāpāstriyāḥ kathām ||58||
antataḥ pāvanīṃ sarvapāpaghnāṃ kṛṣṇayogadām |
abhavatsomikānāmnī gaṇikā pañca tatsutāḥ ||59|||
māṃsādinyo madyapāstā jīvahiṃsāparāyaṇāḥ |
sarvādinyaḥ kukkuṭādipālinyaścāṇḍabhakṣikāḥ ||4.47.60 ||
putryaśca gaṇikā cāpi sarvāstā vārayoṣitaḥ |
mithunakuṭṭavāstavyā bījasāṃkaryagarbhajāḥ ||6 1||
śrutvā lokamukhyebhyo vai mahimānaṃ hareḥ param |
kathāśravaṇajaṃ cāpi mokṣalābhaṃ prakarṇya ca ||62||
jātapāpapraṇāśecchāḥ svajñātyuddhārahetave |
prathamaṃ tāḥ pañcaputryo mātā ca śarkarāpuram ||63||
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrotumāyayuḥ sādhanānvitāḥ |
lomaśaṃ tāḥ praṇamyaiva cakrurnivedanaṃ nijam ||64||
dayālurlomaśastābhyo dadau kṛpāmṛtaṃ balam |
hareḥ prasādajaṃ vāri puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ dadau ||65||
ekāśanaṃ vrataṃ nityaṃ snānaṃ sindhau prapūjanam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ sucintanam ||66||
madyamāṃsādisantyāgaṃ sādhusevanamanvaham |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajāpaṃ dadau tābhyastu lomaśaḥ ||67||
badrike tāstathaivāsan sarvā gurorvacaḥsthitāḥ |
māsamevaṃ vratasthāstāḥ śuśruvuḥ saṃhitākathāḥ ||68||
pāpanāśo’bhavattāsāṃ dharmaśuddhistathābhavat |
dehaśuddhiśca sañjātā prasādānnaphalāśanāt ||69||
tato mantraṃ dadau tābhyo lomaśaḥ pārameśvaram |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||4.47.70||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japam |
dadau tābhyastataḥ sarvāḥ śuddhātmadivyabhāvanāḥ |
kārtikasya tu pūrṇāyā ārabhya māsameva tāḥ ||71||
mārgaśīrṣapūrṇimāparyantaṃ pārāyaṇe sthitāḥ |
śuśruvuḥ paramātmānaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ hṛdi sthitam ||72||
jepurnārāyaṇasvāmiprabhuṃkṛṣṇaṃ niśāmukhe |
apaśyan paramātmānaṃ hasantaṃ drāk puraḥsthitam ||73||
guroḥ kṛpayā mantrasya japena sādhusevayā |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi bhaktyā dhyānena niṣṭhayā ||74||
puṇyodayena bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇo darśanaṃ dadau |
koṭikāmātisaundaryalāvaṇyayauvanānvitaḥ ||75||
sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ |
sarvasnehapramodāḍhyo mahānandaprado hariḥ ||76||
tejasā parito bhāgān pradyotayan hasan hariḥ |
ṣaṭ tāḥ prāha varārthaṃ vai tāśca kṛṣṇaṃ pravavrire ||77||
vārāṅginya ūcuḥvaradānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu paramo varaḥ |
ākṣaraṃ ca padaṃ sthānaṃ nivāsārthaṃ sadāstu naḥ ||78||
sarvapāpavināśo’tra bhaktyā te no hyajāyata |
śuddhā muktānikā divyāḥ kṛtvā naya paraṃ padam ||79||
ityevaṃ badrike tāstu vavrire śrīharestadā |
tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha tāvadvimānamāgatam ||4.47.80||
divyaṃ suvarṇavarṇaṃ vai sarvasampadbharaṃ śubham |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatrābhavaddhi hariḥ ||8 1 ||
rādhālakṣmīyutaḥ so’yaṃ cāvātarad vimānataḥ |
sabhāyāḥ purataḥ sthitvā pasparśa tāśca pāṇinā ||82||
tāvattāsāṃ bhautikāstu dehāste nyapatan kṣitau |
divyadehāḥ kamalāsadṛśyastā vai tadābhavan ||83||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ kṛṣṇājñayāruruhurutsukāḥ |
vimānaṃ sahasā bālakṛṣṇena saha taddrutam ||84||
ambare tvabhavad yānaṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ prati |
jayanādāstadā hyāsan mahāścaryamabhūttu tat ||85||
aho pāpasamācāramayyo’pi śravaṇāddharim |
patiṃ prāpya yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ bhakterhi gauravam ||86||
kṛpāluḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīsvāmivallabhaḥ |
mahāpāpātipāpāḍhyān viśodhya nayati dhruvam ||87||
paraṃ padaṃ śāśvataṃ vai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
evaṃ śrutvā badrike vai camatkāraṃ tadāparāḥ ||88||
mithaḥ prāhuraho ālyo no grāmād gaṇikā kathām |
śrotuṃ pañcasutābhiḥ somikānāmnī yayau tu yā ||89||
sā prayayau vimānena harerdhāma paraṃ padam |
sā dhanyā somikā cāpi dhanyā putryaśca pañca tāḥ ||4.47.90||
aruṇānī pāṭalānī dhavalānī mṛṇālinī |
kiñjalkānī pañca putryo devyo bhūtvākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||91||
aho vayaṃ prayāsyāmaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇaṃ śubham |
ātmoddhāraṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sākṣātprāpya patiṃ harim ||92||
ityevaṃ vārasundaryo mitho mithunakuṭṭagāḥ |
niścitya tāḥ kathāṃ śrotumāyayurvai sahasraśaḥ ||93||
badrike tīrthayāne’pi pade pade’śvamedhajam |
phalaṃ sañjāyate śrāddhavatāṃ tāsāṃ tathābhavat ||94||
pāpānyāsāṃ vinaṣṭāni tīrthābhigamanāttadā |
snātvā sthitvā kathāṃ śrutvā mantraṃ prāpurhi lomaśāt ||95||
pauṣakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tāḥ kathānte prātareva ha |
vimānaṃ tvambarātprāptaṃ vyalokayan suvarṇajam ||96||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇayuktaṃ mahāyatam |
hariścāvātarat tasmāt kathāśālāntikaṃ tadā ||97||
vimānādānītavāriprokṣaṇaṃ sa muhurmuhuḥ |
kṛtāvān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vārāṃganāgaṇe ||98||
tāstu prāpya kaṇauṃstūrṇaṃ tyaktabhautikaputtalāḥ |
divyamuktānikā bhūtvā tasthuḥ kṛṣṇasya sannidhau || 19||
paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ nītvā kṛṣṇo vimānake |
sahasravāramuktābhiḥ sahitaścākṣaraṃ yayau || 4.47.1 00||
tāśca śuddhā brahmahrade snātvā śrīkamalāsamāḥ |
dhāmamuktānikā jātāḥ kathākṛṣṇaprasādataḥ || 10 1||
śraddhayā phalamāpnoti bhaktyā prasannatāṃ tathā |
sevayātmānamāpnoti kṛpayā parameśvaram || 10 2||
badrike sarvalokeṣu saṃhitāyāḥ kathābalam |
prāsarat sahasā mokṣapradaṃ pāpanivāsakam || 1 03||
saṃghaśo vai narā nāryo mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇārthaṃ te samāyānti samantataḥ || 1 04||
kīrtanāni prajāyante bhajanāni sthale sthale |
satāṃ sevāḥ pravartante bhakṣyabhojyapradānakaiḥ || 1 05||
camatkārāḥ prajāyante tatra tatra dine dine |
śrutvā śrutvā narā nāryo harṣitāḥ saṃbhavanti vai || 1 06||
bhajante śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ sākṣādvaddhradayasthitam |
labhante paramaṃ lābhaṃ jñānaṃ śuddhiṃ parāṃ gatim || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇena kṣīrodavīranṛpateḥ ruhāriṇīrājñīyutasya, sahasrādhiprajānāṃ, pañcaputrīsahitāyāḥ somikānāmnīgaṇikāyāḥ, tathā mithunakuṭṭavāsinīgaṇikānāṃ, saṃhitākathāśravaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||

<4.48>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi madyapāyā kathāṃ tathā |
bilvapattanavāsāyā liyārīnāmayoṣitaḥ || 1 ||
bilvākhye pattane markaṭānadeśe tadābhavat |
madirāvyavasāyāḍhyaṃ kuṭumbaṃ madyakartṛ tat || 2 ||
dhvajī tatrābhavanmukhyo nāmnā miṣṭāsavadhvajī |
tasya patnī līyāryākhyā putraputrīsamanvitā || 2 ||
śuśrāva lokamukhataḥ kathāyāḥ paramaṃ balam |
śarkarānagare kṛṣṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tataḥ || 4 ||
śrotumaicchat pramadā sā svāmine prārthayattataḥ |
patirmiṣṭāsavaḥ patnīṃ prāha dūre kathāsthalam || 5 ||
vartate dīrghamārgaśca gantavyaṃ sabhayaṃ pathi |
vayaṃ dhanavihīnāśca dāridryaduḥkhapīḍitāḥ || 6 ||
yāsyāmo vai kathaṃ mārge vartante luṇṭakā janāḥ |
patnī prāha patiṃ śrutvā nāśo dehasya vidyate || 7 ||
yadvākadācilloke’tra martavyaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ |
adya vā bahuvarṣānte dhruvaṃ tu nidhanaṃ matam || 8 ||
yena kena nimittena maraṇaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati |
vayaṃ pāpāḥ pāpakarmāṇaśca pāpaparāyaṇāḥ || 9 ||
pāpināṃ maraṇaṃ pāpe jāyate tattu śokadam |
apāpe puṇyakārye vā jāyate maraṇaṃ yadi || 4.48.1 0||
kaṣṭaṃ vā jāyate tādṛk praśastaṃ lābhadaṃ tu tat |
puṇyasaṃkalpakartārastīrthayātrecchavo’pi ca || 11 ||
akṛtakāryā api te mṛtāḥ svargaṃ prayānti hi |
vayaṃ madyapibāḥ sarve sadā mahātipāpinaḥ || 12||
tīrthayātrānimittena mṛtāścet svargabhāginaḥ |
luṇṭakairluṇṭitā mārge yadi ced bhikṣayā tataḥ || 1 3||
utpādya bhojanaṃ cāpi gamiṣyāmaḥ kathāsthalam |
pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ tena bhāgyānāmudayo bhavet || 14||
yadvā pramokṣaṇaṃ lokādasmāt syānnātra saṃśayaḥ |
sarvathā lābha evāsti hānistatra na vidyate || 15||
tasmāttīrthaṃ prakartavyaṃ gantavyaṃ ca kathāsthale |
ityuktastu tayā patnyā kuṭumbasahito dhvajī || 1 6||
sūnī śūnyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā pratasthe śarkarāyutam |
yathā tu cintitaṃ pūrvaṃ tathaivāsyābhavat pathi || 17||
luṇṭakā militā mārge hṛtaṃ tairbhājanādikam |
pātheyaṃ gardabhaṃ bhāravāhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ kharam || 18||
vastrāṇi cāpi pātrāṇi luṇṭakāḥ samapāharan |
te tu matvā mahatkaṣṭaṃ kintu tīrthanimittakam || 19||
pūrvaṃ vicāritaṃ cāpi nātikaṣṭaṃ tu menire |
hṛtasarvasvakāḥ sarve putrāścaikādaśāpi ca ||4.48.20||
putryaḥ saptadaśa kanyāḥ pitā mātā ca te tataḥ |
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ sāyaṃ sarastaṭe ||21||
drumāḍhye bhūtale rātrinirgamāya kṛtādarāḥ |
kṛtāvāsā jalaṃ pītvā sasmaruḥ parameśvaram ||22||
kaṣṭaṃ prāptaṃ paraṃ mārge sarvaṃ hṛtaṃ tu luṣṭakaiḥ |
adya rātrirgatā syāttu śvaḥ kaṣṭaṃ kṣudhayā bhavet ||23||
martavyaṃ vā bhikṣitavyaṃ cāttavyaṃ dalapatrakam |
tathāpi tatkathāsthānaṃ gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||24||
niścityaivaṃ samidhaścāhṛtya vahnimacetayan |
tadādhārā sthitāḥ sarve kīrtanaṃ saṃpracakrire ||25||
priyākṛṣṇaharekṛṣṇapāvannārāyaṇaprabho |
śrīpatilalitākṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇaprabho vibho ||26||
evaṃ pracakrire dhunyaṃ tālīvādanapūrvakam |
rātryardhaṃ vigataṃ yāvattāvat kramelakasthitaḥ ||27||
daśoṣṭrasahitaḥ kaścicchreṣṭhī bhojanavastravān |
āyayau tena mārgeṇa jalaṃ pātuṃ sarastaṭe ||28|||
so’pi vahniṃ śubhaṃ vīkṣya mānavām̐statra saṃsthitān |
jalaṃ pītvā pāyayitvā viśrāmārthaṃ samāyayau |||29||
jaya nārāyaṇakṛṣṇetyuktvā hyavātarat sthale |
uṣṭrān vṛkṣastambamūle baddhvā vahnisthalaṃ śubham ||4.48.30||
gatvā papraccha tān sarvān vṛttāntaṃ kvāgamādikam |
miṣṭāsavo vinīto vai bhūtvā yātrāṃ jagāda tam |||3 1||
luṇṭakairluṇṭitaṃ sarvaṃ tadāpyenaṃ jagāda ha |
atha śreṣṭhī paraṃ śrutvā kaṣṭaṃ dayāparo’bhavat ||32||
dadau vai bhojanaṃ tebhyaḥ kharjurādikamuttamam |
vastrāṇyapi dadau tebhyo’bhayadānaṃ dadau tataḥ || 33||
uvāca tebhyo mudabhṛd yāmyahaṃ cāpi tatsthalam |
kathāṃ śrotuṃ tato yūyamārohadhvaṃ mamoṣṭrakān | |34||
prayāsyāmo’nena pathā prāpsyāmaḥ śvaḥ prage sthalīm |
uṣṭrā mārgavidaḥ santi panthānaṃ vedmi cāpyaham | |35||
jayaṃ me vidyate naivārohayadhvaṃ mamoṣṭrakān |
ityuktā badrike sarve tvāruruhuḥ kramelakān || 36||
vegavanto dīrghakaṇṭhā uṣṭrā dīrghapadakramāḥ |
vegavaddhāvanamagnā akrāmannoditāḥ pathaḥ ||37||
yathā vā garuḍā haṃsā vimānaṃ vā gajā iva |
mārgamullaṃghayāmāsuryathāmbaravihāriṇaḥ ||38||
dinadvayasya mārgaṃ te rātryardhe niryayurjavāt |
prātarjātaṃ mukhadṛśyaṃ tāvattu śarkarāpuram ||39||
te tvapaśyan puraḥ śvetasaudhālikāpraśobhitam |
kathāmaṇḍapasaṃśobhadvyomakalaśarājitam ||4.48.40||
bahubhirmunibhiḥ sadbhirvaiṣṇavaiḥ pramadānaraiḥ |
viharadbhiḥ snānapūjādyarthaṃ sañcāribhiḥ prage ||41 ||
homadhūmraiḥ sūcayadvai kathāsthānaṃ ca ghoṣaṇaiḥ |
brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhamantroccāraṇānāṃ samucchritaiḥ ||42||
nārāyaṇaprabhokṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho |
bālakṛṣṇaharikṛṣṇamādhavīramaṇaprabho ||43|||
evaṃ saṃkīrtanairvyāptairdhvanivyāptaṃ tu pāvanam |
śarkarānagaraṃ vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paramaṃ lebhire ||44||
sindhutīre drutaṃ gatvā śreṣṭhī sasnau jale muhuḥ |
avatārya samastām̐stān pradarśya mārgamuttamam ||45||
kathāsthalasya vai khyātaṃ svayamuṣṭrān samastakān |
miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ pāyayitvā drutaṃ tvadṛśyatāṃ yayau ||46||
vīkṣyaitat sa dhvajī sūto mahāścaryaparo’bhavat |
aho’yaṃ ko bhaved rakṣākaro’smākaṃ vanāntare ||47||
mahāmārge sukhadātā prāpakaḥ sukathāntike |
nūnaṃ nārāyaṇo yadvā bhavet kaścit sureśvaraḥ ||48||
anyathā na bhavedevamadṛśyavartanaṃ kvacit |
liyārī sā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmāra tatra ha ||49||
ākāśavāṇyā bhagavānāha tāṃ bhagavānaham |
uṣṭrānādāya bhaktānāṃ rakṣārthaṃ tvāgato’bhavam ||4.48.50||
yāta śrotuṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ sevantāṃ lomaśaṃ munim |
svataḥprakāśaṃ sevantāṃ gatiḥ śreṣṭhā bhaviṣyati ||51 ||
ityuktā badrike sarve tuṣṭā ānandamoditāḥ|
yayuḥ kathāsthalaṃ nītvā kusumānyatibhāvataḥ ||52||
nemuste dūrataḥ sthitvā sabhāyāṃ sampraviśya te |
saṃhitāyāḥ pūjanaṃ vai cakruḥ puṣpādibhistataḥ ||53||
niṣeduḥ śravaṇārthaṃ te yāvat kathāpravācanam |
kathānte lomaśaṃ gatvā nemuḥ pādajalaṃ papuḥ ||54||
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsurmārge kṛṣṇakṛtāvanam |
yaścāsīduṣṭraśreṣṭhī vai sa tu kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||55||
bhagavān śrīharirasmān kathāsthānaṃ samānayat |
tatprapattiṃ samicchāmo dehi mantraṃ supāvanam ||56||
ityarthito lomaśastān śrāvayāmāsa sanmanum |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||57||
tathā tatraiva dhunyārthaṃ dadau nāma harestadā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvara ||58||
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rameśvara |
vrataṃ dadau madyahīnaṃ jīvanaṃ tebhya ityatha ||59||
bhojanādivyavasthāṃ ca teṣāṃ śrīlomaśo muniḥ |
rājamahānasāccakre nityaṃ kuṭyāṃ nivāsanam ||4.48.60||
evaṃ te badrike tatra samūṣuḥ sarvadā sukham |
sevāṃ cakruḥ satāṃ tatra pātrādimañjanaṃ tathā ||6 1||
mārjanaṃ kṣālanaṃ vastvānayanaṃ ca kathāsthale |
mahīmānādidehānāṃ saṃvāhanaṃ pracakrire ||62||
śrutvā kathāṃ sevayitvā sādhūnāśīrvaco’mṛtaiḥ |
vidhūya sarvapāpāni kṛṣṇaprasādabhojanaiḥ ||63||
nirmalāste samastā vai jātāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
puṇyātmānaḥ parā bhaktā ātmanivedino yathā || 64||
saṃsmarantyuṣṭrapālaṃ taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhātmakam |
jagatsvapnasuṣuptyādāvuṣṭrapālo vilokyate ||65||
taccittāstaddhyānamagnāstasminnindriyavṛttayaḥ |
tadyogasthāstatsmarāste tanmayā divyabhāvanāḥ ||66||
abhavan svalpakālena mahābhāgavatottamāḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastebhyo badrike svapnagocaraḥ ||67||
bhūtvoṣṭrapālakaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ priyaḥpatiḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhārī bhavati tatkṣaṇe ||68||
evaṃ dadāti nityaṃ vai darśanaṃ bhaktibandhanaḥ |
snehapāśadhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇastānnetuṃ samupāyayau ||69||
divyavimānamāruhya divyaprabhāyutaḥ prabhuḥ |
avātarad vimānātsa pauṣasyaikādaśīdine ||4.48.70||
śuklapakṣe paśyatāṃ yāvatāṃ vai bhaktadehinām |
miṣṭāsavastathā bhāryā liyārī putraputrikāḥ ||71 ||
vilokya tvāgataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ parameśvaram |
sahasotthāya caraṇau natvā cakrurhi daṇḍavat ||72||
lilihuścaraṇau tasya jihvayādhārayan rajaḥ |
śarīreṣu tataḥ kṛṣṇamārthayan mokṣasiddhaye ||73||
kṛpālurbhagavānāha sajjā bhavantu vai drutam |
nayāmi divyadehān vai yuṣmān dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||74||
ityuktamātrāste sarve’rpitāḥ kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ |
abhavan paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ nyapatan kṣitau ||75||
bhautikāni śarīrāṇi tyaktvā bhūtvā harīcchayā |
divyā muktasvarūpāste kṛṣṇatulyaśarīriṇaḥ ||76||
kṛṣṇājñayā niṣeduste drutaṃ divyavimānakam |
bhajantaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā sabhāṃ śubhām ||77||
jayaśabdoccārayuktā vimānenākṣaraṃ padam |
śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ badri yayurmuktasvarūpiṇaḥ ||78||
babhūvuḥ kanyakāstāstu mātā muktānikāstathā |
putrāḥ pitā ca muktāste yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||79||
ityevaṃ badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagadruruḥ |
dīnānāthadaridrāṇāmuddhārako’sti sarvadā ||4.48.80||
śaraṇāgatarakṣāyāṃ tatparosti sadā prabhuḥ |
anavekṣya tu pāpāni pāpināṃ durguṇām̐stathā ||81 ||
śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāyātān kathāśravaṇapāvanān |
anugraheṇa kṛpayā tānnayatyakṣaraṃ padam ||82||
madyapānaratām̐stām̐śca narānnārīḥ samastakān |
pāvayitvā prabhurninye kṛpayā svākṣaraṃ padam ||83||
gaṇayatyeva naivāyaṃ karuṇāsāgaraḥ prabhuḥ |
pāpāni pāpināṃ loke nayatyavyayamakṣaram ||84||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā lokā vīkṣya camatkṛtim |
dīnabandhuraho kṛṣṇaḥ svayamuddhārayatyapi ||85||
dadāti darśanaṃ naijaṃ dadāti vastu vāñchitam |
kṛtvā śuddhān yāmyaduḥkhaṃ vināśya śaraṇāgatān ||86||
svayaṃ nayati divyena vimānena nijaṃ padam |
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ kathāśravaṇakāriṇām ||87||
māsamātreṇa muktiṃ sa karoti bhavapāśataḥ |
saṃhitā śrīkṛṣṇarūpā lakṣmīrūpāsti śābdikī ||88||
pratimā tāṃ sevayitvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya mukto bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ||89||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇena madyapasya miṣṭāsavadhvajikuṭumbasya mārge luṇṭakaprāptakaṣṭasya śrīhariṇā mārge śreṣṭhirūpeṇa rakṣitasya mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||

<4.49>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi cakriṇyāḥ śobhanāṃ kathām |
āsīt kālāntake rāṣṭre gaṇḍavātābhidhā satī || 1 ||
bhāryā sā yāskavādasya cakriṇo yantrakāriṇaḥ |
putraputrīyutā cāpi kuṭumbinī suviśrutā || 2 ||
yasyā gṛhe lohayantrāṇyutpadyante sahasraśaḥ |
ikṣupeṣaṇayantrāṇi tilapeṣaṇakāni ca || 3 ||
bījapeṣaṇayantrāṇi rasotpādanakānyapi |
evaṃvidhāni lauhāni dhātujāni bhavanti ca || 4 ||
kalābhirdhāturasajānyapi praḍhālakāni ca |
yaṃtrāṇāṃ vikrayaṃ sā tu karoti nityameva ha ||5||
krayaṃ karoti bījānāṃ tailārthaṃ sarvatastathā |
nijagṛhe’pi yantrāṇi calanti viṃśatistadā || 6 ||
bhramanti tailapeṣāṇi cekṣupeṣāṇi viṃśatiḥ |
cakrāṇāṃ vikrayaṃ nityaṃ bhagnānāṃ yojanaṃ punaḥ || 7 ||
sandhānaṃ khaṇḍitānāṃ ca kārayatyapi sā satī |
yasyā vaśe karmacārāḥ sahasraśo bhavanti vai || 8 ||
sahasraśaḥ karmacāriṇyo’pi kurvanti tatkriyāḥ |
pravartante tu yantrāṇi mahiṣoṣṭrakharādibhiḥ || 9 ||
nāṇakāni pralabhyante sahasrāṇi daśānvaham |
evaṃvidhā mahārājñī yathā tathā tu sā satī ||4.49.1 0||
dravyāḍhyā mānavāḍhyā ca sattāḍhyā paśupālinī |
cakriṇī sā dīrgharāṣṭre prasiddhāsīt kalāvatī || 1 1||
badrike sā praśuśrāva māhātmyaṃ janavarṇitam |
saṃhitāyāḥ kathājanyaṃ pratāpaṃ mokṣadaṃ param || 12|
sā jānāti mahācakrapeṣaṇaiḥ pāpasañcayam |
bījādau jīvajantūnāṃ peṣaṇādisamudbhavam || 1 3||
sūnānāṃ ca phalaṃ yāmyapuryāṃ kaṣṭaprabhogitām |
nārakīṃ ca gatiṃ nimnāṃ jānātyevātikaṣṭadām || 14||
tatpāpānāṃ praśāntyarthaṃ jijñāsāpreritā tu sā |
kathāśravaṇe śraddhāḍhyā kṛtabuddhirvyajāyata || 15||
prāha svasvāminaṃ sādhvī pārāyaṇaṃ prajāyate |
śarkarānagare svāmin sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 16||
camatkārāśca bahavaḥ śrūyante pāpanāśakāḥ |
mokṣado bhagavām̐statra dṛśyate kṛpayādhunā || 17||
vayaṃ tu pāpino nityaṃ cakriṇaḥ cakrapeṣaṇāḥ |
pāpināṃ na gatiḥ śreṣṭhā nārakī gatirīritā ||18||
rājyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ samastaṃ vā yadgṛhe vartate hyapi |
dehānte niraye vāsaścet sarvaṃ tannirarthakam || 19||
dhanaṃ cākṣayakośātma dāsā dāsyo’yutānyapi |
dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam ||4.49.20||
vāṭīkṣetrāṇi cārāmā udyānāni gṛhāṇyapi |
dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam ||21 ||
prāsādāḥ svarṇakalaśā dhvajāropasuśobhanāḥ |
sampadaḥ kṣayahīnāścāsaṃkhyātā api sarvathā ||22||
dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam |
mahiṣīgogajavājikramelakakareṇukāḥ ||23||
haṃsagaruḍamenādyāḥ śukasārasacātakāḥ |
dehānte narake vāsaścettatsarvaṃ nirarthakam ||24||
patnyo bahvyastathā putrāḥ putryo vaṃśe ca pautrakāḥ |
svasāro bhrātaro vṛddhā bāndhavā mātaraḥ striyaḥ ||25|||
patayo dāsavargāśca dāsyaścāpi sahasraśaḥ |
apyante narake vāsastadā sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||26||
vyāpārā bahavam̐ścāpi śakaṭīnāṃ sahasrakam |
yantrāṇāmayutaṃ cāpi vāhanānāṃ sahasrakam ||27||
ānantyaṃ cāpi bhogānāṃ kīrtīnāmutsavāstathā |
vidyante’pi ca dehānte nārakī cennirarthakāḥ ||28||
tasmāt svāminnātmakalyāṇārthaṃ vicintayāmyaham |
pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ dānaiḥ satāṃ sevādibhistathā || 29||
kathānāṃ śravaṇaiḥ syācca puṇyodayo bhavedapi |
naiṣā smṛddhiḥ puṇyadāsti hiṃsātmikā tu cakriṇī ||4.49.30 ||
sā smṛddhiḥ puṇyakāryārthaṃ yojanīyeti me matiḥ |
lakṣādhikaṃ nāṇakaṃ vai labdhvā yāmaḥ kathāsthalīm ||3 1 ||
śroṣyāmaḥ satkathāṃ nityaṃ dāsyāmo nāṇakādikam |
kariṣyāmaścātmaśuddhiṃ lapsyāmaścātmano hitam |||32|||
drakṣyāmaḥ śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpsyāmaḥ paramaṃ padam |
pradhānasyāgryabhṛtyasya kṛtvātmasāt samastakam ||33||
asaṃkhyaṃ vā dhanaṃ nītvā gacchāmo vai kathāsthalīm |
jīvane niścayo nāsti nedaṃ sahāgamiṣyati ||34||
dharmakarma mahādānaṃ satāṃ prasannatā vratam |
kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ kathāpuṇyaṃ paraloke sahāyadāḥ ||35||
tatkṛtvākṣayapuṇyātmadhanaṃ samarjya sarvathā |
mokṣamārge gamiṣyāmo mā vṛthākleśamāvaha ||36||
ityuktaḥ svapatirnāryā mumukṣuścātmavānapi |
sammatiṃ pradadau tasyai yātrārthaṃ muktihetave ||37||
prasannā gaṇḍavātā sā sajjābhavattato drutam |
śataputrasutāyuktā śatadāsīsamanvitā ||38||
śatadāsairyutā pautraidviśatāmyāṃ samanvitā |
snuṣābhiḥ sahitā bālairbālikābhiryutā tathā ||39||
vṛddhābhiḥ sahitā rakṣākṛdbhiśca sadbhaṭairyutā |
dveśate śakaṭānāṃ ca vājināṃ dveśate tathā ||4.49.40||
uṣṭrāṇāṃ viṃśatiṃ cāpi vṛṣabhāṇāṃ śataṃ tathā |
bhāravāhārthamevaiṣā payodānāṃ gavāṃ śatam ||41 ||
bhojanānāmapāraṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ cāpyanantakam |
pātrāṇāmapyasaṃkhyatvaṃ nītvā sajjābhavattadā ||42||
yāskavādo’pi mudito yātrārthaṃ mokṣahetave |
sajjo babhūva nṛpavat koṭisvarṇasamanvitaḥ ||43||
sarvopaskaraṇairyuktaḥ śreṣṭhavimānamāsthitaḥ |
patnyā sākaṃ vimānena natvā gaṇeśamīśvaram ||44||
vyomnā tu śarkarābhūmiṃ yayau kuṭumbibhiḥ saha |
sārthavāhāśca bhṛtyāśca godhanaṃ sampado’pi ca ||45||
bhūmārgeṇa samāyātaṃ sāyaṃ tu śarkarāpuram |
tatrodyāne sindhutaṭe naije vyāpārayogini ||46||
uvāsa sarvasampanno yāskavādaḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ |
vyavasthāpya samastaṃ svaṃ sainyaṃ snātvā tataśca saḥ ||47||
patnyā yuto yayau śrīmallomaśaṃ draṣṭumutsukaḥ |
gatvā neme pupūjāpi hārdaṃ nyavedayattathā ||48||
lomaśo’pi śubhāśīrbhiḥ protsāhaṃ pradadau tadā |
dadau kṛṣṇāmṛtavāri prasādaṃ pradadau tathā ||49||
saṃhitāyāḥ sthalaṃ nītvā kārayāmāsa darśanam |
cakrī vyāsāsanaṃ vyāsaṃ pūjayāmāsa saddhanaiḥ ||4.49.50||
bahubhiścopacāraiśca vrataṃ jagrāha tatra ca |
sabhāryo nityamevānnaṃ grahīṣyāmyekabhaktakam ||51 ||
sādhusevāṃ kariṣyāmi kathāśravaṇamanvaham |
nityaṃ satāṃ bhojanāni dāsye yatheṣṭakānyapi ||52||
nityaṃ suvarṇadānāni vastradānāni nityaśaḥ |
nityaṃ prasādavāryādipānaṃ ca netaradgraham ||53||
svataḥprakāśavyāsasya payaḥpānādi sarvathā |
matsakāśādbhavecceti jagrāha niyamān sa tu |||54||
nityaṃ mālāśatāvarttapradakṣiṇaśatādikam |
daṇḍavanmantrajapanaṃ sahasravāramuttamam ||55||
evaṃvidhām̐stu niyamān tebhyo dadau hi lomaśaḥ |
dadau mantraṃ ca mālāśca nāma japārthamārpayat ||56||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiprabhonārāyaṇeśvara ||57||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīmādhavīśvara |
evaṃ datvā niyamām̐śca lomaśaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau ||58||
yāskavādādayaḥ sarve nivāsaṃ svaṃ yayustataḥ |
yathāniyamamevaite vartante sma sukhasthitāḥ ||59||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityaṃ prakurvanti samutsukāḥ |
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ sarve prakurvanti kṛtādarāḥ ||4.49.60 |
niḥsaṃśayā dehasevāṃ sākṣāt kurvanti vai satām |
evaṃvidhānāṃ sahasā dhvastānyaghāni cakriṇām ||61 |
narā nāryaḥ samastāste niṣpāpā hyabhavan drutam |
antaḥkapāṭaṃ nirbhinnaṃ jñānavanto’bhavan drutam |||62|
yāskavādo bhojanāni sādhubhyaścānvahaṃ dadau |
vastradānāni bahūni phaladānāni sandadau ||63||
iṣṭadānāni sarvāṇi godānāni dadau tathā |
dugdhadadhighṛtadānaṃ havyadānāni sandadau ||64||
kambalānāṃ pradānāni patradānāni vai dadau |
śṛṃgāravastudānāni pūjāyāṃ mūrtaye dadau ||65||
yānavāhanadāni chatracāmaradānakam |
upānaduṣṇīṣavarmadānaṃ bhūṣārpaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||66||
śayyādānaṃ cānnadānaṃ dhānyadānaṃ dadau tathā |
svarṇarūpyakamudrādidānaṃ ratnārpaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||67||
vācakāya dadau veṣāmbarāṇi kānakaṃ ghaṭam |
vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi svarṇāmbarāṇi vai tathā ||68||
atha bhāryā gaṇḍavātā prasannamānasā tadā |
viprāṇībhyo dadau svarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca ||69||
mauktikāni suratnāni hīrakān śāṭikā dadau |
kurcadhrīṃ ca kucadhrīṃ ca kacaloṃ colikāṃ dadau ||4.49.70||
suravālīṃ ghargharīṃ ca kucalīṃ kambalīṃ dadau |
raśanāṃ vālapāśīṃ ca lalāṭikāṃ ca karṇikām ||71||
ūrmikāṃgulīyakāni kaṃkaṇavalayān dadau |
kaṇṭhikāṃ cāṃgade svarṇamālāśca mudgamālikāḥ ||72||
naro bindvīṃ kuṇḍale ca sauvarṇīḥ śṛṃkhalā dadau |
vātagaṇḍā dadauveva miṣṭānnāpi jalānyapi ||73||
kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpāṇi śṛṃgārāṇi dadau tathā |
tasyāḥ putrāśca putryaśca godānāni pracakrire ||74||
vājidānoṣṭradānāni vṛṣadānāni vai tadā |
cakrustatra supātreṣu mahādānāni vai tadā ||75||
anasāmapi dānāni saudhadānāni bhāvataḥ |
tulasīvṛkṣadānāni havyadānāni sandadhuḥ ||76||
saṃhitāpustakadānaṃ sarvadānāni sandadhuḥ |
sarvāstatra saha nītāḥ sampado jaḍacetanāḥ ||77||
dadurdāne harerbhaktyā viditvāvasaraṃ śubham |
yānavāhanadānāni dāsīdāsapradānakam ||78||
pracakrire yathāyogyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ |
gate pakṣe samaye tu kathājñānapariplutāḥ ||79||
divyabhāvā vyajāyanta sarve te cakriṇastadā |
dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyavargā bāndhavāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ||4.49.80||
ābālavṛddhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanam |
āturāḥ kartumevāsan mokṣamārgaparāyaṇāḥ ||81 ||
māghaikādaśikāsāyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe’rhaṇottaram |
ārārtrikaṃ viniṣpādya yāvat kīrtanakovidāḥ ||82||
kurvanti kīrtanaṃ tāvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ |
bhāsayam̐stejasā vyoma diśāścāvātarad bhuvi ||83||
kānakena vimānena priyālakṣmīyuto hariḥ |
vimānād bahirāgatya darśanaṃ svaṃ dadau tadā ||84||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ śrotāro lakṣaśo janāḥ |
narā nāryaḥ kṣaṇaṃ stabdhāstebhyo’bhibhavadṛṣṭayaḥ ||85||
abhavam̐śca tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃhṛtātiprabhaṃ śubham |
apaśyam̐ste muhuḥ ramyaṃ sundaraṃ gopikāpatim ||86||
gaṇḍavātābhavanmugdhā śrīkṛṣṇe mādhavīpatau |
tatputryaścābhavan mugdhāścātīva paramātmani ||87||
tyaktabhānā abhavam̐stāḥ kṛṣṇākṛṣṭātmavṛttayaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇāya nijadānaṃ tadaiva samacintayan ||88||
dāsyaśca kanyakāścāpi yā yuvatyo’bhavam̐stadā |
sarvā mugdhā nijadānaṃ tadā nārāyaṇe vyadhuḥ ||89 ||
evaṃ narāśca ye bhṛtyāḥ putrā dāsāśca karmiṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇākṛṣṭātmadehāste mokṣaṇaṃ vavrire hareḥ ||4.49.90||
jñātvā teṣāmabhiprāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaparameśvaraḥ |
tūrṇaṃ vidhāya divyām̐stān samastān divyavigrahān ||9 1 ||
dhṛtvā naije vimāne tu kṛtvā muktān surūpiṇaḥ |
vivṛttadehān puruṣān nārīrmuktānikāstathā ||92||
kṛtvā śeṣānavasthāpya bālavargān kuṭumbinaḥ |
poṣakān rakṣakām̐ścāpi yugalān varayoṣitaḥ ||93||
avasthāpya kṣitau tatra tebhyo datvā śubhāśiṣaḥ |
netuṃ yogyānnarānnārīrninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||94||
sahasraśo narānāryastadā taddehadhāriṇaḥ |
divyadehāḥ prabhūtvaiva yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||95||
aho vai cakriṇāṃ bhāgyaṃ badrike narayoṣitām |
sarvasvārpaṇakartṝṇāṃ yeṣāṃ netā narāyaṇaḥ ||96||
aho kālasya kavalā api dehā hi bhautikāḥ |
kṛṣṇecchayā vinā pātaṃ divyā bhūtvā yayuḥ saha ||97||
anyathākartṛsāmarthyaṃ tvetadvai paramātmanaḥ |
jaḍaṃ tu cetanaṃ kṛtvā krīḍatyeva ca taiḥ saha ||18|||
śeṣāḥ sahasraśaścāpi narā nāryastadā tu ye |
kathāṃ śrutvā viniṣpādyā darśanādabhavam̐stathā ||99||
gaṇḍavātākuṭumbaṃ tad yāskavādasya vaṃśina |
vaiṣṇavāste tu māsānte yayurnaijaṃ gṛhaṃ tataḥ || 4.49.1 00||
svadeśe tanmahāścaryaṃ jagaduḥ sarvataḥ śubham |
muktiṃ prāptāścakradhārā vṛddhā madhyāśca bhāvukāḥ || 10 1||
anye tathaiva bhajanaṃ badrike svālaye vyadhuḥ |
evaṃ mahām̐ścamatkārastadā khyāto’bhavad bhuvi || 1 02||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇātpāpanāśanam |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi sarvecchāpūraṇaṃ bhavet || 10 3|||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇena cakriṇo yāskavādasya tatpatnyā gaṇḍavātāyāśca kathāśravaṇena sahasrādhinaranārībhiḥ sahitāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||

<4.50>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ nindakayoṣitaḥ |
bālavane pure tvāsīnnāstikā dveṣakāriṇī || 1 ||
dvirvadantītināmnyeva prasiddhā śūdrabhāminī |
anapatyā rugṇapatibhāryā sarvasya nindikā || 2 ||
yasya kasyāpi śraiṣṭhyaṃ vābhyudayaṃ sā śṛṇoti cet |
khaṇḍayatyeva sāmarṣā svabhāvājjvalanātmikā || 3 ||
tejodveṣakarī cāpyasahamānānyagauravam |
nindatyeva satī lokān sajjanām̐śca satīstathā || 4 ||
vipraṃ guruṃ pitarau ca vṛddhān kuṭumbino’pi ca |
nṛpaṃ rājñīṃ satīṃ sādhvīṃ sādhūnnindati vai vṛthā || 5 ||
etādṛśyāstu nindāyāḥ pāpaṃ tasyā mahaddhyabhūt |
anapatyā tataścāste rugṇaścāsyāḥ patistathā || 6 ||
nindanaṃ khananaṃ proktaṃ bhāgyasya vaṃśajasya ca |
vaṃśasyocchedanaṃ tena pāpena jāyate tataḥ || 7 ||
narake vasatiḥ syācca nirvaṃśasya mṛtasya vai |
puṇyanāśo nindayā syād dharmanāśo’pi nindayā || 8 ||
yaśohānirnindayā cānṛtaṃ sarvaṃ hi nindayā |
mṛṣā kṣepo nindayā syādanartho nindayā bhavet || 9 ||
aparādho nindayā syād devadharmādikhaṇḍanam |
nindayā śāstranāstikyaṃ vratotsavādikhaṇḍanam || 4.50.1 0||
evamādīni pāpāni prajāyante hi nindayā |
nindāsvabhāvinī nārī nindati svapatiṃ hyapi || 11 ||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ śvaśrūṃ śvaśuraṃ nindati hyapi |
yoginaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ guruṃ pūjyaṃ pareśvaram || 12||
lakṣmīṃ rādhāṃ māṇikīṃ ca lalitāṃ cāpi nindati |
muktān muktānikāścāpi mandirāṇi harestathā || 1 3||
devālayān daivijanān satpuruṣān vinindati |
kathāṃ mokṣakarīṃ mokṣaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca paragṛham || 14||
nindatyeṣā caritrāṇi śrīkṛṣṇasyāpi sarvathā |
pāvanāni ca kāryāṇi tīrthānyapi ca nindati || 15||
yajñayāgādikaṃ ceṣṭāpūrttaṃ cāpi vinindati |
nindakaḥ sarvathā dveṣyakāraṇakaḥ prajāyate || 16||
tasmānnindā mahāpāpaṃ duṣṭanirayasadṛśam |
adhonirayadā nindā mahārauravadāyinī || 17||
vaṃśanāśakarī nindā badrike’rthavināśinī |
evaṃpāpābhisaṃvyāptā dvirvadantī tu śūdrikā || 18||
śuśrāva lokamukhato māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśakam |
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāyā vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca || 19||
dvirvadantī patiṃ prāha nāmnā dvirgarjanaṃ tadā |
śarkarānagare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya gauravam ||4.50.20 ||
śrūyate ca camatkāraḥ pratyakṣadarśanaṃ tathā |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi sarvapāpavināśanam ||21||
gacchanti tīrthayātrārthaṃ mānavāstatra saṃghaśaḥ |
na manye’haṃ tādṛśaṃ vai māhātmyaṃ tīrthabhūmijam ||22||
tīrthaṃ vrataṃ kathā yātrā dānaṃ sarvaṃ mṛṣā sadā |
kiṃ tīrthena kathayā vā vṛthā yānti janāḥ khalāḥ ||23||
gatānugatiko loko luṇṭako miṣamātrakṛt |
vṛthā gāyanti māhātmyaṃ lokāḥ kṛṣṇasya tatra vai ||24||
svāmin kiṃ tadbhavet satyaṃ mayānṛtaṃ tu manyate |
kapaṭaṃ sarvamevaitajjaḍānāṃ tat pratāraṇam ||25||
ityuktaḥ sa patirnāmnā dvirgarjano jagāda tām |
maivaṃ maivamavocastat satyamevānṛtaṃ nahi ||26||
satyo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satyā kathāghahāriṇī |
satyaḥ sarvaścamatkāro māhālayaṃ ca ṛtaṃ hareḥ ||27||
tīrthaṃ vrataṃ kathā yātrā dānaṃ sarvamṛtaṃ priye |
tīrthena kathayāghānāṃ kṣālanaṃ jāyate priye ||28||
na loko luṇṭakaḥ patni na gatānugato’pi ca |
yatra śrībhagavadvārtāyajño bhavati sarvathā ||29||
vārṣikaḥ sa mahāyajñastatroddharanti pāpinaḥ |
nindikā nāstikā tv tu pāpā pāpamayī sadā ||4.50.30 ||
pāpameva kalpayasi nindanaṃ prakaroṣi ca |
kiṃ tvayā nindayā bhārye prāpyate duṣṭavādini ||3 1 ||
maivaṃ punaravoco māṃ na śroṣyāmi hi nindanam |
nindāphalaṃ mahāghoraṃ bhujyate tvanapatyatā |||32||
punarnindāphalena tvaṃ prayāsyasi yamālayam |
ityuktā sā dvirvadantī prāhānṛto yamālayaḥ ||33||
na yamā na yamāvāso bālānāṃ bhayameva tat |
asatyā vai yamāḥ sarve yamālayo’nṛtālayaḥ ||34||
evamāha tadā tāṃ ca patiḥ prāha hitāvaham |
duṣṭe vīkṣya camatkāraṃ saty sarvamavāpsyasi ||35||
pāpaphalaṃ bhavatyeva kṛṣṇanindotthamulbaṇam |
tadā jñāsyasi satyaṃ tad yamālayaṃ yamānapi ||36||
virarāma patistūktvā sāpi nāstikyabhāvataḥ |
nindatyeva hariṃ dharmaṃ kathāṃ sādhūn yamādikān ||37||
tāvadevāmbarāttatra yamadūto viniryayau |
śrutvā vākyaṃ dvirvadantyāḥ ṛddhaśca darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||38||
adṛśyata karālo’ti parvataprāyadehavān |
daṃṣṭrākarālaḥ kṛṣṇaśca kajjalābho bhayāvahaḥ || 39||
ūrdhvaromā bahirdanto raktasphāritanetrakaḥ |
mahāmudgarahetiśca lalajjihvo vivastrakaḥ ||4.50.40 ||
vajrakāṭhinyapuṣṭaśca mahākapardimālikaḥ |
śaṃkukarṇo dviśṛṃgaśca dīrghapāśāḍhyahastakaḥ ||41 ||
loṣṭhaśṛkhalāskandhaśca baddhāyomekhalākaṭiḥ |
lohadaṇḍaṃ saśūlaṃ ca kare dadhan saroṣakaḥ ||42|||
udyamya mudgaraṃ vegāt kruddhastāḍayituṃ ca tām |
abhyāyau dvirvadantīṃ garjayan sarvato diśaḥ ||43||
tāvat sā taṃ vilokyaivābhavat trastā savepathuḥ |
śaithilyadehabandhāśca tyaktaviṇmūtramūrchitā ||44||
ākrośaṃ duḥśravaṃ kṛtvā papāta tatra bhūtale |
rakṣāṃ rakṣāṃ karotvevaṃ vadamānā papāta sā ||45||
prasāritāṃghrihastā cottānā vyāttānanābhavat |
svedaklinnābhavat tāvad yamadūtena vai krudhā ||46||
tāḍitā mudgareṇaiva śikṣārthaṃ dvirvadantikā |
mahākaṣṭaṃ ca lebhe sā drutaṃ bhagnāsthikābhavat ||47||
cūrṇadehā mahāmāramāpannā maraṇonmukhī |
sañjātā sā tadā dūtaḥ pasparśa tāṃ kareṇa vai ||48||
sampannadehā sañjātā yathāpūrvaśarīriṇī |
punaḥ sā gadayā vahni tāḍitā śikṣaṇāya vai ||49||
bhagnavaṃśā bhagnadehā prabhagnamastakabhavat |
vihvalā cūrṇitadehā sravadraktābhito’bhavat ||4.50.50||
tathāpi sā sthiraprāṇā mahākaṣṭamavāpa ha |
punaḥ kareṇa dūtastaṃ pasparśa sā samantataḥ ||51||
yathāpūrvaśarīrā sābhavat tāvad yamānugaḥ |
lohadaṇḍena tāṃ pṛṣṭhe mārayāmāsa vai balāt ||52||
praphullapṛṣṭhabhāgā sā mahāmāraprapīḍitā |
ākrandanaṃ mahaccakre muktakaṇṭhātitāḍitā ||93||
pāśenābadhya tāṃ dūtastasthau nagnāṃ vidhāya vai |
prakāśaṃ vyaktarūpo’bhūd gocaraḥ sarvadehinām ||54||
ākrandanaṃ mahacchrutvā patiḥ pārśvanivāsinaḥ |
narā nāryaḥ prapaśyanto mahātrāsātivihvalāḥ ||55||
dūre eva sthitāstrastā nāyayuḥ sannidhau bhayāt |
dūtadarśanamātreṇa nirbalā viviśurgṛham ||56||
dūtastu tāṃ mahāpāpāṃ sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā |
garjayan digvibhāgām̐śca jagāda marmabhedakam ||57||
raṇḍe duṣṭe pāpakartri nindike nāstiki khale |
kathaṃ nindasi dharmaṃ tvaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ hariṃ kathām ||58||
kasmānnindasi sādhūm̐stvaṃ vaṃśavināśakāriṇi |
jihvāṃ te kartayiṣyāmi karṇau ca nāsikāṃ tathā ||59|||
bhedayiṣyāmi vakṣojau nāśayiṣyāmi mastakam |
mūrdhajān kartayiṣyāmi pāṭayiṣye’rdhavarṣma te ||4.50.60||
tvacaṃ cotkartayiṣyāmi pātayiṣyāmi dantakān |
udaraṃ troṭayiṣyāmi vahniṃ dāsyāmi guhyake ||61||
lauhena śaṃkunā dehaṃ bhedayiṣyāmi pāpini |
kathaṃ tvaṃ nindasi sarvān mṛṣāvādān prakatthase ||62||
yamadūtān yamaṃ naiva gaṇayasyatināstike |
jīvato mārayiṣyāmi punarnaivaṃ kṛthā yathā ||63||
vadanneva mamāraināṃ pāśabaddhāṃ vaśaṃgatām |
sparśena sajvarā cāpi kurvanmuhurgatajvarām ||64||
hāhākāro mahān jāto nagare tatra sarvaśaḥ |
rakṣako nahi tatrāsīd balavān harimantarā ||65||
sā tadātimahāduḥkhā tāḍyamānā nirāśrayā |
anāthā nāstikā svārtharakṣārthaṃ tvāstikābhavat ||66||
sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ trātāramacyutam |
hṛdaye prāñjalirbhūtvā dadhyau śrīpārśvagaṃprabhum ||67||
tāvad dūto nijahetīn vṛtvā mārānnyavartata |
tadā jñātavatī duṣṭā kṛṣṇasmṛterbalaṃ mahat ||68||
atha kaṣṭātimagnā sā vyājahāra hare hare |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminnārāyaṇanarāyaṇa ||69||
tāvad dūtaḥ sthalaṃ tyaktvā dudrāva dūrato yayau |
adṛśyatāṃ gato vyomni durvadantī sukhaṃ gatā ||4.50.70||
svāsthyamāsādya cotthāya dhṛtvā vastrāṇi varṣmaṇi |
galitagarvā lokena dhikkṛtā ca tiraskṛtā ||71 ||
viveśa lajjitā tūrṇaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ cāpyaghomukhī |
viveda kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃsmṛteḥ ||72||
kṛṣṇanāmnāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ viveda yāmyamārataḥ |
atha sā svapatiṃ prāha śreyase pāpanuttaye ||73||
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāsthānaṃ gantavyaṃ tīrtharūpi yat |
yatra pārāyaṇaṃ mokṣapradaṃ pāpaghnamuttamam ||74||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāsti kathāmṛtam |
tatpānārthaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ sevārthaṃ gamyameva tat ||75||
yāmyaduḥkhavināśārthaṃ gantavyaṃ tatra sarvathā |
ityuktaḥ svapatistvāha tathāstvevaṃ kuru priye ||76||
mayāpi śreyase tatrāgantavyaṃ mokṣade sthale |
ityevaṃ badrike kṛtvā niścayaṃ tau tu dampatī ||77||
sajjāvabhavatāṃ tūrṇaṃ padbhyāṃ mārgeṇa nirgatau |
prāpya vai śarkarābhūmiṃ snātvā sindhujale tataḥ ||78||
saṃhitāyā maṇḍapau tau gatvā vṛttāntamātmanoḥ |
nivedayāmāsaturvai lomaśāya mahātmane ||79||
lomaśastatsamaye ca dadau kṛṣṇapadāmṛtam |
vāri prasādaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca vrataṃ dadau tataḥ param ||4.50.80||
ekabhuktaṃ nityakathāśravaṇaṃ sādhusevanam |
prasādabhojanaṃ cāpi sabhāsthānādimārjanam ||81 ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ dehasaṃvāhanādikaṃ ca pratyaham |
sevāvrataṃ dadau tābhyāṃ tathā mantraṃ sukhapradam ||82||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminnārāyaṇanarāyaṇa ||83||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktaparāyaṇa |
evaṃ dhunyaṃ sadā kartuṃ śikṣayāmāsa nāma ca ||84||
tau tataḥ pāvanau nityaṃ dhunyaṃ vidadhataḥ śubham |
naṣṭapāpau gatakleśau kathāśravaṇapāvitau ||85||
sādhusevādibhirnaṣṭavāsanau saṃbabhūvatuḥ |
māsamātraṃ śrutavantau pārāyaṇakathāmṛtam ||86||
divārātraṃ satāṃ sevāṃ cakratuśca yathocitām |
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvau tau sādhuprasādabhojinau ||87||
bhaktimantau snehavantau babhūvaturnarāyaṇe |
kṛtadhyānau nimagnau ca harermūrtau babhūvatuḥ ||88||
nindāpāpaṃ samastaṃ tat satsevayā layaṃ gatam |
mahimā sādhuṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe vyavardhata ||89||
athāyuḥpūrṇatāṃ prāptau gatasaṃsārabandhanau |
dvirgarjano dvirvadantī hyubhau pārāyaṇasthale ||4.50.90||
māghe vasantapañcamyāṃ vasantotsavanottaram |
prāptamūrchau drutaṃ tyaktvā dehau divyau babhūvatuḥ ||91 ||
dehābhyāṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣau divyābhyāṃ taijasānvitau |
paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ gocarau sundarau śubhau ||92||
divyabhūṣaṇamālāḍhyau divyagandhānugandhitau |
divyaveṣābhisampannau muktau tau sambabhūvatuḥ ||93||
tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ bhāsvaraṃ śubham |
sauvarṇaṃ tejasā vyāptaṃ vyomamārgādavātarat ||94||
yatra nārāyaṇasvāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
śriyā sākaṃ vimāne śrīmāṇikyayā yuto’bhavat ||95||
divyamālāmbarabhūṣādivyaśṛṃgāraśobhanaḥ |
divyābhiśca samastābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parisevitaḥ ||96||
hasan prasādaṃ janayan paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām |
tau dvau muktau vimāne sve nītvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau ||97||
jayaśabdā jayanādāstadābhavan samantataḥ |
evaṃ śrībadrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ priyeśvaraḥ ||98||
kathāśravaṇapuṇyena satāṃ sevāphalena ca |
nināya tau mahābhaktau kṛpayā svākṣaraṃ padam ||99||
śaraṇāgatabhaktānāṃ gaṇayatyeva naiva saḥ |
dūṣaṇānyaparādhān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ || 4.50.10 0||
dayāluḥ sa dayāṃ kṛtvā śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ |
āpadduḥkhaṃ vārayati nayatyakṣaramuttamam || 101 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi |
bhuktiḥ svargaṃ badri muktiḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā bhavet || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sarvanindāparāyaṇayoḥ dvirvadantīdvirgajanayoryamadūtadarśanottaraṃ saṃhitāśravaṇārthaṃgatayoḥ kṛpālurbhagavān paramamuktiṃ kṛtavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||

<4.51>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ gurughnamokṣadām |
āsīt khanipure vipro nāmnā suraprasādakaḥ || 1 ||
mātāpitarau vārdhakye sutamekamavāpatuḥ |
buddhyā yuktaṃ ca vātsalyapātraṃ snehāspadaṃ param || 2 ||
lālayāmāsatuḥ samyak pālayāmāsaturbahu |
vardhayāmāsatuḥ khānapānādibhiḥ samāhitau || 3 ||
modayāmāsatuḥ putraṃ vastrabhūṣādibhistathā |
pāṭhayāmāsatuścāpi vipravidyāṃ ca vaidikīm || 4 ||
tathāpi badrike bhāgyaṃ yādṛśaṃ rekhayotthitam |
tādṛśaṃ bhujyate kāle bhogārthe samupasthitam || 5 ||
yadi pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ putrajanmapradaṃ bhavet |
tadā putro jāyate’tha ṛṇāpākaraṇāya saḥ || 6 ||
yadi puṇyaṃ na dīrghaṃ syājjīvanārthaṃ tathā sutaḥ |
utpadya maraṇaṃ caiti daivaṃ tādṛk hi nirmitam || 7 ||
yadi puṇyaṃ daśavarṣāyuṣyapradaṃ bhavettadā |
tāvanmātraṃ gṛhe sthitvā paralokāya yāti saḥ || 8 ||
yadi sevārthakaṃ puṇyaṃ pitroḥ putrasya cārjitam |
bhavettadā sutaḥ sevāṃ pitroḥ karoti vai dhruvām || 9 ||
yadi puṇyaṃ na sevārthaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ pālito’pi saḥ |
tadā pitarau santyajya paradeśaṃ paragṛham || 4.51.1 0||
parāṅkaṃ vā paravaśaṃ paraputratvametyapi |
sevate na suto naijaḥ pitarāvapyapuṇyataḥ || 11 ||
paraputraḥ sevate’pyapitarau puṇyayogataḥ |
karmabandho hi saṃsāro yatrarṇa tatra padyate || 12||
anṛṇaṃ na paśuścāpi sameti mānavaḥ kutaḥ |
badrike yad yadadṛṣṭajanyaṃ tad dūramityapi || 13||
sākṣātparamparayā vā tadarthamupayāti tam |
kanyā gaurgajahaṃsādyā jāyante parabhūmiṣu || 14||
prapadyante’dṛṣṭavantaṃ svāminaṃ parabhūsthitam |
annaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ kṣāraṃ salilamoṣadham || 15||
prajāyante’nyatra bhāgyavanto’nyatrāpnuvanti tān |
tāpaḥ śaityaṃ payo mudrāmbaraṃ bhūṣā ca hīrakaḥ || 1 6||
khanyantarodbhavāścāpi prāpnuvanti paraṃ janam |
evaṃ vai badrike loke karmasambandhayojitam || 17||
pravartate mahācakramagamyayogadāyakam |
yadarthaṃ yatate lokastallokārthaṃ na tiṣṭhati || 18||
yadarthe na yatate tat prasahyāgatya tiṣṭhati |
evaṃvidhe’tra lokai vai jñānināṃ rāgaśūnyatā || 19||
aparigrahatā cāpi viśokatā vibaddhatā |
ātmārāmasukhitā ca brahmānandapadasthitiḥ || 4.51.20 ||
jāyante nirguṇatvaṃ ca māyāśūnyatvamityapi |
mokṣaṇaṃ te prāpnuvanti vivekino hi bhaktitaḥ ||21 ||
anyathā tu suyoge syāt sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ viyogake |
karmabaddhaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ yojanaṃ ca viyojanam ||22||
karmaśūnyasya mokṣaḥ syād durbhāgyasya na mokṣaṇam |
sarve’rthāḥ santi loke’tra durbhāgyā nāpnuvanti hi ||23||
vārdhakye putravattāpi daurbhāgye sukhadā na hi |
tathā suraprasādasya pitarāvativatsalau ||24||
preṣayāmāsatuḥ putramadhyayanārthamutsukau |
prabhāvarapuraṃ vidvadvipragṛhe hitāvahau ||25||
bahuvidyādilābhārtha yayau suraprasādakaḥ |
adhyetumadhikāṃ vidyāmāśā hi balavattarā ||26||
so’pi vidyecchayā tyaktvā mātaraṃ devanandinīm |
pitaraṃ devadharmāṇaṃ yayau gurorgṛhaṃ drutam ||27||
natvā guruṃ bhargacātvālakaṃ vṛttāntamāha tam |
guruḥ prasannacittaścādhyāpayāmāsa taṃ mudā ||28||
uvāsa bahuvarṣāṇi gurorgṛhe nirāmayaḥ |
niścinto nityapāṭhī ca mahodyamaparāyaṇaḥ ||29||
daivajñatā tattvavittvamātmavidyāṃ samārjayat |
vidvān kīrtiparipūrṇo jāto vidyāprabhāvavān || 4.51.30||
badrike sa tu vidyāptipuṇyavānapi sarvathā |
pitro sevāpuṇyahīnaḥ tayoḥ sevāṃ na labdhavān || 31 ||
adhityāpi gṛhaṃ naiva yayau vidyābhimānavān |
kadaryasya gṛhaṃ yadvannaijaṃ gṛhaṃ na rocate || 32||
ato naiva yayau pitroḥ sevālābhaṃ na cāptavān |
sa lābhastu gataścāsya tāvadvṛddhau tu tadgunahe | | 33||
vārdhakyenāmayavyāptāvabhūtāvarapīḍitau |
sasmaratuḥ sutaṃ tvekaṃ vidvāsaṃ dūravāsinam ||34||
adhitvā nāgataṃ preṣṭhaṃ tatyajatuśca jīvanam |
putraputretiputreti vadantau maraṇaṃ gatau ||35||
badrike bahupuṇyena pitroḥ sevā tu labhyate |
maraṇasya kṣaṇe putrāsyapradarśanamityapi ||36||
bahupuṇyena bhavati na bhavet karmahinayoḥ |
evaṃ pāpaṃ tu putrasya jātaṃ tadā tu badrike ||37||
pitrasevākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mṛtyurniḥśvāsakāritam |
vidyādhanaṃ na vai śreṣṭhaṃ pitṛsevādisannidhau ||38||
pitṛsevā cātipuṇyatamā śreṣṭhā ca puṇyadā |
mokṣadā svargadā sarvapāpadhvaṃsavidhāyinī ||39||
sarvāpannāśinī badri pitṛsevottamottamā |
sā na labdhā sutaiścet sā parā hāniḥ prajanminām || 4.51.40||
sarvaṃ vināśitaṃ tena pitṛniḥśvāsabhasmitam |
apyanyāśīḥsahasrāṇi dahyanti pitṛśāpataḥ ||41||
anyaśāpasahasrāṇi naśyanti tatprasādataḥ |
badrike puṇyahīnasya suraprasādakasya ha ||42||
pitrasevodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ hānidaṃ samajāyata |
vidyādhyāpayiturdveṣaṃ tata ārabhata dvijaḥ ||43||
bhargacātvālako vidyāguruḥ khyāto’bhavaddhyati |
sahate na sa tāṃ khyātiṃ duṣṭabhāvo’timānavān ||44||
guruṃ sa nindati nityaṃ vidyāyāṃ gauravaṃ gataḥ |
guroḥ kīrtiṃ khaṇḍayati gato’nyatra sabhādiṣu ||45||
evaṃ pāpena liptaḥ sa viśeṣeṇāpyajāyata |
duṣṭā buddhirutthitāsya vidvānahaṃ na cāparaḥ ||46||
gururmayā samo nāsti tadānyasya tu kā kathā |
evaṃ svaṃ gauravaṃ vakti cintayatyeva tādṛśam ||47||
manasā vacasā nindāṃ dveṣaṃ karoti sadguroḥ |
karmaṇāpi kratau śraiṣṭhyaṃ naijaṃ vijñāpayatyapi ||48||
karmakāṇḍe ca vijñāne garvaṃ karoti cordhvagam |
badrike nāśamāyāti puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ gurudviṣaḥ ||49||
vidyā bhāgyaṃ sampadaśca yaśo nāśaṃ prayānti ca |
pāpaṃ bhramo vicittatvamunmattatā bhavanti ca || 4.51.50 ||
aunmatyena tu doṣeṇa sahito’pi gurorgṛhe |
vasatyeva sa taṃ dveṣṭi guruṃ ced dṛṣṭigocaram ||51||
putravat pālitaṃ śiṣyaṃ dayālurgurudevatā |
na niṣkāsayati sthānād vātsalyaṃ hi nirodhakṛt| ||52||
unmatto’pi mahāvidvānnavyavastho vivekavān |
pāpābhibhūtahṛdayaḥ pāpanaṣṭavicāravān ||53||
ekadā svaguruṃ suptaṃ gatvā hastakuṭhārakaḥ |
ciccheda mastakaṃ rātrau nanarta cittavarjitaḥ ||54||
nṛtyaghoṣaṃ samākarṇya tatra bhāryā gurostadā |
tathā śiṣyā apare ca samāyayustadantike ||55||
tāvat kuṭhārahastaṃ taṃ vīkṣya bhāsaṃ prapedire |
vīkṣya hataṃ guruṃ sarve rurudurmuktakaṇṭhinaḥ ||56|||
hāhākāro mahān jātaścāśrameṣu dvijātiṣu |
vicittasyātiduṣṭatvaṃ jñātvā śāpāndadustadā ||57||
aho hatyā kṛtānena duṣṭena gṛhavāsinā |
mahācāṇḍālatulyena so’pi hato’stu tattathā ||58||
gurorhatyā mahāhatyā śatastrīhatyayā samā |
strīhatyā tu śatabhrūṇahatyātulyā nigadyate ||59||
bhrūṇahatyā śatamatsyahatyāsamā nigadyate |
matsyahatyā śatavṛkṣahatyāsamā bhavatyapi || 4.51.60||
vṛkṣahatyā śatastambanāśasamā prakīrtyate |
pitā bījapradaḥ śreṣṭho mātā garbhasya rakṣiṇī ||61||
gururjñānapradānena muktido hi tayoḥ paraḥ |
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāmuddhārakṛdgururhariḥ ||62||
mokṣaṃ karoti jīvānāṃ pāpāni kṣālayatyapi |
kṛṣṇavadrakṣaṇaṃ māyāpāśāt karoti sadguruḥ ||63||
sa vai śreṣṭhatamaścāste’saṃkhyaprāṇipramokṣakṛt |
nārāyaṇasya vijñānaṃ paricayaṃ dadātyapi ||64||
nayatyagre gatiṃ gacchannākarṣayan prapannakam |
sākṣī yo dharmakarmādau yāmyakaṣṭanivārakaḥ ||65||
brahmānandapradātā ca guruḥ śreṣṭhatamo’dhikaḥ |
gurormukhe caturvedā jihvāyāṃ śāradā satī ||66||
gāyatrī cauṣṭhayostasya sāvitrī kaṇṭhavartinī |
mastake brahmanirvāṇaṃ bhāle rudrasthalī guroḥ ||67||
bhrūmadhye tu bhavaścāste brahmā bhūkuṭimadhyagaḥ |
viṣṇurgurostu hṛdaye sūryacandrau tu netrayoḥ ||68||
karṇayorvartate śabdabrahma śāśvatamakṣaram |
hastayorindradevādyā nāsāyāmaśvinīsutaḥ ||69||
golokaścāpi vaikuṇṭhastanayorvartate guroḥ |
udaye tvamṛtaṃ dhāma nābhāvavyākṛtaṃ padam || 4.51.70||
jaghane satyalokaṃ ca gupte brahmavrataṃ guroḥ |
kaṭyāṃ hiraṇyagarbho’sti pṛṣṭhe meruḥ surālayaḥ ||71||
nitambayormahāpṛthvī prakṛtirgahvare’sti ca |
sakthnoḥ śvetadvīpadugdhodadhī staḥ śrīguroḥ sadā ||72||
jānvoḥ sutalavāsāśca jaṃghayordivyaśaktayaḥ |
pādayoḥ śrīguroḥ sarvatīrthānyabhivasanti vai ||73||
pitaraścāsya keśeṣu siddhāścāsya tvaci sthitāḥ |
prāṇe puṇyāni sarvāṇi mokṣo guroḥ kare sthitaḥ ||74||
guroḥ prasāde svargāṇi saṃkalpe sampadaḥ sthitāḥ |
guroḥ kriyāyāṃ vai cintāmaṇayaḥ kāmadhenavaḥ ||75||
sevāyāṃ kalpavṛkṣāśca vacane kalpavallayaḥ |
icchāyāmakṣayapātraṃ guroḥ snehe hariḥ svayam ||76||
guroḥ śaraṇe muktiśca gurvāsane śriyaḥ puram |
gurormūrtiḥ parabrahma vāsudevo gurau sthitaḥ ||77||
śrīkṛṣṇo’sti gurutādātmyatāṃ prāptaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
sarvakāmaprapūraḥ śrīsadgururbadrike bhuvi ||78||
vinā guruṃ na nistāro bhavārṇavaraṇasya vai |
agurūṇāṃ dehināṃ tu gatiḥ kutrāpi nāsti vai ||79||
tasmād guruṃ śrayed bhaktyā sarvasvārpaṇasevayā |
gurughnaḥ sarvavidyāghnaḥ sarvadevādināśakaḥ || 4.51.80||
svargamokṣarddhisampadghnaścātmaghno brahmahā mataḥ |
sarvapumarthahāḥ proktaḥ sarvaśaktivighātakaḥ ||8 1||
gatirnāsti sthitirnāsti sthānaṃ nāsti gurorhanaḥ |
yaśo nāsti sukhaṃ nāsti sarvathā dhig gurorhanaḥ |82||
sarvapāpāni lokānāṃ naśyanti gurusannidhau |
gurordveṣātmakaṃ pāpaṃ kṛṣṇāgre’pi na naśyati ||83||
śrīkṛṣṇo gurvadhīno’sti rādhālakṣmyādikā api |
gurvadhīnā devatāśca sarvātivāhikīprabhāḥ ||84||
gurustvanargalaṃ divyaṃ kapāṭaṃ paramokṣiṇām |
gururvidyutprakāśo’sti mahādīpo’ntaraprabhaḥ || 85||
taddhāte sarvaghātānāṃ jāyante’ghāni ghātinām |
tatsevane sarvasevāphalānyabhimilanti ca ||86||
tatprasāde sarvaprasannatā bhavanti sevinaḥ |
gurorlābhe sarvalābhā gurorhāne layo mahān ||87||
gurormūrtiḥ sadā divyā tvāśikhānakhamadbhutā |
nārāyaṇaḥ pṛthaṅ nāsti gurormūrteḥ kadācana ||88||
pūjayā sadguroḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prapūjyate |
bhojanena guroḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhunakti ca ||89||
jalapānena ca guroḥ kṛṣṇastṛpto pibatyapaḥ |
gurordehasya sevābhiḥ sevyate parameśvaraḥ || 4.51.90||
gurornāśena yāvatyaḥ sevā naṣṭā bhavanti vai |
evaṃ tena dvijenāpi gurorhatyā kṛtā yataḥ ||91 ||
sarvaṃ tasyābhavad badri vinaṣṭaṃ śubhasaṃjñitam |
vicitto jaḍavanmūrkha unmatto buddhivarjitaḥ ||92|||
bhraman mārge vane’raṇye niryayau sa gurorgṛhāt |
śarkarānagaraṃ prāpto daivātpūrvānukarmataḥ ||93||
kathāsthānaṃ yayau vidvām̐stasthau kṣaṇaṃ mudaṃ yayau |
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrutvā pītvāmṛtaṃ harestadā ||94||
prasādānnaṃ mahāpaṃktau bubhuje ca kathāmakhe |
satāṃ maharṣivaryāṇāṃ darśanaṃ prāptavān mudā ||95||
guruhatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śanaiḥ śanairnyavartata |
manasaḥ svasthatā jātā dehabhānaṃ vyavartata ||96||
unmādo’sya layaṃ prāpto vicittatā sucittatā |
jātā tataḥ saśokena lomaśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ||97||
nyavedayat samastaṃ tat pāpaṃ duḥkhaṃ viśodhanam |
lomaśo brahmakūrcākhyaṃ vrataṃ tasmai dadau tadā ||98||
māsaṃ cakre palāśādipatrāṇāṃ vahninā kṛtam |
gavyānāṃ kvathitaṃ vāri papau śuddhiṃ jagāma saḥ ||99||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāsau niṣpāpaḥ sādhusevayā |
vipro jātastato mantramasmai śrīlomaśo dadau || 4.51.1 00||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminśrīharevallabha prabho || 10 1||
anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa padmāvatīprabho |
evaṃ sa bhajanaṃ cakre dhyānaniṣṭho harau sthitaḥ || 1 02||
tīvrasaṃvegamāpannaḥ smṛtvā hatyāṃ guroḥ svayam |
pitṛtyāgaṃ tathā smṛtvā mahāśokamagāttathā | | 1 03||
rātrindivaṃ bhajanaṃ sa cakāra pārameśvaram |
virāgabhāvamāpannaḥ prātilomyamavāpa saḥ || 1 04||
sarvā vṛttīḥ parāvṛttya pratyāhāraṃ paraṃ gataḥ |
dhārayāmāsa satataṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mahāprabhum || 1 05||
dadhyau kṛṣṇaṃ ramākāntaṃ gopālabālakaṃ hṛdi |
samādhau śrīpatiṃ badri sākṣāt prāpātivegavān || 1 06||
māghaśuklaikādaśyāṃ sa prātaḥ snātvā kathāsthalam |
bhajannāma raṭan prāpa tasthau vyāsaṃ vyalokayan || 1 07||
pupūja mantrasahito vyāsaṃ ca saṃhitāṃ tathā |
śuśrāva ca sabhāsaṃsthaḥ kathānte kīrtanottaram || 1 08||
śīghraṃ samādhimāpannaḥ prāṇāḥ saṃkucitā drutam |
papāta deho bhūmau vai śrotṝṇāṃ paśyatāṃ satām || 1 09||
vimānamambarād divyamavātarat samujjvalam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasmād bahirāgatya taṃ dvijam || 4.51.11 0||
divyarūpaṃ sumuktaṃ ca vidhāya divyavigraham |
nītvā vimānake tūrṇaṃ hasan dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau || 111 ||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ kathāśravaṇakāriṇām |
aho gurughnaviprasya śaraṇyo bhagavān prabhuḥ || 11 2||
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt pāpaṃ vidhūya sarvathā |
vipraṃ bhaktaṃ nijaṃ dhāma ninye dehiṣu vatsalaḥ || 11 3||
etādṛśī kṛpā tasya ghaṭate paramātmanaḥ |
jīvāstu sarvathā pāpāḥ santi vai pāpakāriṇaḥ || 1 14||
kupālurbhagavānasti kṛpālavaśca sādhavaḥ |
vinā vinimayaṃ vā ca karamṛṇaṃ vinā khalān || 1 15||
duṣṭān pāpān pāvayitvā preṣayantyakṣaraṃ padam |
evaṃ vai badrike kṛṣṇo mokṣaṃ dadāti sevine || 1 16||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi |
bhuktimuktiḥ śubhaṃ svargaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 17||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne suraprasādanāmakaviprasya mātāpitṛsevāvihīnasya
vidyāpradaguruhatyāvidhāyino’pi śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāśravaṇena satāṃ sevayā pāpanāśo muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśattatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
