namo vṛddhātivṛddhāya purāṇāya ca te namaḥ ||61 ||
lokadhātrī tviyaṃ bhūmirmūrtirdivyā hi te matā |
dyauḥ sarvaṃ mastakaṃ yasya pātālaṃ pādasaṃjñitam ||62||
sṛṣṭayaścodare yasya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ||63||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetravāsabālāya te namaḥ |
sarvahṛtsu nivāsāyāntaryāmiṇe ca te namaḥ ||64||
nārāyaṇastavenaivaṃ ye stuvantyātmanāṃ patim |
śṛṇvanti stavanaṃ caivaṃ teṣāṃ bhāgyodayo bhavet ||689||
bhajanīyo raṭanīyaḥ sevanīyaḥ priyeśvaraḥ |
sarvakarmasu viśvātmā snehanīyaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ || 26||
prāṇapatiḥ pālanīyo rakṣaṇīyo guhāntare |
na kadācinmocanīyaḥ śāśvatānandalipsubhiḥ ||67||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
ityuktvā badrike sādhurjīvanāyana ekalaḥ ||68||
śarkarānagaraṃ gantuṃ samiyeṣa tadā janāḥ |
nṛpādayaḥ saha yātuṃ sajjāḥ prajāstadābhavan ||69||
narā nāryo bālabālā vṛddhā yuvāna ityapi |
saṃhitāśravaṇārthaṃ te sajjā viniryayurdrutam ||4.55.70||
saṃghayātrā cātidīrghā lakṣādhimānavātmikā |.
abhavacchrībadrike vai śrīkṛṣṇalagnamānasā ||71||
kanyā sādhujīvanī sā kumāraḥ sādhujīvanaḥ |
nirviṣādaḥ kumāro yo jyeṣṭho yo nāgavikramaḥ ||72||
yuvarājaḥ svayaṃ cāpi rājñī nārāyaṇī satī |
dāsī prabhāvatīdevī ghaṭamālābhidhāparā ||73||
dāsā dāsyaḥ sahasraṃ ca prajāstu lakṣaśo janāḥ |
niryayuḥ saṃhitāṃ śrotuṃ muktyarthaṃ ca samutsukāḥ ||74||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||75||
narā nāryo vṛddhabālāḥ kurvanto dhunyakīrtanam |
mārge yānti badrike te sarve brahmaparāyaṇāḥ ||76||
sindhughāṭaṃ samāsādya sasnustīrthe papurjalam |
saṃhitāyā maṇḍapaṃ te yayuḥ kīrtanaghoṣiṇaḥ ||77||
nemuśca daṇḍavadvaktāraṃ taṃ svataḥprakāśakam |
jagṛhuste prasādasya vāri kṛṣṇapadāmṛtam ||78||
upadā nidadhuścāgre pupūjuḥ saṃhitāharim |
jagṛhustatra mantraṃ ca parabrahmasamīpataḥ ||79||
oḥ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
kathāśravaṇaṃ cakruśca pupūjurlomaśaṃ munim ||4.55.80||
satāṃ sevāṃ satīnāṃ ca sevāṃ cakrurniḥsaṃśayāḥ |
māsamevaṃ kathāsevāṃ cakrustāvat samāhitāḥ ||8 1||
yuddharājasya pāpaṃ vai viṣadānasya yaddhyabhūt |
kanyākumāraghātasya samūlaṃ tadvyapohitam |||82||
anyeṣāmapi pāpāni prajvalitāni sarvaśaḥ |
viśuddhāḥ pāvanāḥ sarve jātā nṛpaprajādayaḥ ||83||
vāsanāḥ śrīkathāvārtāśravaṇād vilayaṃgatā |
sādhūnāṃ sevanād divyabhāvāḥ sarve’bhavam̐stadā ||84||
pratīkṣante virāgasthā muktiṃ śrīpārameśvarīm |
rājā dhāraṇayā dhyānaṃ labdhavān paramātmani ||85||
rājñī cāpi tathā dhyānaṃ labdhavatī priyeśvare |
dāsī labdhavatī dhyānaṃ nrāyaṇe mādhavīpatau ||86||
vṛddhāścānye narā nāryo babhūvurdhyānayoginaḥ |
phālgunaśuklaikādaśyāṃ muktīkṣakā hi tatparā ||87||
āsan gantuṃ mahāmuktiṃ tadā rājāgrajanmane |
jyeṣṭhakumārakāyaiva nāgavikramanāmine ||88||
likhitvā samukuṭaṃ vai rājyadhiṣṇyaṃ tadā dadau |
kārayitvā mahāyajñasaṃkalpaṃ sārvamedhikam ||89||
atha kanyā kumārau dvau sādhvī sādhū babhavūtuḥ |
tyāginau sarvadā śiṣyau svataḥprakāśayoginaḥ ||4.55.90||
anye nāryo narāścāpi jagṛhustyāgidīkṣaṇam |
sahasraśo’pare bhaktāstyāgāśramaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ ||91||
śṛṇu badrīpriye tatrāścaryaṃ jātaṃ paraṃ mahat |
vimānāni kānakānyāgatāni vyomamārgataḥ ||92||
padmālakṣmīramārādhāmāṇikyāmādhavīstriyaḥ |
muktamuktānikāpārṣadāśca tiṣṭhanti yeṣu vai ||93||
pratyeke rājate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi sundaraḥ |
tadā vyoma brahmadhāmatulyaṃ taistu vyajāyata ||94||
kṛtvā kṛṣṇo divyadehān netuṃ yogyānnijāśritān |
vimāneṣu sthāpayitvā sahasrādhikamānavān ||95||
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām |
ekaṃ vāpi na vai varṣma tadābhūcchavarūpakam ||96||
bhautikā api dehāste divarūpāstadābhavan |
taireva varṣmabhiḥ sarve yayurvimānasaṃsthitāḥ ||97||
aho līlā harerbadri hyagamyā tarkavarjitā |
māyāṃ kuryānnijaṃ dhāma tadā kā vārtikāparā ||98||
athānye ye narā nāryo bālāśca bālikāśca vai |
tyāgāśrame sthitāḥ sarve tadanye tu gṛhāśramāḥ ||99||
yayurnaijān śubhān deśān yuddharājyanivāsinaḥ |
evaṃ badrīpriye tatra camatkāro’bhavanmahān || 4.55.1 00||
nāgavikramarājāpi dadau dānānyanekaśaḥ |
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi bhūṣāmbarāṇi vai tadā | | 10 1||
kṛtvā śrīsahitāpūjāṃ natvā gurumṛṣiṃ tathā |
sato natvājñayā rājyaṃ nijaṃ samāyayau sukham ||102||
kanyāghnasya kṛtā muktiḥ śaraṇe patitasya vai |
sādhoḥ sevāratasyāpi kumāraghnasya badrike ||1 03||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā |
dayālunā kṛtā muktirmuninā jīvanena ca || 104||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi |
guṇagrāhād bhuktimuktī bhavetāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1 05||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrījīvanāyanena yuddharājena ca samaṃ rāṣṭrīyaprajādīnāṃ
saṃhitāsthānagamanaṃ kathāśravaṇaṃ, yuddharājādīnāṃ mokṣaṇam, kanyakādīnāṃ tyāgitvam, itareṣāṃ yuvarājena samaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pratyāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||

<4.56>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāmanyāṃ supāvanīm |
śarkarānagare tatra tvekāsīt kuṭṭanī sakhī || 1 ||
vārāṃganānāṃ maitryāḍhyā vyavāyināṃ niyojinī |
yoṣitāṃ yuvatīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ śaulanāśinī || 2 ||
nāmnā sānaṅgavallīti yā sā nirdhanā hyati |
vyavāyayogalabdhena nirvāhaṃ prakaroti sā || 3 ||
pāpinī pāparūpā sā jānāti hyauṣadhānyapi |
jvaranāśakaraṃ cauṣṇyanāśakṛd roganāśakṛt || 4 ||
guptendriyādirogāṇāṃ tvauṣadhaṃ vetti sā sakhī |
garbhasrāvauṣadhaṃ bhrūṇaghātauṣadhaṃ ca vetyapi || 5 ||
ata eva vyavāyādau nirbhayā yogadāyinī |
pāpajñānavihīnāsījjaḍā kāmātikāminī || 6 ||
svayaṃ duṣṭā parā duṣṭāḥ sampādayati karmaṇā |
evaṃ tayā tu bahvīnāmadhavānāṃ samudbhavāḥ || 7 ||
garbhā nipātitā bījanāśāścāpi kṛtā muhuḥ |
pakvabālā janmayogyā auṣadhairmāritā hyapi || 8 ||
evaṃ sā bālahatyāghā śuśrāva saṃhitākathām |
tayā jñātavatī pāpaṃ bālahatyādijaṃ mahat || 9 ||
duḥkhaṃ jñānavatī cāpi yāmyajaṃ duḥsahaṃ sakhī |
svasyā api pratigarbhaṃ patanaṃ daṇḍamulbaṇam ||4.56.10||
jñātvā śuśoca bahudhā pāpānnyavartatāpi sā |
prāyaścittasya jijñāsāṃ cakāra sadgurostataḥ ||1 1||
ekadā śrīlomaśāgre nivedayituṃ sā yayau |
kathānte lomaśaṃ gatvā pūjayitvā tu dīnavat || 12||
kṛtvā tu daṇḍavadyogyaṃ jagrāha caraṇau muneḥ |
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā lomaśasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 3||
papau pādāmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śiro dhṛtvā tu pādayoḥ |
jagāda kṛtya pāpādi sarvaṃ kapaṭavarjitam || 14||
kṛpālulomaśaḥ śrutvā brahmakūrcavrataṃ dadau |
palāśapatraprabhṛtikvāthaṃ ca pañcagavyakam ||15||
pātumājñāṃ dadau tasyai sā cakāra yathoditam |
māsānte sā śuddhadehā mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt ||16||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 17||
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa |
mantramevaṃ bhajanaṃ ca jagrāha lomaśānmuneḥ ||18||
mālāśataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyeṇanāmnāpyavartayat |
nityaṃ snātvā sindhunadyā jale pāti padāmṛtam || 19||
nityaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ ca bhakṣayatyeva bhāvataḥ |
sādhūnāṃ pātraśeṣaṃ ca bhakṣayatyapi pāvanam ||4.56.20||
sādhuvāseṣu nityaṃ sā mārjanaṃ pātramañjanam |
karoti sevanaṃ gatvā gātrasaṃvāhanaṃ satām ||21 ||
dhūlibhirmārjitābhiścoddhūlanaṃ nijavarṣmaṇi |
karoti bhāvato’naṅgavallikā pāpanuttaye ||22||
dhunyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ karoti sadasi sthitā |
dadāti phalapuṣpādi saṃhitāvācakāya ca ||23||
śrīkṛṣṇāya satīsadbhyo lomaśāya mahātmane |
dhanaṃ tu ḍhabbukamātraṃ nitya dadāti cakriṇe ||24||
akṣatānāṃ nityamuṣṭiṃ vācakāya dadāti sā |
evaṃ kṛtavatī nityaṃ bhaktyā sānaṅgavallikā ||25||
kathāṃ śuśrāva bahudhā sarvapāpaviśodhinīm |
sarvājñānaharāṃ dīrghatamoghnīṃ jñānadāyinīm ||26||
māsaścāsyā vyatīyāya kathāsevādikarmabhiḥ |
sā dadarśa tataḥ svapne prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāgatam ||27||
spṛśantaṃ svāṃ hasantaṃ svāṃ hāsayantaṃ śriyaḥ patim |
vadantaṃ svāṃ viśuddhāsi nayantaṃ svāṃ nijaṃ prati ||28||
kṣaṇamevaṃ pradarśyaiva bhagavān mādhavīpatiḥ |
adṛśyatāṃ yayau sāpi jajāgāra samutsukā ||29|||
utthāya sahasā brāhme muhūrte tu nijālaye |
tūrṇaṃ sā paritaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ mārgayāmāsa bhāminī || 4.56.30||
premavihvalatāṃ prāptā yadā labdhavatī na tam |
tadā mugdhā drutaṃ snātvā pūjāṃ kṛtvā parātmanaḥ ||31 ||
yayau tūrṇaṃ saṃhitāyāḥ pūjārthaṃ kuṃkumākṣataiḥ |
brāhme muhūrte nārīṇāṃ pravāhastumulaḥ prage || 32||
satataṃ saṃhitāyāstu pūjane vartate sadā |
tanmadhye sā gatā śīghraṃ dhyātvā svāpnaṃ priyaṃ prabhum ||33||
pūjayitvā tatastūrṇaṃ samutsukā tu lomaśam |
gatvā jagāda sarvaṃ tat prasannamānasā sakhī ||34||
śrutvā śrīlomaśaḥ prāha śuddhā tvaṃ bhaktiyoginī |
kṛṣṇaprasannatāṃ prāptā vartase’dya ramā yathā ||35||
bhava sajjā dhāma gantuṃ mokṣo te’tra bhaviṣyati |
sarvaṃ pāpaṃ gataṃ te’dya kṛṣṇo yadgocaro’bhavat ||36||
tataḥ sāpi jagādainaṃ guruṃ śrībadrike drutam |
sajjāsmi kintu bhagavannāste me hṛdi cintanam ||37||
mama yogena yā nāryo yuvatyo dhavavarjitāḥ |
garbhapātādidoṣāḍhyā bhrūṇūhatyānvitāstathā ||38||
tāsāṃ kalyāṇamicchāmi pāpanāśanapūrvakam |
kṛpā te’sti tathā cājñā kṛpāloste guroriha || 39||
tāḥ sarvāstvaccharaṇaṃ cānayāmīha pramuktaye |
vinā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā ca sadguruṃ kvacit ||4.56.40 ||
pāpānāṃ naiva nistāro yoṣitāṃ syāt kadācana |
vinā vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ śaraṇaṃ naiva rakṣaṇam ||41 ||
vinā śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ sevanaṃ nāghamarṣaṇam |
vinā satāṃ prasādaṃ na pāpināṃ vāsanākṣayaḥ |||42||
vinā cetanatīrthaṃ na pāpātmanāṃ viśodhanam |
nārīṇāṃ durlabhā śuddhirguro loke’tra māyike ||43 ||
kāmakṣetre tu niṣkāmisatāṃ sevā hi śuddhidā |
yā nārī vāñchati śuddhiṃ muktiṃ brāhmīṃ paraṃ padam ||44||
tayā sevyā hareḥ santo niṣkāmāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
satāṃ prasevayā kāmakrodhalobhādināśanam ||45||
vāsanānāṃ vināśaśca bhavenme vai yathābhavat |
tasmād guro samicchāmi matsakhīnāṃ viśodhanam ||46||
prāpte kṛṣṇe gurau divye tvātmamokṣaḥ puro mataḥ |
kṛṣṇagurvoḥ kṛpayā tu cātmīyānāṃ mato’pi saḥ ||47||
ātmanastāraṇe puṇyaṃ tato’yutaṃ parasya tu |
yoṣitāṃ tāraṇe tatra puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ matam ||48||
anāthānāṃ tāraṇe tu brahmāṇḍoddhārajaṃ hi tat |
anāthā yoṣito yāstā matpāśe patitā guro ||49||
yāvattāsāṃ tu noddhārastāvanme narakaṃ bhavet |
pātitasyodayaṃ kṛtvā kṣantvāparādhamasya ca ||4.56.50 ||
nirṛṇaṃ tu nijaṃ kṛtvā tato gamyaṃ divaṃ sukham |
ityevaṃ me guro cāste matirnārīpramokṣiṇā ||51 ||
tāḥ sarvāstamasi sthāpya kathaṃ me mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
sakhītvaṃ tu tadevātra samalābho yadātmanoḥ ||5 2 ||
svārthamātrastu lābhādirnarakaṃ kapaṭānvitam |
tanmayā sarvathā tāsāṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prabho ||5 3||
punaḥ kṣaṇo divyagatirnāgamiṣyati sadguro |
ityuktvā sā virarāma badrike’naṅgavallarī ||54||
lomaśo’pi śubhaṃ matvā kṛpayā tāṃ jagāda ha |
yogyaṃ vadasi kalyāṇi śreṣṭhaṃ vicāryate tvayā ||55 ||
svārthasya sādhakaḥ prāṇī nārakī nātra saṃśayaḥ |
sa eva kākaḥ sarpaśca sūkaraḥ svārthasādhakaḥ ||5 6 ||
tvaṃ parārthaparā sādhvī dvayoḥ kalyāṇakāriṇī |
parakalyāṇakartryāstu svaṃ kalyāṇaṃ prajāyate ||57||
avaśyaṃ paralokām̐stvaṃ jitāsi copakāriṇī |
yatheṣṭaṃ vartamānā yā cāpi pāpātipāpinī ||58||
paropakāradharmā cet svargaṃ vindati sā satī |
paropakāraḥ puṇyārthaḥ parapīḍā tu pāpadā ||59||
parapīḍānāśayitrī mucyate duḥkhabandhanāt |
pareṣāṃ sukhado lokaḥ svarge loke mahīyate ||4.56.60||
avaśyaṃ cānaṅgavalli samānaya sakhījanān |
tābhyo mantraṃ pradāsye’tra dāsye nāmajapaṃ tathā ||61||
vrataṃ dāsye brahmakūrcaṃ kariṣye pāpanāśanam |
pāvanāstāḥ kariṣye’haṃ mokṣabhāgā viśuddhigāḥ ||62||
ityevaṃ badrike soktā lomaśena maharṣiṇā |
śarkarānagaraṃ tūrṇaṃ gatvā yatra ca yatra ca || 63||
yuvatyo dhavahīnāśca vyavāyavyavasāyikāḥ |
garbhapātabhrūṇahatyādoṣavatyo’bhavan pure ||64||
anaṅgavallīsaṃginyastāstāḥ sānaṅgavallarī |
bodhayāmāsa pāpānāṃ nuttaye śreyase tathā ||65||
tāśca viśvāsamāpannā anaṅgavallikāyutāḥ |
snātvā pūjopasāmagrīrnītvā gurvagramāgatāḥ ||66||
yuvatyastāḥ śataṃ badri vidhavā garbhapātikāḥ |
kanyakāśca śataṃ garbhahantryo’pi yauvanānvitāḥ ||67||
āgatāḥ śrīlomaśāgre pāpabhayena śokitāḥ |
salajjā svasakhīvākyaviśvastā āyayurmunim ||68||
pādajalaṃ papuḥ sarvā lomaśasya tataḥ kathām |
śuśruvustāstato brahmakūrcaṃ vrata ca jagṛhuḥ || 69||
pūjāṃ tāḥ saṃhitāyāśca pracakrurvācakasya vai |
pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ cakruḥ kṣamāṃ yayācire tataḥ ||4.56.70||
mantraṃ jagṛhurmunito nāmadhunyaṃ prajagṛhuḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||71 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||72||
evaṃ mantraṃ ca bhajanaṃ prāpya tathā samācaran |
snātvā tīrthe sadā tāśca śuśruvuḥ saṃhitākathām ||73||
evaṃ tāsu samastāsu vartamānāsu badrike |
pūtāsu jāyamānāsu satāṃ sevāparāsu ca ||74||
ājñāparāsu sarvāsu lomaśasya prasannatā |
abhavallomaśastābhyo dadau kṛṣṇaprasādajam ||75||
svabhuktaṃ phalamevāpi miṣṭānnaṃ nijapātrajam |
sādhuprasādamāsādya bubhujire’tibhāvataḥ ||76||
tāvattāsāṃ śarīrebhyaḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kākā viniryayuḥ |
sarve te garbhahatyākhyā bhraṇūhatyāstathābhavan ||77||
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya cākāśe nipetuḥ sindhusāgare |
vināśaṃ sahasā prāpuḥ kākātmakānyaghāni vai ||78||
striyastāḥ śuddhatāṃ prāptā bhajanti sma narāyaṇam |
pārāyaṇaṃ bhāvabhinnāḥ śṛṇvantvekāgramānasāḥ ||79||
tāvadanagavallīṃ tu netuṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samāyayau |
phālgunasya tu pūrṇāyāṃ tithau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||4.56.80||
vimānenāsthito bhūmāvanaṃgavallikāpuraḥ |
prāha tāṃ tu samāgantuṃ mokṣārthaṃ tu vimānake ||81||
tāvat sā dayayā prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho |
dve śate mama saṃginyaścaitāḥ striyo’ghabhājanāḥ ||82||
kathālomaśayogena niṣpāpā yadi santi cet |
netavyāstāstava dhāmākṣaraṃ divyā vidhāya tāḥ ||83||
nānyathāhaṃ kṛṣṇakānta mokṣamicchāmi caikalā |
uddhara tāḥ samastā vai tataścoddhara māmapi ||84||
śrutvā cātiprasanno’bhūd bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabheśvaraḥ |
kṛpālurbhagavānāhānaṃgavalli śubhaṃ tava ||85||
yāḥ sarvā vidhavāstāstu neṣye me’kṣaramuttamam |
tvayā sākaṃ vimānena kariṣye kamalāsamāḥ ||86||
yāstu santi kanyakā vai tāsāṃ mokṣo’dhunā nahi |
tāḥ sarvāḥ svajanakasya gṛhe vasantu nirbhayāḥ ||87||
pūtā niṣpāpadehāstāḥ kṛpayā bhālitā mayā |
vivāhya tāśca gārhasthyamanubhūya tataḥ param ||88||
āyuṣo’nte mama dhāma cāyāsyanti na saṃśayaḥ |
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pasparśa pāṇinā ||89||
sarvāstāstatra tatkāle saṃhitāśravaṇāsthitāḥ |
pāvayitvā samastāstā vidhavāstu śataṃ tadā ||4.56.90||
divyadehā vidhāyaiva vimāne sve’dhyarohayat |
kanyakāstu samājñāpya sthātuṃ pitṛgṛhe tadā ||91 ||
vimānena yayau kṛṣṇo dhāmākṣaraṃ nijaṃ mahat |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ badri sānaṃgavallikā hyapi ||92||
divyadehābhavattūrṇaṃ divyā divyavibhūṣitā |
vimānaṃ samadhiruhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||93||
jayakāro mahānāsīt puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttadā |
adhamoddhārake kṛṣṇe māhātmyamatulaṃ hyabhūt ||94||
badrike garbhaghātinyaḥ kathāśravaṇamātrataḥ |
pūtatāṃ tā gatāḥ sarvā gurorbalātpramocitāḥ ||95||
aho balaṃ guroḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ śrībhagavānapi |
yadagre nirbalo bhūtvā karoti sadgurorvacaḥ ||96||
vīkṣya śrutvā tu māhātmyaṃ vyavāyadoṣanāśakam |
anyā api tadā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇāśrayaṃ vyadhurmudā ||97||
svadoṣān kṣapayāmāsurananyabhaktitatparāḥ |
mantraṃ tā raṭayāmāsurnāmakīrtanamāvyadhuḥ ||98||
satāṃ sevāṃ pracakruśca dānapuṇyaṃ pracakrire |
prapattiṃ jagṛhuścāpi pavitratvaṃ prapedire ||99||
divyabhāvāḥ śīlaparā dharmadārḍhyāstato’bhavana |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiyutāḥ sadā || 4.56.10 0||
evaṃ śrībadrike devi prabhuḥkṛṣṇo hariḥ svayam |
cakāra mokṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ prāptakāle dayānidhiḥ || 10 1||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi |
guṇagrāhād vartanācca svargo mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ || 102||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarāpuravāsinyāḥ vyavāyakārayitryā garbhrabhrūṇabālaghātinyā anaṃgavallaryāḥ tatsakhīśatadvayasyāpi ca saṃhitāśravaṇādinā mantravratasevābhiśca pāpanirmuktirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||

<4.57>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badripriye devi kathāṃ ṣaṇḍhavrajasya tu |
ṣaṇḍhavrajābhidhaḥ ṣaṇḍho’bhavacchrīśarkarāpure || 1 ||
śataṣaṇḍhaguruḥ so’yaṃ bahucarāptadīkṣaṇaḥ |
nārīveṣadharo naiva strīliṅgo na pulliṅgakaḥ || 2 ||
kāmadhātuvihīno’pi vāsanākāmasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
vartate dīkṣitaḥ ṣaṇḍho ṣāṇḍhīdīkṣānvitaḥ sadā || 3 ||
bhikṣayā jauvanaṃ naijaṃ rājavṛttyā tu sarvathā |
tathānyakliṣṭavṛttyāpi nirvahatyeva sarvadā || 4 ||
māhātmyaṃ taiḥ śrutaṃ tatra kathāyā mokṣadaṃ śubham |
janebhyo mānavebhyaśca sarvapāpavināśakam || 5 ||
punarjanmādarśanaṃ ca kathāśravaṇato bhavet |
pūrvapāpāni sarvāṇi naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
bhasmībhavanti cānyāni hyetajjanmārjitānyapi |
api mānavajanmā yaḥ kathāṃ naiva śṛṇoti ca || 7 ||
ātmamokṣaṃ nārjayati sa ṣaṇḍhaḥ paśureva saḥ |
api rājā dhanī śreṣṭhī prajāpālaḥ prajāgragaḥ || 8 ||
tathāpyātmakṛte mokṣaṃ kuryānna sa tu gokharaḥ |
api ṣaṇḍhaḥ paśuḥ pakṣī nārī pramatta ityapi || 9 ||
ātmaśreyaḥkaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śvapaco’pi śaṭho’pi ca |
mokṣaḥ sādhyaḥ paraṃśreyaḥ puruṣārthaḥ paraḥ sa vai || 4.57.10||
sādhaneṣu samasteṣu satsu satsu sthiteṣu ca |
mokṣo na sādhito yena sa kīṭaḥ sūkaro’pi saḥ || 11 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣā vai puruṣārthā bhavanti hi |
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca prapālyāpi yathocitān || 12||
ante tyaktvā bandhakṛto mokṣamicchanti mānavāḥ |
maharṣayaḥ pūrvajāste tathā kurvanti nānyathā ||1 3||
anye’pi cātmavettāraḥ pravartante kramāttathā |
sanyāsinastu tām̐styaktvā mokṣamicchanti sādhavaḥ || 14||
rājāno’pi vanaṃ prāpya kāmaṃ dagdhvā tapaḥparāḥ |
niṣkāmāḥ samprajāyante mokṣaṃ prayānti vai tataḥ || 15||
dhāturdoṣamayaścāste vāsanānāṃ pravartakaḥ |
sa cennaiva bhavatyeva dehe sā tu kṛpā prabhoḥ || 16||
evaṃ matvā hariṃ śritvā sādhuṃ natvā pramokṣaṇam |
prasevya satpuruṣām̐śca guruṃ bhaktyā prasādya ca || 17||
arpayitvā samastaṃ svaṃ cātmānaṃ gurave’pi ca |
kṛtvā māyāpāśahīnaṃ nirmalaṃ vāsanojjhitam || 18||
divyabhāvaṃ divyadṛṣṭiṃ divyaṃ kṛtvā samastakam |
kṛṣṇavimānamāruhya gantavyaṃ paramaṃ padam || 1 9||
dāso bhūtvā harerdāsī vaikuṇṭhe kṛṣṇavartinī |
goloke cāmṛte cāvyākṛte brahmanivāsane ||4.57.20||
śrīpure bhagavaddhāmni tvāsvādayeddhareḥ rasam |
aśnuvīta sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasādakam ||21 ||
sa evaṃ prāptakaivalyo naro vā yoṣideva vā |
ṣaṇḍho vā tiryagevāpi sa eva puruṣo mataḥ ||22||
puruṣārtho mahān mokṣo yastena prasādhitaḥ |
arthavān puruṣo loke puruṣasyārtha ityapi ||23||
mitho vai vartate saṃsargastayoḥ sārthakaḥ sadā |
evaṃ naiva vijānāti pumarthānna tanotyapi |||24||
vṛthā puruṣagarvāḍhyaḥ ṣaṇḍhaḥ sa naiva saṃśayaḥ |
ṣaṇḍhatā sā sadā tyājyā māyayā nirmitā purā || 25||
jīvānāṃ mokṣamārgādvai pātinī cātmaghātinī |
sevyāḥ santaḥ kathāḥ śravyāḥ prāptavyaḥ śrīpatīśvaraḥ ||26||
parihāryaṃ punarjanma ṣaṇḍhākhyaṃ taruṣaṇḍavat |
putrapautrādisampanno yadi mokṣaṃ pravindati ||27||
vṛkṣaṣaṇḍasvarūpaḥ saḥ sāṇḍo’pi ṣaṇḍha eva saḥ |
vicāryetthaṃ badrike te ṣaṇḍhā gurusamanvitāḥ ||28||
ṣaṇḍhavrajaṃ puraskṛtya kalyāṇārthamupasthitāḥ |
āyayuḥ śrīkathāsthānaṃ bhaktibhāvasamanvitāḥ ||29||
upadāśca kare kṛtvā pūjopasādhanānyapi |
kṛtasnānā śuddhimanto bhajantaḥ kṛṣṇamuttamam ||4.57.30||
kīrtayantaḥ svāmikṛṣṇamādhavīśrīnarāyaṇa |
nārīśvaranarāvāsabahucarādhiṣāyaṇa ||31 ||
evaṃ satālikaṃ gītaṃ gāyantaste kathāsthalam |
yayuḥ ṣaṇḍhāḥ samastā vai dūrānnemurhi maṇḍapam ||32||
vartulaṃ te tadā klṛptvā rāsalīlāṃ pracakrire |
rāsaṃ satālakaṃ sarve nārīveṣadharāstathā ||33||
sakūrdanaṃ sagītaṃ ca sabhramaṇaṃ pracakrire |
savādyaṃ savilāsaṃ ca sunarmākhyaṃ pracakrire ||34||
ekaḥ kṛṣṇo’bhavanmadhye vaṃśīdharo narāyaṇaḥ |
anyāḥ sarvā yoṣitaśca gopikā rāsamuttamam ||35||
vartulasthāśca khelādi darśayantyo vyadhuḥ śubham |
sabhyā rāsaṃ tu ṣaṇḍhānāṃ vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ||36||
ṛṣayo munayaścāpi prajā rājā narāḥ striyaḥ |
prasannāścābhavam̐statra phālgunasya site dale ||37||
pūrṇimāyāṃ tadā sāyaṃ kathānte sarvavaiṣṇavāḥ |
prasanno lomaśo jātaḥ svataḥprakāśako’pi ca || 38||
ṣaṇḍhāste lomaśaṃ natvā natvā śrīsaṃhitāṃ tathā |
brahmaprakāśaṃ natvā ca pūjāṃ cakrustadottamām ||39||
hārān haimān ratnanaddhān śubhaveṣān dadustadā |
svarṇarūpyādimudrāśca vastrapātrādi sandaduḥ ||4.57.40||
kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ pupūjuḥ saṃhitāṃ tathā |
vyāsaṃ ca lomaśaṃ cāpi pupūjuste napuṃsakāḥ ||41||
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca tālīvādanapūrvakam |
mṛdaṃgakāṃsyavādyāḍhyaṃ ghurghurānṛtyaśobhitam ||42||
naivedyaṃ ca nyadhuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pakvānnāni phalāni ca |
brahmaprakāśavyāsena haraye tatsamarpitam ||43||
prasādaśca salilaṃ ca tathā tāmbūlakānyapi |
tebhyo bhakṣyārthamevāpi dattāni pāvanāni vai ||44||
te ṣaṇḍhāḥ prāpya rasikaṃ prasādaṃ ca jalāmṛtam |
phalaṃ ca bhakṣayāmāsuḥ papuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ tathā ||45||
tataste prārthayāmāsurlomaśaṃ pāvanaṃ munim |
ṣaṇḍhatāpāpanāśārthaṃ ṣaṇḍhatājanmanuttaye ||46||
ṣaṇḍhatāyā nivṛttyarthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ śuddhaye’pi ca |
dadau tebhyo lomaśastu mantraṃ ca bhajanaṃ tathā ||47||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa ||48||
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa |
labdhvā mātraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ pāvanāste tadābhavan ||49||
nyūṣustatraiva te rātrau rāsagānaṃ pracakrire |
phālgunasyāsite cādyadine puṣpāvadolanam ||4.57.50|||
utsavaṃ paramaṃ cakruste sarve tu kathottaram |
lakṣaśo mānavāścāpi puṣpadolāmahotsavam ||||51||
pracakruḥ raṃganikṣepaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dolāsthitaṃ harim |
snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ remuśca lakṣaśo janāḥ ||52||
narā nāryaḥ pṛthagbhūtāścakruḥ raṃgaprakhelanam |
evaṃ te vaiṣṇavā badri ṣaṇḍhā sarve’bhavam̐stataḥ ||53||
nityaṃ kathāṃ praśṛṇvanti kīrtayanti narāyaṇam |
mantraṃ jepuśca mālābhiḥ sevante ca sato janān ||54||
tīvrasaṃvegabhaktānāṃ gocaro bhagavān drutam |
jāyate’tha tu ṣaṇḍhānāṃ śīghraṃ prasannatāṃ gataḥ ||95||
caitre kṛṣṇe tu te ṣaṇḍhā ekādaśyā vrataṃ vyadhuḥ |
cakrurjāgaraṇaṃ sarve prātaḥ snātvā kathāmṛtam ||56||
papuste nityavat prātastato madhyāhnake tu te |
bhuktvā sabhāsthale gatvā niṣeduḥ sukhitāstadā |||57|||
dhyānaṃ cakrurharestatra tāvat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
āyayau divyarūpeṇa vimānasthaḥ priyeśvaraḥ |||98||
uvāca tān yatheṣṭaṃ vai bhavantviṣṭasurūpiṇaḥ |
muktarūpaṃ tathā muktānikārūpaṃ yatheṣṭakam |||99||
yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ tanmadicchayātra jāyatām |
badrike evamukte tu nārīṣaṇḍhastu yo’bhavat ||4.57.60||
muktānikādivyarūpaṃ prāptavān sarvathā pṛthak |
naraṣaṇḍhastu yasteṣu sa cāpto muktarūpatām ||61||
evaṃ divyasvarūpā vai muktā muktānikāḥ śubhāḥ |
abhavam̐statra sahasā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||62||
tatastānavadattatra ṣaṇḍhavrajo’gramānavān |
bhūtvā divyasvarūpaśca bodhayāmāsa mānavān ||63||
ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ jāyate nāryā vighnakartryā ratikṣaṇe |
sapatnyā vighnakartryāśca dampatyorvighnayoṣitaḥ ||64||
svapatyurvighnakartryāśca paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā |
yugalānāṃ vighnakartryāḥ ṣaṇḍhātvaṃ samajāyate ||61||
patiṃ tyaktvānyasaktāyāḥ ṣaṇḍhātvaṃ saṃprajāyate |
ratiṃ cāsahamānāyā vidveṣiṇyāḥ striyāstathā ||66||
ābhicārikavetryāśca bhagabandhakayoṣitaḥ |
liṃgāpātanavetryāśca ṛtubhañjakayoṣitaḥ ||67||
ṣaṇḍhātvaṃ jāyate tasyā janmāntare ca janmani |
narasyāpi tathā tasya patnyakāmapradasya tu ||68||
viyonivartamānasya parabhāryāratasya ca |
vighnakarturyugalayoḥ kanyādidūṣakasya ca ||69||
agamyāgamakasyāpi vṛṣaṇocchedakasya ca |
liṃgādināśakasyāpi dehināṃ paśupakṣiṇām ||4.57.70||
ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ jāyate garbhahanturdhātukṣayasya ca |
kukarmakāriṇāṃ prāyaḥ ṣaṃḍhatvaṃ jāyate bhuvi ||71||
mahāpāpaṃ hi tatproktaṃ mānave janmani hyati |
puṃstvastrītvavihīnatvaṃ narakasyaiva rūpaṇam ||72||
tadgataṃ kṛpayā cādya kathāyāḥ śravaṇena naḥ |
muktātvaṃ cāpi muktatvaṃ labdhamasmābhiruttamam ||73||
patirlabdhaḥ parabrahmanārāyaṇaḥ priyeśvaraḥ |
amoghavīryo bhagavān brahmanandapradaḥ prabhuḥ ||74||
mā kurvantu striyo puṃso loke’tra kāmadūṣaṇam |
kāmavighnakṛtānāṃ vai narakaṃ gocaraṃ tviha ||75||
yeṣāmuddharaṇaṃ na syād vinā śrīvallabhaṃharim |
taṃ bhajantāṃ mahābhāgā narā nāryo bhayārditāḥ ||76||
svasvakukarmajālāni smṛtvā smṛtvā narāyaṇam |
yāntu śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhavantu divyavigrahāḥ ||77||
śāśvatānandamagnāśca prajāyantāṃ tadaṅkagāḥ |
vayaṃ snātvā tīrthajale pītvā kathāmṛtaṃ muhuḥ ||78||
bhuktvā kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ ca prāpya prasannatāṃ guroḥ |
bhaktyā labdhvā patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāmo’kṣaraṃ paraṃ padam ||79||
bhūtvā divyasvarūpāḥ śrīkṛṣṇayogyāḥ sukhāśrayāḥ |
śāśvatānandasaṃmagnā bhavāmo rādhikāsamāḥ ||4.57.80||
ityuktvā badrike sarve muktarūpā narāḥ striyaḥ |
kṛṣṇājñayā svarṇayāne niṣeduścākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||81||
tenaiva khalu dehena svena svena napuṃsakāḥ |
vivartamānakāyāste muktā divyāstadābhavan ||82||
abhūnnaiṣāṃ dehapātaḥ kāyākalpo vyajāyat |
śrīkṛṣṇasparśanenaiva muktā jātā napuṃsakāḥ ||83||
sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣā vai narā nāryaḥ sutaijasāḥ |
muktā muktānikāḥ sarve kṛṣṇarādhāramāsamāḥ ||84||
anyathākarturīśeśeśasya nārāyaṇasya tat |
sāmarthyaṃ cāpratihataṃ prākāmyaṃ prakaṭībhavat ||85||
vyarājata manuṣyāṇāṃ hṛdaye tu kṛtāspadam |
camatkāro mahāneṣaḥ kathāyāṃ kṛṣṇadarśitaḥ ||86||
jaḍaṃ sacetanaṃ kuryād vidadhyāccetanaṃ jaḍam |
nārīṃ naraṃ vidadhyāt sa naraṃ nārīṃ vidhāpayet ||87||
naraṃ striyaṃ ca vā kuryādubhayaṃ tu napuṃsakam |
napuṃsakaṃ vidadhyādvā naraṃ nārīṃ ca pārṣadam ||88||
muktaṃ muktānikāṃ vāpi jaḍaṃ divyaṃ vidhāpayet |
māyāṃ kuryādakṣaraṃ so’kṣaraṃ kuryāttu prakṛtim ||89||
kuryāttattvānyatattvāni śūnyaṃ tattvātmakaṃ kriyāt |
tattvāt tattvāntaraṃ kuryādetāstu śaktayo hareḥ ||4.57.90||
anantaśaktiyuktasya vimānaṃ durgamaṃ sadā |
āścaryaṃ tatra nāstyeva sarvaṃ yadātmakaṃ yataḥ ||91||
badrike ca tataḥ śrutvā ṣaṇḍhānāṃ divyadehatām |
guptaṣaṇḍhāḥ striyaścāpi guptaṣaṇḍhā narā api ||92||
saṃhitāyāḥ sthalaṃ gatvā śaraṇāgatimāpnuvan |
mantraṃ ca bhajanaṃ dhunyaṃ lomaśājjagṛhurmudā ||93||
pakṣaṃ pakṣaṃ ca te kṛtvā bhajanaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā |
dhyānaṃ sevāṃ pūjanaṃ ca prasādabhojanāśanam ||94||
bhūtvā pāpavihīnāśca śuddhātmāno vṛṣānvitāḥ |
supuṇyāḍhyāguptaprāptendriyāste tāstato’bhavan ||95||
kecana śrīhariṃ dhyātvā muktā bhūtvākṣaraṃ yayuḥ |
evaṃ ṣaṇḍhāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kṛpayā kṣitau ||96||
satyanarāḥ satyanāryaḥ satyamuktāstathābhavan |
satyamuktānikāścāpyabhavan śāśvatavigrahāḥ ||97||
aho kimatra duṣprāpaṃ yatra kṛṣṇakṛpālavaḥ |
aho kathāyā māhātmyaṃ badrike pārameśvaram ||98||
sarvaṃ niṣpāpatāṃ prāptaṃ yathā mokṣātmakaṃ jagat |
sarve videhamuktā vā jīvanmuktāstathāthavā ||99||
śarkarāpattane jātāḥ śrīsaṃhitākathāśravāt |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktimuktiḥ kare bhavet || 4.57.10 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarāpuravāsināṃ ṣaṇḍhavrajādiṣaṇḍhānāṃ saṃhitāśravaṇena pāpanirmuktiḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanena taireva dehairdivyamuktānikātmakairakṣarapadasya prāptiśca, tathānyaguptanapuṃsakānāṃ śaraṇāgatyā puṃstvastrītvādyabhivyañjakatā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||

<4.58>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ pāpavināśinīm |
karāñcanīpure tvabdhitaṭe sindhumukhe purā || 1 ||
yavasandhābhidhaḥ kaścid dhenukhādakaghātakī |
nyavasanmāṃsamadirāmatsvādano’tihiṃsakaḥ || 2 ||
śaśān kapīn varāhām̐śca hariṇān vanapakṣiṇaḥ |
yādāṃsi cāpi hiṃsitvā gavayājoraṇānapi || 3 ||
sakuṭumbaḥ pācayitvā vikrīṇāti ca khādati |
evaṃ pāpasamācāraḥ sadā pāpaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
kukkuṭādaḥ kukkuṭāṇḍarasabhakṣaṇakārakaḥ |
bhraṣṭadeho bhraṣṭakarmā yavasandhīyajātijaḥ || 5 ||
yavasandhābhidho vārtāṃ śuśrāva nāvikānanāt |
śarkarānagare tatra saṃhitāyāḥ kathā śubhā || 6 ||
jāyate mokṣadā sarvapāpānāṃ kṣālinī tviti |
jāyante divyadehāśca śrotāro brahmalokagāḥ || 7 ||
sarvapāpāni bhagavān śaraṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
śaraṇāgatabhaktasya kṣamate’rpayate divam || 8 ||
hiṃsakā bahavastena tāritāḥ strīnarā api |
tatrāste lomaśarṣiśca svataḥprakāśa īśitā || 9 ||
tathā santaḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyo viprarṣayo’pi ca |
yeṣāṃ vai darśanāt prasevanāt prasādanāttathā || 4.58.1 0||
śāśvatī jāyate muktirvimānena gatiḥ parā |
naitādṛśo hi samayaḥ punarasmān miliṣyati || 11 ||
pāpanāśakaraḥ śuddho’nāyāsamokṣaṇapradaḥ |
yavasandho badrike saṃśuśrāvaitāṃ giraṃ śubhām ||1 2||
mumukṣāsyābhavattūrṇaṃ pāpanāśāya tatkṣaṇam |
mayā pāpānyanantāni kṛtāni ghātanāni vai || 1 3||
teṣāṃ na syāddhi nistāro vinā divyajanāśrayam |
ete naukādharāḥ sarve vadanti ṛtameva tat || 14||
prayāmi śarkarāpuryāmaghāni kṣapayāmi ca |
yadi pāpavināśo me bahuhatyāghanāśanam || 15||
tadā tasmāduttamaṃ me kimatra pariśiṣyate |
karmaṇāṃ cet kṛtānāṃ tu bhūmāvatra nivartanam || 16||
kimasmādaparaṃ sādhyaṃ kartavyaṃ me’vaśiṣyate |
avaśyaṃ tatra gantavyaṃ prāṇamātraṃ tu yatra vai || 17||
avaśyaṃ tatra vastavyaṃ yatra syācchāntirātmanaḥ |
avaśyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ yatroptaṃ phaladaṃ bhavet || 18||
avaśyaṃ tatra suptavyaṃ yatra nirbhīkatā bhavet |
avaśyaṃ tatra martavyaṃ yatrānandastu śāśvataḥ || 19||
yadi gacchāmi tatraiva saṃhitāyāḥ kathārthakaḥ |
pāpanāśo bhavenme ced gantavyaṃ mokṣameva ha ||4.58.20||
punarāvartanaṃ naiva karāñcanīpuraṃ prati |
rocate me pāpakarma naiva naiva ca naiva ca ||21||
kuṭumbasahito yāsye śarkarānagaraṃ prati |
mahatyā naukayā yantragantryā yāsyāmi satvaram ||22||
vicāryetthaṃ yavasandhaḥ patnīṃ nāmnā majāvalīm |
jagāda mānasaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkalpitaṃ śubhāvaham ||23||
sāpi dhanyaṃ nijabhāgyaṃ mene deśāvalokanam |
puṇyāvalokanaṃ cāpi mahotsavapralokanam ||24||
mokṣāvalokanaṃ mene śreṣṭhaṃ hiṃsādyapekṣayā |
badrike sā sammatābhūt putrāḥ putryastathāvidhāḥ ||25||
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyāste kuṭumbino drutaṃ tataḥ |
dhanaṃ dravyaṃ bhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi bhojanānyapi ||26||
gṛhayogyānyauṣadhāni veṣavārāṇi yānyapi |
dehādisādhanakāni pātrāṇyāvaśyakāni ca ||27||
peṭikā copakaraṇaṃ śavayādyaṃ te samutsukāḥ |
ninyire sarvamevāpi yogyaṃ yātrādi yaddhitam ||28||
naukayā yantravegābhigamayitryābdhitīrake |
yayuragre sindhumukhe tato nadyāṃ tu naukayā ||29||
tayaiva sahasā sarve pratipūraṃ yayurmudā |
prāpuḥ śrīśarkarābhūmiṃ snātvā sindhujale tu te ||4.58.30||
nītvopadāḥ prajagmuste kathāmaṇḍapamuttamam |
śuśruvuste kathāṃ ramyāṃ sarvapātakanāśinīm ||3 1||
kathānte vācakaṃ sarve pupūjurvastubhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
lomaśaṃ ca tathā sādhūn praṇemuste tataḥ param ||32||
prārthanāṃ cakrire pāpamokṣārthinīṃ śubhāvahām |
lomaśaśca tadā tebhyo dadau śrībrahmakūrcakam ||33||
vrataṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ ca tathā śrīkṛṣṇanāma ca |
mantraṃ dhunyaṃ bhajanaṃ ca dadau pādāmṛtaṃ tathā ||34||
prasādānnaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ pāpanāśanahetave |
te’pi sarve’tibhāvena cakhadurannamuttamam ||35||
papurvāri vrataṃ cakruḥ kathāśravaṇamācaran |
māsānte pāvanā jātāḥ sarve vigatakalmaṣāḥ ||36||
bhāvanānukūla eṣāmāyuṣyānto’bhavattathā |
dvādaśyāṃ caitrakṛṣṇasya madhyāhne kṛtabhojanāḥ ||37||
sarve te tu niṣedurvai vāsagṛhāṃgaṇe tadā |
akasmāccāgataṃ divyaṃ vimānamambarāt tataḥ ||38||
vimānataijasā spṛṣṭāḥ sarve mūrchāṃ prapedire |
caturbhujo haristeṣāṃ gocaro’pi tadābhavat ||39||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmādhavīśvaraḥ |
tān kṛtvā divyadehām̐śca tyājayitvā śavāni ha ||4.58.40||
ninye vimānagān kṛtvā naijaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ śubham |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ dṛṣṭvā maharṣayo’pi vai tadā ||41||
praśasaṃsuḥ priyakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dayānidhim |
praśasaṃsuśca tān sarvān śaraṇāgatamānavān ||42||
mahāpāpān pāpaśūnyān śaśaṃsurbhaktisaṃbhṛtān |
aho’saṃkhyāghakartṝṇāmapi śrībhagavānhariḥ ||43||
kṛpayā cānivartinyā karoti mokṣaṇaṃ param |
dhanyo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo dhanyāste mokṣabhāginaḥ ||44||
dhanyaṃ śārkaranagaraṃ kathā dhanyā pramuktidā |
badrike evamevānye muktiṃ tatra hi lebhire ||45||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanādaghamokṣaṇam |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi tathā syācchāśvatī gatiḥ ||46||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne karāñcanīpurīsthasya sadāhatyākarasya yavasandhasya sakuṭumbasya saṃhitākathāśravaṇena mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||

<4.59>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ bhāṇḍasya mokṣadām |
dvārāmṛte tu nagare’bhavad bhāṇḍaḥ kuṭumbavān || 1 ||
jñātivṛddho’timatimān hāsyanarmādipaṇḍitaḥ |
rājotsaveṣu sarveṣu prajotsaveṣu cāpi saḥ || 2 ||
āmantritaḥ prayātyāśu rātrau khelaṃ karoti ca |
gāyanaṃ narmapadyāni narmakarmāṇi vai tadā || 3 ||
kṛtvā pradarśya nṛpatīn hāsayatyeva tatprajāḥ |
evaṃ sa kuśalaścāste prāpnoti pāritoṣikam || 4 ||
prasiddhaḥ so’bhavadbhūmau nāmnā tu bhaṇḍaśīlakaḥ |
janebhyaḥ so’pi śuśrāva pārāyaṇamahotsavam || 5 ||
lakṣātilakṣalokānāṃ samājo yatra jāyate |
kathā divyā bhavantyeva vinodāśca navā navāḥ || 6 ||
khelanāni bhavantyeva nūtnapradarśanānyapi |
pāpanāśo bhavatyeva kathāśravaṇato’pi ca || 7 ||
satāṃ samāgamaścāpi darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
prajāyate prabhaktānāṃ camatkāro bhavatyapi || 8 ||
vimānaṃ śrīharestatra samāyāti suśobhanam |
muktā bhūtvā janā yānti parameśapadaṃ param || 9 ||
narā nāryaḥ prayāntyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ hareriha |
pāpānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tatra kāryate paramātmanā || 4.59.10 ||
evaṃ bhāṇḍān samastān vai kathayitvā harerbalam |
svayaṃ samastabhāṇḍaiśca naranārīsamanvitaḥ || 1 1||
bālikābālayuktaśca vṛddhapūjyasamanvitaḥ |
anobhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ pātheyavastubhiḥ saha || 12||
paśvādivāhanairyuktaḥ sajjo bhūtvā samutsukaḥ |
pratasthe śrīhariṃ dhyātvā natvā grāmasya devatām || 1 3||
dhanaṃ dānārthakaṃ cāpi bhūṣāvastrāmbarāṇyapi |
iṣṭopakaraṇādyaṃ ca nītvā yayau kathāṃ prati || 14||
śarkarānagarābhyāśe snātvā sindhujale sa tu |
sarvakuṭumbasahito mānavaistriśatairyutaḥ || 15||
rājodyāne vidhāyaiva vasatiṃ svāsthyamāptavān |
pūjāsāmagrikāyukto vṛddhamānavasaṃyutaḥ ||1 6||
kathāmaṇḍapamabhyāgād vyāsapūjanahetave |
saṃhitāyāḥ sthalaṃ gatvā natvā sabhājanānapi || 17||
jayamokṣapradakṛṣṇa vyāsajīva ciraṃ jaya |
ṛṣayo vṛddhapūjyāśca jayatātra kṛpākarāḥ || 18||
jayantvime sādhavaśca śrotāro’pi jayantviha |
yātrālavastīrthavāsā jayantu sarvadā bhuvi || 19||
viprāḥ sādhvyaḥ sādhavaśca jayantu mokṣakāriṇaḥ |
ajñānapāpahartāro jayantu vaiṣṇavā janāḥ ||4.59.20||
ityevaṃ te vadanto vai cakrire daṇḍavanmuhuḥ |
dhūliṃ sabhāsthalasyāpi dadhyuḥ śirassu varṣmasu || 21 ||
athājñāṃ vyāsadevasya labdhvā pūjārthamāyayuḥ |
upadā vividhā nyasya puṣpahārām̐stilākṣatān ||22||
phalāni tāmbūlakāni nyadhuste saṃhitāpuraḥ |
vyāsasya candanādyaiśca pūjāṃ pracakrire tataḥ ||23 ||
nīrājanaṃ vyadhuścāpi cakrustasya pradakṣiṇam |
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cakrurbhāṇḍāḥ sarve subhāṇḍinaḥ ||24||
subhāṣayā hāsayanto janānnatvā sabhāntare |
prasādaṃ ca jalaṃ pītvā niṣeduḥ śravaṇārthinaḥ ||25||
kathāṃ śrutvā jagṛhuste mantraṃ śrīlomaśānmuneḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||26||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||27||
evaṃ dhunyaṃ dadau tebhyo nāmasaṃkīrtanāya vai |
tataste svanivāsaṃ vai gatāḥ svasthā hariśritāḥ ||28||
nityaṃ kathāṃ praśṛṇvanti gāyanti gītikā hareḥ |
ābālavṛddhāḥ sarve te sevante sādhuyoginaḥ ||29||
evaṃ nityaṃ tu yatsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā māso gato drutam |
caitrakṛṣṇaikādaśikārātrau jāgaraṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||4.59.30||
dvādaśyāṃ te kṛtasnānā kathāśravaṇataḥ param |
sabhāyāmeva sahasā vyāsāsane’ti bhāsuram ||3 1 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīśaṃ hasantaṃ vilulokire |
paśyatāṃ tu sadasyānāṃ vyāse prakāśake prabho ||32||
tiro’bhavaddharistūrṇaṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ramāviśat |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tattu dṛṣṭvā śrīlomaśo muniḥ ||33 ||
bhāgyodayaṃ tu bhāṇḍānāmavocattatra saṃsadi |
trayodaśyāṃ punaścaivaṃ kathottaraṃ prakāśanam || 34||
prasañjātaṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathaiva pārameśvaram |
amāyāṃ tu prage bhāṇḍāḥ svāpnaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vyalokayan ||35 ||
vimānenākṣaraṃ dhāma prayāntītyabhyalokayan |
tataḥ prasannacittāste brāhme protthāya satvaram ||36 ||
snātvā sajjā bahavo’pi bhūtvā kathāsthalaṃ yayuḥ |
kathānte tu prakāśaṃ te vyājahruḥ svapnagocaram ||37||
lomaśastu samākarṇya prāhādya mokṣaṇaṃ tu vaḥ |
sāyaṃ kathānte bhāvyaṃ vai sajjā bhavata muktaye ||38||
bhāṇḍāste’pi yathāyogyaṃ sajjā gantuṃ tato’bhavan |
sāyaṃ kathānte bhagavān svāmīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||39||
vimānenāyayau netuṃ kānakena suvarcasā |
sajjān niṣkāsya dehebhyo divyadehān vidhāya ca ||4.59.40||
labdhvā divye vimāne tān yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam |
sārdhaśataṃ yayurmuktā muktānikāstu bhāṇḍakāḥ ||41 ||
brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ nirbhidya brahmabhāṇḍaṃ prapedire |
aho dayā vicitrā vai śrīmādhavaparātmanaḥ ||42||
bhāṇḍānnītvā yayau kṛṣṇo lakṣmīpadmāvatīpatiḥ |
athānye badrike śiṣṭā bhāṇḍāstadūrdhvadaihikam ||43||
cakrire singhutīre vai bhūtvā te vaiṣṇavāḥ parāḥ |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇārthaṃ te vasatiṃ tatra cakrire ||44||
te’pi sevāṃ satāṃ nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ cakrire mudā |
satīnāṃ brahmacārāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ sevanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||45||
niṣpāpāḥ samajāyanta sevāpūjanadarśanaiḥ |
mahābhāgavatā jātā yeṣāṃ vaṃśāśca pāvanāḥ ||46 ||
narā nāryaḥ sādhubhaktāḥ sādhutulyāstato’bhavan |
sarvārpaṇavidhāne’pi niḥsaṃśayātmavedinaḥ ||47||
badrike teṣu cāyuṣyakṣayo yeṣāṃ vyajāyata |
te’pi divyena yānena śanairdhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||48||
anye bālā yuvānaśca yuvatyo bhejire harim |
ājīvanaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ śrīprabhuṃ mādhavīpatim ||49||
teṣāṃ yogena bahavo jñātibandhava ityapi |
śrīkṛṣṇakāntabhaktāśca jātā yātāḥ paraṃ padam ||4.59.50||
badrike tatra cānyattu mahāścaryamabhūcchṛṇu |
trigālavakuṭumbāni saṃghaśastatra phālgune ||51||
āsan samāgatānyeva mūlatantukapattanāt |
bhavāyano’bhavatteṣāmagresaraḥ kalāvidām ||52||
veṣāṇāṃ dhāraṇe cānukaraṇe kuśalaḥ kṛtau |
śikṣāprado’bhavatteṣāṃ gururbhavāyanaḥ svayam ||53||
bhavāyanasya yā śālā śubhā nāṭyakalāvidaḥ |
tasyāmāsan śikṣaṇīyāḥ śiṣyāḥ pañcaśatāni vai ||54||
taiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitaḥ śrutvā mahimānaṃ hareḥ sa ca |
āgato’bhūt kathāyāṃ vai śravaṇārthaṃ tathāparam ||55||
śrutamāścaryamevāpi parīkṣituṃ vilokitum |
sindhutīre vane ramye ārāmavatsamasthite ||56||
vasatiṃ kṛtavān śreṣṭhāṃ bhavāyanakalāpinaḥ |
athaikadā kathāṃ śrutvā rātrau khelaṃ pracakrire ||57||
tatra te darśayāmāsuḥ śṛṇu tad varṇayāmi te |
brahmaṇastu purā jātaḥ kumāraḥ kṣutasaṃbhavaḥ ||58||
kṣupanāmākarottasya brahmā svayaṃ tu viśvasṛṭ |
tasya mitraṃ dadhīcākhyo maharṣiścyavanātmajaḥ ||59||
sa provāca prasaṃgena dvayoḥ śraiṣṭhye vicārite |
vipraḥ śreṣṭha iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha tu bāhujaḥ ||4.59.60||
yato rājñi nivasanti dikpālā aṣṭasaṃkhyakāḥ |
tato vai kṣatriyaḥ śreṣṭho mūrdhābhiṣiktadaivataḥ ||61 ||
śrutvaitadroṣamāpanno dadhīco vāmahastajām |
muṣṭiṃ dṛḍhāṃ prāharadvai nṛpasyorasi nirbhayaḥ ||62||
rājā ruṣā tu khaṅgena śiraściccheda tatkṣaṇam |
tato hatyā brahmahatyā prādurbhūtā bhayaṃkarī ||63||
kṣupaṃ vavalga sahasā mārayāmītyuvāca tam |
yadvā jīvaya viprendraṃ sañjīvanyā sukhī bhava ||64||
śrutvā rājā prasasmāra śukrācāryaṃ sa āyayau |
sañjīvanyā bhārgavaḥ sa śiraḥsandhānamācarat ||65||
dadhīco jīvanaṃ labdhavān sā hatyā vyalīyata |
atha viprastapaścakre śaṃkarasyopari dhruvam ||66||
śaṃbhuḥ sākṣāt samāyāto dadau tatra varadvayam |
avadhyatvamajeyatvaṃ stāṃ te dadhīca sarvadā ||67||
dadhīcaścādhikaṃ vavre vajrāsthitvaṃ tṛtīyakam |
tathāstviti hara uktvāntardhāmaṃ prajagāma ha ||68||
ataḥ kālāntare viprakṣatrayormitrayoḥ punaḥ |
śraiṣṭhyavāde prajāte svaṃ dadhīcaḥ śreṣṭhamāha vai ||69||
rājā śraiṣṭhyaṃ nijaṃ prāha tadā vipro ruṣā jvalan |
vāmapādena nṛpatermūrdhni dṛḍhamatāḍayat ||4.59.70||
atha rājā purā kṛtvā bhaktimindrāt kulīśakam |
prāptavān yat prajahāra tena viprasya vakṣasi ||71 ||
vajraṃ spṛṣṭvā papātaiva na prāvartata mṛtyave |
vyarthaṃ vajraṃ vilokyaiva rājā roṣamavāptavān ||72||
utthāya prayayau pūjāgṛhaṃ viṣṇumatoṣayat |
pratyakṣaṃ tvāgataṃ viṣṇuṃ rājā prāha varārthakaḥ ||73 ||
viṣṇo sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ dehi me vijayapradam |
viṣṇustasmai pradāyaiva yayau vaikuṇṭhamacyutaḥ ||74||
atha rājā roṣayukto mumocāsya sudarśanam |
dadhīcasya gale yāvattāvad dadhīca ulbaṇam ||75||
phutkāraṃ janayāmāsa sudarśanāyudhopari |
sahasradhārāḥ sarvāstāḥ phutkāravahninā tadā ||76||
rasabhāvaṃ dravabhāvaṃ gatāścakraṃ prakuṇṭhitam |
papāta sahasā bhūmau niṣphalaṃ lohapiṇḍakam ||77||
tadā kṣupo vivedāpi balaṃ viprasya vai mahat |
athāpi roṣamāpanno viṣṇuṃ cārādhayatpunaḥ ||78||
viṣṇuḥ samāyayau rājā viṣṇuṃ prāha kṛtāñjaliḥ |
dadhīcasya vināśaṃ tvaṃ kuru garvaharaṃ prabho ||79||
viṣṇustaṃ pratyuvācāpi viprahatyā bhayāvahā |
na kartavyā kadācidvai rājan svārthahitaiṣiṇā ||4.59.80 ||
kintu taṃ saṃkathayāmi vivadasva nṛpeṇa mā |
iti viṣṇurdadhīcaṃ tu śikṣādānāya cāyayau ||8 1 ||
dadhīcastaṃ prabhuṃ natvā ruṣā novāca kiñcana |
atha viṣṇurnije dehe darśayāmāsa vai jagat ||82||
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ rudraṃ dadhīcaṃ sthirajaṃgamam |
tadā dadhīco haraye darśayāmāsa yogirāṭ ||83||
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇuṃ nṛpaṃ svavarṣmaṇi |
uvāca viṣṇuṃ ca tato mā māyāṃ me pradarśaya ||84||
nāhaṃ tayāpi mugdho’smi sadā vipraḥ samuttamaḥ |
śreṣṭho vipraḥ sadā cāsti na kṣatraṃ garvasaṃbhṛtam ||85||
yāhi viṣṇo nijaṃ sthānaṃ labha janma punaḥ punaḥ |
kṣatrapakṣagato yasmāt phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva mayoditam ||86||
sudarśanaṃ te galitaṃ punaḥ prāpnuhi tattathā |
daityanāśārthamevāpi na viprasya vicchittaye ||87||
evaṃ śapto haristena dadhīcena mahātmanā |
tato vipre tu bāṇena jayaṃ karoti mādhavaḥ ||88||
avatāreṣu sarveṣu daitye sudarśanena ca |
atha kṣupo’bhavad bhakto dīkṣāvān sādhuruttamaḥ ||89||
sannyāsayogamāpanno vaiṣṇavottama uttamaḥ |
tadā dadhīco vipro’pi sādhuṃ neme punaḥ punaḥ ||4.59.90||
uvāca viṣṇurūpo’si sādho śreṣṭhatamo’dhunā |
ṛbhuḥ sanatkumāraśca kapilo dattavāmanau ||91||
parśurāmaśca sarve te vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ |
parabrahmasvarūpāste viprāṇāṃ guravo’malāḥ ||92||
viprāṇāṃ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pūjyāste brahmagotriṇaḥ |
varṇānāṃ guravo viprā viprāṇāṃ tu gururyatiḥ ||93||
sādhavaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ guravaḥ śreṣṭhayoginaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sādhūn samarhati ||94||
evaṃ badrīpriye tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
samāyayau divyarūpaḥ pupūja vyāsarūpiṇam ||95||
sādhuṃ nijaprakāśaṃ vai mahāviṣṇusvarūpiṇam |
dadhīco’pi kṣupāyanābhidhaṃ santaṃ pupūja ha ||96||
evaṃ sādhau hariścāste sādhurūpa svaya hariḥ |
nijaprakāśe tatraiva prabhuḥkṛṣṇastiro’bhavat ||97||
ityevaṃ nāṭakaṃ sarvaṃ darśayāmāsurutyukāḥ |
bhavāyanasya śiṣyāste lakṣajanā vyalokayan ||98||
darśakāḥ sarva evaite prasannāḥ ṛṣayo’malāḥ |
mānavāśca narā nāryaḥ prasannā vīkṣya nāṭakam ||99||
santaśca munayaḥ sarve sādhvyaśca sādhavo’pi ca |
lomaśo’pi tathā vyāsaḥ prasannāste’bhavam̐stadā || 4.59.1 00||
varadānāya tānāhuste sarve varadānakam |
pāpanāśaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca yayācire tu vācakāt || 10 1||
sadā loke ca naḥ syādvai nāṭakaṃ tu yaśaḥpradam |
evaṃ tadvaṃśajānāṃ tu kṛte yayācire’pi ca || 1 02||
tathāstviti prāha tatra vyāsaḥ prakāśakṛt svayam |
ṛṣayo’pi tathā prāhurjayakāro’bhavattadā || 1 03||
praśaśaṃsurnarā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇārthakṛtakhelanān |
mokṣārthavarayācitṝn kṛtakṛtyān prabhupriyān || 1 04||
śrīlomaśājjagṛhuste mantraṃ ca nāmadhunyakam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svahā || 1 05||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa || 1 06||
dhunyaṃ pracakrire premṇā sādhusevāṃ pracakrire |
tataḥ pāpāni naṣṭāni vāsanā vilayaṃ gatā || 1 07||
caitrakṛṣṇāmāvāsyāyāṃ sāyaṃkāle hariḥ svayam |
divyarūpo bālakṛṣṇo vimānena samāyayau || 1 08||
bhavāyanaṃ tathā vṛddhān kṛtvā tu divyavigrahān |
ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 09||
bhavāyanasya śiṣyā vai pare gṛhastharūpiṇaḥ |
narā nāryaśca te sarve bhāvāyanā bhuvi śrutāḥ || 11 0||
abhavan pāvanā lokarañjakā khelakovidāḥ |
vaiṣṇavāste’bhavan sarve’vaśiṣṭāḥ śarkarāpure || 11 1||
kathānte te yayunaijaṃ mūlatantukapattanam |
trigālavāste sarve vai badrike ca tataḥ param || 11 2||
bhaktyā nārāyaṇaratā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 1 13||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bhaṇḍaśīlākhyaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ sārdhaśatabhāṇḍasahitaṃ tathā bhavāyanatrigālavaṃ kṣupadadhīcanāṭyakāriṇaṃ bahubhiḥ sahitaṃ ca kathāśravaṇato harirmuktisthānamanayadityādi nirūpaṇanāmā navapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||

<4.60>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ mallapramokṣiṇīm |
śrīkāranagare tvāsan mallāstadyuddhakovidāḥ || 1 ||
pañcāśatsaṃkhyakāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kṛtābhyāsā dṛḍhāsthinaḥ |
anye’pi mallavargasya kuṭumbino’bhavam̐stathā || 2 ||
narā nāryaśca te yānti nityaṃ kathāśravāya vai |
śrutvā nityaṃ samāyānti gṛhāṇi varṇayanti ca || 3 ||
gṛhasthebhyaḥ kathāṃ divyāṃ śrutāṃ yāṃ mokṣakāriṇīm |
tathā vadanti dṛṣṭaṃ yaṃ camatkāraṃ vimānajam || 4 ||
ye ye mokṣaṃ prayāntyeva tāṃ tāṃ vārtāṃ vadantyapi |
tato mallāḥ prasannāśca kathāsthalīṃ yayurdṛḍhāḥ || 5 ||
bahubhiḥ svajanaiḥ sākaṃ maṇḍapāntamupasthitāḥ |
kathānte te mallayuddhaṃ mahāścaryakaraṃ vyadhuḥ || 6 ||
lomaśastu prasannaḥ san mantraṃ tebhyo dadau mudā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||7 ||
nāmasaṃkīrtanārthaṃ ca bhajanaṃ pradadau tadā |
prabhonārāyaṇasvāminārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 8 ||
anādimādhavīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa |
mallāste sakuṭumbā vai bhajanaṃ cakrire sadā || 9 ||
kathāśravaṇamevāpi nityaṃ nityaṃ pracakrire |
satāṃ sevāṃ vyadhuḥ premṇā pūjanaṃ vācakasya ca || 4.60.1 0||
ārārtrikaṃ saṃhitāyāścakrire dharmamānasāḥ |
dānāni svarṇaratnānāṃ bhūṣāpātrānnavāsasām || 11 ||
cakrire mudrikāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ dānāni cakrire |
bhejuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ śuśravuḥ saṃhitākathām || 1 2||
pavitrāste prajātā vai niṣpāpā vāsanojjhitāḥ |
muktiyogyāstu ye jātā vṛddhā nāryo narā api || 1 3||
teṣāmagresarā nāmnā harivaryo gajakramaḥ |
śatavājaḥ siṃhamardaḥ śarabhārdaḥ kaserukaḥ || 14||
drumabhañjo vaṃśavāraḥ śilādo lohapeṣaṇaḥ |
ityevamādyāścānye’pi kṛtakṛtyā nirāśayāḥ || 15||
pradagdhavāsanā jātā nāryo’pi vṛddhayoṣitaḥ |
pratīkṣante tu muktyarthaṃ savimānāgamaṃ hareḥ || 1 6||
sāyaṃ caitrāmāvāsyāyāṃ kathānte kṛtapūjanāḥ |
sajjā ye cābhavan tāṃstu netuṃ kṛṣṇa upāyayau || 17||
divyavimānasahito divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
śriyā lakṣmyā padmayā ca ramayā saha tejasā || 18||
prakāśayan diśo harirhasan mallānuvāca ha |
mokṣayogyā bhavanto vai mokṣapuṇyābhibhāginaḥ || 19||
vihāya bhautikāndehānārohantu vimānakam |
ityuktā mallabhaktāste ye sajjā gantumakṣaram ||4.60.20||
narā nāryaśca te dehān vihāya divyamūrtayaḥ |
bhūtvā kṛṣṇecchayā tūrṇamāruruhurvimānakam ||21 ||
sarvā muktānikā muktā divyātmānaḥ surūpiṇaḥ |
bhūtvā śrīkṛṣṇadāsāśca jayaśabdān pracakrire |||22||
tānnītvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo badrīśvari nijam |
dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau vyomnā sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ satām || 23 ||
teṣāṃ dehānapare tu śiṣṭā mallakuṭumbinaḥ |
nītvā pradāhayāmāsuścordhvadaihikamācaran ||24||
camatkāro mahām̐ścāyaṃ prasasārātivegataḥ |
deśe grāmeṣu mallānāṃ mokṣātmako’timānavaḥ ||25||
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi camatkāraṃ tathāparam |
vārdhūṣikāśca godhādā lūṇīnagaravāsinaḥ ||26|||
dantadhāvanavikretāraśca kuṭumbinastadā |
śrutavanto mānuṣebhyaḥ praśaṃsāṃ paramātmanaḥ ||27||
kathāyāśca camatkāraṃ pāpināṃ pāpanāśanam |
mokṣaṃ divyavimānena yānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadarśanam ||28||
tena prajātajijñāsā narā nāryaśca saṃhitām |
śrotuṃ kṛtādarāḥ sajjā babhūvurvṛddhasaṃhitāḥ| ||29||
bālāśca bālikāścāpi śataṃ te mānavāḥ sukham |
vṛṣabhairnijasāmagrīrnīyamānāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||4.60.3 0||
vāghgharayaḥ śraukṛṣṇaṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram |
smarantaḥ prayayuḥ sindhujale sasnustato drutam ||3 1||
bhakṣayitvā tu pātheyaṃ prayayurmaṇḍapāntikam |
udyāne vṛṣabhāvāsaṃ cakrire taruṣaṇḍake ||32||
tataḥ śrotuṃ kathāṃ nītvā pūjāsāmagrikāḥ śubhāḥ |
vyāsāsanaṃ kathāsthānaṃ yayurbhāvabharāśca te || 33||
pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā bhāvaprakāśavācakam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ pupūjuḥ samāhitāḥ ||34||
upadā phalapuṣpāṇi svarṇamudrāḥ puro nyadhuḥ |
vastrabhūṣāmālikāśca maṇihārān dadustathā ||35||
guñjāhārān puṣpahārānakṣatān nidadhuḥ puraḥ |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ kuṃkumāgurucandanam || 36||
samarpyārārtrikaṃ cakruḥ sarve cakruśca daṇḍavat |
dakṣiṇāṃ rūpyamudrāśca puro nyadhustataḥ kathām ||37||
śaśruvurbhāvataścāpi pupūjurlomaśaṃ munim |
satāṃ sevāmāśrameṣu gatvā cakruraharniśam ||38||
evaṃ vārdhūṣikāḥ sarve kathāsevāvidhānataḥ |
gatapāpā viśuddhāścābhavan tebhyastu lomaśaḥ ||39||
mantraṃ saṃśrāvayāmāsa nāmadhunyaṃ dadau tathā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||4.60.40||
prabhonārāyaṇasvāminmālatīnrāyaṇaprabho |
jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||41 ||
prāpya mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ jepuścakruḥ sadā prage |
sāyaṃ tvevaṃ kathāṃ śrutvā jepuścakruḥ samāgatāḥ |||42|
nityaṃ cānāyya dadati dantadhāvanakānyapi |
barburādidrumāṇāṃ vā kṣīravatāṃ suśākhinām ||43||
tanuśākhāntalabhyāni mṛdūni surasāni ca |
evaṃ gatvā pārśvavane tvānayanti madhūnyapi ||44||
samarpayanti sādhubhyo vācakāya maharṣaye |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāpi pūjārthamarpayantyapi ||45||
ānayanti ca samidhaḥ kāṣṭhāni dhunihetave |
mṛttikāṃ cānayantyatra sevante sādhuyoginaḥ ||46||
evaṃ sarve kroṣṭṛvyādhā vaiṣṇavāḥ sevayābhavan |
pāvanāḥ pāpahīnāśca kathāśrutervivāsanāḥ ||47||
māsānte śrīprabhurnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmādhavīśvaraḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ prasannasteṣāṃ vai svapne sākṣāttadābhavat ||48||
caturbhujaḥ śrīsahitaḥ kṛtasevādivastuyuk |
hasan divyasvarūpaśca sahasrasūryabhāyutaḥ ||49||
kṣaṇāttiro’bhavaccāpi tataste prātareva ha |
utthāya tūrṇaṃ saṃsnātvā prasannā lomaśaṃ yayuḥ ||4.60.50||
pūjayitvā tu vṛttāntaṃ svāpnaṃ nyavedayanmudā |
lomaśo’pi samākarṇya prāha kroṣṭṛhaṇaḥ śubham ||51||
yuṣmākaṃ pātakaṃ naṣṭaṃ puṇyamabhyuditaṃ bahu |
devānāṃ durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanaṃ va upasthitam ||52||
yūyaṃ yogyā mokṣapade netuṃ vitta hi sarvathā |
bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo neṣyati vastataḥ ||53||
sajjā bhavata vṛddhādyā ye vāñcchantyakṣaraṃ padam |
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ lakṣmīpatiḥ samāgamiṣyati ||54||
ityuktāste vāghgharayo’bhavan sajjāstu muktaye |
vṛddhā nāryo narāścāpi pratīkṣante tadāgamam ||55||
caitrakṛṣṇāmāvāsyāyā rātryante pratipaddine |
prātareva samāyātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||56||
caitraśuklādyadivase śuklātiśuklarūpavān |
ujjvalaḥ śrīsahitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||57||
sarvabhūṣāprabhūṣitaḥ sarvathā saumya īśitā |
vimānena drutaṃ cāvātarat pṛthvyāṃ puraḥkṣitau ||58||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ samujjvalaṃ tadāmbaram |
jayanādāḥ surāṇāṃ ca puṣpavṛṣṭirdivaukasām ||59||
abhavan paritastatra kroṣṭṛhantṝnuvāca saḥ |
āyāta saṃprasanno’smi bhaktyā kathāśraveṇa ca ||4.60.60||
sādhūnāṃ sevayā cāpi mannāmakīrtanena ca |
pāvanāḥ sthaḥ samāyāta vimānaṃ mokṣanetṛ me ||61 ||
śrutvā tu badrike ye ye sajjā gantuṃ paraṃ padam |
abhavam̐ste drutaṃ dehām̐styaktvā tatra hi bhautikān ||62||
vimānaṃ te divyadehā bhūtvāruruhurutsukāḥ |
harṣalālādināmāno natvā śrīpatimīśvaram ||63||
śriyaṃ natvā narā nāryo muktā muktānikāstadā |
śrīkṛṣṇena praṇītāste yayurbrahmākṣaraṃ padam ||64||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ badri paraṃ mokṣaṃ yayurhi te |
kṛpayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca kathābalāt |||65|||
athānyatte kathayāmi mahāścaryaṃ tadā tathā |
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśakam ||66||
kaścinmṛgayurabhavat sindhuvane kuṭumbavān |
dṛṣṭavānambare tejaḥ prātareva vimānakam ||67||
mumude vīkṣya sahasā kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ |
tasyābhavattato buddhiḥ śuddhā mokṣābhigāminī ||68||
hiṃsāṃ vihāya pāpānāṃ nāśārthaṃ sakuṭumbakaḥ |
kathāsthalaṃ yayau tatra pupūja lomaśaṃ munim ||69||
nyavedayat svavṛttāntaṃ pāpanāśanahetukam |
kathāṃ śrotuṃ tathā mantraṃ cāptuṃ gantuṃ paraṃ padam ||4.60.70||
lomaśastaṃ kīravaṇaṃ mṛgayuṃ prāha vai vratam |
snānaṃ prapūjanaṃ mālāvartanaṃ sevanaṃ satām ||71||
nityaṃ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kamalāpateḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||72||
dadau mantraṃ hareḥ pādavāryamṛtaṃ dadau tathā |
prasādaṃ ca dadau brahmakūrcaṃ vrataṃ dadau tataḥ ||73||
kīravaṇādayaḥ sarve kuṭumbino vyadhurvratam |
bhajanaṃ sevanaṃ kathāśravaṇaṃ raṭanaṃ sadā ||74||
evaṃ māse gate sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
āyayau sādhurūpo vai drutaṃ kīravaṇaṃ prati ||75||
bhikṣāṃ yayāce sahasā phalapuṣpādibhojanām |
pātrāmbarādirūpā ca nāryarpaṇātmikāmapi ||76||
prasannaḥ sa kīravaṇo vīkṣya sādhuṃ samujjvalam |
nārāyaṇaṃ vicintyaiva dadau nārīṃ phalādikam ||77||
niḥsaṃśayaṃ nijaṃ bhaktaṃ bhaktāṃ parīkṣya mādhavaḥ |
sādhurūpādāvirāsa viṣṇurūpaścaturbhujaḥ ||78||
prāptvā phalaṃ prapasparśa nārīṃ naraṃ kuṭumbakam |
dakṣakareṇa bhagavān tāvat kīravaṇādayaḥ ||79||
divyadehā drutaṃ jātā divyarūpāḍhyamūrtayaḥ |
viṣṇurnārāyaṇastām̐śca sarvasvadānakāriṇaḥ ||4.60.80||
śaraṇāgatabhaktān vai vimānena suvarcasā |
anayad brahmalokaṃ vai paśyatāṃ dehadhāriṇām ||81 ||
badrike sā kṛpā svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai |
mṛgayuṃ tvanayat kṛṣṇo yannijaṃ dhāma cākṣaram ||82||
śrībadrīpriyovācakathaṃ vai bhagavannārāyaṇa viṣṇo jagatpate |
hiṃsakasyābhavad vyomni vimānasyāsya darśanam ||83||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
badrīpriye vane nityaṃ sādhusevāparaḥ sa hi |
phalapuṣpādibhiścāpi viśrāntisaṃpradānakaḥ ||84||
satāṃ pādādisaṃvāhasevākṛt sakuṭumbakaḥ |
nārāyaṇamprabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ japan satsaṃgakārakaḥ ||85||
tena yogena deveśi nirmalātmā supuṇyavān |
tyaktamṛgayādharmaḥ sa paścakālādavartata ||86||
evamāsīt puṇyaśālī sādhubhakto’tibhāvavān |
tato’sya śrīvimānasya darśanaṃ tvabhavattadā ||87||
badrike ye bhāgavatāste tu kṛṣṇapratāpinaḥ |
divyadṛṣṭayaḥ paśyanti divyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vimānakam ||88||
ye pāpā doṣabhṛddehā doṣātmānaśca doṣiṇaḥ |
nāstikā bhaktihīnāśca satāṃ vidveṣiṇastathā ||89||
teṣāṃ naivāsti nistārasteṣāṃ na divyadarśanam |
teṣāṃ na yogaḥ subhago mokṣadaḥ svargado’pi vā ||4.60.90||
api satsaṃgapārśve ye vasanto’pi tu nāstikāḥ |
teṣāṃ satsaṃgalābho na na puṇyaṃ naiva mokṣaṇam ||91 ||
api dūre vasanto ye snehavanto harau sati |
satsu tādātmyahṛdayāsteṣāṃ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ||92||
badrike bāhyasadbhiśca sahāntarikasādhavaḥ |
melanīyāḥ prayatnena tadā muktiḥ kare sthitā || 13||
bāhyato na satāṃ yogaścāntare viṣayānvitaḥ |
tādṛk satsaṃgahīnasya na svargaṃ na parā gatiḥ ||94||
badrike vai jagat sarvaṃ māyāvikṛtiśobhanam |
antarnagnaṃ bahiśchannaṃ gārhasthyaṃ sutarāṃ tathā || 95||
sadā viṣayacittātma sadā bhogaparāyaṇam |
barhiḥ suveṣamapi tannagnaṃ na yāti mokṣaṇam || 96||
badrike sādhavaḥ śāntā jitendriyā harau sthirāḥ |
antarviṣayahīnāśca bahirdigvāsaso’pi ca || 97||
brahmaguṇairdivyavastraiśchannā vibhūṣitāstu te |
avikṛtā akāmāśca vāsanāviṣavarjitāḥ ||98||
strīpuṃbhānavihīnāste suveṣāḥ sādhavo matāḥ |
teṣāṃ yogena pāpānāṃ vināśo brahmadarśanam ||99||
ātmanā divyatāprāptiraiśvaryāṇāṃ samarjanam |
mokṣaprāptirhareḥ prāptiḥ satāṃ yogena jāyate || 4.60.100||
kālanāśastathā māyānāśaḥ karmavināśanam |
bandhanāśo vāsanānāṃ kṣayaḥ sadyogato bhavet || 10 1 ||
evaṃ mṛgayuścāraṇye sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ |
bījabalavān kṛṣṇasya vimānaṃ samalokayat || 1 02||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya svargo muktirbhavedapi |
bhuktiḥ syāttu sakāmānāṃ sādhusaṃgāddhi mokṣaṇam ||1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne harivīryādimallānāṃ, harṣalālādimṛgayūṇāṃ, kīravaṇādivyādhānāṃ ca kathāśravaṇādito mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||

<4.61>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi līnakṣāranivāsinaḥ |
nāgādasya kathāṃ cāpi pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm || 1 ||
līnakṣāre tu nagare nāgakhelakaraḥ sadā |
sarpapālo’bhavad vādī nāgādanāmakaḥ khalu || 2 ||
vādikuṭumbakaṃ tatra vartate sarpapālakam |
nakulānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śīlānāṃ yuddhadarśakam || 3 ||
āraṇyakapaśūnāṃ ca sarīsṛpāṇāṃ pālakam |
vānarāṇāṃ ca ṛkṣāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ ca pālakam || 4 ||
paśūnādāya rāṣṭreṣu rāṣṭrāntareṣu yāti hi |
paśupakṣisarīsṛpakhelanairjīvavṛttikām || 5 ||
utpādya nirvahatyeva grāme grāme bhramatyapi |
pakṣipaśūn bhakṣayati paśuvad vartate’pi ca || 6 ||
poṣaṇārthaṃ bhramattadvai kuṭumbaṃ śarkarāpuram |
āyayau tat sindhutaṭe vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe samīpataḥ || 7 ||
maṇḍapānnātidūre ca kathāśabdābhisāriṇi |
sthale vāsaṃ vidhāyaiva tasthau jīvanahetave || 8 ||
mānavānāṃ tu sammarde khelaṃ darśayati prage |
madhyāhne ca tathā sāyaṃ janā dadati bhojanam || 9 ||
annaṃ vastraṃ ca piṣṭaṃ cākṣatān vastrāṇi dugdhakam |
śarkarāṃ ca guḍaṃ śākaṃ pātraṃ phalaṃ dalādikam || 4.61.1 0||
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ cekṣudaṇḍaṃ ghāsaṃ kaṇān supolikāḥ |
roṭakān caṇakān bhakṣyaṃ dadatyeva dayāvaśāḥ ||1 1||
nāgādanādayaste’pi vādiṭāḥ sarpakīśayoḥ |
sarpanakulayoścāpi pradarśya khelanaṃ muhuḥ || 12||
lokān prarañjayantyeva vṛttinirvāhahetave |
athaivaṃ khelanaṃ kṛtvā yathākāle kathārthinaḥ || 13||
vādiṭāste kathāṃ śrotuṃ sāyamāyānti nityaśaḥ |
pūjanaṃ vyāsadevasya saṃhitāyāśca pūjanam || 14||
sādhūnāṃ lomaśādeśca kurvanta pūjanaṃ śubham |
upadāścārpayantyeva phalapuṣpāmbarādikam || 16||
ekadā svapaśūnāṃ te sabhārañjanahetave |
vyadhuḥ khelaṃ sabhāraṃge satāṃ prasannatāptaye || 16||
bhallukānāṃ ca ṛkṣāṇāṃ kīśānāṃ vṛścikasya ca |
kukkuṭānāṃ bhogināṃ ca nakulānāṃ ca meṣayoḥ || 17||
rañjitāḥ khelanaiḥ santaḥ prasādaṃ te dadustadā |
miṣṭānnāni bhojanāni phalāni piṣṭakāni ca | |18||
śarkarāśca payaḥ sūpaudanāni bhājikāstathā |
polikāḥ pūrikāścāpi śaṣkulīlaḍḍukānapi || 19||
pāyasānnamapūpāni śākānyuccāvacāni ca |
randhitānnāni caṇakān saṃskṛtān pācitān śṛtām | |4.61.20||
caṭanīṃ dadhidugdhāni takrāṇi kṛsarāṇi ca |
mahābhojyāni sarvāṇi vādiṭebhyastu sādhavaḥ ||21 ||
daduḥ prasādarūpāṇi paśubhyo’pi śubhāni ca |
prasādānnāni sarvāṇi daduḥ payāṃsi yāni ca ||22||
hareḥ pādāmṛtaṃ vāri dadustebhyo dayānvitāḥ |
bubhujuste hṛṣṭacittā vādiṭāḥ sarvaśastadā ||23||
paśavo’pi prasādena tṛptāḥ kiṃ vādiṭāḥ punaḥ |
pāvanāḥ pāpaśūnyāste’bhavan prasādabhojanāt || 24||
kathānāṃ śravaṇaiścāpi sattvacittāstato’bhavan |
mokṣārthamarthayāmāsurlomaśaṃ śreyase muhuḥ ||25||
lomaśaḥ pradadau tebhyo mantraṃ nāma harerapi |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||26||
prabhonārāyaṇasvāminmādhavīnrāyaṇaprabho |
jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||27||
athaivaṃ prāpya mantraṃ te nāmadhunyaṃ pramuktidam |
vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā jātāścakruste bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||28||
māsānte pāvanānāṃ vai prasannaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
caitrasyaiva śvetapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ śriyaḥ patiḥ ||29||
bhagavānāyayau teṣāṃ śreyase savimānakaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇasvāmī vallabho hi mahāprabhuḥ ||4.61.3 0||
vimānāt sahasā sāyaṃ cāvātarat sabhāsthale |
kathottaraṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo jagāda vādiṭān hitam ||3 1 ||
āyāta vādiṭā yūyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ madvimānake |
ye sajjāstviha mokṣārthaṃ teṣāṃ karomi mokṣaṇam ||32||
kṛpayā cāgatastvatra vo dadāmi kathāphalam |
ityuktā mohamāpannāḥ svāminikṛṣṇamādhave ||33||
vādiṭāścābālavṛddhāḥ pañcāśannarayoṣitaḥ |
śatena sahitāḥ pakṣipaśuvṛścikabhoginām || 34||
anyaiśca paśubhiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitāḥ śreya ārthayan |
prāhuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ paśvādyā bālakā hi naḥ ||35||
tān vihāya kathaṃ kṛṣṇa yāsyāmaḥ śreyase vayam |
tān samuddhara bhagavan śaraṇāgatavatsala ||36||
eteṣāṃ na bhavenmuktiḥ pratyakṣaṃ māpatiṃ vinā |
tiryagyonigatānāṃ vai tatastvaṃ tān samuddhara | |37||
ityarthito hi bhagavānnanādiśrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
vādiṭaiḥ saha paśvādīn jalena prokṣya tatkṣaṇam ||38||
divyadehān vidhāyaiva muktarūpān caturbhujān |
devākṛtīn samastām̐stān vimāne nyasya yāvataḥ ||39||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijaṃ hariḥ |
nāgādanādayaḥ sarve kṛpayā sevayā śruteḥ ||4.61.40 ||
yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ badri bhaktyā prapattirūpayā |
jayakāro’bhavattatra mahotsavo vyavartata ||41||
athānyaṃ ca camatkāraṃ śṛṇu badrīpriye tathā |
ārśaphalākhyanagarācchrutvā kathāmahotsavam ||42||
āyayurvyāyāmakhelakuśalā dve śate narāḥ |
nāryaścāpi ca khelinyaḥ siṃhādyāḥ paśavo gajāḥ ||43||
vājinaḥ śarabhā bhallukā dvipā gavayāḥ kharāḥ |
sārahāsyavidaḥ sarve vyomarajjvādidolinaḥ ||44||
vajrakāryavido nirālamboḍḍayanavedinaḥ |
mahābalā narā nāryo dehakauśalyadarśinaḥ ||45||
udyāne te nivāsaṃ vai cakruḥ khelaparāyaṇāḥ |
nityaṃ rātrau sukhelāni kurvanti kārayantyapi ||46||
ekadā te vinā mūlyaṃ khelanāni vyadhurniśi |
satāṃ kathārthināṃ cāpi mānavānāṃ pradṛṣṭaye ||47||
raṃgastatra hi bhaktānāṃ prabhaktānāṃ mahānabhūt |
lakṣaśo mānavā draṣṭuṃ samāyātāstadā niśi ||48||
gajānāṃ vājināṃ cāpi siṃhānāṃ khelanānyapi |
kṛtavantaśca te sārahāsyamaṇḍalikā narāḥ ||49||
nārīṇāṃ gītakāryāṇi nartanāni vyadhuḥ striyaḥ |
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ yāni khelanāni vyadhuśca te ||4.61.50||
vyomoḍḍayanarūpāṇi vahnikāryāṇi yānyapi |
yantrakhelāni hṛdyāni cakrire mānavādayaḥ ||51 ||
prasannāstāni saṃvīkṣya vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavo’pare |
narā nāryaḥ prasannāśca sañjātāḥ khelalokanaiḥ ||52||
upadā khelakebhyaśca daduḥ śrīvaiṣṇavā janāḥ |
nṛpāḥ prajāḥ śreṣṭhinaśca dhanāni bahudhā daduḥ ||53||
khelānte sādhavastebhyo mokṣāśiṣo daduḥ śubhāḥ |
svataḥprakāśo bhagavān prasādaṃ bahuśobhanam ||54||
bhojanaṃ pradadau tebhyo miṣṭānnaṃ caraṇāmṛtam |
bhuktvā te pāvanā jātā mānavāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ ||55||
prātaḥ snātvā ca te nadyā jale śrīlomaśaṃ yayuḥ |
kathāsthānaṃ pūjanārthaṃ vyāsasya pustakasya ca ||56||
prātaḥ prapūjanaṃ cakrurbahubhirvastubhiśca te |
upadāśca puro dhṛtvā candanādyairapūjayan |||57|||
prārthayan śreyase te’pi kathāśravaṇapāvitāḥ |
lomaśastatra sarvebhyo manuṃ nāma dadau mudā ||98||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
prabhonārāyaṇasvāminmādhavīnrārāyaṇaprabho ||99||
jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho |
evaṃ mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ dadau śrīlomaśo muniḥ ||4.61.60||
te sarve sārahāsasthā jepurmantraṃ vidhānavat |
nāmadhunyaṃ pracakruśca mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ||61 ||
sevāṃ satāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ cakrire mudā |
kathāṃ nityaṃ śuśruvuste dānadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ||62||
nityaṃ te bhajanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhoḥ |
māsānte pāvanānāṃ tu mokṣadātā narāyaṇaḥ ||63||
mahāvimānamādāya sūryabhāsaṃ suvarṇajam |
lakṣmyā śriyā prajñayā padmayā muktairyutaṃ śubham ||64||
āyayau maṇḍapodyānamadhyadeśe hyavātarat |
vimānaṃ tatsūryatulyaṃ vyalokayan prajājanāḥ ||65||
sāyāhne vai caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ drutaṃ janāḥ |
mahāścaryaparāstatra kathānte’bhita āyayuḥ ||66||
cakruste darśanaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sārahāsasya mānavān ||67||
narānnārīḥ prāvadadvai tvāyāntvatra vimānake |
bhavanmokṣāyāṣṭhagato’smi samārohantu satvaram || 68||
ye vāñchanti paraṃ mokṣaṃ te tvāyāntu vimānake |
ityuktā badrike sārahāsamaṇḍalino janāḥ ||69||
narā nāryo bālikāśca bālā vṛddhāstathāpare |
yuvānaśca vimalā ye gatamohā nirañjanāḥ ||4.61.70||
nirdagdhavāsanā ye ca kathāśravaṇapāvitāḥ |
sajjā gantumabhavan ye vairāgyavegaśālinaḥ ||71||
te sarve tvaritāścāsan samutsukā hi muktaye |
cakrurhalahalāśabdān vimānaṃ prati dudruvuḥ ||72||
pārvaṇena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalena tān |
saṃprokṣya divyadehān vai kṛtvā tatraiva tatkṣaṇam ||73||
divyoḍḍayanaśaktām̐śca kṛtvā dhṛtvā vimānake |
dehaistaireva ṣoḍaśavarṣān vidhāya mādhavaḥ ||74||
mānavānāṃ śataṃ cāpi nītvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau |
śataṃ tatrāvaśiṣṭāśca paśupakṣisamanvitāḥ ||75||
mahāścaryaparāste’pi bhajanaṃ cakrurādarāt |
te’pi paścājjātavegā mokṣārthaṃ niścayaṃ vyadhuḥ ||76||
kīrtanaṃ nityamevaite cakrurvai bhaktibhāvataḥ |
dadhyurnārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ tanmānasāśca tatparāḥ ||77||
satāṃ sevāṃ pracakruśca viśeṣataḥ samarpitāḥ |
kathāśravaṇaṃ cakruśca nityaṃ nityamatandritāḥ ||78||
prārthanāṃ te’pi mokṣārthaṃ cakruḥ śrīlomaśāgrataḥ |
tathāstviti prāha ṛṣiścāśīrvādān dadau tataḥ ||79||
caitrasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ prātasteṣāṃ janārdanaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇurmokṣārthaṃ samupāgataḥ ||4.61.80||
badrike te kṛtasnānā kṛtārhaṇāḥ sabhāsthalam |
āyāyustatra vai śrutvā kathāṃ tiṣṭhanti yāvatā ||8 1||
tāvadvimānamākāśādavātarat suvarṇajam |
divyaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇena vāhitaṃ suviśālakam ||82||
sarveṣāṃ gocaraṃ ramyaṃ tasmāt kṛṣṇo bahirmudā |
āgatya sārahāsasthānavaśiṣṭān hi mānavān ||83||
hariḥ prāha samāyāntu mokṣapadaṃ nayāmyaham |
sārahāsasyāgranetā nāmnā mārtaṇḍamaṇḍalaḥ ||84||
yo vai mokṣaṃ gataḥ pūrvaṃ tasya putro’rkamaṇḍalaḥ |
tūrṇaṃ kare jalaṃ gṛhya saṃkalpaṃ pra vyadhānmudā |||85||
yaddhanaṃ copakaraṇānyuccāvacāni yāni ca |
vāhanāni ca yānāni vastrabhūṣāsamṛddhayaḥ ||86||
sārahāsīyakaṃ sarvaṃ dhanādi vividharddhikam |
atra sthitaṃ tvarpayāmi pārāyaṇārthamatra yat ||87||
jīvatpaśūn pakṣigaṇān sarīsṛpādikānapi |
asmābhiḥ saha śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nayatvapi ||88||
mokṣapadaṃ prayāntyeva pañcādyā api ye’tra ha |
mānavāśca narā nāryo bālāśca bālikā api ||89||
divyadehā vimānena prayāntvakṣaradhāma te |
śṛṇvatāṃ vai sadasyānāṃ jalaṃ mumoca vai kṣitau ||90 ||
tāvacchrīkṛṣṇabhagavān jalaṃ cikṣepa teṣu tu |
jalasparśena sahasā divyadehāḥ samujjvalāḥ ||4.61.9 1 ||
sārahāsajanā āsan divyāśca divyavigrahāḥ |
paśvādyāśca sthitā vāse mṛtāste paśuvigrahāḥ ||92||
divyadehā abhavam̐śca devatulyāḥ samastataḥ |
āruruhurvimānaṃ te sarve vai muktavigrahāḥ ||93||
narā nāryaśca paśvādyāḥ sārahāsagatāstu ye |
sarve vimānamārūḍhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñāvaśāstadā ||94||
jayaśabdaṃ nāmadhunyaṃ vimāne te pracakrire |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanītā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||95||
badrike jayaśabdāśca tadāsan sarvato hyati |
puṣpāṇāṃ vṛṣṭayastatra divyānāmabhavan śubhāḥ ||96||
candanānāṃ vṛṣṭayaścābhavan meghapathaścyutāḥ |
satāṃ sevāphalaṃ mantranāmajāpaphalaṃ tathā ||97||
kathāśravaṇajanyaṃ ca phalaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam |
badrike sārahāsasya maṇḍalasya prajīvinām ||98||
prāptaṃ kṛpātmakaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha |
kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā sarve muktiṃ yayuḥ parākṣare ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādapi mokṣabhāg |
sarveṣṭasiddhiratyarthā sammukhī samprapadyate || 4.61.1 00||
saṃkalpitaṃ samastaṃ vai labhyeta śravaṇādapi |
bhuktirmuktirmahāsvargaṃ sarvaṃ karagataṃ bhavet || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne vādiṭasya nāgādananāmakasya sakuṭumbasya, sārahāsamaṇḍalasthānāṃ mārtaṇḍamaṇḍalādīnāṃ samastānāṃ ca, kathāśravaṇasādhusevanabhaktyādibhimoṃkṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||

<4.62>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi luñcādasya kathāmapi |
lālākhānapure vipro’bhavat pradhānadhiṣṇyapaḥ || 1 ||
nāmnā vilāsadevaḥ sa rāṣṭre pradhānakāryakṛt |
śarkarānṛpaterājñākaro vivādamadhyagaḥ || 2 ||
nyāyakartābhavaccāpi dharmaśāstrānusārataḥ |
kuṭumbasahitaścāpi rājyasattādhikāravān || 3 ||
prajānāṃ vādaviṣaye śreyaskṛt suvicāravān |
kuśalo rājyakaraṇe kintu lobhaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
dvayorvivāde pracchannāṃ luñcāṃ gṛhṇāti vai dvayoḥ |
dvayoḥ kāryāṇi yogyāni nistārayati nyāyataḥ || 5 ||
evaṃ jāte bahukāle pratiṣṭhāmāptavānati |
luñcādhanaistu bahulaiḥ śreṣṭhī dhanapatiḥ sa vai || 6 ||
jātastathāpi lobhāḍhyo dānaṃ puṇyaṃ karoti na |
na tīrthaṃ na makhaṃ dānaṃ sādhubhyo vā karotyapi || 7 ||
nātithīnna satīḥ sādhvīrna devān pūjayatyapi |
notsavānna ca vā śrāddhaṃ karoti kārayatyapi || 8 ||
na vratāni na bhajanaṃ śreyaḥ kiñcit karotyapi |
ātmahitaṃ nācarati badrike sa dvijo hyapi || 9 ||
nārakīva sadā cāste samṛddho’pi daridravat |
dīyate na na bhujyate tat tṛtīyāṃ vindate gatim ||4.62.1 0||
evamasya bhūdevasya vilāsadevanāminaḥ |
dhanaṃ sañcayamāpannaṃ bhūmau cañcalatāṃ gatam || 1 1||

vilāsadevo vipro’pi parāṃ vihvalatāṃ gataḥ || 14||

śuśoca bahudhā tatra śrāvayan svakuṭumbinaḥ || 15||
aho bhārye sutāḥ putryo dhanaṃ sarvaṃ gataṃ hi naḥ |
durbhāgyasyārjitaṃ cāpi prayāti vṛścikātmakam || 16||
paśyantvimān tāmrakuṃbhān riktān pūrvaprapūritān |
lakṣmīrmayārjitā sā na yojitā satsu karmasu || 17||

sañcitā sarvadā garte mūrchitā sā gatā svayam || 18||

bhogātmakaṃ phalaṃ naiva prāptaṃ mayā kadācana |
pratyutāghaṃ mahat prāptaṃ luñcājanyaṃ pralobhinā ||4.62.20||

pāpasya loke pāpānāṃ mūlaṃ lobho nigadyate ||24||
adharmaputro lobho’styadharmo lobhāt pravardhate |

jaḍāpi sā gatā caityā bhūtvā vṛścikarūpiṇī |
tasyāḥ prasannatārthaṃ tu sādhanaṃ harisevanam ||26||
vinā prasannatāṃ lakṣmyā vaikuṇṭhe vasatirna hi |
tasmāt prasādanīyā sā nārāyaṇasya sevanāt ||27||
ityevaṃ sa śuśocāpi nirdhanaḥ svajanaiḥ saha |
vicittatāṃ gataścāpi luñcādhanalayāttathā ||28||
kuṭumbaṃ duḥkhamāpannaṃ sukhaśūnyaṃ tato’bhavat |
padaṃ pradhānaṃ kaṣṭākhyaṃ sarvaṃ tasyāpyabhāsata ||29||
anyāyopārjitaṃ dravyaṃ mūlamādāya nirgatam |
tasmāt pradhānatā duṣṭā lobhakrodhādisaṃbhṛtā ||4.62.30 ||
svargamokṣādihantryeva viprasya tu viśeṣataḥ |
viprasya yogyatā daive sukhadā na tu rājake ||3 1||
sadā kleśamayaṃ rājyaṃ sattā pāpānvitā sadā |

śrīkṛṣṇadhyānakāle’pi śatrvādidhyānamarṣaṇam ||33||
pūjākāle mahīmānasammānādividhāpanam |
devadarśanakāle’pi cauraduṣṭādicintanam ||34||
ātmasādhanakāle’pi māyāsādhanamanvaham |

aho kaṣṭapadaṃ nityaṃ pradhānapadamīdṛśam ||36||

śāśvataśca na kośo’sti sā vai tyājyā pradhānatā ||37||
bhāgyarekhā daridrasya dāridryamātanoti vai |
yatamānasya yatno’pi nirbalo rekhayā kṛtaḥ ||38||

śrūyate tu mayā nityaṃ śubhaṃ lokamukhādapi ||4.62.40||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ param |
vārṣikaṃ vartate nātidūre vai śarkarāpure ||41||

ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo bhaktā vaiṣṇavā bahavo janāḥ ||42||
śreṣṭhinaśca narā nāryo lakṣādhimānavāḥ sadā |
śṛṇvanti tu kathā divyāḥ pāvanāste bhavantyapi ||43||
lakṣmīḥ prasannā bhavati prasannaśca narāyaṇaḥ |
pāpināṃ cāvīkṣya doṣān karoti pāvanām̐stu tān ||44||
kṛpayaiva prabhuḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvara |
āgatya darśanaṃ datvākṣaraṃ dhāma nayatyapi ||45||
vipro’haṃ pāpasampanno me gatirnānyathā śubhā |
gatvā tatra kathāṃ śrutvā kṛtvā pāpavidhūnanam ||46||
brahmagatiṃ prayāsyāmi syāt sāphalyaṃ janermama |
asāraḥ khalu saṃsāraḥ kṛto’pyakṛta eva saḥ ||47||
vivekena tu taṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim |
yadvā tadvā kathāṃ śrutvā sadgatirme bhaviṣyati ||48||
kuṭumbena sahito’haṃ tato yāmyadhunā kathām |
dharmakṛtye ciratā vai vighnadā na tu sādhikā ||49||
dharmakārye tvātmakārye prakurvīta drutaṃ mudā |
prātaḥ kālo nivarteta na cāgacchet punaḥ śubhaḥ ||4.62.50||
vicāryetthaṃ badrike sa vipro vilāsadevakaḥ |
sajjo bhūtvā kuṭumbena sahitaḥ suvicāravān ||51 ||
tyaktvā prajāsamakṣaṃ vai padaṃ prādhānikaṃ tu tat |
virāmaṃ tu samāsādya parihāraṃ vidhāya ca ||52||
niryayau nagarāttasmāccharkarāpuramāyayau |
mahodyāne nijāvāsaṃ sabhāmaṇḍapasannidhau |||93||
akarodbhagavatprāptyai mano dadhe’tiśāntaye |
sasnau tīrthajalaiścāpyādāyopadāstataḥ svayam ||54|||
kuṭumbasahito vipraḥ kathāmaṇḍapamāyayau |
badrike hṛdaye śāntirviprasya bahudhābhavat |||95|||
muktāgaurī tu tatpatnī parāṃ śāntimavāpa ha |
maṇḍapadarśanaṃ kṛtvā putryaḥ pañca sutāstrayaḥ ||56||
sarve śāntimagustatra kṛtvā vyāsasya darśanam |
saṃhitāyā darśanaṃ ca lomaśasyāpi darśanam ||57||
kṛtvā satāṃ darśanaṃ cāsādhvīnāṃ darśanaṃ tathā |
vaiṣṇavānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ hyapi ||58||
evaṃ teṣāṃ darśanena saṃkalpā vilayaṃ gatāḥ |
hṛdayānyamalānyeva jātāni mānasānyapi ||99||
udvegā vilayaṃ prāptāścintā cittānnyavartata |
duḥkhaṃ vyādhirādhyupādhī sarvaṃ tad vilayaṃ gatam ||4.62.6 0||
brahmasukhaṃ yathā syādvā tathā kṛṣṇasukhaṃ bhavet |
muktisukhaṃ yathā vā syāt tathā śāntirvyavartata ||61||
aho sthānasya māhātmyaṃ māyājālaṃ layaṃ gatam |
aho darśanamāhātmyaṃ manomalamalīyata ||62||
aho satāṃ pramāhātmyaṃ vāsanā vilayaṃ gatā |
darśanādeva viprasya tāpāstatra layaṃ gatāḥ ||63||
tatra cāgatya purato vyāsasyārhaṇamācarat |
saṃhitāyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca lomaśasyāpi pūjanam ||64||
satāṃ prapūjanaṃ cāpi nīrājanaṃ vyadhādapi |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ daṇḍavacca naivedyaṃ ca phalārpaṇam ||65||

tatpatnīputrikāputrāḥ pupūjurvyāsamutsukāḥ ||4.62.70||

kālamāyāpāpakarmaśanuyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ||4.62.80||
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava |

śaraṇaṃ śrākṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā |
evaṃ śaraṇamantraṃ ca datvā brahmamanuṃ dadau ||82||
brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||83||

evaṃ samarpaṇaṃ datvā kāṣāyāmbaradhotrakam ||86||
uttarīyaṃ śirastrāṇaṃ tathā cāpyaṃgarakṣakam |
gātrarakṣakamevāpi kāṣāyāmbaramārpayat ||87||
yajñopavītakaṃ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ candanaṃ tathā |
mālikāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ dadau tataḥ ||88||
evaṃ narebhyo datvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca |
nāmajapātmakaṃ datvā nārībhyo dīkṣaṇaṃ dadau ||89||
mantrān datvā ca kāṣāyāmbaraśāṭīṃ navāṃ śubhām |
kāṣāyaghargharīṃ cāpi kāṣāyacolikāṃ dadau ||4.62.90||
kāṣāyakucarakṣāṃ ca kāṣāyamūrdhakeśalīm |
yajñopavītakaṃ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā ||91||

dehendriyāntaḥkaraṇaiścātmanā guṇakarmabhiḥ |

śrīkṛṣṇānugrahaścāpi śrīkṛṣṇārthasamastatā ||97||
tadbhaktyā taddhāmagatistanmūrtāvabhivāsitā |
tadānandāśanamātraṃ kṛṣṇatādātmyamityapi ||98||
evaṃ samupadiśyaiva prasādānnajalāmṛtam |
dadau tebhyaśca te bhaktā mahābhāgavatottamāḥ ||99||
tyāgisanto bhāvabhaktyā pupūjurvyāsasadgurum |
evaṃ badrīpriye luñcādano’pi dvijapuṃgavaḥ || 4.62.10 0||
kuṭumbasahito jātaḥ sādhuḥ pradhānatāṃ jahau |

muniprakāśāyanakaḥ kṛṣṇaprakāśakāyanaḥ || 1 02||

kṛṣṇakāntāyanī cāpi viṣṇukāntāyanīti ca || 1 04||

<4.63>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīśvari devi sarvādasya kathāṃ tathā |
mahīrāyapure tvāsīd duritaghoṣanāmakaḥ || 1 ||
pradhānapadabhāg vipraḥ sarvabhakṣī yathā janaḥ |
sarvādanaḥ sarvabhojī sarvahārīti viśrutaḥ || 2 ||
sarvādānaparaḥ pāpī pāpācāro’tidūṣitaḥ |
prasahya vā prasādena sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti sarvataḥ || 3 ||
nāgrāhyaṃ nābhakṣyamasya kimapyāsīcca kasyacit |
mlecchadharmābhavat pāpāt pāpisaṃgāt paśuryathā || 4 ||
pūrvaṃ sudharmakarmāpi paścāt pradhānatāṃ gataḥ |
sarvadharmavihīno’bhūnnāstiko nindakaḥ khalaḥ || 5 ||
rājyadravyaṃ tathā pāpaṃ matibhedakaraṃ hi tat |
pāpamiśraṃ prajānāṃ tad dhanamannaṃ karādikam || 6 ||
daṇḍadravyaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ ca cauradhanaṃ tato’pyadhaḥ |
ghātakānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ yathādhonāṇakaṃ tathā || 7 ||
tatprayogeṇa jaṭharā malinā malinaṃ manaḥ |
buddhermālinyamevāpi dharme nāstikyameva tat || 8 ||
satkarmaṇāṃ parityāgo duṣṭakarmānuvartanam |
devapūjāparityāgo mokṣamārgādivarjanam || 9 ||
abhakṣye ca tatastasya pravartanā prajāyate |
sarvāśano bhavet paścād vipro’pi rākṣaso yathā || 4.63.1 0||
evaṃ duritaghoṣo’pi badrike mānavo’pi san |
vipro’pi dhiṣṇyasaṃstho’pi dhikkṛtiṃ samupāgataḥ || 1 1||
militvātha samastābhiḥ prajābhiḥ sa nirākṛtaḥ |
vimānito nijagrāmānniṣkāsitaḥ kuṭumbayuk || 12||
tataḥ śokaṃ jagāmāpi dharmatyāge hi dhikkṛtiḥ |
avamānaṃ prajābhyaśca devebhyo’pi sadā tathā || 1 3||
dhikkṛto mānavairnaiva paralokāya kalpyate |
na gatiḥ subhagā tasya dagdhabhāgyaśca kācana || 14||
rudanti pitaraścāsya kuladevā ruṣanti ca |
dharmo ruṭhati lakṣmīśca pādau kṛtvā nivartate || 15||
sammānaḥ svāgataśceti śrīputrau viprakarṣagau |
sampado vividhā ramyā vilīyante hyadharmiṇaḥ || 1 6||
vighnāḥ kāryeṣu jāyante skhalanaṃ ca pade pade |
parājayaḥ samagreṣu naiṣphalyaṃ ceṣṭakarmasu || 17||
ārabdheṣu kṣatiścāpi prārabdheṣu śilāhatiḥ |
durbhikṣatvaṃ phaladeṣu niṣphaleṣu pravartanā || 18||
gṛhe kuṭumbavarge’pi kalistasya pade dhṛte |
nārīputrādyamānaṃ ca śvavṛttivattu jīvanam || 19||
grāme sūkaravadvṛttiḥ prakāśe’pyandhatāsya ca |
hṛdaye’pi pāpapuñjād vahnijvalanamanvaham ||4.63.20||
āpattayaḥ paritaścāgatyainaṃ tvardayantyapi |
harerbhaktiṃ satāṃ sevāṃ guroḥ prāptiṃ haranti ca ||21 ||
dānaṃ vrataṃ tīrthayātrāṃ virundhanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe |
abhyudayaṃ paraṃ śreyaḥ kalyāṇaṃ nāśayantyapi ||22||
kiṃ bahunā badrike’sya puruṣārthā viyanti ca |
nirarthakā hi sarve te tato yātyadhamāṃ gatim ||23||
evaṃ vicārya bahudhā kalyāṇamārgaṇaṃ vyadhāt |
śuśrāva janamukhataḥ pārāyaṇamahotsavam ||24||
camatkārān hareścāpi pāpināṃ pāpanāśakān |
mokṣadān divyatādhānān śuśrāva sakuṭumbakaḥ ||25||
tatra gantuṃ tadā buddhimakarot sa nirāśrayaḥ |
sajjo’bhavad drutaṃ cāśvaśakaṭyoṣṭrānasā tathā || 26||
yogyavastūnyupakaraṇāni cādāya satvaram |
pratasthe sakuṭumbaḥ sa smarannārāyaṇaṃ harim ||27||
śarkarānagaraṃ prāpya gatyā sabhāsumaṇḍapam |
mahodyāne kṛtāvāsaḥ kṛtasnānavidhistataḥ || 28||
dhṛtopadaḥ sakuṭumbo yayau vyāsāsanaṃ mudā |
sāyaṃ pūjāṃ pracakāra saṃhitāvyāsayormudā ||29||
lomaśādestataḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā natvā sato janān |
sabhāyāṃ śravaṇārthaṃ sa upāviveśa mānitaḥ ||4.63.30||
kathānte sa pracakre nīrājanaṃ bhāvapūrvakam |
kṛṣṇapādāmṛtaṃ cāpi papau prasādamāśa ca ||3 | ||
pūtātmā sahasā jāto mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||32||
prabhonārāyaṇaśrīmanmādhavīnrāyaṇa prabho |
jayākṛṣṇalalitāśrīkṛṣṇarādhāpate vibho | |33||
evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadhunyaṃ ca jagrāha lomaśādapi |
nityaṃ cakre nāmadhunyaṃ satāṃ sevanamanvaham ||34||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi pāpakṣayo’bhavattataḥ |
lomaśasyopadeśena brahmakūrcavrataṃ vyadhāt ||35||
māsāntaṃ tasya manasi vyajāyata śubheṣaṇā |
tyāgidīkṣāgrahaṇecchā prabalā saṃvyajāyata || 36||
prārthayat sa vyāsadevaṃ so’pi dīkṣāṃ dadau tataḥ |
prāyaścittottaraṃ śrāddhaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ ||37||
havanādi tataḥ kṛtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārhaṇam |
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśayitvā yajñopavītakam ||38||
dadau mantrān śaraṇaṃ tu prathamaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
brahmamantraṃ tata ātmanivedanaṃ tataḥ param ||39||
sarvasamarpaṇaṃ cāpi dadau kāṣāyavastrakam |
samastaveṣaṃ pradadau viprāya tatstriyai tathā | |4.63.40||
putrebhyaśca caturbhyo’pi saptaputrībhya ityapi |
dīkṣāṃ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ ca mūrtiṃ pūjārthamityapi | |4 1 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ śrīyutāṃ pradadau tadā |
nāmajapaṃ mahādīkṣāmādāya te pracakrire | |42||
jayakāro’bhavatteṣāṃ sarvamanyacchubhaṃ tathā |
abhavadvai mahādānādikaṃ tatra tu dīkṣaṇe | |43 ||
evaṃ tyāgāśrame tasthurnāmnā saddhoṣaṇāyanaḥ |
patnī nāmnā mahāsatyāyanī bhāgavatottamā ||44||
putrā nāmnā tu vairāgyāyanaḥ śaṃbhvāyanastathā |
yogāyanastathā jñānāyanaścetyabhavam̐stathā ||45||
putryaḥ sādhvyaḥ sapta nāmnā prajñāyanī kṛtāyanī |
sevāyanī tathā sattvāyanī rāmāyaṇī tathā ||46 ||
bodhāyanī ca pratibhāyanīti vaiṣṇavītamāḥ |
sarve te cābhajan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabheśvaram ||47||
kālena te yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ |
evaṃpratāpā badari saṃhitāyāḥ kathā parā | |48 ||
pāpināṃ pāpalayadā mahāpuṇyapradā tathā |
ante mokṣapradā divyā śāśvatānandadāyinī ||49 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradā śubhā |
svargamuktipradā sampatpradā sarvarddhisampradā || 4.63.50 ||
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ cānyāṃ supāvanīm |
dardurākhye pure tvāsīd vipro’mātyo’tibuddhimān ||5 1 ||
nāmnā dharmabhaṭo rāṣṭrayogakṣemakaraḥ sadā |
sa śuśrāva manuṣyebhyo māhātmyaṃ bahulaṃ yataḥ |||52||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇe tena vāñcchā tasya vyajāyata |
sapatnīko yayau tvekahastinā vāhanena saḥ ||5 3 ||
parimeyānugo nītvā dhanaṃ tu svarṇarūpyakam |
snātvā tīrthajale gatvā kathāmaṇḍapamuttamam ||54||
pūjāṃ cakre saṃhitāyā vyāsasya lomaśasya ca |
satāṃ satīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ pūjāṃ cakre sa yoginām ||55 ||
upadāśca nyadhāttatra svaprakāśasya sannidhau |
svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ ratnamaṇīn mauktikānuttamānapi ||56|||
patnī pupūja vai tatra saṃhitāṃ vācakaṃ gurum |
sādhvīśca pūjayāmāsa dadau tābhyo’mbarāṇi ca ||57||
dhanāni phalapuṣpāṇi bhojanāni dadāvapi |
nīrājanaṃ pracakrāte hyubhau svarṇasya dakṣiṇām |||58 ||
nyadhātāṃ sthālikāyāṃ ca cakraturdaṇḍavanmudā |
niṣedatuḥ sabhāyāṃ tau mānitau ca maharṣibhiḥ ||59||
śuśruvatuḥ kathāṃ divyā manoniḥsaṃgakāriṇīm |
vairāgyotpādikāṃ sādhusevāmāhātmyabodhinīm || 4.63.6 0||
bhaktiśikṣāpradāṃ kṛṣṇe snehadāṃ dāsyadāyinīm |
kathānte tu mahodyāne saudhe tau yayaturmudā || 61 ||
evaṃ praśāntahṛdayābūṣaturdinapañcakam |
tāvat satāṃ satīnāṃ ca cakrāte sevanaṃ mudhā ||62||
pāvanau tau sevayā ca pāvitau punareva ha |
prapāvitau ca kathayā bhaktyā nītau ca divyatām ||63||
apaśyatāṃ niśāyāṃ tau nidrāyāṃ mādhavīśvaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacandrakam ||64||
kṣaṇenādṛśyatāṃ prāptaṃ divyaṃ śriyā yutaṃ harim |
atha tau sujñātakṛṣṇamahimānau prage drutam ||65||
utthāya darśanaṃ svāpnaṃ parasparaṃ mudāhatuḥ |
prasannau tau mithaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇadarśanamuttamam ||66|||
mene dharmabhaṭo bhāgyaṃ dhanyaṃ naijaṃ tadā khalu |
patnī nāmnā śīlayānī mene bhāgyaṃ paraṃ nijam ||67||
snātvā sampūjya deveśaṃ yayatustau kathāsthalam |
tatra kathāntike’mātyasannidhau śīlayānikā ||68||
gatvā prapūjya taṃ vyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīkṛṣṇasannibham |
nārāyaṇasamaṃ vyāsaṃ svaprakāśaṃ samuttamam ||69||
devavaccojjvalaṃ yogyamupāveṣṭuṃ gajāsane |
saṃkalpaṃ vidadhe tatra tāvad rājāpi tadvidham ||4.63.70||
saṃkalpaṃ vidadhe vyāsaṃ gajasthaṃ lokituṃ mudā |
prakāśaṃ prāhatustau ca svaprakāśaṃ samutsukau | |7 1 ||
vyāsastathāstviti prāha kathānte tau mudā tadā |
gajaṃ śṛṃgāritaṃ svarṇāmbālikāsahitaṃ śubham ||72|||
ānayāmāsaturdivyaṃ piśaṃgaṃ lambadantinam |
tatastau śrīvyāsadevaṃ niṣādya vāraṇopari ||73 ||
ṛṣiṃ ca lomaśaṃ cāpi niṣādya tatra vāraṇe |
dharmabhaṭo dadhe svarṇacāmaraṃ lomaśopari | |74||
śīlayānī dadhe svarṇacāmaraṃ vācakopari |
vādyanādairjayanādaiḥ sādhvīsādhusukīrtanaiḥ | 72||
vanditau pūjitau mārge bhaktābhivardhitau sumaiḥ |
sindhutaṭaṃ yayatustau gajenāmātyavāñcchayā ||76||
jalapānādikaṃ kṛtvā snātvāmātyālayaṃ tataḥ |
yayatustatra tau patnīpatī pupūjaturgurū ||77||
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhātāṃ ca svarṇapātre dhanāni ca |
kambalāni vicitrāṇi kauśeyānyambarāṇi ca ||78||
maṇiratnādihārām̐śca hīrakāḍhyavibhūṣaṇam |
bahudhā suvibhūṣāśca phalapuṣpādi sampadaḥ ||79||
dadatustau tataḥ pādārcanaṃ śrīcandanādibhiḥ |
cakraturbhāvataścārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ ca daṇḍavat ||4.63.80||
praṇāmān cakratuścātha tato mantraṃ tu vācakāt |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||81 ||
jjagṛhatustathā nāma śrīkṛṣṇacandraketi ca |
prabhonārāyaṇa śrīmādhavīnārāyaṇaprabho ||82||
jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇa rādhāpate vibho |
nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhatustato pādajalaṃ śubham ||83||
prasādaṃ jagṛhatuśca niṣādya vāraṇopari |
mahotsavayutau vyāsagurū cāmararājitau ||84||
prāpayāmāsatuḥ sthānaṃ saṃhitāmaṇḍapaṃ punaḥ |
evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya svarūpaṃ vyāsamanvaham ||89||
bhāvabhaktyā siṣevāte tau dvau tallagnamānasau |
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi camatkāraṃ harestataḥ ||86||
vidyamāne vāraṇe’pi tvādāya divyavāraṇam |
tameva vāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaścāruhya śrīsamanvitaḥ ||87||
tayaiva divyakānakyāmbālikayā virājitam |
tau dvau dharmabhaṭaṃ śīlayānīṃ netuṃ hariḥ svayam ||88||
samāyayau vyomasṛtyā ghaṇṭānādena nādayan |
ambaraṃ tejasā sarvaṃ dhavalayan kṛpānidhiḥ ||89||
caitrakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ vai paśyatāṃ divyacakṣuṣām |
kathottaraṃ tu madhyānte tvāyayau bhagavān prabhuḥ ||4.63.90||
uvāca prahasan dharmabhaṭa ehi paraṃ padam |
śīlayāni samāyāhi muktipadaṃ paraṃ padam ||9 1 ||
śrutvā śrībhagavadvākyaṃ tyaktasaṃsārabandhanau |
ubhau sajjāvabhavatāṃ tūrṇaṃ dhṛtvā kare jalam |||92|||
hastidānādi sarvaṃ śrīvyāsadevāya ca tadā |
dharmabhaṭaḥ śīlayānī dadatuśca dhanādikam ||93||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā tu badrike |
divyadehau muktarūpāvajāyatāṃ manoharau ||94||
vāraṇaṃ cāruruhatuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭistadābhavat |
