paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ gajena vyomagāminā ||95||
harirnināya tau tūrṇaṃ nijaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ śubham |
jayakārastadā sarvalokeṣu prābhavanmuhuḥ ||96||
camatkāraṃ samākarṇya janā vismayamāpnuvan |
bhakto’mātyo yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ dhanyajanurbhuvi ||97||
dhanyā sā śīlayānī ca patyā sārdhaṃ yayau divam |
ityevaṃ praśaśaṃsurvai mānavāḥ sarvataḥ sthitāḥ ||98||
badrike saṃhitāyāstu śravaṇena pramokṣaṇam |
nūnaṃ prajāyate sarvapāpānāṃ cātmanāṃ tathā ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanādapi mokṣaṇam |
iṣṭasiddhiḥ samastā ca bhuktirmuktistathā bhavet || 4.63.1 00||
yatra kṣaṇe yadā kṛṣṇo yaddeśe cābhiyāti vai |
gantavyaṃ tena sākaṃ vai māyāṃ tyaktvātibandhinīm || 10 1||
kartavyaṃ tu tadevāsti yanmāyāmokṣaṇaṃ vrataiḥ |
bhaktyā dhāmākṣaraprāptistatra śrīharisevanam || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne duritaghoṣanāmakasya pradhānasya sakuṭumbasya kathāśravaṇena tyāgidīkṣāgrahaṇaṃ, dharmabhaṭanāmakāmātyasya śīlayānīpatnīsahitasya kathāśravaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||

<4.64>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ duritanāśinīm |
nyāyādhīśasya te vacmi paramokṣapradāyinīm || 1 ||
prasevanākhyanagare nyāyādhīśo’bhavad dvijaḥ |
nāmnā mukundasāvitro dharmādhyakṣo’tibuddhimān || 2 ||
samastanyāyaniṣṇāto vādavivādaśāntikṛt |
nirṇayaṃ pradadātyeva nyāyālayakṛtāsanaḥ || 3 ||
prajānāṃ hitakṛccāpi sa vādiprativādinoḥ |
luñcāṃ prāpyobhayayoścobhayalābhaṃ tu nirṇaye || 4 ||
pradarśya vādaśāntiṃ sa karotyeva visaṃśayām |
kintvevaṃ bahudhā luñcādhanaṃ saṃprāptavān param || 5 ||
pāpena pakṣaghātena rogeṇābhibhavaṃ gataḥ |
khadvāyāṃ sa sadā śete vāmāṃgaśūnyabhāgavān || 6 ||
parādhīno hyati jātaḥ patnībhṛtyakṛtakriyaḥ |
duḥkhamāpnoti hṛdaye śuśrāva bhṛtyavargataḥ || 7 ||
duḥkhanāśakaraṃ vākyaṃ kathāmāhātmyamuttamam |
ye prayānti kathāyāṃ vai rugṇāḥ pāpā adharmiṇaḥ || 8 ||
śuddhāḥ śrutvā kathāṃ yānti brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ |
rogahīnāḥ prajāyante puṇyabhājo bhavantyapi || 9 ||
śrutvaivaṃ sa satīṃ patnīṃ prāha me mokṣaṇaṃ ca vā |
roganāśo yathā syādvai tathā vidhehi matkṛte || 4.64.1 0||
sāpi śrutvā svāmivākyaṃ svāmiśreyaḥparā satī |
prajājanānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ sammatiṃ jagṛhe satī || 11 ||
kathaṃ patyuḥ roganāśaḥ pāpanāśaśca mokṣaṇam |
tat kartavyaṃ mayā tūrṇaṃ papraccheti mahājanān || 1 2|
mahājanā guṇagrāhā śreyase nyāyadāyinaḥ |
prāhuradya varaṃ śreyaḥ saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ matam || 1 3||
camatkārā nityanavāḥ śrūyante tu kathāsthale |
kalyāṇaṃ dehināṃ tatra karoti kṛpayā hariḥ || 14||
tamenaṃ nyāyakartāraṃ naya tatra kathāsthalīm |
kathāṃ śrutvā sato dṛṣṭvā natvā sabhāṃ samantataḥ || 15||
prapūjya paramātmānaṃ taveṣṭaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati |
patyuste sarvathā ceṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 16 ||
ityuktā sā satī bhāryā nāmnā gayākṣiṇī yayau |
dravyaṃ bhṛtyān patiṃ nītvā narayāṇeḥ kathāsthalīm || 1 7||
mahodyānaṃ sthalīvāsaṃ kṛtvā snātvā suśobhanā |
patiṃ nītvā narayāne kathāmaṇḍapamāyayau || 18||
pakṣaghātābhibhūto’pi patirneme sabhājanān |
saṃhitāṃ vācakaṃ kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ neme ca lomaśam || 1 9||
ṛṣīn sādhūn praṇeme ca supto’pi narayānake |
tṛṇaṃ labdhvā mukhe pāpakṣamāṃ sadbhyo’pyayācata ||4.64.20 ||
santo dayālavastasmai daduḥ pādajalāni ca |
prasādaṃ pradadustatra so’pi cakhāda satvaram ||21||
bhadrike tāvatā tasya dehe śaktirvyavardhata |
pakṣaṃ vāmaṃ suśaktaṃ saṃjātaṃ jāḍyavihīnakam ||22||
śūnyabhāvaṃ vihāyaiva caitanyasaṃbhṛtaṃ hyabhūt |
utthāya sahasā khaṣṭvāmadhyataḥ sa sabhāṃ prati || 23||
cakāra daṇḍavadbhūmau vidan māhātmyamuttamam |
nīrugṇatvaṃ darśanāttu tatkālaṃ samajāyata |||24||
tataḥ pūjāṃ cakārāpi dhanaratnādibhistadā |
vyāsapūjāṃ kathāmūrtipūjāṃ lomaśapūjanam |||25||
saṃhitāpūjanaṃ sādhusādhvīprapajūnaṃ tathā |
dvijarṣipūjanaṃ cakre bhūridānādidakṣiṇam ||26|||
kathāṃ śuśrāva ca tataścaivaṃ nityaṃ cakāra ha |
mahimānaṃ vivedāpi kathāyā navajīvane ||27||
mṛtyormukhānmahārogānmuktiḥ kathāprabhāvataḥ |
satāmāśīrvacanaiśca viveda strīyuto hi saḥ || 28||
nyāyākṣiṇī tathā nyāyādhīśaḥ sādhuniṣevaṇam |
nityaṃ pracakratustatra nijāvāse muhurmuhuḥ ||29||
akurvātāṃ vicāraṃ ca maraṇād rakṣaṇaṃ tviha |
jātaṃ tasmājjīvanaṃ vai dātavyaṃ kṛṣṇalabdhaye ||4.64.3 0||
na gantavyaṃ gṛhe cetaḥ sthātavyaṃ sādhumaṇḍale |
śrotavyā śrīsaṃhitāyāḥ kathā sarvārthadāyinī ||31 ||
sevanīyāḥ sādhavaśca toṣaṇīyā maharṣayaḥ |
tāraṇīyo nijātmā ca prāptavyaṃ paramaṃ padam |||32||
api nyāyo hi jagatāṃ kṛto’pi koṭilakṣadhā |
ātmanyāyaḥ kṛtaścenna kṛtaṃ kimapi tena na ||33||
toṣitā vādavivadāḥ kaliprāyā janā api |
api kṛṣṇastoṣito na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||34||
rañjitāḥ kalikartāraḥ śamitā māyikā janāḥ |
santaśced rañjitā naiva kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||35||
arjitaṃ nāṇakaṃ koṭiḥ vardhitāḥ sampado jaḍāḥ |
arjitaṃ nātmakalyāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 36||
sevitāḥ strīmahīmānāḥ satkṛtāśca kuṭumbinaḥ |
sevitāścet sādhavo na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 37||
vanditā dravyadātāro bhojitā lampaṭā janāḥ |
nātithayaḥ pūjitāścet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 38||
smṛtā nityaṃ kalahiṇaḥ vitaṇḍā uditāḥ sadā |
nārāyaṇo neritaścet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||39||
poṣito nijadehaśca saṃskṛtā mūrdhajāḥ sadā |
saṃskṛtaṃ na hṛdayaṃ cet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||4.64.40||
ādhattaṃ bāhyavijñānaṃ vistāritāśca kalpanāḥ |
kṛṣṇadhyānaṃ na cādhattaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||41 ||
nirṇayā laukikā dattāḥ sattāḥ bhuktā tu māyikī |
ātmamokṣo niścito na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||42||
śraddhā mṛṣā vivādeṣu kṛtā naije ca gaurave |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe cenna kṛtā sarvā nirarthikā ||43||
sammānaṃ bahudhā labdhaṃ svāgataṃ cāti vīkṣitam |
mānitaścenna kṛṣṇena mānaṃ cānyannirarthakam ||44||
tāḍitā daṇḍitā duṣṭāḥ kārāgāre nipātitāḥ |
kāmādayo daṇḍitā na daṇḍaścānyo nirarthakaḥ ||45||
mocitāḥ pīḍitā lokā vipado vinivāritāḥ |
svasya yāmyaṃ vāritaṃ na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||46||
gatayo bahudhā klṛptā mārgāścānye’vadhāritāḥ |
brahmamārgo dhṛtaścenna kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||47||
dattaṃ bahubhyo lokebhyo na dattaṃ paramātmane |
bhaktebhyo na na yajñebhyo dattamanyannirarthakam ||48||
arjitā bahudhā ṛddhiḥ kīrtiḥ khyātiḥ pratiṣṭhikā |
na tvarjitā kṛpā kārṣṇī tadarjitaṃ nirarthakam ||49||
kośe surakṣitaṃ svarṇaṃ rajataṃ peṭikāsu ca |
hṛdi kṛṣṇo na nihito rakṣitaṃ tannirarthakam ||4.64.50|||
ārohitāni yānāni vāhanānyādṛtāni ca |
śrīkṛṣṇasya vimānaṃ nādṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||51 ||
rājyaṃ prapālikaṃ samyak prajāḥ samyaṅnibhālitāḥ |
dṛṣṭo nārāyaṇaścenna dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 52||
śrutaṃ saṃśayitaṃ sarvaṃ mataṃ mṛṣābhivardhitam |
na śrutā na matā kṛṣṇakathā sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||53||
dīnānāthā āśvasitā bhṛtyādyāḥ svāśrayīkṛtāḥ |
bhaktā nāśvāsitā divyā āśrayādi nirarthakam ||94||
vyākhyātānyanyatattvāni bhautikāni kṣaṇe kṣaṇe |
kṛṣṇatattvaṃ na cākhyātaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||55||
likhitā rājapadakā yojitā pāśavī kalā |
nātmā saṃyojitaḥ kṛṣṇe yojanā sā nirarthikā ||56||
apyabdhayaḥ kṣālitāścāloḍitā nyāyakoṭayaḥ |
vāsanā jvālitā naiva śramaḥ sarvo nirarthakaḥ ||57||
śatravaḥ sajjitāścāpi baliṣṭhāśca virodhinaḥ |
kāmanā na jitā yena jayastasya nirarthakāḥ ||58||
sarve tvadhītamevāpi vācitaṃ puṣkalaṃ sadā |
nādhītaṃ śrīharernāma raṭanā sā nirarthikā ||59||
preṣitāni tu patrāṇi lagnāni yojitānyapi |
kṛṣṇalagnaṃ na cāpannaṃ sarvamanyannirarthakam ||4.64.60||
striyo vivāhitā bahvyaḥ pravāhitāśca dakṣiṇāḥ |
saṃvāhitā gajā haṃsā nāhitāḥ kṛṣṇavaiṣṇavāḥ ||61||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naiva dhṛto vakṣasi keśavaḥ |
tadā nirarthakaṃ sarvaṃ bhārarūpaṃ hi vāhitam ||62||
api veṣā dhṛtā ramyā dhṛtā bhūṣā suśobhitāḥ |
kṛṣṇakaṇṭhī dhṛtā naiva dhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||63||
pītaṃ bhuktaṃ bahu miṣṭamāsvāditā rasā parāḥ |
prasādo na harerbhukto bhuktaṃ sarvaṃ tu pāpakṛt ||64||
sugandhādi samastaṃ saṃyojitaṃ varṣmahetave |
kṛṣṇārthaṃ yojitaṃ naiva tat sarvaṃ pāpadaṃ kṛtam ||65 ||
utsavā vihitāścānye daivotsavāḥ kṛtā nahi |
satāṃ mahotsavāstyaktāstasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||66||
svajanmāhāni satataṃ pālitānyaparāṇyapi |
kṛṣṇajanmadinaṃ cenna pālitaṃ tena kiṃ kṛtam ||67||
āyuḥ saṃkṣapitaṃ sarvaṃ dehaḥ karmasu dharṣitaḥ |
rāgo na dharṣito dveṣo na dharṣito vṛthāśramaḥ ||68|||
vibhājitā nijā sampat putrādyāśca vibhājitāḥ |
bhajito na harikṛṣṇo bhaktaṃ sarvaṃ viḍambanam ||69||
āvṛtaṃ nagaraṃ sarvamāvṛtānīndriyāṇyapi |
nāvṛtaṃ hṛt śrīkṛṣṇena sarvamāvṛtamāvṛtam ||4.64.70||
anugrahītā bahavo mocitā vipadāṃ mukhāt |
nijātmā mocito naiva mocanaṃ tannirarthakam ||71||
mātā pitā suhṛd bandhuḥ pūjitāḥ sevitāstathā |
sādhavaḥ sevitāścenna mokṣamārgo’sya durghaṭaḥ ||72||
pitarastarpitā dīnā bhojitā vanditāḥ surāḥ |
nopāsitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gurvī tu sā kṣatiḥ ||73||
āsāditāni dhiṣṇyāni mānapatrāṇi śobhanāḥ |
padavyaścāpi saṃlabdhā nāptaṃ kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ||74||
nāpyāptamāsanaṃ kṛṣṇapādāsanasamīpagam |
tadā nāptaṃ tvantatastu kiñcit śūnyamivābhavat ||75||
sarvaṃ śūnye gataṃ tasya kṛṣṇahīnasya dehinaḥ |
ataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prāpaṇīyaḥ sarvamanyannirarthakam ||76||
atraiva sarvadā kṛṣṇakathālābhārthamuttamā |
vasatiḥ rocate tasmādvasitavyamihādhunā ||77||
vicāryetthaṃ mithaḥ patnīpatī tatra nivāsanam |
cakraturbadrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitātmakau ||78||
jagṛhatuśca tau mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ tadā mudā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||79||
prabhonārāyaṇaśrīmādhavīnārāyaṇaprabho |
jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||4.64.80||
svaprakāśo hi bhagavān mantraṃ datvā ca taulasīm |
dadau kaṇṭhīṃ bhajanārthaṃ mālikāṃ pratimāṃ dadau ||8 1 ||
tatastau kṛṣṇacittau vai pratīkṣete pramokṣaṇam |
māsānte śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamāsthitaḥ ||82||
netuṃ samāyayau tau tu caitrasyāmādine hariḥ |
ujjvalaḥ śvetavasanaḥ svarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ ||83||
uvāca tau samāyātaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ mama |
uktamātrau dampatī tau svarṇarūpyādidānakam ||84||
cakraturyānadānaṃ tāvadhyāroḍhuṃ vimānakam |
kṛtakramau ca yāvattu tāvad vimūrchitau drutam ||85||
tyaktadehau labdhadivyasvarūpau saṃbabhūvatuḥ |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ badri vimānamadhyatiṣṭhatām ||86||
puṣpavṛṣṭirvyomamārgājjayaśabdā janavrajāt |
abhavan bahulāstatra tāvad vimānamambare ||87||
ūrdhvaṃ jagāma sahasā divyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ prati |
tiro’bhavad viprakṛṣṭaṃ mahāścaryamabhūddhi tat ||88 ||
evaṃ śrībadrike bhaktau tyaktasarvapravartanau |
snehabhaktyā yayatuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam ||89||
tayorbhṛtyajanāstatra tayoścakruḥ pradāhanam |
tataste’pi harerbhaktiṃ nāma mantraṃ ca jagṛhuḥ ||4.64.90||
bhejuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
kṣapitāghā gatakleśā nirmalāḥ sādhusevinaḥ ||9 1 ||
abhavam̐ste kṛpāpātrāṇyanvahaṃ śrīkathāparāḥ |
prāptavairāgyavegāśca dhyānabhajanayoginaḥ ||92||
vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā bhūtvā labdhvāśīrvādamuttamam |
yayurgṛhāṇi naijāni smarantaḥ parameśvaram ||93||
pakvakālena te sarve satsaṃginaḥ śubhāśayāḥ |
kṣīṇavāsanāḥ saṃlagnā śrīharau mokṣasanmukhāḥ ||94||
pratīkṣante sma deveśaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam |
tāvat teṣāṃ śreyase vai vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ divaḥ ||95||
yayuste’pi harerdhāma kṛṣṇavimānavāhitāḥ |
prasevane pure sarve vyapaśyan svavimānakam ||96||
divyaṃ divyaśrīharyāḍhyaṃ divyamuktādhivāsitam |
darśakā nijabhāgyāni menire mokṣabhāñji ha ||97||
bhajanaṃ te vyadhuḥ svāmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho |
kālena kṣīṇapāpāśca prayātāste paraṃ padam ||98||
evaṃ badrīpriye mokṣaṃ gatau nyāyādhikāriṇau |
nyāyākṣiṇī ca mukundasāvitraḥ satkathāśravāt ||99||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt sevanāt satām |
bhuktirmuktirbhaved badri svargaṃ sveṣṭaṃ bhavedapi || 4.64.1 00||
sarvadivyaguṇāścāpi divyā sampadvarā api |
divyadhāmanivāsaśca divyaśrīkṛṣṇayogitā || 101 ||
divyatā sarvathā syācchrīsaṃhitāśravaṇādiha |
prāptavyaṃ sarvamāpyeta na nyūnaṃ tasya vidyate || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne nyāyakarturmukundasāvitraviprasya nyāyākṣiṇyāstatpatnyāśca kathāśravaṇādibhirmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭittamo’dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||

<4.65>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāmanyāṃ ca pāvanīm |
lekhakaścābhavat tāḍapatreṣu paṭṭakeṣvapi || 1 ||
dhātupatreṣu ca kāṣṭhaphāleṣu cāmbareṣvapi |
nāmnā viśālarekho vai vaiśyaḥ sukarade pure || 2 ||
lekhotpannena satataṃ jīvikāṃ samavartayan |
kuṭumbapoṣaṇaṃ tuṣṭyā karoti dharmavṛttimān || 3 ||
tasyaikadā samāyātaḥ śvā gṛhe ca gṛhāntare |
sampraviṣṭaḥ pātragataṃ payo’pibattu dhenujam || 4 ||
aśuddhaṃ tatpayaḥ sarvaṃ jātaṃ ghaṭagataṃ tataḥ |
vaiśyo’paśyat pibantaṃ taṃ śvānaṃ gṛhāntare gataḥ || 5 ||
ruṣā yaṣṭiṃ samagṛhyātāḍayat śvā tu mūrchitaḥ |
ākrośan patito bhūmau pādān vikṣepayan muhuḥ || 6 ||
mṛtyuṃ jagāma yāvattu tāvad vaiśyena karṣitaḥ |
catvare kṣipta evāpi tāvatpārśvālayā janāḥ || 7 ||
śrutvākrośaṃ satvaraṃ te kutūhalasamanvitāḥ |
āyayuścatvare tatra vyapaśyan māritaṃ tadā || 8 ||
śvānaṃ vaiśyena vai kṣiptaṃ mṛtaṃ vaiśyena māritam |
tiraścakrustu te vaiśyaṃ dhikkāraṃ pradadustathā || 9 ||
śvaghno’yaṃ krūrakarmā cāgrāhyajalānna eva ca |
śrutvaivaṃ tu tadā pāpaśabdān lajjāṃ gato’bhavat || 4.65.1 0||
dharmavān kīrtimām̐ścāpi vegena pāpamācaran |
avācyatāṃ gato vaiśyaḥ śuśocātijanāntike || 11 ||
uvāca tān pārśvalokān na mayā mṛtyuhetave |
tāḍitaḥ śvā kintu śikṣaṇārthaṃ pratāḍito’styayam || 1 2||
gṛhaṃ praviśya sa yato dugdhaṃ papau hi dhenujam |
sarvaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ cakārāsau tena vai tāḍito mayā || 1 3||
pārśvamarmasthale māraḥ kṛto nahi vijānatā |
akasmāt patito māraḥ pārśve marmaṇi tena saḥ || 14||
mṛto’yaṃ tasya hatyā me jātā karomi niṣkṛtim |
viprāḥ śiṣṭā bhavanto me bruvantu tasya niṣkṛtim || 15||
ityarthitā bhūsurāstaṃ jagadurvratamuttamam |
māsaṃ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caikabhuktavrataṃ tathā || 1 6||
satsaṃgaḥ sādhusevā ca dānaṃ yathādhanaṃ tathā |
tīrthasnānaṃ māsamātraṃ nitya mantrasahasrakam || 17||
harernāmnāṃ japaśceti prāyaścittaṃ dadurdvijāḥ |
viśālarekhaḥ pāpasya nuttaye vicacāra ha || 18||
śarkarānagaraṃ tīrthaṃ kathāsthānamanuttamam |
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ cetyubhayaṃ tīrthaṃ hi tatsthale || 19||
prāptaṃ tena tu vidhinā tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ hi sindhujam |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityamekabhuktavratānvitam ||4.65.20||
māsamātraṃ kṛtaṃ tena labdhvā yathoditaṃ manum |
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ tena hitaiṣiṇā ||21||
naṣṭapāpo’bhavannaṣṭavāsano vaiśya eva ha |
pūrvajanmārjitāghāni naṣṭāni sevanāt satām ||22||
prārabdhaṃ sañcitaṃ karma sarvamanta samāvrajat |
āyuḥ pūrṇaṃ tu sañjātaṃ mṛtyukāla upāgataḥ ||23||
māsānte caitraśuklasya pañcamyāṃ prātareva saḥ |
snātvā kathāsthalaṃ prāpa pupūja vyāsapuṃgavam |||24|||
saṃhitāṃ lomaśaṃ cāpi natvā maharṣimaṇḍalam |
kathāṃ śuśrāva mālāyā āvartanapuraḥsaram ||25||
kathānte kīrtanānte’sya jṛṃbhaṇānyabhavan muhuḥ |
tāvad vyomno hariḥ kṛṣṇonārāyaṇaḥ samāyayau ||26|||
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ prāha tamāyāhi vimānakam |
śrūtvā viśālarekhaḥ sa mumude mokṣabhāgyavān || 27||
drutaṃ mūrchāmavāpāpi divyadeho babhūva ha |
vimāne taṃ samādāya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hariḥ ||28||
kṛpaiṣā badrike śrīmatkṛṣṇasya mokṣadāyinī |
prāyaścittanimittena mokṣaṃ yayā jagāma saḥ |||29||
tasya patnī śucikāntānāmnī tasyaurdhvadaihikam |
cakāra vidhivad bhaktā vaiṣṇavī bhāgyaśālinī || 4.65.30||
vairāgyaṃ sā samāpannā hyanapatyā satī śubhā |
bhaktiṃ cakre manuṃ nāma labdhvā śrīlomaśāt sadā || 31 ||
nityaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇotyeva sādhvīvrajaṃ prasevate |
sā tu vairāgyavegena jñānena sevayā tathā ||32||
tyāgadīkṣāṃ jagṛhe vai sarvamantrasamanvitām |
kāṣāyadhāriṇī bhūtvā sādhvīnāṃ maṇḍale’vasat || 33||
bheje’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pārvīprabhumpatim |
badrike sā svatantrābhūt sādhvī svargādigāminī ||34||
brahmasabhāmapi yāti sā samādhimatī tathā |
śucikāntābhavannāmnā kṛṣṇakānteśvarī tataḥ ||35||
caturyugaṃ tu sā sādhvī pṛthvyāṃ tataḥ sthitābhavat |
bhajanaṃ kārayitvāpi nārījanānasaṃkhyakān || 36||
preṣayāmāsa muktyarthaṃ kārṣṇaṃ padaṃ hi pāvanam |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre vāsaṃ vyadhāccaturyugam ||37||
tato dhāmākṣaraṃ prāpa sādhvyayutaṃ vidhāya sā |
śiṣyāṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tasyāḥ sādhvīnāṃ cāyutātmakam || 38||
vyacarad bhūmikhaṇḍeṣu nārīṇāṃ bodhadāyakam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇīsatyaḥ sarvā bhejurnarāyaṇam || 39|||
śākhāḥ praśākhāḥ śiṣyāḥ praśiṣyāḥ sthāpya dharātale |
yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ tāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam ||4.65.40||
ityevaṃ badrike vaiśyo mokṣaṃ jagāma bhaktarāṭ |
kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā bhaktyā sevayā śravaṇena ca ||41 ||
athānyaṃ te kathayāmi camatkāraṃ mahattamam |
kāyasthā bahavaḥ śrutvā camatkāraṃ pramokṣadam |||42||
āyayuḥ parito rāṣṭrāt saṃhitāyāḥ kathāsthalam |
upadā vividhā nītvā pūjāsāmagrikānvitāḥ ||43 ||
kīrtayanto harernāma gāyanto gītikā hareḥ |
narā nāryo bālavṛddhā yuvamaṇḍalakānyapi ||44||
āyayuḥ śarkarābhyāśaṃ mahodyānaṃ samutsukāḥ |
mahodyāne kṛtāvāsā kṛtasnānāśca tīrthake ||45||
upadākarapātrāścāyayuḥ kathāsabhāsthalam |
jayanādān pracakruśca daṇḍavannamanāñjalim ||46||
pūjāṃ cakruḥ saṃhitāyāḥ mūrteśca vācakasya ca |
satāṃ maharṣivaryāṇāṃ satīnāmarhaṇāni ca ||47||
viprāṇāṃ yogināṃ pūjāṃ cakruścārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ |
upāviviśuḥ sadasi śuśruvuśca kathāmṛtam ||48||
mantraṃ svataḥprakāśācca jagṛhurnāmadhunyakam |
yayuścāvasathānnaijān māsaṃ tasthuḥ kathārthinaḥ ||49||
satāṃ sevāṃ ca bahudhā cakrire kīrtanānyapi |
tīrthāplavanaṃ dānāni cakrire bhajanaṃ mithaḥ ||4.65.50||
hṛtapāpā abhavam̐ste gatamāyikavāsanāḥ |
śuddhātmāno’bhavam̐ścāpi narā nāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ |||5 1 ||
caitraśuklaikādaśyāṃ ca badrike tvāyayau hariḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svarṇavimānayuk ||52||
hasan prāha hariḥ sarvān kāyasthān kṛpayā mudā |
śṛṇvatāṃ matkathāṃ sevāṃ kurvatāṃ ca satāṃ mudā ||5 3||
bhajatāṃ māṃ ca vaḥ kalyāṇārthaṃ cāhamupāgataḥ |
āyāntu te ya icchanti tvāgantuṃ dhāma me’kṣaram ||54||
sajjā bhavantu tūrṇaṃ cārohantu me vimānakam |
nayāmi cākṣaraṃ dhāma śāśvatānandamandiram | |55||
evamuktāḥ karaṇādyāḥ kāyasthā narayoṣitaḥ |
pañcaśatāni sahasā sajjāstu muktaye’bhavan ||56||
teṣāṃ halahalāśabdaḥ sahasrotkṣepaṇāhvanāḥ |
paritaścābhavan badri mahāścaryavidhāyinaḥ ||57||
pañcaśatāni kāyasthā narā nāryastadā drutam |
tyaktvā bhautikavarṣmāṇi cābālavṛddhadehinaḥ ||58||
abhavan divyadehāste kṛṣṇaprokṣitavāribhiḥ |
sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣāste muktā muktānikāḥ śubhāḥ ||59||
āruruhurvimānaṃ copāviviśurhareḥ puraḥ |
pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyāśleṣasparśāñjalistavaiḥ ||4.65.6 0||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanītā yayuste paramaṃ padam |
badrike śṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ dhunyaṃ ca paśyatāmapi ||61 ||
sarveṣāmanyalokānāṃ vimānaṃ divamāviśat |
camatkāro mahān jātaḥ kṛpayāyaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ ||62||
paścasthaiśca kṛtānyūrdhvadaihikāni tataḥ param |
te’pi virāgamāpannāḥ kathāṃ śrutvā yayustataḥ ||63||
nijānnijānālayām̐śca kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ pracakrire |
kālena te yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||64||
badrike paramāścaryaṃ kathayāmi nibodha me |
trivādanagare tvāsīt śāstā śāhavilāpanaḥ ||65||
tasya sampattayaścāsan vāṭīkṣetragṛhādikāḥ |
aśvā vṛṣabhā gavayā uṣṭrāśca paśavo’bhavan ||66||
go’jāmahiṣya āsam̐śca bhṛtyāścāpi śatādhikā |
grāmādhipaḥ khaṇḍarājaḥ śāhavilāpanastadā ||67||
aśvapālām̐śca gopālān vetanaiḥ saṃrarakṣa vai |
kṣatriyaḥ sa hi śuśrāva kathotsavaṃ mahattamam ||68||
manaścakre tatra gantuṃ sāśvagopālakaiḥ saha |
sajjo’bhavat sa tūrṇaṃ vai śrīsvāminyā striyā saha ||69||
śrīsvāminī satī patnī gavāṃ śataṃ nināya ha |
dānadharmārthamevāpi dugdhapānārthamityapi ||4.65.70||
pratasthire te gṛhataḥ śarkarānagaraṃ yayuḥ |
gopālāścāśvapālāśca tathā śāhavilāpanaḥ ||71 ||
śrīsvāminī tathā tasyāḥ sakhyo dāsyaḥ śataṃ tadā |
sabhūṣāḥ sopakaraṇāḥ sopadāḥ sasamṛddhayaḥ ||72||
mahodyāne pracakruste svāvasathān yathāyatham |
snātvā te darśanārthaṃ vai sopadāḥ prayayuḥ sabhām ||73||
kathāṃ śrutvā tataḥ pūjāmārārtrikaṃ pracakrire |
rājā rājñī dhanavantastathā bhṛtyādayo’pi ca ||74||
nyadhurvyāsapuraḥsthāne bhūṣāmudrāmbarāṇi ca |
phalapuṣpānnamiṣṭānnadugdhadaugdheyakāni ca ||75||
svaprakāśāyanako’pi lomaśaśca maharṣayaḥ |
āśīrvādān dadustebhyo yayuścāvasathām̐stataḥ ||76||
evaṃ nityaṃ niyamitāḥ śṛṇvanti saṃhitākathām |
rājaikadā niśi svapne dadarśa svaṃ śavaṃ prage ||77||
utthāya sabhayo bhūtvā kathāsthānaṃ samāgamat |
nyavedayallomaśāya svāpnavṛttāntamulbaṇam ||78||
lomaśaḥ prāha rājānaṃ samāptāyuṣyakaṃ tadā |
rājan karmasamāptiste jātā kathāniṣevaṇāt ||79||
mantraṃ gṛhāṇa nāmāpi gṛhṇa śrīparamātmanaḥ |
sajjo bhava ca mokṣārthaṃ tyaja rāgaṃ tu bhautikam ||4.65.80||
ityuktaḥ sa tu śīghraṃ vai mantraṃ jagrāha nāma ca |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||8 1 ||
rājñīdāsyastathā dāsā jagṛhurmantramuttamam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||82||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||83||
prabhonārāyaṇaśrīmādhavīnārāyaṇa prabho |
jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||84||
labdhvā mantraṃ bhajanaṃ te cakrurmitho nijālaye |
rājā rājñī dadatuśca dānāni gajavājinām ||85 ||
gavāṃ suvarṇaratnānāṃ bhūṣāvastrādisampadām |
sajjo bhūtvā pratīkṣāṃ tu rājā rājñīsamanvitaḥ ||86||
karoti śrīhareḥ samyag gantuṃ mokṣapadaṃ param |
dvādaśyāṃ caitraśuklasya vimānenāgato hariḥ ||87||
satāṃ prasevayā śuddhaṃ bhaktaṃ rājñīsametakam |
divyadehaṃ vidhāyaiva svāmīkṛṣṇonarāyaṇaḥ ||88||
tathānyān dāsadāsīśca bhaktisarvasvasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
divyadehān vidhāyaiva niṣādya svavimānake ||89 ||
paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam |
badrike tanmahāścaryaṃ vīkṣyānye bhṛtyadāsikāḥ ||4.65.9 0||
sarvadānāni datvaiva mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ |
jyeṣṭhāya tu kumārāya nāmnā bhāskarabhūtaye ||9 1||
rājyadhuraṃ vinirdiśya sajjāste muktaye’bhavan |
bhejurnārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ tyaktānnabhojanādayaḥ ||92||
dinatrayānte bhagavān svāmīkṛṣṇonarāyaṇaḥ |
kṛpayā tvāyayau tūrṇaṃ netuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||9 3||
vimānena samastām̐stān kṛtvā mūrchāsamanvitān |
tyājayitvā tu dehām̐śca divyadehān vidhāya ca ||94||
ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām |
kumāro bhāskarabhūtiścakre tadaurdhvadaihikam ||95||
bhakto bhūtvā kathāṃ śrutvā bhāgyaṃ matvā paraṃ mahat |
yayau trivādanagaraṃ śaśāsa nyāyataḥ sadā ||96||
bhaktyā kāle samāyāte pāvanaḥ sopi vai mudā |
vāsanāśūnyahṛdayo vaṃśe nyasya dhuraṃ nijām ||97||
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vāhitaḥ |
evaṃ badrīpriye lokairdṛṣṭā camatkṛtiḥ parā ||98||
mokṣadā pāpahantrī ca sākṣātkṛṣṇāṅghriyojikā |
trivādanagare ye ye śuśruvustāṃ camatkṛtim ||99||
te’pi pārokṣyabhāvāḍhyā bhejuḥ kṛṣṇaṃnarāyaṇam |
kṣīṇapāpā abhavam̐śca satāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ || 4.65.1 00||
satsaṃgena yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ tvante kṛpāśrayāḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktibhavedapi || 10 1||
aśvapālāśca gopālā ye ye cāsan trivādake |
te’pi kṛṣṇaṃ bhajitvaiva yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ param || 1 02||
nikṛṣṭayonayaścāpi paśavo’jāgavādayaḥ |
te’pi dugdhārpaṇayogairyayurdhāmākṣaraṃ prabhoḥ || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇādinā lekhakasya viśālarekhasya sapatnīkasya, karaṇādyānāṃ kāyasthānāṃ bahūnāṃ, śāhavilāpanakṣatriyasya sapatnīdāsīdāsasya ca, mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||

<4.66>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ gṛdhrasya mokṣadām |
pārāyaṇasthale nityaṃ satāmucchiṣṭabhojanam || 1 ||
gṛdhro jagdhvā tu madhyāhne muktimavāpa śāśvatīm |
nyagrodhaṣaṇḍe jaraṭhā gṛdhrā āsan śatādhikāḥ || 2 ||
ābālavṛddhāḥ sarve sma vaṭaṣaṇḍe vasanti vai |
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya gagane mārgayanti sma bhojanam || 3 ||
dūraṃ dūraṃ parākramya bhakṣayanti sma mārgitam |
teṣāṃ pārāyaṇakāle mahotsavaḥ sadābhavat || 4 ||
nityaṃ yatra bhojanāni kurvantyasaṃkhyamānavāḥ |
tatra pārāyaṇakṣetre bhojanānāṃ tu bhūmiṣu || 5 ||
ucchiṣṭāni patanti sma vividhānnāni badrike |
bharjitānnāni śākāni miṣṭānnāni patanti ca || 6 ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ paṃktayo vai yatra bhavantyaharniśam |
sādhvīnāṃ paṃktayaścāpi sādhūnāṃ paṃktayastathā || 7 ||
bhavanti bhuñjate tatra prasādānnāni sādhavaḥ |
taducchiṣṭāni pātrebhyaḥ patitāni tu yāni vai || 8 ||
pātrocchiṣṭāni cānnāni gṛdhrāste śataśaḥ sadā |
paṃktyante bhuṃjate sarve tṛptā bhavanti cānvaham || 9 ||
ucchiṣṭakṣepaṇasthāne mahotkare’pi pakṣiṇaḥ |
prakṣiptocchiṣṭaparyuṣitānnaśākāni bhuṃjate || 4.66.10 ||
śṛṇu badrīpriye caitraśukladvādaśikādine |
svataḥprakāśo bhagavān vyāso madhyāhnake śubhe ||1 1 ||
bhuktvocchiṣṭaṃ pracikṣepa pārśve kṣetre sapātrakam |
gṛdhrastveko hi jaraṭho vaṭāduḍḍīya cāgamat || 12||
abhakṣayat taducchiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādamiśritam |
tāvattasya samastāni naṣṭāni pātakāni vai || 1 3||
puṇyātmā tvabhavattūrṇaṃ karmāśayo’sya bhasmitaḥ |
bahūnāṃ paśyatāṃ pakṣī papāta bhūtale drutam || 14||
nirgatya pakṣidehāt sa divyadehaścaturbhujaḥ |
śrīhareḥ pārṣado bhūtvādṛśyata tatra cāmbare || 15||
vismitāḥ sādhavaḥ sarve tathānye vaiṣṇavā api |
vīkṣya taṃ pārṣadarūpaṃ papracchuḥ sādhavastu tam || 16||
ko bhavān pakṣirūpo’pi pārṣadaṃ rūpamāptavān |
vada sarvaṃ yathātathyaṃ nivartaya kutūhalam || 17||
ityevaṃ pārṣadaḥ śrutvovāca sādhūn samutsukaḥ |
abhuvaṃ pūrvadeho’haṃ kauliko mānavo bhuvi || 18||
nāmnā daṇḍāraṇiścāsaṃ hiṃsācauryaparāyaṇaḥ |
khādake nagare cāsaṃ mahākuṭumbavānaham || 19||
mama vṛddhasya vṛddho yastasya putrā daśābhavan |
daśānāṃ śataśaścāsan śatānāṃ tu sahasrakam ||4.66.20||
kanyakāśca tathā hyāsam̐stāsāṃ vaṃśāḥ sahasrakam |
khādakaṃ nagaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kaulikaveśitam ||2 1||
te sarve’pi vayaṃ nityaṃ gṛhasthāḥ sukuṭumbinaḥ |
akaravāma vṛttyarthaṃ kṛṣikarmāṇi nityadā ||22||
duṣkāle coṣṇakāle vā kurmaścauryaṃ prasahya vā |
luṇṭanaṃ cāpaharaṇaṃ dhanānnāmbarasampadām ||23||
viprāṇāṃ vāpi sādhūnāṃ kṣatrāṇāṃ cānyadehinām |
bhakṣayāmastadannādi dhārayāmo’mbarādikam ||24||
tena pāpena pāpiṣṭhā mṛtā vayaṃ tu ye ca ye |
vṛddhā bālā yuvāno vā narā nāryaśca te khalu ||25||
sarve vayaṃ vaṭe gṛdhrā ime jātāḥ sma vaṃśajāḥ |
yāmyaduḥkhānyanubhūya gṛdhrā jātā vaṭe tviha ||26||
teṣu sarveṣu vṛddho’haṃ cauro’bhavaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
corayitvā muhusteṣāṃ poṣaṇaṃ saṃvyadhāṃ tadā ||27||
tena yāmyamahākaṣṭaṃ muktvātra gṛdhratāṃ gataḥ |
vṛddhaḥ prācīnatamaśca bhavāmi bahuvatsaraḥ ||28||
vyāsasyocchiṣṭamāsādya hareḥ prasādamuttamam |
dagdhapāmābhavaṃ naṣṭavāsanaśca drutaṃ tviha ||29||
muktadaśāṃ gataścāsmi muktaḥ pakṣiśarīrataḥ |
prayāmi tvadya badarikāśramaṃ pāvanaṃ tataḥ ||4.66.30||
śvetadvīpaṃ prayāsyāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param |
evaṃ me mokṣaṇaṃ jātaṃ prasādasyaiva bhakṣaṇāt ||3 1||
prasādasya tu māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate |
mahāpāpāḥ prasādena mucyante cādhamā api ||32||
prasādasya tu māhātmyamati jānantyajādayaḥ |
matsyo bhūtvā svayaṃ brahmā cakhāda suprasādakam ||33||
surāḥ prasādamicchanti pitaraḥ sutarāṃ sadā |
pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ sattvavardhanaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ||34||
prāṇā yeṣāṃ na niryānti mṛtyuduḥkhajuṣāṃ yadi |
teṣāṃ prasādalābhena prāṇā niryānti vai drutam ||35||
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ chāyā tasya na lumpati |
na bādhante ḍākinīśākinīpiśācikāśca tam ||36||
prasādabhakṣabhaktānāṃ nirmalānyāntarāṇyapi |
dhārmikāni pravartante tamaḥpāpakṣayāṇi ca ||37||
aprasādabhojino’tra dehaṃ sadā piśācakaḥ |
prasādabhakṣabhaktasya tanuḥ sadā tu devatā ||38||
prasādabhojane dehe devā vasanti nityaśaḥ |
prasādabhojināṃ divyaṃ śarīraṃ pāvanaṃ sadā ||39||
aprasādaprabhoktāraḥ pāpabhoktāra eva te |
bhūtapretapiśācānnaṃ prasādavarjitaṃ hi yat ||4.66.40||
prasādabhojināṃ nityaṃ kṛpā kṛṣṇasya jāyate |
kṛpayā sampadaḥ sarvā dehānte mokṣasampadaḥ ||41 ||
prasādabhojanaṃ nityaṃ nirguṇaṃ doṣavarjitam |
api svādabharaṃ sarvaṃ niḥsvādaṃ tat sadā matam ||42||
kṛṣṇārpitā rasāḥ sarve bhuktā badhnanti te nahi |
rūpāṇi yāni ramyāṇi surūpākṛtayaśca yāḥ ||43||
cākacakyayutāścāpi tejaḥprabhāsamanvitāḥ |
kṛṣṇārpitāstu tā bhuktā naiva badhnanti nirguṇāḥ ||44||
gandhā uccāvacā ye ye tailasārādayo’pi ca |
kastūrīkesarādyāśca karpūraṃ gandhasārakāḥ ||45||
kṛṣṇārpitā nirguṇāste bhuktā badhnanti naiva ha |
śabdā ramyāḥ svarthabharā manoharāśca narmadāḥ ||46||
susvarā utsavapūrṇā ākarṣakāśca tāninaḥ |
kṛṣṇārpitā nirguṇāste bhuktā badhnanti naiva ha ||47||
vāditrāṇi samastāni saṅgītāni ca gītayaḥ |
ālāpāścārpitāḥ kṛṣṇe nirguṇā bandhavarjitāḥ ||48||
sparśāśca komalāḥ snigdhā mṛdavaḥ śītalā api |
uṣṇā gamyā iṣṭavaryā mahānandapradāḥ sukhāḥ ||49||
cetanasthā jaḍasthā vā kṛṣṇārpitā na bandhadāḥ |
saṃyogā vividhāścāpi kaṭhinā śithilāśca ye ||4.66.50||
dravāścāpi samastā ye snehā ye ca mithaḥ śubhāḥ |
vijñānāni ca kāvyāni tarkāśca buddhayastathā ||51 ||
sukhaduḥkhe sarvavidhe sarvā icchāśca vāsanāḥ |
dveṣā yatnāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā dharmādharmādayo’pi ye ||52||
bhāvanāśca samastā vai sarvakarmāṇi yāni vai |
bhāvā abhāvāḥ śrīkṛṣṇe’rpitāste nirguṇāḥ sadā ||53|||
tadbhoktāraṃ na badhnanti yato māyāvivarjitāḥ |
māyāsattvaṃ rajaścāpi tamo’haṃmamatādayaḥ ||54||
svatvaṃ nidrā ca tandrā ca kṛṣṇe’rpitā tu nirguṇāḥ |
naro nārī bālikā ca bālaḥ kanyā yuvā tathā ||55||
vṛddho vṛddhārpitāḥ kṛṣṇe nirguṇā mokṣabhāginaḥ |
gāvo vṛṣā gajā uṣṭrā aśvā ajāḥ prajāstathā ||56||
gṛhaṃ sarvopakaraṇaṃ bhogyajātaṃ samastakam |
veṣā bhūṣāḥ sampadaśca yānāni vāhanānyapi ||57||
raktāni maṇayaścāpi kaṇāḥ patrāṇi sarvathā |
phalapuṣpāṇyarpitāni kṛṣṇe nirbandhanāni vai |||98||
snānaṃ dhyānaṃ dhāraṇā ca pūjā sevā pradānakam |
vrataṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyamiṣṭaṃ vāpīkūpataḍāgakam ||59||
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ divyaṃ nirguṇaṃ bandhavarjitam |
pravāso bhāravāhitvaṃ bhṛtyatā dāsatā kṛtiḥ ||4.66.60||
śilpitā kārutā kṛṣṇasamarpitaṃ tu nirguṇam |
kalākauśalyamatyarthaṃ navāviṣkaraṇānyapi ||61 ||
sādhanānyutsavānāṃ ca pratimāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ |
śṛṃgārāṇi nirguṇāni kṛṣṇe’rpitāni sarvathā ||62||
pācanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ yānaṃ kartanaṃ lavanaṃ tathā |
sīvanaṃ cāpi sandhānaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||63||
śvasanaṃ darpaṇaṃ sparśaḥ svādaśca ghrāṇanaṃ tathā |
bhogaḥ phalaṃ samastaṃ ca kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||64||
vapanaṃ secanaṃ cābhyavardhanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā |
poṣaṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||65||
mañjanaṃ kṣuvanaṃ cāpi mroḍanaṃ troṭanaṃ tathā |
hasanaṃ ramaṇaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||66||
vihāraśca samāptiścārambho vistāraṇaṃ tathā |
saṃkocaśca vikāsaśca kṛṣṇārpitāṃstu nirguṇāḥ ||67||
jṛṃbhaṇaṃ pakṣaṇaṃ cāpi nimeṣonmeṣaṇe tathā |
svapanaṃ kūrdanaṃ pātaḥ kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ ||68||
dhāvanaṃ kramaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ sthairyamuḍuyanaṃ layaḥ |
prakāśanaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ ||69||
kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cullī jalakuṃbhī ca mārjanī |
vardhanī śayanī koṣṭhī kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ ||4.66.70 ||
mastakaṃ netrakarṇoraḥkaṇṭhahastodarādayaḥ |
jaghanorusakthijānujaṃghāpādādayastathā ||71 ||
kṛṣṇārpitāṅgasarvasvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet |
rugṇatā svāsthyamudayo vṛddhirhāniḥ praśāsanam ||72||
arjanaṃ vyavahāraśca kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ |
vyāpāro vikrayo vinimayaḥ krayo’pahāritā ||73||
bhikṣā copārjanaṃ vṛttirjīvikāyavyayau tathā |
sadasad yat samastaṃ tat kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||74||
strīpuṃnapuṃsakabhāvā dhātavaśca pravartanā |
nivartanādyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇārpitā nirguṇamuktidāḥ ||75||
bandhaśūnyā harāvarpaṇamāptāḥ sarvasampadaḥ |
mokṣāyaiva prajāyante kṛṣṇaprasannatāpradāḥ ||76||
yasya dravyaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ naiva naiva guṇāstathā |
yasya karma kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ naiva naiva tathāstitā ||77||
na jīvanaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ na prāṇāḥ kṛṣṇavarjitāḥ |
na caitanyaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ na varṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarjitaḥ ||78||
nāśramaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaśūnyo na tyāgaḥ kṛṣṇavarjitaḥ |
na dīkṣā śrīkṛṣṇaśūnyā na mṛtyuḥ kṛṣṇavarjitaḥ ||79||
neṣaṇāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaśūnyāstasya sarvaṃ hi nirguṇam |
divyaṃ kṛṣṇārthakaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ hi tat ||4.66.80 ||
kṛṣṇaprasannatādaṃ tat tasya sarvaṃ virājate |
so’pi prasādapātraṃ śrīkṛṣṇārpitastadīyakaḥ ||8 1 ||
kṛṣṇatādātmyamāpto vai mahābhāgavato hi saḥ |
koṭikalyāṇabhūmiḥ saḥ sarvakalyāṇado’pi saḥ ||82|||
adharmoddhārakaḥ sa syādaṃśāvatāra eva saḥ |
sādhuḥ sa eva śrīkṛṣṇasampadvān mukta uttamaḥ ||83||
brahmaiva sa tu vijñeyo yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇārthakaḥ sadā |
mūrtiḥ sā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāsārthamandiram ||84||
taddehaḥ śrīkṛṣṇadehastanmanaḥ kṛṣṇamānasam |
tadindriyāṇi śrīkṛṣṇendriyāṇyeva na vai pṛthak ||85||
tatkriyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakriyā na cetarāḥ |
tatsarvasvaṃ kṛṣṇa eva tatpūjā kṛṣṇapūjanam ||86||
tatsevā śrīkṛṣṇasevā sa eva kṛṣṇamūrtikaḥ |
tasya prasannatā kṛṣṇaprasannatā na saṃśayaḥ ||87||
tadvākyaṃ kṛṣṇavacanaṃ tadāśīḥ kṛṣṇakīrtitā |
tasya prāptiḥ kṛṣṇaprāptirnāsti bhedo manāgapi ||88||
avatārāsta evoktā lokoddhārakarā bhuvi |
taṃ bhajantu mahārājaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||89||
prayāmyahaṃ viśālāṃ ca prasādamātrabhojanaḥ |
svasti vo’stu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīnāthavallabhaḥ ||4.66.90||
hatyuktvā badrike gṛdhro divyo badrīśvaraṃ yayau |
naranārāyaṇaṃ māṃ tu prāptastapaścakāra ha ||9 1 ||
tataḥ śvetadvīpadhāma yayau nārāyaṇāśritam |
tato yayau sa vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāptapūrṇamanorathaḥ ||92||
atha tasmād brahmadhāma prayāsyatyakṣaraṃ padam |
prabhonārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti vai japan ||93||
ityevaṃ badrike jāto mokṣastasya prasādataḥ |
tasmāt sarvaṃ karaṇīyaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ prasādajam ||94||
athānye śataśo gṛdhrā vaṭe prasādabhojinaḥ |
kaulikasya purā sambandhino gṛdhragatiṃ gatāḥ ||95||
te’pi nityaṃ bhuṃjate sma prasādaṃ sādhuyoginām |
tena kṣapitakarmāṇo’bhavan puṇyābhibhāginaḥ ||96||
dehāṃstiryagjātijātān tyaktvā divyaśarīriṇaḥ |
bhūtvā śrībadarīnāthaṃ yayurdivyāśramaṃ tu nau ||97||
tatra taptvā tapaste ca yayuḥ śvetālayaṃ hareḥ |
tatra nārāyaṇasevāṃ kṛtvā vaikuṇṭhakaṃ yayuḥ ||98||
te’pi yāsyanti paramaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ param |
prajñānārāyaṇapadmāśrīnārāyaṇajāpinaḥ ||99||
badri prasādavat kṛṣṇasattāṃ dhuliṃ ca pāvanīm |
satāṃ pādajalaṃ pūtaṃ pītvā yānti paraṃ divam || 4.66.10 0||
satāṃ prasevayā pūtā na kalpante bhavāya te |
satāṃ mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇamūrtiḥ kathā kṛṣṇavacaḥ śubham || 101 ||
kṛṣṇārpitaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vai tat sevyaṃ netarat kvacit |
bhuktirmuktirbhavettena śrīkṛṣṇāptirbhavetsadā || 1 02||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya tiryagyonipradaṃ tvagham |
naśyatyeva paraṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 03||
kṛṣṇe bhaktirjāyate’pi satsu prītiḥ prajāyate |
sarvārpaṇādibhāvaḥ syāt tanmayatvaṃ tato bhavet || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne pūrvajanmani daṇḍāraṇināmakaulikasya gṛdhrajanmani kathāsthale bhagavatsādhuprasādocchiṣṭabhojino mokṣaṇaṃ, tatsambandhigṛdhrāṇāmapi prasādabhojanena mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||

<4.67>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ sarvāghahāriṇīm |
taṭādhiṣṭhānake grāme govāro nāmato’bhavat || 1 ||
gavāṃ pālaḥ kuṭumbāḍhyaścārayatyeva gāḥ sadā |
gavāṃ pañcaśataṃ sīmni kṣetreṣu pīḍakeṣu ca || 2 ||
sasyabhūmiṣu ghāsāḍhyakṣitāvucchrāyakeṣu ca |
nītvā nityaṃ cārayati govyāpāraśca jīvati || 3 ||
dugdhadadhyājyavikretā govāraḥ sa prajīvati |
karoti cāparaṃ kāryaṃ grāmīṇagopracāraṇam || 4 ||
grāmīṇānāṃ gavāṃ cāpi cāraṇaṃ svīyadhenubhiḥ |
sākaṃ sīmasu sarvatra vṛttikāṃ labhate tathā || 5 ||
evaṃ nirvāhamāpnoti kintu lobhābhikarṣitaḥ |
anyāsāṃ tu gavāṃ dugdhaṃ dohayitvā ca vikrayam || 6 ||
kvacit kvacit karotyeva dugdhacauryaṃ tathāvidham |
catuḥśatāni gāvastu grāmīṇānāṃ bhavanti tāḥ || 7 ||
nijā gāvaḥ śataṃ ceti dugdhadāstu tadardhikāḥ |
grāmīṇānāṃ gavāṃ nityaṃ pañcānāṃ dugdhameva saḥ || 8 ||
corayatyeva madhyāhnottaraṃ sīmnyeva pratyaham |
nityamevaṃ rasacauryaṃ karoti gosatīṣvapi || 9 ||
dogdhrīṣu ca svakīyāsu tṛṣṇātanturhi durjaraḥ |
rasastainyajapāpena kālāntare mṛto vane || 4.67.1 0||
jalānnarahitaḥ so’yaṃ vane mārjāratāṃ gataḥ |
śarkarānagarābhyāśe mārjāro bhramati prage || 1 1||
yadvā rātrau bhojanārthaṃ samanveṣaṇatatparaḥ |
samāyāti mahodyānaṃ gandhena karṣitastataḥ || 1 2||
āyayau bhojanocchiṣṭotkarapuñjasamīpagaḥ |
tatra kṛṣṇaprasādānnabhojināṃ sādhuyoginām || 1 3||
ucchiṣṭaṃ prāptavān vanyabiḍālako mudaṃ gataḥ |
bhakṣayāmāsa tṛptaśca yayau rātrau vanāntaram || 14||
evaṃ karoti nityaṃ sa miṣṭagariṣṭabhojanam |
tenālasaḥ sa sañjāto māsānte puṣṭadehavān || 15||
utkarasyaiva pārśvasthatṛṇapuñje divāniśam |
vāsaṃ sa rocayāmāsa nirbhīkaḥ stabakeṣvapi || 16||
stambeṣu ca kvacidasti svapiti bhakṣaṇottaram |
kvacid divā samāyāti bahiḥ śvādivivarjite || 17||
caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ bhoktumutkarake sa tu |
madhyāhnottaravelāyāmāgato bhayavarjitaḥ || 18||
ucchiṣṭaṃ bhuktavām̐statra mūrchāṃ jagāma vai tataḥ |
vyasurjātaḥ kṣaṇāt tasmād divyaḥ pumān vyajāyata || 19||
suravad divyadehaśca sarvāṃgaśobhanaḥ śubhaḥ |
ucchiṣṭamārjakā dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryamidaṃ tataḥ ||4.67.20||
papracchustaṃ devajanaṃ kastvaṃ mārjāratāṃ gataḥ |
kathaṃ devatvamāpanno namastubhyaṃ vadātra naḥ ||21 ||
sa cāhocchiṣṭahārām̐stu taṭādhiṣṭhānake pure |
govāranāmakaścāhaṃ gavāṃ cāro’bhavaṃ purā ||22||
grāmīṇānāṃ dhenavaśca dogdhrayaḥ sucāritā mayā |
kintu tāsāṃ sudugdhāni sīmni pralobhinā mayā ||23||
coritāni dohitāni vikrītāni ca cauryataḥ |
ājīvanaṃ kṛtaṃ cauryaṃ tena pāpena vai mṛtaḥ ||24||
yāmyapure duḥkhamayīryātanāḥ samalokya ca |
bhuktvā duḥkhānyasaṃkhyāni tato mārjāratāṃ gataḥ ||25||
jalānnaśūnyadeśe vai kṣudhātṛṣātipīḍitaḥ |
śvapadānāṃ bhautiyukto bhramāmi rakṣayam̐stu mām ||26||
mārgayāmi bhakṣyameva jalaṃ cāpi miled yadi |
aṭan vanāni cāgacchaṃ vane sindhutaṭe’dhunā ||27||
jalayukte pradeśe’haṃ nivāsaṃ samarocayam |
rātrau rātrau vicarāmi bhakṣyalābhāya kheṭakān ||28||
mahodyānābhibhūmau cāgacchaṃ daivānuyojitaḥ |
utkaraṃ dṛṣṭavān rātrāvucchiṣṭabahulaṃ tadā ||29||
abhakṣayaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca tṛptiṃ śāntimavāpa ca |
nityamevaṃ bhakṣyamatra prāptaṃ mayā divāniśam ||4.67.30||
puṣṭiṃ prāpto’tra dehasya mahālasyaṃ gato’pi ca |
alasaḥ sannivāsaṃ cārocayaṃ tṛṇapuñjake ||3 1||
nātidūre stabakeṣu stambeṣvapi bhramāmyaham |
bhuktvā cātra prayāmyevaṃ māso’tra me vyavartata ||32||
ucchiṣṭaṃ bhuktavānnityaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādabhojinām |
sādhūnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca tenāghāni gatāni me ||33||
naṣṭapāpo bhavāmyadya prasādocchiṣṭabhojanaḥ |
puṇyavān bhāgyavānasmi jātaścādya bhuvastale ||34||
kathāsthalīsthasādhūnāṃ prasādaṃ prāptavānaham |
devabhāvaṃ cādhigatastyaktvā biḍālavigraham ||35||
prayāmi vyomacāro’haṃ svargaṃ mahendrapālitam |
tatra śatayugaṃ sthitvā yāsyāmi badarīvanam ||36||
śvetadvīpaṃ tataścāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param |
tatokṣarapadaṃ divyaṃ prayāsyāmi ca saṃśayaḥ ||37||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ |
sādhūnāṃ suprasādasyocchiṣṭabhogaphalaṃ tvidam ||38||
jātaṃ me sarvathā lokā yāsyāmi svargamuttamam |
svasti vo’stu namo vo’stvityuktvā divaṃ yayau drutam ||39||
ucchiṣṭamārjakāḥ sarve mahāścaryaṃ prapedire |
aho prasādamāhātmyaṃ paśūnāṃ devatākaram ||4.67.40||
viditvā te kathāyāṃ vai kathānte cāhurutsukāḥ |
sarve jñātvā menire tāṃ kṛpāṃ kṛṣṇasya sarvathā ||41 ||
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi ṭhaṭhṭholasya kathāṃ tathā |
vastracauro’bhavaddhūrtaḥ ṭhaṭṭholākhyo vaṇigjanaḥ ||42||
hanūdarākhyanagare vastravyāpāravān sadā |
vastrāpaṇād vastrajātīnyabhikrīṇāti nityadā ||43||
vikrīṇāti ca tānyeva vyāpāraṃ prakaroti ca |
kvacit kvacid vastracauryaṃ karoti paravastrataḥ ||44||
kraye cauryaṃ vikraye’pi parakośebhya ityapi |
granthicauryaṃ karotyeva yathā jānāti netaraḥ ||45||
vastracauryotthapāpena dāridryaṃ samajāyata |
annavastrādihīnaḥ sa vyajāyata śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||46||
kuṭumbapoṣaṇāśakto vicittaḥ so’bhavam̐stataḥ |
unmattaḥ sa gṛhaṃ tyaktvābhramad grāmāntare’pi ca ||47||
prārabdhavaśatāpanno jvarāviṣṭobhavattaḥ |
mṛto nirjanadeśe’sau dehaṃ kākā abhakṣayan ||48||
vastracauryasya pāpena yāmyapuraṃ gato’bhavat |
tatra bhuktvā narakān sa vane jambukatāṃ gataḥ ||49||
kṣudhāvyāpto vastrahīnaḥ śītoṣṇapīḍitaḥ śaṭhaḥ |
dhūrtasvabhāvayuktaḥ sa jambukaḥ śarkarāpuram ||4.67.50||
adūravanatastatra kathābhyāśamupāyayau |
rātrau bhojanalabdhīcchāpreritaḥ paryaṭan svayam ||51||
utkaraṃ khādyasampannamucchiṣṭasañcayānvitam |
prāpa cakhāda tatrānnaṃ prasādocchiṣṭamujjhitam ||52||
satāṃ prasādocchiṣṭaṃ ca bubhuje tṛptipūrvakam |
evaṃ nityaṃ bhuktavān sa badrike cotkarojjhitam ||53||
tena pāpāni naṣṭāni paśujanmārthakānyapi |
pūrvajāni samastāni nūtnajanmāni yānyapi ||54||
sarvapāpāni naṣṭāni vāsanāśca kṣayaṃ gatāḥ |
śuddho jātaḥ śṛgālo yat prasādo bheṣajaṃ satām ||55|||
janmarogaharaḥ sarvavāsanākṣayakṛttathā |
hareḥ satāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ prasādo bheṣajaṃ mahat ||56||
saṃsārarogamagnānāṃ prasādo roganāśakaḥ |
brahmasvāsthyapradaścāpi svargasaukhyapradastathā ||57||
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ cāpi kīṭānāṃ kṣudradehinām |
śākhināṃ tṛṇajātīnāmapi pāpavināśakaḥ ||58||
svargadaḥ puṇyado mokṣapradaścāpi prasādakaḥ |
divyadṛṣṭiprado divyagatipradaḥ prasādakaḥ ||59||
prasādānnaṃ prasādāpo bhuktaṃ pītāḥ pramokṣadāḥ |
pitaro mānavā devāḥ pibanti bhuñjate tataḥ ||4.67.60||
hareḥ prasādaṃ muktyarthaṃ satāṃ prasādamityapi |
evaṃ bhuktvā nityameva jambukaḥ śuddhatāṃ gataḥ ||61||
badrike caitrapūrṇāyāṃ madhyandinottaraṃ sa tu |
bhakṣayāmāsa cocchiṣṭaṃ mūrchāmavāpa tatkṣaṇam ||62||
tāvajjambukadehāttu puruṣo devarūpavān |
sudivyaḥ prāvirabhavat sarvatejo’bhibhāsuraḥ ||63||
karmacāraistathānyaiḥ saṃvīkṣitaḥ sa tadāmbare |
pṛṣṭaḥ kastvaṃ kathaṃ devo jambukādvai vyajāyathāḥ ||64||
sa prāhāhaṃ vaṇigjātirhanūdarapurālayaḥ |
purāsaṃ ṭhaṭṭholakākhyo vastravyāpāravān sadā ||65||
viśvastānāṃ cāpaṇebhyo vastracauryaparo’bhavam |
vastrakośebhya evāpi granthikācauryatatparaḥ ||66||
evaṃ cauryaprapāpaiśca dāridryaṃ prāptavām̐stataḥ |
unmattaścābhavaṃ mṛtyuṃ gato bhraman vanāntike ||67||
dehaṃ tvabhakṣayan kākā gṛdhrāśca jambukā mama |
yāmyaduḥkhāni saṃbhuktvā pāpaleśena jambukaḥ |||8|||
vane’trāsmi prasaṃbhūtaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭo bhramāmi ca |
vastrahīnaḥ sadā duḥkhī bhojanārthamihotkaram ||69||
āgatya pratyahaṃ cānnaṃ bhunajmyucchiṣṭamuttamam |
hareḥ prasādajaṃ cānnaṃ satāmucchiṣṭamuttamam ||4.67.70||
pāvanaṃ pāpahāraṃ ca nityaṃ bhuktvāghavarjitaḥ |
pāvano vāsanāhīno jāto’smi puṇyavānaham ||71 ||
kathāprasaṃgataścātra mayā prāptaṃ subhojanam |
yenāhaṃ devatārūpo jāto’smi ca divaṃgataḥ ||72||
uṣitvā suciraṃ mārge tato yāsyāmi mokṣaṇam |
ityuktvā prayayau badri devo bhūtvā divaṃ tadā ||73||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ karmacārāstadā janāḥ |
vividuśca prasādasya māhātmyaṃ svargamokṣadam ||74||
śṛṇu badrīpriye paścādāścaryaparamaṃ manaḥ |
abhavat karmacārāṇāṃ prasādānnādibhakṣaṇe ||75||
māhātmyasaṃvidaste ca prasādaṃ karmacāriṇaḥ |
pāpanāśakaraṃ jñātvā cakhadurbhāvasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||76||
teṣāṃ vai karmacārāṇāṃ nirmalānyāntarāṇi vai |
indriyādīnyabhavam̐śca hṛdayāni śubhāni ca ||77||
pāpaśūnyāni jātāni śreṣṭhavivekavanti ca |
teṣāṃ tadābhavan hṛtsu saṃkalpā mokṣahetave ||78||
mantrāṇāṃ grahaṇe cāpi satāṃ prasevane’pi ca |
nāmnāṃ kṛṣṇasya raṭane kīrtane paramātmanaḥ ||79||
atha te vai śataṃ karmacārāḥ sevāparāyaṇāḥ |
jagṛhuḥ paramaṃ mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ ca kīrtanam ||4.67.80||
svataḥprakāśāyanato jāpaṃ cakruśca kīrtanam |
nityaṃ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kṛtvā kurvanti kīrtanam ||8 1||
evaṃ te śraddhayā yuktā mantramāhātmyavedinaḥ |
prasādasya satāṃ sevāyāśca māhātmyavedinaḥ ||82||
bhaktyā kṛṣṇasya bhajanaṃ cakrire bhojanottaram |
māsānte bhajatāṃ teṣāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prasannatāṃ gataḥ ||83||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntavallabhaḥ |
ākāśādāyayau tūrṇaṃ svarṇavimānavāhanaḥ ||84||
prasannamānaso divyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
lakṣmyā juṣṭo lalitayā māṇikyā parisevitaḥ ||85||
rādhayā japayā padmāvatyā ca prajñayārcitaḥ |
karmacārairnaraiḥ sarvaistathā karmaparāyaṇaiḥ ||86||
tadanyamānavaiścāpi yoṣidbhiḥ karmajuṣṭibhiḥ |
dṛṣṭaḥ śrībhagavān ramyaḥ sarvakāmārthapūrakaḥ ||87||
nato muhurjayaśabdairvardhitaścākṣatādibhiḥ |
pūjito hārdakusumairvimānād bhuvamāgamat ||88||
prāha sarvān prasaṃvīkṣya karmacārāgramānavam |
gṛhṇannāma hariṃ prāha sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā ||89||
bho svarṇāñjana bhṛtya tvaṃ pavitro’si prasādataḥ |
manye nārīnarāḥ sarve prasādabhojino’pi ca ||4.67.90||
kathāsevāparāḥ santi pāvanā gatakalmaṣāḥ |
muktiyogyāḥ samastā vai sarvānnetuṃ mamākṣaram ||91|||
āgato’pi samāyāntu sarve me śāśvatālayam |
ityuktā badrike sarve karmacārā narāḥ striyaḥ ||92||
sajjā halahalāśabdairvimānaṃ prati dudruvuḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenaite vārikaṇaiḥ prasiñcitāḥ ||93||
mūrchāṃ labdhvā tanūstyaktvā bhūtvā sudivyavigrahāḥ |
vimānamadhiruhyaite divyā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||94||
vaiśākhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ |
śataṃ narāḥ śataṃ nāryo divyā muktāḥ sadābhavan ||95||
jayanādān prakurvanto modapramodarañjitāḥ |
śrāvayanto janān sarvān kirtanaṃ te yayustadā ||96||
prabhonārāyaṇakṛṣṇamālataunrāyaṇa prabho |
jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||97||
evaṃ tālīrvādayantaḥ kurvantaḥ kilakilāṭikāḥ |
āhvayanto bhūtalasthān yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ he te ||98||
badrike śrīhareścāyaṃ prasādaḥ kṛpayānvitaḥ |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadātyeva tatheṣṭaṃ pradadātyapi ||99||
bhajatāṃ bhagavantaṃ vai na nyūnaṃ tvavaśiṣyate |
sevatāṃ sādhūvaryāṃśca sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ pravartate || 4.67.10 0||
raṭatāṃ śrīharernāma bhasmībhavantyaghāni vai |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 10 1||
ityevaṃ japatāṃ mantraṃ jāyante puṇyakoṭayaḥ |
smaratāṃ śrīhariṃ badri sākṣāt kṛṣṇo’bhiyāti ca || 10 2|||
arpayatāṃ samastaṃ ca gatirdhāmnyakṣare’sti ca |
svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānnayatyetānnijālayam || 1 03||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi smaratāṃ mokṣadaṃ tvidam |
sarveṣṭapūrakaṃ badri śāśvatānandadāyakam ||104||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne pūrvajanmani dhenupālasya govārābhidhasya mārjāratāṃ gatasya, pūrvabhave ṭhaṭṭholākhyavaṇigjanasya śṛgālatā prāptasya, svarṇāñjanādiśatadvayakarmacārinaranārīṇāṃ ca, prasādabhojanena sevākathādinā ca, mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||

<4.68>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ cānyāṃ hitāvahām |
bharavāṭo’bhavadgrāme gundrake paramīrakaḥ || 1 ||
paramīrābhidhaḥ so’yamajāsahasrapālakaḥ |
ajāmātrapayovṛttyā tathorṇavikrayādibhiḥ || 2 ||
ajāvikrayavṛttyā ca jīvatyeva kuṭumbavān |
ajāmāṃsāśanaścāpi tathājābālabhakṣakaḥ || 3 ||
evaṃvidho’bhavat pāpī sadājāpaśujīvanaḥ |
cārayatyeva sarvājāḥ sīmakṣetrādiṣu nṛṇām || 4 ||
sasvāmikeṣu kṣetreṣu sasyaghāsatṛṇāni ca |
yāni tānyapi cauryeṇa cārayatyapi vai niśi || 5 ||
evaṃ doṣakaraścāyaṃ bharavāṭo’ghasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
dharmakarmādihīnaḥ sa kālapāśavaśaṃgataḥ || 6 ||
yayau yamālayaṃ yāmyairnītaśca tatra raurave |
asipatravane kālapāśe sandaśake tathā || 7 ||
agnijvāle narakeṣu kṣipto lālāśane’pi ca |
yāmyaduḥkhānyanubhūya bhūtale śyenatāṃ gataḥ || 8 ||
araṇye śyenapakṣī sa jātaḥ pāpāvaśeṣataḥ |
sa tūḍḍīya vanād vanāntaraṃ sindhutaṭe’gamat || 9 ||
prāpto’yaṃ śarkarābhūmiṃ yatra kathā pravartate |
taruṣaṇḍeṣu viśrāntiṃ lebhe madhyāhnake tadā || 4.68.1 0||
tatra tatra ca caṭakā mārgayan tūtkare sthitāḥ |
bhakṣayantīścaṭakāḥ sa vyalokayat sudūrataḥ || 1 1||
sādhūcchiṣṭaudanakaṇān kṛṣṇaprasādarūpiṇaḥ |
bhakṣayantīrbhakṣyacittāścaṭakā vīkṣya vai drutam ||1 2||
utpapāta drumāttūrṇaṃ papāta caṭakopari |
sahasraśaścaṭakāstā uḍḍīya bhayato drutam || 1 3||
utpeturambaraṃ tvekāṃ dhṛtavān bhakṣyamuttamam |
cañcvā tāṃ mārayāmāsa tāvaccaṭakāvarṣmaṇaḥ || 14||
viniryayau divyanārī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā |
svargasya devatā yadvat kanyā tejasvinī śubhā ||15||
puṣpamālāṃ kare dhṛtvā sāpsaraḥsundarī drutam |
kathāmaṇḍapamāgatya vyomamārgeṇa pūjanam || 16||
pracakre śrīprabhe badri saṃhitāyāḥ samutsukā |
vilokitā samastaiśca maṇḍapasthairjanaistadā ||17||
pṛṣṭā kā tvaṃ natā cāpi pratyuvāca janān prati |
caṭakāhaṃ prasādānnabhakṣaṇāt pāpavarjitā || 18||
pavitrā puṇyasaṃyuktā bhavāmyadya janāstviha |
satāmucchiṣṭamāsādyābhavaṃ svargāya devatā || 19||
apsarovaratāṃ prāptā svargaṃ prayāmi cādhunā |
caturyugaṃ divi sthitvā śrīsaṃhitārhaṇodbhavam ||4.68.20||
puṇyamāsādya yāsyāmi vaikuṣṭhaṃ muktavigrahā |
śyeno’yaṃ tu purā cāsīdbharavāṭo hyajāpatiḥ ||21 ||
ahamāsamajā tasya mṛtātra caṭakābhavam |
tena dhṛtā mṛtā cāsmi prayāmi svargamuttamam ||22||
anyāścaṭakā uḍḍīya prayātāścāmbaraṃ drutam |
tā api bharavāṭasyābhavannajādimaṇḍalam ||23||
tāḥ sarvā api kālena prasādabhakṣikā yataḥ |
niṣpāpāḥ puṇyavatyaśca prayāsyanti paraṃ padam ||24||
śyeno’pi mama dehasya prasādapāvitasya vai |
bhakṣaṇena puṇyabalo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||25||
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kaṇabhakṣī bhaviṣyatyutkare sthitaḥ |
prasādakaṇabhug bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa prayāsyati ||26||
ityuktvā caṭakā badri natvā saṃpūjya cāmṛtam |
vāri pītvā yayau svargaṃ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ parī ||27||
mahāścaryamabhūtteṣāṃ paśyatāṃ dehināṃ tadā |
badrike cātha caṭakāṃ śyenaḥ sa bubhuje tadā ||28||
odanaṃ susugandhaṃ ca prasādocchiṣṭamityapi |
bubhuje’nyānnakaṇakān śṛtān svādūn sumodavān ||29||
miṣṭānnakhaṇḍakām̐ścāpi ghṛtapakvān surandhitān |
kaccarasthān nityamevamāgatya śyena āda tān ||4.68.30||
pūtātmā cābhavacchyenastatyāja māṃsabhakṣaṇam |
jātismaro’bhavattena mokṣamaicchannijātmanaḥ ||3 1||
caṭakānāṃ tathā mokṣamaikṣat purājajanmanām |
nityaṃ śyenastaruṣaṇḍe pratīkṣan caṭakāgamam ||32||
pracchannastiṣṭhati kroḍe divase cotkaronmukhaḥ |
caṭakāśca samāyānti prasādocchiṣṭavāñcchayā ||33||
bhakṣayantyekacittāśca tāvatpatati pakṣirāṭa |
caṭakaṃ vā caṭakāṃ vā samādatte’danāya saḥ ||34||
caṭakāpi mṛtā tūrṇaṃ devo vā devatā tadā |
bhūtvā yātyambaraṃ svargaṃ prayātyeva mudāvyayam ||35||
evaṃ nityaṃ prakurvāṇaścaikadāha tarau sthitaḥ |
caṭakā yūyamevādāvajā āsta śubhā mama || 36||
karmayogena janmātra bhavatīnāṃ hi vartate |
mayā pūrvaṃ bhavatīnāṃ dugdhānyatithaye tathā ||37||
sādhubhyo dharmakāryārthaṃ nārāyaṇāya caikadā |
arpitāni śivarātryāṃ śivasnānārthamityataḥ ||38||
tena puṇyapratāpena bhavatyaścaṭakāstviha |
sañjātā api kṛṣṇasya prasādocchiṣṭabhakṣikāḥ ||39||
pavitrāḥ puṇyaśālinyo bhavathaiva divārthikāḥ |
smarantu pūrvajanmādya spṛṣṭvā māṃ bharavāṭakam ||4.68.40||
śyenātmānaṃ tato yāntu divaṃ vaikuṇṭhamityapi |
śrīsaṃhitākathāṃ śrutvā prapūjya vācakaṃ tathā ||41||
sādhūn sampūjya divyān vai mokṣadān yāntu mokṣaṇam |
ityevaṃ badrike jātismaraḥ śyeno jagāda tān ||42||
te’pi sarve caṭakāśca narā nāryastadā śubhām |
śyenagiraṃ samākarṇya mahāścaryapuraḥsarāḥ ||43||
sasmaruḥ pūrvajanmāni bharavāṭasya tā ajāḥ |
tadā viśvāsamāpannā nemuḥ śyenaṃ purā patim ||44||
śyeno’pi satkṛtastaiśca samāyayau tamutkaram |
militaścaṭakebhyaśca caṭakābhyaśca sādaram ||45||
jātismarāḥ samastāste vṛttāntān jagadurmithaḥ |
utsavaṃ menire tatra bubhujire prasādakam ||46||
ahiṃsāvratamāsthāya nyūṣustarugaṇe mithaḥ |
ucchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayantaste śṛṇvantaśca kathāmṛtam ||47||
māsaṃ mitho’vasan tāvanmṛtyusteṣāmupāyayau |
sarve kṣapitakarmāṇo niṣpāpāścaṭakādayaḥ |||48|||
vaiśākhakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ madhyāhnottarameva ha |
prasādocchiṣṭabhakṣāste śyenena sahasā saha ||49||
tyaktadehā abhavam̐śca babhūvurdevajātayaḥ |
sahasraśaḥ surā devyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||4.68.50||
tannetā bharavāṭo’pi deveśvaro vyajāyata |
gṛhītakaramālāste gṛhītakusumāstathā ||51||
saṃhitāṃ te prapūjyāpi vyāsaṃ prapūjya vai drutam |
dhṛtvā dhūliṃ kathābhūmerjanitvāścaryamuttamam ||52||
jayaśabdānuccaranto yayuḥ svargaṃ sahasraśaḥ |
badrike te divo’nte ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma śobhanam ||53||
prayāsyanti mahābhāgā muktā muktānikāstadā |
tatra nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ prasevya kṛpayā hareḥ ||54||
golokaṃ saṃprayāsyanti rādhākṛṣṇakṛpālayāḥ |
tatra prasādya rādhāṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ prasādya vai tataḥ ||55||
prayāsyantyakṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham |
ityetat kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ māhātmyaṃ tu kathodbhavam ||56||
prasādasyāpi māhātmyaṃ yasya pāṭhācchruterapi |
bhuktirmuktirdivaṃ sveṣṭaṃ labhet kṛṣṇakṛpālavāt ||57||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’jāpālabharavāṭasya śyenajanmani, ajānāṃ caṭakājanmasu ca, hareḥ sādhūnāṃ ca prasādocchiṣṭabhakṣaṇalābhena kathālābhena ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 68 ||

<4.69>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāmanyāṃ supāvanīm |
kapotāścāyayurvyomnā daśotkarānnavāñcchayā || 1 ||
kathāmaṇḍapamāsādya kṣaṇaṃ tasthurghaṭadhvaje |
niṣedurmaṇḍape śāntāḥ kathāśravaṇahetave || 2 ||
jātismarāśca te sarve kathānte dvādaśīdine |
vaiśākhakṛṣṇe pakṣe vai madhyānhottarameva ha || 3 ||
pākaśālābhyāśabhūmau bhojanālayabhūtale |
vīkṣya lokām̐stu bhuñjānān sādhūn sādhvīśca vaiṣṇavān || 4 || 
āśayocchiṣṭalabdheste samuḍḍīya punaḥ punaḥ |
maṇḍapopari tiṣṭhanti niṣīdanti samīhayā || 5 ||
tāvanmiṣṭaudanādyaṃ ca bhakṣyaṃ pakvānnamuttamam |
ucchiṣṭaṃ sādhusādhvyaśca cikṣipuścotkare tataḥ || 6 ||
kapotā daśa śīghraṃ nirbhīkā bhakṣyārthamāyayuḥ |
prasādaṃ sahasā bhuktvā pītvā sūpaṃ jalaṃ tathā || 7 ||
tṛptāstuṣṭāḥ prasannāśca babhūvurgatakalmaṣāḥ |
pāvanā dhanyabhāgyāḍhyā menire puṇyamuttamam || 8 ||
uḍḍīya te vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe niṣaṇṇā jagadurmithaḥ |
aho bhāgyaṃ tu naḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prasādo’dya hareḥ satām || 9 ||
ucchiṣṭo labdha utkṛṣṭo bhakṣitaḥ pāpanāśakṛt |
pūtā adya tu jātāḥ sma pakṣiṇo bhāgyaśālinaḥ || 4.69.10 ||
śrutāsmābhiḥ kathā divyā mokṣadā saṃhitātmikā |
aho bhāgyaṃ mānavānāṃ ye śṛṇvanti sadā kathām || 1 1||
aho bhāgyamatithīnāṃ prasādaṃ bhuṃjate tu ye |
aho bhāgyaṃ tu kīṭānāmadantyucchiṣṭamatra ye || 1 2||
aho bhāgyaṃ paśūnāṃ ca ye’dantyucchiṣṭamatra vai |
dhanyeyaṃ bhūmikā mokṣakarī jātā tu pāvanī || 1 3||
dhanyā sindhuḥ sudhāsindhusamādya vartate bhuvi |
vadantyevaṃ kapotāste tacchrutaṃ tvekasādhunā ||14||
nāmnā kṛṣṇavirāmeṇa bhūtarutābhivedinā |
tena pṛṣṭāḥ kapotāste premṇā jijñāsayā drutam || 19||
ke bhavantaḥ kapotā yat prasādotkarṣavedinaḥ |
hareḥ satāṃ ca māhātmyavido divyā ivottamāḥ || 16||
jātismarāḥ kapotāste prāhurvayaṃ purā kṣitau |
ekagrāmanivāsā vai sārthavāṭetijātijāḥ || 17||
āsma vai mṛttikāpuryāṃ dāridryadoṣapīḍitāḥ |
daśaiva navakuṭṭākhye nagare jīvikecchayā || 18||
agacchāma ca tatrāpi bhṛtyatāyāṃ dhanigṛhe |
dhaninā nijakāryārthaṃ yojitā vetanena vai || 1 9||
sarve vayaṃ tu kārpāsavyāpāre tena yojitāḥ |
kārpāsānāmānayane grāmāntarebhya ityapi ||4.69.20||
kārpāsānāṃ vikraye ca kraye’pi yojitā vayam |
ekadā kṛtā ntrāśca vayaṃ tu dhanalālasāḥ ||2 1 ||
jānanto bhūmigaṃ dravyaṃ śreṣṭhino rāmavarcasaḥ |
rātrau viśvāsamāpannaṃ samastā rāmavarcasam ||22||
ekalaṃ galapāśena rurudhimātinirdayāḥ |
rāmavarcā mṛtiṃ prāpto vayamādāya nāṇakam ||23||
niryayima nagarādvai tena pāpena vai pathi |
caurairmilitairbahubhirluṇṭitā māritāstathā ||24||
śavāḥ kṣiptāśca garteṣu phalaṃ prāptā drutaṃ tadā |
yamadūtairdhṛtāḥ pāśairnītā yāmyapuraṃ daśa ||25||
bhuktavanto yātanāni kuṇḍeṣu pātitā yamaiḥ |
nirgatya ca tato jātā vane vayaṃ tu bhallukāḥ ||26||
mṛtāstato vānarāśca jātā saha daśaiva tu |
punarmṛtāśca kākā vai jātāstataḥ sahaiva ca ||27||
mṛtāḥ kapotakā jātā vartāmaścātra bhakṣakāḥ |
ucchiṣṭabhojino jātā jātismarāstu pāvanāḥ ||28|| 
bhavatprasādocchiṣṭasyādanādadyāghanāśanam |
jātaṃ sarvavidhānāṃ vai pāpānāṃ vinivartanam ||29||
uktaṃ sarvaṃ smarāmo’dya kṛtapāpaphalādikam |
bhāti no’dya paraṃ śreyo bhavanāśo bhaviṣyati ||4.69.30||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ prasādabhojanam |
puṇyaṃ satāṃ darśanaṃ ca satsaṃgo mokṣadaḥ sadā ||3 1||
sādho bhavatprasaṃgena nirbhīkāḥ smo vayaṃ tviha |
mokṣārthaṃ sādhanaṃ yattad dehi naḥ śīghrameva ha || 32||
prāptalābhaḥ punarnaiva miliṣyatīti mā ciram |
ityevaṃ badrike taistu kapotaiḥ paribhāṣitaḥ ||33||
kṛṣṇavirāmaḥ salilaṃ kare dhṛtvā sthito’bhavat |
āhvayāmāsa tānsarvān kapotān śaraṇaṃ prati || 34||
āyayuste drutaṃ matvā kalyāṇaṃ samupasthitam |
nipetuḥ pādayostasya so’pi vārābhyaṣecayat || 35||
śrāvayāmāsa nāmāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca |
tāvatte pakṣivaṣmāṇi samutsṛjya surāḥ śubhāḥ || 36||
divyā devāḥ surūpāścābhavan sādhoḥ prapaśyataḥ |
athocuste santamenaṃ dehi mantraṃ tu mokṣadam ||37||
devalokaṃ na cecchāmo yataḥ prapatanaṃ punaḥ |
śrutvā sādhurdadau mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||38||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
mantraṃ prāpya kapotāste devāstiro’bhavan drutam ||39||
caturbhujāstu muktāste’bhavan sādhoḥ prapaśyataḥ |
prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho |||4.69.40||
jayākṛṣṇa lalitānrāyaṇāya rādhāpate vibho |
evaṃ te bhajanaṃ cakrustāvattatra vimānakam ||41 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiyuktaṃ cāvātarattu khāt |
tānāha bhagavān kṛṣṇovallābhāryaḥ kṛpāvaśaḥ |||42||
āyāntu me vimānaṃ vai muktā bhaktā mamāśritāḥ |
kapotakā bhavanto’dya supotakāḥ sumuktigāḥ ||43||
ityuktvā tān kare dhṛtvā bhagavān kṛṣṇamādhavaḥ |
nināya śāśvataṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ sāghoḥ prapaśyataḥ ||44||
badrike te sadā māyābandhād viniryayuḥ sukham |
athānyaṃ te camatkāraṃ kathayāmi nibodha me ||45||
kākānāṃ śatasaṃkhyānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyomavartmanā |
yadṛcchayāyayau tatra mahānasasamīpataḥ ||46||
gandhaṃ prāpya ca miṣṭānnaṃ vīkṣya ghrātvājyadhūmrakam |
avātarat taruṣaṇḍe bhojanocchiṣṭavācchayā ||47||
vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ dinārdhake |
bhāge teṣāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ vai bhojanottaram ||48||
ucchiṣṭamutkarasthaṃ tu bhakṣayituṃ prasādakam |
uparyupari cotpetuḥ kākāste hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||49||
nipeturhṛṣṭaśabdāste bubhujurmiṣṭamuttamam |
kṣīraṃ ca dugdhasārādi polikāḥ pūrikādikam ||4.69.50||
odanaṃ ca tathā sūpaṃ caṇakān granthakām̐stathā |
pūpānapūpān kalikā bubhujuścotkarojjhitān ||51 ||
sādhuprasādarūpām̐śca sarve kākā mudānvitāḥ |
badrike mahadāścaryamabhūttatrāpyatarkitam ||52||
kṛṣṇapakṣāstu te kākā babhūbustatra sarvathā |
karburapakṣiṇo ramyā nānāraṃgāḍhyapakṣiṇaḥ ||53||
kṛṣṇaṃ rūpaṃ hi pāpātma līnaṃ pakṣeṣu bhāgataḥ |
athānyasmid dine cāpi bubhujuste tathāvidham ||54||
tena śvetabahulā vai pakṣāsteṣāṃ tadābhavan |
athāparasmin divase bubhujuste tayojjhitam ||55||
sampūrṇaśvetapakṣāste’bhavan dugdhasvarūpiṇaḥ |
athetarasmin divase bubhujuste tathojjhitam ||56||
sarvathā kākadehāste śvetarūpā babhūvire |
aho prasādamāhātmyaṃ pāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ param ||57||
satāmucchiṣṭamāhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam |
pātakaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ vai śvetaṃ puṇyaṃ sadā matam | |58||
puṇyavantaḥ prajātāste kākā haṃsasamāstadā |
evaṃ te bubhujurnityaṃ śuddhātmāno’bhavam̐stataḥ ||59||
kākajātīyadoṣāśca naṣṭāsteṣāṃ tadātmanām |
jātismarāśca te jātā jñānino haṃsavattadā ||4.69.60||
tān draṣṭuṃ mānavāstatrāyānti kutūhalānvitāḥ |
kākāste nirbhayāstatra vicaranti ca bhūtale ||61 ||
praśaṃsanti prasādasyocchiṣṭamāhātmyamadbhutam |
aho prāptā hareścāpi satāmucchiṣṭabhojanam ||62||
tena puṇyena pāpāni naṣṭāni tāmasāni naḥ |
rājasāni samastāni naṣṭānyaghāni sarvathā ||63||
sāttvikāni tu puṇyāni svargapradāni yāni vai |
tāni jātāni cāsmākaṃ satāṃ prasādasevayā ||64||
kākā vayaṃ hi pāpiṣṭhā viḍabhujaḥ pūrvakarmataḥ |
teṣāṃ kalyāṇakartāraḥ santaḥ satāṃ prasādakāḥ ||65||
ye na bhuṃjate kṛṣṇasya prasādaṃ ca satāṃ tathā |
te loke śvetavarṇāścet tathāpi kākakoṭikāḥ ||66||
ye tu bhuṃjate kṛṣṇasya satāṃ prasādamuttamam |
te kṛṣṇā api nityaṃ vai devāste haṃsakoṭikāḥ ||67||
śvetatvaṃ niṣphalaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ pāpātmabhojanam |
kṛṣṇatvaṃ saphalaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ vai vighasāśitā ||68||
tadgṛhaṃ malavat proktaṃ yatra devā na bhuṃjate |
sā bhāṣā kākabhāṣā vai na yatra kṛṣṇakīrtanam ||69||
tadrūpaṃ kuṣṭharūpaṃ vai yanna kṛṣṇārthamarpitam |
tadbhojyaṃ tajjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ śākaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ dalam ||4.69.70||
vastraṃ copakaraṇādi kṛṣṇārthaṃ na kṛtaṃ tu yat |
sarve tat kākamalavat pāpabhṛtaṃ mataṃ tviha ||71||
tiraścāṃ naiva doṣo’sti paśūnāṃ nāpi dūṣaṇam |
doṣastu mānavānāṃ yajjānanto’pyarpayanti na ||72||
na bhajante na sevante nāśrayanti hariṃ sataḥ |
yatante nāpi cātmārthe te hareraparādhinaḥ ||73||
āgaskṛtasta evātra kartavyaṃ nācaranti ye |
mānavatvaṃ vyarthayanti na smaranti hariṃ prabhum ||74||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ sevanaṃ na guroḥ prasannatāṃ na ca |
pitrorāśīrvacanaṃ na prāptāste nārakā dhruvāḥ ||75||
api candrasamaṃ tvāsyaṃ vāṇī miṣṭā sudhāsamā |
dehaḥ svarṇasamaścāpi kṛṣṇaśūnyāstu te yadi ||76||
tadā te nirayā bodhyā doṣākarāghakośakāḥ |
sarve kākāṃgarūpāste nikṛṣṭā narakapradāḥ ||77||
kākaśabdaḥ sārthako naścādya samyag vyajāyata |
kaṃ sukhaṃ tadbhinnameva duḥkhamakaṃ samucyate ||78||
kutsitaṃ tu kṛtaṃ duḥkhamadya prasādasevanāt |
kākāstena vayaṃ tvadya sukhārthino’ghavarjitāḥ ||79||
kā śaktirbrahmaṇaḥ proktā rādhā lakṣmīḥ satī prabhā |
tayā kaṃ sukhamastyeṣāṃ kākā vayaṃ sukhāśrayāḥ ||4.69.80||
kā kāyā pṛthivī tatra kaṃ sukhaṃ cātra vartate |
asmākaṃ kākavācyatvaṃ sukhitvaṃ ghaṭate’dya vai ||8 1||
ityeva badrike kākā vārtā kurvanti vai mithaḥ |
tāṃ śṛṇvanti janāsteṣāṃ darśakāḥ smayasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||82||
janāstān śvetavarṇāstu papracchuḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śubhān |
kathaṃ kākā bhavanto’tra pūrvaṃ ke ke tataḥ param ||83||
kākastvekaścāgragaṇya uvāca mānavān prati |
vayamāsva kaṃkavarṇāḥ kaṃkāḥ pūrve hi mānavāḥ ||84||
luṇṭakā malināhārāḥ paradārapradharṣakāḥ |
paradravyaharāścāpi parānnabhojakāstathā ||85||
khadiragrāmavāsāśca madyamāṃsaparāyaṇāḥ |
ekadā pūrvanārāyāḥ saritaḥ sannidhau vane ||86||
prayāntaṃ śreṣṭhinaṃ prāpya samācarāma luṇṭanam |
śreṣṭhī lakṣeṇa sahito nāṇakena praluṇṭitaḥ ||87||
tāvad yadṛcchayā tatrāyayuścānye praluṇṭakāḥ |
pañcāśat te parijñāya vṛttāntaṃ vaṇijo drutam ||88||
luṇṭituṃ naḥ samāyātā yuddhaṃ mitho’bhavat tadā |
mṛtāḥ parasparaṃ sarve śastrairyāmyapuraṃ gatāḥ ||89||
kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvaiḥ phalaṃ bhuktaṃ tu kuṇḍajam |
yāmyapāśānnirgatāśca dvipino’raṇyavāsinaḥ ||4.69.90||
hiṃsakāḥ smo vayaṃ jātā vṛkā jātāstataḥ param |
mārjārāśca tato jātāstataḥ kākāstu sāmpratam ||91 ||
atra prāptaṃ prasādasyocchiṣṭaṃ hareḥ satāṃ tathā |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhaṃ sarvaṃ sarvapātakanāśakam ||92||
pātakāni samastāni naṣṭānyucchiṣṭabhojanāt |
śvetā idānīṃ jātāḥ smaḥ puṇyavantaḥ surā yathā ||93||
yadi labhema sākṣācchrīvyāsahastajalaṃ tviha |
devā bhūtvā prayāsyāmo divaṃ tūrṇaṃ sukhāśrayam ||94||
pratīkṣāmo jalaṃ tasyāmṛtaṃ taṃ sūcayantu vai |
śrutvā lokā vyāsasaudhamāgatya tamudantakam |||95||
kathayāmāsurīśaṃ taṃ svataḥprakāśakāyanam |
vyāsastūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasādavāri ca ||96||
nītvā yayau tu tān sarvān vāriṇā so’bhyaṣecayat |
prabhonārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti kīrtayan ||97||
tāvatte badrike sarve tyaktadehāstadābhavan |
pītvā jalakaṇān spṛṣṭvā jalabindūn drutaṃ surāḥ ||98||
suratulyā divyarūpā sañjātā divyamūrtayaḥ |
mantramayācan vyāsātte prapūjya caraṇau tataḥ ||99||
vyāsadevo dadau mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ dadau tadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 4.69.10 0||
prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho |
jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho ||10 1||
prāpya mantraṃ prāpya dhunyaṃ labdhvā pādāmṛtaṃ tathā |
labdhvā kṛpāṃ prāpya cāśīrvādān vyāsasya te surāḥ || 10 2||
caturbhujāḥ sma sañjātā muktā vaikuṇṭhayoginaḥ |
natvā yayuste sahasā divyā ambaravartmanā || 10 3||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhagavaddhāma nārāyaṇavimānagāḥ |
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyātithau madhyānhakottaram || 1 04||
prāptā vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ te sādhuprasādabhojinaḥ |
evaṃ śrībadrike teṣāṃ muktistatrābhavattadā || 1 05||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt pāpanāśanam |
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi kṛṣṇaprāptiḥ śubhā bhavet || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇādinā purā sārthavāṭajātīnāṃ daśakapotānāṃ, tathā purā kaṃkajātīnāṃ śatakākapakṣiṇāṃ, sādhoḥ kṛpādibhiścocchiṣṭabhojanena ca mokṣaṇamityādi nirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 69 ||

<4.70>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ mokṣakarīṃ tathā |
gṛhagodhābhavat tatra kathāmaṇḍapabhittigā || 1 ||
dūtī sā tvabhavat pūrvaṃ bhāṇavāṇīsahāyinī |
dineśvaryā mahārājñyāḥ kṛpāpātraṃ kriyākarī || 2 ||
jātyā khavāsinī nārī kuśalā svārthasādhane |
parārthacintāśūnyā ca dhūrteva śāṭhyaśālinī || 3 ||
rājñyā ādeśakartryeva tadanyājñāvamāninī |
rājñyāḥ sahacarī nityaṃ rājñyagre dīnakiṃkarī || 4 ||
tadānyāgre siṃhikeva vartamānā balādhikā |
adhṛṣyā bhṛtyavargasya varcasvinī tu sarvathā || 5 ||
pracchannasvārthakuśalā pracchannadravyasaṃgrahā |
krayavikrayavārtāyāṃ dānādau dharmakarmasu || 6 ||
rājñyā pradattadhanataścauryavṛttyā pratāriṇī |
dhananiṣkāsane nityaṃ kuśalā śāṭhyadharmiṇī || 7 ||
nityamevaṃ dattadhanānniṣkāsya svaṃ karoti sā |
tena pāpena sā dūtī nāmnā nāṇakinī mṛtā || 8 ||
yayau yāmyapuraṃ tatra kuṃbhīpāke gatā tataḥ |
niṣkāsitā tu janmārthaṃ gṛhagodhābhavaddhi sā || 9 ||
kathāyā maṇḍape dīpasannidhau jantubhakṣiṇī |
bhittibhāge toraṇasthāvasad bhītivivarjitā || 4.70.1 0||
nityaṃ khādati kīṭām̐śca makṣikā bhittisaṃgatāḥ |
divāniśaṃ toraṇe’pi viśrāntiṃ labhate mudā || 11 ||
athaikadā sā tvaritā kathāmaṇḍapikopari |
āgatya saṃsthitā śrīmatsaṃhitāyā vitānake || 12||
gṛhṇātyājyadīpadhūmaṃ sugandhi dhūpamuttamam |
puṣpapallavapatrāṇāṃ śaityaṃ śītajalodbhavam || 1 3||
pūjāvaśiṣṭasalilaṃ patrapuṣpādiṣu sthitam |
bindvātmakaṃ svedarūpaṃ pibatyapi sutṛptidam || 14||
guḍaṃ ca śarkarāṃ miṣṭamannaṃ pūjārthamarpitam |
jihvayā rasalubdhā sā lihatyātṛptidaṃ sukham || 15||
evaṃ prasādamāsādya jātā pāpavivarjitā |
jātismarā ca sā jātā smṛtvā smṛtvā ca duḥkhitā || 16||
śūhagodhāvapustyaktumīhamānā virāgiṇī |
abhavat tvaritā badri nimittasyābhikāṃkṣiṇī || 17||
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyādine prātaḥ kathāsane |
pūjanārthaṃ saṃhitāyā lomaśaḥ samupāyayau ||18||
dineśvarī rāyaharistathānye’pi samāyayuḥ |
candreśvarī koṭirāyastatharṣisādhavo dvijāḥ || 19||
sahasraśo janāścāpi darśanaśravaṇārthinaḥ |
sabhāmaṇḍapamāsādya tasthuryathocitaṃ tadā ||4.70.20||
pūjāmārārtrikaṃ cakre lomaśaḥ pustakasya ha |
vyāsapūjāṃ pracakre’pi patrapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||21||
śaṃkhajalena ca nīrājanaṃ vyāvartayat tridhā |
śaṃkhajalaṃ tu cikṣepa lomaśaḥ parito’pi ca ||22||
prasādabindulābhārthaṃ sarveṣāmākṣipanmuniḥ |
dakṣakarāñjalau vāri dhṛtvā dhṛtvordhvavartinā || 23||
bhramatā svakareṇaiva vāri cikṣepa cābhitaḥ |
gṛhagodhāpi sā vārispṛśābhavad vitānake ||24||
apibajjalabinduṃ sā lomaśasya karojjhitam |
tūrṇaṃ sā gatapāpā ca dagdhakalmaṣavāsanā ||25||
śuddhātmā sādhuvṛttirvai jātā prakṣīṇajīvanā |
mūrchāmāsādya bhūbhāge saṃhitāgre’pataddhi sā ||26||
gṛhagodhāśarīrāttu nirgatā divyakanyakā |
pūrvarūpānurūpā sābhavad yathā khavāsinī ||27||
tatsarūpāpi divyābhā divyasvarṇātisundarī |
ṣoḍaśavatsarā bālā devakanyeva cāparā ||28||
sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃśobhadvigrahā suvibhūṣitā |
tejaḥparidhiyuktā sā vyadyotata sabhāntare ||29||
aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ badrike ca kṛpālutā |
lohāt svarṇaṃ kaṃkarācca hīrakaṃ mauktikaṃ jhaṣāt ||4.70.30||
ratnaṃ kṣiteḥ sutaṃ vīryānmokṣamucchiṣṭabhakṣaṇāt |
jantordevaṃ paśormuktaṃ jīvācchivaṃ karoti saḥ ||3 1||
badrike gṛhagodhāṃ tāṃ mṛtāṃ tu surakanyakām |
cakṣuṣāṃ gocarāṃ sarvatejaākarṣiṇīṃ śubhām ||32||
vīkṣya nāryo narāstatra lakṣaśo vismayaṃ gatāḥ |
svaprakāśo hi bhagavān puṣpahāraṃ dadau gale ||33||
lomaśastilakaṃ tasyā bhālamadhye cakāra ha |
candrakaṃ kuṃkumenāpi pracakāra sa lomaśaḥ ||34||
pṛṣṭavām̐stāṃ lomaśo vai kā tvaṃ purādhunāpi ca |
kamalā vā satī bhaktiḥ sāvitrī kāsi kanyake ||35||
devatā vā saṃhitā vā gṛhagodhotthavigrahā |
kā tvaṃ kalyāṇasaṃsthānā vada sandehanāśini ||36||
pṛṣṭaivaṃ sā badrike saṃjagāda śṛṇvatāṃ satām |
sabhājanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā ||37||
namo vo’stu samastebhyo vyāsāya te namo’stu ca |
śrīsaṃhitāsvarūpāyai lakṣmyai devyai namo namaḥ ||38||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyātra kṛṣṇakāntāya vai namaḥ |
lomaśāya gurave ca mokṣadāya namo namaḥ ||39||
sarvarṣibhyaśca sādhubhyaḥ sādhvībhyaśca namo namaḥ |
namo mātre mahārājñyai mahārājāya vai namaḥ ||4.70.40||
vaiṣṇavebhyaḥ samastebhyaḥ kathāśrotṛbhya oṃ namaḥ |
namo maṇḍapadevebhyo devībhyaśca namo namaḥ ||41||
muktamuktānikābhyaśca sarvebhyaśca namo namaḥ |
kṣamadhvaṃ cāparādhānme doṣān kṣamadhvamīśvarāḥ ||42||
sādhavaḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve rājā rājñī ca vaiṣṇavāḥ |
sakhījanāḥ sakhāyaśca kṣamadhvaṃ me’parādhakān ||43||
ahaṃ nāṇakinīnāmnī khavāsinī purābhavam |
bhāṇavāṇīsakhī rājñyā dineśvaryāśca kiṃkarī ||44||
svārthaparā stainyaparā dharmadhanāvacorikā |
sāhaṃ mṛtā yāmyadūtairnītā yāmyapuraṃ tataḥ ||45||
bhuktvā pāpaphalaṃ tasmājjanmārthaṃ tviha cāgatā |
gṛhagodhā karmavaśājjātāvaśeṣabhoginī ||46||
pūjāvārispṛṣṭadehā mṛtātra kṛpayā muneḥ |
prasādāśanato naṣṭā vāsanā mama sarvathā ||47||
bahupuṇyāsmi sañjātā kathāyāḥ śravaṇādiha |
divyā devyasmi sañjātā kṛpayā lomaśasya ca ||48||
mokṣamicchāmi gantuṃ vai necchāmi svargamityapi |
mahyaṃ mantraṃ hareścāpi nāmadhunyaṃ prapattidam ||49||
lomaśo’yaṃ dadātvatra yena yāmi parākṣaram |
namāmi pādayorvaśca kiṃkarī devikāsmi ca ||4.70.50||
uktvaivaṃ badrike sā tu cakāra daṇḍavad bhuvi |
dhūliṃ ghṛṣṭvā śarīre sve cikṣepa ca prasādajām |||51||
aluṭhat pañcavāraṃ sā pṛthvyāṃ luṇṭhaccharīriṇī |
utthāya sahasā śrīmallomaśānmantramādadhe ||52||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīkṛṣṇa hare prabho ||13||
jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho |
evaṃ dhunyaṃ dadau tasmai lomaśaḥ sāpi jagṛhe ||54||
prasannahṛdayā śāntā jātā sā brahmarūpiṇī |
brāhmī śaktirhareḥ śaktirmuktānikābhavaddhi sā ||55||
oṃ namaḥ kamalāyai me mātre lakṣmyai namo namaḥ |
ityevaṃ sā nāmadhunyaṃ svayaṃ cakre samutsukā ||56||
tāvad vyomnā vimānaṃ tu lakṣmīnārāyaṇānvitam |
avātarattu sahasā maṇḍapasya samīpataḥ ||57||
jayanādā vaiṣṇavānāṃ pūjāyuktāstadābhavan |
nārāyaṇena kṛṣṇena lakṣmyā kamalayā tadā ||58||
āhūtā kanyake nāṇakinītyevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
sāpi sarvānnamaskṛtyoḍḍīya vimānamāyayau ||59||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tāṃ tu nītvākṣaraṃ yayau hariḥ |
ityevaṃ badrike dūtī gṛhagodhāpi devatā ||4.70.60||
muktānikā kṛpāyogād bhūtvākṣaraṃ yayau tadā |
kiṃ vacmyatra camatkārān kathāprasaṃgajān bahūn ||61 ||
makṣikā matsarāḥ kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca pipīlikāḥ |
jantavo’pyakṣaraṃ yānti prasādocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ ||62||
athāpyanyā kathāṃ badri camatkārānvitāṃ tava |
kathayāmi mūṣakāṇāṃ mokṣadāṃ pāvanīṃ parām ||63||
pūrvanārānadītīre grāme bhāgalake’vasat |
saṃghavāṭābhidhaḥ śūdraḥ śastradhārī balī tathā ||64||
dhanurdhārī gadādhārī saṃgarajñaḥ kalālayaḥ |
prasiddhaḥ saṃgare yuddhe vijaye parabhīpradaḥ ||65||
tathāpi tu svabhāvena cauryaṃ rātrau karotyapi |
annānāṃ kṣetrasasyānāṃ kvacittu paśudehinām ||66||
ekadā saṃghaśo bhūtvā vrīhīṇāṃ dīrghabhūmiṣu |
cauryārthaṃ pākayuktānāṃ rātrau kṣetreṣu so’gamat ||67||
vrīhīṇāṃ sañcayān bhṛtvānassu yāvat pragacchati |
tāvat kṣetrapatiḥ śastrasampannaḥ saṃghaśo’pi saḥ ||68||
samāyayau rakṣaṇārthaṃ tayoryuddhamabhūttadā |
saṃghavāṭo hatastatra khaḍgasya tīkṣṇadhārayā ||69||
parasparaṃ hatāścānye caurāśca svāmino’pi ca |
mṛtāste karmabhogārthaṃ yāmyaṃ puraṃ yayustataḥ ||4.70.70||
anubhūya kṛtānāṃ tu bhogān duḥkhāni sarvathā |
janma prāptā mayūrāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ tataḥ param ||71 ||
tittirāṇāṃ tataścāpi ghūkānāṃ ca tataḥ param |
mūṣakāṇāṃ tato janma labdhavanto’tiduḥkhadam ||72||
kathāmaṇḍapasānnidhye utkarābhikṣitau ca te |
stabakānāṃ samūheṣu tṛṇaghāsādiṣu sthitāḥ ||73||
bilavāsāstṛṇaghāsasasyakaṇādino’bhavan |
te vaiśākhāsitapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ kathottaram ||74||
mūṣakā dvātriṃśadeva prasādocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ |
nityabhojanapūtāśca kathāsthalaṃ niśāmukhe ||75||
ārārtrikottaraṃ yadṛcchayāyayurhi maṇḍape |
saṃhitāpaṭṭikāmūle cāyayuḥ prasamutsukāḥ ||76||
prasādasya kaṇām̐statra yavasasyāni yāni ca |
godhūmasyāpi sasyāni komalāni navānyapi ||77||
prācīnāni kaṇiśāni labdhavanto hi sadrasān |
miṣṭānnakhaṇḍakām̐ścāpi prasādarūpiṇastadā ||78||
bhuktavantaśca te tatra ramamāṇā itastataḥ |
sarvathā pāvanā jātāḥ sarvakṣapitavāsanāḥ ||79||
niṣkalmaṣāḥ śuddhabhāvāḥ śuddhātmānaḥ surā yathā |
drutaṃ te mūṣakadehām̐styaktvā vai maṇḍapāntare ||4.70.80||
sudivyā devavajjātā devā devyaśca śobhanāḥ |
sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣāśca bhāsamānāḥ prabhāviṇaḥ ||81 ||
tuṣṭuvuḥ paramātmānaṃ saṃhitāsthaṃ hariṃ prabhum |
namo mokṣapradānāṃ tu satāṃ lakṣyaikabindave ||82||
muktānāṃ dhyānalakṣyāya sarvāvatāriṇe namaḥ |
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇādisvāmine paramātmane ||83||
bālakṛṣṇāya kāntāya sarvakāntāya rakṣiṇe |
śrīśāya kamaleśāya rādheśāya vihāriṇe ||84||
namo devādhivāsāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ |
namo’nādinidhanāya mokṣadātre kṛpālave ||841||
namaḥ śrīlomaśāyāpi sadbhyaścāpi namo namaḥ |
namo vyāsāya divyāya svayamprakāśine namaḥ ||86||
namaḥ padmāvatīlakṣmīprajñābhūpataye namaḥ |
namastasmai hṛdisthāya dhāmasthāya ca te namaḥ ||87||
prasādāya namaścāpi maṇḍapāya ca vai namaḥ |
namo maṇḍapadevebhyo namaḥ śravaṇibhyastathā ||88||
tārakebhyaḥ pāvakebhyaḥ sadbhyaḥ sadā namo namaḥ |
sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca vaiṣṇavebhyo namo namaḥ ||89||
vayaṃ pāpāḥ prasādenoddhṛtā yadṛcchayā tviha |
kṛpayā divyatāṃ prāptāḥ satāṃ darśanatastathā ||4.70.90||
jātismarāḥ sma sañjātāḥ kathāsthānaprabhāvataḥ |
punarjanma na cecchāmaścecchāmaḥ śāśvatākṣaram ||91||
svaprakāśo hi bhagavān dadātu mantramuttamam |
nāmadhunyaṃ pradadātu yena yāsyāma uttamam ||92||
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma parameśvararājitam |
ityevaṃ badrike te samprārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||93||
svaprakāśo hi bhagavān dadau tebhyo manuṃ tadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||94||
prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho |
jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho ||95||
dhunyaṃ dadau tadā tebhyaste’pi cakruḥ prakīrtanam |
ekatānā abhavam̐śca śrīkṛṣṇevallabhe prabhau ||96||
tāvacchrīlalitāsvāmī badrīnāthaḥ samāyayau |
māṇikyāpadmajāprajñopetaḥ kṛṣṇo’tivallabhaḥ ||97||
rādhālakṣmīyutaścāpi vimānavarasaṃsthitaḥ |
tānsarvānpārṣadān muktān kṛtvā muktānikāstathā ||98||
vimāne tānupāgṛhya paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām |
jayanādaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīharirnināya cākṣaram ||99||
mahāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ prasādanam |
kṛpāṃ hareḥ praśaśaṃsurmantrabalaṃ ca kīrtanam || 4.70.10 0||
bhaktiṃ sevāṃ kathāṃ cāpi praśaśaṃsurhi mokṣaṇam |
dhanyavādāndaduścāpi bhūmaye maṇḍapāya ca || 101 ||
muktiṃ gatebhyaḥ sarvebhyo dhanyavādāndadurjanāḥ |
evaṃ badrīpriye muktiṃ gatāste mūṣakāstadā || 1 02||
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyādine vimānasaṃsthitāḥ |
na svargaṃ sampadasteṣāṃ bandhanāya tadābhavat || 1 03||
kṛpaikā paramo heturgamane cākṣaraṃ prati |
yayāgatya svayaṃ kṛṣṇo nayatyevākṣaraṃ nijān || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇaprasādabhojanajalaprokṣaṇādibhiḥ pūrvajanmani nāṇakinīkhavāsinyāḥ paścād gṛhagodhāyāḥ tathā pūrvajanmani saṃghavāṭādidvātriṃśacchūdrāṇāṃ paścānmūṣakāṇāṃ ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||

<4.71>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ nakulamokṣadām |
prasādocchiṣṭasampanne cotkare tu bubhukṣitaḥ || 1 ||
nakulaḥ kaścidāyātaḥ kathāmaṇḍapasannidhau |
bhuktavān sa tadocchiṣṭaṃ satāṃ prasādamiśritam || 2 ||
tāvat sa mūrchitastatra tatyāja nijavigraham |
devasvarūpaḥ sañjāto vaiśākhapañcamīdine || 3 ||
śuklapakṣe tadā sarvairdṛṣṭaḥ surottamaḥ sa tu |
pṛṣṭaścovāca vṛttāntaṃ naijaṃ pūrvabhavasya tu || 4 ||
śṛṇvantu vaiṣṇavā lokā acchodarapure purā |
ahamāsaṃ jñānivaryo vāruṭaḥ sāgarābhidhaḥ || 5 ||
lokāḥ sāgaradāneti vidurmāṃ jñānināmbaram |
itihāsakathābhijñaṃ samāhūya nijālayān || 6 ||
kārayanti kathākhyānaṃ śṛṇvanti mānavāstadā |
pūjayanti prasannāste’rpayanti me dhanādikam || 7 ||
ahaṃ tṛpto dhanaṃ labdhvā prayāmi sma svamandiram |
kathāsu dānavārtāṃ vai karomi pūrvabhūbhṛtām || 8 ||
dharmavārtāṃ gavāṃ sevāṃ pitṛsevāṃ vadāmi ca |
tīrthasevāṃ vratarakṣāṃ devapūjāṃ samutsavān || 9 ||
niyamām̐śca yamām̐ścāpi janānupadiśāmi ca |
snānadharmādikaṃ sarvaṃ copadiśāmi sarvathā || 4.71.1 0||
nāhaṃ kiṃcinmanāg vāpi pālayāmi tu tattathā |
mṛṣāvādī miṣṭavādī svārthasiddhiparāyaṇaḥ || 1 1||
duṣṭātmāhaṃ dhanadhūrto dhanaṃ harāmi vārtayā |
na dharmaṃ na niyamaṃ yamaṃ vrataṃ karomyapi ||12||
āsīt sarvaṃ vacane me na kriyāyāṃ tu kiñcana |
ācārahīnaḥ satataṃ tadābhavaṃ pratārakaḥ || 1 3||
gavāṃ pitroḥ surāṇāṃ ca sevayā hīna ityapi |
abhavaṃ sarvathā āryā asatpralāpagarjanaḥ || 14||
tena pāpena me vidyā kuvidyā samajāyata |
vyākhyānāni samastāni śāṭhyapāpaphalāni ca || 15||
vākchalairgrathitānyeva pāpadāni mamābhavan |
evaṃ pāpātibhāreṇa naṣṭāyuṣyo mṛto’bhavam || 16||
yāmyapuraṃ gatastatra yāmyaiḥ saṃdaṃśakuṇḍake |
kṣipto jihvā kartitā me bahiḥ kṛṣṭā cipīṭakaiḥ || 17||
saṃdaṃśaistīkṣṇadhāraiśca niṣkāsitā muhurmuhuḥ |
bheditā cheditā cāpi prajvālitā ca kūrcitā || 18||
vidāritā kaccaritā tanurme kardamīkṛtā |
bahūni tatra kaṣṭāni bhuktvā nakulatāmiha || 1 9||
gato’smi kṣudhayā tvatrotkarocchiṣṭaṃ prajagdhivān |
tena naṣṭāni pāpāni mamāvaśeṣakāṇyapi ||4.71.20||
pūtātmā pūṇyavānasmi sañjāto’dya divaṃgamaḥ |
suro’smi cādya sampannaḥ prayāmi svargamuttamam ||2 1 ||
ityuktavān badrike sa neme sarvān suvaiṣṇavān |
atha tatra suraṃ taṃ tu jagāda lomaśo muniḥ ||22||
śṛṇu tvaṃ suravaryādya devatvaṃ gatavānapi |
maraṇaṃ te punaścāsti deve’mṛtatvamasti na ||23||
tasmāt sādhaya puṇyātmannamṛtatvaṃ tu śāśvatam |
apunarbhavasaṃjñaṃ ca brahmalokamanāmayam ||24||
śrutvetathaṃ lomaśaṃ so’pi papraccha kuśalaṃ dhruvam|
kathaṃ mune’mṛtadhāmaprāptiḥ syād vada me drutam ||25||
lomaśaḥ pratyuvācainaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇu sthiro bhava |
prasādaṃ śrīharerbhuṃkṣva naivedyaṃ haraye’rpitam ||26||
vrataṃ rakṣa satāṃ sevātmakaṃ bhaktiṃ kuru prabhau |
kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ samastaṃ vai vidhehi parameśvare ||27||
mantraṃ dhunyaṃ gṛhāṇāpi vaiṣṇavo bhava uttamaḥ |
mahābhāgavato bhūtvākṣaraṃ dhāma prayāsyasi ||28||
ityuktaśca tadā devasvarūpaḥ sa kathālaye |
devānāṃ maṇḍale divyarūpastatra tiro’bhavat || 29||
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrotuṃ devagaṇe sthiro’bhavat |
vrataṃ cakre prasādānnabhojanaṃ saptavāsarān ||4.71.30||
satāṃ sevāṃ mānavena svarūpeṇa karotyapi |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ dehamardanaṃ darśanādikam ||31 ||
vaiśākhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ prātaḥ kathāśravottaram |
lomaśaḥ kṛpayā tasmai mantraṃ dhunyaṃ dadau drutam ||32||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā |
prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho ||33||
jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho |
so’pi devo manuṃ labdhvā nāmadhunyaṃ cakāra ha ||34||
naivedyabhojanaṃ kṛtvā yāvad devagaṇe sthitaḥ |
akasmādāyayau tāvanmadhyāhne śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||35||
divyaśvetahayārūḍhaḥ śrīpatiḥ kamalāpatiḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpativallabhaḥ || 36||
taṃ netumāyayau pakṣiturage chatraśobhite |
āhvayāmāsa taṃ devaṃ bhagavān kambharātmajaḥ ||37||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ devaścāśvārūḍho babhūva ha |
nītvā taṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣaraṃ yayau ||38||
kṛpaiṣā śrīhareścāti lomaśasyāpi bhūyasī |
sāntamamarabhāvaṃ taṃ śāśvatāmaratāmitaḥ ||39||
nakulaḥ sakulaścāpi bhagavatkulavān kṛtaḥ |
badrike sā kathā cātra prabhūtā kathitā parā ||4.71.40 ||
athānyaṃ te pravadāmi camatkāraṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ |
bhāṭaḥ kaścitkathāṃ śrotuṃ samāyātaḥ kathāsthalam ||41 ||
nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃjapan |
ślokaṃ kṛtvā stutiṃ cakre saṃhitāyāḥ sabhāsthale ||42||
kathā kalyāṇadā ceyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇāpradaḥ |
kīratārābhidho bhāṭaḥ śreyase’ta upāgataḥ ||43||
namo vyāsāya kṛṣṇāya saṃhitāyai namo muhuḥ |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ sabhāyai ca lomaśāya namo muhuḥ ||44||
namaḥ sadbhyo maharṣibhyaḥ sādhvībhyaśca namo muhuḥ |
pāvanebhyo’tra devebhyaḥ sarvebhyaśca namo muhuḥ ||45||
śrūyante bahavaḥ pāpāstāritāḥ kṛpayā khalāḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenātra kīratāraṃ samuddhara ||46||
hṛdaye vartate yaśca vyāse ca pustake’pi yaḥ |
sadasyeṣu ca bhāṭe yaḥ sa māmuddharatu prabhuḥ ||47||
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante prāpto’smi parameśvaram |
śaraṇyaḥ sa harirbhāṭaṃ prapannaṃ pātu pāmaram ||48||
prāptamadya mayā svarṇaṃ ratnaṃ pīyūṣamamṛtam |
pītvā pītvā dṛḍho bhūtvā prayāsyāmi paraṃ padam ||49||
uddhartānādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabheśvaraḥ |
paraṃ dhāma prayāsyāmi mantradhunyādilābhavān ||4.71.50||
evaṃ tuṣṭāva ca namaścovāca daṇḍavattathā |
cakre svātmārpaṇaṃ tatra dhūliṃ dehe’pyagharṣayat ||51 ||
atha śrīvyāsadevaśca svataḥprakāśakāyanaḥ |
dadāvasmai manuṃ nāmadhunyaṃ salilasākṣikam ||52||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho ||53||
jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho |
bālakaṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi ||54||
tanno hṛtsthaḥ pracodayāditi mantraṃ ca jagṛhe |
bhāṭaḥ pavitratāṃ prāpto’bhavad vigatakalmaṣaḥ ||55||
badrike sa prasādaṃ ca jagdhvā pītvā padāmṛtam |
dadhāra taulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ cakre tilakacandrakau ||56||
dhunyaṃ cakre mudā nṛtyan kathāṃ śuśrāva līnavat |
brahmarasaṃ papau nityaṃ sādhusevāṃ cakāra ca ||57||
māsamātraṃ sthitastvevaṃ bhajan śrīkāntavallabham |
kathārthāṃścintayan dhyāyan hṛdaye parameśvaram ||58||
gopālanandanaṃ divyaṃ dhārayan kambharātmajam |
vaiśākhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ muktasaṃsārabandhanaḥ ||59||
kīratāraḥ kathāṃ śrūtvā samādhiṃ prāpa maṇḍape |
yāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ kṛṣṇaśobhitam ||4.71.60||
divyaṃ tejāṃsi paritaḥ prāsṛjat svarṇakāntimat |
kīratāro’bhavanmuktastadā vai divyavigrahaḥ ||6 1||
caturbhujaḥ surūpaśca pārṣadaḥ paramātmanaḥ |
svarṇakuṇḍalamukuṭasragāpīḍādibhūṣitaḥ ||62||
āruroha vimānaṃ tat samāhūto dayālunā |
paśyatāṃ tu sadasyānāṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||63||
śṛṇu badrīpriye cātra kṛpaiva kāraṇaṃ hareḥ |
ya icchati mokṣaṃ taṃ drutaṃ nayati mādhavaḥ ||64||
śāśvatānandalabdhestu sādhanaṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ |
tavāsmīti yācakāya sa dadāti paraṃ padam ||65||
dehī divyo bhavatyeva prārabdhaṃ parivartate |
kṛṣṇamandiravāsārho jāyate kṛpayā hareḥ ||66||
naro muktaḥ pārṣadaḥ syānnārī lakṣmīḥ prajāyate |
kṛṣṇena saha ramate’śnute kṛṣṇasya sadrasān ||67||
na nyūnaṃ vidyate tasya tādātmyadravatāṃ labhet |
svāmināthāt sarvakāmān bhuṃkte kṛṣṇāsanāsanaḥ ||68||
sparśānandān samastām̐śca kṛṣṇamāliṅgya so’śnute |
rūpānandān rasānandān jihvāsvādān samastakān ||69||
gandhānandān girānandān samastāśleṣamodakān |
śayyānandān samastām̐śca kṛṣṇakāntāt samaśnute ||4.71.70||
kvaciddhāmni nijaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ rahaḥ prasevate |
kvacid ramyāṇi puṣpāṇi bhūtvā gandhaiḥ prasevate ||71 ||
kvacit phalaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvā kṛṣṇaṃ rasena sevate |
kvacidbhūtvā kāmadhenuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dugdhena sevate ||72||
kvacidbhūtvā ramā rāmaṃ vakṣasyārāmamicchati |
kvacicchrīmāṇikī bhūtvā vahate kāntamuttamam ||73||
kvacid bhramarikā bhūtvā kṛṣṇagandhaṃ samaśnute |
kvacid rādhā sakhī bhūtvā tāmbūlaṃ pradadātyapi ||74||
bhūtvā lakṣmīrhareroṣṭhatāmbūlarasameti ca |
āndhasikī kvacid bhūtvā pācayatyasya bhojanam ||75||
dāsī bhūtvāplavanaṃ sā kārayatyacyutasya vai |
dehasaṃvāhanaṃ dāso bhūtvā karoti sevanam ||76||
yaṣṭiḥ svarṇamayī bhūtvā karasparśaṃ suvindati |
naktakaśca kvacid bhūtvā mukhasparśaṃ pravindati ||77||
