pādukārūpamāsādya pādacūmbanamṛcchati |
ādarśarūpamāsādya kṛṣṇaṃ svasmin dadhātyapi ||78||
gendukatāṃ samāsādya kṛṣṇapṛṣṭhaṃ dadhātyapi |
kuṃkumaṃ candanaṃ bhūtvā bhālasukhaṃ pravindati ||79||
kajjalaṃ ca kvacid bhūtvā netrasparśaṃ pravindati |
dugdhaṃ dugdhāmṛtaṃ bhūtvā jaṭhare saṃviśatyapi ||4.71.80||
jalaṃ bhūtvā tathā dhautraṃ kaṭisparśaṃ ca vindati |
tailaṃ bhūtvā romamūlasparśasukhaṃ ca vindati ||81 ||
manobhavaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā kṛṣṇānandaṃ samaśnute |
rādhā bhūtvāsya ramate yānaṃ bhūtvā vahatyapi ||82||
siṃhāsanaṃ kvacid bhūtvā rājate svāmināśritam |
kambalaśca kvacid bhūtvā paritaḥ sevate harim ||83||
sugandhipavano bhūtvā sevate śītalo’pi san |
ūrmikā vāṃgarakṣaṃ ca bhūtvāṅguliṃ ca varṣma ca ||84||
kaustubho raśanā bhūtvā vakṣaḥ kaṭiṃ ca sevate |
bhuktipātraṃ kvacid bhūtvā prasādaṃ sarvamaśnute ||85||
snānakuṇḍaṃ kvacid bhūtvā sparśaṃ vindati sarvataḥ |
kvacit kāntā pramā bhūtvā kāntamāśliṣyati prabhum ||86||
kvacittu garuḍo hastī bhūtvā vājī vimānakam |
vāhanaṃ narayānādi bhūtvā dhārayati prabhum ||87||
kvacit pāśaṃvatī bhūtvā sarvasevāṃ karoti hi |
muktā muktānikā premṇāstuvate harijaṃ rasam ||88||
badri dhāmnyakṣare premṇā muktāḥ pibanti tadrasam |
goloke gopikā gopā pibanti kṛṣṇajaṃ rasam ||89||
vaikuṇṭhe pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaḥ pibanti tadrasam |
avyākṛte’mṛte dhāmni śrīpure badarīvane ||4.71.90||
śvetadvīpe kṣīravārdhau pibanti sevino rasam |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ ||9 1 ||
pibantyanādikṛṣṇasya rasaṃ rādhāramāśriyaḥ |
jayā ca lalitā lakṣmīḥ mālatī māṇikī priyā ||92||
padmāvatī sukhadāśrīrnārāyaṇī ca bhārgavī |
tulasī padminī padmā pibanti tā hareḥ rasam ||93||
badarī ca vikuṇṭhā ca muktiḥ śaktiḥ sarasvatī |
tā etāḥ śrīkṛṣṇakāntarasaṃ pibanti śāśvatam ||94||
sanakādyāḥ sādhavaśca nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ |
vyāsādyāḥ śaṃsakāścāpi kārṣṇaṃ rasaṃ pibanti hi ||95||
balirājādayo daityā vibhīṣaṇādirākṣasāḥ |
īśvarāḥ śaṃkarādyāśca pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam ||96||
agnyādayo devatāśca kāśyapā garuḍādayaḥ |
mānavā dhruvamukhyāśca pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam ||97||
bhoginaḥ śeṣasarpādyā gāvastu kāmadhenavaḥ |
ātmanivedino bhaktāḥ pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam ||98||
badrike śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ sāmastyena samarpitāḥ |
dāsā dāsyaḥ priyavargāḥ pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam || 99||
ye ye dhāmākṣaraṃ prāptāḥ parabrahmarasaṃ tu te |
pibanti satataṃ badri parabrahmakṛpāśrayāḥ || 4.71.10 0||
kṛpayā ca gatau muktiṃ sāgaraḥ kīratārakaḥ |
pāṭhako vācakaḥ śrotā saṃhitāyā hi mokṣadāḥ || 10 1||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sāgaradānavāruṭasya kīratārabhāṭasya ca kathāśravaṇasādhusevādibhirmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 71 ||

<4.72>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ jyotirvidasya vai |
vikramanagare vipro nāmnā devamatīśvaraḥ || 1 ||
kulakuṭumbasahitaścāsīddharmavratādimān |
devasevāparaścāpi prajākalyāṇacintanaḥ || 2 ||
ātitheyaḥ śaraṇyaśca paraduḥkhaprabhañjanaḥ |
brahmakarmaparaścāpi jyotirvidyārdhapaṇḍitaḥ || 3 ||
badrike sarvalokeṣu cārdhajñaḥ sarvakarmasu |
na pāraṃ nirṇayaṃ yāti tato bhavati kleśabhāk || 4 ||
auṣadheṣu bhāgyavitsu jyotirvitsu kalāsu ca |
sarvathā pārago dīrghānubhavī ca bahuśrutaḥ || 5 ||
sādhaneṣvanukūleṣu dhruvaṃ phalaṃ samaśnute |
apāragastu yatnena daivānukūlavartmani || 6 | |
akasmāllabhate puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vā labhate kvacit |
prāyaśo na phalaṃ yāti viphalaṃ labhate sadā || 7 ||
asatyāḍambaradoṣairlipyate vijñagarvavān |
ardhadagdhena bhāvyaṃ na prāyaśaḥ kleśakāriṇā || 8 ||
ardhābhijño bhiṣaṅmadhya śatahiṃsottaraṃ varaḥ |
utkṛṣṭabhāvamāyāti hiṃsāpāpaśatānvitaḥ || 9 ||

<4.73>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi bandijanasya pāvanīm |
kathāṃ mokṣakarīṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastavānvitām || 1 ||
dveṣarāgajayanāmni nagare pāvanaḥ paraḥ |
bandijano’bhavannāmnā jayamānābhidhaḥ sukhī || 2 ||
kuṭumbasahitastatra vasamānaśca jīvikām |
bandiṃ suvandanaṃ rājñāṃ kṛtvā nirvahate sadā || 3 ||
dveṣarāgajaye grāme rājāsīd vajravikramaḥ |
bandipriyo hi bahudhā dānapriyastathottamaḥ || 4 ||
nityaṃ rātrau divā prātarbandistriyaśca bandinaḥ |
vandanāmiśritā gītīrgāyanti tasya sannidhau || 1 ||
viṣṇutulyamindratulyaṃ rudratulyaṃ śaśiprabham |
ravitulyaṃ cakravartitulyaṃ matvā narāḥ striyaḥ || 6 ||
kalpitāstatkathāḥ sarvā gāyanti supraśaṃsitāḥ |
jayamāno vandakastu nūtnaṃ nityaṃ pragāyati || 7 ||
prasanno’sya viśeṣeṇa jāyate vajravikramaḥ |
pāritoṣikamasmai sa svarṇamudrāṃ dadāti ca || 8 ||
jayamāno jayaṃ datvā natvā taṃ nṛpatiṃ gṛham |
nityaṃ prayāti muditaḥ kāvyaṃ nūtnaṃ karoti ca || 9 ||
dvitīye ca dine prātargatvā gāyati sannidhau |
evaṃ sadā karotyeva jīvikāṃ labhate sadā || 4.73.1 0||
athaikadā jayamāno jvareṇātīva pīḍitaḥ |
śeke gantuṃ na bhūpāgre bhūpaśca vihvalo’bhavat || 1 1||
pratīkṣamāṇastaṃ rājā na lebhe darśanaṃ kaveḥ |
utthāya sa yayau padbhyāṃ jayamānasya mandiram || 12||
jayamānaścakārāsya bhūpasya svāgatādikam |
āsanaṃ pradadāvupāviveśa nṛpatiḥ sa ca || 1 3||
pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalaṃ vīkṣya jvaritaṃ kavimuttamam |
bandino jvaraśāntyarthaṃ vaidyamāhūya cauṣadham || 14||
kārayāmāsa nṛpatistasyāgre tvavasannṛpaḥ |
muhūrtānte jvaro naṣṭo nīrugṇo jayamānakaḥ || 15||
nṛpaṃ bandipriyaṃ tatra vavande tanmano vidan |
aho rājan yathārthaṃ vai bhavato nāma vidyate || 1 6||
rājase devavalloke rakṣasi dyunivāsivat |
śobhase kṛṣṇavad viṣṇutulyo dadāsi sampadaḥ || 17||
dayāṃ karoṣi lakṣmīvannibhālayasi brahmavat |
āyāsi meghavad rājan śṛṇoṣi paramātmavat || 18||
prerayasi prabheśābhaḥ prajāṃ dharasi dharmavat |
sudhāṃśuvat poṣayasi prakāśase tu candravat| || 19||
sevase mātṛvad rājan sukhākaroṣi rātrivat |
pitṛvat pālayasi śrīsamo bhavasi bhūtale ||4.73.20 ||
kubero’nya ivābhāsi dhanadātā dhaneśvaraḥ |
suvarṇaṃ srāvayasyatra vahniḥtulyaḥ pratāpavān ||21||
śāsane dharmarājābho vibhāsi ca diśāṃpatiḥ |
yatra rājan vidyase tadvanaṃ prajāyate divam ||22|

saudho vaikuṇṭhāyate sa yatra bhramasi bhāgyavān |
yatra vasasi kṣaṇavat sthalaṃ mokṣāyate’pi tat ||24||
ājñāpayasi kṣmeśām̐śca sureśānīśvarānapi |

śrutaṃ rājan mayā tvadya śarkarānagare’dhunā ||26||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathā pravartate |

sarvaviṣṇuśivapūjyaḥ sarvabrahmābhivanditaḥ ||4.73.30||
sarvatīrthanivāsaśca prajñāpadmāvatīpatiḥ |
sarveśānaḥ sarvadehiniyantā sarvamokṣadaḥ ||31 ||
rādhājayāpatiḥ kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo hi gīyate |
rājan yathā sārvabhaumo bhagavān sa virājate ||32||
tathā virājate sārvabhaumo’nanyasamo bhuvi |
aho bhāgyaṃ paraṃ manye kṛṣṇavannṛpatirgṛhe ||33||
aho bhāgyaṃ paraṃ rājan sādhuvad vartase sadā |
mṛṣā mithyā vartase na satyavrataḥ pravartase ||34||
satyaṃ vadasi satyaṃ ca śṛṇoṣi vindase ṛtam |
satyaṃ brahma cintayasi mokṣe sthito’si sarvathā ||35||
kālakavalatāṃ prāptāḥ pūrvanṛpatayo’dhruvāḥ |
na tathā bhāsase rājan kālapāśātigo hyasi ||36||
mṛtyuḥ sarveṣu yaścāste sa nāsti vajravikrame |
vārdhakyaṃ yāmyakaṣṭāni na santi vajravikrame || 37||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyo vibhāsi me |
aho kṛṣṇa aho kṛṣṇa aho kṛṣṇa hare hare || 38||
aho rājannaho rājannaho rājan hare hare |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 29||
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa |
aho rājannaho kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāpate ||4.73.40||
aho viṣṇo aho śrīmadbālakṛṣṇa śriyaḥ pate |
aho bhāgyaṃ mama rājan kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare ||41 ||
aho bhāgyaṃ nṛpateśca kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare |
aho svāminnaho svāminnārāyaṇa jagatpate || 42||
aho yāminnaho yāminnārāyaṇa prabhopate |
aho kṛṣṇahare svāmin padmāvatīsatīpate ||43||
aho’kṣarapate svāmin badarīsuguṇāpate |
duḥkhahāśrīpate rādhāmaṃjulīmāṇikīpate ||44||
muktamuktānikāhaṃsāsvāmin jayādayāpate |
jayālalitākāntaśrīsarvadhāmapate pate ||45||
ātmamokṣapate lakṣmīsaṃhitākhyakathāpate |
māmuddhara kṛpāsindho vajravikramamuddhara ||46||
evaṃ brahmātmabhāvena jayamānastu vandakaḥ |
tuṣṭāva kaṃbharālālaṃ gopālatanujaṃ prabhum ||47||
nṛpatiṃ cāpi taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaikyabhāvataḥ |
rājā kṛṣṇābhidhāḥ śrutvā tūrṇaṃ niṣkalmaṣo’bhavat ||48||
ajñānaṃ vigataṃ rājño moho naṣṭo’bhavattadā |
naṣṭo rāgo nijaślāghāviṣayo viramo’bhavat ||49||
mithyābhimānanāśena prakāśo’sya vyajāyata |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇecchā ca darśanecchā harestathā ||4.73.50|||
kālamṛtyujarāvyādhināśecchā ca vyajāyata |
vairāgyaścābhavattasya nāśaśīlāccharīrataḥ ||51 ||
vivekaṃ prāptavān rājā śrutvā mṛṣāpraśaṃsanam |
aho’yaṃ jāyamāno me kurute yatpraśaṃsanam ||52||
tadaṃśo’pi mayi nāsti mayi śaktirna vidyate |
vidyate naiva bhaktiśca nārāyaṇabalaṃ na ca ||53||
kālapāśasya yogyo’haṃ mariṣyāmi kṣaṇāntare |
kīṭavadvartamāno’smi sṛṣṭau me gaṇanāsti na |||94||
nāhaṃ mṛtyuvihīno’smi kālasya kavalo’smyapi |
māyāyāṃ vartamāno’smi mokṣe naiva sthito’smi ca |||55|||
cintayāmi na cātmānaṃ na brahma na narāyaṇam |
na pālayāmi satyaṃ ca mithyāyāṃ saṃrato’smi ca ||96||
na varte’haṃ sādhuvacca kutastaraṃ tu kṛṣṇavat |
khaṇḍarājo’pi naivāsmi sārvabhaumaḥ kutastaraḥ |||57||
nājñāyāṃ mama deho’sti devādyāstu kutastarāḥ |
durguṇo’haṃ sadā cāsmi sadguṇastu kutastaraḥ ||58||
bāliśo’haṃ pramūrkho’haṃ mṛṣākīrtipriyo’smyaham |
māyājāle vicitto’haṃ pramattonmattavattathā |||55||
aho nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ smaryate na mayā hariḥ |
icchāmi bhavituṃ nārāyaṇatulyo mṛṣāśravaḥ ||4.73.60||
pāpaṃ karomi satataṃ pāpātmā kṛṣṇaśatruvat |
mahāpāpyatipāpātmā kārayāmi praśaṃsanam ||61||
nāsti pūgīphalaṃ haste vāñcchāmi śevadhīśatām |
nirmalaṃ hṛdayaṃ nāsti samicchāmi sureśatām || 32||
malinaṃ sarvathā varṣma manye śivādhikaṃ khalaḥ |
kīdṛśo’haṃ paśuśreṣṭho’dhamo mithyābhimānavān || 63 ||
dhanyo’yaṃ jayamāno hi bhakto’smi paramātmanaḥ |
mama mokṣakaraścāsmi guruścāpyasti me’dhunā || 64||
praśaṃsāmiṣato yenāhitaṃ jñānaṃ mayi dhruvam |
vivekaścāhitastena mṛṣāgarvavināśakṛt || 65||
smāritā devatāḥ sarvāḥ smāritaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
smāritā śrīsaṃhitāyāḥ kathā pāpavimocinī || 66||
avaśyaṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ gacchāmi tatkathāsthalam |
pāvanīṃ sādhutāṃ labdhvā kariṣye bhajanaṃ hareḥ || 67||
tariṣyāmi bhavābdhiṃ ca kariṣye svātmamokṣaṇam |
mṛṣāpāpaṃ kṣālayiṣye grahīṣye satyavartanam || 68 ||
nāmaśravaṇamātreṇa hṛdayaṃ pūtatāṃ gatam |
tatkathāśravaṇāt kiṃ kiṃ syānme śreya uttamam || 69 ||
jayamāno jayatveva me vivekaprado guruḥ |
vandakā vandinaḥ santu tādṛśā mokṣadarśakāḥ ||4.73.7 0 ||
ajñānahārakā santu na santu śaṃkhavādinaḥ |
mithyāgālaphaṭā mā ca santu santu ṛtaṃvadāḥ ||7 1 ||
vicāryetthaṃ nṛpaḥ prāha śiṣyavad bandinaṃ gurum |
aho vivekadānena tārito’haṃ tvayā gṛhe || 72||
praśaṃsā yā tvayā proktā śrutā mayātirāgiṇā |
śrutottaraṃ mama naṣṭo rāgastṛṣṇā layaṃ gatā |||73 ||
mṛṣā satyaṃ ca yattattvaṃ prakāśitaṃ tu me hṛdi |
dāso’smi te gurustvaṃ ca saṃsāroddhārakṛnmama ||74||
vada me kva haristvāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
kathā kva vartate lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃbhavā ||75 ||
śravaṇecchā vartate me mṛṣapāpaṃ vyapohitum |
mokṣecchā vartate bandin naya yatra kathāmṛtam || 76 ||
ityevaṃ vadatastasya nṛpaterdarśanaṃ hareḥ |
ajāyata prakāśe svahṛdaye paramātmanaḥ ||77||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastūrṇaṃ pradarśya rūpamātmanaḥ |
tirobhavaddhi hṛdye vṛttīrākarṣayan drutam ||78 ||
mūrtidarśanamātreṇa rājā paravaśo’bhavat |
nanarta bahudhā tatra dehabhānavivarjitaḥ ||79||
agāyata harikṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhum |
satālagālavādyena kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa hare hare ||4.73.8 0 ||
jayamāno’pi tenaiva sārdhaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhāt |
pramodasaṃbhṛtaścāpi rājñā saha nanarta ha || 81 ||
aho badrīpriye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai kṛpā |
kathākṛṣṇapraśaṃsābhiḥ kṛṣṇaścopasthito’bhavat ||8 2 ||
evaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ tau nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ pracakratuḥ |
tataḥ śāntau sukhānandabhṛtau virematuḥ kṣaṇam ||83 ||
parasparaṃ ca kathayāmāsatuḥ pārameśvaram |
darśanaṃ ca mahānandaṃ mahāsaubhāgyamātmanoḥ ||84||
śuśruvuścānyamanujā narā nāryastadā gṛhe |
āyātā ye mahāścaryaparā draṣṭaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ||85 ||
rājā bandī bandipatnī bandiputrāstathā striyaḥ |
putryaśca bāndhavāścāpi śarkarānagaraṃ prati ||86||
gantuṃ sajjā babhūvuste nṛpo rājñī ca tatsutāḥ |
putryo rājñyāstathā lokāḥ prajā nāryo narā api ||87||
sahasraśo mānavāste śarkarānagaraṃ prati |
gantuṃ sajjā babhūvuścāmātyapradhānakarmiṇaḥ | |88 ||
dāsyo dāsāḥ karmacārā bhaṭāḥ saṃrakṣakāstathā |
gajavāhanasaṃyuktā aśvavārāśca niryayuḥ ||89 ||
bahusvarṇaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ puṣkalaṃ saha jagṛhuḥ |
dānayogyāmbarapātrabhūṣākambalakānapi ||4.73.9 0 ||
sotsavā bahavo lokā halahaleti vādinaḥ |
niryayuste tīrthayātrākṛte kathāsthalīṃ prati || 91 ||
bhajanaṃ cakrire mārge mahodyānamupāyayuḥ |
kathāmaṇḍapasānnidhye sahasraśastu te janāḥ || 92||
mahodyāne nivāsāṃśca yathāyogyaṃ pracakrire |
snātvā tīrthajale devān prapūjya maṇḍapaṃ prati || 93 ||
yayuste pūjanaṃ cakruḥ saṃhitāyāḥ kathottare |
vyāsasya pūjanaṃ cakrurlomaśasya satāṃ tathā || 94||
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruścopadā nyadhuḥ purastadā |
vyāsādyāḥ svāgataṃ cakrurdaduḥ prasādabhojanam || 95||
atha rājādayaḥ sarve yayurnivāsamutsukāḥ |
prātaḥ sarve samāgatya vyāsāttathaiva lomaśāt || 9 6||
mantraṃ dhunyaṃ srajaṃ caiva jagṛhustaulasīṃ mudā |
vaiṣṇavāste tato jātāḥ pāvanāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ || 97||
śuśruvuste kathāṃ nityaṃ pupūjurvyāsamanvaham |
ṛṣīn sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīḥ siṣevire hariṃ prabhum || 98 ||
bhejire paramātmānaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 99||
cakrire sarvadā dhunyaṃ prasādaṃ ca jalāmṛtam |
sarve bubhujire bālavṛddhayuvajanāḥ sadā || 4.73.100 ||
tena jātāḥ pāvanāste kṣapitāghaughasañcayāḥ |
sāttvatāḥ paramāsteṣāṃ māsānte kṛṣṇa āyayau || 101 ||
prabhurnārāyaṇo divyamūrtirvimānamāsthitaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ bhūmāvavātatāra cāmbarāt || 102 ||
jalaṃ cikṣepa paritasteṣāmupari gopajaḥ |
sarve divyadṛśo jātā bhālayāmāsuracyutam || 103 ||
uktā bhagavatā gantuṃ nṛpādyāścākṣaraṃ padam |
sahasrādhijanāḥ sajjā babhūvurgantumakṣaram || 1 04||
divyān dehān vidhāyaiva nītvā vimānake ca tān |
śeṣām̐styaktvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣaraṃ jagāma ha || 1 09||
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇasya pañcamyāṃ ninye tānakṣaraṃ hariḥ |
mahāścaryamidaṃ jātaṃ khyātaṃ sarvaṃ vyajāyata || 106 | |
badrike śeṣavargāstu mahābhāgavatottamāḥ |
kathāṃ śrutvā yayurnaijaṃ dveṣarāgajayaṃ puram || 1 07||
te’pi kālena govindaṃ bhajitvā cākṣaraṃ yayuḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirdivaṃ milet || 108 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne jayamānākhyabandijanasya stavanena prāptavairāgyavivekasya vajravikramanṛpatestatprajānāṃ ca kathāśravaṇādibhirmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||

<4.74>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye lakṣmi kathāṃ sūtasya mokṣadām |
pañcanade śubhe deśe sindhucīnāpagāntare || 1 ||
saṃgame bhūtale tvāsīnnagarī pañcanādinī |
tasyā rājābhavannāmnā saptābdhisiṃha uttamaḥ || 2 ||
mahāparākramaḥ khyātaśauryaḥ prajāprarakṣakaḥ |
hastivājimahāyānavimānādicamūpatiḥ || 3 ||
prajāpālo dharmabuddhirbrahmakarmaparāyaṇaḥ |
tasya svasya rathavāhaḥ sūto’bhavat sukesarī || 4 ||
so’pi bhūpasamo dehe bhāne mantre raṇe matau |
sūtakāryakaro nityaṃ rājñaḥ priyataro’bhavat || 5 ||
sa rājā rathamāsthāya sūtanoditamuttamam |
mṛgayārthamaraṇyānīṃ vicacāra nadītaṭe || 6 ||
tatra pātuṃ jalaṃ sindhutaṭaṃ yayau rathānvitaḥ |
viśaśrāma papau vāri sūto vāri papau tataḥ || 7 ||
aśvāḥ papurjalaṃ śrāntā muktā rathayugāt kṣaṇam |
vaṭacchāyātale rājā sūryatāpena noditaḥ || 8 ||
lebhe nidrāṃ manāk tāvat sarpo vaṭāt papāta ha |
nṛpakaṇṭhopari śvetavarṇo’daśannṛpaṃ drutam || 9 ||
sūto dadarśa sarpaṃ taṃ daśantaṃ dīrghavigraham |
neme dūrāt sūtavaryo jānan devasamaṃ sṛpam || 4.74.10 ||
namaste śvetavarṇāya śeṣarūpāya bhogine |
daṃśate mama rājānaṃ viṣṇurūpāya te namaḥ || 11 ||
kālarūpāya rudrāya raudrāya prāṇahāriṇe |
namaste duḥkhahārāya rakṣākartre muhurnamaḥ || 1 2||
eṣo’haṃ nṛpateḥ sūto bhṛtyo’smi kiṃkarastviha |
aparo na sahāyo’sti dayālo māṃ prarakṣaya || 1 3||
īdṛśe nirjane’raṇye jīvite mayi kiṃkare |
svāmino maraṇaṃ yogyaṃ naiva naiva ca naiva ca || 1 4||
tato matsvāminaṃ sarpa samuddhara viṣānalāt |
tatsthāne māṃ daśa sarpa svasti me te muhurnamaḥ || 15||
rājārthe devatārthe ca guvarthe gokṛte tathā |
pitrarthe prāṇadātā yaḥ sa svargaṃ divyamaśnute || 16 ||
naṣṭe nṛpe mama mṛtyurdhruvaścātra bhaviṣyati |
tatpāpaṃ te bhavet sarpa tasmāduddhara mannṛpam || 1 7||
nṛpoddhāre mama bhṛtyau pāpa te na bhaviṣyati |
mṛte svāmini bhṛtyasya jīvanaṃ garhitaṃ kṣitau || 18 ||
tasmād rakṣaya bhogīndra dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari |
viṣaṃ vārāya śīghraṃ tu yāvanniryānti nāsavaḥ || 19 ||
tvaṃ vane vidyase svāmī vaṭasthāyīti tarkaye |
tavātithisvarūpo’haṃ nṛpaste’tithirasti ca || 4.74.20 ||
ātitheyo bhavān bhūtvā prarakṣatu kṣitīśvaram |
vidhehi svāgataṃ sarpa jīvadānena bhūpateḥ || 21 ||
na cet pāpaṃ bhavette’tra puṇyanāśo bhavettava |
āśābhagno’tithiryasya gṛhātpratinivartate ||22||
pāpaṃ datvā puṇyamapyādāyātithiḥ sa gacchati |
dhanyāste gṛhiṇaḥ sarpa pūjyante’tithayo’nvaham || 23 ||
yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu pūjānnavastravāripradānakaiḥ |
jīvadānasamaṃ dānaṃ paraṃ dānaṃ na vidyate || 24||
sarvadānakṛtaṃ puṇyamabhayasya prade bhavet |
sarvapāpāni bhayade tiṣṭhanti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
bhayaṃ kāryaṃ na kasyāpi sūkṣmasyāpi tu dehinaḥ |
bhayadasya phalaṃ syādvai pratibhayaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 26 ||
tasmād rakṣaya rājānaṃ sarpa tvaṃ vaṭasaṃgṛhī |
na cet prāṇabhayaṃ te’pi mama bāṇena viddhi hi ||27||
ekasya paścādubhayorvyasutvaṃ niścitaṃ tviha |
datvā prāṇaṃ tava prāṇānnītvā yāsye yamālayam ||28||
vadātra śīghraṃ kartavyaṃ śara eṣo’nusandhitaḥ |
ityuktvā badrike dhanuḥ saguṇaṃ saśaraṃ tathā ||29||
vidhāya krodhamāpannaḥ pratīkṣate hitaṃ vacaḥ |
tāvat sarpo bhīta iva pratyuvāca tu sāntvayan ||4.74.30||
śṛṇvatithe tathyamatra tato yogyāya cārhasi |
avicāryakṛtaḥ śīghraṃ bhayamāpadyate ṛtam ||3 1||
sukesarin purā sṛṣṭau brahmā rudrāya sṛṣṭaye |
ājñāṃ cakāra rudro’sau na svīcakāra vai tadā ||32||
svayaṃ brahmā tu vividhāḥ prajāḥ sasarja śāntimān |
athotpannāḥ prajāścāsannākalpasthāyijīvanāḥ ||33||
nāpyavardhanta ca nāśaṃ na prāpurvai yadā tadā |
vṛddhyarthaṃ sa nijāddehāt prajāḥ sasarja maithunīḥ ||34||
yugalāni sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ca |
bahvyaḥ prajāstā utpannā yugalebhyo’rbudārbudam ||35||
tāsāmasaṃkhyasaṃtatyā prapūritamidaṃ jagat |
tāsāṃ puṣṭiṃ cakāraiva viṣṇurlakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||36
na nāśo’sti tadā tāsāṃ saṃkulitaṃ jagad yadā |
tadā brahmā tu rudrāya prajānāśakalāṃ dadau ||37||
rudraḥ prāha na me hiṃsā rocate bhayakāriṇī |
hiṃsāphalaṃ tu narakaṃ śāpo duḥkhaṃ tatholbaṇam ||38||
krūraṃ karma dayāhīnaṃ hiṃsanaṃ prāṇaghātanam |
na tat kariṣye doṣāḍhyaṃ pāpāḍhyaṃ vai prajāpate ||39|||
tadā brahmā vicāryaiva rudramuvāca tatkṣaṇam |
kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ jarāṃ vyādhīn sṛjāmi paśya nāśakān ||4.74.40||
te vināśān kariṣyanti mā te hiṃsā bhavecchiva |
nimittena vināśaḥ syāt tvaṃ tannirīkṣako bhava ||41 ||
ityuktaḥ śaṅkaro devo jagṛhe brāhmaṇo vacaḥ |
saṃhārakarmaṇāmādhidaivatvaṃ jagṛhe haraḥ ||42||
tato brahmā sasarjoktān kālamṛtyujarādhikān |
krūrān nimittabhūtām̐śca dehino naḥ sasarja ca ||43||
sarpān vyāghrān vṛścikām̐śca viṣāḍhyān dehinastathā |
jvarān rogānmandaśaktauḥ sasarja mārakānajaḥ ||44||
tebhyo’smabhyo dadāvājñāṃ yeṣāṃ mṛtyuryathā mataḥ |
yena nimittamātreṇa bādhadhvaṃ tān tathaiva ha ||45||
evamājñāṃ pradāyaiva śaṅkarāya samarpitāḥ |
te vayaṃ nāśakartāro naṣṭāyuṣāṃ na cānyathā ||46||
preryante śaṅkareṇaiva kālā rogā aśaktayaḥ |
viṣāḍhyā rūpavantaśca bhūtvā bhūtvā prajāsu ca ||47||
vicarāmo nāśarekhāṃ nāśakṣaṇaṃ vilokya ca |
daśāmo nānyathā sūta gatāyurnṛpatistviha ||48||
dṛṣṭo mayā na doṣo me na vayaṃ bhayaśālinaḥ |
ye ye’smākaṃ mahīmānā bhavantyatithayastathā ||49||
kurmasteṣāṃ tu sammānaṃ viṣārpaṇairhi mṛtyave |
kṛto mayā cātitheyaḥ satkāro yo’stimadgṛhe ||4.74.50||
rājā gato hi nidhanaṃ na punaḥ prāṇameṣyati |
sūta te jīvanaṃ cāste śavaṃ naya prayāhi ca ||51 ||
yadi tvaṃ śarasandhānairmama prāṇān hariṣyasi |
nūtnena karmaṇā tvaṃ ca prāṇān tyakṣyasi cātra vai ||52||
mānuṣāṇāṃ tu śastrāṇāṃ daive pravartanaṃ nahi |
sarpo’haṃ kālarūpo’haṃ tathyaṃ vacmi prayāhi ca ||53||
viramāsmāt karmaṇaśca mā svāyuṣyaṃ vināśaya |
vicāryātra yathāyogyaṃ yad vidheyaṃ vidhehi tat ||||54||
eṣo’smi vaṭaśākhāyāṃ nirbhīko hṛdgataṃ kuru |
kartustu sāhasasyaivāpadyante duḥkhakoṭayaḥ ||55||
vayaṃ niyāmakāḥ sṛṣṭestvaṃ niyāmyo’si sanṛpaḥ |
hiṃsāyāṃ mama pāpaṃ na tava pāpaṃ tu vai dhruvam |||56|||
hiṃsāyāṃ me na narakaṃ te narakaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavet |
rājñā kāryo virodho na janena sukhamicchatā ||57||
virodho nāpi daivena bhāgyenāpi ca naiva ha |
yadāpatet tadbhoktavyaṃ yathākarma hyupasthitam ||98||
sūta naiva hi kartavyo virodho vahninā saha |
na kālena saha kāryo virodhaḥ sukhamicchatā ||59||
na mṛtyunā neśvareṇa na śāstrā na striyā hyapi |
na mūrkheṇa na kruddhena na śastradhāriṇāpi ca ||4.74.60||
na samarthena kartavyo virodho mṛdunā satā |
na śastreṇa na bhūtaiśca na camatkārakāriṇā ||6 1||
balinā na viroddhavyaṃ na mātrā janakena ca |
guruṇā na viroddhavyaṃ tapasvinā na sādhunā ||62||
bahubhirna viroddhavyaṃ kṣemaṃ kuśalamicchatā |
patinā na viroddhavyaṃ na gṛhasvāminā kvacit ||63||
na piśācena yoddhavyaṃ rakṣasā dānavena na |
na siṃhena gajenāpi na sarpeṇa viṣeṇa ca ||64||
na duṣṭena ca yoddhavyaṃ na nirdayena śatruṇā |
tatra dharmo na vai tiṣṭhecchaṭhe duṣṭe ca nirdaye ||65||
śaraṃ saṃhara rājānaṃ nayorddhvadaihikaṃ kuru |
yadvā muñca śaraṃ śīghraṃ mayi yatphalamāpnuyāḥ ||66||
vivekena vidadhyādvai taddhīnastvāpadāṃ padam |
manuṣyo’si ca medhāvī yad yogyaṃ tat samācara || 67||
nāyaṃ hato mayā sūta rājā hataḥ svakarmaṇā |
nāhaṃ ghātamavāpsyāmi śareṇa tava kesarin ||68||
pratyuta tava ghātārthaḥ śaraścātra bhaviṣyati |
mamāhamiti mohaṃ tvaṃ muñca mā kuru mohanam || 69||
kva te rājā kvāsya sūtaḥ sarvaṃ vai karmabandhanam
bhautike puttale baddhā ātmāno nijakarmabhiḥ ||4.74.70||
bhuñjate svakṛtaṃ karma yāvad dehe vasanti hi |
tat tyaktvā cāpare dehe punaḥ karmāṇi bhuñjate ||71||
mayi sarpe na viśvāsaste yadi muñca mārgaṇam |
kṛtvā parīkṣāṃ ca tato mauḍhyaṃ svayaṃ prahāsyasi ||72||
ityuktvā badrike sarpo virarāma kathānakāt |
sūto vicārya sahasā tyaktvā dhanuḥ śaraṃ tathā ||73||
eṣo’haṃ śaraṇe te’smi sarpadeva śucaṃ hara |
devo’si kālakālo’si kālo’si śaṃkaro’si vā ||74||
yo’si so’si ṛtaṃ manye kṛtaṃ tvayā yathātatham |
tathāpi vandanāṃ kurve hitaṃ me syād yathā tathā ||75||
nṛpateśca hitaṃ syād yat daṃśaste viphalo’pi na |
tathā daivaniyogena vidhehi sarparāḍiha ||76||
ityuktvā badrike sūto daṇḍavatpracakāra tam |
sarpo’pi kālarūpo’pi hitaṃ vyacintayat kṣaṇam ||77||
uvāca sūta bhīṃ tyaktvottiṣṭha nṛpaṃ samāhvaya |
viṣaṃ harāmi cādyātra nṛpo jīvatu cādhunā ||78||
kintu dhāraya mantraṃ tva nṛpaṃ śrāvaya satvaram |
puṇyena tena kālo’haṃ harāmyasya na jīvanam ||79||
ityuktvā badrike kālaḥ sarpo mantraṃ dadau tadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||4.74.80||
oṃ bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi |
tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādīti mantraṃ ca vai dadau ||8 1 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||82||
nāmadhunyaṃ dadau cāpi sarpaḥ sūtāya vai tadā |
sūtaḥ śrīnṛpateḥ karṇe śrāvayāmāsa satvaram ||83||
tāvad rājā samuttasthau nirviṣaḥ svasthadehavān |
sarpaścainaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha yāhi rājan kathāsthalam ||84||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ śubhām |
kuru sevāṃ satāṃ cāpi tataḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ vraja ||85||
sūtādatha viśeṣeṇa vṛttāntaṃ nṛpatiḥ svakam |
jñātvā dadau dhanyavādān sūtāya bhogine’pi ca ||86||
namaskṛtya drutaṃ naijarathena gṛhamāyayau |
gṛhiṇīṃ dāsadāsīśca nītvā saha yayau kathām ||87||
pupūja paramātmānaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sumūrtikam |
vyāsaṃ ca lomaśaṃ cāpi sādhūn pupūja bhūpatiḥ ||88||
dadau dānānyanekāni kathāṃ śuśrāva bhāvataḥ |
bhojanānāṃ pradānaiśca sevāṃ satāṃ cakāra saḥ |89||
sūtena smārito rājā bhajanaṃ pracakāra ha |
prasādaṃ pādasalilaṃ jagrāha nṛpatirmuhuḥ ||4.74.90||
kuṭumbasahito badri pāvanaḥ sambabhūva ha |
mṛtyubhayāt kṛṣṇamūrtau līnavad vartate sadā ||9 1||
jyeṣṭhe kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne bhagavān hariḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamāsthitaḥ ||92||
āyayau tasya mokṣārthaṃ rājā sajjo babhūva ca |
dadau dānāni sarvāṇi namaskṛtya samastakān ||93||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhūto vimānamāruroha saḥ |
sūtaḥ sukesarī cāpi rājñī rakṣāvatī tathā ||94||
putrāḥ putryoḥ bhṛtyavargā dāsā dāsyo nṛpāya vai |
jayavādānnamovādān dadurmokṣapragāmine ||95||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ rājā saptābdhisiṃhanāmakaḥ |
divyo bhūtvā badrike sa yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||96||
rājñyādyāśca nṛpasyaurdhvadaihikaṃ pravyadhustataḥ |
sūtaḥ sukesarī rājñī rakṣāvatī sutādayaḥ ||97||
vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā bhūtvā śrutvā kathāṃ pramokṣiṇīm |
yayunaiṃjāṃ hi nagarīṃ saindhavīṃ pañcanādinīm ||98||
bhajitvā vallabhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ gopālabālakam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ padmāvatīpatim ||99||
yayuḥ kālena sarve te harerdhāmākṣaraṃ param |
evaṃ badrīpriye rājā mṛto mantreṇa jīvitaḥ || 4.74.1 00||
kathāṃ śrutvā hariṃ prāpya yayau brahmākṣaraṃ padam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanādapi sarvathā || 10 1||
kālamāyāpāpakarmavimuktiḥ saṃbhavettathā |
bhuktirmuktirbhavecchreṣṭhā yatheṣṭāḥ syuḥ samṛddhayaḥ || 1 02||
kṛṣṇakathābalaṃ badri sarvabalādhikaṃ matam |
tato’dhikaṃ kṛṣṇakṛpābalaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sarpadaṣṭasya saptābdhisiṃhanṛpate sūtadattamantradhunyayogena saṃjīvanaṃ kathāśravaṇena ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||

<4.75>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye lakṣmi māgadhasya kathāṃ śubhām |
amṛtākhyanagare vai tadāsīnmāgadho janaḥ || 1 ||
nāmnā tu harṣanayano vaṃśopavaṃśabodhavān |
vaṃśopavaṃśapūrveṣāṃ caritrākhyānakārakaḥ || 2 ||
rājñāṃ pañcanadīyānāṃ sindhujānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
sa śuśrāva janebhyo vai camatkāraṃ kathodbhavam || 3 ||
rājñāṃ prajānāṃ bahvīnāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam |
tato vicārya sahasā kathākarṇanahetave || 4 ||
āyayau śarkarāpuryāṃ kathāmaṇḍapamāgataḥ |
neme sarvān saṃhitāṃ ca vyāsaṃ śrīlomaśaṃ harim || 5 ||
sādhujanān satīḥ sādhvīrvaiṣṇavān nṛpatīṃstathā |
śrotṝn rājñījanām̐ścāpi neme śuśrāva satkathām || 6 ||
kathānte sa tu vaṃśān vai nārāyaṇasamudbhavān |
jagāda bhaktiyuktaśca rañjayāmāsa mānavān || 7 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ |
eko divyeśvarakoṭyavatārakoṭikāraṇam || 8 ||
akṣare parame dhāmni rājate puruṣottamaḥ |
tadvaṃśe prathamaṃ kṛṣṇo vyāsudevo vyajāyata || 9 ||
tato nārāyaṇo jāto mahāviṣṇustataḥ param |
tato virāḍ virājācca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 4.75.1 0||
brahmataḥ sanakādyāśca ṛṣayo mānavādayaḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare || 1 1||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ |
kaṃbharāśrīmahālakṣmīsuto gopālanandanaḥ || 1 2||
lakṣmīrādhāramākṛṣṇāprajñāpadmāvatīpatiḥ |
māṇikīsukhadālakṣmīlalitākamalāpatiḥ ||1 3||
vrahmapriyāpatirmuktapatirmuktānikāpatiḥ |
haripriyāpatiḥ sarvapatirbrahmapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||14||
vartate viprarūpo’dya sarvagotrāgraśāśvataḥ |
gīyate’tra harirlakṣmīnārāyaṇakathādibhiḥ ||15||
jayatvatra mahārājarājādhirājapuṃgavaḥ |
vidhātā śreyasāṃ kartā mokṣasya duḥkhanāśanaḥ || 16||
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt jayatvānandaśevadhiḥ |
parabrahma harikṛṣṇo nityaṃ vijayatetamām ||17||
sādhavo vijayante ca vaiṣṇavā vijayantyati |
evaṃ śrībadrike harṣanayanaḥ śrīpatiṃ harim ||18||
abhiṣṭūya sabhāyāṃ sa daṇḍavat pracakāra ha |
tulasīdalapuṣpāṇi phalāni śarkarāstathā || 19||
pūgīphalaṃ ca mudrāṃ ca kānakīṃ cāmbaraṃ śubham |
vyāsāya ca tathā saṃhitāyai nyadhāt prapūjya ca ||4.75.20||
namaścakre prasādaṃ ca jagṛhe caraṇāmṛtam |
mantraṃ ca nāmadhunyaṃ ca jagṛhe vyāsadevataḥ ||21 ||
jajāpa mantraṃ nityaṃ sa cakre dhunyaprakīrtanam |
śuśrāva ca kathāṃ nityamekatāno’bhavat sadā ||22||
pāvanaḥ pūrṇabhāgyaśca samajāyata māgadhaḥ |
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tu sāyaṃ bhaktyā vaśīkṛtaḥ ||23||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamāsthitaḥ |
āyayau taṃ samānetuṃ divyaḥ śrīsevito hariḥ ||24||
māgadhaṃ harṣanayanaṃ saṃkṛtvā divyavigraham |
avasthāpya vimāne taṃ ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||25||
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ cānyāṃ prapāvanīm |
dāsastatrābhavad vṛddhaḥ saṃhitāmaṇḍapasthale ||26||
rātrau rakṣākaro nityaṃ jāgarti yaśca rakṣati |
nityaṃ sa bhajate kṛṣṇaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇoti bhāvataḥ ||27||
pradakṣiṇaṃ niśānte ca karoti saṃhitāsanam |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ nityamarpayatyapi bhāvataḥ ||28||
karoti kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ bhuṃkte prasādamuttamam |
pibatyapaḥ prasādotthāḥ satāṃ prasādamaśnute ||29||
sevāṃ vyāsasya dehādisaṃvāhanaṃ karotyapi |
mārjanaṃ sadasaścāpi vastrakṣālanamityapi ||4.75.30||
vaiṣṇavebhya iṣṭavastupradānaṃ prakarotyapi |
evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya yogidāsābhidhasya tu ||3 1||
prasannaḥ śrīharirjāto badrike cāyayau hariḥ |
divyaṃ haṃsaṃ samāruhya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||32||
uvāca yogidāsaṃ tvaṃ sajjo bhava vimuktaye |
netuṃ samāgato’smyatra haṃsena mokṣaṇaṃ prati ||33||
yogidāso’timumude śrutvā vākyaṃ parātmanaḥ |
cacāla śrīhariṃ haṃsaṃ prati yāvad vimuktaye ||34||
tāvanmūrchāmavāpāsau dehaḥ papāta bhūtale |
divyarūpo yogidāso’bhavanmuktasvarūpavān ||35||
haṃse niṣādya bhaktaṃ taṃ yayau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
śāśvataṃ paramaṃ dhāma paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām ||36||
ityevaṃ badrike mukto’bhavat kathādisevayā |
yogidāso jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇamānasaḥ ||37||
athānyāṃ te kathāṃ badri vadāmi bhaktamokṣadām |
nāmnā saurabhasāvitro’bhavattāmbūlakārakaḥ ||38||
śarkarānagare badri satāṃ hareśca sevakaḥ |
pratyahaṃ so’pi sevāyāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sthiro’bhavat ||39||
dadāti tāmbūlakāni nityaṃ sahasraśo mudā |
sugandhirasacūrṇādimiśritāni śubhāni ca | 4.75.40||
nityaṃ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā cāyāti maṇḍapam |
yathāsthānaṃ samāgatya patrapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||41||
karoti pūjanaṃ kathāsaṃhitāyāstathā satām |
vyāsadevasyārhaṇāṃ ca lomaśasyārhaṇāṃ tathā ||42||
lālāsanasyāpi pūjāṃ pūjāṃ vṛkāyanasya ca |
nīlakarṇasya pūjāṃ ca yavakrītādipūjanam ||43||
tuṣitānāṃ hāritānāṃ divimānāyanasya ca |
devāyatanameṣāyatamaṃkaṇādiyoginām ||44||
hemaśālāyanādīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ prage |
karoti nityamevāyaṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||45||
vyāsāya saṃhitāyaicārpayatyeva phalānyapi |
tāmcūlakāni tulasīpatrahārām̐śca kausumān ||46||
mudrāścākṣatagodhūmān vastrakambalakām̐stathā |
yathāśakti dadātyeva pūjāyāṃ saurabhān rasān ||47||
evaṃ saurabhasāvitro bhaktyā niṣkalmaṣo’bhavat |
satāṃ dehādisaṃvāhapādasaṃmardanādikam ||48||
kṛtvā bhuktvā prasādaṃ ca pītvā taccaraṇāmṛtam |
śrutvā kathāḥ saṃhitāyāḥ sandagdhavāsano’bhavat ||49||
taṃ netuṃ cākṣare sthāne kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
āyayau śvetagaruḍe sthitvā kathāsthalaṃ hariḥ ||4.75.50||
avātatāra sahasā prasannānanapaṅkajaḥ |
prāha saurabhasāvitraṃ prasannastava sevayā |||51||
āyāhi paramaṃ sthānaṃ divyaṃ vyoma mamākṣaram |
śrutvā saurabhasāvitraḥ kūrdayitvā nanarta ha ||52||
dhanyaṃ mokṣapadaṃ matvāgataṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
natvā tyaktvā nijaṃ dehaṃ manuṃ japaṃ purārjitam ||53||
nāmadhunyaṃ śrāvayam̐ścāruroha garuḍopari |
divyamuktaśarīro’sau yayāvambaravartmanā ||54||
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇasya dvādaśyāṃ kathottaraṃ yayau param |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumudire’timānavāḥ ||55||
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi bhaktagāthāṃ tathāparām |
raṃgakārakathāṃ tatrabhūtāṃ paramapāvanīm ||56||
raṃgakāro’bhavannāmnā raṃgilo raṃgakṛt sadā |
raṃgakalāsu sarvāsu kuśalaścitrakoṭiṣu ||57||
śarkarānagare nityaṃ raṃgakāryaprajīvanaḥ |
devasevāparaścāpi sādhubhakto’bhavat sadā ||58||
badrike sa kathāyā vai maṇḍapaṃ samaraṃgayat |
devacitrāṇi sarvāṇi bhaktacitrāṇi sarvaśaḥ ||59||
bhittīnāṃ raṃgakāryāṇi paṭaraṃgān suśobhanān |
akarot sevayā bhaktyā satāṃ prasannatāptaye ||4.75.60||
hareḥ prasannatāyai ca raṃgasevāṃ tathākarot |
abhajatparamātmānaṃ mantraṃ jajāpa nityaśaḥ ||61||
nāmasaṃkīrtanadhunyādīnyācarat kṛtādaraḥ |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ sevanaṃ ca kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||62||
prasādabhakṣaṇaṃ pādāmṛtavāriprapānakam |
pādadhūlivahanaṃ ca śarīre bhāvato’karot ||63|||
evaṃ kṣapitapāpaḥ sa saṃprakṣālitavāsanaḥ |
iyeṣa śrīharerdhāma gantuṃ śāśvatamakṣaram ||64||
badrike vyāpakaḥ kṛṣṇo’ntaryāmī śrīnarāyaṇaḥ |
śvetāśvārūḍha īśeśeśeśvaraḥ samupāyayau ||65||
uvāca raṃgila ehi mama dhāmākṣaraṃ param |
raṃgilaḥ sahasā dehaṃ tyaktvā bhautikamutsukaḥ ||66||
divyadeho’bhavat kṛṣṇadṛṣṭyāśvamāruroha ca |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nārāyaṇo ninye tamakṣaram ||67||
raṃgilaṃ raṃgakartāraṃ yāntaṃ vīkṣya sabhājanāḥ |
jayavādān pracakruśca nemustāṃ diśamacyutam ||68||
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ raṃgilo hyakṣaraṃ yayau |
badrike ca tataścānyāṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya saṃśṛṇu ||69||
vādyakāro’bhavattatra śarkarānagare śubhaḥ |
ḍamarūkābhidhaḥ so’pi bhakto vādyādinirmitim ||4.75.70||
kṛtvā vṛttiṃ nirvahati satāṃ sevāṃ karoti ca |
kathāyāṃ vādyadānāni kṛtavān bhāvataḥ sa vai ||71 ||
kāṃsyān śaṃkhān paṭahām̐śca bherīdiṇḍimagomukhān |
mṛdaṃgān paṇavām̐ścāpi murajāmbarakām̐stathā ||72||
mardalān veṇuvīṇāśca dardurān kacchapān dadau |
talaghātānānakām̐śca dundubhīn tālakān dadau ||73||
tena puṇyena bhagavān prasanno’syābhavattadā |
so’pi vādyakalāvijño vādyavādanamācarat ||74||
tena santaḥ prasannāśca badrike tasya cābhavan |
sevāṃ cakre satāṃ nityaṃ kathāṃ śuśrāva nityadā ||75||
prasādaṃ jagṛhe nityaṃ pādāmṛtaṃ papau sadā |
mantraṃ jajāpa satataṃ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhāt ||76||
evaṃ vaiṣṇavasevāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevane rataḥ |
ḍamarūko’bhavat sarvanaṣṭapāpaḥ supāvanaḥ ||77||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntavallabhaḥ |
āyayau tvakṣaraṃ dhāma netuṃ taṃ ḍamarūkaṇam ||78||
so’pi mokṣakṣaṇaṃ jñātvā cāgataṃ harinā harim |
neme dadhyau hṛdaye ca natvā sabhājanān muhuḥ ||79||
bhautikaṃ varṣma santyaktvā divyadehamavāpya ca |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhūto gajaṃ samāruroha saḥ ||4.75.80||
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ śrīmannārāyaṇasya śāśvatam |
kṛpayā śrīharerbadri yayāvapunarāgamam ||8 1 ||
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yayau ḍamarūko’kṣaram |
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tathā kathāṃ supāvanīm ||82||
bhāvasāro’bhavattatra vastravyāpārakārakaḥ |
śarkarānagare nāmnā cihnarāyeti viśrutaḥ ||83 ||
cihnarāyo dadau vastrasahasraṃ maṇḍapārthakam |
bhaktyā kathāsthalārthaṃ sa vaiṣṇavo dhanavān sukhī ||84||
ūrṇikāprastaraṇāni vitānānyuttamāni ca |
āsanāni suramyāṇi dadau kathotsave yataḥ ||85||
sādhūn sa sevayāmāsa śuśrāva cācyutīṃ kathām |
mantraṃ jagrāha dhunyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ vyāsadevataḥ ||86||
siṣeve nityamevāpi vastranāṇakadāṇakaiḥ |
tatsevayā prasanno’bhūcchrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ | |87||
prasādena pavitrāya cihnarāyāya darśanam |
pratyakṣaṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo vallabhāryaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ ||88||
uvāca taṃ prasanno’smi dhāma cāyāhi me’kṣaram |
etadvimānavaryeṇa nayāmi paramaṃ padam ||89||
jyeṣṭhāmāyāṃ tu madhyāhne kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāgatam |
sajjo’bhavat pragantuṃ vai tatyāja bhautikīṃ tanum | |4.75.90||
divyadeho’bhavattūrṇaṃ vimānamāruroha ca |
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kurvan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saḥ ||91||
sārdhaṃ śrīhariṇā tūrṇaṃ vimānenākṣaraṃ yayau |
jayanādāstadā tatra bhaktānāmabhavan muhuḥ ||92||
badrike ca tadā tatra sāyaṃkāle kathottaram |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇu tadgrāmayājinaḥ ||93||
grāmayājī vipradevo’bhavannāmnā rameśvaraḥ |
nityaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇotyeva vyāsārhaṇāṃ karoti ca ||94||
bhajate śrīhariṃ nityaṃ mantraṃ japati nityaśaḥ |
nāmadhunyaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca karoti satataṃ mudā ||95||
prasādaṃ śrīharernityaṃ gṛhṇāti ca padāmṛtam |
evaṃ pāvanahṛdayo vipro vyavartatānvaham ||96||
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo nityaṃ sevate sādhupuṃgavān |
niścayaṃ so’karod gantuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hareḥ ||97||
badrike’naśanaṃ cakre nirjalaṃ mokṣalabdhaye |
dinatraye haristasya mokṣārthaṃ samupāyayau ||98||
amāyāṃ tu niśāraṃbhe vimānena samāyayau |
āha taṃ bhakta cāyāhi vimānaṃ tvatkṛte tvidam ||99||
so’pi tūrṇaṃ divyadevo bhūtvā samāruroha tat |
yayau kṛṣṇena sahito dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ padam || 4.75.1 00||
badrike te camatkārāḥ prāsaran bhuvi sarvataḥ |
asaṃkhyā mānavā yānti kathāśravaṇahetave || 10 1||
tīvravegāstūrṇaśuddhāḥ prayānti tūrṇamakṣaram |
madhyavegāḥ śanairyānti mandāścireṇa yānti ca || 1 02||
asnehāstu na vai yānti snehastatra hi kāraṇam |
prasannatā kṛpā sevā śraddhā ca divyabhāvanā || 1 03||
vāsanāvilayaścāpi jigamiṣātiveginī |
vairāgyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktiḥ kāraṇāni tu mokṣaṇe || 1 04||
yeṣāṃ tīvrāste tu śīghraṃ prayānti paramaṃ padam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇasevādānādinā prasannaḥ śrīhariḥ, harṣanayanākhyaṃ māgadhaṃ, yogidāsākhyaṃ dāsaṃ, saurabhasāvitrākhyaṃ tāmbūlakāraṃ, raṃgilākhyaṃ raṃgakāraṃ, ḍamarūkākhyaṃ vādyakāraṃ, cihnarāyākhyaṃ bhāvasāraṃ, rameśvaraṃ grāmayājinaṃ ca, mokṣapadaṃ nītavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||

<4.76>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi camatkārabharīṃ kathām |
vidyādharāṇāṃ mokṣasya kāriṇīṃ pārameśvarīm || 1||
svarṇāstaraṇanāmā tu vidyādharo’bhavattadā |
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putra himālayanivāsakṛt ||2||
sa vai nijavimānenāmbare vihartukāmyayā |
niryayau sindhumārgeṇa paśyan deśān vanāśritān ||3||
mānasarovarādagre trivittān vīkṣya vai tataḥ |
kāśamehān pañcanadān vīkṣya sindhutaṭām̐stataḥ || 4 ||
vimānenāyayau yatra śarkarānagaraṃ mahat |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāyāśca maṇḍapaḥ || 5 ||
vidyate svargasadṛśo divā svarṇaprakāśanaḥ |
viśālo lakṣaśo yatra mānavāḥ santi veśitāḥ || 6 ||
pravartate kathā yatra vyāsakaṇṭhaninādanam |
meghānullaṃghya khe yāti devaśravaṇagocaram || 7 ||
havanasya ghṛtādīnāṃ dhūmāḥ sugandhaśālinaḥ |
pravartante vāyuloke yatsthānādatipāvanāḥ || 8 ||
śāntiryadbhūtalādūrdhvamambare ca pravartate |
santaptahṛdayānāṃ vai brahmaśāntiryato milet || 9 ||
yogināṃ sadṛśānyeva mānasāni tadāmbare |
prajāyante prajānāṃ vai vimānānāmapi kṣaṇam || 4.76.10 ||
dhvajāḥ patākāḥ kalaśāḥ satāṃ saṃkīrtanāni ca |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ samudāyāḥ saṃghāśca daivayoṣitām || 11 ||
āgamā vigamā vyomni vaiṣṇavānāmanāratam |
devānāmavatārāśca vedaghoṣā dvijeritāḥ || 1 2||
sarvametattu vaikuṇṭhabhrāntiṃ kārayati kṣitau |
etādṛśo mahān satraḥ kathārūpaḥ prajāyate || 1 3||
vīkṣyālocya vivicyāpi niścitya sukhamutsavam |
devarṣisiddhasaṃghānāṃ vimānāvataraṃ tathā || 14||
vīkṣya naijaṃ vimānaṃ tu sindhutīre’bhyatārayat |
vidyādhrīśatasaṃyukto dāsadāsaśatānvitaḥ || 15||
putraputrīśatairyukto vimānād bahirāyayau |
mahodyānāṃgaṇe sthāpya vimānaṃ maṇḍapaṃ yayau || 1 6||
vācyamānāṃ kathāṃ tatra sthitvā niṣadya maṇḍape |
śrutvā caikāgramanasā kathānte vyāsasannidhau || 17||
bahūpadābhiḥ sahitaḥ kuṭumbasahitastathā |
āyayau vyāsapūjārthaṃ natvā sabhāṃ sataḥ satīḥ || 18||
svarṇāstaraṇo mukuṭaṃ cāvatārya tu mastakāt |
neme vyāsaṃ saṃhitāṃ ca hariṃ neme punaḥ punaḥ || 19||
candanākṣatapuṣpādyai ratnahīrakabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
svarṇamaṇimauktikādyaiḥ pūjanaṃ sa vyadhānmudā ||4.76.20||
ārārtrikaṃ sahasraikavarttibhiḥ pracakāra saḥ |
vidyādharyo nanṛtuśca gāyantyo guṇagauravam ||21 ||
dāsā dāsyo nanṛtuśca kathāśravaṇamodinaḥ |
lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre’pṛcchat paricayaṃ tataḥ ||22||
sa āha lomaśasyāhaṃ śiṣyo’smi himaparvate |
nivasāmi kuṭumbena sahito mānasārase ||23||
āgato’smi vihārārthaṃ dṛṣṭvotsavamavātaram |
kṛtakṛtyo’smi sañjātaḥ kathāśravaṇapūjanaiḥ ||24||
śāntirme hṛdaye jātāmbare eva śubhārthinī |
tataścāvātaraṃ cātra vṛttaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ mama ||25||
vidyādharo’pi jijñāsāṃ cakre vyāsaṃ praveditum |
tathā taṃ guruvaryaṃ ca lomaśaṃ jñātumityapi ||26||
tadā lālāyanaḥ sādhurvidyādhraṃ prāha satvaram |
ayaṃ nārāyaṇo vyāsaḥ svataḥprakāśakāyanaḥ ||27||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśiṣyaśiromaṇiḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ katheyamuttamā ||28||
yasya tvaṃ śiṣya evāste sa cāyaṃ lomaśo muniḥ |
ahaṃ lālāyanaścāpi himādrau ca vihāravān ||29||
ityuktaḥ sa tu vidyādhraḥ snehāśrūṇi samasṛjat |
patitaḥ pādayostūrṇaṃ lomaśasya gurostadā ||4.76.30||
kuṭumbaṃ sarvamevāpi patitaṃ pādayormuneḥ |
lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre papraccha kuśalaṃ sukham ||3 1||
āvāsaṃ pradadau rājyodyāne bhojyaṃ tato dadau |
mahīmānātithisevāṃ cakāra lomaśo guruḥ ||32||
lomaśasya vacanena māsamuvāsa tatra saḥ |
śuśrāva ca kathāṃ nityaṃ bhavabandhavimocinīm ||33||
kuṭumbasahito nityaṃ prasādaṃ bubhuje hareḥ |
dāsā dāsyo guroḥ sevāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ pracakrire || 34||
putrāḥ putryaśca vidyādhryaḥ cakruḥ sevāṃ guroḥ satām |
nityaṃ cakruḥ kīrtanāni nāmadhunyaṃ pracakrire ||35||
dadau śrīlomaśastebhyo mantraṃ mokṣapradaṃ tataḥ |
brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsī bhavāmi om ||36||
mantraṃ labdhvā tu vidyādhrāḥ sarve vigatakalmaṣāḥ |
abhavan muktarūpāste sarve kṣapitavāsanāḥ ||37||
mokṣetracchavo’bhavam̐ścāpi brahmānandātilipsavaḥ |
prārthanāṃ cakrire śrīmadgurave mokṣalabdhaye ||38||
omityāha gurustebhyaḥ sasmāra parameśvaram |
lomaśasmṛtamātraḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’bhyagāt ||39||
sarvavimānasaṃsthaśca rādhālakṣmīpriyāyutaḥ |
mādhavīpārṣadamuktamuktānikānvito’bhyagāt ||4.76.40||
sūryaprabhavimānācchrīhariḥ prasannamānasaḥ |
sarvābharaṇasaṃśobhāḥ prahasan bahirāyayau ||41 ||
lomaśādyairgurugaṇaiḥ sadbhiḥ satībhirarcitaḥ |
vaiṣṇavairvanditaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jalāmṛtaiḥ |||42||
vidyādharavrajaṃ sarvaṃ divyatārthaṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ |
aprokṣayad bindukaṇaiḥ sarve divyāstato’bhavan ||43||
parivartanamāptāste vidyādhrā muktavarṣmasu |
divyadehā vyajāyanta kṛṣṇarādhāramāsamāḥ ||44||
pañcaśatāni sarve te vimānavaramāsthitāḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpyābhavan muktā hi śāśvatāḥ ||45||
āśīrvādairvardhitāste maharṣisādhubhūsuraiḥ |
kīrtayantaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti tālavādanaiḥ ||46||
ākāśaṃ garjayantaśca jayaśabdān pracakrire |
harirvimānaṃ sahasā himālayena vartmanā ||47||
mānasarovaraṃ nītvā vidyādhranagaraṃ śubham |
svarṇāstaraṇapautrāya yune nāmnā viśāline ||48||
datvordhvavyomamārgeṇa yayau brahmākṣaraṃ nijam |
viśālāstaraṇaścāpi bhaktiṃ cakāra vai hareḥ ||49||
putrapautrādivaṃśāḍhyaḥ sampannaścābhavattataḥ |
cireṇa so’pi kamalākāntabhaktyākṣaraṃ padam ||4.76.50||
prāpa badrīpriye mokṣaṃ parameśapadāsanam |
jyeṣṭhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ te vidyādhrā yayurakṣaram ||51 ||
athānyaṃ te camatkāraṃ vadāmi śṛṇu badrike |
gandharvā himavāsā ye citrabarhādayaḥ śubhāḥ ||52||
mānasarovare deśe vihartuṃ samupāyayuḥ |
te vimānaṃ dṛṣṭavantaḥ sahasraśo himālaye ||53||
svarṇāstaraṇaṃ papracchuḥ pitā kutra gatastava |
pratyāha svarṇāstaraṇo mokṣapadaṃ yayau pitā ||54|||
vimānena sudivyena śrīkṛṣṇacālitena vai |
pañcaśatāni vidyādhrā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||55||
kathāśravaṇamātreṇa sarve mokṣapadaṃ yayuḥ |
sā kathā śarkarāpuryāṃ sindhudeśe pravartate ||56||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ paramamokṣadā |
yatra devo’nādikṛṣṇo vallabhāryo virājate ||57||
saṃhitādevatārūpaḥ sarvāvirbhāvakāraṇam |
yatra vidyādharādīnāṃ guruḥ śrīlomaśo muniḥ ||58|||
svataḥprakāśo bhagavān vyāso yadvācako’sti ca |
devadānavagandharvāḥ pūtā yacchravaṇāt khalu ||59||
tāṃ kathāṃ prasamākarṇya matpitrādyā divaṃ gatāḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ tu camatkāraṃ badrike himavāsinaḥ ||4.76.60||
citrabarhādayaścāpi vimānena kathāsthalīm |
āyayuḥ strīpūruṣāśca triśatāni samutsukāḥ ||61 ||
ambarādavateruste mahodyānasamīpataḥ |
kathāmaṇḍapamāgatya jyeṣṭhe dvādaśikādine ||62||
śuklapakṣe hi gandharvā gāndharvyaśca hareḥ kathām |
saṃhitāṃ śuśruvuḥ sāyaṃ nīrājanottaraṃ tataḥ ||63||
lomaśājjagṛhurmantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ |
prasādaṃ jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇapādavāri papuśca te ||64||
caturdaśadinānyevaṃ śuśruvuste kathāṃ śubhām |
satāṃ sevāṃ pracakruśca nṛtyaṃ nityaṃ vyadhurmudā ||65||
gāyanaṃ ca vyadhurnityaṃ samārañjanakārakam |
kṛṣṇāgre saṃhitāgre ca satāmagre jagurmudā ||66||
bhaktiyuktāścakrureva nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ |
tena snehena vigatakatmaṣā abhavan drutam ||67||
kṣīṇakleśāḥ kṣīṇasarvavāsanāḥ siddhayoginaḥ |
sañjātāste samastā vai mokṣamantraṃ ca jagṛhuḥ | |68||
brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāso bhavāmi om |
saṃgṛhya mantraṃ jepuste narānāryo’tibhāvataḥ ||69||
teṣāṃ prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo’ṣāḍhakṛṣṇe dale drutam |
ekādaśyāṃ vimānenāyayau netuṃ nijākṣaram ||4.76.70||
triśatānāṃ tu sarveṣāmuparyeva jalāñjalim |
pracikṣepa harirvārikaṇaiḥ spṛṣṭāśca te tadā ||71||
divyadehāḥ samastāste gandharvā muktakoṭigāḥ |
gandharvā muktagandharvā abhavan divyavigrahāḥ ||72||
śrīkṛṣṇena samāhūtā āruruhurvimānakam |
jayanādairgarjayanto natvā kathāsthalaṃ sabhām ||73||
guruṃ sādhūn namaskṛtya dadhyuḥ śrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo ninye kṣaṇāttataḥ ||74||
himādriṃ ca tato ninye brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ nijam |
evaṃ śrībadrike yātāḥ sarve te śāśvataṃ padam ||75||
śṛṇu badrīpriye divyacamatkāraṃ tathaiva ha |
kinnarāḥ kimpuruṣā ye himādrau sārase sthale ||76||
śuśruvuśca purā vidyādharāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
vimānairāyayurlakṣmīnārāyaṇakathāsthalīm ||77||
sahasrārdhaṃ kinnarāśca kiṃpuruṣāstadardhakāḥ |
cāraṇā dve śate siddhāḥ pañcāśatte samāyayuḥ ||78||
mahodyāne vimānāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt |
kathāsthānaṃ yayuḥ sarve’vatīrya darśanāya ha ||79||
sammānitā lomaśādyaiḥ śuśravuste kathāṃ śubhām |
prasādaṃ jagṛhuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ papurmudānvitāḥ ||4.76.80||
mokṣamantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhurlomaśānmuneḥ |
vyāsapūjāṃ kathāpūjāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ ca nityadā ||8 1 ||
cakrire bhāvayuktāste vaiṣṇavāḥ pāvanāḥ parāḥ |
āṣāḍhakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||82||
sākṣātteṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ niśāyāmabhavaddhariḥ |
sarvābharaṇasaṃśobho rādhālakṣmīsamanvitaḥ ||83||
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ prasannavadanaḥ prabhuḥ |
uvācāyāntu me dhāmākṣaraṃ paramapāvanam ||84||
ityuktā badrike dhanyabhāgyāni tvabhimatya te |
sajjā bhūtvā cāruruhurvimānaṃ kṛṣṇaśobhitam ||85||
divyadehāḥ samastāste kṛpayā śrīhareḥ śubhāḥ |
abhavan muttarūpā vai cakrurdhunyaṃ vimānake ||86 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībadrike prabhuḥ |
nināya tāṃ himaśailaṃ tato dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||87||
kinnarān kiṃpūruṣām̐śca cāraṇān siddhayoginaḥ |
divyamuktān vidhāyaiva nināya kṛpayā hariḥ ||88||
aho śrībadrike bhāgyaṃ himācalanivāsinām |
nārāyaṇavimānāptirnārāyaṇāptirityapi ||89||
brahmalokāptirevāpi kathāśravaṇayogataḥ |
satāṃ sevanataścāpi prasādāśanatastathā ||4.76.90||
avatārikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptirvyavartata |
ityevaṃ badrike nityaṃ jīvānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ śubham ||91||
kathāśravaṇataścāpi darśanādvandanāt satām |
bhavatyeva hareryogāt sarvakāraṇakāraṇāt ||92||
nāgā daityā dānavāścoragā yakṣāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ |
ye tatra cāyayurbadri yogāmupāyayuśca ye ||93||
sarve te kṣīṇapāpāśca nirguṇāḥ kṛṣṇayoginaḥ |
bhūtvā bhūtvā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||94||
kīṭāḥ śākhāmṛgā vanyāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo’pi ca |
jantavo vallikā vṛkṣā yādāṃsi svedajā api ||95||
ye ye tatra mṛtāḥ satre kārṣṇayogena yojitāḥ |
sarve prāpuḥ paraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ te kṛpayā hareḥ ||96||
yāni sasyāni dhānyāni stambāśca stabakā api |
phalapuṣpadalavṛkṣāḥ kathāyogamupāyayuḥ ||97||
paramparayā sākṣādvā svāṃgaiḥ phalādibhiśca vai |
te sarve paramaṃ mokṣaṃ prāptāḥ kārṣṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||98||
sarvaṃ vai sulabhaṃ loke satsaṃgo durlabhaḥ sadā |
satsaṃgaḥ kṛpayā prāpyo yena mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ ||99||
badrike paṭhanādasya śravaṇānmananādapi |
bhuktirmuktirbhavedatra śāśvatī paramā gatiḥ || 4.76.100 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇādibhiḥ svarṇāstaraṇaprabhṛtividyādharāṇāṃ, citrabarhādigandharvāṇāṃ, kinnarakimpuruṣacāraṇasiddhānāṃ ca, mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||

<4.77>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi yathā yathā dinātyayaḥ |
kathāyā jāyate lokā lakṣaśo yānti tatra vai || 1 ||
māsamātraṃ kathā cāsti pakṣamātramataḥ param |
saptāhamātrameveti jñātvā cāyānti lakṣaśaḥ || 2 ||
narā nāryo bālabālāyutā vṛddhā yuvātmakāḥ |
sotsāhā pāpanāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ || 3 ||
mokṣavāñcchāyutāścānye bahavastatra cāyayuḥ |
nityaṃ yathā tu goloko vaikuṇṭho dyauryathā ca vā || 4 ||
tathā śrīśarkarābhūmirdivyā bhaktairvibhāti hi |
pūjayanti janā vyāsaṃ kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ ca saṃhitām || 5 ||
lomaśādīn gurun sādhūn viprān pravaiṣṇavān satīḥ |
sādhvīśca yogivaryāṃśca yatinīḥ sāṃkhyayoginīḥ || 6 ||
upadāḥ pradadū ratnamaṇisvarṇāmbarādikam |
śuśruvuḥ sevayāmāsurdadurdānāni muktaye || 7 ||
śuddhāḥ prasādaṃ bhuktvāpaḥ pītvā bhaktisamanvitāḥ |
yayuḥ prasādya sādhūm̐śca hariṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 8 ||
āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe tu dākṣiṇātyā nṛpādayaḥ |
uṣṇālayanivāsāśca prāgjyotirbhūnivāsinaḥ || 9 ||
brahmadeśanivāsāśca śyāmaśaṃbhunivāsinaḥ |
prācīnavāsinaścāpi śibirājyanivāsinaḥ || 4.77.10 ||
āyayū rāśiyānānāṃ mānavāśca nṛpeśvarāḥ |
ketumālanivāsāśca kimpuruṣanivāsinaḥ || 11 ||
hāritāśca parīdeśanivāsāścāyayurmudā |
abriktānāṃ mānavāśca nṛpāstatra samāyayuḥ || 1 2||
amarāṇāṃ janā bhūpā vimānaiḥ samupāyayuḥ |
yāvadbhūstaravāsāśca narā nāryaḥ samāyayuḥ || 1 3||
bhūgarbhāntrapradeśānā narā nāryaḥ samāyayuḥ |
kathāśravaṇalābhārthaṃ kṛṣṇekṣārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 14||
kīrtayantaḥ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāpatiṃ satīpatim |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam || 15||
teṣāṃ svāgatasammānaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃ gṛham |
koṭirāyo rāyahariścakruḥ śrīlomaśādayaḥ || 1 6||
yayāvyakti yathāyogyaṃ svargyaṃ nirmimire sukham |
yānabhojanapānārhāvāsān divyān dadustadā || 17||
toṣayāmāsa sarvāṃstān śrīkṛṣṇo’saṃkhyarūpadhṛk |
nijabhaktān siṣeve’pi sarveṣṭapūrako’bhavat || 1||
lakṣmī rādhā ramā śrīrbhūḥ mādhavī māṇikī priyā |
maṃgalā mañjulā revā suguṇā ca sarasvatī ||19||
gaṃgā bhaktiḥ satī muktirekādaśī ratirdayā |
tulasī kāmagauḥ śāntā kamalā virajā himā ||4.77.20 ||
haṃsā mūrtirgomatī kuṃkumavāpyannapūrṇikā |
jayā durgā lalitā sāvitrī santoṣiṇī kalā ||21 ||
badrī campā mauktikā ca vidyut ṣaṣṭhī ṛtambharā |
śvetā raktā siddhayaśca kṛṣṇātha nidhayo’pi ca ||22||
śaktayo’nekarūpādidhāriṇyo janasevanam |
yathāyogyaṃ pracakruste kṛṣṇājñayā hyanantaśaḥ ||23||
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ dehinaḥ kramaśaḥ kramāt |
āyayuḥ śrīkathākṛṣṇalābhārthaṃ śarkarāpurīm ||24||
kṛtakṛtyā babhūvuste pumāṃso yoṣito’khilāḥ |
divyabhāvaṃ prapannā ye prapannāḥ puruṣottamam ||25||
śṛṇu badripriye devi mahotsavastadābhavat |
āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣe vai pārāyaṇāntime dale ||26||
āyayuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇādyāḥ kuṃkumasthalāt |
ye tvāsan tatra vai rūpāntarairbhaktārthamāsthitāḥ ||27||
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā vṛddhā maharṣayastathā |
tathāśrīkambharālakṣmīsahitā brahmayoṣitaḥ ||28||
pārṣadāḥ pāvanādyāśca devā maharṣayo’pare |
rājānaśca prajāścāpi kathāyajñe samāyayuḥ ||29||
śrībadrīpriyovācake ke samāgatāstatra śrotumicchāmi nāmataḥ |
devā maharṣayo ye ca gandharvāpsarasastathā ||4.77.3 0||
pārṣadā ye ca rājānastān sarvān śrāvaya prabho |
pārāyaṇe prasaktānāmāgatānāṃ ṭale’ntime ||3 1 ||
nāmnāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ tadā |
pāpanāśo bhavedeva puṇyaṃ bhāgyaṃ pravardhate || 32||
dhanyāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogamupāgatāḥ |
yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa māyābandhaḥ praṇaśyati ||33||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇubadrīpriye devi dale pārāyaṇāntime |
āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe vai ye ye tatra samāgatāḥ ||34||
ekādaśyāṃ samāptau copasthitā ye’bhavam̐stadā |
tān sarvān sampravacmyatra mahābhāgavatān śṛṇu ||35||
āyayurānandadevā bhuvardevāḥ samāyayuḥ |
bhāvadevā rāṃbhadevāstathā tāpasadevatāḥ |||36||
ārtavadevā ādhvaradevāḥ pāvakadevatāḥ |.
sāvitrā havyavāhāśca bhūmadevāstathāyayuḥ ||37||
auśikāḥ kauśikā devāstathā gāndhāradevatāḥ |
ārṣabhāḥ ṣaḍjanā mārjālīyadevāstathāyayuḥ || 38||
vairājakā mādhyamāśca niṣādāḥ prāṇadevatāḥ |
ākūtikāścintakāścāyayuśca meghavāhanāḥ || 39||
vijñātikā mānasāśca bhāvā rāthantarāḥ surāḥ |
sadyojātā vāmadevā vīrāḥ pītāḥ kumārakāḥ ||4.77.40||
satyādyā vyāsadevāśca sutārādyāśca śaṃbhavaḥ |
svāyambhuvādyā manavaḥ pūrṇāhutau samāyayuḥ ||41 ||
vaimānikāḥ samastāśca sahasrākṣāḥ samāyayuḥ |
nārāyaṇāstathādityāḥ prājāpatyāḥ samāyayuḥ |||42||
āmṛtā brāhmadevāśca kalpāvasānikāstathā |
pitaro munayaścāpi kathāyāṃ samupāyayuḥ ||43||
dharmo ruciśca dakṣaśca marīcirbhṛgurāyayuḥ |
atryaṃgiraḥpulastyāśca vasiṣṭhaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ||44||
nāradaśca ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyāḥ samāyayuḥ |
gandharvāḥ siddhapūrṇau ca bahvī pūrṇāśa ityapi ||45||
śataguṇo brahmacārī viśvāvasuḥ suparṇakaḥ |
bhānuḥ sucandro varuṇo bhīmasenograsenakau ||46||
suparṇo dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sūryavarcāśca tumburuḥ |
gomān subāhuḥ prayutaḥ patravānarkaparṇakaḥ ||47||
bhīmaścitrarathaḥ śāliśirāḥ parjanya ityapi |
hāhā hūhūḥ kalirhaṃso jyotiṣṭomaśca madhyamaḥ ||48||
ācāro dāruṇaścāpi vareṇyo varuṇastathā |
suruciḥ sumanāścāpi vasurucyādayo’pi ca ||49||
āyayuste tu gandharvāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ |
apsarasaścāyayuśca badrike urvaśī tathā ||4.77.50||
aruṇā vimanuṣyā cānapāyā ca varāmbarā |
asiparṇā miśrakeśī śucikālambuṣā tathā ||51 ||
vidyutparṇā lakṣmaṇā ca tilottamārdrikā tayā |
rambhā kṣemāsitā mārīcikā manobhavā tathā ||52||
subāhvī supriyā puṇḍarikā ca sudatī tathā |
surasā subhujā cājagandhā haṃsā sarasvatī ||53||
ajayā kamalā sūtā sumukhī haṃsapādikā |
arūpā subhagā bhāsī manuvantī sukeśinī ||54||
menakā sahajanyā ca parṇinī pūrvacittikā |
kṛtasthalī ghṛtācī ca pramlocāstatra cāyayuḥ ||55|||
anumlocā tathā tanvī pūñjikasthalinī uṣā |
putryastāsāṃ prapautryaśca sahasraśaḥ samāyayuḥ ||56||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanalālasāḥ |
sarvā dāsyastathā tāsāṃ pārāyaṇe samāyayuḥ |||57||
badrike pārṣadāścāpi bālakṛṣṇasya cāyayuḥ |
pāvano vṛṣabho gopo vatsalaśca kumārakaḥ ||58||
siddho’ruṇo hāritaśca viśvo vipraśca kuṇḍala |
sahasrākṣaḥ suyogaśca mahīmāno vasantakaḥ ||99||
sahasraśirā madhvaścorukramo vikramastathā |
viśvākṣaścorugāyaśca viśvātmā jātavedakaḥ ||4.77.60||
ānandaściklītadevo devatrā vijayo jayaḥ |
nandaḥ sunandaśca vasuvano jayanta āyayuḥ ||61 ||
śrutadevaḥ pracaṇḍaśca caṇḍaḥ sāttvata āyayuḥ |
viśvaksenaḥ puṣpadantaḥ suparṇaḥ prabalo balaḥ ||62||

santoṣo brahmadṛk pradhyānaścidānanda ūrjakaḥ |
paramajñaḥ sunayaśca vinayaśca prabhañjanaḥ ||65||
acintyo’nantaḥ praśamo’moghaśca daharastathā |
viśvarūpaśca vaikuṇṭhaḥ prajñānauṃkārakau tathā ||66||
pratattvo nijabodhaśca puṇḍarīkastathottamaḥ |
uddhavaḥ śāśvataścāpi pūrṇabhadraḥ prabhūtakaḥ ||67||
ṛṣabhaśca subhadraśca nirālambo videhakaḥ |
sālambanastathānandaḥ dyukaṇṭhaśca prasattakaḥ ||68||
haṃsaḥ prahaṃso bhadrākṣo mañjulaśca pradhanyakaḥ |
prabodhaśca sujyotiśca satyeśaśca savitrakaḥ ||69||
avyayo maṃgalaścāpi tāpasaḥ suvratastathā |
suśīlaśca praturyaśca praviṣṇurvaradastathā ||4.77.70||
prajiṣṇurvallabhaścāpi prasādaḥ pradhanastathā |
avadāto’mṛtaścāpi prabhavo’dhvara ityapi ||71||
utsavaśca hiraṇyaścānagho viśruta āyayuḥ |
nirdeśo bhūṣaṇaścāpi nivṛttaśca pravardhanaḥ ||72||
saṃvṛtaśca bṛhadrūpaḥ prabhāvo’śoka āyayuḥ |
akāmaścāpi niṣkāmaḥ śrīgarbhaśca sudarśanaḥ ||73||
nirvāṇaśca virāmaśca dharmayūpo viśālakaḥ |
purātanaḥ pramodaścāmodaḥ supuṇya āyayuḥ ||74||
ādityaśca viśuddhaścodbhavo netrajña āyayuḥ |
śrīvāsaḥ kṛṣṇapādaśca pārṣadāste samāyayuḥ ||75||
svastikāḥ śeṣasaṃjñādyā nāgā ye vaiṣṇavottamāḥ |
anantādyā āyayuśca pārāyaṇāntimotsave ||76||
rājānaścāpi bhūmisthā badrike te samāyayuḥ |
śāvadīno lakṣmaṇaśca jummasemlaśca bhūpatiḥ ||77||
dakṣajavaṃgaraścāpi śibidevaḥ samāyayuḥ |
tharkūṭastho vīrajāraḥ śaktyakṣikaḥ samāyayuḥ ||78||
kālimāśo bālakāśaḥ kathakaśca samāyayuḥ |
pṛthurājastathoralaketuruṣṭrālarājakaḥ ||79||
tīrāṇaścāpi haṃkāro jayakāṣṭhala āyayuḥ |
alvīnaro jīnavarddhiralpaketuḥ samāyayuḥ ||4.77.80||
jayakṛṣṇavanṛpatiḥ parīśānanṛpastathā |
indurāyaśca mudrāṇḍo gaṇḍarājaḥ samāyayuḥ ||8 1||
vṛhaccharaśca līnorṇo balalīnaḥ samāyayuḥ |
rāyagānalabhūpaśca varasiṃho nṛpastathā ||82||

kāṣṭhayāno dinamānārkaśca vai rāyakinnaṭaḥ ||83||
rāyarokīśvaro rāyaraṇajīvaḥ samāyayuḥ |
rāyavākakṣakaścāpi rāyamārīśa ityapi ||84||
rāyabaleśvaro rāyalambārabhūpa āyayuḥ |
rāyanavārkabhūpaśca rāyahuṇḍeśabhūpatiḥ ||85||

vanajeleśabhūpaśca pārāvārapibo nṛpaḥ ||86||

<4.78>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi samājo’nantasaṃkhyakaḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāsamāpane || 1 ||
abhavaccharkarāpuryā sindhutaṭe samantataḥ |
mahodyāne viśāle vai daśayojanavistare || 2 ||
bhūtale drumasaṃkīrṇe gandhipuṣpādiśobhite |
svāgataṃ bhojanaṃ sarvasamājasya vyadhāt prabhuḥ || 3 ||
nivāsān pārṣadā dāsā dāsyaḥ sevāṃ pracakrire |
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe tvekādaśyāṃ prage hariḥ || 4 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ |
brahmapriyābhiḥ snapitaḥ śṛṃgāritaḥ priyājanaiḥ || 5 ||
vibhūṣito veṣitaśca pūjitaḥ sādhumaṇḍalaiḥ |
vandito bandisūtādyairnato’rcitaśca rājabhiḥ || 6 ||
vardhito vaiṣṇavībhiśca stuto bhāgavatairjanaiḥ |
nirīkṣitaḥ strīsamājaiḥ prasādito’ṅgasevakaiḥ || 7 ||
rājādhirājacihnādyairbṛṃhito divyapārṣadaiḥ |
kṛtapūjādisatkarmā vādyadhvaniṃ prakarṣayan || 8 ||
āyayau rājacihnāḍhyaḥ kathāmaṇḍapamacyutaḥ |
gajāsane svarṇamaṇihārāḍhye saṃvyarājata || 9 ||
āyayau bhagavān vyāsaḥ svataḥprakāśakāyanaḥ |
sabhājanaiḥ kṛtotthānaiḥ satkṛtaścāsanaṃ svakam || 4.78.1 0||
alaṃcakāra puṣpādipūjitaḥ śrāvito jayam |
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣigaṇā lālāyanādisādhavaḥ || 1 1||
ramādyāḥ śaktayo maṇimāṇikyādyā haripriyāḥ |
devyaśca devatā īśvarāṇya īśvarakoṭayaḥ || 1 2||
viprā vedavidaḥ sarve vaiṣṇavāḥ pāvanāḥ śubhāḥ |
siddhāśca bhūpaśārdūlāḥ prajā nāryo narāstathā || 1 3||
āyayuḥ saṃhitāsthāne maṇḍape ca yathāyatham |
niṣeduśca kathāraṃbho vyajāyata samaṃgalaḥ || 14||
muhūrtānte saṃhitāyāḥ samāptau śrīharestathā |
nyāsasya pūjanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādayaḥ ||15||
koṭirāyo rāyaharistathāgnidhrādayo nṛpāḥ |
sarve nṛpāḥ sarvadevāḥ sarvarṣayaśca sādhavaḥ || 1 6||
ānarcuḥ śrīsaṃhitāṃ ca vyāsaṃ svataḥprakāśakam |
prajājanāḥ śreṣṭhinaśca patrapuṣpaphalairjalaiḥ || 17||
svarṇarūpyakamudrābhirhīrakādyaiḥ sumauktikaiḥ |
maṇibhiḥ svarṇabhūṣābhiḥ pupūjuścandanākṣataiḥ || 18||
rājārhāmbaravaryaiśca rājārhabhūṣaṇādibhiḥ |
mukuṭādyairamūlyaiśca pupūjurvyāsamacyutam || 1 9||
svāyaṃbhuvaḥ kṣiteḥ rājyaṃ priyavrato’pi vai tathā |
uttānapādaḥ pṛthivīkhaṇḍarājyaṃ hare tava || 4.78.20 ||
ityārpayat tathāgnidhro hiraṇyādyāḥ samārpayan |

kevalāśca nṛpāḥ sajjā bhūtvā pratīkṣaṇe sthitāḥ ||34||
tadā vyacintayat kṛṣṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ lābhakāṃkṣayā |
naikarūpadharatvaṃ vai sarvaiḥ saha pramāṇakam || 35||
athaivaṃ saṃvicāryaivānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
badrike’dhārayannaikarūpāṇi sadṛśāni saḥ ||36||
svataḥprakāśavyāsātmā lomaśātmābhavatprabhuḥ |
tāvadrūpaśca pitrātmā mātrātmā cābhavatprabhuḥ ||37||
rādhāramādiśaktyātmā dāsadāsīsvarūpavān |
yāvanto rājanyavaryāstāvadrūpāṇyadhārayat ||38||
teṣāṃ tāvadvimāneṣu samāruroha mādhavaḥ |
tāvatsarvasvarūpātmā sarvasvavargarūpavān ||39||
śarkarānagaraṃ tyaktvāmbare vimānakāni vai |
abhavan badrike kṛṣṇājñayā tatsvāmijūṃṣi vai || 4.79.40||
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstadābhavan |
oṃ namo bālakṛṣṇāyānādikṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||41||
namaskārāścābhavam̐śca puṣpākṣatābhivardhanam |
cakrurlokā devatādyāścandanādyabhivarṣaṇam ||42|||
kṛṣṇājñayā vimānāni niryayuḥ sindhumaṇḍalāt |
prathamaṃ koṭirāyasyālayaṃ prati yayau drutam |||43||
dvitīyaṃ tu rāyaharimandiraṃ prati tad yayau |
tṛtīyaṃ tu yayau svāyambhuvamandiramujjvalam ||44||
caturthaṃ tu yayau divyaṃ priyavratālayaṃ prati |
paṃcamaṃ tu yayau divyamuttānapādamandiram ||45||
ṣaṣṭhamāgnīdhrarājyaṃ vai saptamaṃ tu hiraṇyakam |
aṣṭamaṃ ketumālaṃ ca navamaṃ tu kuruṃ prati ||46||
daśamaṃ kāśikārājaṃ yayau vimānamuttamam |
śāvadīnaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca jummāsemlaṃ nṛpaṃ prati ||47||
dakṣajavaṃgaraṃ śibidevaṃ prati pṛthak pṛthak |
tharkūṭasthaṃ vīrajāraṃ śaktyakṣikaṃ nṛpaṃ prati ||48||
kālimāśaṃ bālakāśaṃ kathakaṃ prati vai pṛthak |
pṛthurājaṃ pratyuralaketumuṣṭrālarājakam ||49||
tīrāṇaṃ cāpi haṃkāraṃ jayakāṣṭhalakaṃ prati |
pṛthak kṛṣṇasya yānāni yayustaistaiḥ sahaiva ha ||4.79.50||
alvīnaraṃ jīnavarddhimalpaketuṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
jayakṛṣṇavanṛpatiṃ parīśānanṛpaṃ prati ||51 ||
indurāyaṃ ca mudrāṇḍaṃ gaṇḍarājaṃ pṛthak prati |
vṛhaccharaṃ ca līnorṇaṃ balalīnaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||52||
rāyagāmalabhūpaṃ ca varasiṃhaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ |
phenatantunṛpaṃ stokahomaṃ ca kolakaṃ prati ||53||
kāṣṭhayānaṃ dinamānārkaṃ pṛthag rāyakinnaṭam |
rāyarokīśvaraṃ rāyaraṇajīvaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ ||54||
rāyavākakṣakaṃ cāpi rāyamārīśakaṃ prati |
rāyabaleśvaraṃ rāyalambaraṃ prati vai pṛthak ||55||
rāyanavārkabhūpaṃ ca rāyahuṇḍeśakaṃ prati |
rāyakūpeśabhūpaṃ ca kālimāṇḍalikaṃ prati ||56||
vanajeleśabhūpaṃ ca pārāvārapibaṃ pṛthak |
harervimānavaryāṇi yayustān prati vai pṛthak ||57||
koṭīśvaraṃ śrīsatīśaṃ tretākarkaśabhūpatim |
āṇḍajaraṃ bālyarajaṃ rāyasomanakaṃ pṛthag |||58||
ūrugavākṣakaṃ parāṅvratamīśānapānakam |
rājārāyapatiṃ cāpi vimānāni pṛthag yayuḥ ||59||
yajñaṃ dharmaṃ ca dhātāraṃ vidhātāraṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
nābhiṃ kimpuruṣaṃ cānyaṃ ramyakaṃ prati vai pṛthak ||4.79.60||
umārāyaṃ kṣīrapuruṃ nāgavikramaṇaṃ prati |
jayādityaṃ vikramārkaṃ kṛṣṇadurgaṃ ca pāñcalam ||61 ||
prabhālākṣaṃ lakṣasenam āmraśālaṃ śrīlambhanam |
prapatpālaṃ prāṇipātaṃ nandibhillaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ ||6 2||
rāyapāraṃ cendragṛtsaṃ gavayendraṃ janāstrakam |
karṇaputsamavadhyābhaṃ yāgadevaṃ paṭāsanam ||63||
dārābhāgyaṃ rājamānaṃ mādhavaṃ brahmapānakam |
śīlahāraṃ māṇikābhaṃ cittamāṃgeyakaṃ prati || 64||
candranāgaṃ medakośaṃ purukutsaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ |
bālasaṃghaṃ pārvateśaṃ nāgavijayakaṃ prati ||65 ||
rājamāruṃ mahendrābhaṃ madāśanaṃ nṛpaṃ prati |
śararaṃgaṃ madhurājaṃ virāmāsaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ ||66||
trikūṭārkaṃ mahāsāraṃ citralāsyaṃ nṛpaṃ prati |
kalikāñcanamāpāṇḍamakkalāryaṃ vivardhanam ||67||
maṇḍalāraṃ javalīnamindradyumnaṃ nṛpaṃ prati |
māṭharasiṃhaṃ nṛpaṃ kuṭidharaṃ cicintanaṃ pṛthag ||68||
udaṅprabhaṃ śrīnāgāriṃ dharaṇidhraṃ rajidhvajam |
mūradhvajaṃ kuṃkumāsyaṃ nṛpaṃ prati pṛthak pṛthak | |69||
yayurharervimānāni badrike saha taiḥ pṛthak |
tathā khaṇḍanṛpaiścāpi dvīpeśaiścābdhitīragaiḥ ||4.79.70||
raṇeśairadribhūpaiśca copabhūpaiḥ pṛthag yayuḥ |
tattaddeśān samullaṃghya tattadrāṣṭrāṇi saṃyayuḥ ||71 ||
tattannṛpālayodyānabhūmyādau tānyavātaran |
jalapānaṃ bhojanādi kārayitvāmṛtādanam ||72||
nagare bhrāmayāmāsuḥ svasvasmin bhūmipāstataḥ |
saṃhitāyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca vyāsasya pūjanaṃ guroḥ ||73||
sve sve divye mahāramye prāsāde cakrurutsukāḥ |
upadāścārpayāmāsū ratnahīrakamālikāḥ ||74||
sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ gṛhe yadyad rājye rāṣṭre tathottamam |
tattacchrīkṛṣṇasevāyāṃ nyadhuste rājasattamāḥ ||75||
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca papuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ hareḥ |
prasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsuḥ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇahastataḥ ||76||
sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ |
enaṃ prasādayāmāsurbhaktyā padmāvatīpatim ||77||
jagṛhuste mahāmantrān prajñānārāyaṇānanāt |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||78||
śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā |
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ||79||
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastivānava |
brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ ||4.79.80||
brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsī bhavāmi om |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||8 1 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me |
bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ||82||
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ poṣako’stu saḥ |
bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi |
tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayāt ||83||
oṃ śrīlakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai duḥkhabhaṃktryai śriyai namaḥ |
oṃ māṃ śrībālakṛṣṇāya samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ||84||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’haṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
śrīkṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ svāmī śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama ||85||
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīhariḥ svāmī śrīpatiḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
śrīkṛṣṇo vaiṣṇavācāryaḥ prabhuḥ padmāvatīpatiḥ ||86||
svāmī me śāśvataḥ kāntastasyāhaṃ svāminī priyā |
prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārameśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||87||
prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārvaṇo nārāyaṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
etānmantrān dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ||88||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rādhāramāyaṇa ||89||
prabho nārāyaṇa mādhavīśrīnārāyaṇa prabho |
jayānārāyaṇa śrīlalitānārāyaṇa vibho ||4.79.90 ||
kaṃbharāgopālalālaḥ svāmī patiśca māmava |
evaṃ mantrān nāmadhunyaṃ dadau cāpi svayaṃ hariḥ ||91 ||
tulasīkaṇṭhikāṃ cāpi tilakaṃ candraśobhitam |
dadau svacaraṇau teṣāṃ vakṣaḥsthaleṣu mādhavaḥ ||92||
jagṛhuste hare raktacaraṇau raṃgaśobhitau |
mudrāpitau śubhau sarvapādacihnasuśobhitau ||93||
dakṣahastatalasyāpi sacihnamudrikāṃ śubhām |
jagṛhuste tu pūjārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ tu rañjitām ||94||
pratikṛtiṃ pratimāṃ ca pratirūpaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ |
citraṃ kṛtvā hariṃ gehe rakṣayāmāsuranvaham ||95||
badrike dvādaśīrātriṃ sarvageheṣu mādhavaḥ |
uṣitvā tu tataḥ prātaḥ kṛtasevādarāśanaḥ ||96||
kṛtapūjaḥ samastaiśca toṣitastoṣitaiśca taiḥ |
savādyagītayaśasā jayanādaiḥ samantataḥ ||97||
prasthāpito vimāne sve pṛthak samāruroha ca |
tadā sarve’ntimāṃ naijāṃ prārthanāṃ cakrurīśinaḥ ||98||
hare svāmin kṛpāsindho pāvitāḥ kṛpayā vayam |
tathaiva cāntakāle’pi pāvanān svākṣaraṃ naya ||99||
madhye sadā mūrtirūpo rakṣayāsmān tavāśritān |
hṛdaye svaṃ divyarūpaṃ sadā cedaṃ pradarśaya || 4.79.10 0||
tavāsmīti tava smaśca tathā pālaya sarvadā |
evaṃ māyāvimoho na bhavannaiveti cintaya || 10 1||
ityevaṃ badrike sarve cakruścābhyarthanāṃ prabhoḥ |
pūjāyāmāgataṃ yadyat sarvaṃ prasādarūpi tat || 1 02||
haristebhyaḥ pradātṛbhyaḥ pratyārpayat kṛpāvaśaḥ |
āśīrvādān śubhān datvā svīkṛtya prārthanāṃ tataḥ || 10 3||
prāpya vidāyamevāsau paśyan bhaktānnṛpādikān |
prajājanāḥ prapaśyam̐śca premṇā vimānamairayat || 1 04||
ambare sahasā kṛṣṇavimānāni samauḍḍayan |
tiro’bhavan cidākāśe kṛṣṇātmakāni tāni vai || 105||
ekībhūtāni sarvāṇi saurāṣṭre’śvasaro’ntike |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre vimānamekamāyayau || 1 06||
avātiracchanaiḥ kṣetre dyotayan sarvatodiśaḥ |
bhagavān vyāsadevādyā lomaśādyā maharṣayaḥ || 1 07||
pitarau dāsikā dāsā viviśuḥ svasvamandiram |
evaṃ śrībadrike pārāyaṇasyāsya mahotsavaḥ || 1 08||
abhūt sarvotsavāgryaśca pārāyaṇāgrya eva saḥ |
tatastu cakrire tvanye makhān bhāgavatottamāḥ || 1 09||
svārociṣastathā bhūpā uttamastāmaso’pi ca |
raivataścākṣuṣaścāpi vaivasvato’pi tannṛpāḥ || 4.79.11 0|||
ete ca manavaḥ pārāyaṇotsavān pracakrire |
anye cāpi vidhāsyanti mahābhāgavatottamāḥ || 111 ||
mokṣaśāstramidaṃ badri dharmārthakāmanāphalam |
sarveṣṭadāyakaṃ cātmaparamātmaprasaṅgadam || 1 12||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya kathotsavasya cintanāt |
sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ sulabhā sulabhā divyasampadaḥ || 1 13||
mokṣalābho bhaveccāpi sarveṣaṇāprapūrttayaḥ |
kalpavṛkṣasamāstasya saṃkalpāḥ saphalā drutam || 1 14||
manaścintāmaṇiprakhyaṃ prajāyeta na saṃśayaḥ |
kathānāṃ dhāraṇāllakṣmītulyā nārī bhavedapi || 1 15||
naro nārāyaṇaḥ syācca kathānāṃ dhāraṇādiha |
badrike sarvasṛṣṭau tat pārāyaṇaṃ jayatyati || 1 16||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’khilanṛpārthitaḥ śrīharirnaikarūpadharaḥ san sarvanṛparāṣṭramandirāṇi yayau, pūjāṃ pragṛhya pāvayitvā tirobhūyāśvapaṭṭasaraḥ pratyāyayāvityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||

<4.80>
śrībadrīpriyovācasarvakalyāṇakartaḥ śrīkānta kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
kiṃ cakāra tataḥ sarvaṃ caritraṃ vaktumarhasi || 1 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
nāgavikramabhūpena yajñe tvākārito yayau || 2 ||
pāravatyā nijapatnyā prabhayā nijakāntayā |
yutaḥ santuṣṭayā svasrā dāsadāsīgaṇairyutaḥ || 3 ||
yayāvasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya śarkarāpure |
pratijñātaṃ tu yajñārthaṃ yuddhapurādhipena yat || 4 ||
nāgavikramasaṃjñena samārabdho makhastu saḥ |
tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau nimantritaḥ || 5 ||
sarvamedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīśvaravallabhaḥ || 6 ||
nāgavikramarājeśo mahābhāgavatottamaḥ |
cāturmāsyavrataṃ kurvan sarvamedhaṃ cakāra ha || 7 ||
yuddhapure lunīnadyāstaṭe viśālabhūtale |
pañcayojanavistāre maṇḍapaṃ sa tvakārayat || 8 ||
śrāvaṇaśuklaikādaśyāṃ kṛtasaṃbhārasañcayaḥ |
yajñamārabhata kṣmeśo viprayājñikanoditaḥ || 9 ||
āyayustatra bhūdevāḥ sādhavo vaiṣṇavā api |
narā nāryo lakṣaśo vai dharmakāryaparāyaṇāḥ || 4.80.1 0||
brahmābhavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam |
yajamāno nāgavikramākhyo bhūpo hi vaiṣṇavaḥ || 11 ||
ṛtvijo gālavādyāśca maharṣayo’bhavanmakhe |
phālāyano’bhavattatrodgātā sāmaparāyaṇaḥ || 12||
sārāyaṇo’bhavatpratyudgātā vedārthavittathā |
ajāyano’bhavattatrāhartā vaidikasatkriyaḥ || 1 3|||
daṇḍāyano’bhavatpratihartā sarvakriyāparaḥ |
bhālāyanastu ṛṣirāṭ prastotā cābhavanmakhe || 14||
rasāyano’bhavat pratiprastotā yajñakarmaṇi |
hotā dhārāyaṇaścaiva pratihotālavāyanaḥ || 15 ||
jāpakāścārbudā viprāḥ pauṣkarā havanārthinaḥ |
yāmuneyā dvijāścāsan dikpālā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ || 16||
saurāṣṭrīyāḥ pūjakāśca dvijāścāsam̐stadā makhe |
gaurjarāḥ pācakāścāsan marujāḥ pariveṣakāḥ || 17||
gāṃgeyā vedamantrādivyākhyātāro’bhavanmakhe |
sindhujāḥ pāṭhakāścāsan sabhāsadāstu pūrvajāḥ || 18||
dakṣiṇātyā havanārthā āsam̐statra ca jāpakāḥ |
maharṣayo vaśiṣṭhādyā guravastu nirīkṣakāḥ || 1 9||
draṣṭārastatra sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ vai tadābhavan |
madhyasthā vaidikā viprā āsan prakhyātanāminaḥ ||4.80.20||
lomaśādyāstathā mārkaṇḍeyādyā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ |
haimācalāḥ kṛṣṇanāmnāṃ kīrtaneṣvabhavan sthirāḥ ||21 ||
evaṃ vai badrike yajñe’bhavan viprā vyavasthitāḥ |
sādhavo lakṣaśaścāpyabhavan bhajanakāriṇaḥ || 22||
prajāśca khaṇḍarājanyā āmantritāḥ samāyayuḥ |
lakṣātilakṣamanujāḥ sarvamedhe’bhavam̐stadā |||23|||
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ sudhākulyāstadābhavan |
payaḥkulyā madhukulyā śarkarāparvatāstathā ||24||
miṣṭānnānāṃ parvatāśca pānānāṃ prasarāṃsi ca |
bhakṣyāṇāṃ setavaścāsan sarvamedhe’tra badrike ||25||
phalānāṃ lehyacośyānāṃ mahādrayo’bhavan makhe |
dānārhahomayogyānāṃ meravastatra cābhavan ||26||
samidhāṃ pāyasānnānāṃ kṣīrāṇāṃ sañcayottamāḥ |
kaṇānāṃ cāpi śimbīnāṃ rāśayo’pyabhavanmakhe || 27||
vastrāṇāṃ kambalānāṃ ca bhūṣāṇāmadrayo’bhavan |

suvarṇānāṃ rajatānāṃ sañcayāścābhavanmakhe

daśa sūtyāstathā badri dīkṣāśca dvādaśāpi vai |
upasado dvādaśaśca yathāyogyaṃ vyavartayan || 31 ||
bhādrapūrṇāvadhiryāgaścatustriṃśaddinātmakaḥ |

bṛhaspatisavādyāśca āptoryāmāntakāḥ śubhāḥ |
