sādhubhiḥ saha tiṣṭhanti tasmāt tyāgaḥ sadottamaḥ ||69||
ākṣaraḥ paramānande hyutsavā bhuktakoṭikāḥ |
kuṭumbaṃ cācyutaṃ yatra tasmāt tyāgaḥ sadottamaḥ ||4.88.70||
nartanaṃ bhagavadarthe vyāpārāḥ kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye |
ārambhā yatra muktyarthāstasmāt tyāgaḥ sadottamaḥ ||71 ||
makhā bhāgavatā yatra prasādaśca satāṃ hareḥ |
kṛṣirmāyāmalahantrī tasmāt tyāgaḥ sadottamaḥ |||72||
jīvanaṃ cātmasiddhyarthaṃ pravṛttiḥ kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye |
brahmagṛhaprayāṇaṃ ca tasmāt tyāgaḥ sadottamaḥ ||73| |
yena tyaktaṃ samastaṃ vai samastairujjhitaḥ sa vai |
tyāgaḥ svātmārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe sarvārpaṇaṃ hi muktaye ||74||
muktirvai śāśvatānandamagnatākṣaradhāmani |
atrāpyanubhavastādṛṅ muktaḥ sa tyāgavān guruḥ ||75||
ye ye’rthā iṣṭatāpannāste te tyāge hyakalmaṣāḥ |
siddhyanti sarvathā sādhvi prajñe mādhavi siddhavat ||76||
tatastyāgāśramaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pūjyo mānyaśca mokṣadaḥ |
phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na vai puṣpaṃ na patraṃ nāpi mañjarī ||77||
phale pakvarasaḥ śreṣṭho rase miṣṭāmlako rasaḥ |
śreṣṭho nārāyaṇo miṣṭaścāmlastatrātiraktatā ||78||
snehabhaktidharaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prāpyastyāgena cottamaḥ |
kevalastu parastyāgo na śreṣṭho bhajanaṃ vinā ||79||
upāsanāṃ vinā tyāgaḥ pāṣāṇatvāya kalpate |
sevāṃ dhyānaṃ vinā tyāgaścāgaskaro na saṃśayaḥ ||4.88.80||
jñānaṃ vinā tathā tyāgaścāgaskaro’sti sarvathā |
gurorājñāṃ vinā tyāgo vairāgyamantarā tathā ||8 1 ||
āgaskaraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāptiśūnyo phale mṛṣā |
saṃsāratyajanaṃ sārthaṃ yadyātmā harimāpnuyāt ||82||
na prāptistu hareryena prāptānāṃ yatra nāśanam |
pumarthā niṣphalā yatra sa tyāgaścāga eva ha ||83||
jñānaṃ copāsanā bhaktirdivyatā śrīharismṛtiḥ |
mokṣasthitirguṇāstyāge sādhutā muktatāpi ca ||84||
kevalastu mahātyāgo doṣa evāsti dehinaḥ |
prastaro’pi mahātyāge tiṣṭhatyeva sa tādṛśaḥ ||85||
tyāge maurkhyaṃ ca garvaśca mānaṃ ca jaḍatā tathā |
phalecchā tyaktasājātyagocarā dūṣaṇāni vai ||86||
upavāsī pāraṇāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ grasate yadi |
pūrvadine’pi dviguṇaṃ tadopavāsitā mṛṣā ||87||
tyāgī paścācchataguṇaṃ gṛhṇāti svarjanaṃ tapaḥ |
satyamaiśvaralokaṃ ca tadā tyāgaphalaṃ nu kim ||88||
anityaṃ tu prāgabhavat paścādanityamityapi |
dvayoḥ paryavasānaṃ tu nāśe tyāgo vivartate ||89||
doṣastyāge mahān so’sti yaduttamābhirāgitā |
prāptaṃ tyaktaṃ cādhruvaṃ tat prāptavyaṃ svaṃ tathādhruvam ||4.88.90||
dhruvaṃ nālambitaṃ brahma tyāge tredhāpi dūṣaṇam |
tyajanād vāpyabhiyogād brahma sampadyate yayā ||9 1 ||
sevayopāsanayā vājñayā jñānena vā tathā |
tyāgena vidhinā vāpi sa tyāgo bhoga eva vā ||92||
brahmaprado yataḥ śreṣṭho guṇa eva sa uttamaḥ |
kṛṣṇecchādhīnavāñchātmatyāga uttama eva saḥ ||93||
mokṣasthityanubhāvātmatyāga uttama eva saḥ |
tadvinā dūṣaṇaṃ tyāgo bhāra eva sa kevalaḥ ||94||
śṛṇutaṃ mādhavi sādhvi prajñe tyāge tu bhūṣaṇam |
audāsīnyaṃ bādhitānuvṛttistu dūṣaṇaṃ tathā ||95||
karmatyāgo bhūṣaṇaṃ vai kṛṣṇatyāgastu dūṣaṇam |
nārītyāgo bhūṣaṇaṃ satkriyātyāgastu dūṣaṇam ||96||
doṣatyāgo bhūṣaṇaṃ vai guṇatyāgastu dūṣaṇam |
gṛhiṇāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ tyāgo bhūṣaṇaṃ bhogasampadaḥ ||97||
tyāgināṃ dūṣaṇaṃ bhogo bhūṣaṇaṃ bhogavarjanam |
mama bhaktiḥ satāṃ sevā devā devārhātithipūjanam ||98||
sudhārmikaṃ tu dāmpatyaṃ bhūṣaṇāni tu dāriṇām |
ātmaniṣṭha mayi niṣṭhā tadanāsaktavṛttitā ||99||
nityabhaktiśca satsaṃgastyāgināṃ bhūṣaṇāni vai |
kṣamā bhūṣaṇaṃ sādhūnāṃ satkāro gṛhiṇāṃ tu tat || 4.88.1 00||
sādhvīnāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ śīlaṃ mamājñā bhaktabhūṣaṇam |
bhūṣaṇaṃ sthānināṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ bhūṣā tu yoginām ||1 0 1||
tyāgavatāṃ tvanāsaktirbhūṣaṇaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ satī |
aśraddhā tyāgināṃ doṣo dehābhimāna ityapi || 10 2||
ālasyaṃ dharmahīnatvaṃ nāstikyaṃ dūṣaṇāni vai |
viṣayāṇāṃ sevanecchā dūṣaṇaṃ paramaṃ tu tat || 10 3||
dhyānāśrame dhane vāñcchā dūṣaṇaṃ tyāgināṃ sadā |
kuṭumbiṣu snehavṛttistyāgināṃ dūṣaṇaṃ param || 1 04||
dāridryaṃ tu gṛhasthānāṃ doṣakṛd dūṣaṇaṃ mahat |
tṛṣṇā doṣo hi sarveṣāṃ rājñāṃ tu bhūṣaṇaṃ matā || 1 05||
jñānināṃ jñānatṛṣṇāpi bhūṣaṇaṃ tyāgavat sadā |
bhaktānāṃ bhaktitṛṣṇāpi mama tṛṣṇātibhūṣaṇam || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne gṛhagītāyāṃ gṛhasthasya mokṣopāyāḥ, tyāgāśrame rūkṣatā niścintatā sukhitā ca, yathārthatyāgo yathārthā doṣāśca, guṇatā doṣatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||

<4.89>
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇutaṃ mādhavi sādhvi prajñe saṃsāramagnatām |
brahmacārī prathamo vai svābhyudayaṃ samicchati || 1 ||
janmataḥ sarvabālā vai bālakā brahmacāriṇaḥ |
āgārhasthyaṃ tarkayanti śraiṣṭhyamudayamunnatim || 2 ||
adhyayanaṃ kalāśikṣāṃ vyāpāraṃ jīvikākriyām |
bhṛtyatvaṃ dāsatāṃ yadvā kṛṣiṃ rakṣāṃ ca kārutām || 3 ||
tatsaṃkalpāḥ prajāyante mahattvākāṃkṣayānvitāḥ |
ākāṃkṣāstāḥ samastā vai bandhanaṃ brahmacāriṇām || 4 ||
gṛhasthānāṃ priyāyāṃ vā svāmini svasutādiṣu |
dhane gṛhe ca sampatsu bhavatyāsaktiranvaham || 5 ||
sā vāsanāsvarūpā syād bandhanaṃ vāsanāmayaḥ |
saṃsārastu gṛhasthānāṃ kuṇape sukhamāninām || 6 ||
viyogaṃ na sahante vai mithaḥ saktā rudanti ca |
vahanti kaṣṭaṃ yatpaścānmṛtiṃ yantyanu kecana || 7 ||
evaṃ rāgābhisannaddhā magnāḥ saṃsārasāgare |
gṛhasthāḥ saṃprajāyante punarāvṛtticakriṇaḥ || 8 ||
yeṣāṃ lokaiṣaṇā putraiṣaṇā vittaiṣaṇāsti ca |
te vai saṃsāramagnā hi nottaranti kadācana || 9 ||
api ye yatayo yeṣāṃ neṣṭaṃ vai kṛṣṇamantarā |
teṣāṃ ceddehapūjeṣṭā rāgāsaktī tu bandhane || 4.89.1 0||
tyaktvā gṛhaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca grāmaṃ dhanaṃ ca sampadaḥ |
tyāgī maṭhe ca śiṣyeṣu vāse dravye tathāśrame || 1 1||
āsaktaḥ sa tu saṃsāre magna eva na saṃśayaḥ |
upādiśya janān dravyādibhyaḥ pracyāvya taddhanam || 12||
ākāṃkṣati svayaṃ tyāgī saṃsāre magna eva saḥ |
tyāgī bhūtvā gṛhasthānāṃ śuśrūṣāṃ tu karoti yaḥ || 1 3||
svārthavṛttiḥ sa evāsti magnaḥ saṃsārakardame |
tyāge sthitaścintayati mānaṃ me na na pūjanam || 14||
na kīrtirna yaśo me’sti na me rājyādarastathā |
na prajāyāṃ na sammānaṃ sampado me na na priyā || 15||
na prāsādo na me yānaṃ vāhanaṃ na na vāṭikā |
na me kṣetraṃ nāmbaraṃ me narddhirna dhiṣṇyamityapi || 16||
nācāryatvaṃ gurutvaṃ na naiśvaryaṃ na praśaṃsanam |
na kṣetraṃ na sutaścāpi na bhṛtyo na paśurgajaḥ || 17||
nāśvo nāsti vimānaṃ me na miṣṭānnāśanotsavaḥ |
na śṛṅgāro na cāṃgāro nāgāraṃ me na catvaram || 18||
na śayyā me na paryaṃko na dāso me na dāsyakṛt |
na bandī me na sevākṛnnāsti vidyā na saṃskṛtiḥ || 19||
ityevamihayākṛṣṭo majjatyagādhasāgare |
saṃsāranāmake magno na nissarati karhicit || 4.89.20||
mādhavi vidhimutsṛjya vartante kāmagarvitāḥ |
ye te prajñe sumajjanti saṃsāre ghorasāgare |||2 1 ||
vidhiṃ dṛṣṭvā gurorājñāṃ mamājñāṃ saṃprapālya ca |
vartante ye mamavṛttāsteṣāṃ naimnyaṃ na vai kvacit ||22||
patnī yā patyurājñāyāṃ vartamānātigāpi ca |
sā nikṛṣṭā na vai kvāpi yājñā sā dharmarūpiṇī ||23||
yatiḥ sādhuḥ satī sādhvī tyāgī yogī viraktakaḥ |
mamājñāyāṃ vartamānāḥ praṇālīrītivarjitāḥ |||24|||
alokamilanāścāpi samūhaviparītagāḥ |
aślīlavṛttakācārā amaryādāsthitā api ||25||
brahmabhāvaparācārāḥ śreṣṭhā eva sadā hi te |
na nimnatvaṃ viraktānāṃ brahmasthitijuṣāṃ kvacit ||26||
na nimnatvaṃ hi devānāmīśvarāṇāṃ tathā kvacit |
na muktānāṃ nimnatā nāvatārāṇāṃ tathā kvacit ||27||
nāpyavatāriṇīnāṃ ca nimnatvaṃ vidyate kvacit |
satīnāṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ nimnatā nāsti karhicit ||28||
ājñāyāṃ sampado bhogā nirguṇā na tu bandhadāḥ |
ājñālabhyā viraktānāṃ bhogā nairguṇyaśālinaḥ ||29||
bandhadā na bhavantyete kṛṣṇaprasādarūpiṇaḥ |
tyāgināṃ śrīharerājñā muktidā saguṇāguṇā ||4.89.3 0||
kṛṣṇājñā nirguṇā tasmāttakṛtirnirguṇā sadā |
lokavattu harerlīlā tyāgilīlāpi mokṣadā ||3 1 ||
kṛṣṇārpaṇīkṛtā ceṣṭā sarvā nirguṇatāṃ vrajet |
amāyikī sthitiśceyaṃ tyāgināṃ bandhavarjitā ||22|||
dārāstu bandhanaṃ mokṣe yadi vighnavidhāyinī |
pumān vai bandhanaṃ tadvanmokṣe vighnakaro yadi ||33||
mokṣadau tau mithaścedvai parasparaṃ na bandhanam |
prajñe śrīmādhavi tattvaṃ cākarṇaya tu bandhakṛt ||34||
pativratā yadi nārī mokṣatattvābhivartinī |
sā nārī bandhanaṃ naiva pumām̐stasyāstu bandhanam ||35||
patnīvrataḥ pumān yasyā mokṣamārgābhivartanaḥ |
sa pumān bandhanaṃ naiva tasya nārī hi bandhanam || 36||
samaśīlau bandhane na viśīlau bandhane matau |
kāmāsaktasya vai nārī bandhanaṃ vartate sadā |||37||
tadviraktasya vai nārī bandhanaṃ nāsti sarvathā |
evaṃ striyāstu tādṛśyāḥ pumān bandho vibandhanam || 28||
āsaktirbandhanaṃ tṛṣṇā rāgo gṛdhnā ca bandhanam |
saṃskārā bandhanaṃ cāpi vāsanā bandhanāni vai ||39||
nārītvaṃ ca naratvaṃ ca sāpekṣaṃ dehayogataḥ |
yāvadātmani sphurati tāvadvai bandhanaṃ matam ||4.89.40 ||
brahmātmabhāvato nārīnaratve vigate yadā |
tadā tu bandhanaṃ sarvaṃ līyate mayi satprabhau ||41||
mādhavi gahanā yuṣmadasmadarthasya vārtikā |
sā yāvad bandhanaṃ tāvat sā gatā bandhanaṃ gatam ||42||
vilīyante tu pāpāni kṣīyante karmarāśayaḥ |
sevayāhaṃ prabhuḥ prasādito mokṣaṃ dadāmi vai ||43||
vaitṛṣṇyaṃ guṇamātreṣu sneho guṇātige mayi |
sarvārpaṇaṃ yadā nāryā narasyāpi ca mokṣaṇam ||44||
bhrāntiryadā layaṃ prāptā vivekaśca prakāśate |
ākarṣaṇaṃ mayi yatra kṣaṇe tadā tu muktatā ||45||
guruśāstrasatāṃ sevā śuśrūṣā paramātmanaḥ |
atyutkṛṣṭā pākamāptā yadā tadā tu mokṣaṇam ||46||
tattvābhyāsānnijajñānaṃ mayi snehasamanvitam |
prārabdhasya kṣayāntaśca mokṣaḥ phalaṃ prapadyate ||47||
ātmāhaṃ naiva deho’smi na māyāsmi na vāsanā |
na nārī na naraścāsmītyevaṃvidasya mokṣaṇam ||48||
brahmāsmi brahmaṇaścāsmi saccidānandarūpyaham |
mayi nārāyaṇaścāste evaṃpaśyasya mokṣaṇam ||49||
strīgocarāstu saṃkalpāḥ saṃskārāśca yadā kṣayam |
yanti tadā narasyāpi mokṣaṇaṃ nānyathā kvacit ||4.89.50||
kṣīyante tu yadā nāryāḥ saṃkalpā naragocarāḥ |
saṃskārāśca tadā mokṣo mithyāsphuraṇasaṃkṣayāt ||5 1 ||
strīliṅgo’haṃ pulliṃgo’haṃ yāvadasti guṇāṅkuraḥ |
tāvad baddhastatkṣaye’sya mokṣo bhavati dehinaḥ |||52|||
kṛtādhikārasarvasvo nivṛttaḥ sarvarāgataḥ |
nirvātasthadīpaśikhāsthirastaraṃgavarjitaḥ ||53||
antastattve kṛtasnehaścāntarātmābhirāmakaḥ |
tadanyaudāsīnyamāptaścātmā mokṣagato bhavet |||54|||
striyā rādhāramātulyā matirmayi yadā bhavet |
tadā mokṣe sthitā sāsti kṛpayā paramātmanaḥ ||95||
strī patyarthaṃ tu sarvasvaṃ yathā karoti cārpaṇam |
tathā mayyarpitāyāstu mokṣaṇaṃ kṛpayā mama ||56||
yathaikasmin priye putre bāle mātustadātmatā |
taddhyānaṃ taccintanādi tathā cenmayi mokṣaṇam ||57 ||
śavahartuḥ śmaśāne vai kṣaṇaṃ rāgo vinaśyati |
tathā rāgādihīnasya drutaṃ bhavati mokṣaṇam ||58||
anapatyā yathā nārī bharturmṛtyau praśocati |
tathāvegavatī kṛṣṇe mucyate bhavabandhanāt ||59||
mahāpatsvāvarito yo rakṣakaṃ dhyāyati kṣaṇam |
tathā dhyāyati kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ sa drutaṃ mucyate bhavāt ||4.89.60||
ātmārthaṃ kriyate yāvaddharyarthaṃ kriyate yadi |
tadā mokṣaḥ kare cāsti phalaṃ pakvaṃ bhunakti saḥ ||61||
yathā nadyaḥ samudreṣu vegavatyo’bhiyanti vai |
tathā nāryo mayi veginyaścenmokṣaṃ viśanti tāḥ |||62||
yāvatpatyurapekṣāsti patnyapekṣā ca vā manāk |
tāvanmuktirbhaved dūre’pekṣānāśe kare bhavet ||63||
yasyā brahmamayī buddhirdṛṣṭirbrahmamayī sadā |
sarvaṃ brahmaspṛśaṃ yasyāstasyā mokṣasukhaṃ tviha ||64||
yasyā nirlepatābuddhiryasyāḥ śaityauṣṇyavarjitā |
māyāsvādā layaṃ prāptāstasyā mokṣaphalaṃ tviha ||65||
yasyāḥ kāmā nivartante santi cet kṛṣṇagocarāḥ |
asāṃkaryasthitiṃ prāptāstadā mokṣaphalaṃ tviha ||66||
jāgratsu viṣayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svapnasya viṣayo hariḥ |
suṣupteścāntarātmā ca turye’kṣarasthitaḥ prabhuḥ ||67||
yasyā bhavet sadā tvevaṃ yasya vā tau hi mokṣiṇau |
taskarasya yathā caurye naṭasya khelane yathā ||68||
śatroḥ śatrau yathā vṛttirekāgrā mokṣadā mayi |
sādhvyā sneho yathā sādhau cakorasya niśādhipe ||69||
śalabhānāṃ pradīpte’gnau matsyānāṃ piṣṭabhojane |
kāmāturasya vai nāryāṃ mokṣadaḥ sa tathā mayi ||4.89.70 ||
yathā mūrchātiratyante śastraghāte’timūrchanā |
suṣuptau mādake vā ca tathā vai mayi muktidā ||71 ||
yathā matirjīvane sve svārthe’bhigamanaṃ yathā |
svasmin yathā guṇadṛṣṭistathā vai mayi mokṣadā ||72||
gṛhasthasya ciraṃ mokṣastyāginastu drutaṃ mataḥ |
gṛhasthastyāgamāpannaḥ śīghraṃ mokṣaṃ pravindati ||73||
tyāgī gṛhasthācāraścenmokṣārthaṃ sa cirāyate |
gṛhasthasya tyāgino vā sādṛśyaṃ jñānasatkṛtam ||74||
viṣavad viṣayā yasya sādṛśyaṃ vai tayormatam |
sudhāvanmokṣaṇaṃ yasya sādṛśyaṃ vā tayoḥ sadā ||75|||
lokaḥ sudhāyate’nyasyaikasya sudhāyate hariḥ |
dvayoḥ panthā vibhinnaśced vaidharmyaṃ tu tayostadā ||76||
ye vā ke vā brahmabhāvā brahmajñānā haripriyāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti yadā sādhvyau tadā mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ ||77||
strīdharmitvaṃ gṛhasthasya vaidharmyaṃ tyāginastu tat |
parigraho gṛhasthasya tyāginastvaparigrahaḥ ||78||
tīvrasaṃvegamāptasya drutaṃ mokṣo bhavediti |
tyāgino vā gṛhasthasya sa mandasya cirāyate ||79||
sadharmitvaṃ dehavattvaṃ vidharmitātmabhāvanā |
dhīsvāmitvaṃ sadharmitvaṃ strīsvāmitvaṃ vidharmitā ||4.89.80||
satkarmitvaṃ sadharmitvaṃ naiṣkarmyaṃ tu vidharmitā |
phale rāgaḥ sadharmitvaṃ puṣpe rāgo vidharmitā ||8 1 ||
sāpekṣatvaṃ sadharmitvaṃ nairapekṣyaṃ vidharmitā |
yātrālutvaṃ sadharmitvaṃ nikṣepastu vidharmitā ||82||
arvāgvṛttiḥ sadharmitvaṃ parāgvṛttirvidharmitā |
punarecchā sadharmitvaṃ śāśvatecchā vidharmitā ||8 3||
sthūlabhogāḥ sadharmitvaṃ prajñābhogo vidharmitā |
cidānandaḥ sadharmitvaṃ sadānando vidharmitā ||84||
nijānandaḥ sadharmitvaṃ parānando vidharmitā |
gṛhasthatyāginoścaivaṃ tyāginaḥ sā kramād vidhā ||85||
śṛṇutaṃ jñānipatnyau me hyrubhayorgṛhadharmitām |
eka āyāti garbhādvai tathaiko vardhate sadā ||86||
eko yuvā ca vṛddhaśca prayātyekaḥ paretakaḥ |
punarjanma punarmṛtyurgṛhe tiṣṭhati vai punaḥ ||87||
gṛhaṃ garbho gṛhaṃ saudhaṃ gṛhaṃ naijaṃ vapustathā |
gṛhaṃ karma gṛhaṃ tṛṣṇā gṛhaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhati ||88||
sa gṛhṇāti gṛhaṃ tadvai gṛhyate yena tad gṛham |
citā gṛhaṃ maraṇotthaṃ garbho gṛhaṃ tu karmajam ||89||
saudhaṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtrimaṃ vai tadvān gṛhastha ucyate |
tyāgino vā gṛhasthasya dvayoḥ sā gṛhadharmitā ||4.89.90||
ātitheyatvamātmaniṣṭhatvaṃ devārpaṇaṃ vratam |
dānaṃ snānaṃ dhyānamiṣṭārādhanaṃ japakīrtane ||9 1 ||
havanaṃ pitṛtṛptiśca dvayoḥ sā gṛhadharmitā |
gṛhiṇī gṛhamevāpi strī gṛhasthasya sā matā ||92||
tyāginastu harermūrtirgṛhiṇīva priyā sadā |
tayā sākaṃ sthitiryā sā hyubhayorgṛhadharmitā ||93||
śṛṇutaṃ mādhavi prajñe dvayośca tyāgadharmitām |
yathā yuvāṃ sādhike stho nirdvandve kṛṣṇamānase ||94 ||
yathāhaṃ tāpasaścāsmi nirdvandvo vāṃ parāyaṇaḥ |
yuvāṃ patnyau patiścāhaṃ tathāpi dvandvatā nahi ||015||
na saṃsāro gṛhitvaṃ na kintvasti tyāgadharmitā |
evaṃvidhayordampatyoḥ sadāsti tyāgadharmitā ||96||
yathā śaṃbhośca pārvatyā yogaḥ putrārtha iṣṭakṛt |
evaṃvidhayordampatyoryogastu gṛhadharmitā ||97||
āsane parṇakuṭyāṃ ca vṛkṣe dehe tu suṣṭhutā |
bhāsate cet tyāginastad bandhanaṃ gṛhadharmitā ||98||
bhogo vai mānaso yasya kriyā tu cobhayātmikā |
anyataḥ sukhitā ceti tyāgino gṛhadharmitā ||99||
tyāge yatno harau prītirmokṣe cecchātmani sthitiḥ |
ratirjñāne jape karma dhyāne śāntiḥ parātmanaḥ || 4.89.10 0||
yasya vai tyāginaḥ santi sa tyāgityāga uttamaḥ |
bhogyaṃ dehendriyabuddhyādikaṃ māyāmayaṃ jagat || 101 ||
bhoktā tena tu sambaddhaścātmā karmānugo vaśī |
ātmātmā yaḥ paramātmā sa tvabhoktā pṛthagvidhaḥ || 1 02||
abhogyaṃ cetanaṃ sarvaṃ vikāravarjitaṃ yataḥ |
bhogaḥ sukhasya duḥkhasya vā sākṣāttvaṃ nijasya vai || 1 03||
bhogaṃ vihāya satataṃ vartate yaḥ sa muktarāṭ |
sa eva tvaritaṃ sādhvyau parabrahmābhivindati || 1 04||
ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ jñātavyaṃ hitakṛt tathā |
etajjñātvā pālayitvā mokṣārthaṃ nāvaśiṣyate || 105||
gṛhagītā mayoktā vo gṛhabandhananāśinī |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktiḥ kare bhavet || 1 05||
catuḥpumarthalābhaśca parā śānti tathātmani |
sarvodvegāḥ praṇaśyeyurgṛhagītārthacintanāt || 1 07||
sarvaiṣaṇānivṛttiśca sakāmānāṃ sukhāptayaḥ |
gṛhe mokṣābhigamanaṃ gṛhagītārthacintanāt || 1 08||
nārī nārāyaṇī syācca naro nārāyaṇo bhavet |
aṅgane gṛhagītāyāḥ svarūpaṃ bhagavanmayam || 1 09||
gṛhagītārthavijñānāṃ pāpalepo na karmabhiḥ |
gṛhitve’pi sadā tyāgisamatvaṃ śobhate’malam || 4.89.110 ||
sarve vighnā nivartante bādhante siddhayo’pi na |
saṃskārā na tvarāyante gṛhagītābhipāṭhinām || 111 ||
suvarṇatā bhavatyasyāmṛtatā ca bhavatyapi |
bhaved dibyāmbaratā ca gṛhagītābhipāṭhinām || 112||
kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ pūjya vidhivad gṛhagītāṃ paṭhettataḥ |
tasyeṣṭasiddhirjāyeta tvaritā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 113 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne gṛhagītāyāṃ sarvāśramiṇāṃ saṃsāramagnatā, vidhyājñāvatāṃ magnatā na, strīpuṃsorbandhanābandhane, sevādibhirmokṣaṇam, gṛhityāgino vaidharmyaṃ sādharmyaṃ ca, gṛhitvārthaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 89 ||

<4.90>
śrīpadmāvatīprajñe procatuḥ
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmina sarvoddhāraparāyaṇa |
saṃsārakardamasthānāmuddhārako’si vai prabho || 1 ||
yeṣāṃ jñānaṃ na vā dhyānaṃ na japo neṣṭadevatā |
na gururna makho dharmaḥ kintu pāpāni santi vai || 2 ||
na satsaṃgo vrataṃ nāsti na tīrthaṃ viprabhojanam |
na sādhubhojanaṃ kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ nāsti vai tathā || 3 ||
teṣāṃ saṃsāramagnānāṃ samuddhārāya sādhanam |
mokṣadaṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ sugamaṃ yad vadasva nau || 4 ||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇutaṃ mādhavi sādhvi prajñe saṃsārimuktaye |
pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ sādhanaṃ gopradānakam || 5 ||
gṛhāśramastu pāpāḍhyo godānaṃ pāpanāśakam |
uddhārakaṃ yamadūtabhayāt saṃrakṣakaṃ sadā || 6 ||
pitruddhārakaraṃ svargapradaṃ vaṃśapradaṃ tathā |
sampatpradaṃ hi godānaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadgatipradam || 7 ||
yena nānyat kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ kartavyaṃ gopradānakam |
godānena prajāyante samagrā iṣṭasiddhayaḥ || 8 ||
godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ pṛthivī gosvarūpiṇī |
godānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadānaṃ dhenuḥ kṛṣṇapriyā sadā || 9 ||
godānaṃ yajñapuṇyādipradaṃ gauryajñarūpiṇī |
godānaṃ śrīramādānaṃ gaurhi lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī || 4.90.1 0||
godānaṃ tu sarvarasapradānaṃ dugdhadā hi gauḥ |
gaurmātā sarvalokānāṃ payobhiḥ poṣaṇapradā || 1 1||
dātavyā sarvathā dāne dogdhrī vatsatarīyutā |
gurave sā pradātavyā vaiṣṇavāya tu sādhave || 12||
viprāya sā pradātavyā makhine’tithisevine |
aṅgane yajamānastu snātaḥ kṛtābhivandanaḥ || 1 3||
yāyād goṣṭhaṃ makhadvāraṃ devālayaṃ maṭhaṃ satām |
tīrthaṃ yāyāt prakuryādvai śuddhyarthaṃ tīrthavāriṇā || 14||
ācamanatrayaṃ netre jalasparśaṃ tathācaret |
hastapādau ālayecca dakṣe kare jalaṃ śubham || 15||
gṛhṇīyād deśakālādi puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ |
gururdānasya saṃkalpaṃ kuryācca kārayettathā || 1 6||
jalaṃ bhūmau pramucyātha namaḥ kuryāt payasvatīm |
savatsikāṃ mātaraṃ gāṃ punarjalaṃ kare nyaset || 17||
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ nijasambandhināṃ tathā |
kuṭumbināṃ ca saukhyārthaṃ karomi gopradānakam || 18||
ityuktvā tajjalaṃ pṛthvyāṃ muñced varuṇasākṣikam |
namaskuryācca gāṃ paścāt kare dhṛtvā tu kuṃkumam || 19||
yajamāno vadet sveṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ gosamīpataḥ |
ārogyārthaṃ sampadarthaṃ putrapautrādisiddhaye |||4.90.20||
vaṃśavistārasaukhyārthaṃ saukhyārthaṃ yaśase tathā |
tāpatrayavināśārthaṃ dharmārthaṃ mokṣahetave ||21 ||
sarvaśatruvināśārthaṃ nirvighnakāryasiddhaye |
pretānāṃ mama muktyarthaṃ sarvapāpādiśāntaye || 22||
sarvakleśavināśārthaṃ puṇyārthaṃ goprapūjanam |
dhenudānāṃgabhūtaṃ vai karomi kuṃkumādibhiḥ ||23||
binduṃ bhāle kuṃkumena karomi candanādibhiḥ |
mama saubhāgyasiddhyarthaṃ karomi tilakaṃ tu goḥ || 24||
mama kuṭumbisaukhyārthaṃ pūjāṃ karomi cākṣataiḥ |
mama puṇyasya lābhārthaṃ dīpaṃ dhūpaṃ karomi ca ||25||
mama sampatpravṛddhyarthaṃ gave bhakṣyaṃ dadāmi ca |
mama svargasya siddhyarthaṃ gave vāri dadāmi ca ||26||
pitruddhārāya ca gave guḍaṃ miṣṭaṃ dadāmi ca |
navasasyāni bījāni kārpāsasya dadāmi ca || 27||
vastraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ pṛṣṭhe dadāmi jhullarīṃ śubhām |
mālyaṃ mālāṃ puṣpamālāṃ svarṇamālāṃ dadāmi ca || 28||
ambaraṃ ca vibhūṣāśca gave dadāmi śṛṅgayoḥ |
svarṇaśṛṅge rūpyakhurāḥ khureṣu pradadāmi ca ||29||
dohanaṃ tāmrapātraṃ ca śṛṅkhalāṃ pradadāmi ca |
suvarṇaghaṇṭikāyuktaṃ hāraṃ kaṇṭhe dadāmi ca || 4.90.30||
bhakṣyapātraṃ pānapātraṃ dohapātraṃ dadāmi ca |
gavāṃ kharjananāśārthaṃ kharjakaṃ pradadāmi ca ||3 1 ||
devagurvoḥ pratuṣṭyarthaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ pradadāmi ca |
gulālābīrakuṃkumākṣataiḥ prapūjayāmi gām ||32||
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiścāpi tulasīpatrakaistathā |
pūjayāmi prakaromi pradakṣiṇacatuṣṭayam || 33||
pṛthvīpradakṣiṇatulyaṃ cārthayāmi sukhāptaye |
namo’stu brahmamūrtibhyo viśvamātṛbhya oṃnamaḥ ||34||
lokādhivāsinībhyaśca rohiṇībhyaśca vai namaḥ |
gavāmaṅgeṣu tiṣṭhanti sarve devāstatheśvarāḥ ||35||
avatārāśca pitarastiṣṭhanti śrīramādikāḥ |
golalāṭe gaṇeśo’sti gaṇeśaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||36||
gośṛṃgayostu goloko vaikuṇḍastau namāmyaham |
gonetrayoḥ sūryacandrau vasatastau namāmyaham || 37||
vaiśvānaro’sti dhenvāsye vaiśvānaraṃ namāmyaham |
godanteṣu grahāḥ sarve grahān sarvānnamāmyaham ||38||
gonasoraśvinīputrau kumārau tau namāmyaham |
gavoṣṭhayornāradastumburustau praṇamāmyaham ||39||
gokarṇayornaranārāyaṇau tau praṇamāmyaham |
gojivhāyāṃ śāradāsti śāradāṃ praṇamāmyaham ||4.90.40||
gokaṇṭhe praṇavaścāsti oṃkāraṃ praṇamāmyaham |
brahmā gale kambale tu sāvitrī tau namāmyaham ||41 ||
śaṃbhuḥ kakudi skandhe tu śivā tau praṇamāmyaham |
viṣṇurhṛdaye lakṣmīśca śakṛti tau namāmyaham ||42||
mūtre gaṅgā yamunā ca sarasvatī namāmi tāḥ |
pucche tu pitaraḥ santi pitṝn sarvānnamāmyaham ||43||
pṛṣṭhavaṃśe tu ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣīn sarvānnamāmyaham |
pārśveṣu devatāḥ santi devatāstā namāmyaham ||44||
romasu sādhavaḥ siddhā vasanti tānnamāmyaham |
pucche śeṣaśca viṣṇuḥ śrīstān sarvān praṇamāmyaham ||45||
pucchānte sarvatīrthāni tīrthāni praṇamāmyaham |
udare lokapālāśca lokapālānnamāmyaham ||46||
oghasyamṛtasarvasvaṃ brahmāmṛtaṃ namāmyaham |
staneṣu sāgarāḥ sarve rādhāputrānnamāmyaham ||47||
vakṣo’gre tu brahmahrado brahma tatpraṇamāmyaham |
pādeṣu pārṣadā viṣṇostān sarvān praṇamāmyaham ||48||
khureṣu tu makhāḥ sarve tān yajñān praṇamāmyaham |
goṣṭhaṃ brahmākṣaraṃ dhāma gosthalīṃ praṇamāmyaham ||49||
godhūlirjaṃgamaṃ tīrthaṃ dhūliṃ mūrdhni vahāmyaham |
gotakraṃ goghṛtaṃ dhenukṣīraṃ gorasamityapi ||4.90.50||
gonavanītamevāpi brahmapīyūṣapañcakam |
dāne dadāmi tatsarvaṃ tṛpyantāṃ pitaraḥ surāḥ ||51||
rohiṇyo dogdhrya īśvaryo mātaraḥ pāntu māṃ sadā |
gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvaḥ santu ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||52||
gāvaḥ śirasi me nityaṃ gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham |
vatsatarī bhaktirūpā vatso dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||53||
kṛṣṇaśaṃbhupriyau pātāṃ māṃ sadā sakuṭumbakam |
svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vairājaṃ bhaumaṃ vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||54||
śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ golokamakṣaram |
brahmadhāma ca me gāvo dadatveva ca sampadaḥ ||55||
tvaṃ devi sarvadevānāṃ vāsarūpāsi tāriṇī |
kāmadhenusamastānāṃ pratimāyai ca te namaḥ ||56||
sarvakāmaprade mātargolokavāsini priye |
pāpahe puṇyade mokṣaprade mātaśca te namaḥ ||57|||
māmasmāt sāgarāllakṣmīrūpe tāraya sarvathā |
sarvasampatprade kṛṣṇapriye tāraya sāgarāt ||58||
putrān pautrān putrikāśca dhanaṃ dhānyādi dehi me |
aiśvaryāṇi ca dīrghāyurārogyaṃ sampradehi me ||59||
saubhāgyaṃ patisaubhāgyaṃ patnīsaubhāgyamityapi |
dravyasaubhāgyamevāpi dehi me kāmapūrike ||4.90.60||
ityabhyarthya yajamāno gurorhaste dvijasya ca |
jalaṃ dadyānmayā dattā gaurgṛhyatāṃ samuccaret ||61||
gave puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyānnamaskuryād gave sate |
gurave cāpi viprāya sādhave pātrayogine ||62||
dhenuṃ dadyāt sugurave mahācāryāya sādhave |
viprāya yogyapātrāya vaiṣṇavāya ca śārṅgiṇe ||63||
mahyaṃ kṛṣṇāya dātavyo mandirāya harāya ca |
anyaratnāni dhānyāni deyavastūni yāni ca ||64||
tāni sarvāṇi dadyācca yathāyogyebhya ādarāt |
bhojayed bālikā bālān satīḥ sādhvī sato dvijān ||65||
puṣpahāraṃ gavocchiṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīyād yajamānakaḥ |
gopūjāsalilaṃ pucchapāvanaṃ praṇamed gṛhe ||66||
prokṣaṇaṃ gṛhamadhye vai kuryādgopūtavāriṇā |
puṣpahāraṃ rakṣayecca vidhnanāśakaro hi saḥ ||67||
guruṃ sampūjayettatra gopūjāyā anantaram |
vatsaṃ vatsāṃ pūjayecca praṇamecca pradakṣiṇam ||68||
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyād yathāśakti kṛtādaraḥ |
kapilāṃ gāṃ ca dhavalāṃ raktāṃ karburikāṃ ca vā ||69||
dadyāttasyā phalaṃ sādhvyau vairājapadamuttamam |
kṛṣṇāṃ dhūmrāṃ piśaṃgīṃ ca dadyād vedhaḥpadaṃ phalam || 4.90.70||
dogdhrīṃ yāṃ kāṃ pradadyācca phalaṃ tvindrapadaṃ divi |
vatsāṃ dadyāt phalaṃ tasya devatābhavanaṃ divi ||71 ||
dadyādubhayatomukhīṃ phalaṃ tasyāḥ paraṃ padam |
ākṣarī paramā muktiḥ śāśvatī pauruṣottamī ||72||
asūtakīṃ pradadyādvai dogdhrīṃ golokadā tu sā |
godānasya yajamānaḥ pālayed govrataṃ tadā ||73||
divārātraṃ vrataṃ kuryādekabhojitvameva ha |
gavyāśitvaṃ prakuryādvai gosevāṃ sarvathā caret ||74||
brahmacaryaṃ tadekāhaṃ pālayed gosthale svapim |
mālayā śrīhariṃ māṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ japet ||95||
godānena samaṃ dadyānmāsagrāsatṛṇānyapi |
kārpāsabījakādīni dadyād gobhuktaye sadā ||76||
pratyakṣāṃ gāṃ pradadyādvai śreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ hi tanmatam |
gavālābhe gāṃ prapūjya tanmūlyaṃ cārpayetparam ||77||
mūlyārdhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā svalpaṃ daśāṃśakaṃ ca vā |
dadyād yathādhanaṃ bhakto natvā śrīgurave muhuḥ ||78||
yathāśakti mayā dattaṃ kṣamasvāpūrṇamatra yat |
kuryācca daṇḍavattasmai vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||79||
godānaṃ mandire śreṣṭhaṃ devālaye taduttamam |
maṭhe sādhvāśrame śreṣṭhaṃ makhe pārāyaṇālaye ||4.90.80 ||
vivāhamaṇḍape śreṣṭhaṃ tīrthe sarittaṭe’pi ca |
vratāhe puṇyadivase mahotsave śubhotsave ||8 1||
śreṣṭhaṃ dhenupradānaṃ vai svāsthye kuryāt kareṇa vai |
yā dhenurdīyate dāne sā divyā maraṇottaram ||82||
svargamārge dharmamārge hyagre’gre yāti rakṣikā |
dhenudānapradātā na yātyasadgatimīśvari ||8 3||
vaitaraṇyāṃ duḥkhanadyāṃ dhenuścottāriṇī priye |
paraloke pragantuśca pretasya bhojanapradā ||84||
dhenuṃ svarṇamayīṃ dadyād dhenuṃ ca rājatīṃ tathā |
dhenuṃ dhānyamayīṃ dadyāddhenuṃ kārpāsakīṃ tathā ||85||
dhenuṃ rasamayīṃ dadyād dhenuṃ sampanmayīṃ tathā |
dhenuṃ kanyāmayīṃ dadyāt kanyāhīno jano bhuvi ||86||
vidhivanmaṇḍapaṃ kuryād vedīṃ kuṇḍaṃ ca kārayet| |
dānavastūni sarvāṇi tathā ratnāni sannyaset ||87||
dhenuṃ svakanyakāṃ kṛtvā nāmānvitāṃ tadā |
kanyāvastrāṇi sarvāṇi kanyakābharaṇāni ca ||88||
kanyādhenuṃ maṇḍape vai kṛtvā dadyād dvijātaye |
havanaṃ kārayettatra vāditrāṇi pravādayet ||89||
kanyādānavidhiṃ yogyaṃ kārayenmaṇḍape tadā |
kanyādānaphalaṃ tasya dhenudātuḥ prajāyate ||4.90.90||
kanyādhenuṃ rohiṇīṃ vai dadyād vṛṣabhāsaṃginīm |
agarbhiṇīṃ mahāvatsīṃ dadyāt kanyāsvarūpiṇīm ||9 1 ||
mahāvatsīpradānena kanyāvān jāyate tataḥ |
evaṃdānapradātā syāt svargabhāk mokṣabhāk tathā |||92||
bhuktimuktimahāmuktisampanno jāyate sadā |
pitṝṇāṃ tārakaścāpi kuṭumbināṃ ca tārakaḥ ||93||
sarvapuṇyasupātraṃ ca brahmānandamayo bhavet |
anapatyo dhenudātā sāpatyo hi samāntare ||94||
aputraḥ putravān syācca varṣāntare na saṃśayaḥ |
śubhaṃ kālaṃ ca satpātraṃ prāpya dadyāt pradānakam |||95||
gataḥ kālaḥ śubho yastu punarnāyāsyati kvacit |
gṛhastho dharmakarmārthahīno godānamācaret ||96||
gaustasyoddhārikā sādhvyau śataikādikuṭumbinām |
godātre tu gururdadyādāśīrvādān tadākṣataiḥ ||97||
dhanavān putravām̐llakṣmīsampadvān bhava pārthivaḥ |
ārogyavām̐stathā śrīmān varcasvavān janeṣvapi ||98||
āyuṣyavān bhogavām̐śca vaṃśavistāravān bhava |
svargavān surasampadvān mokṣavān bhava cottare ||99||
vaṃśe te gopradātāro jāyantāṃ mokṣabhāginaḥ |
dhārmikā devabhaktāśca prajoddhāraparāyaṇāḥ || 4.90.10 0||
sādhusevāparāḥ santu nāryaḥ santu pativratāḥ |
satya santu ca te vaṃśe rādhālakṣmīsamāḥ striyaḥ ||1 01 ||
svasti te’stu sadā loke paraloke’pi te’stu tat |
gauriyaṃ sarvathā svasti karotvagre gatā tava | | 10 2||
oṃ namaḥ śrīgopataye rādhāyāḥ pataye namaḥ |
gavātmani sthitaścāhaṃ sākṣī kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | | 103 ||
māṃ saṃsmṛtya priye padmāvati kuryādgavārpaṇam |
kṛṣṇārpaṇamidaṃ dānaṃ cāstvityuktvā visarjayet | | 1 04||
ityevaṃ supriye śreṣṭhaṃ sādhanaṃ vāṃ mayoditam |
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya dhenudānaphalaṃ bhavet | | 105||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne gṛhagītāyāṃ sarvadharmādivarjitagṛhiṇo’pi mokṣādisādhanaṃ godānaṃ gosthadevādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||

śrīpadmāvatīprajñe procatuḥ
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin godānaṃ cet kṛtaṃ na hi |
mokṣārthaṃ tvaparaṃ kiñcidasti cennau vadātra ha || 1 ||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca
satāṃ dehena manasā sevā vai karmaṇā sadā |
sarvasampatpraṭā mokṣapradā pāpavināśinī || 2 ||
yeṣāṃ na vratavijñānaṃ dharmajñānaṃ na vidyate |
dāridryaṃ vidyate cāpi mālinyaṃ tīrthavarjitā || 3 ||
teṣāṃ sādhostu satsaṃgāt pāpanāśaśca mokṣaṇam |
jāyate nātra sandehaḥ satsaṃge bhagavān sthitaḥ || 4 ||
satāṃ samāgamo bhārye bahudhā rucibhedataḥ |
yasya bhavati tasyāghavināśo mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || |9 ||
netrābhyāṃ darśanamātraṃ satsaṃgo darśanātmakaḥ |
hastābhyāṃ saṃvāhanādi satsaṃgo dehamardanaḥ || 6 ||
śuśrūṣā kāryakāritvaṃ cājñāyāmanuvartanam |
bhṛtyatā dāsyamevāpi satsaṃgo dehadānakam || 7 ||
padbhyāṃ gamanaṃ sādhūnāmāśramaṃ prati nityadā |
pradakṣiṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ satsaṃgāścaraṇārpaṇaḥ || 8 ||
mastakena namet santaṃ satsaṃgo namanātmakaḥ |
prāñjaliḥ praṇamet santaṃ satsaṃgaḥ prāñjaliḥ sa tu || 9 ||
praśaṃsejjihvayā santaṃ satsaṃgaḥ śaṃsanātmakaḥ |
prasādaṃ bhakṣayet sādhoḥ satsaṃgo rasanātmakaḥ || 4.91.10 ||
śṛṇuyāttatra kathāṃ sādhoḥ satsaṃgaḥ śravaṇātmakaḥ |
spṛśet sādhuṃ snehapūrvaṃ satsaṃgaḥ sparśanātmakaḥ || 11 ||
gandhaṃ satāṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt puṣpaprasādasaṃbhavam |
gandhasāraṃ satāṃ dehāt satsaṃgo ghrāṇanātmakaḥ || 1 2||
āśliṣyet sādhuvaryaṃ tu satsaṃgaḥ sañjanātmakaḥ |
prasādayenmodayecca satsaṃgo nandanātmakaḥ || 1 3||
stuvītājñāṃ pālayecca satsaṃgaḥ stavanātmakaḥ |
seveta satataṃ sādhūn satsaṃgaḥ sevanātmakaḥ || 14||
viharet sādhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ satsaṃgo bhramaṇātmakaḥ |
vicaret sādhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ satsaṃgo maṇḍalātmakaḥ || 15||
nivasettu satā sākaṃ satsaṃgaḥ sa gṛhātmakaḥ |
manyeta pitaraṃ sādhuṃ satsaṃgaḥ sa sutātmakaḥ || 1 6||
pramanyeta guruṃ sādhuṃ satsaṃgaḥ śiṣyavartanaḥ |
susādhoḥ śaraṇaṃ gacchet satsaṃgaḥ śaraṇātmakaḥ || 17||
bhojanaṃ sādhave dadyāt satsaṃgo bhojanātmakaḥ |
dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ dadyāt satsaṃgaḥ sa rasātmakaḥ || 18||
vastraṃ ca kambalaṃ dadyāt satsaṃgaścāmbarātmakaḥ |
chatraṃ dadyāccāmaraṃ ca satsaṃgaḥ karaṇātmakaḥ || 1 9||
pātraṃ śayyāṃ pradadyācca satsaṃgaḥ śayanātmakaḥ |
gṛhaṃ saudhaṃ pradadyācca satsaṃgo bhavanātmakaḥ ||4.91.20||
yānaṃ dadyādvimānaṃ ca satsaṃgo vāhanātmakaḥ |
annaṃ śākaṃ phalaṃ dadyāt satsaṃgastarpaṇātmakaḥ |||2 1 ||
jalaṃ dadyāt lepayecca satsaṃgaḥ snānanāmakaḥ |
sādhuṃ śṛṃgārayet puṣpaiḥ satsaṃgo bhūṣaṇātmakaḥ || 22||
sādhuṃ cāvāhayedgrāme gṛhe vāṭyāṃ prapūjayet |
bhrāmayed grāmamadhye ca satsaṅgaścotsavātmakaḥ |||23||
upadeśaṃ dhārayecca satsaṅgo bodhanātmakaḥ |
dravyaṃ samarpayettasmai satsaṅgaḥ sa dhanātmakaḥ || 24||
iṣṭadānaistoṣayecca satsaṅgastoṣaṇātmakaḥ |
āśīrvādān labhet sādhoḥ satsaṅgaḥ sa varātmakaḥ ||25||
auṣadhādi diśet tasmai satsaṅgaḥ sa nirāmayaḥ |
samidādi diśed yajñe satsaṅgaḥ samidātmakaḥ ||26||
adhyāpayettu sādhūn vai satsaṅgo’dhyāpanātmakaḥ |
brahmavidyāmarjayecca satsaṅgo brahmabuddhidaḥ |||27||
dhyāyet sādhuṃ ca māṃ nityaṃ satsaṅgo dhyānayogadaḥ |
kīrtayecchrīhariṃ sādhūn satsaṅgaḥ kīrtanātmakaḥ ||28||
sādhvarthaṃ sarvaśaḥ kuryāt satsaṅgo nirguṇo hi saḥ |
sādhureva hariryasya tasya kāryaṃ na vidyate ||29||
eva satāṃ sevanena satsaṅgena mamāṅgane |
mokṣaḥ kare sthito bodhyaḥ kartavyaṃ nāsya śiṣyate ||4.91.30||
śṛṇutaṃ bhāvanāṃ sādhujane gurau yathāyatham |
kartavyavidhinā samyak kṛtāṃ saṃvarṇayāmi vām || 3 1||
sādhuṃ divyaṃ vijānīyād brahmamūrtimamāyikam |
pāvanaṃ puṇyamūrtiṃ ca nirlepaṃ puruṣottamam ||32||
sādhupādarajaḥ puṇyaṃ sādhuvastraṃ ca pāvanam |
sādhusevyaṃ samastaṃ vai pāvanaṃ cāpyamāyikam ||33||
sādhusparśaḥ pāvano’sti sādhubhuktaṃ hi pāvanam |
jalānnaphalapuṣpādiḥ prasādaḥ pāvanaḥ satām || 34||
sādhvāsanaṃ pavitraṃ ca pāduke pāvane satām |
sarvopakaraṇādyaṃ ca pāvanaṃ sarvathā satām ||35||
sādhordantā nakhāḥ keśāḥ pāvanāḥ pāpanāśakāḥ |
sādhvāśleṣaḥ pāvano vai sarvābhicāranāśanaḥ ||36||
upādhyādhivyādhināśakaraḥ sādhoḥ samāgamaḥ |
sādhvāśramo mahattīrthaṃ sādhvāśrayaśca pāvanaḥ ||37||
sādhūnāṃ vasatirdivyā mahāvaikuṇṭhaśālinī |
sādhvāgamaḥ svastidātā śreyasāṃ varṣakaḥ sukhaḥ ||38||
kalyāṇaśevadhiḥ sādhoḥ prasannatā tu sevayā |
sādhoḥ sneho brahmalābhapradaḥ prītiḥ pramokṣadā ||39||
sarvānandapradā sādhoḥ saṅgatirbhayavarjitā |
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyabhayāpahā ||4.91.40||
sādhoḥ śikhānte virajā nadī golokajāsti vai |
śikhāmūle brahmahrado’kṣarastho rājate sadā ||41 ||
brahmarandhe’kṣaraṃ dhāma goloko mastake’sti ca |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu lalāṭe’sti bhālamadhye ramāpuram |||42||
bhālāntayoramṛtāvyākṛtadhāmadvayaṃ sthitam |
karṇayostu mahāviṣṇuvairājau dvāvavasthitau ||43||
netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca gaṇḍayorve dhruvadvayam |
nāsāyāṃ maruto devā mukhe nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||44||
oṣṭhayoramṛtaṃ divyaṃ miṣṭamānandasaṃbhṛtam |
jihvāyāṃ sarvavedāśca mukhagarbhe’gnidevatā ||45||
śabde vāṇī śāradāśrīḥ rūpe lakṣmīrhi kandhare |
kaṇṭhe sarvā brahmavidyā hṛdaye brahma śāśvatam ||46||
cetane’haṃ parabrahma saṃkalpe kṛṣṇadevatā |
vakṣasi dharmadevaśca pṛṣṭhe pitaro devatāḥ ||47||
pārśvayorbrahmarudrau ca viṣṇururasi tiṣṭhati |
udare cānnapūrṇāsti nābhau svargaṃ surālayam ||48||
jaghane śrīgaṇeśaśca gupte caiśvaryakoṭayaḥ |
kaṭyāṃ pṛthivī dvāvadrī cāstodayau nitambayoḥ ||49||
skandhayoraniruddhaśca pradyumnaśceti tāvubhau |
bhruvoḥ saṃkarṣaṇo vāsudevo bhrūmadhyagaḥ satām ||4.91.50||
bhujayostu diśāṃ pālā lokapālāstu hastayoḥ |
hastatalayoḥ śrīrbhūśca vibhūtayo’ṅguliṣvapi ||51||
nakheṣu tārakāḥ santi grahā vasanti parvasu |
sarvaromasu tīrthāni vasanti sādhuvigrahe ||52||
vacane kāmagāvaśca cintāmaṇayaścintane |
kalpadrumā hyanuvṛttau sauhṛde kalpavallayaḥ ||53||
nāḍīṣu tīrthasaritaḥ sarovarāṇi kukṣiṣu |
āntreṣu kāśyapāḥ sarve vasanti sādhuvigrahe ||54||
sakthnoḥ śilādaprahlādau jānunorbalivāmanau |
jaṃghayornāgalokāśca pādayoḥ śeṣakacchapau ||55||
śaktayaḥ santi sarveṣu sandhiṣu sādhuvigrahe |
muktā ghātuṣu vartante pārṣadāḥ sādhusatkṛtau |||56||
siddhayo dhāraṇāyāṃ ca sādhordhyāne haristvaham |
sādhutādātmyavāso’smi bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||57||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rāje hi sādhuṣu |
aṅgane sādhumūrtau na tyāgabhāgau kathaṃcana ||58||
evaṃ tu bhāvayet sādhuṃ tathaiva sevayet sadā |
sarvaṃ samarpayed yastu tasya mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ ||59||
sādhvike bhāvayitvaivaṃ pūjayet sevayet sataḥ |
prātaḥ prabodhasamaye dehasaṃvāhanaṃ caret ||4.91.60||
utthitāya jalaṃ dadyād dantadhāvanamarpayet |
jalapātraṃ pradadyācca dehaśaucārthamityapi ||61||
hastaśaucaṃ kārayecca pātraśuddhiṃ vidhāpayet |
yatheṣṭavāribhirdivyaistīrthajalaiḥ sugandhitaiḥ |||62||
snānamālepanapūrvaṃ kārayeccāndanairjalaiḥ |
sugandhitailasammiśraiḥ snāpayettilacūrṇakaiḥ ||63||
āmalakādicūrṇaiśca mardayet sādhuvigraham |
dugdhena snāpayeccāpi paraṃ śuddhajalairapi ||64||
vastraiḥ sammārjayed dehaṃ sugandhaṃ prokṣayettathā |
vastrādhānaṃ bhūṣaṇāni śṛṃgāraṃ mālikādibhiḥ ||65|||
puṣpaiḥ saubhāgyacūrṇaiśca kuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ |
kārayecca tato dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tilakaṃ candrakam ||66||
kārayed raṅgarūpādyaṃ raṃjayet sādhuvigraham |
kajjalaṃ netrayordadyāt keśeṣu tailamityapi ||67||
āsanaṃ paṭṭikādyaṃ ca siṃhāsanaṃ sate’rpayet |
āvāhanaṃ ca pādyaṃ cācamanīyaṃ tathārpayet ||68||
arghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca dadyāt śrīsādhave rasān |
naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ diśet ||69||
yajñopavītakaṃ dadyānmekhalāṃ yogapaṭṭakam |
kambalaṃ naktakaṃ dadyātpuṣpagucchaṃ kare’rpayet ||4.91.70||
naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ sugandhaṃ bhakṣyamityapi |
dugdhasāraṃ kṣīramiṣṭaṃ pūrikāḥ prārpayed dadhi ||7 1 ||
takraṃ jalaṃ prārpayecca mukhavāsaṃ tathārpayet |
paryaṃkaṃ vāhanaṃ yānaṃ pāduke chatramarpayet ||72||
śayyāṃ dadyāt svāpayecca pavanaṃ prārpayettathā |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ dehamardanaṃ dāsyamācaret ||73||
yadyadapekṣitaṃ dadyād daihikaṃ mānasaṃ ca vā |
prakāśaṃ cāprakāśaṃ ca yadicchettatprapūrayet ||74||
evaṃ kuryāt satāṃ sevāṃ pāvanīṃ śrīpradāṃ tadā |
hariḥ sākṣāt pūjito’haṃ teneyaṃ sṛṣṭirarcitā ||75||
sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tīrthaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā |
sādhupādajalaṃ divyaṃ pibet tīrthādipāvanam ||76||
sarvaṃ tīrthaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tu sevayā |
sādhuḥ prasādito yena tena kṛṣṇaḥ prasāditaḥ ||77||
kṛṣṇaḥ prasādito yena brahmadhāmni sa modate |
parānandamayo bhūtvā sarvān kāmān samaśnute ||78||
sādhutoṣaṇakācchreṣṭhaṃ tulyaṃ vā sādhanaṃ param |
vidyate naiva saralaṃ mokṣārthaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ bhuvi ||79||
sarvapāpaharāḥ santo hariśīlaparā yataḥ |
brahmavrataparā yasmānmahābhāgavatā yataḥ ||4.91.8 0||
nibodhata priye patnyau gṛhī yathā tu toṣayet |
patnyai sarvaṃ pradāyaiva yathā patnīṃ pratoṣayet ||8 1 ||
putraṃ putrīṃ yathā pratoṣayed gṛhī tadiṣṭadaḥ |
tathā sādhuṃ pradāyaiva toṣayedabhivāñcchitam |||82||
bhrātre pitre pataye ca pradāyaiva yathā gṛhī |
iṣṭaṃ sate tathā datvā toṣayet santamanvaham ||83||
mahīmānārthamevāyaṃ gṛhī yādṛgvyayaṃ bahum |
karoti tu tathā kuryāt satāmarthe sa mokṣabhāg ||84||
sate pauṣpaṃ samukuṭaṃ dadyānmūrdhni suśobhanam |
sādhave pracchadapaṭīṃ dadyāt pauṣpīṃ ca sūtrajām ||89||
badhnīyāt puṣpakaṭakān bhujayośca prakoṣṭhayoḥ |
ārārtrikaṃ prakurvīta bahuvartisamanvitam ||86||
pradakṣiṇaṃ prakuryācca kuryācca daṇḍavanmudā |
pādayormastakaṃ dadyānmūrdhni hastau nidhāpayet ||87||
satāṃ prasādaṃ bhuñjītāśīrvādān dhārayecchubhān |
puṣpāñjaliṃ sate dadyād dānaṃ yatheṣṭamarpayet ||88||
evaṃ śrīlalane sādhoḥ sevayā gṛhadharmiṇām |
satsaṃgasya balāt sarvāghāni naśyanti sarvathā ||89||
satāṃ puṇyaṃ labhetāpi sampatpradaṃ pramokṣadam |
prārthayettu sataḥ sādhvīḥ kṣamāpayettadagrataḥ ||4.91.90||
kṛpāsindho dayāsindho śaraṇāgatavatsala |
sādho hyasādhulokānāmasmākaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavān ||9 1||
na sādhanāni jānāmi na puṇyāni karomyapi |
nārādhanaṃ pāpahaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ sādhanaṃ na ca ||92||
agatīnāṃ gatistvaṃ me bhavāraṇye’tidurgame |
saṃsārasāgare naukā tārayitrī pravartase ||93||
sarvapāpavināśārthaṃ muktyarthaṃ sukhahetave |
sādho kṛṣṇasvarūpo’si tvāṃ prapadye harestanum ||94||
vayaṃ nityaṃ patitāḥ smo ghore saṃsārakardame |
prakṣālya naḥ samuddhartuṃ samartho’si samuddhara ||95||
pūjane sevane sādho nyūnaṃ vā kramavarjitam |
mānahīnaṃ ca vā yattat kṣamasva śaraṇaṃjuṣam ||96||
oṃ namo gurudevāya sādhave paramātmane |
asmaddaivatarūpāyoddhārakartre muhurnamaḥ ||97||
ityabhyarthya namaskṛtya samarpya gurudakṣiṇām |
visarjayet sadāsmatsu prasanno bhava tāpasa ||98||
āyāhi nityamevātra pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa māmakīm |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca sampattiṃ pradehi me kṛpāṃ kuru ||99||
itivisarjitaṃ sādhuṃ cintayeddharirūpiṇam |
evaṃ sādhuvratenāpi sādhvyau mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ || 4.91.1 00||
antakāle sādhubhaktā yānti sādhubhireva te |
ākṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma divyaṃ vimānagaiḥ saha || 101 ||
naro nārī sataḥ sādhvyā evaṃ pūjanamācaret |
varṣe varṣe ca māse vā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 1 02||
yatra sādhoścaraṇaṃ tadgṛhaṃ golokasadṛśam |
sādhubhaktāḥ pārṣadāste nāryo muktānikāstu tāḥ || 10 3||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya sādhupūjāphalaṃ bhavet |
ante bhaktyā labhetāpi brahmadhāma na saṃśayaḥ || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne gṛhagītāyāṃ sarvadharmakarmādihīnānāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ paramaṃ mokṣasya sādhanaṃ sādhusatsaṃgatirityādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||

<4.92>
śrīmādhavīprajñe procatuḥ
bhagavan karuṇāsindho kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho |
svaḥ sañjāte kṛtakṛtye māhātmyaśravaṇāt satām || 1 ||
athānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇamādhava |
kartumīhāmahe sarvā bhavajjanyajayantikām || 2 ||
ājñāṃ dehi pate svāmin sarvāḥ kurmo mahotsavam |
apūrvamutsavaṃ vīkṣya jīvānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet| || 3 ||
śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca
munayo’nādikṛṣṇāśrīnārāyaṇastadarthanām |
gṛhītvājñāṃ dadau kartuṃ tābhyaḥ svāvirdinotsavam || 4 ||
dvāviṃśatitame janmavatsare kārtike’site |
ādye dale’ṣṭamī prāptā tajjayotsavasiddhaye || 5 ||
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇastu pitā maṇḍapamuttamam |
klṛptayāmāsa sahasā sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ śubham || 6 ||
viśālaṃ yojanāyāmaṃ paṭamaṇḍapamityapi |
gajāsanaṃ ca sauvarṇamaṇḍape sannyadhāddhareḥ || 7 ||
lomaśo havanārthaṃ vai kuṇḍaṃ cākārayattathā |
samagropakaraṇādi sādhayāmāsa lomaśaḥ || 8 ||
brahmapriyādyāḥ pramadāḥ pakvānnāni pracakrire |
padmāvatīpriyāyāśca haripriyāstathāparāḥ || 9 ||
maṇḍape’tha samājasyopaveśanāni sarvaśaḥ |
klṛptayāmāsa bhagavān jyeṣṭho bhrātā harestadā || 4.92.1 0||
śuko bhrātā dvitīyaśca svāgatārthaṃ sthito’bhavat |
santuṣṭādyāḥ kumāryaśca devīnāṃ svāgataṃ vyadhuḥ || | 1 ||
āyayuḥ sarvalokebhyo dhiṣṇyapāḥ svavimānakaiḥ |
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥ kṛṣṇāśīrvādahetave || 1 2||
yogeśā brāhmasamaye’vādyanta vādyakoṭayaḥ |
saṃgṛhṇāti ca nārīṇāṃ kīrtanānyabhavan prage || 1 3||
viprāṇāṃ vedaghoṣāścābhavannāśīḥparāyaṇāḥ |
gītayaścāpsarasāṃ ca sanṛtyāḥ parito’bhavan || 14||
gandharvāṇāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ kiṃpuṃsāṃ gāyanāni ca |
sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ vandanāni śubhāni ca || 19||
kāvyottamāni ca kavivaryāṇāmabhavam̐stadā |
vidyādhrāṇāṃ cāraṇānāmāsan kathānakāni ca || 1 6||
paṇḍitānāṃ nāṭakāni satānāṃ kīrtanāni ca |
nāmadhūnyāni sādhvīnāṃ cāsan jayantikotsave || 17||
naiṣṭhikāḥ śrīhariḥ prātaryoganidrāṃ vihāya ca |
divyavādyādighoṣādīn śṛṇvan sasnau sarojalaiḥ || 18 | |
dadhāra veṣaṃ subhagaṃ bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārakāṇi ca |
sugandhāni sarvasvasticandrakaḥ śuśubhe hariḥ || 19 | |
mātāśrīkambharālakṣmīḥ putrasya tilakaṃ vyadhāt |
candrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ cāpi cāndanaṃ kesarānvitam || 4.92.20 ||
santuṣṭā bhaginī bhāle’kṣatabinduṃ vyadhāddhareḥ |
pitā mālāṃ dadau putrakaṇṭhe svarṇamaṇisrajam | | 21 | |
athaivaṃ śobhitaḥ kṛṣṇo maṇḍapaṃ samupāyayau |
lomaśaścāyayau tatra pūjopakaraṇānvitaḥ | | 22 | |
sarvairnamaskṛtastūrṇaṃ vācayāmāsa maṃgalam |
puṇyāhaṃ svasti caivāpi gaṇeśapūjanaṃ tataḥ | | 23 ||
dehaśuddhiṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca tilakaṃ candrakaṃ hareḥ |
bhāle cakāra ṛṣirāḍāśīrvādān dadau tataḥ || 94 | |
puṣpahāraṃ gale ramyaṃ dadau kṛṣṇasya lomaśaḥ |
tato mātā pitā bhāle bāndhavāśca kuṭumbinaḥ || 25 ||
tilakaṃ sākṣataṃ cakruryavāṃkurāṇi karṇayoḥ |
daduścāśīrvādavāṇīṃ tato brahmā hyupāyayau || 26 ||
kṛtvā tu tilakaṃ hāraṃ gale datvā stutiṃ vyadhāt |
namaskṛtyāsanaṃ prāpa viṣṇustata upāyayau | | 27 | |
hāraṃ ca mukuṭaṃ divyaṃ kuṇḍale kaustubhaṃ maṇim |
datvā nanāma ca tataḥ śaṃbhurupāyayau harim | | 28 | |
natvā datvā puṣpamālāṃ cakre bhāle sucandrakam |
indrādayastato devāḥ siddhāśca sādhavo’malāḥ | | 29 ||
sanakādyā bhavantaḥ śrīhariṃ pupūjurādarāt |
nāradādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca sūryādyāstilakaṃ vyadhuḥ | | 4.92.30 ||
lokapālāśca pitaro gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā |
kiṃpumāṃso mānavāśca viprāḥ santo jaleśayāḥ | | 31 ||
tīrthāni sāgarā nadyo vṛkṣāśca virudho’pi ca |
devā daityā dānavāśca bhaktāḥ sūtāśca māgadhāḥ | | 32 ||
cāraṇā vaiṣṇavāścānye śaivā gaṇāśca pārṣadāḥ |
apsaraso devatāśca devyaḥ sādhvyaśca yoginaḥ | | 33 ||
yoginyo gaṇikāvṛndā bhaktānikāśca yoṣitaḥ |
varṇāśramā narā nāryo yakṣā rakṣāṃsi vandinaḥ | | 34||
vidyādharāśca vidvāṃso kṛṣṇamānarcurutsukāḥ |
nāgā yādāṃsi ca jarāyūjāśca svedajāśca ye | | 35 ||
divyā divyavapuṣmantaḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram |
ārārtrikaṃ mahāmuktāścakrurmuktānikāstadā | | 3 6||
abhiṣekaṃ tato nadyaḥ pādayoścakrurutsave |
upadāśca daduḥ sarve mahīmānottamāḥ surāḥ ||37|||
ciraṃ jīvāva naḥ kṛṣṇa kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ tava |
ārogyaṃ ca dhanaṃ sampanmahaiśvaryāṇi santu te |||38||
śaraṇyatvaṃ dayālutvaṃ mokṣadatvaṃ sadāstu tai |
vaṃśavistāravattvaṃ ca devādhidevarājatā |||39||
saukhyaṃ sarvavidhaṃ te’stu sarvānandādiśevadheḥ |
evamāśīrvādavāṇīścāhuḥ surādayastathā ||4.92.40||
lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ mānaṃ dhanyavādān dadau tadā |
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca haripriyāśca yoṣitaḥ ||41 ||
rādhāramāśrīkamalāvṛndāpāśaṃvatīpriyāḥ |
māṇikīsukhadālakṣmībhūlīlābhūtiśāradāḥ ||42||
sāvitrīpārvatīsaṃjñāgāyatrībhagavatpriyāḥ |
devyastatheśvarapatnyāvatāriṇyo’parāḥ striyaḥ ||43||
pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ bhāle’sya tilakaṃ vyadhuḥ |
vṛddhyañjaliṃ duḥkhanāśāñjaliṃ jagṛhurādarāt || 44||
puṣpākṣatāñjalīn kṛṣṇe nidadhurjagadurharim |
ciraṃ jīva satīsādhvīśaktīśānandado bhava |||4||
sampatprado mokṣadaśca no hṛtsvavicalo vasa |
evamāśīrdadustasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya tāḥ ||46||
ārārtrikaṃ ca tāścakrurjalaṃ papuśca pādayoḥ |
haristato narānnārīrnamaścakre samutthitaḥ |||47||
vardhito’haṃ mahābhāgyairnamāmi parameśvarān |

vaṃśavistāravantaśca lokadhāmādhipāstathā |
nirbhayā vimalānandabhogasampatsukhocchrayāḥ ||4.92.50||
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rājannijāsane |
āhūya pūjyavargāṃśca pradadau bahudānakam ||5 1||
sarvasṛṣṭyadhipān pūrvaṃ dadau ratnāni sarvaśaḥ |
tataḥ sādhūn bhūsurām̐śca sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ||52||
bhikṣukān bālikā bālān yoginaśca satījanān |
dāsīrdāsāṃśca bhṛtyām̐śca narānnārīḥ samastakān ||53||
natvā natvā mahāmūlyaṃ dhanaṃ tebhyo dadau hariḥ |
yathāyogyaprasādām̐śca bhūṣāpātrāmbarāṇi ca ||54||
dadau cakre tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sabhāvisarjanaṃ drutam |
atha tebhyo bhojanāni vicitrāṇyuttamāni ca ||55||
kārayāmāsa bhagavān pitā mātā ca bāndhavāḥ |
tarpayāmāsurīśādyān miṣṭānnajalapānakaiḥ || 56||
mukhavāsapradānaiśca viśrāmāsanadānakaiḥ |
sevābhirvividhābhiśca satkārairyogyavartanaiḥ ||57||
bubhūjurdehinastatra janmajayantikādine |
dvāviṃśativarṣasaṃkhye’ṣṭamyāṃ trilokavāsinaḥ || 58 ||
madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ prārthayāmāsuracyutam |
nijalokān pāvayituṃ samāgantuṃ hariṃ tu te ||59 ||
tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha visasarja samājakam |
vidāya prāpya te sarve yayurlokānajaṃ vinā || 4.92.60 ||
brahmā tasthau gṛhe tatra kṛṣṇājñayā sukhena vai |
vimānaiste yayuḥ sarve mudā svasvālayān prati || 61 ||
athāścaryamabhūttatra śṛṇutedaṃ munīśvarāḥ |
vardhamānanagarasya rājā nāmnā purañjanaḥ || 62 ||
āgato’bhūjjanmamahotsave cānye nṛpā yathā |
purañjanasya vai rātrau svapnamabhūccirāyitam ||63 ||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre muhūrte brāhmapūrvake |
svapne dadarśa rājā svaṃ patitaṃ jvalitānale ||| 64||
ninyustaṃ vikarālā vai dūtā yamasya dakṣiṇām |
yāmyapurīṃ sarvakarmaphalabhogārthasaṃsthitām | | 65||
dharmarājo dadau daṇḍaṃ vīkṣya pāpāni bhūbhṛtaḥ |
paravittāpatyanārīhartā tvaṃ kālapāśakam || 66 ||
tāmisraṃ ghoranarakaṃ bhuṃkṣvetyāha yamādhipaḥ |
naranārīvañcakastvamandhatāmisrago bhava || 67||
bhūtadrohakarastvaṃ ca hiṃsako rauravaṃ vraja |
dehaṃbharo na dātā tvaṃ mahārauravago bhava || 68||
paśupakṣiprāṇahā tvaṃ kumbhīpākagato bhava |
pitṛviprabrahmadhruk tvaṃ kālasūtragato bhava || 6 9||
pāṣaṇḍapoṣakastvaṃ vai saṃviśāsidalaṃ vanam |
adaṇḍyadaṇḍakartā tvaṃ sūkarānanake pata ||4.92.7 0 ||
prāṇivyathāpradātā tvamandhakūpagato bhava |
pañcayajñavihīnastvaṃ kṛmikuṇḍagato bhava ||7 1 ||
hiraṇyaratnahartā tvaṃ sandaśe narake pata |
agamyāgamakastvaṃ vai tigmasūrmyāgato bhava |||72 ||
pāṣaṇḍapoṣakastvaṃ vaitaraṇyāṃ pata sarvathā |
śaucācāravihīnastvaṃ pūyakardamago bhava ||73 ||
mṛgayāvyasanī tvaṃ vai yāhi vaiśasamulbaṇam |
anṛtārthapravādī tvaṃ yāhyavīcimadhaḥśirāḥ || 74||
madyapastvaṃ raktamadyānalapānakaro bhava |
gurvavajñāvidhātā tvaṃ kṣārakardamake pata ||75||
sarvodvegakarastvaṃ vai dandaśūkagato bhava |
sādhvabhyāgatapūjāghno vajratuṇḍagato bhava ||76||
evamuktvā yamo yāmyānnṛpaṃ netumuvāca ha |
yamadūtā dadau duḥkhaṃ tāḍanaiśchedanaistathā ||77||
ghātanairvahnidāhaiśca peṣaṇaiḥ kartanaistathā |
vahnipānairviṣadānaiḥ kṣārapātanakaistathā ||78||
galarodhaiścāntrakarṣairvajraghātairmuhurmuhuḥ |
kaṇṭakādau gamanaiścākarṣaṇaiḥ śastribhūtale ||79||
tāmrabandhairjvālanaiśca pāśalambanakaistathā |
khaṅgapatrapravāsaiśca pūyaśoṇitapātanaiḥ ||4.92.8 0||
evaṃvidhāni duḥkhāni bhuktvā svapne nṛpaściram |
niṣkāsito bahiścāpi pravāsito vidāyavān ||8 1 ||
āyayau svanivāse vai vardhamānapure hi saḥ |
sammānito nṛpo lokairmahotsāhaiḥ prajādibhiḥ |||82||
rājyāsane sthitaḥ paścād viśramya ca dināntare |
yātrārthaṃ prayayau kuṃkumavāpīṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ||83||
janmajayantikāhe vai tatra kṛtvā mahotsavam |
vidāyaṃ sa lalābhāpi tāvannidrotthito’bhavat ||84||
śuśoca bahudhā rājā kimidaṃ svapnamulbaṇam |
pṛcchāmi paramātmānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yat tat samastakam ||85||
rājā purañjayaḥ śīghraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai |
śrāvayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ śokaṃ cakāra vai kṣaṇam ||86||
anādiśrīhariḥ prāha rājatvaṃ pāpakṛt purā |
paścād bhakto’si jāto’tra mahāpāpī purābhavaḥ ||87||
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ pāpaphalaṃ tavābhavat |
bhogāya yamaloke vai tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ||88||
mamāśrayeṇa vai rājan yadaṃśaḥ svapnake tvayā |
bhuktaḥ sarvo’pi rātrau vai na śeṣaṃ tava vidyate ||89||
athādhunā mama mantraṃ gṛhāṇa śuddhabhāvanaḥ |
mukto bhūtvā prayāhyevākṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃ padam ||4.92.90||
tvamagnau patito rājan nāyuṣyaṃ tava vidyate |
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yāhi dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||9 1 ||
ityuktyā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mantraṃ tu bhūbhate |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |||92|||
dadau vāri dadau naijaṃ pādaprakṣālanodbhavam |
papau rājā pādajalaṃ divyadṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ||93||
māyāpārācāravām̐ścābhavat karuṇayā hareḥ |
ācakarṣa samastā vai vṛttiścendriyavājinām ||94||
tūrṇaṃ brahmasthitau tiṣṭhan pupūja parameśvaram |
ṛṣīn sādhūn vaiṣṇavām̐śca neme paramabhāvavān || 95||
svabhṛtyān śikṣaṇaṃ datvā svastyā tatra kalevaram |
āgatena vimānena divyena muktaśobhinā || 96||
yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ śīghraṃ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām |
śrutvā yāmyapradattān vai daṇḍān sarve’nuyāyinaḥ ||97||
tatyajurbhṛtyavargāste dūṣaṇāni hyaghāni ca |
jayakāro’bhavad rājñaścaurdhvakṛtyaṃ tato’bhavat ||98||
bhūpasyānucarāḥ sarve mantraṃ jagṛhuracyutāt |
nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhuśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ||99||
bālakṛṣṇasvāmikṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇaprabho vibho |
evaṃ dhunyaṃ pracakruste yayurnaijaṃ puraṃ prati || 4.92.100 ||
jagadurnṛpamokṣaṃ ca bhejustato hariṃ prabhum |
ityevaṃ varculaṃ tatrāścaryamabhūnmayoditam ||1 01 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktibhāg bhavet |
māyāṃ vihāya pāpāni brahmalokagato’bhavat || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīharerdvāviṃśatitamo janmajayantīdinotsavaḥ, vardhamānapureśituḥ purañjayanṛpateḥ svapne sarvanarakabhogastataḥ śīghraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisannidhau mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||

<4.93>
śrīpadmāvatīprajñe procatuḥ
bhaktapriyaharikṛṣṇasvāminnārāyaṇaprabho |
brahmā pitāmahaḥ kasmād rakṣito’tra svasannidhau || 1 ||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca
śarkarānagare’haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mahe |
deveśapitṛnāgādīn teṣāṃ svīkṛtya cārthanām || 2 ||
teṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhavanāni tataścid gantumāha tān |
tallakṣyīkṛtya bhagavāniyeṣaitumajāspadam || 3 ||
satyalokaṃ pragantuṃ vai brahmaṇā saha kārtike |
brahmaṇo mānasapūrtyai prārūrudhaṃ nijāntike || 4 ||
ūrjakṛṣṇanavamyāṃ māṃ hariṃ brahmā praṇamya tu |
apṛcchat kāraṇaṃ svasya nirodhasya sukhāsane || 5 ||
ahaṃ nyavedaya tatrāsmārayaṃ ca tadarthanām |
sarvabrahmapriyāharipriyādyābhiḥ sahaiva ha || 6 ||
kṛtaprārthanasthānīśālayān gantuṃ tu vedhasam |
brahmāpi ca kṛpāṃ labdhvātuṣyaccātīva tatkṣaṇam || 7 ||
mahyaṃ nyavedayattatra yathāyogyaṃ hitaṃ nijam |
bhagavan satyaloke me dīpotsavaṃ vidhāpaya || 8 ||
annakūṭān divyabhogānarpayiṣyāmi bhāvataḥ |
sevālābho hi gāyatryāḥ sāvitryāśca bhaviṣyati || 9 ||
satyavāsisamastānāṃ tatra sevā bhaviṣyati |
tavāṅganānāṃ sarvāsāṃ darśanaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 4.93.1 0||
yadiṣṭaṃ tat satvaraṃ vai vidhehi bhagavan prabho |
matpriye’haṃ tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’gadaṃ tamom || 11 ||
susvīkṛtavān brahmoktaṃ tasmāt sajje’dya tiṣṭhatam |
sarvābhiścāṃganābhirvai svasrā santuṣṭayā saha || 12||
dāsībhiḥ sevikābhiśca lomaśādimaharṣibhiḥ |
pārṣadairbhṛtyavargaiśca saha sajjo bhavāmyaham || 1 3||
śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca
kṛtvā caikādaśīṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagatprabhuḥ |
śatayojanavistāraṃ vimānaṃ sūkṣmabhāvagam || 14||
vardhayāmāsa sahasā vyomni sarvāsanārhakam |
divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhatulyaṃ vai hiraṇyabrahmanāmakam || 15||
sarvarddhisarvabhogāḍhyaṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakam |
vimāne’trānādikṛṣṇonārāyaṇaḥśrīvallabhaḥ || 16||
niṣasāda drutaṃ sarvadāsadāsīprasevitaḥ |
atha halahalāśabdo yātrārthaṃ cājñayā hareḥ || 17||
abhavat kuṃkumavāpīnagare’bhita ūrdhvagaḥ |
nāryaḥ samastaveṣāḍhyā nītabhūṣāmbarāstathā || 18||
sarvaśṛṅgārakaraṇā hyatiṣṭhan yānasannidhau |
ājñāṃ dadau sa tāstūrṇaṃ cāruruhurvimānakam || 19||
śrīhariḥ svapitarau sampraṇamyāpi vimānake |
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa brahmaṇā lomaśena ca ||4.93.20 ||
sadbhiḥ svapārṣadaiḥ sarvapriyābhiḥ saṃvyarājata |
atha vādyānyavādyanta puṣpacandanavṛṣṭayaḥ |||21|||
ambarādabhavam̐statra jayanādāstato’bhavan |
atha śrībadarī badrikāśrame śrīnarāyaṇam ||22||
śrutvā ghoṣān divyaśaktyā papraccha śrīhareḥ kathām |
kva yānāditadāha śrīnaranārāyaṇo’pi tām ||23||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye kṛṣṇo dvāviṃśaṃ svajanermaham |
kṛtvā purañjanamokṣottaraṃ satyastaraṃ prati ||24||

dvādaśyāṃ te kṛtāhārā vimānasthāḥ sarovaram ||25|||
vāpīṃ kṣetrāṇi natvāpi natvā svadvisvarūpiṇam |
narā nāryo harṣayuktā yātrārthaṃ niryayurhi khe ||26||
vimānaṃ jayanādaiśca sahitaṃ cāmbare’gragam |
śanairgatiparaṃ jātaṃ vimucyābhrāṇi vai kṣaṇāt ||27||
manovegena ca bhuvaḥ svargaṃ maharjanaṃ tapaḥ |
satyaṃ prāpa muhūrtena mahāścaryamabhūddhi tat ||28|||
sarvāsāṃ yoṣitāṃ dāsīdāsānāṃ vegadarśinām |
uddhoṣaḥ sarvato jāto yātrāyāṃ bhagavān yayau |||29||
sarvalokeṣu sarvatra sā vārtā prāsarat kṣaṇāt |
yogino devatāścāpi divyajñā vividuḥ kṣaṇāt ||4.93.3 0||
āyayuḥ satyaloke te hariṃ netuṃ nijālayān |
kramāt kṛṣṇo’pi tānāha samāgantuṃ yathāyatham ||3 1 ||

śrīkṛṣṇasyāgame jāte mahānando vyajāyata ||32||
svāgataṃ satyalokasthā brahmaputrāḥ sanātanāḥ |
siddhāḥ sanatkumārādyāstathā satyādhikāriṇaḥ ||33||
devāścakrurharestatra vādyamālārhaṇādibhiḥ |
phalākṣatasupuṣpādyairlājāsugandhisaddravaiḥ ||34||

sugandhisiktamārgāṃ ca dhvajapatākikorjitām ||35||

satyābhirdevikābhiścasuveṣābhiralaṃkṛtām ||36||
mandirāgārasunyastasvastikādivirājitām |
kadalīstambhaśākhāḍhyagopuraiḥ śobhitāṃ tadā || 37||

vividhairdivyavādyaiśca nāditāṃ sumanoharām || 38||
satyadevairdevikābhiścāpsarobhiralaṃkṛtām |
siṃhavyāghrahaṃsahastimṛgaveṣitasainyikām || 39||
divyakusumairgucchaiśca vikīritāṃ samantataḥ |
dadhimāṃgalyasaṃśobhadagārasaudharājitām ||4.93.40||
karāttākṣatapuṣpādisiddhābhiḥ supratīkṣitām |
kṛtrimodyānasaṃśobhaccatvarāvāsaśāntidām ||41||
kāmakalpalatāvṛkṣamālābhirabhirājitām |
satyāṃ brahmapurīṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi vedhasā ||42||
nīyamānaścāviveśa vardhitaḥ pūjitaḥ suraiḥ |
bhramitvā śrīharirdīrghāṃ satyāṃ vai lakṣayojanām || 43 ||
vimānaṃ tu sthirīkṛtya haṃsayānamupāviśat |
brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ brahmānayacchrīparameśvaram || 44 ||
brahmā ca brahmaputrāśca sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ |
ṛbhuśca nāradādyāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||45||
pādāmṛtaṃ papuścārārtrikaṃ cakruḥ samutsukāḥ |
hārān bhūṣāścandanādi samarpya ca tato’stuvan || 46||
pāvitaḥ satyaloko’yaṃ bhagavan kṛpayā tvayā |
sevāyāṃ na samarthāḥ sma kṣamasvāśaktimacyuta ||47||
brahmā divyasabhāyāṃ ca ninye śrīpuruṣottamam |
viśrāmaṃ prāpa bhagavān bhojitaścāmṛtādibhiḥ ||48 ||
atha sāvitrikāgāyatrikāsarasvatīstriyaḥ |
sādhvyaśca siddhayaścāpi surāṇyaḥ koṭiśo’pi ca ||49 ||
pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ tatra tathā śrīṃ māṇikīṃ ramām |
lakṣmīṃ prajñāṃ pāśavatīṃ rādhāṃ ca śāradāṃ satīm || 4.93.50 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnīḥ pūjayāmāsureva tāḥ |
upadā vividhāścāpi dadurdivyāstadudbhavāḥ |||51 ||
tataścārārtrikaṃ cakrurbhojayāmāsurīśvarīḥ |
brahmapriyādikāḥ sarvā dāsīrdāsān samastataḥ | | 52||
viśrāntimandireṣvetā dadurviśramaṇaṃ tathā |
sarvapradānakairdevyo bhagavatyo’rhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ ||53 ||
sevāṃ cakrurmahīmānayoṣitāṃ sarvato’rpaṇaiḥ |
brahmābhavat kṛtakṛtyaḥ sāvitryādyā mudānvitāḥ || 54||
sanakādyāḥ sādhavaścābhavan kṛtārthakāstadā |
badripriye brahmasatye kṣaṇamātraṃ tu bhūtale || 55||
yugāyutāyate cāpi mānavasya kṛte khalu |
na tu yogavatāṃ cāpi bhagavatāṃ tathāvidhā ||56||
īśvarāṇāṃ na ca tathā sutarāṃ śrīharernahi |
kāle dairghyaṃ kṛtaṃ yena vāmanatvaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā || 57||
saṃkalpādhīnamasyāsti kā tatra kālakalpanā |
badripriye harikṛṣṇaḥ prapūrya brahmaṇo manaḥ ||58 ||
brahmaṇādiṣṭadevānāṃ mandireṣu yayau tataḥ |
saudheṣu sanakādīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ prayayau purā ||5 9||
brahmaśīlavratānāṃ ca naiṣṭhikānāṃ mahātmanām |
siddhānāmāśramaśreṣṭheṣvapi nārāyaṇo yayau || 4.93.60 ||
pūjitaḥ sādhusaṃghaiśca tato gṛhigṛhāṇyapi |
satyāvasānikadevālayeṣu bhagavān yayau || 61 ||
pūjito vanditaḥ sarvairbhojito’mṛtasadrasaiḥ |
nīrājito vardhitaścāyayau brahmālayaṃ punaḥ || 62||
dhanalakṣmīmahāpūjāṃ brahmādyāścakrire tataḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapūjāṃ pracakrire || 63 ||
dīpāvalyāṃ śāradāśrīmahāpūjāṃ pracakrire |
koṭisiddhāḥ koṭisanto naiṣṭhikā brahmakoṭikāḥ || 64||
ṛbhurnīrājanaṃ cakre brahmāpyapūjayan mudā |
sāvitryādyāḥ satīnāryo lakṣmīpūjāṃ pracakrire || 65||
divyasārairamṛtādyairabhiṣekaṃ pracakrire |
śṛṅgārāṇi samastāni samastabhūṣaṇāni ca || 66 ||
samastaveṣasaubhāgyaṃ lakṣmyā devyāḥ pracakrire |
satyalokaṃ brahmadīpāvalikoṭisamujjvalam || 6 7||
cakrire dīpanivahaiḥ puṇyātmakaiḥ samastataḥ |
nṛtagītamahāmodāmṛtādimiṣṭabhojanaiḥ || 68 ||
mahīmānamahānandaṃ janayāmāsurīśikāḥ |
annakūṭotsavaṃ brahmā cakāra bahuvastukam ||69||
satyalokānnanivahān pācitān susudhābhṛtān |
miṣṭānnāni samastāni kṣārānnāni tathaiva ca ||4.93.70 ||
rasyānnāni ca bhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni vividhānyapi |
lehyāni rasayuktāni peyāni vividhāni ca ||7 1 ||
āsvādyāni samastāni coṣyāṇi cottamāni ca |
tiktamiṣṭāmblakaṭūni pravāhitāni yānyapi |72||
sahāyakāni sarvāṇi rūkṣaśuṣkāṇi yāni ca |
bharjitāni saṃskṛtāni divyagandharasāni ca ||7 3 ||
śākapatrāṇi ramyāṇi bhājā bhājīḥ rasaplutāḥ |
kandamūlāni sarvāṇi phalapuṣpāṇi yānyapi ||74||
utkṛṣṭotkṛṣṭarūpāṇi sarvakalākṛtāni ca |
svarṇapātreṣu mahāsthāleṣu koṭyarbudeṣu ca ||75||
divyabhājanavaryeṣu kalaśeṣu jalāni ca |
sākṣātphalāni puṣpāṇi bījāni mañjarīstathā ||76||
saṃskṛtya śimbikāścāpi nyadhuḥ śrīharisannidhau |
svarṇahaṃsāsane rājatkṛṣṇo brahmapriyādibhiḥ |||77||
bubhuje brahmaṇādiṣṭaḥ sāvitryādibhirarcitaḥ |
praśaṃsyānnāni bhagavān śrīprajñāmādhavīdhavaḥ ||78 ||
gāyatryādyā brahmapatnyo vyajanaiḥ pavanaṃ daduḥ |
sāvitryādyāḥ punastatra pariveṣaṇamācaran ||79 ||
haristṛpto hareḥ patnyo dāsyo dāsāśca sevakāḥ |
sādhavaḥ pārṣadāstṛptāśculukaṃ ca vyadhustataḥ ||4.93.8 0 ||
vāryamṛtaṃ papuścāpi mukhavāsaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ |
tāmbūlakaṃ tu bhagavān sarvāśca śrīharipriyāḥ ||8 1||
mukhavāsāni cānyāni divyapūgīphalānyapi |
tathā sugandhibījāni śītakaṇāṃśca jagṛhuḥ ||82|||
bhuktvotthāya harikṛṣṇo niṣasāda mahāsane |
brahmā ca brahmapatnyaśca brahmaputrādayastathā ||8 3|||
prasādaṃ śrīhareḥ sarve vubhujire’tibhāvataḥ |
sanakādyā ṛṣayaśca ṛbhvādyā naiṣṭhikottamāḥ ||84||
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ śāradādyā bubhujire prasādakam |
tataḥ śrībhagavān satyalokavāsibhya ādarāt |||85|||
śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇe prāptān dadau mantraṃ nijaṃ svayam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||86||
oṃ bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi |
tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādīti mantraṃ dadau tathā ||89|||
satyaloke koṭiśo’pi siddhāḥ sādhyāśca naiṣṭhikāḥ |
pūrvaprapūrvakalpīyadevādyā nyavasam̐śca ye ||88||
sarve te vaiṣṇavā jātāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritāḥ |
devā devyaḥ samastā vai nāmadhunyaṃ pracakrire ||89||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin ramāyaṇa ||4.93.90 ||
ityevamutsavaṃ brahmā cānnakūṭasya saṃvyadhāt |
dakṣādyāḥ brahmaputrāśca nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ ||9 1 ||
satyalokagatāḥ kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ jagṛhurmudā |
nṛtyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ cakrurgāndharvā nāradādayaḥ ||92||
brahmasaraso’psaraso vyadhurnṛtyāni vai mudā |
yogino yatayaḥ siddhāstāpasā brahmacāriṇaḥ |||93||
cakrire nāmadhunyaṃ ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhoḥ |
apunarmārakā devāḥ satyāḥ satyanivāsinaḥ ||94||
pūjanaṃ śrīhareścakrurāgatya brahmamandiram |
prasādaṃ jagṛhuste ca mantraṃ ca jagṛhurhareḥ ||95||
atha śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasādya vedhasam |
viṣṇunābhiṣṭutaḥ prāyānnārāyaṇālayaṃ tataḥ ||96||
viṣṇulokaṃ viśālaṃ vai prāpya viṣṇostu mandire |
viṣṇunā ca śriyā sarvapārṣadaiḥ kṛtamuttamam ||97||
svāgataṃ pūjanaṃ divyakaustubhādyarpaṇaṃ mudā |
jagrāhorjasya pūrṇāyāṃ tithau padmāvatīpatiḥ ||98||
bhojanaṃ ca śubhaṃ pānaṃ prāpya pūjāṃ śriyā kṛtām |
vimānena yayau jyotirmayaṃ harapuraṃ prabhuḥ ||99||
koṭikoṭigaṇo’dhyakṣo haro muditamānasaḥ |
abhyāyayau hariṃ cakre daṇḍavat gaṇakoṭibhiḥ || 4.93.1 00||
jyotirmaye pure kṛṣṇaṃ bhrāmayitvā vimānagam |
naije svarṇālaye ninye pupūja puṣparatnakaiḥ || 101 ||
ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi bhojayāmāsa cāmṛtam |
sarvānugayutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sevayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || 102||
gaṇā gaṇikāḥ satyaśca śrīsatīsahitā hareḥ |
lakṣmyādīnāṃ ca śuśrūṣāṃ cakrire hyatibhāvataḥ || 1 03||
haristebhyo dadau mantraṃ tābhyaśca naijamuttamam |
vaiṣṇavān saṃvidhāyaivāsādya pūjāṃ tataḥ param ||104||
svayaṃbhūmanunāgatyārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo yayau saha |
arcitaḥ pūjitaḥ sarvasampadbhirvardhitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 05||
sevitaḥ śatarūpādinārībhiḥ śrīpramāpatiḥ |
pratoṣya taṃ manuṃ cānyamanūnāmālayān yayau || 1 06||
sarve te manavaḥ svasvamandire cāṃganāyutam |
avasthāpya manuṃ prāpya pupūjuḥ sampadā harim || 1 07||
manūnāṃ patnikāḥ kṛṣṇapatnīḥ pupūjurādarāt |
ārārtrikaṃ tataścakrurbhojanāni vyadhustathā || 1 08||
tebhyaḥ prasanno bhagavān dadau pādau tu vakṣasi |
prasthāpitastataḥ kṛṣṇo vimānena nijena tu || 1 09||
samāpya bhramaṇaṃ satye tapolokamupāgamat |
badrīpriye mārgaśīrṣe sarvasvavargasaṃyutaḥ || 4.93.11 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne brahmaṇārthiṃto bhagavān koṭyarbudādipatnyādisahitaḥ śatayojanavimānena satyalokaṃ yayau, tatra dīpotsavānnakūṭādimahotsave brahmasiddhayatimanuprabhṛtibhiḥ pūjito haristān sukhayitvā tapolokamājagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 93 ||

<4.94>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye prajñāpārāvatīśvaraḥ |
tapolokaṃ prājagāma tāpasānāṃ nivāsanam || 1 ||
aryamādikapitṝṇāṃ puṇyasthānaṃ paraṃ divam |
pūrvakalpodbhavāḥ sthānadhiṣṇyādhikāriṇaḥ surāḥ || 2 ||
adhikāraṃ samāpyaiva yatra vasanti nirbhayāḥ |
ṛṣayo munayaścāpi pitaraḥ śrāvaṇāśca ye || 3 ||
yāmyāḥ samvatsarāḥ kālāḥ kālādhidevatāśca yāḥ |
ye naiṣṭhikāstāpasāśca vṛddhāḥ puṇyābhiyoginaḥ || 4 ||
vairājāśca tathā devāḥ sarvathā dāhavarjitāḥ |
prājāpatyā devatāśca saumyā barhiṣadastathā || 5 ||
agniṣvāttāśca kāvyāśca ṛtavaḥ somapāstathā |
aṣṭakāpatayaścāpi lekhāstathoṣmapā api || 6 ||
divākīrtyāśca pitaraśchandajāḥ pitarastathā |
śrāddhadevāśca pitaro yajvāno’yonijāstathā || 7 ||
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā yajñena prajayā tathā |
śraddhayā vidyayā dānaiḥ śraddhāyuktena karmaṇā || 8 ||
paralokagatā ye te yatra vasanti tāpase |
vāruṇā bhṛgavaścāpi āgneyāṅgirasāstathā || 9 ||
mārīcāścātreyakāśca paulastyāḥ paulahāstathā |
vāśiṣṭhā vasavaścāpi brahmāṇaḥ pitaraśca te || 4.94.10 ||
prajāpataya evaite yamo rājā prajāpatiḥ |
kārdamāḥ kāśyapāḥ śaiṣā vikrāntāḥ suśravādayaḥ || 1 1||
bahuputrāḥ kumārāśca vivasvantaḥ śuciśravāḥ |
prācetaso’riṣṭanemirbahulāḥ pitaraśca te || 4 2||
kuśoccayāśca pitaraḥ prājāpataya eva te |
bālakhilyāstathā vaikhānasā aśvisutāvubhau || 1 3||
ete sarve tapoloke vasanti puṇyabhoginaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra samāgatam || 14||
viditvā cāryamā rājā koṭisainyaiśca tāpasaiḥ |
devībhirmātṛbhiryuktaḥ kṛṣṇasannidhimāyayau || 15||
āryamṇīṃ nijanagarīṃ śṛṃgāraiḥ sarvatomukhīm |
prāveśayaddhariṃ sarvastrīvimānasamanvitam || 1 6||
mahāsaudhe nije siṃhāsane’ryamā nyaṣādayat |
apūjayaddhariṃ ratnaiḥ puṣpaiḥ suvarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 17||
candanādyaiśca pīyūṣairamṛtairakṣatādibhiḥ |
abhojayaddivyabhogairbhojyānnairvividhaistathā || 18||
ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi pāpau pādajalāmṛtam |
āryādevī ca tatpatnī rājñī pitṛśarīriṇām || 19||
pupūja paramātmānaṃ tathā brahmapriyādikāḥ |
bhojayāmāsa sarvāstā āryādevī hi mātṛkā ||4.94.20||
atha saudhe pauṣamāse kṛṣṇo’ryamṇo vasam̐stataḥ |
tapolokanivāsānānāmālayeṣu yayau muhuḥ ||2 1 ||
mahāśveto vāmadevādayo ye tu maharṣayaḥ |
svasvamandiravaryeṣu śrīkṛṣṇamanayanmudā ||22||
sarvasārthasahitaṃ taṃ hyapūjayan yathādhanam |
brahmasattvāyanādyāśca munayo’pyanayaddharim ||23|||
yathādhanaṃ ca satkāraṃ hyakurvan bhāvasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
śravaṇādyāḥ pitaraśca pitṛrājyakarā api ||24||
sapatnīkāḥ sapatnīkaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ svagṛhe’nayan |
apūjayannabhojayan tathāśṛṃgārayan prabhum |||25|||
tathā yāmyāḥ pitaraśca dharmadhanākhyamukhyakāḥ |
sahasraśo hariṃ nītvā svālayeṣvabhyapūjayan ||26||
tathā samvatsaraparivatsarādyāśca pitṛkāḥ |
svasvakuṭumbasahitāḥ svālayeṣvanayan prabhum ||27||
apūjayan yathādravyaṃ hyabhojayan sudhānnakam |
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca daduḥ svarṇamaṇīn bahūn |||28||
tathā kālādhidevākhyāḥ ṛtavo māsapakṣakāḥ |
pitaraḥ śrīhariṃ ninyurnijālaye samārcayan ||29||
atha ye naiṣṭhikā vṛddhāstāpasāḥ puṇyasañcayāḥ |
pitaraḥ puṇyajananābhidhāste’pyanayan harim ||4.94.30||
svasvālayeṣu vidhivat pupūjuḥ parameśvaram |
atha vairājadevāśca tapolokanivāsinaḥ ||3 1 ||
svarṇadahanapramukhā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
svasvālayeṣu vidhivad rājādhirājavat prabhum || 32||
pūjayāmāsurīśeśaṃ maṇiratnāni te daduḥ |
atha prājāpatyadevāstapolokanivāsinaḥ |||33||
yogāhārābhidhādyāśca ninyuḥ pārvīprabhumpatim |
svasvālayeṣu deveśaṃ pupūjuḥ paramādṛtāḥ || 34||
ārārtrikādikaṃ cakrurbhojayāmāsuracyutam |
atha saumyāśca pitaraścāndrāyaṇādināminaḥ ||35||
ninyuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ nijālayeṣu bhāvataḥ |
amṛtādyaiḥ samānarcurbhojayāmāsuramṛtam ||36||
candrakāntādiratnāni daduḥ pūjākṣaṇe ca te |
atha barhiṣadāścāpi pitaraḥ kuśikādayaḥ ||37||
svasvālayeṣu nāthaṃ taṃ ninyurānarcurutsukāḥ |
yathādhanaṃ ca satkāraṃ pracakrurbhojanādibhiḥ ||38||
atha ye pitaraścāgniṣvāttādyā bhāsurādayaḥ |
ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ svasvasaudheṣvānarcuracyutam ||39||
pāyasādīni bhojyāni daduste pāvanāni vai |
atha ye kāvyapitaro’pakvabhojanarāgiṇaḥ ||4.94.40||
ninyuste paramātmānaṃ svasvālayeṣvapūjayan |
atha somāyanādyāśca somapāśca sudhāśinaḥ ||41||
ninyuste śrīhariṃ svasvālayeṣvānarcurutsukāḥ |
sudhābhojyāni ramyāṇi kārayāmāsuracyutam || 82||
athāṣṭakāpatayo’pi tāpasāḥ pitaro’pi ca |
uttathyakāyanādyāśca ninyurnijālaye harim |||42|||
pupūjurbhojayāmāsurārārtrikādikaṃ vyadhuḥ |
atha lekhāśca pitaro vipralīpādayo harim ||44||
ninyurnijāśramaṃ harṣādānarcuścopadā daduḥ |
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sevayāmāsurīśvaram ||45||
athoṣmapāśca pitaraḥ phenilehādayo harim |
ninyurnijāśrameṣvevānarcuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ||46||
navanītādibhojyāni daduste ca yathādhanam |
atha ye tu divākīrtyāḥ pitaraḥ ṛṣikādayaḥ ||47||
te’pi ninyurhariṃ naijālayeṣvānarcurutsukāḥ |
chandajāḥ pitaraścāpi ninyuranuṣṭupādayaḥ ||48 ||
hariṃ nijālayeṣvānarcuḥ prabhuṃ parameśvaram |
śrāddhadevāśca pitaro ninyuḥ śrīśaṃ nijālayam ||49||
pupūjurbhojayāmāsurārārtrikādikaṃ vyadhuḥ |
yajvāno bhūbhṛtaścāpi cakravartina eva ye |||4.94.50||
tapoloke sthitāste’pi ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ gṛhe |
pupūjū rājayogyaiśca vastubhirbahumānataḥ ||51 ||
upadāśca daduḥ śreṣṭhā bhojayāmāsuracyutam |
vāruṇā bhārgavāścāpi āgneyāḥ pitarastathā |||52||
āṅgīrasāśca mārīcā ātreyakāśca tāpasāḥ |
paulastyāḥ paulahāścāpi vāśiṣṭhā vasavaśca ye ||53|||
bhinnabhinnāśramāste’pi prajānāṃ patayo’malāḥ |
ninyuḥ svasvāśrameṣvenaṃ śrīpatiṃ rādhikāpatim ||54||
tapoloke tamānarcurbhojayāmāsurutsukāḥ |
yamaḥ prajāpatiścāpi nināya svālaye prabhum ||55||
kārdamāḥ kāśyapāḥ śaiṣā vikrāntāḥ suśravādayaḥ |
bahuputrāśca pitaraḥ kumārāḥ pitaro’pi ca ||56||
prācetaso vivasvanto’riṣṭanemaya ityapi |
kuśoccayāśca pitaro ninyurnārāyaṇeśvaram ||57|||
svasvālayeṣu cānarcurupadābhirmudānvitāḥ |
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sevayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||58||
vālyakhilyāśca ṛṣayo vaikhānasāśca ye tathā |
devavaidyau bhagavantau tathānye tapaāśritāḥ ||59|||
svasvālayeṣu devīśaṃ sapatnīkaṃ vimānakaiḥ |
ninyurānarcurārārtrikaṃ vyadhuścopadā daduḥ ||4.94.60 ||
bhojayāmāsurutkṛṣṭāmṛtānnāni gṛhe gṛhe |
bhrāmayāmāsurīśeśaṃ grāme grāme gṛhe gṛhe ||61 ||
śayanāsanabhogām̐śca daduste gandhimālikāḥ |
bhūṣā veṣām̐śca pradadurmaṇiratnasragādikam |||62|||
pātrāsanānarghyaśṛṅgārādi daduryathāyatham |
navīnopakaraṇāni daduste kamaleśine ||63||
āhārām̐śca vihārām̐ścārpayāmāsuḥ parātmane |
puṇyodyāneṣu vāṭīṣu vanāraṇyādribhūmiṣu ||64||
nijarājyeṣu saudheṣu prajāsu vasatiṣvapi |
bhrāmayitvā sarvarājaṃ pāvayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||65|||
papuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ te te tāstāśca yoṣitaḥ śubhāḥ |
bhojayitvā hariṃ tasya prasādaṃ lebhire striyaḥ ||66||
naijaṃ saubhāgyamutkṛṣṭaṃ dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ ca menire |
nārāyaṇaprasaṃgena kṛtakṛtyā babhūvire ||67||
rāmayāmāsurīśeśaṃ svasvasampatpradānakaiḥ |
sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ śayaneśvaram ||68||
prāṇeśaṃ bhojayāmāsurarpayāmāsuruttamam |
dravyaṃ dhanaṃ sugandhaṃ ca divyaṃ veṣaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam ||69||
kṛṣṇamāndolayāmāsurdolāsu bahuyoṣitaḥ |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruraṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ tathā ||4.94.70||
svasvakalānāṃ kauśalyaṃ darśayāmāsuragrataḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyasvāmine svāhā ||7 1 ||
bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi |
tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādītimantrau ca jagṛhuḥ ||72||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakānta ramāyaṇa ||73|||
evaṃ te jagṛhurnāmadhunyaṃ śrīmādhavīśituḥ |
mātaraṃ śrīramālakṣmīprajñārhaṇāṃ pracakrire ||74||
tathā devyo brahmanārīḥ pupūjuścopadānvitāḥ |
nṛtyagītotsavām̐ścakruḥ svāvāse yajjanārdanaḥ ||75||
sarvārpaṇaṃ pracakruśca brahmeśāya parātmane |
tuṣṭuvuḥ śrījayākāntaṃ narā nāryaśca tāpasāḥ ||76||
namaḥ sarvāvatārāṇāmavatāriparātmane |
muktānāṃ maṇḍalāvāsāyāpi mānuṣavāsine ||77||
kṛpālave satyalokalābhadāya ca te namaḥ |
namastāpasadevāya tapolokāgatāya te ||78||
namo mokṣapradātre te namaḥ pitṛpramocine |
namo’nantasvarūpāyānantaśaktyabhiśāline ||79||
namo brahmapriyākāntasvarūpāyāntarātmane |
haripriyābhisevyāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||4.94.80||
tapolokastapaḥprāpyastapaḥkṣaye kṣayaṃ vrajet |
tāpasāśca gataiśvaryā naśyanti bhavasāgare ||8 1 ||
hariṃ vinā na vai muktiḥ so’yaṃ bhavānupāgataḥ |
uddhāraya tapolokāt saṃsārasāgarāditaḥ ||82|||
pūrveṣāṃ kalpakālānāṃ puṇyabhājo vayaṃ tviha |
kṛpayā nivasāmo hi yadyapi śrībhujaḥ sadā ||83||
tathāpi tava sānnidhyaṃ pādayoḥ pūjanaṃ tu naḥ |
kadāpi prāpyate naiva nāvāpyeta kṛpāṃ vinā ||84||
svargasatyāntalokānāṃ nivāsināṃ tu sarvathā |
mahāpuṇyāni santyeva kevalabandhanāni hi ||85||
naiva puṇyaphalaṃ bhogamantarānyat pravartate |
iyaṃ tu karuṇā te’tra hare yad darśanaṃ tava ||86||
varaṃ tu bhūtale janma yatra kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate |
na dinaṃ tu vinā kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣāt pṛthvīgataṃ kvacit ||87||
anyalokeṣvekavāraṃ samāyāsyati gauravāt |
mahākāryanivahārthaṃ sarvathā dṛśyase nahi ||88||
varaṃ bhūtapiśācādijanma devarṣipitṛtaḥ |
yatra kvāpi milenmuktiryogataḥ śrīhareḥ satām ||89||
tadadya bhagavān prāpto dayāśevadhiracyutaḥ |
kuru naḥ sarvathā mokṣamarthayāmo varaṃ tviyam ||4.94.9 0||
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śrutvā teṣāṃ tadarthanām |
purāṇapitṛnivahān śrāddhāpekṣakajīvinām ||91 ||
purāṇātipurāṇānāṃ mokṣamiyeṣa satvaram |
badrike śrīharistām̐śca pāyayāmāsa cāmṛtam ||92||
pādāmṛtaṃ prasādādi bhojayāmāsa sakṛpaḥ |
teṣāṃ vakṣaḥsu caraṇau dadau bandhaharau sukhī ||93||
divyatādhāyakau ramyau rādhālakṣmyādisevitau |
ūrdhvarekhānvitau raktatalau ca mṛdulāvati ||94||
aṣṭakoṇasvastikāmyā vajrajambūjavāṃkuśaiḥ |
ketupadmasucakrādyairyuktaṃ dakṣapadaṃ śubham ||95||
trikoṇakalaśābhyāṃ ca gopādamakarāmbaraiḥ |
dhanurmīnārdhacandraiśca mandiracakrakairyutam ||96||
vāmapādaṃ pravīkṣyāpi tuṣṭiṃ te paramāṃ yayuḥ |
mastakeṣu nyadhāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ karadvayam ||97||
komalaṃ raktatalakaṃ candrāṃśanakharājitam |
mīnadhvajadhanusvastiśaraśūlavirājitam || 98||
catuścakramahādaṇḍaśaṃkhalekhādiśobhitam |
dakṣaṃ karaṃ harervīkṣyānandaṃ paraṃ hi lebhire ||99||
vāmaṃ suśobhanaṃ ramyaṃ chatradhenulatānvitam |
nirmīcakrayutaṃ cakracatuṣṭayābjarājitam || 4.94.100 ||
śaṃkhena rekhitaṃ madhyāṃgulyagraṃ vīkṣya te tadā |
divyadṛṣṭiyutā jātāḥ sakthna lakṣmīṃ tu vāmake || 101 ||
rādhāṃ tu jaghane vīkṣya mahānandaṃ prapedire |
kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā tūrṇaṃ visṛjya pitṛputtalān || 1 02||
divyadehā abhavam̐śca bahavaḥ pitarastadā |
muktā muktānikā jātāḥ pitaro mātaro gaṇāḥ || 10 3||
āyayuśca vimānāni mukteritāni dhāmataḥ |
sthitvā niṣadya te teṣu yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 1 04||
ityevaṃ badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi mokṣaṇam |
datvā prasādya tān tatra nivasitān prabhāṣya ca || 1 05||
aryamādikṛtārcaśca vimānena svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
sarvasārthayutaḥ prasthāpito janaṃ samāyayau || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīharistapolokanivāsināṃ pitrādidevagaṇānāṃ bhavaneṣu
cāryamādikṛtapūjāṃ samprāpya pitṝṇāṃ mokṣaṃ kṛtvā janalokamājagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||

<4.95>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi bhagavān pauṣamāsake |
janalokaṃ sādhyadevāśritaṃ samāyayau tataḥ || 1 ||
tatra devāḥ sādhyasaṃjñā jayākhyāḥ pitarastathā |
yajñabhājaḥ paradevāḥ svāgataṃ śrīharervyadhuḥ || 2 ||
brahmaṇo ye mukhājjātā jayā devāḥ prajepsavaḥ |
sarve mantraśarīrāste hareḥ svāgatamācaran || 3 ||
darśākhyaḥ pūrṇamāsākhyo bṛhadvaryo rathantaraḥ |
citiścāpi vicittiśca ākūtiḥ kūtirityapi || 4 ||
vijñātaśca mano yajñaścaite jayākhyadevatāḥ |
yajñanārāyaṇasaudhe rājādhirājaśobhite || 5 ||
yajñadevo hariṃ tatra nivāsaṃ samakārayat |
pupūja parayā prītyārārtrikaṃ ca vyadhāttathā || 6 ||
bhojayāmāsa pīyūṣaṃ sevayāmāsa bhāvataḥ |
tuṣitā nāma devāśca tato ninyurnijālaye || 7 ||
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā nīrājanaṃ vyadhurhareḥ |
tataśca harayo devā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 8 ||
ānarcurbahusampattyā bhojayāmāsuracyutam |
vaikuṇṭhā nāma vai devā janalokanivāsinaḥ || 9 ||
ninyuḥ svamandire kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjuḥ paramādṛtāḥ |
haṃsaḥ prāṇaḥ prabhavaścārārtrikaṃ śrīharervyadhuḥ || 4.95.1 0||
aṣṭāpi vasavaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ninyurnijālāyan prati |
dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścāpyanilo’nalaḥ || 1 1||
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaścānarcuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam |
maṇiratnāni bahūni pradaduḥ paramātmane || 12||
atha ninyuviśvadevāḥ kraturdakṣaḥ śravaḥ stavaḥ |
kāmaḥ satyo dhuniḥ kālaḥ kuruḥ prabhuśca rocanaḥ || 13||
pupūjuḥ paramīśānaṃ śrīkāntaṃ kambharātmajam |
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuścāpi bhojayāmāsuracyutam || 14||
viṣṇurvai mānasākhyaścājitaścāpi haristathā |
satyo viṣṇuśca vaikuṇṭhaḥ sādhyo viṣṇustrivikramaḥ || 15||
ta ete viṣṇavaḥ sarve janaloke kṛtālayāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇana rāyaṇamāhūya mandire || 16 ||
pupūjurviṣṇuyantāraṃ parabrahma pumuttamam |
abhiṣekaṃ pracakruste śrīgopālātmajasya vai || 17||
śṛṃgāraṃ śobhanaṃ pūjāmārārtrikaṃ tato vyadhuḥ |
bhojanāni pradaduśca tāmbūlakāni vai tataḥ || 18||
vaiṣṇavāśca janāḥ sarve tathānarcuḥ pareśvaram |
vaiṣṇavya indirāḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuḥ śrīramāpriyāḥ || 19||
lakṣmīrādhābrahmapriyā haripriyāśca yoṣitaḥ |
indirābhiścārpitāścopadā lakṣmyādisannidhau ||4.95.20 ||
bhojitāḥ pūjitāścāpi sevitā mātaro’khilāḥ |
pradadurviṣṇavaścāpīndirādyā bhūṣaṇāni ha || 21 ||
sauvarṇaṃ mukuṭaṃ divyaṃ sāgraṃ ratnādisaṃbhṛtam |
kuṇḍale śobhane divye karṇapūrau ca kānakau |||22||
kaṇṭhahārān kaustubhāḍhyān maṇiratnādiyojitān |
bhujabandhau hīrakādyaiḥ khacitau kānakau daduḥ ||23||
prakoṣṭhaśṛṃkhale svarṇamauktikādivibhūṣite |
kaṭake kānake cāpyaṅgulīyakāni cormikāḥ ||24||
padmāni raśanā hārān sudarśanāni vai daduḥ |
vetraṃ yaṣṭiṃ kānakīṃ ca naktakaṃ divyatantujam ||25||
pāduke pādabhūṣe ca sauvarṇe divyakānake |
pradadurharaye badri viṣṇavaste haripriyāḥ ||26||
haripriyābhyaḥ pradadurindirādyā mahopadāḥ |
kucalīḥ kutaladhrīśca śāṭikā kañcukīstathā ||27||
ghargharīścāntarapaṭānyapi daduḥ subhāvitāḥ |
keśabhūṣāścandrakāni cipiṭikāḥ sugucchakān || 28||
veṇīveṣān kānakām̐śca dhammiladhrān suvarṇajān |
cūḍāmaṇīn taijasām̐śca nandamauktikabhūṣitān || 29||
divyā lalantikāścāpi gaṇḍapadmalalantikāḥ |
cibūkacandrikāścāpi karṇaśṛṃkhalikāḥ śubhāḥ ||4.95.3 0||
śrāvaṇīḥ kānakīścāpyālambarāṇīḥ suśobhitāḥ |
puṣpakāṇi kānakāni sthalakāni śubhānyapi |||3 1 ||
tārakā vardhikāścāpi candrikā pradaduḥ striyaḥ |
patrikāḥ pañcasarikāḥ sūkṣmatilām̐śca kānakān ||32||
mudgamālāḥ svastimālā badarīmālikā daduḥ |
yavamālāḥ svarṇamāṣāḥ suvarṇakaṇṭhikā daduḥ |||33||
patramālāḥ śṛṃkhalāśca maṇimauktikamālikāḥ |
dadurindivaraśyāmā vaiṣṇavyaḥ padmamālikāḥ || 34||
sphāṭikānāṃ śubhān hārān sūryamukhīṃ dadustadā |
stanacandrau maṇiratnanaddhakānakanirmitau ||35|||
natthikā vālikāḥ svarṇajanyā maṇivibhūṣitāḥ |
pāṭalīmālikāścāpi maṇihārān daduḥ striyaḥ || 36||
kaṇṭhavalayān sauvarṇatilasrajaśca mādalīḥ |
plakṣadalīṃ mahāhārān raśanā mekhalā daduḥ |||37||
svarṇagucchān kandukām̐śca sauvarṇān cakrakān daduḥ |
sakthipaṭṭān jānupaṭṭān prakoṣṭhaśṛṅkhalā daduḥ ||38||
jhāṃjharīḥ kāmbikāścāpi daduḥ kadalikāḥ śubhāḥ |
pādabhūṣāṃgulibhūṣāṃguṣṭhabhūṣā daduḥ striyaḥ || 39||
alaktakān kajjalāni śṛṃgārakuṃkumāni ca |
raṃgān dravān dravasārān tailasārāṇi vai daduḥ ||4.95.40||
rasasārān gandhasārān miṣṭasārāṇi saṃdaduḥ |
ambarāṇi bhāsvarāṇi svarṇatāramayāni ca ||41||
divyamauktikanaddhāni dadustābhyastu cendirāḥ |
pātrāṇi kundanajāni divyopakaraṇānyapi ||42|||
sarvasārātisārāṇi gṛhopakaraṇāni ca |
indirāḥ indirābhyaḥ sandaduḥ śayyāḥ samujjvalāḥ ||43||
āsamāni vicitrāṇi keśasādhanakānyapi |
ādarśān saurabhacūrṇān pūjāyāṃ pradaduḥ striyaḥ ||44||
pādatrāṇāni ramyāṇi komalāni mṛdūni ca |
ālekhanāni ramyāṇi kirīṭān pradaduḥ striyaḥ ||45||
ityevaṃ janalokasthā viṣṇavaścendirāstathā |
haraye haripatnībhya upadāḥ subhagā daduḥ ||46 ||
sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ janaloke tu badrike |
poṣamāsaṃ janaloke bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ || 47||
vyatyayāmāsa janināṃ snehāgrahaprasevanaiḥ |
parvatodyānasarito lokayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||48 ||
darśayāmāsa bhagavān sarvā bhagavatīrnijāḥ |
janalokanivāsibhyo dadau mantraṃ hariḥ svayam ||49||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |
bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi ||4.95.50 ||
tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādītimantraṃ jagāda tān |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa ||51 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin ramāyaṇa |
itidhunyaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ pāvayitvā tato hariḥ ||52||
bahubhyaḥ preṣayāmāsa dhāmākṣaraṃ nijaṃ drutam |
yajñadevādayo devā vidāyaṃ haraye daduḥ ||53 ||
harirmāghe janalokānmaharlokaṃ samāyayau |
kalpādhikāridevānāṃ dvijānāṃ yatra vāsitā ||54||
rudrā ekādaśa ye te brahmaputrāstu bhālajāḥ |
pūrvakalpodbhavāḥ kalpāvasānikā mahargatāḥ ||55||
teṣāṃ rājyeṣu bhagavān rudrārthita upāyayau |
nīlalohitarudrasya mahāpuryāṃ janārdanam | |56||
nīlalohitarudro vai pupūja rudrikāyutaḥ |
ārārtrikaṃ pracakāra bhojayāmāsa keśavam ||57||
vāsamāmāsa saudhe sve sevayāmāsa sapriyaḥ |
dadau kṛṣṇāya bahulopadā divyāḥ prapūjane ||58 ||
mukuṭāmbarabhūṣādi maṇiratnavibhūtikāḥ |
athānye ye rudravaryā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ harim || 59||
nijālayeṣu vidhivat pūjayāmāsuracyutam |
sahasraikavṛṣabhāṇāṃ dhavalānāṃ prabhājuṣām ||4.95.60 ||
kakudvatāṃ surūpāṇāṃ giriśṛṃgābhadehinām |
vyomagānāṃ hi dhuryāṇāṃ yojite kānake rathe || 61 ||
sahasraikakalaśāḍhye sahasraikadhvajānvite |
śatakammānikājuṣṭe vartule padmasadṛśe || 62||
svarṇavyāghrāsane kṛṣṇaṃ rudrā nyaṣādayan harim |
abhrāmayannijapuryāṃ raudryāṃ sarvatra meśvaram || 63 ||
gṛhe gṛhe ca rathyāsu catvare catvare tathā |
udyāneṣu nivāseṣu rudrā ninyurhariṃ prabhum || 64||
pupujuḥ parayā prītyā rudrāstatra sthale sthale |
rudrāṇyo dhavalābhāśca pupūjuḥ pārvatīśvaram ||65||
candanākṣatagandhaiśca phalapuṣpairvibhūtibhiḥ |
bhūṣāvastranāṇakaiśca divyamānasabhāvanaiḥ ||66 ||
pūvakalpāntikā devā aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ |
nītvā nītvālayān naijānānarcurbahurūpiṇam ||67||
bhojayāmāsuriṣṭānnānyatidivyāmṛtānyapi |
sevayāmāsurīśeśaṃ devāste devatāyutāḥ ||68||
ānandākhyāśca ye devā bhāvadevāśca ye tathā |
rāṃbhadevā ārtavāśca āśvarāḥ pāvakāḥ surāḥ ||69||
havyavāhāśca sāvitrā auśikāḥ kauśikāstathā |
ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ svasvamandireṣvabhyapūjayan ||4.95.70 ||
bhojayāmāsurīśeśaṃ siṣevire samādṛtāḥ |
atha gāndhāradevāśca ṣaḍjanā ārṣabhāḥ surāḥ ||7 1 ||
mārjālīyāstathā devā mādhyamā ninyuracyutam |
divyayāne hariṃ naijanagareṣu vyavartayan ||72||
apūjayam̐śca vividhairupahārairanuttamaiḥ |
abhojayam̐śca bahudhā divyānnairdivyabhojanaiḥ ||73 ||
atha vairājakāścānye naiṣādā meghavāhanāḥ |
prāṇadevāścintakāścākūtikā mānasāḥ surāḥ || 74||
ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ svasvasaudheṣu cābhyapūjayan |
rāthantarāḥ surāścāpi sadyojātā harāstathā ||75||
vīrāśca vāmadevāśca pītavāsādayaḥ surāḥ |
sitakalpā aghorāśca viśvarūpāśca ye surāḥ ||76||
ninyuste paramātmānaṃ svasvālayeṣu bhāvitāḥ |
abhrāmayan hariṃ naije naije tu pattane gṛhe ||77||
apūjayan maṇiratnairdivyaiḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ |
abhojayan sudhānnaiścātarpayannamṛtairjalaiḥ ||78||
rudrāścakrustāṇḍavāni nārāyaṇasamīpagāḥ |
nīlalohitarudro vai sucakre tāṇḍavaṃ śubham ||79||
śrībadrīpriyovācakīdṛśaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ cakre kīdṛgrūpo harastadā |
vada me tatsvarūpaṃ vai nārāyaṇapareśvara ||4.95.80 ||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
rudro hariṃ prapūjyātmānandamagno babhūva ha |
prasannātmā praṇipatya svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||8 1 ||
dhanyo’smyadya hareḥ prāpteḥ kṛtakṛtyo’smi sarvathā |
yanme gṛhe kṛpāsindhuḥ parameśa upāgataḥ |||82||
ityuktvā harṣapūrṇaśca smayan tāṇḍavamācarat |
tatra sthitāḥ śṛṅgibhṛṅgirīṭikirīṭināmakāḥ ||83||
ambākārtikavighneśā abhavannṛtyayoginaḥ |
rūpaṃ dadhāra rudro’tra cārdhanārīnarātmakam ||84||
mandasmitānanaṃ bhasmagauraṃ yathārhabhūṣaṇam |
vāmapādāṃguṣṭhasaṃstho dakṣapādaṃ samunnayan ||85||
iṣadūrdhvānanaścordhvahasto vakraśca jānunoḥ |

netraprāntadadhatsnigdhanīlakajjalarekhakaḥ ||92||

satīstanapaṭaprāntayojitottarakañcukaḥ ||95||
kārtikasya mayūreṇa phuṃkārito’tibhogarāṭ |

dhavalo vṛṣabho yatra bhāṃ karoti tadanvitām |
teṣāṃ tālapradāno’yaṃ ḍamarūṃ vādayan haraḥ ||99||
hṛṣṭaromā hṛṣṭagātraḥ kampayan dharaṇiśrayam |
pāda vikṣepayan caikapādāṃguṣṭena tolayan || 4.95.10 0||
nanarta bhrāmayan dehaṃ bhraman rarāja nṛtyakṛt |
pradakṣiṇena dakṣeṇa vāmenāpi tataḥ punaḥ || 101 ||
pṛṣṭhavaṃśena cāgreṇa pārśvadānena vai punaḥ |
padenāpi ca pādābhyāṃ dattakṛṣṇekṣaṇo hariḥ || 10 2||
nanarta cañcalastyaktalajjaḥ sarvāṃgakampanaḥ |
kvacit stanaṃ kvacilliṅgaṃ kvacitkarāgramātrakam || 1 03||
