ityevamarthayāmāsurbhṛtyādyā nṛpamānavāḥ ||4.109.100||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭyuttaraṃ rājñāṃ nirmāṇaṃ, dilāvarīrājadhānīnṛpasya nāgavikramasya tīrthayātrāvicaraṇe kuṃkumavāpyāṃ gamanaṃ, tatra samādhiphalaṃ divyatāpādanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 109 ||

<4.110>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi nāgavikramabhūbhṛtaḥ |
bhṛtyādīnāṃ prārthanordhvaṃ yadabhūt tad vadāmyaham || 1 ||
anādiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ kṛṣṇamādhavaḥ |
pratyuvāca tu tadbhṛtyān yathārthaṃ vai śubhaṃ vacaḥ || 2 ||
nāyaṃ rājā pramatto’sti nonmatto na vicittakaḥ |
nāpi bhūtapiśācābhibhavavān nābhicāravān || 3 ||
madbhakto matpratāpena samādhau māṃ nijākṣare |
dhāmni rājādhirājaṃ sa vyalokayat priyāyutaḥ || 4 ||
divyaṃ māṃ divyadhāmāpi sarvāśca divyasampadaḥ |
vīkṣya divyavibhūtīśca divyatāṃ prāptavān hi saḥ || 5 ||
divyadṛṣṭirdivyakarmā divyadharmāsti sāmpratam |
divyabhāvamayaścāste divyāntaḥkaraṇendriyaḥ || 6 ||
na tasya rocate māyāmayaṃ cedaṃ sakalmaṣam |
audāsīnyaṃ gataścāste paśyatyetattu naśvaram || 7 ||
nirayākhyaṃ samastaṃ vai brahmāṇḍaṃ sa prapaśyati |
rājyaṃ naijaṃ ca bhūmyādi sarvaṃ paśyati kardamam || 8 ||
aśuddhaṃ cāpi vikṛtaṃ kledāḍhyaṃ saṃprapaśyati |
videha iva cāste’sau jīvanmukto jitendriyaḥ || 9 ||
pratyāhṛtāntaḥkaraṇaḥ sastrīko muktavat sthitaḥ |
tato’sau yogivadbhūmau vartate hṛtavāsanaḥ || 4.110.1 0||
vrahmadaśāṃ samārūḍho vartate māyikātparaḥ |
amāyiko’yaṃ sañjāto matsamādhermadātmakaḥ || 1 1||
sanakādisamaścāste śivatulyo virāgavān |
mā śocantu mahābhāgyaṃ divyaṃ nṛpaṃ tato’nugāḥ || 1 2||
asya divyatayā santi nāvaraṇāni kānicit |
bhūmau jale’nale pāraṃ gantuṃ śakto’ṇusiddhimān || 1 3||
svarge satye ca vairāje vaikuṇṭhe gantumīśvaraḥ |
nāsya rājyaṃ na vai bhṛtyā bādhitumīśvarāstviha || 14||
tato’yaṃ vartate yogisthityā yogīśvaro yatiḥ |
satī taddharmabhāryāpi tathaiva vartate parā || 15||
bhavatāṃ pratyayārthaṃ taṃ prerayāmi samakṣagam |
sāntvayituṃ bhavataśca kṛtayatno yathā bhavet || 16||
ityuktvā badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamahāprabhuḥ |
rājānaṃ prerayāmāsa bhṛtyādiśokanuttaye || 17||
śṛṇu rājam̐stava bhṛtyādayaḥ śocanti te kṛte |
tān vijñāpaya vṛttāntaṃ naijaṃ yathārthamujjvalam || 18||
ityevaṃ badrike prokto rājā tu nāgavikramaḥ |
sbabhṛtyādīn samuvāca virāgiṇīṃ nijāṃ sthitim || 1 9||
śṛṇvantu bhṛtyavargādyāḥ kurvantu ca mayoditam |
hitaṃ vadāmi sarveṣāṃ prāptaṃ divyaṃ mayā dhanam ||4.110.20||
ayaṃ vai bhagavān sākṣācchrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
akṣareśo’vatārāṇāṃ dhartā prāpto mayā tviha ||21 ||
madyogena bhavadbhiśca prāptaḥ śrīpativallabhaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||22||
tatpratāpena sāmrājyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā viśālakam |
tatpratāpena divyā ca dṛṣṭiṃ sthitiṃ gato’smi ca ||23||
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma tatpratāpena vai mayā |
vīkṣitaṃ ca samādhau vai divyarddhayo vilokitāḥ ||24||
yadagre ceśvarāṇāṃ vai smṛddhayo nirayopamāḥ |
tataḥ kimuta devānāṃ sutarāṃ mānavarddhayaḥ ||25||
māyāmayyaḥ smṛddhayastā nirayā eva santi vai |
na rocante mama tvetāḥ smṛddhayo malinā yataḥ || 26||
harerdivyasya yogena prāpto’haṃ divyatāṃ parām |
bhavanto’pi hareryogād gṛhṇantu divyatāṃ parām ||27||
śāśvataṃ paramānandaṃ gṛhṇantvanādimādhavāt |
tyajantu vāsanāsainyaṃ nirayaṃ bhautikaṃ gṛham ||28||
hareḥ rājyaṃ samastaṃ vai brahmāṇḍānāṃ paraṃ tathā |
samastaṃ śrīhareḥ rājyaṃ na me rājyaṃ manāgapi || 29||
muktirājyaṃ samicchāmi bhuktirājyaṃ na rocate |
tato bhavanto bhṛtyādyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śrayantu satpatim ||4.110.3 0||
tyaktabhogasukhā nityānandā bhavantu keśave |
adhruvaṃ mā ca valgantu valgantu parameśvaram ||3 1||
mṛtasya rājadehasya na rājyaṃ na dhanaṃ gṛham |
ātmanastu pramuktasya mahārājyaṃ parākṣaram ||32||
vicāryetthaṃ cārpayāmi samastaṃ paramātmane |
dilāvarīmahārājyaṃ cārpayāmi parātmane ||33||
vairāgyaṃ prāptavānasmi sapatnīko na saṃśayaḥ |
bhūtvā dāso hareḥ sādhuḥ seviṣye’tra guruṃ harim ||34||
rājyaṃ dadāmi haraye yena dattaṃ purā tu me |
sa eva sarvamavatu nāhaṃ rājyaṃ prarocaye || 35||
ityuktvā bhṛtyavargebhyo rājā vai nāgavikramaḥ |
haste jalaṃ samādāya rājyaṃ kṛṣṇāya cārpayat || 36 ||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ kṛṣṇapādayornipapāta saḥ |
vihāya rājacihnāni kṛṣṇapādarajo’gilat || 37||
rājñī cāpi tathā cakre kṛṣṇapādarajāṃsi vai |
jihvayā lehayāmāsa kṛṣṇapādatalaṃ tathā || 38||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ bhṛtyādyāste nṛpānugāḥ |
matvaiva dhanyabhāgyāni vavandire hariṃ tadā || 3 9||
praśaśaṃsurnṛpaṃ cāpi mokṣamārgaprayāyinam |
sarve bhṛtyādayaścāpi tyāgamārgaṃ prapedire ||4.110.40 ||
nipatya śrīhareragre nṛpavaccakrire ca te |
nijārpaṇaṃ hareragre tyāgārthaṃ prākṛtasya vai ||41 ||
atha śrībhagavān rājñe dadau dīkṣāṃ tu sādhavīm |
nāma kṛṣṇo dadau tasya trivikramāyano muniḥ |||42 ||
rājñyā nāma cakārāpi kṛṣṇaḥ śrīmālikāyanī |
trivikramāyanaḥ sādhuḥ sādhvī śrīmālikāyanī ||43 ||
pupūjatuḥ parātmānaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
guruṃ cānye badri sarve bhṛtyāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāḥ || 44||
sādhudīkṣāṃ jagṛhuśca tyāgāśrame sthitāstadā |
sarve tyāgaṃ samāśritya bhejuḥ śrīkāntavallabham ||45||
nāryo dāsyaśca yāstā vai sādhvīdīkṣāṃ prapedire |
sahasrasaṃkhyakā nāryaḥ sādhvyastatrābhavam̐stadā ||46 ||
divyabhāvā divyadehāḥ samastatyaktavāsanāḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre nyavasam̐ste tathāvidhāḥ ||47||
svataḥprakāśo bhagavān svāśrame tānnyavāsayat |
te bhejuḥ paramātmānaṃ siṣevire patiṃ prabhum ||48 ||
śrutvā pṛthvyāṃ janāḥ sarve mahāścaryaṃ prapedire |
rājānaścāpi cāścaryaṃ prāpurvai tyāgagocaram ||49 ||
ityevaṃ badrike tatra rājā vai nāgavikramaḥ |
tyāgāśramaṃ tvāviveśa sastrīsainyānugaḥ kṣaṇāt ||4.110.50 ||
tapastepe hareḥ kṣetre bheje śrīmādhavīpatim |
siṣeve śrīprabhuṃ nāthaṃ brahmasthityā hi vartayan ||51 ||
atha śrībhagavān badri prāha trivikramāyanam |
dilāvarīmahārājyaṃ kasmai deyaṃ vadātra me ||52 ||
muniḥ prāha hare rājyaṃ bhavatā mayi yojitam |
bhavatastat, na me rājyaṃ yatheṣṭāya nivedaya ||53||
putro’yaṃ bhavataḥ kṛṣṇa tvatsamo rājate prabhuḥ |
mukundavikramo nāmnā cakravartiguṇānvitaḥ |||54|||
dakṣahastatale tasya cakracihnaṃ virājate |
rājyayogyo bhavatyeṣastasmai cecchasi dehi vai ||55 ||
evaṃ tvabhihite tatra sādhu sādhviti cābhitaḥ |
vāco’bhavan harṣayuktā nārīnarābhyudīritāḥ ||56||
mukundavikramasyārthe jayaśabdastadābhavan |
śrīkṛṣṇasya sutāḥ putryaḥ patnyaścāpi tathāvadan ||57||
mukundavikramo rājā jyeṣṭhapatnyagrajaḥ sutaḥ |
sarvajyeṣṭhatamastasmād rājyamarhati śobhanam ||58||
evaṃ vāco’bhavan badri maṃgalāḥ sarvatodiśaḥ |
omityevaṃ hariścāpi mene tathyāṃ munermatim ||59||
sā vārtā prāsarat tūrṇaṃ kuṃkumapattane’bhitaḥ |
ākṣare parame kṣetre saurāṣṭre’pi gṛhe gṛhe ||4.110.60 ||
ājanābhe tathā khaṇḍe khaṇḍeṣvanyeṣvapi dhruvā |
svarge satye ca pātāle sarvalokeṣu satvaram || 61 ||
nāgavikramanṛpatistyāgināṃ jagṛhe bhuvi |
mukundavikramo rājā cakravartī bhaviṣyati || 6 2||
hareḥ putro hareraṃśo dilāvarīśvaro’dhunā |
hāstinīnagarīsvāmī haimakhaṇḍe bhaviṣyati ||62 ||
muktibāleśvarī tasya sahajā yamalodbhavā |
samrājñī tatpriyā rājyamātā śreṣṭhā bhaviṣyati ||64||
ityevaṃ bhūtalādau vai prāvartata jane jane |
mahāmaṃgalavārteyaṃ kṛṣṇasmaraṇakāriṇī || 65||
utsavāścāpyajāyanta vādyakīrtananartanaiḥ |
nārīṇāṃ veṣaśṛṃgārairmānavānāṃ gṛhe gṛhe || 66||
atha śrībadrīke’nādiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
candraṃ tu sanmukhaṃ vīkṣya muhūrte balavattame ||67||
dilāvarīṃ prati gantumājñāṃ dadau nijātmajān |
mukundavikramo jyeṣṭhaputro rājā bhaviṣyati ||68 ||
tadutsave vimānaiśca yugalāni prayāntu vai |
mama patnyaḥ samastāśca yāvanti yamalānyapi || 69||
dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyavargā dilāvarīṃ prayāntu vai |
lomaśaśca tathā yogī sārthaḥ prakāśakāyanaḥ ||4.110.70 ||
trivikramāyanaścāpi tathānye sādhavo janāḥ |
maharṣayaśca ṛṣayo munayo vedapāragāḥ ||7 1 ||
karmaṭhā vaiṣṇavā viprā dilāvarīṃ prayāntu vai |
evamājñāpya bhagavān preṣayamāsa prāka tu tān |||72||
pārṣadaiścāpi bhūkhaṇḍe preṣayāmāsa patrikāḥ |
svarge satye ca pātāle caturdaśastareṣvapi ||73||
preṣayāmāsa vijñaptipatrikāṃ maṃgalāvahām |
īśvarān siddhasādhyām̐śca pitṝn surām̐śca mānavān ||74||
dikpālān lokapālāṃśca yakṣarākṣasakinnarān |
kimpuruṣām̐ścāraṇām̐śca vidyādhrān daityadānavān ||75||
apsaraso brahmasarasaśca sādhvīḥ satīstathā |
yoginīḥ śaktidevīśca devatāśca tatheśvarīḥ ||76||
vijñaptipatrikāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ preṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ |
dhāmadhāmādimuktām̐śca muktānikāstathā prabhūn ||77||
āhvayāmāsa bhagavān kuṃkumapatrikādibhiḥ |
bhaktānnṛpān samastām̐ścāparān khaṇḍāntareśvarān ||78||
dvīpeśvarān bhūbhṛtaścāhvayāmāsa haristadā |
śvaśurān nijaputrām̐śca tattaddhāmagṛhasthitān ||79||
āhvayāmāsa bhagavān dilāvarīpurīṃ prati |
atha śrībhagavān mātrāpitrā putrādibhiḥ saha ||4.110.80 ||
patnyādibhiśca sahito vimānena hi satvaram |
yayau dilāvarīṃ rājadhānīṃ haimabhuvāṃ śubhām ||8 1 ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa daśayojanamuttamam |
sauvarṇaṃ cānuyamunaṃ divyaratnādirājitam | |82||
divyādivyanṛpavargasiṃhāsanādisaṃyutam |
munimaharṣimuktādyāsanapaṃktyādyalaṃkṛtam ||83||
sarvasiddhimayaṃ sarvarājasmṛddhiprapūritam |
sarvadṛśyamahādṛśyaśastrāstraputtalānvitam ||84||
sarvaraṃgāvaliśobhaṃ kalpalatādruveṣitam |
vidyutprakāśabhāvyāptaṃ divyādarśādiśobhanam ||85||
divyaparīdevatābhiḥ karamālābhivardhitam |
divyāstaraṇabhūbhāgaṃ divyatoraṇarājitam ||86||
bahuvyomāntarakakṣānārīvṛndavilāsitam |
gandhasugandhasurabhivyāptaṃ susparśavātinam ||87||
sarvapānādisaṃklṛptaṃ sarvasevakavetriṇam |
sarvamaṃgalapadmādisvastikādisuśobhitam ||88||
raṃgavallīvitānādyairmālāhārālirājitam |
divyayantradhvaniramyaṃ gītigāyanaharṣitam ||89|||
vādyasuvādyagāndharvagaṇanṛtyādihṛddharam |
manoharaṃ samastābhirviśvakarmakalādibhiḥ ||4.110.9 0 ||
vahnikuṇḍādibhirdevāsanottamairvirājitam |
ābhiṣekopakaraṇaiḥ pūjādravyaiḥ samanvitam ||9 1||
havyairvividhairdānādyaiḥ sampūrṇaṃ sādhanādibhiḥ |
rājavidhimahādravyairyuktaṃ veṣādibhistathā ||92||
rājyābhiṣekopakaraṇādyaiḥ samanvitaṃ śubham |
svarṇaratnavibhūṣādyairnṛpayogyasuvastubhiḥ || 9 3 ||
chatracāmaravetrādyaiḥ pādapīṭhādisaṃkulam |
sauvarṇakalaśaistīrthajalabhṛtairvirājitam ||94||
miṣṭānnaphalapatrādyaiḥ samitkuśādibhiryutam |
divyacandanavaryaiśca gandhasāraiḥ sugandhitam ||95||
rājādhirājaśobhāḍhyaṃ saṃkalpasiddhavastudam |
caityacetanadhiṣṇyaiśca lakṣyasaṃkhyairvirājitam ||96||
mahāsiṃhāsanarājanmadhyapaścimapīṭhakam |
etādṛśaṃ suvaikuṇṭhaprabhaṃ divyaṃ hi maṇḍapam ||97||
kārayāmāsa bhagavān dhāmayuktakalākaraiḥ |
tathaiva bhojanānāṃ ca parvatān miṣṭasadrasān ||98||
payo’mṛtādipānānāṃ sarāṃsi cāpyakārayat |
āvāsān klṛptayāmāsa sukhaśayyādiśobhanān ||99||
pānabhojanaveṣāṇāṃ klṛptīḥ sukhakarīstathā |
dāsadāsībhṛtyasevākarān rarakṣa tatra ca || 4.110.1 00||
ityevaṃ sarvathā svāmīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
racayāmāsa yogyāni vidheyāni tadābhitaḥ || 101 ||
badrike ca tadā sarvaprāṇināṃ supramodanam |
utsavāścābhavan hṛtsu mahānandā nisargajāḥ || 1 02||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīhariḥ svaputrasya mukundavikramasya rājyābhiṣekaṃ
kartuṃ dilāvarīrājadhānīṃ yayau, maṇḍapādīn kārayāmāsa, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||

<4.111>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi mukundavikramaṃ hariḥ |
upoṣaṇaṃ cādyadine kārayāmāsa śuddhaye || 1 ||
gavyaprāśanamevāpi kṣaurakarmāpyakārayat |
dehaśuddhiṃ tathā tīrthavāribhiḥ snānamityapi || 2 ||
akṣayyatṛtīyāyāṃ ca prage’bhiṣekamutsavam |
kārayāmāsa bhagavān sahasratīrthavāribhiḥ || 3 ||
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cāpi kuladevaprapūjanam |
hanūmatpūjanaṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 4 ||
maṇḍape vāstudevānāmarhaṇāṃ lomaśena tu |
kārayāmāsa bhagavān havanāni yathāyatham || 5 ||
vahneḥ prapūjanaṃ vahnau caroḥ śrapaṇamityapi |
homaṃ ca kārayāmāsa viprairvai vedapāragaiḥ || 6 ||
bahuvādyānyavādyanta strīṇāṃ ca gītayo’bhavan |
mahīmānāḥ sarvalokanivāsinaḥ samāyayuḥ ||7||
muktāstathāvatārāśceśvarāḥ siddhāśca sādhavaḥ |
satyadevāśca pitaro mātaro devatāḥ surāḥ ||8||
pārṣadāścāpi muktānyo devyo lakṣmyaḥ samāyayuḥ |
maṇḍape dyunivāsāśca rudrādyā viṣṇavo hyajāḥ ||9||
lokapālā diśāṃpālā merumandaravāsinaḥ |
tīrthāni divyataravaścāyayurvṛkṣavallikāḥ || 4.111.1 0||
tattvāni śaktayaścāpi kāmadughāḥ samāyayuḥ |
maharṣayaśca munayaḥ sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ samāyayuḥ || 11 ||
bhaṭāścāraṇagandharvāḥ sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ |
nartakāścāpi nartakyo maṇḍape vai samāyayuḥ || 1 2||
vidvām̐saḥ kiṃpuruṣāśca kinnarā yakṣarākṣasāḥ |
uragāśca bhujagāśca nāgā daityāśca dānavāḥ || 1 3||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo divyā jātismarāḥ samāyayuḥ |
nadyaśca parvatāścāpi samudrāśca rasāstathā || 14||
tārā grahāśca nakṣatramaṇḍalāni samāyayuḥ |
mānavāḥ ṛṣayo viprā dīnānāthāḥ samāyayuḥ || 15|||
rājāno rājavargāśca prajeśvarāḥ prajājanāḥ |
śreṣṭhino vaiṣṇavā bhaktāḥ koṭiśastatra cāyayuḥ || 16||
rājarājeśvarāḥ sarve niṣeduḥ svāsanādiṣu |
maṇḍapaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ samrājaiḥ śobhano’bhavat || 17||
vedakāryāṇi sarvāṇi pravartante dvijādibhiḥ |
vedaghoṣā udbhavanti garjayanti diśo daśa || 18||
gopālaḥ kārayāmāsa pārṣadaiḥ svāgatādikam |
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kārayāmāsa sammānaṃ pādyavāribhiḥ || 1 9||
arghyādibhiścāpi tathā madhuparkaiḥ samarhaṇaiḥ |
vimānāni samantādvai vyomnaścāvataranti ca ||4.111.20||
āyānti devavaryāśca maṇḍape divyavigrahāḥ |
svāgatenārcitā niṣīdanti siṃhāsaneṣu te ||21 ||
homakāryaṃ tadā badri pravartate yathāyatham |
mukundavikramastatra sapatnīko’nale carum ||22||
juhāva bhāvanāyuktāścājyasamitphalādibhiḥ |
atha śrīlomaśastatra kārayāmāsa pūjanam |||23||
suvarṇavarmaṇaścāpi khaḍgasya carmaṇastathā |
chatrasya vetrayaṣṭyāśca mukuṭasya paṭasya ca || 24||
śataghnyāḥ pūjanaṃ cāpi gadāyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā |
cakrasya pūjanaṃ lakṣmyā rudrāṇyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā ||25||
dhanuṣaḥ pūjanaṃ cāpi bāṇasya pūjanaṃ tathā |
sarvaśastrāstramantrāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca tataḥ param ||26||
rājadhiṣṇyārhaṇāṃ cāpi rudrasya pūjanaṃ tathā |
viṣṇośca brahmaṇaścāpi kārayāmāsa pūjanam || 27||
senādevyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca kośadevasya pūjanam |
pṛthivyāḥ pūjanaṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ ||28||
vārāhapūjanaṃ cāpi svāmiśrīkṛṣṇapūjanam |
bhūpamukuṭapūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ |||29||
śriyā lakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca lābhaśubhaprapūjanam |
jayaśrīpūjanaṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ ||4.111.30||
dikpālāvāhanaṃ bhūpadehe cakāra lomaśaḥ |
surāvāhanamevāpi cakāra lomaśo guruḥ ||3 1||
bhūpatitvārthasaṃsiddhyai cakre bhuvaḥ prapūjanam |
prajāpatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre prajeśapūjanam ||32||
lakṣmīpatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre lakṣmīprapūjanam |
daṇḍapatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre yamasya pūjanam || 33||
dhanapatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre kuberapūjanam |
nadyabdhīśatvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre varuṇapūjanam || 34||
annauṣadhīśatāptyai cakre candraprapūjanam |
rājatvasiddhilābhāya cakre mahendrapūjanam ||35||
pākapatitvalābhārthaṃ cakre’rkapūjanaṃ muniḥ |
ārogyārthaṃ rogapatirudrārhaṇāṃ cakāra saḥ ||36||
tejolābhāya ca vahnipūjāṃ cakāra lomaśaḥ |
prāṇarakṣākaraṃ devaṃ vāyuṃ pupūja lomaśaḥ || 37||
mātṛkāpūjanaṃ rāṣṭraprajāvṛddhyai cakāra saḥ |
samastasṛṣṭidevānāṃ cakāra pūjanaṃ tathā || 38||
vāhanānāṃ pūjanāni śamigohastivājinām |
yānayantravimānānāṃ pūjāṃ cakāra lomaśaḥ ||39||
balidānāni sarvebhyo dadau śrīlomaśastadā |
nirṛtirakṣasāṃ cāpi surāṇāṃ grahanākinām ||4.111.40||
balidānāni ca dadau lomaśaḥ sukhahetave |
kṛtvaivaṃ vidhivat pūjāṃ śāntiṃ śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi ||41 ||
mukhe pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā lomaśastu tataḥ param |
prasādatilakaṃ cakre rājarājñīlalāṭayoḥ |||42||
rājaveṣaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ yajñopavītakaṃ srajam |
mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa yavāṃkurāṇi bhūpatiḥ ||43||
śastradhāraṇamevāpi cakre mukundavikramaḥ |
cakre rājyapratijñāṃ ca prajāpālanagarbhitām ||44||
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca vṛddhā nṛpādayaḥ prajāḥ |
īśvarāśca tathā muktā viprā ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ ||45||
āśīrvādān daduścāpi ciraṃ jīva prajā ava |
putrapautrādimānāssva prajāsevāparo bhava ||46||
svasti te sarvadā cāstu maṃgalāni sadā tava |
utsavāste prajāyāṃ tu bhavantu satataṃ sukhāḥ ||47||
avighnaṃ tava rājyaṃ cāsamudrāntaṃ sthiraṃ sadā |
ārogyadhānyadhanavat sampannaṃ sarvadāstviti ||48||
athaivaṃ dvijavaryāste samuccārya sumākṣataiḥ |
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ puṣpāñjalīn daduḥ kramāt ||49||
trivikramāyanarṣiśca tilakaṃ pracakāra ha |
mukuṭaṃ ca srajaṃ tasya mūrdhni kaṇṭhe’nyasattadā ||4.111.50||
anye’pi sādhavo viprāḥ pupūjuḥ kṣmāpatiṃ tadā |
guruḥ prakāśo bhagavān rājapatraṃ dadau tadā ||51||
rājyādhikāralekhaṃ ca dadau tasmai nṛpāya vai |
jayanādā abhavam̐śca rājānaścopadā daduḥ ||52||
upāyanāni ratnāni maṇihārān suvarṇajān |
dadurnṛpāya cāmūlyān sampadaśca parāḥ śubhāḥ ||53||
kaścicchatraṃ tathā kaścid vetraṃ tathā ca cāmare |
mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale kaścit kaṭake ca dhanāni ca ||54||
svarṇarūpyakabhūṣāśca dadū rājanyavaṃśajāḥ |
prajājanāḥ surā devavarāśca devatā daduḥ ||55||
upāyanāni bahūni cāmūlyāni tadā tadā |
atha śrībhagavānasya tilakaṃ saṃvyadhāddhariḥ ||56||
vaṃśavistāravān rājā bhava cakrādhipādhipaḥ |
ityuktvā mastake mālāṃ karaṃ putrasya sandadau ||57||
āha saṃśṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūpānāṃ saṃsadi prabhuḥ |
bhavatāṃ sarvabhūpānāṃ mūrdhanyo’yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ ||58||
mukundavikramo rājeśvaraḥ samrāṭ karārjakaḥ |
sudarśanaṃ mama cakra rakṣārthaṃ dīyate’sya vai ||29||
aśāsane sthitā ye syusteṣāṃ nibarhaṇaṃ tvidam |
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścakraṃ dadau mahat ||4.111.60||
sahasrāraṃ yathāvāñcchā tathārūpadharaṃ śubham |
cakradhvajaṃ jaitrarathaṃ dadau śaṃkhaṃ jayapradam ||6 1||
kalpalatāṃ cākṣayaṃ sat pātraṃ dadau hariḥ svayam |
puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau kaṇṭhe jīvamālāṃ tato dadau |||62||
athaivaṃ pūjane jāte mukundavikramo nṛpaḥ |
śuśubhe kṛṣṇavat tatra rājñīyuto nṛpāsane ||63||
vṛddhābhivādanaṃ cakre śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ vyadhāt |
dadau dānāni sarvāṇi svarṇaratnāmbarāṇi ca ||64||
gajavājivimānāni gṛhodyānatalāni ca |
dhanāni sampadaścāpi divyānnabhūṣaṇāni ca ||65||
brahmāṇḍadānamevāpi tulādānāni yānyapi |
dhenudānāni sarvāṇi kanyādānāni vai tathā ||66||
grāmakṣetrālayadānānyapi dadau tadā nṛpaḥ |
jīvikāḥ pradadau devālayadīnāndharogiṣu ||67||
mocayāmāsa nigaḍasthitān pradaṇḍitān janān |
miṣṭānnāni tadā tatra bhūrīṇi pradadau nṛpaḥ ||68||
sūtamāgadhabandibhyaścāraṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau |
viprarṣidvijajātibhyo mahādānāni vai dadau ||69||
bhojanāni samastebhyo dadau rājye tadā dine |
jayaśabdaiḥ samaṃ tatra sabhāmaṇḍapato nṛpaḥ ||4.111.70||
datvā ca dakṣiṇāstūrṇaṃ parihāraṃ vidhāya ca |
utthito rājacihnaiśca sarvarājanyavanditaḥ ||71||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ natvābhivādyābhijanaṃ nṛpaḥ |
rājyāgrapadabhāgbhiśca prārthito bhramaṇāya ha |||72|||
jagaryāṃ sainyasahito vardhamāno janaistadā |
babhrāma rājamārgeṣu sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ ||73||
vanditaḥ pūjitaścāśīrbhiśca saṃvardhito nṛpaḥ |
prajāḥ prasādya yamunāṃ gatvā prapūjya tāṃ nadīm ||74||
jalaṃ pītvāpūjya durgaṃ śanairyāyānnṛpālayam |
viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ paścādbhājanāni śubhāni vai ||75||
kārayāmāsa sarvebhyo mahīmānebhya ādarāt |
bhojayāmāsa sarvāśca vidāyaṃ pradadau tadā ||76||
jayadhvaniṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ śrāvayāmāsa cakrarāṭ |
sāyaṃ nṛtyāni modārthaṃ bhūbhṛto’psaraso vyadhuḥ ||77||
gāyanāni ca gandharvāḥ kavayaḥ kavitā vyadhuḥ |
ebhyo’pi nṛpavaryo’sau dadau toṣāya saddhanam ||78||
viśaśramustato rātrau sarve rājā prajādayaḥ |
prātarjajāgaruḥ śrutvā maṃgalāni śubhāni ha ||79||
mahīmānā yayurnaijān deśān lokān sukhānvitāḥ |
bhuktvā vidhāya pānāni cāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ ||4.111.80||
athānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
nijaputrān yamalām̐śca svasvamātāmahādibhiḥ ||8 1 ||
saha gantuṃ tadājñāṃ vai cakāra bahupūjitān |
śvaśurāśca tathā cānye prasannā bahumānitāḥ |||82||
yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca vimānaiśca nijaiḥ saha |
prajāḥ svasvapradeśām̐śca yayurvai mānitāstadā |||83||
athānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svīyajanaiḥ saha |
putrāya śikṣaṇaṃ datvā yayau kuṃkumavāpikām ||84||
svapatnyādisametaśca svīyakuṭumbayuk tathā |
lomaśādyaiśca sahito yayāvaśvasarobhuvam ||85||
badrike bhagavatputraścābhiṣikto nṛpāsane |
śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ dīrghāṃ daśasāhasrayojanām ||86||
karadīkṛtabhūpālo bhagavadbalamāśritaḥ |
vaiṣṇavīṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ cakāra dharmaśāsanaḥ ||87||
nāsya rājye hyanāvṛṣṭirdubhikṣaṃ duṣṭapīḍanam |
rogā naivākālamṛtyurna ca vaidhavyamityapi ||88||
na śāṭhyaṃ na ca paiśunyaṃ kāpaṭyaṃ na prajāsvapi |
na hiṃsā nāpi cauryaṃ ca prasahya haraṇaṃ na ca ||89||
naiva vasatidvārāṇāṃ pidhānaṃ vidyate tadā |
udghāṭitakapāṭā vai tadā vasatayaḥ sadā ||4.111.90||
vāgbandhe na vyabhicāraḥ pratijñābhaṃga eva na |
vṛddhābhivādanaṃ nityaṃ pañcamakhapravartanam ||9 1||
pañcāgnitāpanaṃ nityaśrāddhādi karma vai satām |
viprāṇāṃ vedaghoṣāśca grāme grāme sthale sthale |||92||
sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ pātivratyaparāḥ striyaḥ |
satyaḥ sādhvyaśca santaśca gṛhasthā api sarvadā ||93||
śamamārgasthitā nārāyaṇadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
phalanti ca tadā kalpavallikā iva buddhayaḥ ||94||
kṛṣṇārpitāni śastrāṇi divyavigrahavanti ca |
pravartante tu daṇḍārthaṃ gatvā duṣṭaṃ svayaṃ tadā ||95||
deśāntare praśāstāraḥ śastrarūpā bhaṭāstadā |
kārāgārasya nairarthyaṃ tadābhavat samantataḥ ||96||
agnayaḥ sīmabhāgasthā rakṣantyasya surāṣṭrakam |
abdhayo mūrtimantaśca durganirvāhakāriṇaḥ ||97||
asyādhvareṣu vai devāḥ sākṣādāyānti śārṅgiṇā |
sahitāḥ pārṣadā muktā īśvarā havyabhojanāḥ ||98||
grāmadevyo vanadevyo rakṣanti tatprajāḥ sadā |
daityadānavarakṣāṃsi sattvabhāvaṃ gatāni vai ||99||
tāmasyaḥ sampado yāśca gatāḥ sāttvikatāṃ tadā |
vighasāśiprajāścāsya devagṛhānvitagṛhāḥ || 4.111.100 ||
badrike sarvathā bhaktiḥ prāvartata samantataḥ |
hareḥ putrasya rājye vai mokṣadā sampadāvahāḥ || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne dilāvarīrājadhānyāṃ mukundavikramasya rājyābhiṣekotsavādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||

<4.112>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi mukundavikramo nṛpaḥ |
kṣīrodaputryā lakṣmyāstu sutāya mantriṇe tadā || 1 ||
vāsudevāya rājyasya dhuraṃ nirvahituṃ sadā |
ājñāpya niryayau pṛthvīṃ vīkṣituṃ paritastadā || 2 ||
vimānena yayau prāk tu tuhīnādrīn tathottarān |
kurūn kimpuruṣaṃ cāpi ketumālamilāvṛtam || 3 ||
pūrvadeśān dakṣiṇām̐śca paścimān bhūpradeśakān |
sarvatra bhūpavaryā ye tiṣṭhanti te tu bhāvataḥ || 4 ||
cakruḥ sammānamarghyaṃ ca pūjāṃ samrāṭ susannibhām |
karān daduśca te sarve yathāyogyān svabhūbhṛte || 5 ||
ekacakraṃ mahārājyaṃ daśasāhasrayojanam |
vīkṣyāgatya yamīṃ snātvā dilāvaryāṃ sthiro’bhavat || 6 ||
koṭiparārdharatnāni rājadattāni cānayat |
tāni sarvāṇi ca vāsudevasātkṛtya vai tataḥ || 7 ||
svayaṃ vrataṃ prajagrāha sadaivātmanivedanam |
sarvadā bhagavadbhaktimayaṃ patnīyuto nṛpaḥ || 8 ||
yamunāyāstaṭe ramye kārayitvā sugahvaram |
prarakṣya pitṛbhagavatpratimāṃ tatra kānakīm || 9 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākhyāṃ śobhanāṃ śubhām |
sarvadā sarvathā tasyāḥ sevāparo’bhavannṛpaḥ || 4.112.10 ||
jaṭādhṛk suvalkalāḍhyaḥ karamālādharastathā |
susādhuveṣo’ntarvṛttimūrtidhyānādimānasaḥ || 1 1||
babhūva sarvadā badri yogirāḍiva muktigaḥ |
sarvaḥ karmakalāpaśca kṛtastena hareḥ kṛte || 12||
pṛthvītattvaṃ dehagaṃ ca kṛtaṃ haryarthameva tat |
jalatattvaṃ ca dehasthaṃ kṛtaṃ haryarthamityapi || 1 3||
vahnitattvaṃ śarīrasthaṃ kṛtaṃ haryarthamanvaham |
vāyutattvaṃ dehagaṃ ca kṛtaṃ haryarthamuttamam || 14||
vyomatattvaṃ ca dehasthaṃ kṛtaṃ haryarthamambaram |
śabdaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandho haryarthamityamī || 15||
pādau pradakṣiṇaṃ kartuṃ yojitau śrīharestathā |
hastau kṛṣṇasya sevāyāṃ sarvathā yojitau sadā || 16 ||
vāṇī kṛṣṇasya kīrtau ca vyāpāritā stavādiṣu |
pāyūpasthendriye tena kṛte śīle ca saṃyame || 17||
netre tu yojite’nādikṛṣṇarūpādidarśane |
śrotre kṛte hareḥ śabdagrahaṇe niyamānvite || 18||
tvaṅnityaṃ sthāpitā kṛṣṇasambandhivastuyoginī |
rasanā kṛṣṇanaivedyarasamātrābhivartinī || 1 9||
ghrāṇaṃ kṛṣṇasya surabhergrahe sadā vinirmitam |
prāṇān sarvān japagarbhān cakre kṛṣṇārthajīvanaḥ || 4.112.20 ||
mastakaṃ namane cakre yojitaṃ śrīhareḥ sadā |
kaṇṭhaṃ cakāra bhagavatsvarālāpaguṇodaye || 21 ||
hāsyaṃ hareḥ samīpe bhrūkuṭiṃ cakre hareḥ kṛte |
nimeṣaṃ bhagavanmiṣaṃ kṣuvanaṃ nāmasaṃgatam || 22||
oṣṭhayormelana kṛṣṇaprasādānnādilehane |
jihvāyā bhramaṇaṃ cāsye kṛṣṇaprasādamārgaṇe || 23 ||
varṇasthānāni sarvāṇi cakre kṛṣṇābhidhākṛte |
grīvāṃ cakre hareḥ sragbhirbhūṣitāṃ candanādibhiḥ ||24||
jāgratiḥ spaṣṭamūrtyarthaṃ nidrā mānasamūrtaye |
suṣuptisturyarūpe ca kṛṣṇārthaṃ tena yojitā || 25||
kharjanaṃ moḍanaṃ dehatroḍanaṃ śayanaṃ tathā |
āsanaṃ guṇṭhanaṃ saṃkocanaṃ cakre hareḥ kṛte || 26||
uttānaṃ bhūpratānaṃ ca pārśvatānamadhaḥsthitim |
svastikādyāsanabhedān cakre kṛṣṇe prayojitān || 27|||
daṇḍavat karaṇe netre karau pādau manaḥ śiraḥ |
vakṣaścetyaṣṭakaṃ cakre’ñjaliṃ kṛṣṇasya sannidhau || 28 ||
mālikāvartane sarvāṅgulīścakre suyojitāḥ |
hastatale’ṅguṣṭhayukte cakre’rhaṇe hareḥ sa vai || 29||
prakoṣṭhayoḥ kriyāḥ kaphoṇikayośca kriyāstathā |
skandhayośca kriyāścakre kṛṣṇakāryavidhāpane || 4.112.30 ||
nitambayośca pṛṣṭhasyodarasya nalayoḥ kriyāḥ |
nāḍīnāṃ vāyusañcārām̐ścakre kṛṣṇakriyāyutāḥ || 31 ||
hṛdayasya dhamanītvaṃ cakre kṛṣṇakriyānvitam |
romṇāṃ valīnāmastitvaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthamasya vai || 3 2||
sakthnośca jaṃghayoḥ puṣṭirdhātūnāṃ klṛptirityapi |
bhojanaṃ pānamāsvādaścāsya kṛṣṇakṛte’bhavan | | 3 3||
dehasaṃśodhanaṃ bhūṣāveṣaśṛṃgāramārjanam |
dravaddravyapradānaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthamasya vai | | 34||
romṇāṃ snehodgamaścāpi tathendriyapramodanam |
kṛṣṇapramodaprītyarthaṃ rājñastasyābhavat sadā || 35||
ādānaṃ gamanaṃ tṛptistapaḥ saṃyama utthitiḥ |
ālasyaṃ saraṇaṃ rodhaḥ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | | 3 6||
muṣṭiḥ prasūtirasyāpyañjalirvyaṅgulivistaraḥ |
phaṇāprasāra evāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | | 37||
nakhanikṛntanaṃ romanikṛntanaṃ ca kampanam |
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ bhāvā dhāvanaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte | | 38 ||
cāñcalyaṃ ca munitvaṃ ca bahirāntaravartanam |
udgāraścāpi hikkā ca vyāptatvaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte | | 39||
akriyatvaṃ sakriyatvaṃ vyāpārā varṣmaṇastathā |
snānaṃ sandhyā japo homaḥ sarvaṃ tasya hareḥ kṛte | |4.112.40 ||
lekhanaṃ vācanaṃ puṣpapatrādyādhāraṇaṃ tathā |
pūjopakaraṇāvāptiḥ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |4 1 ||
yānavāhanayogāśca naranāryabhimelanam |
prajāpradarśanaṃ cāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |42||
mantraṇānumatiḥ kārye kvacitkāryāvalokanam |
nirvṛttiḥ sammatirvāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |43 ||
deśāvalokanaṃ śreṣṭhotsavābhigamanaṃ śubham |
śobhā pravṛttirevāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |44||
rājotsavāḥ sainyaśobhotsavā devotsavāstathā |
vratotsavāśca dānāni sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |45||
yajñāḥ paropakārāśca nyāyā daṇḍāḥ praśikṣaṇam |
smṛddhayaḥ sampadaścāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte ||46||
udayāstamayau tasya madhyāhnaṃ saṃgavastathā |
sandhyā velā brāhmakālo niśā cāsya hareḥ kṛte || 47||
ṛtavaścauṣṇyaśaityādi vṛṣṭayaścātapāstathā |
vānaṃ gharmāgnisaṃjvālāprākaṭyaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte || 48 ||
satkāraḥ svāgataṃ cārghyaṃ madhuparkaḥ sugandhanam |
sammānaṃ ca mahīmānāgamaścāsya hareḥ kṛte || 49||
āyavyayau ca kṛṣṇārthau kośāḥ kṛṣṇārthakāstathā |
dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyavargāḥ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇakṛte’sya vai || 4.112.50 ||
saṃkalpo mananaṃ bodhaścintanaṃ tṛptirityapi |
dhyānaṃ ca bhajanaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ smaraṇaṃ dhṛtiḥ ||5 1 ||
bhaktiḥ prītiḥ sthitirmānaṃ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte |
ātmasaṃvedanaṃ cātmabhogaḥ sākṣātsvavṛttitā ||52||
nijānandaśca santoṣaḥ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte |
ekāntasevanaṃ cāpi śvasanaṃ jīvanaṃ ratiḥ ||53||
āhāraścopavāsaśca sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte |
ātmano dehavāsaśca tathā vastrādidhāraṇam ||54||
gahvare ca gṛhe vāso vakṣe’syāpi hareḥ kṛte |
nibhālayati rājāsau cātmanyātmānamacyutam |||55||
sarvavastuṣu sarvatra nibhālayati mādhavam |
ṛṣayo munayo devāstīrthāni mūrtimanti ca ||56||
tadāśrayaṃ samāgatya dṛṣṭvā prayānti nityaśaḥ |
satyaśca sādhavaḥ sādhvyo yoginyo yoginastathā ||57||
viraktā vrahmasaṃsaktā jñānino dhyāninastathā |
paritastasya tiṣṭhanti divyāśramasya sīmasu ||58||
kṛṣṇakathāḥ pravartante’nuvelaṃ cādhvarā japāḥ |
vedaghoṣāḥ kīrtanāni pravartante’sya cāśrame ||59||
abhiṣekā devapūjā balayo bhojanāni ca |
caravo devakāryāṇi nīrājanāni cābhitaḥ ||4.112.60||
sughaṇṭājhallarīnādāḥ pravartante’bhito’sya ca |
śaṃkhanādā jayanādāḥ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetighoṣaṇāḥ ||61||
api siṃhā mṛgāḥ sattvāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavastathā |
kīṭāścetāḥ pataṃgāśca vadanti brahmagāyanam ||62||
yādāṃsi bhūmigartasthā vṛkṣakoṭaravāsinaḥ |
tvāvāsāḥ patravāsāśca vadanti brahmaśāśvatam ||63||
vṛkṣāśca vallikāścāpi smaranti brahma śāśvatam |
pratiśabdaiśca garjanti parvatā gartikā jaḍāḥ ||64||
evamasyābhavadbhaktiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sadā |
badrike nṛpateryogāt prajāḥ sarvā narāḥ striyaḥ ||65||
vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā divyā hyajāyanta bhuvastale |
prasādaṃ pitaraścāpi labhante devatā grahāḥ ||66||
pūjāṃ labhante dyusado hariḥ sarvatra pūjyate |
mānave mānave kaṇṭhī japamālāsya vartate ||67||
mānave mānave mūrtirnārāyaṇasya vartate |
grāme grāme makhaścāpi baiśvadevaḥ pratidvijam ||68||
gopure gopure kṛṣṇamūrtigogrāsaśobhanā |
nāryā nāryā vibhūṣāsu kṛṣṇābhidhānamastyapi ||69||
śastre śastre harernāma sarveṣūpaskareṣvapi |
āpaṇe hyāpaṇe mūrtirnārāyaṇasya vartate ||4.112.70||
grāme grāme mayabhūmau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai |
mandiraṃ vartate śreṣṭhaṃ pattane pattane’pi ca ||71||
prātaḥ sāyaṃ harerlakṣmīsvāminaśca prapūjanam |
nīrājanāni jāyante ghaṇṭādinādanānyapi ||72||
stutayaḥ sampravartante gītayaḥ kīrtanānyapi |
naivedyāni pradīyante tāmbūlāni jalāni ca ||73||
prasādāśca prabhujyante pīyate’mṛtavāri ca |
badrike pratyahaṃ grāme grāme sāyaṃ kathāḥ śubhāḥ ||74||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā bhavanti bhūtale |
evaṃ vai vaiṣṇavī bhūmirjātā mukundatanmayī ||75||
mukundavikramo rājā tāpaso nityameva ca |
prātarutthāya kṛṣṇasya karoti dhyānamanvaham ||76||
snātvā pitṛgaṇebhyaśca tarpaṇaṃ prakaroti ca |
sūryārādhanamevāpi sandhyāvandanamityapi ||77||
hareḥ pūjāṃ pratimāyāṃ karoti lagnamānasaḥ |
āvāhanaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsane kṛtvā tataḥ param ||78||
pādyamarghyaṃ samarpyācamanīyakaṃ dadātyapi |
dantadhāvanamevāpi śaucajalaṃ dadātyapi ||79||
hastapādādiśuddhyarthaṃ mṛda cūrṇaṃ dadātyapi |
gaṇḍūṣāya jalaṃ pātramañjanaṃ prakarotyapi ||4.112.8 0||
kṛṣṇamūrtau sugandhibhṛttailasāraṃ dadātyapi |
arkasāraṃ rasasāraṃ dadāti mardanaṃ hyapi ||8 1||
candanaṃ ca sugandhaṃ ca dadāti pañcagavyakam |
dugdhaṃ dadhiṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarāṃ tīrthavāryapi ||82||
abhiṣekaṃ kārayitvā mārjanaṃ prakarotyapi |
vastradānaṃ vibhūṣāṇāmarpaṇaṃ ca karotyapi ||83||
śṛṅgāraṃ vividhaṃ sarvaṃ karoti kṛṣṇavarṣmaṇi |
keśaprasādhanaṃ tailapradānaṃ puṣpayojanam ||84||
netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ bhāle tilakaṃ candrakaṃ śubham |
kastūrikāṃ candanaṃ ca mālikāṃ ratnamālikām ||85||
hārān tulasīpatrāṇi tathā yajñopavītakam |
akṣatān kuṃkumaṃ cāpi gulālaṃ pradadātyapi ||86||
abīlaṃ cottaragandhaṃ gucchaṃ raṃgādirañjanam |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jalam ||87||
karodvartanakaṃ cāpi dadāti naktakaṃ tataḥ |
śayyāṃ suśobhanāṃ sarvopaskārasahitāṃ tathā ||88||
preṃkhāṃ dadāti bhāvena vyajanaṃ pavanapradam |
chatraṃ sucāmare yaṣṭiṃ pattrāṇe mukuṭādikam ||89||
yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ cāpi bhramaṇaṃ gṛhakhelanam |
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ cāpi dadāti śrīvilāsine ||4.112.90||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi viśrāmaṃ śayane śubhe |
utthānaṃ bhramaṇaṃ sāyaṃ mahodyāne dadātyapi ||9 1||
khelanaṃ cāpi sandhyāyāmārārtrikaṃ karoti ca |
stavanaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi bhojanaṃ pāyasārpaṇam ||92||
jalārpaṇaṃ mukhavāsaṃ śayanaṃ ca dadātyapi |
aṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ cāpi karoti sukhakṛddhareḥ ||93||
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca sevanaṃ vividhaṃ tathā |
kathāyā śravaṇaṃ kṛṣṇakīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||94||
dāsyaṃ cātmārpaṇaṃ cāpi karoti kṛṣṇatoṣaṇam |
evaṃ karmakalāpaṃ śrīśārthaṃ mukundavikramaḥ |||95||
karoti sarvadā badri nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ |
tadbhāryā ca satī muktibāleśvarī virāgiṇī ||96||
vaiṣṇavī pativat sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kṛṣṇārthasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
karoti patisevāḍhyā śrīkṛṣṇārpitamānasā ||97||
dehanirvāhayogyaṃ yat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthameva tat |
patisevopayogyaṃ yat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthameva tat ||98||
ityevaṃ badrike tena mukundavikrameṇa vai |
arpitaṃ śrīharau divyādivyācaraṇamātmanaḥ ||99||
vaikuṇṭhamaparaṃ bhūmau golokaścāparaḥ kṣitau |
kṛtastena harerbhaktyāvatārita ivottamaḥ || 4.112.10 0||
gṛhe gṛhe camatkārāḥ prajāyante navā navāḥ |
sākṣāt kṛṣṇaharirbhaktyā bhaktadṛṣṭau prayāti ca || 10 1||
aneke brahmavettāro jīvā nāryo narāstadā |
prayānti paramaṃ dhāma śrīhareḥ paramātmanaḥ || 102|||
evaṃ satyayugastatra mukundavikrame nṛpe |
avartatābdhiparyantaṃ devamānavasadṛśaḥ || 1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne mukundavikramasya rājño bhagavatparāyaṇatādivarṇananāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||

<4.113>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
atha śrībhagavān badri kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
vartate kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sarvasaukhyapradastadā || 1 ||
vāsudevasahāyārthaṃ putrāstena pare’pi ca |
preṣitā rājyapuṣṭyarthaṃ kalāśāstraviśāradāḥ || 2 ||
śriyāḥ putro rāsakṛṣṇaścopapradhānako’bhavat |
prajñāputro brahmaprabhuḥ saināpatyamarakṣayat || 3 ||
padmāvatīsuto’nantaḥ kārāgārādhipo’bhavat |
lalitāyāḥ suto lāleśvaro rāṣṭrādhipo’bhavat || 4 ||
jayāyā vijayaḥ putraścopamantrī tadābhavat |
māṇikyāḥ kaustubhamaṇirnyāyaprado’bhavat tadā || 5 ||
kamalāyāḥ padmanābhaḥ sabhādhyakṣo’bhavat sadā |
ramāsuto rāmasākṣī vidyādhikāravānabhūt || 6 ||
rādhātmajo rāyakeśī kośādhyakṣo’bhavattadā |
nārāyaṇyā naradevaścopasainyādhipo’bhavat || 7 ||
brāhmyāḥ suto brahmarāto rājapurohito’bhavat |
bhāgavatyāḥ suto bhargo yajñakāryakaro’bhavat || 8 ||
ūrjabalādyā ye cānye khaṇḍapālāśca te’bhavan |
dvādaśordhvaśatānāṃ tu putrāste vai yathāyatham || 9 ||
haryuktavyavasāyeṣu yojitāste’bhavam̐stadā |
evaṃ rājyaṃ mahānandapradaṃ cābhūttadābhitaḥ || 4.113.1 0||
badari te sutastatra bādarāyaṇasaṃjñakaḥ |
jñānado dānadaścāsīd dakṣiṇādipradāyakaḥ || 11 ||
prajāśca jñānamāsādya videhā iva cābhavan |
sākṣātprabhorjñānavatyo yātrārthamaśvasārasam || 1 2||
draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cāyānti yānti vai muhuḥ |
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamottamam || 1 3||
vyajāyata harervāsādākṣaraṃ kṣetramuttamam |
āgatya ca mahābhaktāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tu || 14||
prayānti cākṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ divyamadbhutam |
kecit samādhimāsādya gatvā cāyānti tat punaḥ || 15||
varṇayanti harerdhāmākṣaraṃ tatparamaṃ padam |
śrutvā śrutvāpare lokā modante sāttvatottamāḥ || 1 6||
praśaṃsanti harerdhāmākṣaraṃ tatparamaṃ padam |
golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhāduttamaṃ paramaṃ padam || 17||
yatraitāḥ śrīhareḥ patnyo muktānikātmikāḥ sadā |
virājante’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sevikāḥ ||18||
śrutvaivaṃ badrike śaṃsāṃ jijñāsā kṛṣṇayoṣitām |
utpannā vīkṣituṃ divyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ sukhāspadam || 1 9||
śāśvataṃ brahmalokaṃ taṃ divyaṃ svasvavirājitam |
athārthanāṃ tu tā nāryaścakruḥ svāmipatiṃ prati ||4.113.20||
śāśvatasyākṣaradhāmno lokituṃ divyasampadaḥ |
hariḥ prāha tadā strībhyo na draṣṭavyaṃ taccādhunā ||21||
yasya vai darśane tatra sthātuṃ manaḥ prajāyate |
punarāgamane naiva matirbhavati dehinām ||22|
maddhāmāgre’nyadhāmāni nistejāṃsi vibhānti vai |
īśvarāṇāṃ nilayāstu bhāsante nirayā iva ||23||
akṣarasya mama dhāmno rase pīte tatastviha |
pānaṃ niḥsvādeva syānmāyāmayaṃ rasakṣayam ||24||
akṣarasya mama dhāmno miṣṭānne bhakṣite tviha |
bhojanaṃ svādahīnaṃ syānmāyāmayaṃ rasakṣayam ||25||
akṣarasya sugandhe tu gṛhīte’tra tu saurabhaḥ |
nyakkāra eva durgandharūpaḥ syānmāyikaḥ khalu ||26||
akṣarasyāsvādite tu pāyase kāmadhenuje |
māyāmayāni dugdhāni bhavanti nīrasāni vai ||27||
akṣarasya phalapuṣpādyalaṃkāre tu vīkṣite |
bhukte satpatra puṣpādi kledavat saṃbhavanti vai ||28||
tatratyasampadāṃ bhoge bhogāścātra purīṣavat |
tatratyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ vaukṣaṇe’nyat kurūpavat ||29||
kuṣṭhavajjāyate patnyastasmānna vīkṣaṇaṃ varam |
idānīṃ vai bhavatīnāṃ pramanye tu virāgakṛt ||4.113.3 0||
iha loke nivāse tad vighnakartṛ bhaviṣyati |
āyuṣo’nte divyadhāma draṣṭavyaṃ nādhunā hyataḥ ||3 1 ||
ityevaṃ bodhitā patnyo nocurnārāyaṇaṃ prati |
kintu tīvratamā tāsāṃ didṛkṣā saṃvyajāyata || 32||
kīdṛśyo vai vayaṃ tatra varṇyamānā tu yogibhiḥ |
bhavāmaśca haristatra kīdṛg bhavet prasundaraḥ || 33||
yāvad vayaṃ na paśyāmastāvacchāntirna vai matā |
didṛkṣāyāśca vai nityaṃ prābalyaṃ saṃpravardhate ||34||
vicāryetthaṃ dine’nyasmin prāhuḥ padmāvatīṃ priyām |
bhagini śrīhareḥ patni priye mānyā matāsi vai ||35||
bhavatyā saṃprārthanīyo’smatpatiḥ vallabhaḥ prabhuḥ |
dhāmadarśanalābhārthaṃ tvadvacaḥ pālayiṣyati ||36||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
sapatnībhistu sarvābhiḥ preritā mādhavīpriyā |
prārthayāmāsa taddhāmadarśanārthaṃ svavallabham ||37||
śrīpadmāvatīpriyā provācaparamapriya nātha tvaṃ dayālo nijayoṣitaḥ |
darśayākṣaradhāmādya sarvāsāṃ tvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru ||38||
punastvamatra cānetuṃ samartho’si mahāprabho |
ānetavyāḥ priyāḥ sarvāḥ pūrayitvā manorathān ||39||
athānyāḥ koṭyarbudābjānyapi cakrustathārthanām |
pradarśaya prabho svāmin dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ tava ||4.113.40 ||
sarvā vayaṃ samicchāmo vīkṣituṃ dhāma cākṣaram |
sarvasaṃkalpitaṃ svāmin pūrayituṃ svavāñcchayā ||4 1 ||
samartho’si punaścātrānetuṃ śakto’si sarvathā |
tasmāddhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ pradarśaya pate hare ||42||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
ityevaṃ badrike sarvā brahmapriyāśca yoṣitaḥ |
cakruḥ samprārthanāṃ tīvrāmaśāmyāmanivartinīm ||43 ||
harirvijñāya bhāvaṃ ca nijecchayotthitaṃ tadā |
vistāraṃ cāpi saṃhartuṃ svayaṃ ceyeṣa tanmiṣāt |||44||
tathāstvomiti tāḥ prāha bhagavān sarvabhāvanaḥ |
tāśca sarvāḥ prasannāśca jātā vīkṣitumakṣaram ||45||
badrike bhagavān sarvāḥ prāha sajjā bhavantviti |
koṭyarbudābjapatnyastāḥ śrutvājñāṃ svāminaḥ śubhām ||46||
saveṣabhūṣāśṛṃgārāḥ sveṣṭopakaraṇānvitāḥ |
atyutsāhabharā nāryaḥ sajjāstūrṇaṃ tadābhavan ||47||
amūlyāmbaradhāriṇyaḥ keśaveṣātiśobhanāḥ |
svarṇaratnamaṇīndrāḍhyahārabhūṣādyalaṃkṛtāḥ ||48 ||
tejo’bhivardhitā divyā yuvatyo naikaraṃgikāḥ |
sajjā drutaṃ vīkṣituṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāmābhavan mudā ||49||
mithaḥ pramodavacanānyabruvan snehasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
ālyo nāthena kṛṣṇena sanāthā vai vayaṃ sadā ||4.113.5 0 ||
kāntena kṛpayāsmabhyo darśitaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam |
tataḥ svargāni sarvāṇi pātālānyapyaśeṣataḥ ||51 ||
darśitānīśvarāṇāṃ ca gṛhāṇi vividhānyapi |
īśasṛṣṭiḥ samastā no darśitā paramātmanā ||52||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi goloko dhāmāvyākṛtamityapi |
amṛtaṃ śrīpuraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ darśitāni dayālunā ||53 ||
paraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tasya svāminaḥ sarvato’dhikam |
drakṣyāmo’dya mahābhāgyavatyaḥ smo’tra hareḥ priyāḥ ||54||
nānyāsāṃ tādṛśaṃ bhāgyaṃ yadasmākaṃ pravartate |
mūlaṃ gṛhaṃ svāmino no drakṣyāmaḥ śāśvataṃ padam ||55||
śrutayo’pi na paśyanti na paśyantyapi yoginaḥ |
īśvarā naiva paśyanti tad drakṣyāmo hareḥ padam ||56||
yadatra bhagavānasmadagre kiroti varṇanam |
bhavatīnāṃ svarūpāṇi santyakṣare pare pade ||57||
divyātidivyadivyāni svarūpāṇi svayoṣitām |
tāni rūpāṇi cāsmākaṃ drakṣyāmo’dya kṛpālavāt ||58||
divyaṃ svasvāminaṃ cālyo drakṣyāmastatra saṃsthitam |
asaṃkhyamuktajuṣṭaṃ cāsaṃkhyāvatāradhāriṇam ||59||
anantadivyavāmābhiḥ sevitaṃ svāminaṃ harim |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ drakṣyāma uttamam ||4.113.60||
bhokṣyāmo divyabhogām̐śca vatsyāmaśca yathepsitam |
raṃsyāmahe mahānandapradena paramātmanā ||6 1 ||
udyānāni samastāni mandirāṇi śubhāni ca |
brahmahṛdān brahmanadīrdrakṣyāmaḥ paramātmanaḥ ||62||
divyasiṃhāsanādīni divyasaṃsadsthalāni ca |
divyarāsavihārām̐śca drakṣyāmaḥ kṛpayā hareḥ || 63||
divyasudhāḥ prapāsyāmo vetsyāmo nijasampadaḥ |
atsyāmo miṣṭabhojyāni śrīharerbrahmadhāmani ||64||
ityevaṃ vadamānāstā brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ |
kṛṣṇapriyāśca tāḥ patnyaḥ sajjāstadābhavan drutam ||65||
badrike’nādikṛṣṇaśrīnārāyaṇaḥ samutsukaḥ |
sasmāra muktavṛndāni tadā svākṣaradhāmataḥ ||66||
āyayurdivyarūpāśca divyāsaṃkhyavimānagāḥ |
divyavimāninaścāpi divyavimānavāhakāḥ ||67||
āyayustāḥ samānetuṃ sṛṣṭyāvaraṇavarjitāḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrordhve’mbare te’bhavan sthirāḥ ||68||
puṣpāṇāṃ divyagandhānāṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇe pravarṣaṇam |
vādayāmāsuratyarthaṃ divyavādyāni vai tadā ||69||
devādyā darśanaṃ kartumāyayurdyunivāsinaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścājñāpayāmāsa nijapriyāḥ ||4.113.70 ||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi dāsān dāsīśca vai tadā |
ṛṣīn maharṣīn sādhūm̐śca sādhvīśca sevakām̐stathā ||71||
yamalāni sahasthāni svāpatyāni tadāpi ca |
āroḍhuṃ ca vimāneṣu divyeṣu kramaśaḥ khalu ||72|||
patnyaḥ sarvā niṣeduśca dāsyo dāsāśca bālakāḥ |
sevakāḥ pitarau cāpi niṣedusteṣu cāmbare |||73||
satyaśca sādhavaścāpi parīhāraparāyaṇāḥ |
niṣeduste vimāneṣu muktaiḥ saha kṣaṇāntare ||74||
śaṃkhanādo’bhavattūrṇaṃ tataḥ sañcārabodhakaḥ |
na kaścidvā kācidapi śiṣyate bhūtale yathā ||75||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ kṣaṇaṃ śūnyamivābhavat |
vimāneṣu sthitāḥ sarvanārīnarādikoṭayaḥ ||76||
punarvai śaṃkhanādo’bhūt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha |
na kaścicchiṣyate pṛthvyāṃ dhāmajigamiṣārthavān ||77||
atha kṛṣṇaścakārāpi śaṃkhanādaṃ tṛtīyakam |
vimānāni tadā śrīmallomaśenānvitāni vai ||78 ||
asañcaran vyomamārge kṣaṇādadṛśyatāṃ yayuḥ |
vibhidya saptanākāni tathāṣṭāvaraṇānyapi ||79||
īśvarāṇāṃ ca dhāmānyullaṃghyākṣarapadaṃ yayuḥ |
akṣarasya tadā sīmni śāradīpūrṇimātithau ||4.113.80 ||
vegavanti vimānāni madhyāhne tvakṣaraṃ yayuḥ |
brahmahrade hariḥ sarvān snāpayitvā vimānagān ||81 ||
narānnārīḥ samastām̐śca kṛtvā tadyogyavigrahān |
divyān divyasvarūpām̐śca brahmadehān samastakān |||82||

yayāvagre hariḥ svāmī naikarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvānnītvā sahaivāgre paramākṣaradhāmani ||89||
athāpi badrike divyāpāratejo’bhisampadam |
ākṣaraṃ vyoma saṃvīkṣya kṣaṇaṃ te stabdhatāṃ gatāḥ ||86||
tadā śrībhagavām̐steṣu mukteṣvāviśya satvaram |
śaktīrnijā dhāmayogyāḥ pradadau tebhya ākṣarīḥ ||87||
athāścaryaṃ mahatprāptāḥ kimetat puruṣā vayam |
nārītvaṃ vigataṃ sarvamabhavāmo narottamāḥ ||88||
puruṣottamarūpāḥ svasvāmirūpāśca sarvathā |
bhavāmo’tra kimetadvai mahāścaryamidaṃ tviha ||89||
brahmapriyādikamuktāḥ papracchuḥ parameśvaram |
kimatra bhagavānno’sti puṃstvaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ vada ||4.113.90||
śrutvā tu badrike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
prāha svīyāṃgakoṭibhyaḥ śṛṇvantu mama cāṃganāḥ ||91 ||
māyā yā prakṛtiḥ proktā mama śaktisvarūpiṇī |
sā rādhā kṛṣṇapatnī ca mayā svasmāt prakāśitā ||92||
muktarūpātirūpāḍhyā muktagandhātigandhinī |
muktasnaigdhyātisnaigdhyāḍhyā cākacikyātiśobhanā ||93||
suvālā peśalā tanvī sarvalāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ |
sarvākarṣaṇadharmāḍhyā darśanīyātisundarī ||94||
vicitrāṃ cañcalāṃ tāṃ ca vīkṣya visṛjya māṃ ca vai |
muktāḥ snigdhāḥ parabrahma matvā tāṃ matsvarūpiṇīm ||95||
dadhyurānarcuretā ca siṣevire maheśvarīm |
navadhā rādhikāyāstu bhaktiṃ cakrurviśeṣataḥ ||96||
vidanto māṃ tadākṛṣṭāstanmayāste’bhavam̐stadā |
athāhaṃ matprabhāvaṃ taṃ jñātvā muktavaśaṃkaram ||97||
kṛṣṇaṃ rūpaṃ samāsthāya cāpāsaraṃ tadākṣarāt |
golokaṃ vāsayāmāsa sadā tatra sthito’bhavam ||98||
mūlarūpo’kṣare’traivāvasaṃ muktābhisevitaḥ |
tadāsaṃkalpayaṃ cātrākṣare dhāmni pare mama ||99||
prakṛtirvāpi rādhā vā māṇikī lakṣmīrityapi |
brahmapriyāśca vā kṛṣṇapriyā haripriyāśca vā || 4.113.1 00||
īśānyaśceśvarāṇyo vā muktānyo bhaktayoṣitaḥ |
manmūrteḥ śaktayo vāpi cāvatārastriyo’pi vā || 10 1||
āgaccheyurmama dhāmnyakṣare paramadhāmani |
tadā nāryo narā bhūtvānādikṛṣṇasvarūpiṇaḥ || 102|||
āviśeyuśca tiṣṭheyurvihareyurmamākṣare |
nānyatheti niyamo vai mayā śāśvatikaḥ kṛtaḥ || 10 3||
prakāśaṃ naiva nārīṇāṃ rūpamatra pravartate |
tadevaṃ bhavatīnāṃ vai matsvarūpāṇi cākṣare || 1 04||
prajātāni tataścātra madātmakāni sarvathā |
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaikatvavanti ca || 1 05||
athāpi bahuvāraṃ tā rādhādyā māṃ samārthayan |
akṣare nijarūpeṇa sevituṃ māṃ yatheṣṭakam || 1 06||
mayā tato’tisevārthaṃ pratipannaṃ vadāmi vaḥ |
yathā muktā na paśyeyurnārīrūpaṃ mamākṣare ||1 07||
tathā rahaḥ prasevantāṃ mandire mama sarvadā |
yatheṣṭarūpamādhāya patnīrūpāṇi vai tathā || 1 08||
muktā api prasevantāṃ cāprakāśaṃ tathāvidhāḥ |
tato’kṣare pare dhāmni cātra prakāśagocarāḥ || 1 09||
sarve narasvarūpā vai vicaranti madātmakāḥ |
agocarāstu te sarve madanyāgocarāḥ sadā ||4.113.1 10||
madaṃganāsvarūpā māmupāsate mama priyāḥ |
tathā bhavanto muktāśca pumāṃsaḥ santi gocarāḥ || 11 1||
madanyāgocarāḥ kāle bhavatha matpriyā api |
ākarṣaṇātivegenopāsanānyatra no yathā || 1 12||
bhavet tathā nigūḍhāśca pratyekamātragocarāḥ |
madyoṣito’nvahaṃ bhūtvā prasevantāṃ yathāyatham || 11 3||
sarve muktāḥ prasevante gūḍhakāmāstathāhi mām |
yatheṣṭarūpadhartāraḥ sevante māṃ svamandire || 1 14||
līlāmetāṃ mama dhāmni na jānantyapare mithaḥ |
evamapārasāmarthyo’nantalīlādigocaraḥ || 1 15||
atisnehena cāśleṣaṃ dadāmi tābhya uttamam |
ityuktvā badrike cāgre vimānāni vyanodayat || 1 16||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīharernijapatnyādīnāṃ paramākṣaradhāmāvalokanaprārthanāṃ svīkṛtya sarvābhiḥ saha koṭivimānaiḥ paramākṣaradhāmābhigamanaṃ, tatra muktanarasvarūpeṣu sarvāsāṃ parivartanaṃ, tajjijñāsāyāḥ samādhānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||

<4.117>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi vimānagāḥ samarcitāḥ |
rahasyānādimuktaistairvīkṣya durgaṃ tamaṣṭamam || 1 ||
bālakṛṣṇeritāścāgre yayurdeśām̐stataḥ parān |
anantāsaṃkhyamānāṃścātarkyarddhisaṃbhṛtān śubhān || 2 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatejobhisaṃbhṛtān |
yatrānādimahāyuktā vasanti sarvataḥ khalu || 3 ||
yatra rahasyamuktāśca nivasanti hareḥ priyāḥ |
yatra tādātmyamuktāśca sadā vasanti bhūmiṣu || 4 ||
yatra vasanti ca mūrtimuktā abhinnabhāvanāḥ |
yatra vasanti cādṛśyamuktāḥ kṛṣṇaikagocarāḥ || 5 ||
badrike varṇanaṃ cāsyāḥ sthiterbuddheḥ paraṃ mama |
tān pradeśān lokayanto yayuragre vimānagāḥ || 6 ||
vyapaśyam̐ste tādṛśānāṃ muktānāṃ nagarāṇi vai |
pattanāni nagarīśca vasatīn rāṣṭrakāṇi ca || 7 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānandavāhinyo yeṣu cāpagā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtirasadhrāṇi sarāṃsi ca || 8 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāsvādavatyo yeṣu tu dīrghikāḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāsyotthatāmbūlarasasāgarāḥ || 9 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśleṣajanyāmṛtabharā ca bhūḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtidhrāṇi rajāṃsi yeṣu ca || 4.117.10 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūtidhrāṇi vanāni yeṣu ca |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiphalikā yeṣu vallayaḥ || 11 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtipuṣpiṇaḥ stabakāstathā |
kṛṣṇakāntadharā vāṭyaḥ ārāmāḥ kṛṣṇayoginaḥ || 1 2||
udyānānyabhitaḥ santi kṛṣṇamayāni yatra ca |
tṛṇāni muktarūpāṇi sasyāni tādṛśāni ca || 13 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtidharāṇi santi cābhitaḥ |
vividhānāṃ ca muktānāṃ dhyānasevājuṣāṃ hareḥ || 1 4||
maṇḍalāni virājante’bhitaḥ sabhāgṛheṣu vai |
kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve kāmamaṇipradhāriṇaḥ || 15 ||
kāmapūrakakṛṣṇasya kalāṃśāveśarūpiṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇāṃgarūpiṇaḥ sarve kṛṣṇābhinnasvarūpiṇaḥ || 16 ||
kṛṣṇānandabharāḥ kṛṣṇāpṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇāḥ |
anantabhūpradeśasthā riktasthalīvivarjitāḥ || 17 ||
pratyekaṃ śrīharermūrtyā sahitāḥ santi sanmukhāḥ |
vanāraṇyamahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 18 ||
parvatādimahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
nadīnadamahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kūṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 19 ||
sīmavāṭīmahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
ārāmodyānagā muktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 4.117.20 ||
grāmapattanamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
nagarāvāsamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 21 ||
prasādālayamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 22||
śākhipraśākhimuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
vanyanāgarikā muktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 23 ||
svāmikāntasya muktānyaḥ sarvāstāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ |
śaktayaścāpi muktānyaḥ sarvāstāḥ svāmimūrtayaḥ || 24||
parabrahmapriyāḥ kṛṣṇaharipriyāśca śaktayaḥ |
sarvā rahasyamuktānyaḥ sarvathā harimūrtayaḥ || 25||
are badri vibhūṣāśca cetanā harimūrtayaḥ |
are badri svarṇaveṣāścetanā harimūrtayaḥ || 26 ||
are badri ca śṛṅgārāścetanā harimūrtayaḥ |
are badri cāyudhāni sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ || 27||
are badryupaskarāṇi sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ |
are badri prabhogyāni sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ || 28 ||
are badri suvarṣmāṇi sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ |
are vadri ca harmyāṇi sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ || 29||
are badri samastānīndriyāṇi harimūrtayaḥ |
are badri pṛthag yāni tāni vai harimūrtayaḥ || 4.117.30 ||
are badri nijātmāpi tatrāste harimūrtikaḥ |
yatkiñcidvartate dhāmni pare tat kṛṣṇamūrtikam || 31 ||
sarvaṃ haryātmakaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ nānyadasti tat |
kṛṣṇānandasukhaṃ kṛṣṇāpṛthakprasiddhavigraham || 32||
ekamevādvitīyaṃ tannānyat paśyati netaraḥ |
sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntātmānvitaṃ tadrūparūpitam || 33 ||
tatra kiṃ kena gṛhṇīyāt svātmakaṃ svaṃ pravindate |
etādṛśaṃ parabrahma vartate sarvato’nvitam ||34||
badrike’ṇḍapradeśe’pi parabrahma prakāśate |
parā brāhmī mahāvidyopaniṣat seyamucyate ||35||
etāmadhītya mukto’pi parabrahmāyate tadā |
amukto muktatāṃ yāti mukto’nādipramuktatām ||36||
anādimukta evāpi yāti rahasyamuktatām |
rahasyamukta evāpi yāti tādātmyamuktatām || 37||
tādātmyamuktaḥ saṃyāti parabrahmasvarūpatām |
nānyadasyāvaśiṣṭaṃ syājjñātavyaṃ paramaṃ tataḥ ||38||
nānyadasya tathāptavyaṃ śiṣyeta kāntataḥ param |
svaḥ kāntaḥ kānta eva saḥ sā kāntā kānta eva saḥ || 39||
yatsāmyamevāsya na kiñcidasti
yasmātparaṃ nāsti tathā ca kiñcit |
yadgarbhamevākhilamasya cāsti
tadbhāvya vidvānna pṛthak praśāsti ||4.117.40||
kā vā priyā tatra ca kaḥ priyo’sya
yasya priyaṃ sarvamayaṃ sa eva |
taṃ preṣṭhakāntaṃ parirabhya dhāmni
pare pṛthaktvaṃ vijahāti muktaḥ ||41 ||
so’yaṃ priyaḥ saiva parā priyā ca
sa eva bhoktā ca bhujiṣyikā sā |
sa garbhaniṣṭho hṛdaye bahiśca
taṃ prāpya kāntaṃ vṛjinaṃ hinasti ||42||
brahmapriyāḥ kṛṣṇaramāśca badrike
haripriyā muktaramāśca tāḥ khalu |
taṃ prāpya kāntaṃ ca samastarūpiṇaṃ
sthātuṃ hi tatraiva manāṃsi cakrire ||43||
vimānagāstāḥ khalu kṛṣṇadehino
muktā api kaṇṭhamaṇīcchayā muhuḥ |
samutsukāḥ kṛṣṇapatispṛhārthino
muhurvyapaśyan smitabhāvagarbhikāḥ ||44||
hariḥ pravijñāya ca vīkṣya bhāvaṃ
nijaṃ paraṃ prema tathāvidhaṃ ca |
pradarśya śīghraṃ hyanayat puraṃ svaṃ
parātparaṃ sarvaparaṃ maholam ||45||
vimānagāśca te sarve vīkṣya muktamayīṃ bhuvam |
pārabrāhmīṃ ca vasatiṃ yayuḥ śrīkṛṣṇamandiram ||46||
sarvamuktanagarāṇāṃ vartulānāṃ ca garbhagam |
mahādurgābhisampannaṃ nijaṃ rahasyamandiram ||47||
badrike te spṛhāvanto dhāmni sthātuṃ vimānagāḥ |
parabrahmapuraṃ dūrān muktavasatimadhyagam ||48|
vyapaśyan yāvadeveti tāvannetrāṇi satvaram |
tejo’bhibhūtatejāṃsi mimilurvai vimāninām ||49||
parabrahmapuraṃ dṛṣṭamaśaktāste vimānagāḥ |
mahimānaṃ viduḥ sveṣāṃ svāminastejasāṃ tadā ||4.117.50||
prārthayan paramātmānaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dātuṃ taduttamām |
harirdadau nijāṃ parākāṣṭhitāṃ dṛṣṭimuttamām ||51||
nijanetramayīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nijanetrapṛthaksthitām |
tadā vimānagāḥ sarve sphāranetrāḥ saśaktikāḥ ||52||
abhavannirnimeṣāśca kṛṣṇatejaḥsahāḥ sadā |
vimānāni yayurdrāk ca parabrahmapurāntikam ||53||
ghanatejoghanatejoghanatejo’tighaṭṭitam |
yatra tato’pi ca saddhaṭṭatejoghaṭṭātitaijasam ||||54||
parabrahmapuradurgaṃ vyapaśyam̐ste vimānagāḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmatattvanirmitam ||55||
sarvāścaryamayaṃ divyaṃ rahasyamuktasaṃśritam |
kaṇṭhamaṇimahāmuktapremamuktādhivāsitam ||56||
koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ dāsā dāsyaśca sevakāḥ |
putrā putryaśca yā ye ca te sarve kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ ||57||
tatra durge nivasanti parārdhayojanāvṛte |
asaṃkhyarddhiyute sarvakṛṣṇabhogābhipūrite ||58||
divyagopurabhūmyabjocchraye’ntaḥpurarakṣake |
vimānasthā vilokyāpi tān sarvān kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ ||59||
samānān jñātavanto na putrīḥ putrām̐śca sevakān |
ṛṣīn sādhūn yatīn sādhvīrvividurna yadā tadā ||4.117.60||
pravedanaparāṃ buddhiṃ dadau tebhyo hariḥ prabhuḥ |
drutaṃ prodbhinnamatayaḥ sarvajñāste’bhavan drutam ||6 1 ||
sarvāvedanayogyāśca sarvāṃste vividustadā |
mama putro hyayaṃ putrī ceyaṃ dāso mamāpyayam ||62||
mama mātā pitā cāyaṃ mama dāsī tviyaṃ suhṛt |
ityevaṃ prāptavijñānāḥ pramodino vimānagāḥ ||63||
saharṣāścātmasambodhā mitho gāthāḥ pracakrire |
badrike te rahasyākhyā muktā api ca satvaram ||64||
vimānagān pitā me’yaṃ māteyaṃ me suhṛnmama |
bandhuścāyaṃ kṣitau deśe putro’yaṃ putrikā tviyam ||65||
ityevaṃ bahudhā vyaktamavocurvīkṣya cāmbare |
śrutvā vīkṣya nisargotthasnehāḥ kutuhalānvitāḥ ||66||
sasaṃbhramāḥ sacāñcalyā dudruvuḥ premapūritāḥ |
sapūjopaskarapātrakarāste kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ||67||
vimānagāḥ samastāste’pi ca tān premanetriṇaḥ |
ālokayantaḥ snehāḍhyāstadāhvānaṃ pracakrire ||68||
koṭikoṭivimānānāmavatāraṇabhūmiṣu |
durgamadhyasthalīṣvete svāgatārthaṃ samāyayuḥ ||69||
sarvasaugandhyalāvaṇyavyāptaudyānasubhūmiṣu |
parabrahmamaholasyāgārabhāgātmikāsu vai ||4.117.70||
jayaśabdān sukhaśabdām̐ścakrire te mudānvitāḥ |
avaterurvimānāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ||71 ||
tāni sarvāṇi te muktā akṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ |
candanairamṛtaistoyairvardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||72||
mimiluścāvatīrṇāstān nijānnijān haripriyān |
samāśliṣan mitho vakṣomelanairnetramelanaiḥ ||73||
ānanānāṃ melanaiśca dehānāṃ melanaistathā |
atha badripriye devi rahasyaṃ śṛṇu cottamam ||74||
vimāne ye sthitāścāsan nārīmuktādayo’khilāḥ |
avatīrṇā vimānāttu yadā tadā puraḥ sthitān ||75||
vyalokayannijarūpān svāgatārthaṃ samāgatān |
anādisiddhamuktām̐stān kṛṣṇakāntātmakān śubhān ||76||
sadā paramadhāmasthān parabrahmapurāśrayān |
svātmakān svāpararūpān svabhāvaguṇarūpiṇaḥ ||77||
svāgataṃ kurvataḥ sveṣāṃ svapūjārthaṃ samāgatān |
svābhinnarūpiṇastām̐śca svām̐śca tacchāyikātmakān ||78||
vīkṣya vijñāya mūlātmarūpiṇaḥ sarvataḥ sthitān |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā abhavan vai vimāninaḥ ||79||
kṛṣṇapūjottaraṃ pūjāṃ prāpya kṛṣṇājñayā tu te |
vimānino yayustaistaiḥ sahitāḥ svasvakālayān ||4.117.80||
vimāninā tu muktena pratyekena saha prabhuḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau tadālayam ||8 1||
tasya tasya gṛhe divyagajāsane’paro hariḥ |
rājate mūlarūpo’pītyevaṃ vyalokayan harim ||82||
haridvayaṃ nijarūpadvayaṃ vīkṣya vimāninaḥ |
svīyamanādimuktatvaṃ rahasyamuktatāmapi ||83||
vividurdivyavijñānāścāntarbhāvaṃ nijātmani |
mūlarūpe yayuḥ sarve kṛṣṇo kṛṣṇe tiro’bhavat || 84 ||
sarve’nādikṛṣṇarūpā mūlarūpā yadābhavan |
badrike divyaparamāṃ viśrāntimāpuruttamām || 85 ||
yathā videśe vihṛtya svagṛhe śāntimeti ha |
tathā viśrāntimāpannā visasmarurvideśakān || 86 ||
aho kṛṣṇasya sāmarthyaṃ divyādivyamatipradam |
anantarūpadhāritvamasaṃkhyarūpadatvakam || 87 ||
vimānāni vimāneṣu vyalīyanta kṣaṇāttadā |
bhūṣāveṣasmṛddhayaśca vyalīyanta tadarddhiṣu || 88 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpaṃ samastakam |
ekamevādvitīyaṃ vai rūpato guṇato’pi ca || 89 ||
abhavat sarvameveti līlāṃ jānāti ko hareḥ |
gṛhe gṛhe hariścāste muktaṃ muktaṃ prati prabhuḥ || 4.117.90 ||
brahmapriyādikāḥ sarvā rahasyamuktatāṃ gatāḥ |
koṭyarbudābjakoṭyaśca prāsādāścātiśobhanāḥ || 91 ||
asaṃkhyarddhiyutāstatra parabrahmapure sthirāḥ |
kaṇṭhamaṇiprabhāveṇa prāsādeṣu sthitāśca te || 92 ||
vividuśca nijaṃ patnībhāvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ prati |
siṣevire tathaivainaṃ patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 93 ||
tadaṃgārdhasvarūpāḍhyāḥ prāpya svaṃ śāśvataṃ puram |
parabrahmāmṛtasnānaṃ cakrire te tadā gṛhe || 94 ||
parabrahmākṣatapuṣpacandanaiḥ kṛṣṇamījire |
parabrahmarasāsvādāmṛtānāṃ bhojanaṃ vyadhuḥ || 95 ||
parabrahmāmṛtavāripānaṃ pracakrire priyāḥ |
parabrahma paraṃ kāntaṃ siṣevire nirantaram || 96 ||
parabrahmaṇaḥ kāntasyopāsanāṃ cakrire’nvaham |
parabrahmaparābhaktiṃ vyadhuste nityamuktigāḥ || 97 ||
parabrahmānandavārddhiṃ bubhujire’tisevayā |
vividurna paraṃ kiñcit kāntasukhāt sukhetarat || 98 ||
kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā patnyaḥ prāpuḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpatām |
atha śrībhagavām̐stābhyo darśayituṃ svamandiram || 99 ||
koṭyarbudābjakoṭīnāṃ prāsādānāṃ tu madhyagam |
manaścakre’tha vai kṛṣṇaḥ sarvāḥ prāha priyaṃ vacaḥ || 4.117.10 0||
parabrahmamaholākhyasabhāsthānaṃ prayāmyaham |
āyāntu sahasā sarvāstatra matparamaṃ padam || 10 1||
prāptavatyo bhavatyo’tra sālokyaṃ sārṣṭi cetyapi |
sāyujyaṃ cāpi sārūpyaṃ caikatvaṃ pariśiṣyate || 102||
tadapyahaṃ darśayāmi paradhiṣṇayasthite mayi |
ityevaṃ badrike proktvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ || 10 3||
tirobhavaddrutaṃ tattanmandirāt prayayau sabhām |
yatra rājādhirājeśādhirājeśvarapūjitaḥ || 1 04||
anādyanantamukteśeśvaramuktādipūjitaḥ |
asaṃkhyānantavibhavairavatāraiśca pūjitaḥ || 1 05||
asaṃkhyadivyaśaktyādyairāyudhairabhipūjitaḥ |
sarvasṛṣṭisvarāṭ cāste sarvadhāmasvarāṭ patiḥ || 1 06||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ kṛṣṇakeśavaḥ |
svayaṃ mūle svarūpe sve gatvā sthiro’bhavaddhariḥ || 1 07||
kaṃbharānandano yo’yaṃ gopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ |
prabhuḥ padmāvatīsvāmī rādhālakṣmīvarottamaḥ || 1 08||
paramātmā parabrahma parameśaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
puruṣottamasaṃjño vai bhūtvā dhiṣṇye sthiro’bhavat || 1 09||
badrike muktakoṭyastā āyayuśca sabhāṃ prati |
harṣitāḥ svapatiṃ proṣya prāptā punaryathāṃganāḥ || 4.117.11 0||
bhuvi prākaṭyadivase saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyake |
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrūpe prātareva priyādikāḥ || 11 1||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmāritamutsavam |
kartuṃ tūrṇaṃ yayuḥ sarve muktā muktānikāstadā || 1 12||
gajāsane sthitaṃ kāntaṃ sabhāmaholake’bhitaḥ |
sthitvānarcuḥ svāminaṃ svaṃ cārārtrikaṃ vyadhustathā || 11 3||
asaṃkhyamuktā āgatya divyopacārakairharim |
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā jayanādān pracakrire || 1 14||
tatratyāḥ prayayuḥ sarve prapūjya ca nijālayān |
sahāyātāstu ye brahmapriyādyā muktakoṭayaḥ || 1 15||
te sarve tu samaicchan vai draṣṭuṃ kṛṣṇamaholakān |
omityāha tadā muktān darśayāmīti cāha tān || 116 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’ṣṭamadurgottarasthāḥ paradhāmapradeśāḥ, parabrahmapuradurgaḥ, parabrahmātmamuktavasatayaḥ, parabrahmapurasthānāṃ vaimānikānāṃ svarūpadvaye’pyaikyaṃ, parabrahmapure svasvālayeṣvavataraṇam, svāgataṃ viśramaṇaṃ, parabrahmaṇaḥ sabhāyāṃ svaśāśvatadhiṣṇyaṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 117 ||

<4.118>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu badrīpriye devi raṃgamaholamuttamam |
sabhāmaholamutkṛṣṭaṃ vāsamaholamityapi || 1 ||
śayyāmaholamucchraiṣṭhyaṃ maholaṃ mandirābhidham |
snānamaholanairmalyaṃ khelamaholamityapi || 2 ||
śāntimaholasaukhyaṃ ca śṛṃgārārhamaholakam |
maholaṃ bhojanākhyaṃ ca pūjāmaholamityapi || 3 ||
sarvāgamamaholaṃ ca bhaktasevāmaholakam |
tathā rahasyamuktānīkṛtasevāmaholakam || 4 ||
paṭṭāṃganāmahāmuktānikāmaholakaṃ tathā |
antaḥpuramaholaṃ ca ṣoḍaśetimaholakān || 5 ||
brahmapriyādyā muktāśca vyapaśyan bahuvistarān |
lakṣayojanavistārān pratyekaṃ tān maholakān || 6 ||
raṃgamaholasaṃjño yo maholaḥ paramātmanaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannivāsavān || 7 ||
sarvo divyasuvarṇātmā saccidānandataijasaḥ |
sarvarddhisiddhisāmarthyāsaṃkhyaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtaḥ || 8 ||
sarvordhvadhvajasaṃśobhadvṛttamaṇḍaparājitaḥ |
asaṃkhyastambhaśobhābhiḥ ramaṇīyamanoharaḥ || 9 ||
kalpalatākṣayapātracintāmaṇyādikoṇakaḥ |
sarvabhogyādisaṃrājatpārśvaśālādirājitaḥ || 4.118.10 ||
asaṃkhyatoraṇālambikammānikātisundaraḥ |
divyātidivyatejobhirhareḥ samantataḥ śubhaḥ || 11 ||
madhye brahmāsanāḍhyaśca vitānachatracāmaraiḥ |
divyadevatāmuktābhiḥ puṣpasragābhivarṣitaḥ || 1 2||
yattejāṃsi hareḥ siṃhāsanatejobhavāni vai |
tattejāṃsi prasaranti cānyamaholakeṣu ha || 13 ||
anyamaholatejāṃsi vartulāni prayānti ca |
bahirdurgābhisammukhānyatīva sarvasṛṣṭiṣu || 14||
brahmāsane’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate |
pareśvaro mūlarūpaḥ sarvasvāmī sadīśvaraḥ || 1 5||
sarvābharaṇabhūṣaśca sarvasugandhasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
sarvarūpātirūpāḍhyaḥ sundarebhyo’pi sundaraḥ || 1 6||
yuvāṣoḍaśavarṣonaḥ sarvakāntāmanoharaḥ |
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ hṛdayaṃgamaḥ || 1 7||
sahasrastambhayuksaumyabrahmāsane virājitaḥ |
śatasopānordhvapīṭhe samāsīnaḥ sa komale || 18||
sarvapūjopahārādyairarcito muktakoṭibhiḥ |
tamenaṃ paramātmānaṃ kāntaṃ paramapūruṣam || 1 9||
dṛṣṭvānandaṃ yayuḥ sarvarahasyamuktakoṭayaḥ |
raṃgamahole muktāste vyapaśyan svān hi koṭiśaḥ || 4.118.20 ||
divyaratnagatarūpān naijānasaṃkhyakānapi |
bhittau te ca tato’paśyan dhāmasṛṣṭīḥ samastikāḥ ||21 ||
caruṣvapi tato’paśyannīśvarākhilasarjanam |
paṭṭikāsu tato’paśyan brahmāṇḍāni samastataḥ ||22||
evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ sākṣādanubhavaṃ hi lebhire |
koṇake koṇake sarvasṛṣṭivyūhā bhavanti hi ||23||
talake talake tatra sarvadhāmāni santi hi |
phalake phalake sarvabrahmāṇḍāni bhavanti hi ||24||
anantārādhikāstatrāsaṃkhyāśca kamalāstathā |
asaṃkhyāścāpi māṇikyaḥ padmāvatyo’pyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||25||
priyā anantakāstatra lakṣmyo’pyanantakā hyapi |
ramā anantakāścāpi śriyaḥ santyapyanantakāḥ ||26||
raṃgamaholamadhye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyāḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpapratimā muktavigrahāḥ |||27||
sarvāḥ puṃrūpiṇya iti sevante kāntamutsukāḥ |
rahasyarūpadhāriṇyaḥ sevane śayanālaye ||28||
puṃrūpapradhāriṇyastāḥ sevante raṃgamaṇḍape |
brahmapriyā asaṃkhyāścāpyasaṃkhyāśca haripriyāḥ ||29||
kārṣṇyo’pyanantāḥ sevante hariṇyo harimacyutam |
nārāyaṇyo’pyasaṃkhyāśca mādhavyo’pi tathāvidhāḥ ||4.118.30||
līlāścāpi tathā vāsudevyaścāpi hyasaṃkhyakāḥ |
padmāścāpi ca padminyastulasyaścāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ || 31 ||
śāradāśca sarasvatyo gaṃgā yamyo’pyasaṃkhyakāḥ |
puṃmuktākhyāḥ prasevante kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam ||32||
pūjayanti prabhuṃ kāntaṃ rāmayanti ramottamāḥ |
preṃkhāyāṃ śrīharimāndolayanti gītikovidāḥ ||33||
śṛṃgārayanti kamalā svāmiśrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram |
saṃvāhayanti cāṃgāni hariṇyaśca hiraṇyabhāḥ ||34||
bhojayanti prabhuṃ sarvarasyabhojanapānakaiḥ |
sukhayanti kṛpānāthaṃ sarvāśleṣapradānakaiḥ ||35||
sukhaṃ gṛhṇanti kāntāt tā rahasyamandiraśritāḥ |
pāyayanti hariṃ divyaśarkarailārkakesaraiḥ ||36||
miśritāni sudugdhāni kāmadhenūdbhavāni vai |
evaṃvidhe mahāraṃgamahole hīrakottamāḥ ||37||
vidyante’saṃkhyaratnāni svarṇahārāśca śobhanāḥ |
taistaiḥ kāntaṃ bhūṣayanti kāntāḥ śrīkāntavallabham || 38||
tatra brahmapriyādyāstāḥ svāminā saha saṃgatāḥ |
tatrāpi bhagavān kṛṣṇo dvitīyarūpadhṛk prabhuḥ || 39||
tābhirvilokitaḥ kānto dvayoraikyaṃ tato’bhavat |
brahmasiṃhāsane tatra vyarājata pareśvaraḥ ||4.118.40||
rājādhirājaśobhāḍhyo’nantamuktābhisevitaḥ |
badrike mahadāścaryaṃ vyalokayam̐śca tatsthale ||41 ||
pratyekaṃ ye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇā hyāsan sahāgatāḥ |
pratimuktena sahate parakṛṣṇe layaṃ gatāḥ |||42||
brahmasiṃhāsane’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇe prabhau |
layaṃ yātān nijakāntān vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ||43||
tata eva priyā muktā ākṛṣṭāḥ sukhamūrchitāḥ |
mugdhāḥ kānte pare deve pupūjustuṣṭuvurmudā ||44||
ārārtrikaṃ pracakrūśca samāślikṣan patiṃ prabhum |
samūcuḥ śrīhariṃ muktāḥ pralubdhāḥ parameśvare ||45||
hare kṛṣṇa kṛpāsindho tvameva paramaḥ pumān |
rājase’nantakṛṣṇātmā sevanīyo’si naḥ sadā ||46||
bhavataḥ sampadaḥ sarvāḥ pradarśayātra no vibho |
maholāḥ ṣoḍaśa divyā bahiṣṭo vīkṣitāḥ khalu ||47||
āntaraṃ vīkṣituṃ sarvaṃ samīcchāmaḥ prabhopate |
bahiṣṭo’nantapārāste dṛśyante mādhavīpate ||48||
taijasordhvā yathā sūryāstaijasānāṃ sadādhikāḥ |
brahmāṇḍeṣu bhavantyeva tathā maholakāstava ||49||
ṣoḍaśānāṃ sumadhyastho raṃgamaholakastava |
koṭisūryātmakaḥ sūrya ivābhāti samantataḥ ||4.118.50||
sarvādhiko mahārāja manomohakaro hi naḥ |
pradarśaya prabho sarvān sampadāṃ nilayān hi naḥ ||51 ||
badrike śrīharistūrṇaṃ darśayituṃ tu taiḥ saha |
raṃgamahole babhrāma yatrarddhyo hyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||52||
divyacintāmaṇīnāṃ vai bhittayaśca talāni ca |
divyacintāmaṇīnāṃ ca svarṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca ||53||
divyaratnasrajo ramyā divyatoraṇapaṃktayaḥ |
divyaveṣā divyasarvopaskarā divyabhūmikāḥ ||54||
divyasarvāstaraṇāni divyāsanāni mūrtayaḥ |
divyapātrāṇi sarvāṇi divyamañjuṣikādikāḥ ||55||
śṛṇu śrībadrike tatra santi raṅgamaholake |
ekaikasmād vastunastu bījamaṇīndrasaṃjñakāt ||56||
yatheṣṭamudbhavāḥ sañjāyante’saṃkhyasajātikāḥ |
rūpakulyā rasakulyā gandhakulyā maṇīśvarāḥ ||57||
dadhikulyā madhukulyāḥ sudhākulyā maṇīśvarāḥ |
ānandaghanapānādikulyāstṛptipradāstathā ||58||
sarvalāvaṇyakulyāśca maṇyo rasyasampradāḥ |
rahasyamuktanivahairvīkṣitā bhogyadāstadā ||59||
keśāḥ sarvādhikā badri śṛṃgāradravyasampradāḥ |
bhūṣāvastrapradā veṣapradāstatra vilokitāḥ ||4.118.60||
lakṣaśo bhūmikāḥ kakṣāḥ saccidānandabhāyutāḥ |
ekaikayā priyayā ca saha sthitaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ ||61||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāḥ pratyekamandire |
vilokitaḥ samastābhirdivyamuktānikādibhiḥ ||62|||
sarvotkṛṣṭamahānandaghanavarṣaṇakāriṇaḥ | |
vilokitāstatra kṛṣṇamaṇayaḥ kāntamūrtijāḥ ||63||
parāvarttanamaṇyo latākuñjamaṇivrajāḥ |
mahodyānādimaṇayaścārāmamaṇayastathā ||64||
vilokitāḥ samastābhistatra ratnādihetavaḥ |
hiraṇmayyaśriyaḥ sarvā lokitā vai samantataḥ ||65||
sūryacandrādimaṇayo darpaṇādarśapaṭṭakāḥ |
vilokitāḥ samastābhiḥ raṃgamaholake’bhitaḥ ||66||
svasvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi vilokitāni tatra ca |
rahasyamuktanivahaiḥ spṛhāvadbhirmaholake ||67||
atyāścaryamidaṃ tatra dṛṣṭipathamabhūd gatam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau sthitāyāṃ raṃgamaṇḍape ||68||
paradhāmasamastaṃ vai mastake tairvilokitam |
akṣaraṃ dhāma hṛdaye māyādhāmodare tathā ||69||
avatārādidhāmāni mukhe vilokitāni vai |
īśvarāṇāṃ tu lokāśca jadyane hyavalokitāḥ ||4.118.70 ||
brahmāṇḍāni pādayostu vilokitāni taistadā |
liṅge saṃkarṣaṇarudraśaṃkarāstairvilokitāḥ ||71 ||
aniruddhā vedhasaśca nābhau tasya vilokitāḥ |
pradyumnā viṣṇavastasya vṛṣaṇayorvilokitāḥ ||72||
mahāpumān mahākālo bhrakuṭau tasya lokitau |
prakṛtiśca mahāmāyā tadicchāyāṃ vilokitā ||73|||
sākṣī vāsudeva etau buddhau tasya vilokitau |
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇastasya bhujayostairvilokitau ||74||
priyāḥ sarvā harervāme pārśve kukṣau vilokitāḥ |
ātmānaśca harerdakṣe narāḥ sarve vilokitāḥ ||75||
vihaṃgamāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe yādāṃsi tu nitambake |
vāme dakṣe tu tiryañcaḥ śākhinaḥ sarvaromasu ||76||
kandā romṇāṃ tu mūleṣu romakūpeṣu vallikāḥ |
parvatāḥ kaṭhine tasya nadyo nāḍīṣu sarvaśaḥ ||77||
ekatattvātmake tasmin tasyaiva kṛpayā bahūn |
bhedān vilokayāmāsū rahasyamuktakoṭayaḥ ||78||
surāṣṭraṃ tasya bhāle vai bhālamadhye’śvasārasam |
tasya nijasvarūpāṇi vyalokayan hareḥ priyāḥ ||79||
āho’sya badrike pāro vaibhavānāṃ na gamyate |
yadyanmūrtau ca tatsarvaṃ raṃgamaholake’bhitaḥ ||4.118.80||
vilokitaṃ priyābhirvai vyatiriktaṃ tadicchayā |
punaśca kṛpayā tatra tatra vastuni mādhavaḥ ||8 1||
prakāśamagamad vastu tirobhāvamupāgamat |
anvitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpativallabhaḥ ||82||
vilokitaḥ samastābhiḥ sarvātmako’bhitaḥ patiḥ |
śarīrīva tadantaḥstho bahiḥsthaścāpi lokitaḥ ||83||
vastu vilīya sahasā lokitaḥ sa tadaikalaḥ |
svarāṭ samrāṇmahārāṭ sa eka evādvitīyakaḥ ||84||
tatraikatāṃ tadā prāptā anādimuktakoṭayaḥ |
paramuktakoṭayaśca lokitāḥ śrīharau tadā ||85||
mūrtimagnā jale yadvanmīnā iva hyasaṃkhyakāḥ |
ekatvarasavettāraścāpṛthagbhāvamāsthitāḥ ||86||
na niḥsaranti te kvāpi mūrtilagnā bahiḥ kvacit |
yeṣāṃ pāro na vā sīmā na saṃkhyā na ca mānakam ||87||
hyeṣā mūrtimayī sṛṣṭiḥ paradhāmno’tirekiṇī |
vīkṣya tāṃ paramāścaryaṃ gatā rahasyamuktigāḥ ||88||
mānaṃ ca galitaṃ tāsāṃ nyūnasthityā tadagrataḥ |
atha tāścārthayāmāsuḥ kānte sthitiṃ tu tādṛśīm ||89||
harirdadau ca vacanaṃ maholadarśanottaram |
tato vai darśayāmāsa vāsamaholamuttamam ||4.118.90||
lakṣayojanamānaṃ ca sarvarddhipūrṇamacyutaḥ |
tataśca darśayāmāsa śayyāmaholamuttamam ||91 ||
koṭyarbudābjakāntānāṃ śayyāparyaṃkamaṇḍitam |
sarvaśṛṃgāraveṣārhottamadravyādisaṃbhṛtam ||92||
adṛṣṭapūrvamenaṃ ca dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ |
atha svamandiraṃ paścād darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||93||
yatra mātā kabhbharāśrīḥ pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ |
santuṣṭā ca svasāpyāste śukaśca bhagavānapi ||94||
vallabhaśca tathā teṣāṃ bhaktā vasanti sarvadā |
tattanmūlasvarūpeṣu mātāpitrādikān hariḥ ||95||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra kṛpayāntarabhāvayat |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tadvai vīkṣya te’pi mudaṃ yayuḥ ||96||
tatraivoṣuryatheṣṭaṃ vai mātrādyā mandirālaye |
sarvarddhisahite lakṣayojane divyavigrahe ||97||
atha snānamaholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa satpatiḥ |
divyasnānavidhānāni vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ ||98||
prasravaṇāḥ samastāśca kṣīranīrājyamādhavāḥ |
sudhāmṛtānandamodapramodādipravāhiṇaḥ ||99||
vīkṣitāḥ sarvasaugandhyamṛdupeśalavāryutāḥ |
tatastābhirvīkṣitaśca khelamahola uttamaḥ || 4.118.10 0||
sarvānandaramaṇāni khelasādhanakāni ca |
yatra divyāni vai santi kalpalabhyāni sarvathā || 101 ||
tataḥ śāntimaholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ |
sarvaśāntipradaṃ sarvaśāntisādhanasaṃbhṛtam || 1 02||
tataśca darśayāmāsa śṛṅgārodyānamuttamam |
lakṣayojanavistāraṃ suśṛṃgāramaholakam || 1 03|||
koṭyarbudābjapadmānāṃ śṛṅgāravastupūrakam |
mūrtikalpalatāvyāptaṃ sarveṣṭasampradaṃ śubham || 1 04||
kuṃkumālaktakavallīḥ kajjalākṣatavallikāḥ |
candanadravalatikā gandhasāradravadrumān || 1 05||
snehasāranavanītapiṇḍān mṛdurasānapi |
vīkṣya modaṃ paraṃ prāptā rahasyamuktigāstadā || 1 06||
bhojanānāṃ maholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa muktikṛt |
sarvavidhāsu divyāsvadivyāsu sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ||1 07||
yadyad bhojyaṃ bhakṣyavaryaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyaṃ ca pānakam |
tasya sarvasya mūlaṃ vai divyaṃ bhojyaṃ samastakam || 1 08||
sarvaṃ daivaṃ caiśvaraṃ cāvatārīyaṃ ca moktikam |
ātmīyaṃ brāhmamevāpi sarvaṃ tatra pravīkṣyatāḥ || 1 09||
spṛhāvatyo’bhavan bhoktuṃ bhojayāmāsa tatpatiḥ |
cāntimāṃ paramāṃ tṛptiṃ bahirbhāvāṃ dadau prabhuḥ || 4.118.11 0||
tataḥ pūjāmaholaṃ ca lakṣayojanavistaram |
sarvapūjārhaṇāyogyopaskāravastusaṃbhṛtam || 11 1||
darśayāmāsa bhagavān pūjāṃ pracakrire tu tāḥ |
sarvāgamamaholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa dhāmapaḥ || 112||
sarvasṛṣṭinivāsānāmāgamārthakṛtakṣaṇam |
samādhiyogināṃ yatra kṛṣṇayogaḥ prajāyate || 11 3||
yatraikake maṇau sarvasṛṣṭayo dṛṣṭigocarāḥ |
prajāyante ca vīkṣyainaṃ bhaktasevāmaholakam || 1 14||
vyalokayam̐śca te muktā yatra sevāṃ hareḥ sadā |
muktāḥ kurvanti vividhāṃ muktasevāṃ haristadā || 1 15||
parasparaprasevānāṃ vīkṣya sevakatāṃ tayoḥ |
mahāścaryaṃ yayuḥ sarvāḥ paraṃ bhāgyaṃ hi menire || 1 16||
darśayāmāsa bhagavān svaṃ rahasyamaholakam |
yatra kāntā imāḥ sarvāḥ kāntaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham || 1 17||
sarvakāmapradā nityaṃ sevante śayanādiṣu |
asaṃkhyakāntādhāmaitad vīkṣyāścaryaṃ gatāḥ striyaḥ || 1 18||
tataśca darśayāmāsa paṭṭāṃganāmaholakam |
yatra śataṃ tathā catvāriṃśat santi nijāṃganāḥ || 1 19||
sahasrasevikāyuktāḥ pratyekaṃ svapatiṃ harim |
sevante sarvadā badri vīkṣya modaṃ pralebhire ||4.118.120||
tāsu tāstā layaṃ prāptā nijamūlāsu yoṣitaḥ |
atha śrībhagavān badri cāntaḥpuramaholakam || 121 ||
darśayāmāsa sarvāstā anantamānamṛddhidam |
bhajante kāntabhāvena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu yāḥ || 1 22||
sarvasṛṣṭiṣu sarvatra sarvāstā yānti tatra ha |

nijatādātmyayogārthaṃ mūrtau vāsāya sarvadā || 124|||
harirvijñāya tadbhāvaṃ samāśleṣaṃ svavakṣasi |
dadau premṇā dadau vāsaṃ cāntarbhāvya nije hṛdi || 1 25||
svamūrtau mūrtigarbhākhyasṛṣṭau vāsaṃ dadau sadā |
koṭyarbudābjapatnīḥ svāḥ sakhībhiḥ sahitāḥ priyāḥ || 1 26||
antarbhāvya yayau kṛṣṇo nije raṃgamaholake |

bhaktecchāpūrakaścaivaṃ svecchāsvatantrabhāgapi |

putraputryādikaṃ sarvaṃ dāsadāsīpravistaram |
svodbhāvitaṃ svavistāraṃ svasminnāveśayatprabhuḥ || 129||
atha kṣaṇāt tirobhūya kuṃkumavāpikālaye |
lomaśena punaḥ svataḥprakāśena punastathā || 4.118.1 30||
lakṣmyā hṛdi sthayāśvinyā māṇikyayā ca vāhayā |
vimānenāpi yuktaḥ śrīhariścāśvasaro yayau || 131 ||
prajñāpadmāvatīyukto jalaṃ papau jagadguruḥ |
yātrāmetāṃ ca saptāyatanaṃ smaret tu yo janaḥ || 1 32||
sa yāyācchrīkṛṣṇasvāmyācāryaśrīharidhāma vai |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prajñā ca mādhavī || 1 33||
