saptāyatanametadvai smartavyaṃ sarvadā janaiḥ || 1 34||
parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastisro’sya śaktayaḥ |
jñānaśaktiḥ pramā cecchāśaktirlakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā || 1 35||
padmāvatī kriyāśaktirmāṇikyā śāśvatī chaviḥ |
svataḥprakāśaḥ saṃkalpo lomaśo brahmaśīlatā || 136||
sthāpayet pūjayed yastān sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt |
harermūrttaḥ prabhā kāntiḥ padmāvatī tu divyatā || 137||
lakṣmīśca kamanīyatvaṃ māṇikyā svacchatātmikā |
svataḥprakāśaḥ paridhirlomaśo romarūpadhṛk || 138||
viditvaivaṃ saptarūpaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam |
pṛthaṅmuktimatikramya mūrtimuktiṃ prayāti saḥ || 1 39||
rādhāṃ duḥkhaharāṃ śaktiṃ lakṣmīṃ sampatpradāṃ tathā |
prajñāṃ svarūpadāṃ śaktiṃ padmāvatīṃ tu mokṣadām || 4.118.140||
lomaśaṃ me’nādimuktaṃ brahma svayaṃprakāśitam |
saptāyatanakaṃ tvevaṃ viditvā kṛṣṇarūpagam || 141||
muktiṃ yānti parāṃ tvevaṃ pare dhāmni na saṃśayaḥ |
evamāha purā badri harirmāṃ parameśvaraḥ || 142||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne paradhāmani raṅgamaholādiṣoḍaśamaholānāṃ rahasyamuktebhyaḥ pradarśanaṃ, tadarddhipradarśana, svamūrtau sarvarddhisarvasṛṣṭipradarśanaṃ, śrīharimūrtigarbhagatānāditādātmyamuktasṛṣṭipradarśanaṃ, rahasyamuktānāṃ tatspṛhāvatāṃ mūrtigarbhatādātmyamuktipradānaṃ, saptāyatanasamaṣṭirūpahareḥ kuṃkumavāpīṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśata tamo’dhyāyaḥ || 118 ||

<4.119>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
badrike tā yā yatra vimānena yayuḥ striyaḥ |
tatra tatreśvaraloke pratigṛhaṃ hariṃ patim || 1 ||
vyalokayan svargaloke satyādau parameśvaram |
vairājeṣu tathā ceśvarāṇāṃ lokeṣu sarvaśaḥ || 2 ||
dhāmasvapyavatārāṇāṃ pratimuktaṃ hariṃ patim |
vyalokayan tathā tāścākṣare dhāmni gṛhe gṛhe || 3 ||
sarvadurgāntarasṛṣṭau pratimuktaṃ hariṃ patim |
pratigṛhaṃ tathānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam || 4 ||
maholeṣu tathā kṛṣṇahṛdaye’pi ca mandiram |
pratimuktaṃ pratimūrtiṃ vyalokayannijaṃ prabhum || 5 ||
vinānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ taddhṛdaye’pi ca |
muktā naiva hi vartante mūrtau yatkoṭimūrtayaḥ || 6 ||
asaṃkhyamūrtayastatra pratimuktaṃ bhavantyapi |
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ tadā tatra mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tathā tadā || 7 ||
tādātmyatāmavāpsyanti ye te drakṣyanti tattathā |
anyeṣāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi naiva bhavati tādṛśam || 8 ||
sarvotkṛṣṭā mūrtigarbhasṛṣṭistādātmyasaṃjñikā |
dvitīyā tu pare dhāmni rahasyabhāvasṛṣṭikā || 9 ||
tṛtīyā tu pare dhāmni mahāmuktamayī hi sā |
caturthī tu pare dhāmni muktasṛṣṭiḥ samānikā ||4.119.1 0||
aṣṭadurgamayī sarvā parabrahmaparāyaṇā |
pañcamī tvakṣare dhāmni sṛṣṭiścākṣaramuktigā || 1 1||
ṣaṣṭhī sarvāvatārāṇāṃ dhāmamayī tadātmikā |
saptamī ceśvarāṇāṃ tu sṛṣṭiḥ sattvamayī śubhā || 1 2||
aṣṭamī tu triguṇānāṃ sṛṣṭirmāyāmayī tathā |
navamī śaṃkarabrahmaviṣṇūnāṃ sṛṣṭiruttamā || 1 3||
daśamī siddhakoṭīnāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ sādhumayī śubhā |
ekādaśī tu pitṝṇāṃ dvādaśī dyunivāsinām || 14||
trayodaśī maharṣīṇāṃ mānavānāṃ ca badrike |
caturdaśī tiraścāṃ tu pañcadaśī tu śākhinām || 15||
ṣoḍaśī guṇadharmāṇāṃ sṛṣṭayaḥ ṣoḍaśa tvimāḥ |
asṛṣṭiḥ paramātmāsāvanādipuruṣottamaḥ ||16||
sarvasṛṣṭidharo nāthaḥ sarvāntaryāmikaḥ prabhuḥ |
anvitaḥ sarvasākṣī cānanvitastu svarāṭ paraḥ || 17||
anvitānanvitamiśro’vatārādisvarūpadhṛk |
mokṣado bhaktasukhado dharmasthāpanavigrahaḥ || 18||
nāmirūpijagatāṃ sa netā hantā tadanvitaḥ |
ityeṣāṃ sampravijñāyopaniṣadaṃ tu ṣoḍaśīm || 1 9||
virajyeta vimucyeta prayāyāt paramaṃ padam |
na tasya punarāvṛttirya evaṃ veda ṣoḍaśīm ||4.119.20||
śrībadrīpriyovācakuṃkumavāpīmāgatya bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
kiṃ cakāra tadācakṣva naranārāyaṇaprabho ||21||
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāgatya bhūtale |
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāturmāsyavrataṃ vyadhāt ||22||
aṣṭāviṃśatitamake nijaprākaṭyake’hani |
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥkāle nijotsavottaram ||2 3|||
dadau dānāni bhagavān svarṇaratnagavāṃ tathā |
prāsādānāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ rajatānāṃ dvijātaye|| 24||
pātrāṇāṃ cāpi ratnānāṃ maṇīnāṃ vājināṃ tathā |
vimānānāṃ ca yānānāṃ gajānāṃ viprajātaye || 25||
dadau dānāni bhagavān vastrāṇāṃ svarṇayoginām |
bhūṣaṇānāṃ samastānāṃ paryaṃkānāṃ suvarcasām || 26||
mukuṭānāṃ kaṭakānāṃ śṛṃkhalānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
mauktikānāṃ sphaṭikānāṃ gomedānāṃ sutejasām || 27||
dadau dānāni bhagavān pādukānāṃ srajāṃ tathā |
chatrāṇāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca vetrāṇāṃ svarṇapatriṇām || 288|||
siṃhāsanānāṃ peṭānāṃ mañjuṣāṇāṃ dadau hariḥ |
kapāṭānāṃ vṛsīnāṃ ca khaṣṭvānāṃ siṃhacarmaṇām || 29 ||
gajavyāghrarkṣahariṇadvipigavayacarmaṇām |
dadau dantotthavastūnāṃ dānāni bālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 4.119.30 ||
kambalānāṃ kañcukīnāṃ kañcukānāṃ ca varmaṇām |
śastrāṇāṃ ca vitānānāṃ bhūstarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 31 ||
kauśeyānāmambarāṇāṃ dhautrāṇāṃ mūrddhavāsasām |
sukañcūnā kaṭisthānāṃ raśanānāṃ dadau prabhuḥ || 3 2||
gendukānāṃ cakrakāṇāṃ kaśipūnāṃ ca tūlinām |
tulānāṃ musalānāṃ colūkhalānāṃ jalabhṛtām || 33||
preṅkhāṇāṃ bāladolānāṃ ghaṭānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
sthālīnāṃ vāṭikānāṃ ca peṣaṇīnāṃ tathā dadau || 34||
cullīnāṃ vyajanānāṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ pādarakṣiṇām |
kavacānāmūrmikānāṃ bāṇānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ tathā || 35||
śarāṇāṃ cāpi khaḍgāṇāṃ mudgarāṇāṃ pravidyutām |
rajjūnāṃ darpaṇānāṃ ca keśaprasādhanārthinām || 36||
dadau dānāni ca guptadorakāṇāṃ janārdanaḥ |
kṣetrāṇāṃ vāṭikānāṃ ca mahiṣīṇāṃ payomucām || 37||
sasyānāṃ ca kaṇānāṃ ca śubhānnānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
kalabhānāṃ śākhināṃ ca phalināṃ puṣpiṇāṃ tathā || 38 ||
dhanānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca yūpānāṃ cāpi sampadām |
gṛhopakaraṇānāṃ ca śayyānāṃ paramānasām || 39||
udyāmārāmavāpīnāṃ śakaṭānāṃ dadau hariḥ |
śibikānāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ paṭamaṇḍaparūpiṇām ||4.119.40 ||
parabhittigṛhāṇāṃ ca varūthānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
palyāṇānāṃ ca dānāni kūpāmbālikaśṛṃgiṇām ||41 ||
niḥśreṇīnāṃ catuṣpādaghoṭīnāṃ paṭṭasevinām |
droṇīnāṃ gargarīṇāṃ ca kusulānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||42||
toraṇānāṃ pradīpānāṃ ghaṇṭānāṃ vādyanāminām |
dadau dānāni ca vīṇāvipañcīnāṃ janārdanaḥ ||43||
kaṇṭhīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca kośānāṃ bhṛtyayoṣitām |
dāsānāṃ cāpi dāsīnāṃ dadau dānāni godhano ||44||
tālānāṃ pañcapātrāṇāṃ śāṭīnāṃ payasāṃ tathā |
naktakānāṃ pragucchānāṃ pūgānāṃ mukhavāsinām ||45||
lekhinīnāṃ ca vedānāṃ vidyānāṃ dānakānyapi |
mahānasīyavastūnāṃ sabhāsthānopayoginām ||46||
mahotsavādivastūnāṃ dadau dānāni vai hariḥ |
dhātūnāṃ sarvajātīnāṃ daṃśamatsaranāśinām ||47||
vastraśayyāvitānānāṃ dadau dānottamāni saḥ |
piṣṭānāṃ peṭikānāṃ ca nāvāṃ sauvarṇapakṣiṇām ||48||
āsanānāṃ catuṣkīṇāṃ dadau dānāni mādhavaḥ |
ghargharīṇāṃ jhallarīṇāṃ strībhūṣāṇāṃ samastataḥ ||49||
makhapātropapātrāṇāṃ dadau dānāni gopajaḥ |
vṛṣabhāṇāṃ vatsakānāṃ vatsikānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||4.119.50||
sthālānāṃ kuṇḍikānāṃ ca hīrakāṇāṃ dadau prabhuḥ |
śarkarāṇāṃ ca gūḍānāṃ miṣṭānāṃ madhugandhinām ||51 ||
madhūnāṃ navanītānāṃ ghṛtānāṃ ca dadau prabhuḥ |
dvidalānāṃ ca dhānyānāmakṣatānāṃ dadau tathā ||52||
godhūmānāṃ caṇakānāṃ mudgānāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
munyannānāṃ tathā kamaṇḍalūnāṃ śreṣṭharūpiṇām ||53||
darvīnāṃ sruksruvādīnāṃ camacīnāṃ dadau prabhuḥ |
mahāsthālātiśālānāṃ śirastrāṇādibandhinām ||54||
rājaveṣādiveṣāṇāṃ dadau dānāni badrike |
kārpāsānāṃ śaṇānāṃ ca māṣāṇāṃ ca rameśvaraḥ ||55||
saktūnāṃ rājamāṣāṇāṃ kaṅgūnāṃ pradadau tathā |
rasānāṃ cāpi gandhānāṃ candanānāṃ dravātmanām ||56||
kastūrīṇāṃ tathā śreṣṭhakarpūrāṇāṃ dadau prabhuḥ |
elālavaṃgajāvaṃtrījāyaphalādigandhinām ||57||
rājikāśuṇṭhikātiktakaṭūnāṃ dānakānyapi |
bhakṣyāṇāṃ cāpi bhojyānāṃ lehyānāṃ cūṣyatāvatām |||58|||
carvaṇārhakaṇānāṃ ca lavaṇānāṃ dadau tathā |
veṣavārottamānāṃ ca kandānāṃ śākapatriṇām ||59||
āranālādimūlānāmikṣūṇāmamblapuṣpiṇām |
takrāṇāṃ ca carūṇāṃ ca kṣīrāṇāṃ dānakāni ca ||4.119.60||
śukānāṃ pañjarasthānāṃ menakānāṃ ca pakṣiṇām |
sārikāṇāṃ ghātakānāṃ garuḍānāṃ dadau prabhuḥ ||6 1 ||
kokilānāṃ tittirāṇāṃ bhāradvājādipakṣiṇām |
mayūrāṇāṃ ca haṃsānāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ bahuśṛṃgiṇām ||62|||
ghoṭakānāṃ tathoṣṭrāṇāṃ dadau dānāni dānakṛt |
devānāṃ ca pratimānāṃ jīvikānāṃ tathā dadau ||63||
puttalīnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ puttalānāṃ dadāvapi |
brahmāṇḍānāṃ ghaṭānāṃ ca guptadānāni vai dadau ||64||
śālānāṃ mandirāṇāṃ ca saṃhitānāṃ dadau tathā |
śirastrāṇoṣṇiṣāṃ prāvaraṇānāṃ kalpaśākhinām ||65||
kalpalatānāṃ dānāni dadau śrīparameśvaraḥ |
vajramaṇīn dadau muktāmaṇīn supadmarāgakān ||66||
indranīlānmarakatān vaidūryān pradadau hariḥ |
karketanān puṣparāgān bhīṣmakām̐śca maṇīn dadau ||67||
pulakān rudhirān sarvān sphaṭikān pradadau prabhuḥ |
vidrumān kaustubhān cintāmaṇīn dadau pareśvaraḥ ||68||
māṇikyān candrahāsām̐śca pāraśān svarṇadām̐stathā |
sūryakāntān divyakācān kācayantrāṇi dīpikāḥ ||69||
taijasīrhāṇḍikāścāpi jhumbharān bahuśobhagān |
pradadau sarvaśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dvijātaye ||4.119.70||
kanyābhyo bahuratnāni kumārebhyo’pi vai dadau |
dīnānāthātithibhikṣusadbhyo dadau prabheśvaraḥ ||71 ||
hiraṇyaparvatadānaṃ tilaparvatamārpayan |
suvarṇamedinīdānaṃ kalpapādapadānakan ||72||
hemadhenupradānaṃ ca svarṇalakṣmīpradānakam |
tiladhenupradānaṃ ca gosahasrapradānakam ||73||
hiraṇyāśvapradānaṃ ca cakre padmāvatīśvaraḥ |
kanyādānāni dīnānāmadāpayat satīpatiḥ ||74||
hiraṇyavṛṣadānaṃ ca suvaṇagajadānakam |
lokapālāṣṭakadānaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivārpaṇam ||75||
cakāra sa satāṃ nātho hyaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe |
śrāddhāni vividhānyeṣaścakāra tarpaṇaṃ dadau ||76||
pitṛśrāddhāni sarvāṇi mātṛśrāddhāni yānyapi |
nāndīśrāddhāni sarvāṇi cakāra kṛṣṇa eva saḥ || 77||
yadyat kṛṣṇena lokebhyaḥ pūjāyāṃ tu samarpitam |
rājadevarṣipitṛbhyaśceśvarebhyaḥ samarjitam ||78 ||
śreṣṭhibhyaścāpi daityebhyo dānavebhyastathārjitam |
yakṣebhyo rākṣasebhyaśca nāgebhyo yadupārjitam ||79||
bhaktebhyaścāpi muktebhyaḥ svabhujābhyāṃ samarjitam |
tatsarvaṃ svadhanaṃ cāpi svapatnīnāṃ dhanānyapi ||4.119.8 0 ||
koṭyarbudābjapadmāni dadau dāne harīśvaraḥ |
prāsādikaṃ hareryadvai sarvaṃ divyaṃ ca mokṣadam || 81 ||
matvā matvā dānapātraṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā surādayaḥ |
īśvarāścāpi muktāśca brahmakṣatrādvijātayaḥ ||82||
anyavarṇāścāpi kṛṣṇaprasādamahimecchayā |
jagṛhurbhikṣukā bhūtvā sarve yat kṛṣṇabhikṣukāḥ ||8 2||
yairyaiḥ prāptāni divyāni vastūni kṛṣṇahastataḥ |
te te tadvastuyogena bhūtvā tu pāpavarjitāḥ ||84||
mahāpuṇyāśrayā bhūtvā bhūtvā divyaguṇālayāḥ |
sattvaprakarṣavantaste bhūtvā bhaktā hareḥ khalu ||85||
dehānte te yayuḥ smṛtvā tadyogena paraṃ harim |
paraṃ dhāma yayurbrahmalokaṃ lokaṃ tathākṣaram ||8 6||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ padam |
avyākṛtapadaṃ cāpi yayurviṣṇupadaṃ hyapi ||87||
aho śrībadrike yairyergṛhītaṃ tatprasādakam |
te te dāridryahīnāścābhavan pṛthvyāṃ samṛddhayaḥ ||88 ||
ante’bhavan hareryoge parame mokṣabhāginaḥ |
ye’pi dānāni kṛṣṇasya praśaśaṃsurmudānvitāḥ ||89||
guṇaṃ ca jagṛhurye’pi te’pi mokṣagatiṃ yayuḥ |
kṛṣṇapradattadhenūnāṃ pītāni yaiḥ payāṃsyapi || 4.119.90 ||
te’pi dhāma yayustasya prasādasya pratāpataḥ |
hīrakādyanvitā mālāḥ kṛṣṇaprasādamūrtayaḥ || 91 ||
dehe dhṛtāśca yairbhūṣā vastrāṇyapi dhṛtāni yaiḥ |
paryaṃkādyā upabhuktā veṣā dhṛtāḥ supāvanāḥ ||92||
yānavāhanaśakaṭānovimānāni yairapi |
adhiṣṭhitāni dhiṣṇyāni prasādapāvanāni vai ||93 ||
gṛhāṇi ca rajāṃsi śrīkṛṣṇapādasya yairapi |
yābhiścāpi dhṛtānyeva dehe te tā yayuḥ param || 94||
kṛṣṇaprasādalabdhāni phalānyattāni yairapi |
bṛsyāsanāni kauśeyakambalādīni yānyapi ||95||
adhiṣṭhitāni yaiste’pi pūtāḥ paraṃ padaṃ yayuḥ |
badrike bhagavānnityaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe || 96||
lakṣaviprān lakṣapatnīyutān dvilakṣabālakān |
lakṣakanyākumārām̐śca lakṣadīnātithīn sataḥ || 97||
lakṣasādhujanān lakṣasādhvīrlakṣādhibhikṣukān |
bhojayatyeva bhāvena miṣṭānnāni śubhāni vai || 98||
gariṣṭāni sugandhāni vaṃhvājyāni sadā sadā |
kṣīrapāyasayuktāni laḍḍukaiḥ sahitānyapi ||99||
meśubhāni ca śākāni suramyāṇyodanāni ca |
dadhibhaktāni sājyāni bhojayatyeva nityaśaḥ || 4.119.10 0||
pānatāmbūlakādyaiśca mukhavāsairanuttamaiḥ |
dakṣiṇābhiḥ svarṇamudrābhiśca toṣayati dvijān || 101 ||
varṣakāle samāyātaṃ cāṣṭāviṃśaṃ mahodinam |
svajanmano haristatra pūjito viprabhūmipaiḥ || 1 02||
devairmuktaiḥ pitṛbhiśca prajābhirvaiṣṇavaistathā |
sādhubhiḥ sarvalokānāṃ dehibhiḥ pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 03||
nityaṃ prapūjyate tadvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
dadāti pūjakānāṃ ca muktiṃ paraṃ pade nijam || 1 04||
badrike bhavane naije rājate’śvasarastaṭe |
sarvaduḥkhaharaḥ svāmīśrīkṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ prabhuḥ ||1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bhagavān svopārjitāsaṃkhyasamṛddhīnāṃ dānāni cakāretyādinirūpaṇanāmā navadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 19||

<4.120>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
badrike śrīharikṛṣṇo vānaprasthaḥ samādvayam |
atiṣṭhata mahāśānto mahāvratadharaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 ||
brahmavrataparo nityaṃ bhaktimārgaprabodhakṛt |
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca satāṃ yogiyatīnāṃ maṇḍalaiḥ suyuk || 2 ||
ātmadhyānaparaścāpi vartate tyāgaśīlavān |
sādhyāḥ siddhāḥ samāyānti sabhāyāṃ harisannidhau || 3 ||
kathāvārtāḥ pravartante hyādhyātmikyo hi mokṣadāḥ |
bahavo dehino dīkṣāṃ labdhvā yānti paraṃ padam || 4 ||
badrike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi niṣparigrahaḥ |
sarvavyavahāramuktastyāgimārgaṃ samaihata || 5 ||
tyāgisādhumahādīkṣāṃ samaicchallomaśādguroḥ |
prārthayallomaśaṃ cāpi kārtike śuklapakṣake || 6 ||
ekādaśyāṃ mahādīkṣāṃ grahītuṃ parameśvaraḥ |
āśramakramarakṣārthaṃ dharmasthāpanahetave || 7 ||
parameśo’pi bhagavān mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata |
dharmasyāpi sunirmātā dharmamūrtirvidhāyakaḥ || 8 ||
āśramāṇāṃ sadādhāro mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata |
yasmād dīkṣāḥ pravartante makhā vratāni vai yataḥ || 9 ||
yadicchāyāṃ mahāmokṣaḥ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata |
yadvacastacchrutivākyaṃ yatsaṃkalpo vidhirmataḥ || 4.120.1 0||
yatprasādāt phalaṃ sarvaṃ yatprapattiḥ parātparā |
yadīkṣaṇaṃ mahādīkṣā so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 1||
dīkṣayā yatphalaṃ proktaṃ yajjñānaṃ dīkṣayāpyate |
yayāghānāṃ kṣālanaṃ ca yadanugrahato bhavet || 1 2||
yāṃ vināpi svayaṃ śakto mokṣaṃ dātuṃ nijecchayā |
so’pi sarvāvatāreśo mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 3||
yatsparśaḥ śastramātrādidvārako mokṣaṇāya vai |
pāpināmapi jīvānāṃ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 14||
yatsparśaḥ kāmanāpūrvaḥ strīṇāmuddhārakṛt sadā |
āśleṣo muktijanakaḥ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 15||
yasyāṅguṣṭhajñalaṃ gaṃgā mokṣadā sarvadehinām |
yadbhaktā mokṣadāścāpi sopi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 6||
badrike dīkṣayā yatra gantavyaṃ so’sti yaḥ svayam |
yadyogena khadehāśca yātā yānti paraṃ padam || 17||
brahmapriyādyā muktāśca yena nītā nijaṃ padam |
rakṣitāstatra tenaiva divyadehena yena tu || 18||
yanmantrāptermokṣadāśca bhavanti sādhavo janāḥ |
mokṣadāḥ sarvajīvānāṃ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 9||
yadaiśvaryakaṇaṃ prāpya dīkṣāṃ mokṣaṃ dadātyapi |
so’pi dīkṣābhikṣukaḥ san mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata ||4.120.20||
romaśo lomaśaścāpi yadupāsanābhavat |
mahāmukto maharṣiśca cirāyurmokṣadaḥ sadā ||21 ||
sarvakalyāṇakṛt sādhuviprarṣiḥ pāvanaḥ paraḥ |
tasmādupāsakāt kṛṣṇo mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata ||22||
sarvopāsyo harirbhaktānupāste premasamplutaḥ |
so’yaṃ kṛṣṇo’pi bhagavānupāste lomaśaṃ munim ||23||
śikṣako bālamadhyāpya bālād gṛhṇāti sāravat |
dīkṣako munimadhyāpya munergṛhṇāti dakṣiṇam ||24||
evaṃ paramparāṃ pūrvapūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭirakṣaṇe |
rakṣituṃ tāṃ mahādīkṣāṃ lomaśāt kṛṣṇa aihata || 25||
daśamyāṃ śrīhariścakre hyupoṣaṇaṃ sunirjalam |
pañcagavyāśanaṃ cakre dehaśuddhiprayojakam ||26||
tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ cakre tīrthasnānādibhistathā |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cakre gītakīrtanamaṅgalaiḥ ||27||
prātarutthāya vai snānaṃ dhyānaṃ cakre nijātmanaḥ |
pūjanaṃ pracakārāpi devānāṃ ca vidhānataḥ |||28||
kṣauraṃ prakārayāmāsa sasnau tīrthādivāribhiḥ |
śrāddhādi pracakārāpi pitṛtṛptikaraṃ śubham |||29||
kuṇḍaṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram |
puṇyāhaṃ vācayāmāsa jalaṃ mumoca bhūtale ||4.120.30 ||
ācamanaṃ tathā nyāsān pracakāra vidhānataḥ |
prāṇāyāmān vidhāyātha cakre gaṇeśapūjanam ||3 1 ||
vāstudevādyarhaṇaṃ ca vardhanīkalaśārhaṇam |
kuṇḍamaṇḍapadevānāmarhaṇaṃ pracakāra ca |||22||
grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ sarvadikpālānāṃ prapūjanam |
lokapālārhaṇaṃ cāpi ṛṣipitrarhaṇaṃ tathā ||33||
devīdevatāpūjāṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā |
īśanīnāṃ pūjanaṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ prapūjanam |||34||
mātṛkāṇāṃ yoginīnāṃ satīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā |
muktānāṃ pūjanaṃ muktānikānāṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||35||
parabrahmārhaṇaṃ cakre sarvatattvārhaṇaṃ tathā |
kāśyapīnāṃ prajānāṃ ca pūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ || 36||
prāyaścittavidhiṃ cakre havanaṃ pracakāra ca |
vahnipūjāṃ vahnimukhasarvadevapratarpaṇam ||37|||
cakāra bhagavān homaṃ kṣīrājyapāyasodbhavam |
phalapuṣpamadhūnāṃ ca samidhāṃ havyasañjuṣām || 38||
kavyānāṃ havanaṃ cakre piṇḍānāṃ ca pradānakam |
śrīphalādyairmahāhomaṃ cakre ca ghṛtadhārayā || 39||
madhye vyāvartya vastrāṇi kāṣāyāṇi dadhāra saḥ |
dhautraṃ cāṃgarakṣakaṃ cottarāsaṃgaṃ samuṣṇiṣam ||4.120.40||
yajñopavītakaṃ pracchadapaṭīṃ cottarīyakam |
pāduke ca dadhārāpi kaupīnaṃ ca kamaṇḍalūn ||41 ||
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ cakre cāndanaṃ kauṃkuma tathā |
śikhāṃ baddhvā ca gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ jagṛhe guroḥ ||42||
parabrahmaṇe vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi |
tanno hariḥ pracodayādīti jagrāha lomaśāt ||43||
oṃ parabrahmāhamasmītyaṣṭākṣaraṃ ca jagṛhe |
omanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu śaraṇaṃ mama ||44||
ṣoḍaśākṣaramantraṃ ca jagṛhe lomaśānmuneḥ |
ityevaṃ prāpya mantrām̐strīn trivāraṃ praṇanāma tam |||45||
lomaśaṃ ca tathā vahniṃ devānnatvā pradakṣiṇam |
pracakre daṇḍavat sādhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyanaḥ ||46||
devaprasādaṃ jagṛhe pupūja lomaśaṃ gurum |
upadāḥ pradadau divyāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ tathā ||47||
dakṣiṇāṃ pradadau cāpi tyāgī bhūtvā janārdanaḥ |
kṛṣṇavat labhyate yaḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho’bhavat ||48||
vaiṣṇavo vai parabrahma haṃsovijñānaśobhanaḥ |
sādhurūpaḥ parabrahma haṃsastyāgāśramī prabhuḥ || 49||
svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvavallabhatāṃ gataḥ |
parameśaḥ svāmibhāve vartate sarvadāpi saḥ ||4.120.50||
dīkṣayā svāmitāṃ prāpya svāmisvāmo tato’bhavat |
brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ nityaṃ bhaktivrataṃ mahattamam ||51||
pālayāmāsa bhagavān kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇāyanaḥ |
dīkṣākāle maṇḍape ca maharṣisādhusādhvikāḥ || 52||
āśīrvādān dadustatra śreyase paramātmane |
vireje bhagavān dvedhā kāṣāyāmbaradhṛk tathā ||53||
rājādhirājarūpo’pi sarveṣāṃ mānaseṣu saḥ |
dīkṣākāle tu vādyāni hyavādyanta samantataḥ ||54||
vedamantrā maharṣīṇāṃ gītayaḥ surayoṣitām |
mānavīnāṃ kīrtanāni maṇḍapādau tadābhavan ||55||
upadeśaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ ca labdhvā tyāgāśramaṃ śubham |
pūrṇāhutiṃ vyadhāddhomaṃ dadau dānāni vai tadā |||56||
svarṇahīrakarūpyāṇāṃ ratnagodhanavāsasām |
parṇaśālāṃ vinā sarvaṃ pradadau bhavanādikam ||57||
lomaśasyāśrame paścācchiṣyarūpo’vasatprabhuḥ |
asaṃkhyasādhusañjuṣṭe tyāgināṃ maṇḍale hariḥ ||58||
nyavasat śāntacittātmā sādhusevākṛtādaraḥ |
asaṃkhyajīvajātānāṃ mokṣe tu satataṃ rataḥ ||59||
lakṣmīstadā pṛthag bhūtvā sādhvī kāṣāyadhāriṇī |
astaut svāmisvarūpaṃ śrīparabrahmaprahaṃsakam ||4.120.60||
oṃ namaḥ śrīparabrahma te namaḥ paramātmane |
brahmamuktādhipataye paradhāmanivāsine ||61||
apṛthaṅmuktasaṃsthāya rahasyamuktasevine |
namaste śrīraṅgamaholādivāsāya yogine ||62|||
nirlepāya mahāmuktānādimuktādisevine |
ākṣarairmuktavṛndaiśca sevitāya ca te namaḥ ||63||
avatārairīśvarādyaiḥ sevitāya ca te namaḥ |
ṛṣipitṛsurādyaiśca sevitāya ca te namaḥ ||64||
mānavaiścetaraiścāpi yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ |
nāgaiḥ sarpai rākṣasaiśca sevitāya ca te namaḥ ||65||
udbhijjarāsvedajaiśca prasevitāya te namaḥ |
naraiśca pramadābhiśca sarvasthāvarajaṅgamaiḥ ||66||
puṣṭyarthaṃ saṃsevitāya sukhadāya ca te namaḥ |
asaṃkhyayogināṃ kāmapūrakāya ca te namaḥ ||67||
asaṃkhyānāṃ svabhaktānāṃ tārakāya ca te namaḥ |
māṇikyāyā badaryāśca nāthāya te namo namaḥ ||68||
badaro nāma rājarṣirvyadhād badarikāśramam |
yatkṛpāṃśāt svāminaṃ taṃ vande badarikeśvaram ||69||
hemānalāsuro yena parvatādho niṣūditaḥ |
tasya badaranṛpateḥ prasannāya ca te namaḥ ||4.120.70||
badarīsvīyamūlādho hemānalamamardayat |
yatpratāpena taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ natāsmi sādhurūpiṇam ||71 ||
badaro rasārūpo’pi yatkṛpāto vyajāyata |
phale taṃ paramātmānaṃ vande śrīsvāminaṃ tviha ||72||
naro’pi bījatāṃ prāpto badarākhye phale sadā |
yatkṛpātastaṃ phaleśaṃ vande śrīsvāminaṃ prabhum ||73||
śrīśīlasya tu viprasya pretabhūtasya mokṣaṇam |
badarasva pradānena kṛtaṃ yena ca te namaḥ ||74||
sādhusādhvīsvarūpābhyāṃ dārābhāgyāya darśanam |
datvāpyamokṣayad bhūpaṃ taṃ yastasmai ca te namaḥ |||75||
brahmadevadvijapatnyai datvā dve badare phale |
badrikā putrikāputrau dadau badrīśa te namaḥ ||76||
yatpratāpāt kṛṣṇapatnī jātā vai bālayoginī |
sureśvarīsutā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vande narāyaṇam ||77||
yaḥ kṛṣṇo divyadehāṃ ca cāraṇīṃ nāgnakesarīm |
kṛtvā muktānikāṃ ninye’kṣaraṃ tasmai namo namaḥ ||78||

kṛtaṃ yena kṛto devaloko’pi ca sakhīvidhaḥ ||79||

bāhulakāya tatpatnyai līlāvatyai ca nartanāt ||4.120.80||

māliyānaṃ mallikāṃ ca mālākārau hariḥ purā ||81 ||
prasannaḥ pāyayāmāsa brahmarasaṃ tatastayoḥ |
mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtavān kṛṣṇo yastasmai svāmine namaḥ ||82||

mokṣaṃ dadau ca tatpatnyai tasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ ||83||
nigaḍabhrāmakaivartaṃ matsyāśāpāt suduḥkhinam |
tāritaṃ bhaktayā patnyā yasya kṛpādiśevadheḥ ||84||

tathā tatputrikā cādyā sādhvī puṇḍarikā satī || 85||
nirvāṇikā satī cānyānandaghanā tṛtīyakā |
tathā pañcātmajā jñānadarbhyādayo’pi yaṃ prabhum ||86||
bhajitvā mokṣaṇaṃ prāptāstaṃ bhaje svāminaṃ harim |
kṛtaghnyāstu kuthalyākhyastriyā yo rājayakṣmataḥ ||87||

pratāraṇyā viṣalāṇyāḥ satāṃ samāgamāddhariḥ ||88||
uddhāraṃ kṛtavān yastaṃ vande śrīsvāminaṃ prabhum |
gaṃgāṃjanīṃ kaṭakartrīṃ satsaṃgena tvamokṣayat ||89||

sunāriṇīṃ kulālīṃ ca raṇastambaṃ ca tatpatim ||4.120.90||
sādhuyogena tatputraṃ saṃsārād yo vyamocayat |
vande taṃ svāminaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhumīśvaram ||9 1||
svarṇakārastriyā hemasudhāyāstu prabhaktitaḥ |
prasanno yo dadau tasyai cānnapūrṇātvamuttamam ||92||

sakuṭumbāmakarod yastasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ |
rathyāmārjanikāṃ kārelikāṃ hitāñjalermuneḥ |||95|||
yogāt kathāśravaṇena muktimanayad yaḥ prabhuḥ |

nirañjanādayaścāpi bhrātaraḥ pañca tādṛśāḥ ||97||

yantrakartrīṃ gomatīṃ ca nayarājaṃ ca tatpatim ||98||

rāyaharinṛpasyāpi taṃ vande svāminaṃ prabhum || 4.120.10 0||
mādhavarāyanṛpateḥ śreyo vyadhāttu yaḥ prabhuḥ |
vaidyotikāṃ tu kaṃsārīṃ divyāmamokṣayacca yaḥ || 10 1||
nararājaṃ kuṃbhakāraṃ tadbhāryāṃ ratnikāṃ ca yaḥ |

amokṣayaddhariryaśca naṭaṃ rañjanakovidam |
śrīrāmasundaraṃ cāpi kadaryaṃ yo’pyamokṣayat || 1 03||

kṣīrodavīraṃ bhūpaṃ ca rājñīṃ ruhāriṇīṃ ca yaḥ || 1 04||

yāskavādasya ca mokṣaṃ taṃ vande svāminaṃ harim || 1 07||

dvirgarjanākhyapatyuśca taṃ vande svāminaṃ harim || 1 08||
suraprasādaṃ vipraṃ ca gurughnaṃ yo hyamocayat |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tasya cāmokṣayattu yaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 09||
nāgavikramabhūpasya devadroharatasya ca |
navadrohiyutasyāpi mokṣakartre tu te namaḥ || 4.120.11 0||
śālamitro jīvikāghno jayālakṣmīśca tatpriyā |
uddhṛtau yena kṛṣṇena tasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ || 111 ||
kanyāghnaṃ yaddharājaṃ yo viṣadaṃ sādhuyogataḥ |
amocayad yamadūtān taṃ bhaje svāminaṃ harim || 11 2|||
sādhujīvaṃ kumāraṃ ca kumārīṃ sādhujīvanīm |

nārāyaṇyai prabhāvatyai ghaṭamālākhyayoṣite |

anaṃgavallyāḥ kuṭṭanyāstatsakhīnāṃ ca mokṣaṇam |

harivīryādimallām̐ścamokṣayad yaḥ prabhurhariḥ |
vārdhūṣikān harilālādīṃśca vyamokṣayattu yaḥ || 1 19||
kīravaṇādimṛgayūmamokṣayacca yaḥ prabhuḥ |
amokṣayacca nāgādaṃ vādiṭaṃ yaśca te namaḥ || 4.120.1 20||
sārahāsīyamārtaṇḍamaṇḍalādipramokṣakam |

namāmi svāmine tasmai śrīkṛṣṇaprabhave namaḥ |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyanāya yogine || 151 ||
yaḥ sadā śrīhariścāste saptāyatanamūrtimān |
līnā lakṣmīryadaṃge’haṃ varte sāmaparāyaṇā || 152||
prajñā līnā pāśavatī līnā ca svāmini prabhau |
yallīlāḥ śreyase sarvā jīvānāṃ karmadehinām || 153|||
tasmai te pataye cāpyapataye praṇamāmyaham |
sarvadānīśvaravaryottamāya paramātmane || 154||
namo viśiṣṭarūpāya sarvatīrthātitīrthine |
tīrthārthaṃ bhagavan svāmin lokakalyāṇahetave || 155||
abhilāṣā jāyate me mahātmam̐stāṃ prapūrayaḥ |
asaṃkhyajanmabhiḥ kṛṣṇoddhṛtāstvayā hi dehinaḥ || 156||
dharmavṛddhiḥ kṛtā sarvā punaścāpi vibhāvaya |
lakṣmībhaktā bahavo’tra loke bhavanti tān prabho || 157||
sādhurūpeṇa nirbandhān kṛtvā mokṣaya macchritān |
ityarthayāmi bhagavan viramāmi tvayi prabho || 158||
ityuktvā badrike lakṣmīḥ svāminyantaradhīyata |
lakṣmīstavaṃ prabhāṣeta bhāvagarbho’pi yo janaḥ || 159||
lakṣmīvacchrīharau līnasthānameṣyati śāśvatam |
nārī stavamadhīyānā lakṣmīḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 4.120.16 0||
priyā lakṣmīḥ stavājjātā jātā lakṣmīśca mādhavī |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet stotrād yatheṣṭāṃ pārameśvarīm || 161 ||
yatkṛṣṇasya samastaṃ vai tat tasyāḥ syāt samastakam |
śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇadakṣāyāḥ kārṣṇyāḥ śrībadrike svakam || 1 62||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparamātmano vānaprasthadharmottaraṃ sādhudīkṣāgrahaṇaṃ lakṣmīkṛtastavanaṃ lakṣmīprabhṛtīnāṃ svasvāmini śāśvatī līnatetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 20||

<4.121>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
badrike ca tato’nādiḥkṛṣṇonārāyaṇo hariḥ |
lakṣmīṃ prajñāṃ pāśavatīṃ cāntarbhāvya nijātmani || 1 ||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tvekarūpeṇa cāvasat |
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa śriyā yuktena cāntare || 2 ||
sādhurūpeṇa tīrtheṣu yayau śrīyuktamūrtikaḥ |
agocaromuktasevyadevajuṣṭaḥ saekalaḥ || 3 ||
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthajalaṃ pītvāśvasārasam |
jalaṃ pītvācamanaṃ ca kṛtvā snātvā sarovare || 4 ||
śrīgaṇeśaṃ guruṃ cāpi natvā sampūjya bhāvataḥ |
sarvatīrthāni natvāpi kṛtvā saraḥpradakṣiṇam || 5 ||
prayayau cāmravaṇato vyāghrāraṇyaṃ mahattaram |
siṃhāraṇyaṃ yayau paścāt talaśyāmasthalaṃ śubham || 6 ||
snātvā yayau somanāthaṃ prācīpippalamityapi |
mūladvārāvatīṃ naijāṃ tataścoṣṇapuraṃ yayau || 7 ||
gopanāthaṃ yayau paścād gokarṇaṃ prajagāma saḥ |
nṛsiṃheśaṃ śarabheśaṃ kṛtvā vyomnā yayau drutam || 8 ||
nārāyaṇīṃ mahādīrghāṃ sarvottamāṃ nadīṃ parām |
trināsaṃ ca saraścāpi rudalālpasaro yayau || 9 ||
viṣaturīyakasarastrigāyanasarovaram |
nyāyajaṃ ca saraścāpi yayau kaṅgūmahānadīm || 4.121.1 0||
nyāyajarāṃ nadīṃ gatvā bhūmadhyasāgaraṃ yayau |
nīparāṃ prayayau dyūnāṃ vātagāmuralāṃ nadīm || 11 ||
bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi yayābobīṃ mahānadīm |
yāneśīṃ ca yayau kṛṣṇo dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram || 1 2|
āyurāṃ ca nadīṃ ramyāṃ cābdhiṃ yayau tataḥ param |
bahuliṅgasamudraṃ ca gatvā matkuñcikānadīm || 13 ||
gartasrāvasaro gatvā līnapādasaro yayau |
sūparīśasaro gatvā tato’rkeśāṃ nadīṃ yayau || 14||
samudraṃ ca tato gatvāmāñjanīṃ sunadīṃ yayau |
pārānasīṃ nadīṃ gatvollaṃghyasamudramāyatam || 15||
uṣṭrālaye mayūrāṃ ca nadīṃ yayau janārdanaḥ |
kāruliṅgīṃ nadīṃ gatvā yayāvaitasarovaram || 1 6||
grāsakāyāṃ nadīṃ gatvā vyomnā brahmapradeśakam |
āyayau bhagavān badri menakāṅgīṃ mahānadīm || 17||
śālavīnāṃ tathā cairāvatīṃ nadīṃ yayau prabhuḥ |
śikṣāṃgīṃ cāṅgaśikṣāṃgāṃ triyājñikāṃ nadīṃ yayau || 18||
brahmaputrāṃ ca gaṃgāṃ ca godāvarīṃ ca narmadām |
śatruñjitāṃ yayau kṛṣṇastato’śvapaṭṭasārasam || 1 9|||
āyayau bhagavān vyomnākṣarakṣetraṃ nijālayam |
ekonatriṃśāṃ subhagāṃ naijāṃ janmajayantikām ||4.121.20||
vyadhāt kṛṣṇaḥ sādhuveṣaḥ kuṃkumavāpikālaye |
evaṃ śrībhagavān badri lakṣmyā mano’pyapūrayat ||21||
padmāvatyāśca prajñāyāḥ manasyapi hyapūrayat |
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni nadīnadādrisāgarāḥ ||22||
vanabhūgahvarāraṇyagrāmadvīpasurālayāḥ |
yatra tatra yayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyano muhuḥ ||23||
śreyase svastaye kalyāṇāya bhadrāya dehinām |
mokṣāya muktaye nirvāṇāya śāśvatasiddhaye ||24|||
anekān dehinaḥ kṛṣṇa uddadhāra bhavārṇavān |
badrike svecchayā naijakṛpayā līlayā dhiyā || 25||
muhurdeśeṣu sarveṣu bhaktavaśaḥ prayātyapi |
kṛtvoddhāraṃ janānāṃ ca samāyāti nijālayam ||26||
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ rājate sādhubhūṣaṇaḥ |
lakṣaśaḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo yatra vasantyaharniśam ||27||
triśattamādyāḥ kṛṣṇasyotsavā janmanimittajāḥ |
kriyante sādhusādhvyādyasaṃkhyabhaktaiḥ pramodadāḥ ||28||
mucyante’saṃkhyamanujāstadyogāt prativatsaram |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaputrā yugalā ye videśagāḥ |||29||
te’pi tvāgatya pitaraṃ vīkṣya prasevya mādhavam |
prayānti te nijamātāmahadeśān sukhānvitāḥ ||4.121.3 0 ||
asaṃkhyāśca narā nāryo vaiṣṇavā bhaktibhāvanāḥ |
badrike nityamāyānti sevanārthaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||3 1 ||
nikāmaṃ te samprasevya samāsādya manogatam |
prayānti nijadeśām̐śca prāpnuvanti paraṃ sukham |||32|||
paraṃ padaṃ pare dhāma dehānte samprayānti vai |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe tiṣṭhati bhūtale ||33||
sarvathā kārtayugako vyavartata prajāsu vai |
anye yugāḥ prabhāvaṃ na kartuṃ śaktā bhavanti tu ||34||
satye yathā tathā tretāyuge dvāparake tathā |
kalau tathā hareryogāt prajānāṃ kṛtavat sthitiḥ || 35||
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ balaṃ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt |
yathārthaṃ sukhadaṃ cāste sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tadā || 36||
badrike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādiḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairarthitaśca muhurmuhuḥ || 37||
pṛthvyāṃ tasthau lakṣavarṣāṇyūrdhvaṃ ca pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
sahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni sarvagocaraḥ || 38||
sapādalakṣavarṣānte paraṃ dhāma nijaṃ padam |
tenaiva varṣmaṇā divyaśāśvatena yayau hariḥ || 39||
tataḥ kuṃkumavāpyādau mūrtirūpo virājate |
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ carmacakṣuṣāṃ dṛṣṭigocaraḥ ||4.121.40 ||
divyadṛśāṃ tu divyātmā pratyakṣaḥ pūrvavat sadā |
lomaśādestu bhagavān nityapratyakṣa eva ha ||41 ||
sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sādhusvarūpo nityagocaraḥ |
yogināṃ dhyānagamyaśca muktānāṃ dhāmagocaraḥ ||42||
bhaktānāṃ snehavaśago vartate hṛdaye sthitaḥ |
sarvatra vartate sākṣī sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||43||
badrike bahavastasyāvatārāḥ saṃbhavanti hi |
naranārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tasyāvatāra eva ha ||44||
tvaṃ cāpi tasya kṛṣṇasyārdhāṃganāsyavatāriṇī |
bhaja taṃ paramātmānaṃ kāntaṃ bhajāmyahaṃ yathā ||45||
viṣṇubrahmamaheśādyā yathā bhajantyaharniśam |
devarṣipitṛsādhyāśca yathā bhajantyaharniśam ||46||
īśā īśānikā muktā yathā bhajantyaharniśam |
smara kṛṣṇaṃ sadā kāntaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam ||47||
smārayānyān hariṃ taṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
tasyaiva bhajanaṃ badri bhaktiṃ kāraya dehinām ||48||
tasyaiva bhajanenaiva te yāsyanti paraṃ padam |
yathaiva bhajanaṃ tasya mokṣadaṃ ca tathāvidham ||49||
saṃhitāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ nityamodadam |
mayā badri śrāvitāni caritrāṇi harestava ||4.121.50||
bhaktābhaktamokṣadāni camatkāramayāni vai |
tallīlālalitaṃ nāthaṃ hṛdi nidhehi badrike ||51||
śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca
śṛṇvantu munayo lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitām |
ye śroṣyanti bhāgato’pi te yāsyanti parāṃ gatim ||52||
khaṇḍo’tra prathamaścāste kṛtasantānakābhidhaḥ |
dvitīyaśca samāste vai tretāsantānakābhidhaḥ |||53||
tṛtīyo dvāparasantānākhyaḥ khaṇḍo’sya vartate |
caturthastiṣyasantānābhidho’styatra camatkaraḥ ||54||
prathame kṛtasantāne’dhyāyāḥ pañcaśatāni ca |
navatiśca tathādhyāyā vartante dvijamūrtayaḥ ||||55||
ślokāstu pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇi tathā punaḥ |
pañcaśatānyadhikāni saptaviṃśatiyūñji ca |||56||
dvitīye trītasantāne tvadhyāyāstriśatāni ca |
vai dvātriṃśatsahasrāṇi dve śate ca tathā punaḥ ||57||
pañcāśaccāpi catvāraḥ ślokāḥ santi hi tītrake |
tṛtīye dvāparasantānake’dhyāyāḥ śatadvayam ||58||
saptatriṃśat tathā santi mokṣadā divyavigrahāḥ |
ślokāḥ santi sahasrāṇi pañcaviṃśatirapyatha ||59||
śataṃ ṣaṣṭiśca vai dve ca muktidā bhaktidāḥ khalu |
caturthe tiṣyasantāne’ghyāyāstu śatamityapi ||4.121.60 ||
trayoviṃśatiścāpyeva vartante brahmadhāmadāḥ |
ślokāḥ santi trayodaśasahasrāṇi tathopari ||6 1||
aṣṭātriṃśatisarve sākṣānmokṣapradāḥ parāḥ |
catuḥsantānarūpāyāḥ saṃhitāyāstu sarvaśaḥ |||62||
adhyāyāścaikasāhasraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ hi śatānyapi |
pañcāśat santi ca tathā sarvathā mokṣakāriṇaḥ |||62|||
asyāḥ pūrṇasaṃhitāyāḥ ślokāstu caikalakṣakam |
tadūrdhvaṃ tu pañcaviṃśatisahasrāṇi vai tathā ||64||
navaśatāni caikāśītiratadūrdhvaṃ bhavanti hi |
tato’tiriktāḥ saptāpi vidyante ślokakā api |||65||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīvallabhaprabhuḥ |
munayo nyavasat pṛthvyāṃ lakṣavarṣāṇi tatparam ||66||
pañcaviṃśatisahasrāṇyapi pañcaśatāni ca |
tatra kṛtāścamatkārāḥ saṃkhyātuṃ cāpya gocarāḥ ||67||
sādhurūpeṇa kṛṣṇena kṛtā ye ye tu te’khilāḥ |
likhitā vai sādhusaṃhitāyāṃ sādhubhirādarāt ||68||
sanatkumāraprabhṛtibhistu mokṣaparāyaṇaiḥ |
śloke śloke’tra sarvatra hareryogena dehinām ||69||
mokṣecchayā kṛṣṇakṛpā siñcitā durlabhā tu yā |
kṛpāmūrtisvarūpeyaṃ saṃhitā mokṣadā tataḥ ||4.121.70||
lakṣmīrūpā saṃhiteyaṃ saṃhitā śrīsvarūpiṇī |
yathā lakṣmīstathā ceyaṃ yathā ceyaṃ tathā ramā ||71||
dayitānādikṛṣṇasyārdhāṃganā mokṣadāyinī |
pāvanī sarvalokānāṃ jananī muktigāminām ||72||
poṣaṇī caihikānāṃ tu sampatpradāṃ tu kāminām |
kṛṣṇakaṇṭhād divyarūpā cāvirbhūteyamīśvarī ||73||
śrutirūpā tataśceyaṃ vedavad vedinī tviyam |
vedānāṃ phaladā ceyaṃ pūjitā vācitā śrutā ||74||
sadā śāntikarī ceyaṃ muktivanmodakāriṇī |
rādhāvad ṛddhisiddhidhrā sarvarddhisiddhidāyinī || 75|||
nārāyaṇī mūrtimatī nārāyaṇasya bodhinī |
nārāyaṇaprāptikarī pūjitā vācitā śrutā ||73||
vaiṣṇavīyaṃ mūrtimatī vaiṣṇavānāṃ pramodinī |
yoginī yugavārtānāṃ bodhinī brahmayoginī ||77||
brahmarūpakarī śroturvaktuḥ pūjayitustathā |
svāheyaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ phaladā dakṣiṇātmikā ||78||
prajñeyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavallabhamūrtijā |
brahmapārapradā ceyaṃ yajñāvabhṛtharūpiṇī ||79||
sarasvatī brahmapatnī nityā vāṇī hareriyam |
satāmāśīrvādarūpā lomaśena vikāsitā ||4.121.80 ||
śvaitiprabhatiśiṣyaiśca sanakādyaiḥ supoṣitā |
dyaurdivyā devakoṭīnāṃ sajīvanaprakāriṇī ||8 1 ||
mahāsādhvī satī devī divyeyaṃ cācyutī matā |
gaṃgeyaṃ pāpavidhvaṃsakāriṇī viṣṇudhāriṇī ||82||
śiveyaṃ śivadā svastipradānandapradā sadā |
saṃjñeyaṃ mānadā saurī gāyatrī trāṇadā parā ||83||
svadheyaṃ sarvapitṝṇāṃ pretānāṃ śreyasāmpradā |
kaumudīyaṃ sudhāsvādapradā cāndrī sarojanī ||84||
padmeyaṃ padmikā padmadharīvāvyayakāriṇī |
annapūrṇā kṛṣṇatṛptyābhogasukhapradāyinī |||85||

hānumatī mahāśaktiḥ śīlinī brahmavarculā ||86||

yamuneyaṃ yamalokagatinirodhinī svasā ||88||

kāmadhenuriyaṃ drogdhrī kṛṣṇasaurabhadāyinī ||89||

amṛteyaṃ sevakānāṃ mahāmṛtapradāyinī ||4.121.90||
kalpavallī śāśvatīyaṃ manovāñcchāprapūraṇī |
akṣayyapātrikā ceyaṃ kṛṣṇakathākṣayānvitā || 91 ||
kalpadrumasvarūpeyaṃ sarvārtharasavarṣiṇī |
cintāmaṇiḥ saṃhiteyaṃ sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇacintanī || 92||

sarvavratamahāśālā saṃhiteyaṃ phalapradā || 93 ||

dhārmikīyaṃ dharmarakṣākartrī dharmasya dhāriṇī |
vibhūtiḥ śāśvatīyaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇasyāvatāriṇī || 95 ||
saṃkrāntiḥ sahiteyaṃ ca kṛṣṇasaṃkrāntiyoginī |
mahotsavī sadā ceyaṃ śroturvaktuḥ samutsavā ||96||
amūrtā śabdamūrteyaṃ kṛṣṇajihvā rasābharā |
kṛṣṇayoniḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānandapradāyinī || 97||
mokṣavimānikā śreṣṭhā dhāmasṛtiḥ sukomalā |
kṛṣṇaśayyātmikā divyā kṛṣṇapārśvapradāyinī || 98 ||
śrīkṛṣṇāsyasvarūpeyaṃ kṛṣṇatāmbūlapāyinī |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmarūpiṇī tviyam || 99 ||
bahunā kiṃ sādhavīyaṃ catuḥpumarthadāyinī |
tulasīmālikeyaṃ ca sādhvīdīkṣeyamityapi || 4.121.100 ||
mahāsaṃnyāsinī ceyaṃ kaṇṭhīyaṃ saṃhitā sadā |
ṛtambhareyaṃ satataṃ sattvaprakarṣiṇī tviyam || 101 ||
ātivāhikadevīyaṃ parāvidyeyamavyayā |
vidhiśaktiriyaṃ śāstrī bhaktimūrtiriyaṃ tathā || 102||
duḥkhahāśrīriyaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā |
lakṣāśvamedhayajñānāṃ phaladā vācitā śrutā || 103 ||
lakṣaviṣṇumakhānāṃ ca puṇyadā mokṣadā śubhā |
sarvavidhānāṃ tapasāṃ phaladā śāntidā tathā || 1 04||
sarvavratānāṃ tīrthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ puṇyadāyinī |
koṭidhenugajāśvānāṃ dānānāṃ phaladottamā || 1 05||
brahmāṇḍadānaphaladā jīvābhayapradāyinī |
koṭikanyādānaphalā koṭiśrīdānasadṛśī || 1 06||
upaniṣat mūrtimatī kṛṣṇasannidhikāriṇī |
ātmavidyā hyakāmānāṃ sakāmānāṃ tu ceṣṭadā || 1 07||
dhanadā putradā putrīpradārogyayaśaḥpradā |
rājyadā puṣṭidā nārīpradā ceṣṭapatipradā || 108 ||
svargadā dhāmadā mokṣapradā kṛṣṇāṃkavāsadā |
sarvadā sarvadā ceyaṃ saṃhitā hitadānvaham || 10 9||
gṛhasthā tu gṛhasthānāṃ gṛhasthitiprapoṣiṇī |
hṛdisthā tu satāṃ saccidānandahariyoginī || 4.121.11 0||
sarvasaubhāgyadā ceyaṃ sarvotkarṣapradāyinī |
anantānandadhāmākhyasāmrājyasukhavarṣiṇī || 111 ||
vartate saṃhitā ceyaṃ mahāmuktānikā kṣitau |
pratyekamasyāḥ santānāḥ putrā nārāyaṇasya vai || 112|
nārāyaṇasamā mokṣe bale kīrtau ca sampadi |
yathā kṛtaḥ sarvadharme tretā yathākhile makhe || 1 13||
dvīto yathākhile dāne tiṣyo’khile jape’tulaḥ |
kṛtaḥ sāmarthyasañjuṣṭastretā divyacaritravān || 1 14||
dvītaśca divyalīlāḍhyastiṣyaḥ śaraṇitārakaḥ |
satyaḥ svātmabaloddhartā tretā surādisaṃśrayāt || 1 15||
dvītaḥ kṛṣṇacamatkārāt tiṣyaḥ sādhusamāgamāt |
tiṣyo’yaṃ kṛṣṇasantānaḥ kevalaḥ paṭhitaḥ śritaḥ || 1 16||
śrutaśca śrāvitaścāpi pūjitaśca gṛhe’vitaḥ |
smṛto guṇairgṛhītaśca tārayatyāśritān drutam || 1 17||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kānakīṃ śubhām |
hareḥ supratimāṃ kṛtvā tiṣyasantānakaṃ tvimam || 1 18||
dadyād dāne tu yo bhaktyā viduṣe brahmavādine |
vaiṣṇavāya viśeṣeṇācāryāya gurave’pi ca || 1 19||
viprāyādhyāpakāyāpi kathāvācanaśīline |
dhenuṃ vatsāyutāṃ sarvopaskaraṇādisaṃyutām || 4.121.1 20||
śayyāṃ prapūrṇāṃ mṛdvīṃ ca pātrāṇi cārpayettathā |
saratnadhānyavastrādi dadyād yaḥ sa tu mokṣabhāk || 121 ||
sakāmaḥ svargamāsādya brahmakalpāyureva ca |
bhuktvā bhogān prayātyeva saṃhitādānato’kṣaram || 1 22||
tiṣyasantānakaścāyaṃ sadbhāvādhāyakaḥ satām |
satsu snehakaraḥ sevādharmabodhapradastathā || 1 23||
pāpānāmapi sarveṣāṃ kṣālakaḥ pāpimokṣadaḥ |
śaraṇāgatajīvānāṃ brahmadhāmapradaḥ sukhaḥ || 1 24||
api sādhorharervāpi pāpī prasādadhug bhavet |
tiryag vā svedajo’ṇḍottho jarājo vā samucyate || 1 25||
tiṣyādhyāyaṃ gṛhe tvekaṃ vācayed yaḥ samāhitaḥ |
tiṣyasantānapāṭhasya labhate sa phalaṃ drutam || 1 26||
munayaḥ tiṣyapāṭhānāṃ tiṣyavego na bādhate |
tiṣyadoṣā na jāyante yamo’sya yāti dūrataḥ || 1 27||
tiṣyakathāśravaṇārthī matkṛpāpātrameva saḥ |
sarvamokṣapradān sādhūn śritvā yatlabhate’kṣaram || 128||
yasya dānaṃ tapo dharmastapo japo na śīlatā |
tasya tiṣyāśrayād sādhvīsādhvāśrayāt pramokṣaṇam || 129||
svarṇavimānakaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpya tiṣyakhaṇḍakam |
prapūjya cārpayet pātre dātā vimānago’kṣare || 4.121.1 30||
sarvakuṭumbasahito modate harimandire |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca labhate śāśvatīṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 131 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya munirūpeṇāpareṇa divyenasvarūpeṇa śrīmanorathapūraṇārthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthābhigamanaṃ, punaḥ kuṃkumavāpikāgamanam, tiṣyasantānasya samastasaṃhitāyāścādhyāyaślokasaṃkhyānirdeśaḥ, samastasaṃhitāyāstiṣyasantānasya ca dānādimahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 12 1||

<4.122>
śrīśvetāyano vyāsa uvāca
śṛṇuta śrīsaṃhitāyāḥ puraścaraṇamuttamam |
sarvāyāstu saṃhitāyāḥ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 1 ||
svayaṃ paṭhet pāṭhayedvā cāṣṭottaraśatadvijaiḥ |
vaiṣṇavaiḥ sādhusādhvībhirbrahmaśīlaparāyaṇaiḥ || 2 ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ viśālaṃ kuṇḍamaṇḍapam |
paritaḥ sthāpayed saumyāsanāni corṇajāni tu || 3 ||
kāṣṭhāsanādīni cāpi tvekaikaṃ pustakaṃ tathā |
śreṣṭhāsane tu pratyeke sthāpayet pūjayettataḥ || 4 ||
ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca tataḥ pāṭhāni kārayet |
pratyahaṃ pūrikākṣīrapāyasānnāni bhojayet || 5 ||
yadyadapekṣitaṃ sarvaṃ dadyāttu dāpayettathā |
māsaṃ pārāyaṇaṃ cātra puraścaraṇamātrakam || 6 ||
dvimāsaṃ vā kārayecca catuḥpumarthasiddhidam |
ṣāṇmāsikaṃ kārayedvā vārṣikaṃ vācayecca vā || 7 ||
nityaṃ sādhūn vaiṣṇavām̐śca dīnānāthān prabhojayet |
viprān sādhvīrbālikāśca bālakān bhojayedapi || 8 ||
svarṇarūpyakapātrāṇāṃ dānāni dāpayettathā |
dhanāmbarakaṇānāṃ cānnānāṃ dānāni kārayet || 9 ||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ śriyā samam |
pūjanaṃ kārayennityaṃ havanaṃ cācarettathā || 4.122.1 0||
rādhālakṣmīramāprajñāvatīśrīmāṇikīyutam |
pūjayet paramātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim || 11 ||
daśāṃśahomaṃ nityaṃ vai kārayed ghṛtapāyasaiḥ |
samidbhiḥ puṇyavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣparasādibhiḥ || 12|
māsapārāyaṇe’dhyāyān nityaṃ vai vācayed vratī |
dvyadhicatvāriṃśadeva dvimāse tu tadardhataḥ || 13||
ṣaṇmāse cānvahaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ varṣamātre trikaṃ trikam |
nyūnādhikaṃ yathāyogaṃ vibhajya vācayed vratī || 14||
ślokānāṃ saṃkhyayānityaṃ dṛśāṃśahavanaṃ caret |
dakṣiṇā bahudhā dadyād vācakebhyaḥ sukhapradāḥ || 15||
pustakaṃ navavastreṇa veṣṭayitvā prapūjitam |
bhrāmayennagare svarṇahastisthitaṃ sacāmaram || 16||
dānaṃ tataḥ pradadyācca mukhyavācakasādhave |
chatradānaṃ pādukādānakaṃ vastrādidānakam || 17||
bhūṣāgobhūhiraṇyādi dadyād vai mukhyasādhave |
suvācakāya gurave vidyācāryāya yogine || 18 ||
vaiṣṇavāya viśeṣeṇa dadyād viprāya bhāvataḥ |
bhojayed vipravaryāṃśca sādhūn sādhvīśca bālakān || 19||
bhaktām̐śca vaiṣṇavān sarvān bhojayecca visarjayet |
evaṃ puraścaraṇena sveṣṭān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||4.122.20 ||
mahādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi samrāḍyogyaṃ nibodha me |
sārvabhaumo mahārājastvāgnīdhraḥ pradadau purā || 21 ||
svāyambhuvo manuścāpi pradadau gomatītaṭe |
kuberaḥ pradadau cāpi viśālāyāṃ himālaye || 22||
koṭirāyo dadau cāpi sindhutaṭe’bdhisannidhau |
evamanye pradaduśca yathākālaṃ yathādhanam ||23||
sārvabhaumamahādānaṃ gadyate tanmayā śṛṇu |
atra ye kīrtitā devā bhaktā devyaḥ pramuktigāḥ |||24||
sarvanāmāni saṃgṛhya kārayitvā suvarṇajāḥ |
pratimāḥ koṭiśaḥ sarvā dadyād dāne sutīrthake ||25|||
saṃhitādevatā yatra caikāpi nātiricyate |
sarvadevatā dadyād vai dāne godānapūrvakam || 26||
pūjayitvā vidhānena dadyād vipreṣu sādhuṣu |
satpātreṣu samasteṣu puṇyapāro na vidyate || 27||
śrīharerbhagavato’rthaṃ yena, hma sarvasvamarpitam |
sa eva kartuṃ śaknoti mahādānaṃ yathārthataḥ |||28||
sa tārayejjagatsarvaṃ mahādānabalāt khalu |
mahādānapradātustu sannidhau gocaro hariḥ ||29||
lakṣmīśca gocarā nityaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ |
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāyajñaṃ kuryāt prakārayecca yaḥ || 4.122.30||
tasyarddhayaḥ samastāḥ syurakṣayyā vṛddhimāgatāḥ |
kārtike’syā dānakartā brahmā bhavati viśvasṛṭ ||3 1||
mārgaśīrṣe pradātāsyā nārāyaṇāḥ prajāyate |
pauṣe dātā saṃhitāyā rudro bhavati śaṃkaraḥ ||32||
māghe dātā saṃhitāyā viṣṇuḥ prajāyate khalu |
phālgune’syāḥ pradātā tu jāyate dhanado’calaḥ ||33||
caitre’syā dānakartā vai jāyate sūryadevatā |
vaiśākhe dānakṛcchreṣṭho dhruvo bhavati vaiṣṇavaḥ ||34||
jyeṣṭhe dātā virāṭ syāccāṣāḍhe dātā sadāśivaḥ |
śrāvaṇe tu mahāviṣṇurbhaved dātā na saṃśayaḥ ||35||
bhādre dātā mahendraḥ syādāśvine tu bṛhaspatiḥ |
adhimāse pradātāsyā vāsudevaḥ prajāyate ||36||
evaṃ dānaphalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saṃproktaṃ matkṛpodbhavam |
nārī dātro bhaved rādhā ramā lakṣmīśca mādhavī ||37||
dāridryāni samastāni naśyantyasyāḥ pradānataḥ |
trividhānyapi duḥkhāni naśyantyasyāḥ pradānataḥ ||38||
sampūrṇāṃ saṃhitāṃ caitāṃ nidhāya gajamastake |
yadvā svarṇagaje svarṇasaṃhitāṃ praṇidhāya ca ||39||
dadyād yastasya sāmrājyaṃ caturdaśabhuvāṃ bhavet |
manuḥ syāt khaṇḍadātāpi samastāyāḥ prado hariḥ ||4.122.40||
asyāḥ ślokasya vai vakturnāsadgatirbhavet kvacit |
sarvavarṇāśramadharmaphalaṃ cāsyāḥ pradānataḥ ||41 ||
yo vidvān saṃhitāṃ cemāṃ kaṇṭhe kṛtvā tvaviṣyati |
sa tu tenaiva dehena divyabhāvena sarvathā ||42||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇāt prāptavimānena paraṃ padam |
prayāsyatyākṣaramuktaiḥ śaṃsitaḥ pūjitaḥ suraiḥ ||43||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā yo hṛdi dhārakaḥ |
sṛṣṭyantare bhavedeṣaḥ vaikuṇṭhadhāmna īśvaraḥ ||44||
nārī syādīśvarī lakṣmīrvaikuṇṭhasvāminī sadā |
eṣaṇāvān labheteṣṭaṃ sakāmaḥ kāmanāṃ labhet ||45||
niṣkāmo mokṣaṇaṃ preyānnaro nārāyaṇo bhavet |
nārī nārāyaṇī syācca saṃhitādhāraṇāt sadā ||46||
catuṣṭayaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śāśvatīṃ bhūtimicchatā |
lakṣmīpūjā harerdhyānaṃ dānamasyāḥ kathāśrutiḥ ||47||
catuṣṭayaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣamicchatā |
satāṃ sevā harerbhaktirlīlāsmṛtistadarpaṇam ||48||
catuṣṭayaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śāśvatīṃ śāntimicchatā |
anārambhaśca nivṛttirjapo vivekitātmani ||49||
ya iha sumatimān syācchāśvatānandamicchet,
tribhuvanasupatitvaṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ patitvam ||
api ca paramamuktiṃ cāvatārātmakatvam,
pibatu sa satataṃ śrīsaṃhitotthāmṛtāni ||4.122.50||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’syāḥ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ puraścaraṇavidhiḥ, sārvabhaumamahādānavidhiḥ, saṃhitādhāraṇāyāḥ phalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 22||

<4.123>
śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu śrībadarīdevi nārāyaṇi pareśvari |
tiṣyasantānaviṣayān saṃkṣepāt smārayāmi te || 1 ||
caturthe tiṣyasantāne naranārāyaṇasya me |
śrībadaryāḥ svarūpasya vartanaṃ te samīritam || 2 ||
rājarṣerbadarākhyasyākhyānaṃ himācalasya ca |
hemānalāsurasyaiva garte nikṣepa īritaḥ || 3 ||
śrīmāṇikyā badarīśīrūpatādi prakīrtitam |
śrīśīlasya tu viprasya pretasya muktirīritā || 4 ||
dārābhāgyākhyabhūpasya parīkṣaṇaṃ ca mokṣaṇam |
brahmadevadvijasyāpi vaṃśavattvakathoditā || 5 ||
badaryā bālayoginyā gītoktā brahmabhāvadā |
dāsyaṃ bhāgavatatvaṃ ca vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ca yogitā || 6 ||
parabrahmapremarasavarṇanaṃ ceti kīrtitam |
satsevayā nāgnamukhīcāraṇyā muktirīritā || 7 ||
vinodinyāstu kāntasya bhaktyā nārāyaṇāgamaḥ |
devalikātmakatvaṃ cetyetat sarvamudīritam || 8 ||
bāhulakasya ca līlāvatyā bhaktirudāhṛtā |
saptadaśo’nādikṛṣṇajanmotsavastathoditaḥ || 9 ||
māliyānamallikayo sevayā muktirīritā |
jñānalabhyo brahmarasaścopāstyā kathitastataḥ || 4.123.1 0||
rasapradādhidharmāṇāṃ mahāyogasya varṇanam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca bālayoginīn || 1 1||
vivāhayāmāsa kathā caiṣā tata udīritā |
sadbhaktasya tato nikāmadevasya ca mokṣaṇam || 12||
svarūpayogarūpaṃ ca parabrahmaṇi coditam |
tato viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmā harirudīritaḥ ||1 3||
nirbhayayogakathanaṃ stutiścāpi tathoditā |
stutikartryai tathā stotre hyakhiladhāmidarśanam || 14||
sadehadivyamuktiśca tayostata udīritā |
nigaḍabhramaṇādīnāṃ kaivartānāṃ pramokṣaṇam || 15||
pipaṭhāyanayogena tata uktaṃ hi badrike |
ekalāyāśca kuśalīsāgaryā rājayakṣmataḥ || 16||
rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cāpi tata uktaṃ hi badrike |
vañcayitryā viṣalāṇyāḥ satāṃ prasādabhojanāt || 17||
muktiruktā tato gaṃgāñjanyā mokṣa udīritaḥ |
ramāñjanyā ramātva ca mokṣaṇaṃ samudīritam || 18||
striyāṃ raṇastambakumbhakārasya sādhusevayā |
candramāḥ putratāṃ prāptastato mokṣaṃ udīritaḥ ||19||
tato devasudhānāmnyāḥ svarṇakartryāścamatkṛtiḥ |
durbhikṣe’saṃkhyajīvānāṃ bhojanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ||4.123.20||
viṣṭināryā vidrumiṇyāḥ satsaṃgena ca divyatā |
cāṇḍālyā mālavānyāśca sevayā dharmadarśanam ||21 ||
mūrtamantradarśanaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ cāpyudīritam |
kārelikāyāḥ śūdryāśca nirmohitvamudāhṛtam ||22||
badrikāyanasādhośca mūkatā śāpamokṣaṇam |
yantrakartryāśca gomatyāḥ kṣayaroganivāraṇam ||23||
kanakāṃgadāyā mokṣaḥ sādhūnāṃ sevayā kṛtaḥ |
rāyaharibhāṇavāṇyorunmattayostu muktaye ||24||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathādivācanam |
aṣṭādaśo harerjanmamahotsava udīritaḥ ||25||
nārāyaṇasaraḥsthānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ rucchabhūbhṛtaḥ |
pāvanatvaṃ tathā vidyotāyā mokṣaṃ udīritaḥ ||26||
kuṃbhakārakuṭumbasya svarṇakārastriyāstathā |
dhātudhmāyā naṭasyāpi kadaryasyāpi mokṣaṇam ||27||
kṣīrodanṛpateḥ patnyāḥ prajānāṃ muktirīritā |
somikādigaṇikānāṃ mokṣaṃ udīritastataḥ ||28||
duḥkhanāśo madyapasya mokṣaśca hariṇā kṛtaḥ |
cakriṇo yāskavādasya bahūnāṃ mokṣa īritaḥ ||29||
nindakayordvivadantīrdvirgarjanābhidhānayoḥ |
yamadūtadarśanaṃ ca mokṣastata udīritaḥ ||4.123.30||
suraprasādaviprasya guruhantuḥ kathāśravāt |
satāṃ prasevayā mokṣastata ukto hi badrike ||3 1||
kārāgrahe patitānāṃ devadrohavatāṃ sadā |
nāgavikramādīnāṃ ca rakṣāmokṣa udīritau ||32||
śālamitranṛpateśca rājñyāścāyurvināśanam |
mokṣaṇaṃ saṃhitākathāśravaṇāt samudīritam ||33||
yuddharājasya ca viṣapradasya kanyakādiṣu |
yamadūtāgamo mṛtyuḥ sādhukṛtaṃ ca rakṣaṇam ||34||
vyavāyinyā garbhahantryā anaṃgavallarīstriyāḥ |
pāpanāśo mokṣaṇaṃ ca kathāśrayādudīritam || 35||
ṣaṇḍhavajrādiṣaṇḍhānāṃ kathāśravāt pramokṣaṇam |
napuṃsakānāmanyeṣāṃ puṃstrīvyañjakatoditā ||36||
ghātakino yavasandhyākhyasya muktirudīritā |
bhaṇḍaśīlākhyabhāṇḍasya bhavāyanasya mokṣaṇam ||37||
harṣavīryādimallānāṃ mṛgayūṇāṃ ca badrike |
vārdhūṣikāṇāṃ mokṣaśca kathāśravādudīritaḥ |||28|||
nāgādasya vādiṭasya sārahāse ca khelinām |
kathāsādhuprasaṃgena mokṣastataḥ udīritaḥ ||39||
vilāsadevaviprasya luñcādasya ca dīkṣaṇam |
duritaghoṣasaṃjñasya dīkṣaṇaṃ kīrtitaṃ tataḥ ||4.123.40||
śīlayānyāḥ svāminaśca dharmabhaṭasya mokṣaṇam |
nyāyākṣiṇyāḥ svāminaśca nyāyādhīśasya mokṣaṇam ||41 ||
viśālarekhakāyasthādīnāṃ coktaṃ ca mokṣaṇam |
śāhavilāpanakṣatriyasyoktaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||42||
daṇḍāraṇikaulikasya gṛdhrajanmani mokṣaṇam |
govārasya biḍālajanmanaścoktaṃ pramokṣaṇam ||43||
ṭhaṭṭholavaṇijo mokṣaḥ proktaḥ śṛgālajanmanaḥ |
svarṇāñjanānibhṛtyānāṃ sevayoktaṃ pramokṣaṇam ||44||
ajāpālasyāpi muktiruktā ca śyenajanmanaḥ |
ajānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ coktaṃ caṭakājanmanāṃ tataḥ ||45||
kapotānāṃ purā sārthavāhānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā |
purā tu kaṃkajātīnāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kākapakṣiṇām ||46||
nāṇakinyāḥ khavāsinyā gṛhagodhākhyajanmani |
mokṣaṇaṃ saṃghavāṭādiśūdrāṇāmākhujanmanām ||47||
sāgaradānavāruṭakīratārākhyabhāṭayoḥ |
puṇyavatyāḥ svāminaśca devagatīśvarasya ca ||48||
jayamānabandinaśca vajravikramabhūbhṛtaḥ |
kathāśravaṇataḥ proktaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ badrike tataḥ ||49||
saptābdhisiṃhanṛpateḥ sarpadaṣṭasya mokṣaṇam |
harṣanayanasaṃjñasya māgadhasyāpi mokṣaṇam ||4.123.50||
yogidāsasya mokṣaśca kathito badrike tataḥ |
saurabhasāvitranāmnastāmcūlinaśca mokṣaṇam ||51 ||
ragilākhyaraṃgakarturmokṣa uktastataḥ param |
ḍamarūkābhidhavādyakārasyoktaṃ ca mokṣaṇam |||5 2 ||
cihnarāyābhidhabhāvasārasyoktaṃ ca mokṣaṇam |
svarṇāstaraṇādīnāṃ ca vidyādhrāṇāṃ pramokṣaṇam | | 5 3 ||
citrabarhādigandharvottamānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
kinnarāṇāṃ cāraṇānāṃ siddhānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||54||

nagare bhramaṇaṃ sarvarājarāṣṭrādiṣu prabhoḥ ||55||

uktaḥ sarvamedhayajño nāgavikramabhūpateḥ || 5 6 ||

vairājeśvaraprabhṛtilokeṣu dhāmasūrdhvagaḥ || 64||

kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ siṃhāraṇyādibhūmiṣu || 65||

tatra sarvābhiriṣṭāni hyapatyāni harestadā ||66||
sarvābhyaḥ pradadau tatra yugalāpatyakāni saḥ |
mānasāni hi divyāni na garbhajāni badrike || 67||
teṣāṃ saṃskāravidhayaḥ kathitāśca tataḥ param |
tiṣyasvabhāvakathanaṃ tiṣyaguṇapravarṇanam ||68 ||

sanatkumāramuninā kṛtaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||69 ||

gatvā koṭivimānaiḥ pradarśya pūritavān prabhuḥ ||72||
patnīnāṃ muktapuṃrūpatvaṃ ca vrahmahradāplavaḥ |
koṭiśṛṃgādrivīkṣā ca nṛtyamaṇḍapavīkṣaṇam ||73||

rāṣṭramaṇḍalavīkṣā cākṣaradhāmapurekṣaṇam ||74||
brahmamaholavīkṣā cāvatārālayavīkṣaṇam |
varṇitaṃ sarvamevaitat tataḥ paramadhāmani ||75||
gamanaṃ tadrahasyopaniṣadādivivecanam |
aṣṭadurgavarṇanaṃ ca parabrahmapurasya ca ||76||

lakṣmīkṛtaṃ stavanaṃ ca tatastīrthābhiyātrikā ||8 1 ||
harerlakṣmyā sahitasya punaḥ kuṃkumavāpikām |

saṃhitādhyāyasaṃkhyā ca ślokasaṃkhyā hyudīritā |

yeṣāṃ śravaṇātsmaraṇānmuktiṃ vindati dehavān ||85||

kathitā badrike tasmāt jñātavyāstattadantataḥ ||86||

paṭhanācchravaṇāddhyānād bhuktirmuktirmiled dhruvā ||87||

ehyāgaccha mahānandapayodhau syāva tanmayau |
śrīkṛṣṇasvāmijānandaṃ bhujyāsvāti yatheṣṭakam ||89||
śrīśvetakṛṣṇāyano vyāsa uvāca
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāṃ kathāyāṃ prāha badrikā |
dhanyāsmi tāpasī cāhaṃ mahābhāgyānvitāsmi ca ||4.123.90||
yāhaṃ śaktiścārdhamūrtiḥ puruṣottamarūpiṇī |
avaimi māṃ māṇikīṃ ca mādhavīṃ ca pramātmikām ||9 1 ||

svāmī kānto’nādikṛṣṇonārāyaṇo’sti me patiḥ ||92||

sa bhavāniha badrīnārāyaṇo’sti narānvitaḥ ||93||
sāhaṃ nārāyaṇībadrī sarveśī puruṣottamī |

mannimittena lokānāṃ paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati |
dhanyeyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dhanyāśca mānavā ime ||95||
yeṣāṃ nārāyaṇo bhartā dhartā kartāvitā sadā |
dhanyā nāryaḥ sarvavidhāḥ kṛpā yāsu hareḥ śubhā ||96||
sarvābhyo’pi viśeṣeṇa kṛpā ṣaṭsu hi cakriṇaḥ |

nārāyaṇīśriyāṃ cāpi puruṣottamarūpiṇaḥ ||98||
naranārāyaṇasyāpi badaryā mayi śāśvatī |
lakṣmyai nārāyaṇenātra śrāvitaḥ kṛtakhaṇḍakaḥ ||99||
rādhāyai kṛṣṇarūpeṇa śrāvitastrītakhaṇḍakaḥ |
puruṣottamarūpeṇa nārāyaṇīśriyai tathā || 4.123.100||
śrāvito dvāparasantānako mahyaṃ tvayāntimaḥ |
prajñāyai pāśavatyai ca gṛhagītādyudīritam ||1 01 ||
eṣāhaṃ bhagavannasmi patitā pādayostava |

virāmaṃ labha me svāminnaiṣā dhyāyāmi taṃ harim |
ityuktvā badarī tūrṇaṃ dhyānamagnā yato’bhavat || 10 3||
tāvattatrābhavattūrṇaṃ mahāścaryaṃ mahādbhutam |

bibhūṣāṇāṃ pādayośca karayoḥ kaṭivakṣasoḥ ||1 05||

tādṛśo dṛśyate tasmai catasraḥ padmamālikāḥ |

kṛtvā prapūjya yugmāni cāstaut tadgatamānasā |
vihvalā snehihṛdayā pūrṇakāmāpi saṃhitā || 127||
vicarati yo’kṣare paratare nijadhāmni

nijatanurūpiṇībhiranugābhiramābhirayaṃ

iti smṛtvā paraṃ kāntaṃ dadmaścāśīrvacāṃsi vai |
oṃ namo’nādiśāstṛśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya om || 162||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne tiṣyasantānaviṣayāḥ, badrikānārāyaṇasannidhau saṃhitāyāḥ kumārīrūpeṇāvirbhāvaḥ, śrīnārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇaśrīnaranārāyaṇānāṃ svasvaśaktibhiḥ sākaṃ tatraiva āvirbhāvaḥ, saṃhitāyai varadānāni, kathāśravaṇaphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 123 ||
iti śrītiṣyasantānakhaṇḍaḥ ||
